# %player:dimension% Placeholder

### This mod will no longer be updated because I just noticed [TextPlaceholderAPI already does this](https://github.com/Patbox/TextPlaceholderAPI/blob/1.20/src/main/java/eu/pb4/placeholders/impl/placeholder/builtin/WorldPlaceholders.java#L72). :(

Adds placeholders that return the (mod that adds the) dimension a player is in.  
To be used with mods that implement [Placeholders API](https://placeholders.pb4.eu).

Placeholders:
- `%player:dimension%` - returns the dimension a player is in
- `%player:dimension_mod%` - returns the name of the "mod" that adds the dimension a player is in
- `%player:dimension_raw%` - returns dimension path
- `%player:dimension_mod_raw%` - returns dimension namespace

Examples:

Minecraft's "The Nether":
- `dimension` = `The Nether`
- `dimension_mod` = `Minecraft`
- `dimension_raw` = `the_nether`
- `dimension_mod_raw` = `minecraft`

Ad Astra's "Moon"
- `dimension` = `Moon`
- `dimension_mod` = `Ad Astra`
- `dimension_raw` = `moon`
- `dimension_mod_raw` = `ad_astra`

etc.

Planned features:
- Configurable colors for dimensions (green for overworld, red for the_nether, purple for the_end, ...)

title: Immersive Creative
description: A datapack which adds a creative superflat dimension, complete with integrated immersive portals compatibility.
body:
# Immersive Creative
This Datapack adds a creative dimension and configurations for Immersive Portals, allowing you to seamlessly walk from your survival world to a creative superflat with seperate inventories.


### Dependencies
[Immersive Portals](https://github.com/iPortalTeam/ImmersivePortalsMod) and [Dimensional Inventories](https://modrinth.com/mod/dimensional-inventories) are the core mods required to add full functionality to the pack.

I recommend my custom-made [Multiversal Vanilla](https://modrinth.com/modpack/multiversalvanilla) modpack for the best experience. It's been thoroughly tested and contains as many performance-enhancing mods as possible without conflicting with immersive portals, as well as some QOL mods and some extra audiovisual enhancement goodies.

### Installation
1) Install your preference of the optional dependencies above.
2) Back up your Minecraft world.
3) Drop the datapack into your world folder.
4) Drop the preset from the [github repo](https://github.com/SlyAquaGuy/immersive-gamemodes/tree/main/dimensionalinventories) into the dimensionalinventories folder or configure Dimensional Inventories using `/diminv`.

# Features 

### Vanilla First
The datapack minimally works on a vanilla installation *(you can use `/tp` to swap dimensions)*, the recommended mods only enabling immersive travel between gamemodes using portals and seamless inventory swapping.

This implementation using Mojang's inbuilt dimension system means that your vanilla Minecraft world stays vanilla; if there's a version change or datapack update that renders the pack unusable, you're left with a vanilla world free from any modifications and some empty portals.

### Balanced Dimensions
Care was taken to ensure the datapack doesn't enable any major exploits in a world.
- Achievements and statistics don't progress in Creative. 
- Items and mobs can't be transported across different gamemodes. 
- No player interaction across gamemodes. *(can't place blocks in overworld from creative)*

**Creative Features**
- Creative portal requires a Gold Block frame and a Nether Star to activate, making it similar in cost to a beacon.
- A basic superflat with 64 stone, primed for testing, creativity and experimentation.
- Hostile mobs won't spawn, yet can be summoned. *(change the biome using `/biomefill` to enable mob spawning in an area)*
- Portals can only be made from survival to creative.

## Credits
Special thanks to Qouteall for [Immersive Portals](https://github.com/iPortalTeam/ImmersivePortalsMod) and Thomilist for [Dimensional Inventories](https://modrinth.com/mod/dimensional-inventories).

title: Pedestals - Core
description: A Minecraft Paper plugin designed for server administrators who want to add interactive crafting and display elements to their world.
body:
# Pedestals

Pedestals is a powerful and customizable Minecraft Paper plugin designed for server administrators who want to add interactive crafting and display elements to their world. It allows for the creation of unique pedestal systems that can be used for advanced item processing, decorative displays, or progression-based mechanics.

## Features

- Custom Pedestals: Create and manage multiple pedestal types with specific properties.
- Interactive GUI: Intuitive menu-driven system for managing pedestal settings and configurations.
- Flexible Recipes: Define custom recipes that interact with pedestals for unique crafting experiences.
- MiniMessage Support: Full support for modern Minecraft text formatting throughout the plugin messages.
- Permission System: Granular control over who can create and edit pedestals.
- Global Announcements: Optional broadcast messages when crafting tasks reach completion.

## Commands

- /pedestal create: Create a new pedestal at your current location.
- /pedestal edit: Open the management GUI for a specific pedestal.
- /pedestal list: View all active pedestals.
- /pedestal move: Relocate an existing pedestal.
- /pedestal toggle: Enable or disable a pedestal.
- /pedestal delete: Remove a pedestal from the world.

## Permissions

- pedestals.admin: Grants access to all administrative commands and the management GUI. Default: OP.

## Installation

1. Download the latest Pedestals JAR file.
2. Place the JAR in your server's 'plugins' folder.
3. Restart your server to generate the configuration files.
4. Configure 'config.yml' to your liking and start creating pedestals!

## Links

- Discord: https://discord.gg/zwj5sEbmDs

title: Dynamic Villager Drops
description: Gives Villagers realistic death drops based on their profession.
body:
# Description
Gives Villagers and Wandering Traders realistic loot based on their professions. Loot will drop when they die, and is meant to make them feel more like real characters than just the boring NPC you trade with and trap in a 1x1 (and yes, this pack will probably end up encouraging more of that).
### Examples:
- All villagers have 4-8 bread
- All villagers have 1-5 emeralds except: Unemployed - 1-4, Nitwit - 0-2
- Blacksmiths (weaponsmith, toolsmith, armorer) have diamonds*, iron, and relevant iron gear
- Clerics have items related to their magic-related trades including ender pearls and ender eyes*
- Farmers have crops (potatoes even have a chance to be poisonous) and a hoe
- Wandering traders focus on exploring
- And much more!

> About balancing:
> - Blacksmith villagers having renewable diamonds seems fair because of how easy diamonds are to find while mining.
> - Clerics having eyes of ender is not vanilla in recent versions, but since it's a lower chance (pearls are 1/2 and eyes are 1/4 of the other items' chances), it would take a lot of death to fill an end portal. It would take less work to get a fire res potion from piglins and loot a fortress. It's just an alternative.

# Versions
Supports Java Edition ```1.21.5 - 26.2```.

# Compatibility
Should be fine with any pack that doesn't change villager or wandering trader death drops

title: Pentamana Extra
description: A Pentamana addon providing mana calculation modifying features.
body:
# Pentamana Extra

Pentamana Extra is a library providing mana calculation modifying features. Examples include:

- Enchantments.
- Status effects.
- Modifiers.

## Configuration

`config/pentamana-extra.json`:

```json
{
  "enchantmentCapacityBase": 2.0,
  "enchantmentStreamBase": 0.015625,
  "enchantmentManaEfficiencyBase": 0.1,
  "enchantmentPotencyBase": 0.5,
  "statusEffectManaBoostBase": 4.0,
  "statusEffectManaReductionBase": 4.0,
  "statusEffectInstantManaBase": 4.0,
  "statusEffectInstantDepleteBase": 6.0,
  "statusEffectManaPowerBase": 3.0,
  "statusEffectManaSicknessBase": 4.0,
  "statusEffectManaRegenerationBase": 50,
  "statusEffectManaInhibitionBase": 40,
  "shouldConvertExperience": false,
  "experienceConversionBase": 1.0
}
```

## Command

The commands below require premission level 2 to execute.

- `/custom effect give <entities> <effect> [<duration|infinite>] [<amplifier>]` Give custom status effect. `effect` can be `pentamana.mana_boost`, `pentamana.mana_reduction`, `pentamana.instant_mana`, `pentamana.instant_deplete`, `pentamana.mana_regeneration`, `pentamana.mana_inhibition`, `pentamana.mana_power`, `pentamana.mana_sick`.

## Modifier

![Compound](https://github.com/CookedSeafood/nbtsheet/raw/0cfc19cc5644a82c921d39f9c40729aca3dea33d/compound.png) **custom_data**/**data**: Parent tag.  
 \\- ![List](https://github.com/CookedSeafood/nbtsheet/raw/0cfc19cc5644a82c921d39f9c40729aca3dea33d/list.png) **modifiers**  
  \\- ![Compound](https://github.com/CookedSeafood/nbtsheet/raw/0cfc19cc5644a82c921d39f9c40729aca3dea33d/compound.png) A modifier.  
    |- ![String](https://github.com/CookedSeafood/nbtsheet/raw/0cfc19cc5644a82c921d39f9c40729aca3dea33d/string.png) **attribute**: `namespace:path`. `pentamana:mana_capacity`, `pentamana:mana_regeneration`, `pentamana:mana_consumption`, `pentamana:casting_damage`.  
    |- ![Double](https://github.com/CookedSeafood/nbtsheet/raw/0cfc19cc5644a82c921d39f9c40729aca3dea33d/double.png) **base**: Any.  
    |- ![String](https://github.com/CookedSeafood/nbtsheet/raw/0cfc19cc5644a82c921d39f9c40729aca3dea33d/string.png) **id**: Any.  
    |- ![String](https://github.com/CookedSeafood/nbtsheet/raw/0cfc19cc5644a82c921d39f9c40729aca3dea33d/string.png) **operation**: `add_value`, `add_multiplied_base`, `add_multiplied_total`.  
    \\- ![String](https://github.com/CookedSeafood/nbtsheet/raw/0cfc19cc5644a82c921d39f9c40729aca3dea33d/string.png) **slot**: `mainhand`, `offhand`, `feet`, `legs`, `chest`, `head`.

Below is an example modifier for item stacks which increase mana capacity by 10 when held in offhand.

```component
[
  custom_data={
    modifiers: [
      {
        attribute: "pentamana:mana_capacity",
        base: 10.0d,
        operation: "add_value",
```

## Status Effect

![Compound](https://github.com/CookedSeafood/nbtsheet/raw/0cfc19cc5644a82c921d39f9c40729aca3dea33d/compound.png) **custom_data**/**data**: Parent tag.

     \\- ![Compound](https://github.com/CookedSeafood/nbtsheet/raw/0cfc19cc5644a82c921d39f9c40729aca3dea33d/compound.png) An episode.  
       |- ![Int](https://github.com/CookedSeafood/nbtsheet/raw/0cfc19cc5644a82c921d39f9c40729aca3dea33d/int.png) **amplifier**: Any.

### Mana Boost

Increase mana capacity by `level * statusEffectManaBoostBase`.

### Mana Reduction

Decrease mana capacity by `level * statusEffectManaReductionBase`.

### Instant Mana

Increase mana regeneration by `2 ^ level * statusEffectInstantManaBase`.

### Instant Deplete

Decrease mana regeneration by `2 ^ level * statusEffectInstantDepleteBase`.

### Mana Regeneration

Increase mana regeneration by `manaPerPoint / statusEffectManaRegenerationBase >> level`

### Mana Inhibition

Decrease mana regeneration by `manaPerPoint / statusEffectManaInhibitionBase >> level`

### Mana Power

Increase casting damage by `level * statusEffectManaPowerBase`.

### Mana Sickness

Decrease casting damage by `level * statusEffectManaSicknessBase`.

### Potency

title: No Too Expensive
description: No more "Too Expensive!" Use your anvil without limits.
body:
Removes the "Too Expensive!" anvil limit. Any operation goes through regardless of cost, and the repair penalty on the output item is reset each time so it never builds up again.

## Features
- Removes the "Too Expensive!" block on all anvil operations
- Resets the repair cost on output items so the problem does not come back
- No commands, no config, no permissions to set up
- Tiny footprint, just a single event listener running in the background

## How it works

Vanilla blocks any anvil result with a cost of 40 levels or more. NoTooExpensive listens for the anvil calculation event, detects when the cost hits that threshold, and allows the result through anyway. It also zeroes out the repair penalty on the output item so it stays usable long term.

title: Player Disguise
description: Add new profiles with custom names and skins
body:
[![Player Disguise banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/weaversworkshop/playerdisguise/1.21.1-release/docs/media/playerdisguise-banner.gif)](https://github.com/weaversworkshop/playerdisguise)

[![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-v1.21.1-blue?style=flat-square)](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us)
[![NeoForge Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/NeoForge-v21.1.219-orange?style=flat-square)](https://neoforged.net/)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MPL_2.0-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/MPL/2.0/)

---

Pick a name. Pick a skin. Step into a new identity *on the server, for everyone, in real time*.

Player Disguise is a custom-alias system for servers, character-driven worlds, and anyone who wants a fresh identity without leaving their account. Build a book of profiles client-side, then present any one of them to the rest of the server: chat, tab, nameplates, F5 self-view, voice icons, map markers, and more.

Runs on **NeoForge 1.21.1**. A Fabric port is planned.


## What's in the box

- **A profile book.** Create profiles with a custom name and skin PNG. Wide and slim model support. Skins are validated against vanilla specs (64×64 or 64×32, ≤64 KB) before they ever touch the server.
- **Server-wide visibility.** Once you join, everyone on the server sees your alias and skin: chat, tab list, nameplates, F5 self-view.
- **Persistent claims.** Your alias and skin stay reserved on the server across logouts. Other players can't snatch a name you're using.
- **Cooldown on release.** When you switch profiles, your previous alias enters a per-player cooldown so a quick rejoin doesn't lose it.
- **Efficient skin transfer.** Two-step handshake: the server only requests data when it doesn't already have the skin saved. No re-uploading on every login.
- **Storage hygiene.** Server-side cleanup routines keep the skin cache bounded.


## For server admins

Aliases exist for fun, not for hiding. Operators always have a real-name lookup:

- `/whois <alias>` — name-anchored. Returns every player who has ever used that alias, with timestamps.
- `/namehistory <player>` — player-anchored. Returns every alias that player has ever held, including their real-name intervals.
- Standard moderation commands (`/ban`, `/kick`, etc.) operate on real names, not aliases.
- **Real-name collision kick.** If a player joins under their real Mojang name and someone else is currently disguised as that name, the disguised player is temporarily kicked. Your real name is always your real name.
- **Reserved-name list.** A player can never claim an alias that matches another player's real Mojang name.


## Compatibility

| Mod | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat) | Voice icons follow the disguised identity |
| [BlueMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/bluemap) | Map markers reflect the disguise |
| [JourneyMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/journeymap) | Map markers reflect the disguise |
| [Chat Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/chat-heads) | Chat avatars match the disguised skin |


## Data & privacy

Skin PNGs and aliases travel only between the modded client and the modded server you're joining. There are no external skin hosts, no third-party APIs, no telemetry. Vanilla servers will still see your real Minecraft identity.


## Credits

By WeaversWorkshop. Licensed under MPL-2.0.

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/weaversworkshop/playerdisguise/issues).

title: Hex Shadowing
description: A Hex Casting addon that enables 1.17-style item shadowing.
body:
# Hex Shadowing

> **Deprecation Notice**
> This interation of the mod is no longer maintained and will not be getting item blacklists. A replacement mod with similar functionality is in progress and should remove most currently-known duplication glitches.

![Screenshot of linking two stacks of amethyst shards. A scroll displaying the spell is in the background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5105c5137dd23a28f4d7d2bab8f7b4f460a35c62.png)

A Hex Casting addon that enables item shadowing.

Adds a single Great Spell to shadow link two dropped items. Two linked stacks behave like they are one -
items added to one sync to the other, and items removed also vanish from the other stack. (In fact,
they *are* the same ItemStack internally.) Managing linked items without disconnecting them requires
some care, but also enables a number of unique applications, such as remote item restocking,
item storage, wireless hoppers, wireless redstone, etc.

This brings back the same item shadowing exploit that Mojang patched in 1.19, without the need to
perform update suppression. Behavior regarding what actions are safe (preserve the link) and what is
not is largely the same. This addon modifies a block entity's behavior to make it possible to
get linked item entities back into an inventory safely. (The original 1.17 exploit did not need this
as initial linking was done in-inventory.)

1.17/1.18 item shadowing behavior is documented in two excellent videos
by [PR0CESS](https://youtube.com/watch?v=i8_FPyn20ns)
and [Fallen_Breath](https://youtube.com/watch?v=mTeYwq7HaEA).

## Balancing Note (Server Owners Please Read)

1.17 item shadowing was inherently a general item dupe exploit that came with additional, more
interesting applications. This mod seeks to re-enable the latter applications without significantly
impacting balance. To link items, two full stacks of the same item are required - this should be the
maximum number of items that a player can get back after unlinking. Thus, there is no known general
item duplication glitch with just the vanilla game, Hex Casting, and this addon. (Smaller tricks, like
mending two broken tools with the xp cost of one, are possible and will not be patched.) However,
it may be possible to duplicate items by using this addon in combination with some other mod.

A configurable blacklist of linkable items is planned for a future release of this addon. Blacklisting
by item type, tag, damageability, enchantments, and other properties is planned.

# ⏩ Hopper Optimiser / Speed

Hopper Optimiser improves performance of hoppers on Spigot servers. This plugin reduces the lag caused by hopper systems while keeping behaviour somewhat similar to vanilla, although it adds extra things such as being able to increase the speed.

Redstone still works as expected. Farms still function normally. The thing that changes is behind the screens.

---

# 🚀 Performance Improvements

The plugin optimises item transfer handling to reduce strain on server resources.

Hoppers remain consistent with vanilla logic, but with less TPS and processor usage. This makes a big difference on servers with:

* Storage systems
* Item sorters
* Farms
* High player activity

Speed settings are configurable, so you can decide how closely it follows vanilla behaviour versus how much optimisation you want.

---

# 📦 Crafter Distribution

Hopper Optimiser also includes accurate distribution for crafters.

**Speed 9**

* Distributes 1 item evenly into each slot

**Speed 10**

* Distributes 1 item into each slot
* Continues to bring 1 to the first slot

This ensures predictable behaviour for item farms and automation setups.

---

# ⚙️ Configuration

The config is simple. No unneeded settings.

You can adjust and/or toggle:
* If optimisation is enabled
* Crafter speed
* Item transfer amount
* Transfer cooldown (transfer frequency)
* Check interval (ticks between for checking items)

It’s designed to be easy to set up and maintain.

---

# 📈 Ideal For

* Survival servers
* Economy servers
* Creative servers
* Any server with lag related to hoppers

If hopper activity is a major part of your CPU usage, this plugin is worth trying.

---

# 💬 Support

The plugin is updated and maintained by just one developer.

For bugs, suggestions, or help, [join our Discord server.](https://discord.gg/Vtxdn9guAQ)

---

Hopper Optimiser focuses on one thing, reducing hopper lag without changing gameplay and maintaining speeds from older plugins you may have had.

description: Collect all of your favorite songs from the Minecraft Soundtrack using Skeletons!
body:
**ExtraDiscs** is a simple music mod for Minecraft that adds Music Discs for all of the game’s music, allowing the player to listen to it on demand. The songs are divided into separate categories that all have their own methods of being obtained. 

To obtain discs in certain categories, the player must get a Skeleton to kill a certain mob. Each category correlates to a specific mob:

<details>
<summary>Overworld Music Discs</summary>
Zombies will drop Overworld Music Discs
</details>
<details>
<summary>Creative Music Discs</summary>
Iron Golems will drop Creative Music Discs
</details>
<details>
<summary>Underground Music Discs</summary>
Silverfish will drop Underground Music Discs
</details>
<details>
<summary>Underwater Music Discs</summary>
Guardians will drop Underwater Music Discs
</details>
<details>
<summary>Nether Music Discs</summary>
Ghasts will drop Nether Music Discs (C418).

Piglin Brutes will drop post 1.16 Nether Music Discs (Lena Raine).
</details>
<details>
<summary>End Music Discs</summary>
Shulkers will drop End Music Discs
</details>
<details>
<summary>Menu Music Discs</summary>
Endermen will drop Menu Music Discs (figure it out.)
</details>
<details>
<summary>Deep Dark Music Discs</summary>
Wardens will drop Ancestry, the Deep Dark Music Disc.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Creator Remix</summary>
Strike the Creator Music Disc with Lightning to de-oxidize and enchant it.
</details>

Each condition is meant to give the player a unique challenge. The pools with less items will have harder conditions, but will inherently guarantee the player has to do it less times than pools with more items in them, and vice versa. 

**Technical Specifications:**
This mod does not contain any of the music in the game, and instead registers sound entries for the songs already in the game. 

Any and all assets are purely custom and are not in violation of any copyright laws pertaining to the usage of the game’s music. Please support C418, Lena Raine, Kumi Tanioka and Aaron Cherof.

**Additional Credits:**
- [Ocelot5836](https://github.com/Ocelot5836/) for the Mono Audio Wrapper code
- [NoteBlock](https://www.youtube.com/@NoteBlock), [Jonny Atma](https://www.youtube.com/@JonnyAtma) and [Dom Palombi](https://www.youtube.com/@DomPalombiMusic) for the amazing Creator Remix (used with permission, of course).

title: Expensive Boats
description: Makes boats a late-game item: crafting requires a netherite ingot, implied to be the keel (some imagination required)
body:
Boats have been in Minecraft since the early days, and they let you travel vast distances across water from day one with minimal resource investment. These are one of the few features of the game that I actively dislike, and here's why.

A basic boat requires just five planks. That's it. You can craft one immediately after punching your first tree and suddenly cross entire oceans at high speed. Water goes from being a major obstacle to a highway you can access instantly.

This fundamentally changes how you approach the world. Instead of water creating natural boundaries that shape your exploration, you can sail off into the sunset whenever you want. Distance becomes meaningless when you can cross thousands of blocks in minutes with almost no preparation.

### Early game exploration

Think about your typical early game progression. You spawn, gather basic resources, and then you can craft a boat and sail to any biome you want. You can reach structures, villages, and resources that *should* feel like major discoveries, all without any real investment or journey.

Water also becomes a safety net. If you're cheap like me, you've probably spent at least one early-game night on a boat just to get away from hostile mobs on land. Instead of engaging with the gameplay loop (building proper shelter or dealing with the night cycle) you just explore islands and shipwrecks until dawn. It's an easy escape that removes the pressure of early survival.

When boats are cheap, water exploration has no significance or stakes.

## Expensive Boats

This data pack changes the boat crafting recipe to require a bottom layer of wood, a netherite ingot, and wood (underneath the normal recipe). This is implied to be the boat's ballast and keel - you'll just have to pretend it's not a dinghy.

With netherite required, boats become an investment. You need to progress through the game, explore the Nether, and commit valuable resources before you can sail vast distances. Water travel becomes something you earn rather than something you get for free.

When boats are expensive, crossing water feels meaningful again. You plan your journeys, you consider whether the trip is worth the resource cost, and reaching distant shores feels like an accomplishment.

I think this is more fun when used in combination with [No Sprinting](https://modrinth.com/datapack/no-sprinting) and [No Sprint-Swimming](https://modrinth.com/datapack/no-sprint-swimming), to make movement more intentional and distance more meaningful.

How it works: Jsonite acts as a middleman between the Java code for creating items and the resource/datapacks json files. It translates the basic JSON data and applys the rest of the code the item requires. 

Limitations: Due to how mods work u can only turn on/off the defualt behavoirs of resource/data packs. To remove or use a pack a game restart is needed. title: PostPlaceholderAPI
description: Get placeholders using get requests
body:
# PostPlaceholderAPI

The **PostPlaceholderAPI** is a powerful Minecraft plugin that enables server administrators to retrieve placeholders using GET requests. With this plugin, you can seamlessly integrate dynamic content into your server, enhancing the player experience. By sending a GET request to the server, you can access various placeholders that provide real-time information about players.

## Features

- Fetch placeholders through GET requests.
- Retrieve player-related data using the provided format: `http://backend.ip:port/<player-uuid>/<placeholder-without-%>`.
- Example request: `http://example.com:8000/d2f0a4b6-260e-480b-a33c-bbe5a5db2d53/player_name` (returns JSON containing "playgamesgo").
- Requires inclusion of a valid **Token** in the request header to authorize access. Failure to do so results in a **401 Unauthorized** response.
- Example responses:
  - `{"status":"401","message":"Unauthorized"}` - Without Authorization Header
  - `{"status":"404","message":"Invalid URI"}` - With the Wrong URL Scheme
  - `{"status": "200", "message":"playgamesgo"}` - Valid Placeholder (`%player_name%`)

## Compatibility

- The PostPlaceholderAPI plugin is compatible with **Minecraft version 1.19 and above**.
- If you require plugin functionality for Minecraft version 1.18 or lower, consider using the [RestPlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/rest-placeholderapi.90266/) plugin.
- Note that the RestPlaceholderAPI plugin is recommended for older versions, as the PostPlaceholderAPI plugin focuses on offering functionality for newer versions of Minecraft.

Enhance your server's capabilities and provide dynamic content effortlessly with the PostPlaceholderAPI plugin. Retrieve placeholders, deliver personalized experiences, and keep your players engaged like never before.

title: Amethyst Revamped
description: A mod that completely revamps the Amethyst Ore, adding a new tool + armor pack, a new shield, new blocks and more to come!
body:
![Amethyst Revamped title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/074ae650bf2558d37f65488653840e83b3b612f8_0.webp)

# ABANDONED

So, I am going to upload these so called 'death versions' for all of my mods. The reason these exist and the reason I am uploading them is because they were in-development versions of the mods, that I managed to salvage because I made copies of it on my Minecraft mods folder when testing. Unfortunately, I used a PC cleaner app that caused most of my MCreator mods to be deleted, corrupted, or returned back to an extremely older version. This would require me to recreate 85%+ of all modding content I made from scratch. I was sad and frustrated considering the time and effort I put into these, so I ended up deleting MCreator and all files related to it to free up space in my computer. Since I found these prototype files of versions I was working on updating before the wipe, I decided to upload it to Modrinth, despite them being technically incomplete versions, because I fixed a lot of bugs.

Welcome to Amethyst Revamped! This is a small mod that aims to give more uses to the Amethyst ore and make it more worth going out of your way and freeing-up inventory space to get it.

# WHAT DOES IT ADD?

As of version 1.0.0, AR adds many useful and innovating features to the game of Minecraft. These features can be divided up to 2 categories and a special item.

### TOOLS & ARMOR

AR adds Amethyst tools and armor to the game! These tools are a mid-game equipment, and they have stats that fit right in between Iron and Diamond tier, but they're not a requirement for progression. You can still skip over from iron to diamond if you'd like!

![Amethyst tools & armor.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16d23162b598d3307ee6b67f68a19db2e8ca42bc.png)

### DECORATIVE BLOCKS

Aside from the gear you can obtain with this mod, you can also craft pretty-looking blocks to decorate your builds on your Minecraft world! These blocks include:

- Amethyst Bricks
- Amethyst Brick Stairs
- Amethyst Brick Slab
- Amethyst Brick Wall
- Smooth Basalt Bricks
- Smooth Basalt Brick Stairs
- Smooth Basalt Brick Slab
- Smooth Basalt Brick Wall
- Calcite Stairs
- Calcite Slab
- Calcite Wall
- Amethyst Ore

![Smooth Basalt Bricks & Amethyst Bricks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/485bcd277544d85b9428b5657acedf12eba2d574.png)

### SPECIAL ITEM: THE AMETHYST SHIELD

The Amethyst shield is a feature many other peopel suggested to be added, but I decdied to put my own spin on it. The Amethyst Shield is crafted with a regular shield and 3 Amethyst shards surrounding it. The way it works is that every time an entity attacks the wielder whilst the shield is being held up/blocking, the entity that attacked the wielder takes damage. This damage ranges from 3 (1 and a half hearts of damage) to 8 (4 hearts of damage) depending on the level of the Sharpness enchantment applied to the shield.

Yes! I plan on adding a structure, mobs, a golem, a special tool, upgrades to Netherite, and much much more! Just stay tuned and wait for the next updates, because they might just change how you play Minecraft. At least if you have the mod installed, it's not going to do otherwise.

Ready to download this mod and explore the world? No?... How about now? Huh? If you want a better experience with Minecraft and a more complete feeling to Amethyst, you should try this mod out. Anyways, have a good day, and happy mining!

title: Attuned
description: Fabric accessory mod for Minecraft 26.2 with deliberate Focus loadouts, Circles, Deep Lanterns, and an eightfold affinity counter wheel.
body:
# Attuned

Attuned is a Fabric accessory mod for **Minecraft 26.2** built around deliberate Focus loadouts, visible counterplay, and progression through attunement.

Equip **Foci** into six inventory slots, manage your **attunement capacity**, and build around trade-offs instead of stacking every bonus at once. If your equipped Foci exceed your capacity, the lowest-priority Foci go dormant until the build fits again.

## Highlights

- **Attuned 1.5.2 - Minecraft 26.2 Chaos Cubed** moves the current release line to Minecraft 26.2 with Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Fabric API 0.152.1+26.2, and the 1.5.1 Updraft Focus, smooth boost/brake controls, flight feedback, and PvP exhaustion safeguard.
- **Deep Lanterns** add four exploration-support Foci: Cavewick for lantern-marked cave routes, Glowline for same-dimension Circle pings, Rescueflame for drowning party members, and Depthglass for lodestone-compass navigation hints.
- **Circles** are temporary server-authoritative expedition parties with invite flows, party HUD state, pings, disconnect cleanup, and bounded shared contribution windows.
- **Shared progress stays controlled**: Circle credit requires same-dimension, nearby, recent contribution, so coordinated play feels better without passive proximity farming Pact, Field, Circle, surge, or party progress.
- **Safer build sharing** validates imported Reliquary build codes against the server Focus registry, slot data, names, setup metadata, warnings, and required Focus ids before saving or applying.
- **Expanded datapack behavior palettes** cover block-context effects, navigation hints, party assists, item-use windows, and marked-target patterns for pack authors.
- **99 Foci** across mobility, defense, combat, stealth, holy, seafaring, shadow, rescue, utility, and the eightfold counter wheel.
- **16 new pure-affinity modifier Foci** fill out the expanded roster with simple, readable stat identities and animated medallion art.
- **Eight Affinity Pacts** and expanded Apex capstones reward commitment to any single Affinity, while Discord and neutral builds keep their own endgame paths.
- **Readable creative inventory tabs** split Foci into Fury & Bastion, Zephyr & Holy, Tide & Forge, Verdant & Umbral, and Utility & Tools.
- **Focus Confluences** wake small set bonuses when specific active Focus combinations align, with journal discovery and HUD pips.
- **Custom Focus visual motifs** add subtle particle feedback to selected Foci without changing their balance identity.
- **Focus Reliquary and Grand Focus Reliquary** store spare Foci, save named builds, preview missing items, and apply loadouts from your bag/inventory.
- **Data-driven authoring** supports datapack Foci, behavior palettes, `/attuned validate`, a blank custom Focus item pool, and a worked example pack.

## How it plays

Attuned is about building a kit, not wearing a pile of stats. A Focus can be active, dormant, part of a Pact, part of a Confluence, tied to a faction, and part of an Affinity identity. Tooltips keep the Focus-specific readout clean, while the Attunement Journal explains the full matchup web.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API 0.152.1+26.2

Lootr is optional but recommended for modpacks. Attuned injects Foci and shard fragments into vanilla loot tables rather than adding custom loot containers, so Lootr's per-player containers can roll the same rewards.

## Links

- Documentation and authoring guides are included in the repository under `docs/`.
- Current release notes explain the larger gameplay-polish patch, including the roughly 14k-line increase from Circles, Deep Lanterns, networking, behavior data, docs, gallery assets, and regression coverage.

SCP-2521 is a mysterious entity that appears when its own number is mentioned. This creature is fast, invincible, and able to move through walls and instantly teleporting to its target. Once it reaches a victim, it drags them into the void before disappearing again. Be careful what you type, even writing 2521 accidentally in chat through coordinates or else can summon it.

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Why are signs and books unaffected by SCP-2521?

Signs and books are unaffected from SCP-2521 due to MCreators limitations. I tried to add this mechanic but wasn't able to make it. At least the chat function works.

► Where does SCP-2521 spawn?

SCP-2521 only spawns if a player writes the numbers "2521" in the chat or has a book called "2521" in it's main hand.

</details>



![SCP-2521](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48c4c16de4a525c24d153b865d1994b291b4f6f8_0.webp)

It manifests whenever the numbers 2521 are written in chat or appears in a signed book’s title, regardless of what surrounds the number. Even coordinates or random messages containing 2521 can summon it. Once spawned, SCP-2521 moves quickly, phases through walls, and cannot be harmed or contained. If its target is more than 15 blocks away, it teleports instantly to them. Upon reaching its victim, it drags them into the void before vanishing.

# Dash’s Tweaks

Small, non-intrusive tweaks for Vanilla Minecraft. **No new items or blocks.**

## Features

1. Happy Ghast shielding  
   While riding a Happy Ghast, blocking with a shield protects the ghast from incoming projectiles. The shield loses durability.

2. Echo shard duplication  
   If a mob dies near a sculk catalyst while an echo shard and an amethyst shard are on the ground, there’s a **10%** chance the amethyst converts into an echo shard (otherwise **90%** chance it shatters).

3. Bedrock cracking  
   Detonating TNT on top of bedrock inside a weakness lingering potion cloud cracks the bedrock into deepslate.
4. Beacon Expansion
  Beacon effects now apply to all non-undead mobs in the range.

5. More to come  
   Additional vanilla-friendly tweaks planned for future updates.

title: Wait What?
description: Injects cursed cartoon physics into Minecraft: from Wile E. Coyote gravity and block avalanches to getting flattened like a pancake by anvils and doors.
body:
## 🇷🇺 Описание

### О моде
Вам надоела скучная физика? Хотите, чтобы игра работала по законам "Тома и Джерри" или "Хитрого Койота"?
**Wait What?** ломает реальность, добавляет абсурдные механики движения и уморительные деформации игрока.

### Возможности
*   🐺 **Coyote Time:** Сбежали с края обрыва? Вы зависните в воздухе на 5 секунд. Но гравитация включится, если посмотреть вниз!
*   🧱 **Elytra Splat:** Если врезаться в стену во время полета, вы превратитесь в плоский стикер и сползете вниз.
*   🏃 **Scramble Run:** При попытке бега персонаж сначала буксует на месте с облаками пыли, и только потом бежит.
*   🔨 **Anvil Squash:** Упавшая на голову наковальня превращает вас в лепешку.
*   🚪 **Door Smash:** Открытая на вас дверь расплющит вас в лист бумаги.
*   🔧 **Piston Mechanics:** Поршни могут сплющивать или растягивать игрока.

### Управление
Нажмите **`U`** для открытия **Меню**.

**Команды:**
*   `/pistoncrush <true/false>`
*   `/blockphysic <true/false>`
*   `/deformation <0-4>`

---

## 🇺🇸 English

### About
Bored of realistic physics? **Wait What?** injects cursed cartoon physics into Minecraft, featuring hilarious player deformations and delayed gravity.

### Features
*   🐺 **Coyote Time:** Ran off a cliff? You hang in mid-air for 5 seconds. Gravity kicks in if you look down!
*   🧱 **Elytra Splat:** Crashed into a wall? You turn into a flat sticker and slide down.
*   🏃 **Scramble Run:** Trying to sprint? You scramble in place before zooming off.
*   🔨 **Anvil Squash:** Getting hit by an anvil flattens you into a pancake.
*   🚪 **Door Smash:** Opening a door on yourself flattens you.
*   🔧 **Pistons:** Pistons can crush you thin or stretch you wide.

### Controls
Press **`U`** to open the **Settings Menu**.

**Commands:**
*   `/pistoncrush <true/false>`
*   `/blockphysic <true/false>`
*   `/deformation <0-4>`

title: Uncraftable Coins
description: Currency coins that cannot be crafted - perfect for controlled server economies where operators manage the money supply.
body:
# Uncraftable Coins

**Uncraftable Coins** is a fork of [RPG Coins](https://modrinth.com/mod/coins) specifically designed for controlled server economies. This version removes all crafting recipes, making coins obtainable only through creative mode or commands.

## What Makes This Different?

Unlike the original RPG Coins mod, **Uncraftable Coins** has **no crafting recipes**. Players cannot:
- Craft coins from ingots
- Convert between coin types
- Farm resources to create currency

This makes the mod perfect for servers where operators need full control over the money supply.

## Features

- Adds **Gold Coin**, **Iron Coin**, and **Copper Coin** items
- **Zero crafting recipes** - coins can only be added by operators
- Works with economy plugins and shop mods as regular items
- Can be stored, traded, and dropped like any item

## Ideal For

- **RPG Servers** - Distribute coins as quest rewards
- **Economy Servers** - Admins control currency circulation
- **Survival Servers** - Non-farmable currency for player shops
- **Custom Gamemodes** - Any scenario requiring controlled currency

## Compatibility

- **Required:** [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- **Works with shop mods:** [Spud's Shops](https://modrinth.com/mod/spuds-shops), [Universal Shops](https://modrinth.com/mod/universal-shops)
- **Compatible with:** [RPG Series mods](https://modrinth.com/user/ZsoltMolnarrr)

## Installation

1. Drop the `UncraftableCoins.jar` into your `mods` folder (client and/or server)
2. Start Minecraft - the mod works immediately
3. Use creative mode or `/give` commands to distribute coins

## Tags

- `coins:coins`
- `coins:gold_coin`
- `coins:iron_coin`
- `coins:copper_coin`

## Coins

![The three coins added by the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/26269f0a02adaf1dccc10cb6fa5aa7a928dbc1ae.webp)

## Credits

This mod is a fork of [RPG Coins](https://modrinth.com/mod/coins) by [Riser876](https://modrinth.com/user/Riser876).

Original design inspired by [Jewelry (RPG Series)](https://modrinth.com/mod/jewelry) by [ZsoltMolnarrr](https://modrinth.com/user/ZsoltMolnarrr).

title: tweak-api
description: A Minecraft fabric api that make more events and callbacks, and configure
body:
# Tweak API

A powerful extension API for Minecraft Fabric mod developers, providing rich callback and event systems.

## 📦 Installation

### For Developers
Add dependency in `build.gradle`:

```gradle
dependencies {
    modImplementation "io.github.zhengzhengyiyi.tweak_api:tweak:${project.tweak_version}"
}
```
`gradle.properties`
```properties
tweak_version=1.0.3
# use same version number as the versions on modrinth
```
package inside
```java
import io.github.zhengzhengyiyi.tweak_api.*;
```

## 🎯 Available Callbacks

- `GameOptionsChangedCallback` - Triggered when game options are changed
- `EntityHurtCallback` - Triggered when an entity takes damage  
- `ScreenOpenCallback` - Triggered before any screen opens
- `CommandExecuteCallback` - Triggered before command execution

title: Recalls
description: Adds recall potions from Terraria along with two additional potions! A replacement for /home and /back!
body:
# **Recalls**
**Recalls** is a Data Pack that adds the Recall Potion and Return Potion from the game Terraria.
There is also a third potion called the "Potion of Death Recall" which isn't from Terraria but rather an idea I had while making the original Potion of Recall.

Here are the potions and what they do:
- Potion of Recall
  - Teleports you to your spawnpoint.
- Potion of Death Return
  - Teleports you to your last death location.
- Potion of Return
  - Teleports you to your spawnpoint and creates a portal back to the original location. (Careful using this in multiplayer, other people can, and probably will, steal your portal back, leaving you at your spawnpoint.)

In order to make one of the potions easier to make, the Wither's loot table was modified to drop 3-5 wither roses upon death.

You will unlock the recipes in the recipe book when you either obtain the special ingredient for the specific potion, or you obtain nether wart which will unlock all of them.
#
 There are two version of the datapack, stackable and unstackable. Stackable is the normal, base version that allows for the three potions to be stacked up to 16. Unstackable is a slightly modified version that only changes one thing, the three potions cannot be stacked. This is to accomodate for people who may think stacking them is too overpowered, so I created a version where they aren't stackable.

title: Daylight Shaders
description: A vibrant BSL fork blending semi-realistic lighting with a highly saturated, stylized pixel aesthetic. Featuring 16x pixel-locked shadows, it elevates your world while preserving the classic Minecraft charm. The ultimate retro-modern shader experience!
body:
# Daylight Shaders (BSL Fork)

Welcome to a unique visual overhaul for Minecraft. This shader is a custom BSL fork designed for players who love vibrant, high-contrast worlds but do not want to lose the iconic, blocky charm of the original game. It strikes a balance between modern atmospheric rendering and retro styling.

## Key Features

* **Semi-Realistic Aesthetics:** Enjoy beautiful, volumetric lighting and atmospheric fog blended seamlessly with pixelated art styles.
* **Highly Saturated Colors:** Say goodbye to washed-out landscapes. This shader pumps up the color palette to make every biome pop with life.
* **16x Pixel-Locked Shadows:** Shadows are locked onto a clean 16x16 grid, eliminating modern smooth gradients in favor of crisp, retro-style shadow mapping that matches Minecraft's default textures.
* **Optimized Performance:** Built upon the foundation of BSL, ensuring stable frame rates even with enhanced visuals.

## Installation and Compatibility

1. Make sure you have Iris Shaders or OptiFine installed.
2. Download the latest version from the versions tab.
3. Move the downloaded zip file into your shaderpacks folder.
4. Activate the shader in your in-game video settings.

# Damage Indicator YS

## Focus Mode Design

Damage Indicator YS is designed as a low-clutter alternative to floating health text datapacks.

Instead of showing health above every nearby entity, it only displays information for the entity you are actively looking at. This keeps the screen cleaner while still giving useful combat feedback.

## Features

- Clean red bossbar health indicator
- Shows the entity name and HP
- Displays recent damage as `Damaged -X`
- Displays recent healing as `Healed +X`
- Briefly shows 0 HP when a tracked entity dies
- Multiplayer-friendly per-player bossbar system
- Optional player targeting, disabled by default
- No resource pack required

## Commands

Use these commands after installing or reloading the datapack:

```mcfunction
/function dmi:systems/info
/function dmi:systems/install
/function dmi:systems/refresh
/function dmi:systems/repair
/function dmi:systems/uninstall
```
## Roadmap

Version 1.0 focuses on the clean bossbar-based display.

Future updates may expand the datapack with more optional display modes, better configuration controls, combat memory tracking, and additional server-friendly customization.

title: Electrical Age: Re-Wired
description: A 1.12.2 port and overhaul of Electrical Age, introducing realistic power grids, voltage management, thermal mechanics, and advanced automation.
body:
# Electrical Age: Re-Wired

NOTE: Still in Alpha, may not be ready for survival gameplay! And please, backup your worlds, altough corruption is unlikely, a crash could make your world unplayable until we fix it!

_Real Physics. Real Danger. Real Engineering._

  Have you ever felt that most tech mods are too simple? That "energy" is just a magic number that flows through pipes? Electrical Age: Re-Wired is here to change that. This is the definitive 1.12.2 port and modern overhaul of the
  legendary [Electrical Age mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/electrical-age-jrddunbr-edition) (maintained 1.7.10 fork).

  In this mod, electricity isn't just a number—it follows the laws of physics. You aren't just placing blocks; you're building a living, breathing power grid.

  ---


###   🔌 A Real Power Grid
  Forget simple "Energy Units." Here you have to manage Voltage, Current, and Resistance.
   * Don't Blow It Up: If you plug a 50V lightbulb directly into an 800V high-voltage line, it won't just "not work" - it will explode.
   * Step Up & Down: Use transformers and DC-DC converters to manage power across long distances, just like a real-world city.
   * Resistive Loss: Long cables have resistance. Plan your wiring carefully to ensure power actually reaches your machines!


###   🔥 Thermal Management
  Some machines aren't just "on" or "off." They generate heat.
   * If your power plant runs without cooling, it will overheat and explode.
   * Build cooling systems using passive heat sinks or active heatsink fans to keep your plant running smoothly.


###   ☀ Harness the Elements
  Generate power using a huge variety of detailed components:
   * Solar Power: From small roof panels to massive 2x3 arrays that actually track the sun across the sky.
   * Wind & Water: Build turbines and water wheels that react to the environment.
   * Coal Heat Furnaces: Harness the power of the furnace to heat turbines, and generate power from coal and heat!
   * Industrial Turbines: Build massive steam or gas-powered generators for end-game power needs.


###   🤖 Advanced Automation & Gadgets
   * The Auto-Miner: The iconic mining rig is back! Deploy a massive drill head and watch it procedurally excavate your world.
   * Sensors & Probes: Use voltage probes, light sensors, and entity detectors to automate your base.
   * Logic Gates: A full suite of chips (AND, OR, XOR) and analog components (PID regulators) lets you build computers out of pure electricity.
   * 3D Visuals: Every component uses high-quality 3D models, giving your base a unique, industrial laboratory aesthetic.


###   🚀 Built for 1.12.2
  This isn't just a copy-paste port. We've rebuilt the core of the mod to be faster and more stable:
   * Modern Performance: Rewritten in Kotlin for better compatibility with modern modpacks.
   * CleanroomMC Ready: Optimized to run on modern Java versions (8 through 21+).
   * Classic Feel: All the original mechanics you loved, now polished and ready for your 1.12.2 world.

  ---


###   🛠 Compatibility
  We play nice with others!
   * Ore Dictionary: Works with Copper, Lead, and Tungsten from other mods.
   * OpenComputers/ComputerCraft: Hook up your grid to a computer for the ultimate automated control room.

title: Uncapped Armor
description: Allows for armor values above 20 to be factored into protection
body:
This is a very simple mod that replaces values in Minecraft's default `DamageUtil` class to allow for protection values over `20` to be calculated.

The way it works is by calculating the damage based on however much armor the player has PLUS a predefined 'padding' (set in config). The higher the armor value, the higher the protection, however you wil experience diminishing returns at higher values.

title: Artery
description: a mod of "organic" shenanigans for the hit game Minecraft
body:
Artery, named after the blood vessel [artery](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artery), is a mod for Fabric that adds a new mechanism called **sanguinity**. It also adds several items and blocks centered around it. It's like blood magic <small>(not the mod)</small>, but with other mobs' blood.

It's an interesting tech/magic mod (imo).

## Note to Players

This mod is currently under development and might be unstable and buggy (though it works fine on its own when I'm testing). It might interact weirdly with other mods. If you plan on installing this mod, make sure to make backups of your world regularly.

Also note that this mod is kinda unbalanced and some balancing changes might be made here and there.

Feel free to send feedback on [Discord](https://discord.gg/tMebDH4nJZ), maybe.
## Features

### Sanguinity

The most important resource in the mod. Players harvest sanguinity mainly through **combat**. Every 4 damage done will grant 1 sanguinity. If injured, every 4 sanguinity will restore 1 health. The conversion rates can be improved by equipments.

Sanguinity is also used to power several blocks provided by this mod.

### Ores

This mod provides three types of ores:
- Erythrite, one of the "vital" materials used to make **organ blocks**;
- Leukium,  a strong metal used to make weapons that harvest sanguinity more efficiently; and
- Thrombium, a durable metal used to make armors that make restoring health more cost-effective.

And I don't plan on adding more, because there are just too many types of ores in modded Minecraft.

![each ore and their related items](https://i.imgur.com/ar9lzTV.png)

### Organ Blocks

Technology blocks in Artery are called organ blocks. Unlike machines, they don't require any wire to transfer sanguinity. Instead, they automatically form groups with their neighbors. Organ blocks in the same group share sanguinity and capacity.

Currently, there are four types of organ blocks:
- Atrium, which takes and stores sanguinity;
- Ventricle, which **infuses** materials;
- Fibroblaster, which restores durability of any item; and
- Pressor, which **pressurizes** certain items to release their powerful potentials.

![organ blocks](https://i.imgur.com/b0m6tms.gif)

### Infusion

Flesh, another important material, is created through infusing rotten flesh. It can be used as a crafting ingredient or food. Eating it restores sanguinity, making it a strong choice of food paired with thrombium armors.

### Pressurization
The **totem of revival** and several mob wands can be pressurized.

The totem of revival does nothing if not pressurized, but it behaves like the totem of undying if pressurized with enough sanguinity. When fully pressurized, it can prevent death up to six times.

Mob wands are used to summon mobs.

## Mod Compatibilities

### AppleSkin

Some food restores sanguinity, amount of which is showed in the tooltip.

### Recipe Viewers (JEI, REI, EMI, etc.)

I haven't implemented anything. Infusion recipes doesn't show up but still can be checked in the in-game recipe book of Ventricle.

### WTHIT

Atrium tooltip shows system storage.

### **Ultimate QoL** 🌟

**Overview** 🌍  
**Ultimate QoL** is designed for gamers who seek to enhance their Minecraft experience with a visual upgrade and refined improvements, all while preserving the essence of vanilla gameplay and maintaining high performance.

**Vanilla Integrity** 🏠  
Enjoy the charm of classic Minecraft with enhancements that refine gameplay without altering its core feel. **Ultimate QoL** focuses on improving every aspect of the game while staying true to its vanilla roots.

**Visual and Performance Enhancements** 🚀  
Experience a visual treat and performance boosts with optimizations that enhance graphics and efficiency without significant FPS loss. Designed to be as light as possible, this modpack ensures smooth gameplay even on lower-end systems.

**Streamlined Gameplay** 🔧  
Tackle the game's more challenging and cumbersome aspects with thoughtful improvements that simplify and enhance your Minecraft journey. From better resource management to streamlined mechanics, enjoy a more intuitive and enjoyable experience.

**Creator’s Commitment 💡**

As the creator of the “**[Boostify]([https://modrinth.com/modpack/boostify](https://modrinth.com/modpack/boostify))**” modpack, I’m dedicated to providing a lag-free experience with Ultimate QoL. My goal is to deliver a smooth, optimized, and enjoyable gameplay experience for all players.

**[Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/) Compatibility** 🧵  
**Ultimate QoL** is built on the Fabric mod loader, ensuring a lightweight and efficient setup. This modpack is optimized to work seamlessly within the Fabric ecosystem.

**Inspiration** 🌟  
Inspired by the modpack "[DB's Minecraft PLUS](https://modrinth.com/modpack/dbs-minecraft-plus)," **Ultimate QoL** takes cues from its approach to enhancing the Minecraft experience while adding unique improvements to create a refined and optimized gameplay environment.

**Download and Installation** 📥  
You can download **Ultimate QoL** directly from the Modrinth website or through launchers that support Modrinth. Get started quickly and enhance your Minecraft experience with minimal hassle.

**Issues and Support** 🛠️  
For any issues or feedback, join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/MMRPUv4aNp) where you can report problems and get support directly from the community and developers.

Transform your Minecraft world with **Ultimate QoL** and enjoy a refined, enhanced, and lag-free adventure!

This Pack was designed with Technology, Exploration and the TARDIS in mind. The player (You) will be able to design technical marvels using Create and Ad Astra, dabble in the arts of magic with Botania, explore your way through a world full of old and new structures to make your home with Village improvements and world generation, and discover the wonders of expansive Travel into the universe using the Adventures in Time Mod. So download it now, and find out what lies in store for yourself! More information on the pack below.

This Modpack is taking a slightly different route this time, with the use of the Adventures in Time mod to bring us the Tardis in 1.20. This change may be unexpected and different, but it was chosen to both move us forward to more up to date versions of the game, but also to move to Fabric.

Stands for: "Where Is That Lodestone".

A small client-side mod which turns Lodestone Compasses into Markers in your world for you to see!
body:
# W.I.T.L (Where Is That Lodestone)
A simple client-side Vanilla+ mod which lets you save Waypoint Markers by using a lodestone and a compass. 

Once a marker has been made, renaming the compass will change the display name of the marker.

## Compatibility
So far this mod only works directly with [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap), not World Map. I may possibly increase this list of compatibility in the future.

So far I have not found any conflicts, but please if you do, send them as an issue [here](https://github.com/saturn-volv/WITL/issues)!

## Disclaimer!
This mod is still a **WORK IN PROGRESS** and in such, all displays of the markers is not final and subject to change. The plan for markers is to have them change icon dependent on what the item's name is, so changing the name changes the marker icon.

description: Itemcall is a survival game based on collecting items and scoring the most points between players! Play against yourself or with friends or even complete strangers!
body:
## Intro

Whether you're on your own, or you're racing a bunch of friends or complete internet strangers, Itemcall is a custom survival gamemode all about finding random items as fast as you can. Race yourself for the fastest time, or race other players and try to beat your opponents for the most points! With a unique permission system, this game requires no players to be opped, and only one person with permissions to do the configuring, making it a great choice for playing with friends or complete internet randos! Ready to get to racing? Read on below!

## Getting started

This is a datapack that's been designed for Vanilla Minecraft 1.18/1.19. While possible to get running on modded servers, it may be in your best interest to install on a vanilla server. Installing alongside plugins such as Essentials may break this datapack!

### Configuration

Once you've installed the datapack, you can confirm that the datapack is installed correctly before moving on using `/datapack list`  

Itemcall has an abundance of settings you can choose to edit to change things such as game length and win conditions. Before customizing however, you'll need to grant yourself permission. Confirm you have op (or cheats enabled), then run the command `/tag @s add ic_op`. You may replace `@s` with a player name to grant other players permission. Now you can run the command `/trigger ic_menu` to change settings. We'll cover those now.

---

**Win condition** (points/rounds)  
*Default: Points*

**Points**: X amount of points is required to be obtained by a player before winning the game  
**Rounds**: X amount of rounds will be played; whichever player has the most points at the end will win

---

**Rounds/Points needed** (1 - 999)  
*Default: Points=15 / Rounds=5*

The amount of points needed or rounds to be played before a winner is chosen and the game has ended

---

**Show points** (On/Off)  
*Default: On*

Should a scoreboard be displayed on the right hand side of the screen with player scores

---

**Random Spawn** (On/Off)  
*Default: On*

Should players be teleported away from the spawn point or wherever they are located at the start of the game

---

**Spread players** (On/Off)  
*Default: On*

Should players be spread apart from each other at the start of the game? Note that if this and random spawn are on, that random spawn will occur first, then players will be spread out centralized at where they were located.

---

**Anti-hoard mode** (On/Off)  
*Default: On*

Anti-hoard mode changes the survival element a bit. It's a solution to the problem of players holding a bunch of items in their inventory to score free points. This also adds a new challenging element to traditional survival, which helps spice the game up. Enabling this will disable all slots except armor and your hotbar.

---

**Skip round voting** (Players/IC Op Only)  
*Default: Players*

Dictates who can initiate a vote to skip a round. If set to player, the game will be paused while players will have a limited amount of time to decide if they want to skip the round. Each player may call a vote to skip a round once per round. Votes require 50% or more of players in order to pass. If set to IC Op only, any player with IC OP can immediately skip a round. To disable round skipping entirely, set to IC OP and ensure no other players have access to IC OP.

---

### Starting

When ready to start the game, IC ops may initiate the game through the settings menu by clicking "Start game". If there are any players who have not chosen a team by now, they will be prompted to join one. If they still have not chosen a team after 30 seconds, they will automatically be placed on the spectator team. Players on the spectator team will need to wait until next game before participating. Players at any time before the start of the game may switch their team via the `/trigger ic_jointeam` command.

## Gameplay

The game starts with a quick dynamic tutorial briefing players on how to play Itemcall and their overall goal. The game will run until either a player has reached the point requirement, or X rounds has passed (Depending on your decision set in the configuration). Each round, a random item will be drawn from an item pool and announced globally. All players are tasked with fetching the same item, and whoever finds the item first will be rewarded the points. In the event of a tie, all players who found the item will receive points. 

Rounds are balanced around Vanilla progression, so items from late game will not show up in early rounds. For specifics, you may refer to the chart in the gallery for item distribution and their point values.

In the event an item is drawn, a vote can be called by players through the `/trigger ic_vote` command. This command is locked from non IC op players if chosen in the configuration, and the round will be skipped immediately in the event the IC op decides to skip the round. Players will have a limited amount of time to vote, and the vote will only pass if enough players vote "Yes". Note that you only need to take action if you agree to skip the round.

The game will end once either a player has reached the point goal, or X amount of rounds have passed, depending on what win method you chose in the configuration. Players will be ranked up to 3rd place depending on their performance. In the event of a tie, players will share that placement. 

## Credits
- Serioustar - For original game idea, gameplay suggestions, and playtesting
- Cloudwolf - For use of their [Math lite](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ky3OpQg6OsA) datapack to make RNG magic happen | [Website](https://cloudwolfyt.github.io/)
- To my playtesters, which include: Brittank88, Cyberpon3, Dogpun, Fennrye, Lumeah Trinity, Notetaker, Solarhors, and TheodoreSnowfall

title: Cinderscapes Reforged
description: Port of Cinderscapes to forge
body:
This version of Cinderscapes is a port for the Forge mod loader. You can find the Fabric version at Cinderscapes. 

This is in no way related to the Terraformers team or any of their memebers, they are listed as former authors only to pay proper credits to them for the code I did not write myself and other assets. Please bring any issues that you encounter with this to MY github, NOT THEIRS.

 

Now here's a modified version of the description on the original page:

 

Cinderscapes is a beautiful, yet frightening biomes mod for Minecraft 1.16 and above running on the Fabric mod loader. Cinderscapes enchances the default minecraft experience by adding 6 new rich and detailed nether biomes following in the same style as those already in the vanilla game. In addition to new biomes Cinderscapes adds some new unique types of building blocks further expanding your building capabilities.

Cinderscapes Reforged requires Terraformed Api Reforged and Fabric's Biome API Reforged 

Check out my Discord Server to chat about Cinderscapes and other Reforged mods!

The two central tenants of the Cinderscapes project are refinement and simplicity, so in order to uphold those central values, the few biomes that Cinderscapes does add have gone through rigorous polishing, detailing, and refining to make sure all additions are up to the community's standards. Focus has been placed on depth rather than breadth and we hope that it clearly shows. Overall we hope this will result in a more cohesive experience compared to existing biome mods.

Biomes:

  • Ashy Shoals
  • Blackstone Shales
  • Luminous Grove
  • Quartz Canyon

 

Images of the biomes can be found on the Images page.

 

Other Mods by Terraformers:

Check out the sister biome mods, Traverse and Terrestria:

    

Terrestria Reforged and Traverse Reforged(Tbd, traverse reforged currently does not work my my biome api mod, it's not my mod so it doesn't yet use my api)  work well with Cinderscapes if you wish to expand your overall biome experience in the Overworld as well.

title: zy optimised pack
description: A modpack with a focus on optimisation and quality of life features. Designed for use with vanilla servers.
body:
zy optimised pack is modpack with a focus on optimisation and quality of life features. The performance of the game is improved with mods such as [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) and [Lithum](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), with QoL mods such as [Bobby](https://modrinth.com/mod/bobby), [WI Zoom](https://modrinth.com/mod/wi-zoom), [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip) and [WI Zoom](https://modrinth.com/mod/wi-zoom) being included. 

Various resource packs and shaders are included, making configuration easily accessible upon startup. This modpack aims to enable good performance across various devices and keep the experience as close to vanilla as possible, whilst improving the game in unobtrusive ways.

[PrismLauncher](https://prismlauncher.org/) is recommended to manage different Minecraft versions.

![Ghast with shaders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/p4MSuVei/images/a15429a91806c1b78609f3b639db75ad3be43b49.jpeg)

## How to Install
[PrismLauncher](https://prismlauncher.org/download/) is recommended to manage instances and download mods. With PrismLauncher open, click the `Add Instance` button, select the `Modrinth` tab and search for this modpack (either by name or by using the link).

Alternatively, you can use the `Import` tab to select the `.mrpack` that can be downloaded to import the pack into PrismLauncher.

You will need Java (version 21) installed on your device. PrismLauncher can download Java for you when you open it for the first time.

Additionally, you can also download Java here: [adoptium.net](https://adoptium.net/en-GB/temurin/releases/?version=21&os=any&arch=any).
> **Note: On Macs with Intel processors, you need to install the x64 version of Java, on Macs with Arm 64 (Apple silicon) processors, you need to install the Arm 64 (aarch64) version of Java.**

## When Updating
To keep your settings, make sure to copy over `options.txt` to the new instance's folder, from your old folder. Also, if you want, copy over `servers.dat` (your server list), `hotbar.nbt` (your saved creative hotbars), `saves/` (your worlds) and `screenshots/`, along with `.bobby/` (only made if you have the bobby mod).

title: The Legendary Sword: Excalibur II
description: This mod adds most powerful sword ever.
body:
![The Legendary Sword Excalibur](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de559b3fd7abc84541750646804e7d31f121302e.png)

This mod introduces a new progression path focused on powerful bosses, unique items, and handcrafted mechanics.

Face off against two major bosses: the **Forgebound Colossus**, a relentless construct forged in fire and steel, and the **Primordial Guardian**, an ancient entity tied to the origins of the world. Each encounter is designed to challenge the player with distinct mechanics and intense combat.

Along the way, you will discover new items, including magical tools, mana-based systems, and rare relics. Gather powerful materials to create the **Relic of Reforging**, a key item required to restore the **Legendary Excalibur.**

The mod also features custom structures, unique mobs, and new environments such as volcanic and hostile biomes, expanding the exploration experience.

**_⚠️ This mod is still in development and is not 100% complete. More content, bosses, and features will be added over time._**

title: Nyoldarria
description: Game expansion mod, intended on adding a lot of new content and a somewhat separate and unique gameplay experience.
body:
_Do note that this is in very early access, a lot of things are subject to change and this is only a small slice of what this mod aims to be, which is basically, a whole new different game! (Very ambitious I know, but I’ll try my best!) Any feedback and sharing is extremely appreciated! Help me make a goofy fun mod for you all to enjoy :D_

**Hello and welcome to Nyoldarria!** This is a survival centric “sandboxed” experience meant to give you a more difficult and immersive experience.

This mod is a spiritual successor to Endertech Infinity, with many returning features, but in a completely new context with a different implementation(A better one I like to think!), and a new canon.

## Introduction

Consuming a bottle containing an odd substance will allow the player to travel to the “Pre-Singularity”, a different past timeline of what “The End” could have looked like.

This place is cold, dangerously so at times. Storms often envelop the area, forcing survivors to seek shelter.

## Gameplay

Using a scanner, the player is able to see their temperature and other vitals. The player must eat the correct foods as to sustain themselves in a semi-realistic way, not only being able to rely on one source of sustenance.

Going in an area where the temperature drops under 10 degrees will cause the player to start freezing, and eventually to faint and perish. The player is able to prevent this by doing a few things:
- Staying near the world centre, where it’s warmer.
- Staying near a Heat Furnace.
- Wearing armour that provides Insulation.

The Heat Furnace provides passive heat, and also can be improved by using Insulation blocks around your shelter. It may also be powered by coal. You can increase the heat output of a Heat Furnace, but doing so also increases the fuel consumption of it.

Going further away from spawn makes it colder, stronger enemies spawn but also more powerful loot can be obtained from crates.

Storms cause more enemies to spawn, while also making it drastically colder and harder to see.

Some items are classified as physics objects, and may be moved around similar to moving physics objects in games created in the popular Source Engine.

## The World

The Dreadnought Confederation (DNCF) makes a return, with their huge facility, VOXEL, in the centre of the world. These enemies are well armed and dangerous, it’s recommended they are avoided for the most part.

I’ve put a lot of love and care into the level and specifically the audio design of each area, while also trying my best to create an unique skybox and other visual effects. Using external shaders may ruin these, so sorry about that!

If you have any feedback, questions or want to report something, please contact me on my Discord server, or feel free to reach out directly to my account “nwago”.

I really do hope you enjoy this!

title: STALKERS
description: Something Is Always Watching You...
body:
![STALKERS_MOD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/edb341be54b60b20cbff4a37a33f707206910c8a.png)Stalkers (Forge 1.20.1)

Stalkers is a minimal anomaly-based mod that introduces observing entities and unstable dimensions.
The mod focuses on perception rather than combat.

⸻

Entities:

Watcher — keeps distance, appears in view, disappears on direct focus.
Corner — manifests near edges and corners, rarely fully visible.
Mimic — imitates familiar shapes with subtle inconsistencies.

⸻
![BEHIND](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86fce45526a16456cdffd9af1690729b526e2073.jpeg)

Dimensions:

The mod includes isolated, unstable dimensions with altered behavior:

inconsistent layout
distorted lighting
unreliable spatial cues

⸻

Dimensional Access:

A craftable item allows controlled teleportation into these dimensions.
Usage is intentional — entry is not random.

⸻

Behavior:

non-standard spawn conditions
no predictable patterns
limited interaction
conditional despawn

⸻

Effects:

brief visual artifacts
irregular audio
lighting inconsistencies
UI anomalies

⸻

Technical:

Minecraft 1.20.1
Forge
Singleplayer focused

⸻

No explanation is provided for entities or dimensions.

title: AutoCommand+
description: Client-side Fabric command scheduler for Minecraft 1.21.4 - 1.21.11 with Mod Menu and YetAnotherConfigLib support. Configure single commands, multi-command sequences, randomized timing windows, batch repeats, rate limits, dry-run logging
body:
AutoCommand+ is a client-side Fabric mod that lets you schedule Minecraft commands automatically.

  Configure single commands or multi-command sequences, set custom timing windows, repeat command batches, and manage execution through a clean Mod Menu / YetAnotherConfigLib settings screen.

  Features:
  - Single command scheduling
  - Multi-command sequences
  - Configurable min/max delay windows
  - Batch repeat support
  - Global command rate limit
  - Dry-run mode for testing
  - Command logging
  - Runtime status display
  - Optional multiplayer server allowlist
  - Mod Menu and YetAnotherConfigLib integration

title: Rideable Sulphur Cubes
description: Master the Chaos Cubed update! Tame and ride the new Sulfur Cube mob. Control unique physics—bounce like wood or slide like ice—while exploring 26.2 Sulfur Caves. Includes the "Slimy Slingshot" advancement. Simple, vanilla-plus, and Vulkan-ready!
body:
## **Rideable Sulfur Cube**

The **Rideable Sulfur Cube** mod is a technical expansion for Minecraft **26.2 Snapshot 3 (Chaos Cubed update)** that transforms the new **Sulfur Cube** mob into a versatile, physics-based mount. While the vanilla Sulfur Cube is a passive creature used primarily for puzzles and minigames, this mod bridges the gap between player mobility and the cube’s unique "Archetype" system.

### **Core Gameplay Mechanics**
* **Advanced Taming:** Players must feed a **Slime Ball** to an adult Sulfur Cube to tame it. Unlike the vanilla growth mechanic for babies, this creates a loyal bond with the adult form, indicated by heart particles and a "purring" sound (Fox sniff).
* **Physics-Synchronized Riding:** This is the heart of the mod. When mounted, the player doesn't just "sit" on the mob; they control it. The movement physics are dictated by the cube's absorbed block:
    * **Bouncy:** High-jump through caves while absorbing wood.
    * **Fast Sliding:** Glide across flat terrain at high speeds using ice.
    * **Sticky:** Scale steep inclines or stick to walls using honeycombs.
* **Interactive Controls:** Uses standard WASD controls for steering while maintaining the "Cube Ball" interaction mechanics (punching/launching) even with a rider.

---

### **Technical Specifications**
This project is built to handle the significant architectural shifts introduced in the 2026 snapshots:

* **Vulkan-Ready Rendering:** Utilizing the new **Blaze3D** and **Fabric Rendering API v1** to ensure the player model and cube outer layers render correctly under the new Vulkan graphics backend.
* **Data Component Integration:** Moves away from old NBT-heavy logic to utilize the new `minecraft:bounciness` and `minecraft:sulfur_cube_content` components for smoother physics calculation.
* **Identifier-Based Predicates:** All mod advancements and triggers are written in the 26.2-compliant JSON format, ensuring compatibility with the updated Data Pack 102.0 structure.

---

### **Adv: Slimy Slingshot"**
* **Goal:** Successfully tame, pet, and mount a Sulfur Cube.
* **Requirement:** The player must trigger the `minecraft:started_riding` event while the `Petted` component is active on a tamed `sulfur_cube`.
* **Icon:** A **Slime Ball** with a golden glint, representing the bond between player and cube.

### **Summary**
The mod natively supports all Snapshot 3 features, including the **Sulfur Spikes** (falling spikes can still damage you while riding) and the **Bed-to-Model** overhaul, ensuring that the mod's resource footprint remains minimal and "vanilla-plus" in feel.
