title: SizePlayer
description:
EN: Allows players to change their size, which changes their HP.
RU: Позволяет игрокам менять свой размер, из-за чего меняется их ХП.
body:
# EN

The plugin allows you to change a player's size using convenient commands. Size directly affects the maximum health, which is calculated using configurable formulas.

## Commands

- ```/sizeplayer own <size>``` — change your own size
- ```/sizeplayer set <nickname> <size>``` — change another player's size
- ```/sizeplayer reload``` — reload the config

## Health

When the size is changed, the player's maximum health is automatically adjusted.

Examples (default):

- Size 0.4 → ~4 hearts
- Size 1 → 10 hearts
- Size 10 → ~20 hearts

The formulas are fully configurable in the config, allowing flexible gameplay balancing.

## Formulas
Mathematical expressions are supported (via exp4j)
The variable ```x``` is used — the player's size

Separate formulas for:
- small players (x < 1)
- large players (x > 1)

## Configuration
- HEX color support (&#RRGGBB)
- Fully customizable messages
- Includes a Russian config (config_ru.yml). ПSimply copy its contents into config.yml and run ```/sizeplayer reload```

## Permissions
```sizeplayer.own``` — change your own size
```sizeplayer.set``` — change other players' size
```sizeplayer.reload``` — reload the config


# RU

Плагин позволяет изменять размер игрока с помощью удобных команд. Размер напрямую влияет на максимальное здоровье, которое рассчитывается по настраиваемым формулам.

## Команды

- ```/sizeplayer own <размер>``` — изменить свой размер
- ```/sizeplayer set <ник> <размер>``` — изменить размер другому игроку
- ```/sizeplayer reload``` — перезагрузить конфиг

## Здоровье

При изменении размера автоматически изменяется максимальное здоровье игрока.

Примеры (по умолчанию):

- Размер 0.4 → ~4 сердца
- Размер 1 → 10 сердец
- Размер 10 → ~20 сердец

Формулы полностью настраиваются в конфиге, что позволяет гибко балансировать геймплей.

## Формулы
Поддерживаются математические выражения (через exp4j)
Используется переменная ```x``` — размер игрока

Отдельные формулы для:
- маленьких игроков (x < 1)
- больших игроков (x > 1)

## Настройка
- Поддержка HEX-цветов (&#RRGGBB)
- Полностью настраиваемые сообщения
- В комплекте есть русский конфиг (config_ru.yml). Просто скопируйте его содержимое в config.yml и выполните ```/sizeplayer reload```

## Права
```sizeplayer.own``` — изменение своего размера
```sizeplayer.set``` — изменение размера других игроков
```sizeplayer.reload``` — перезагрузка конфига

title: Henko's Creation - Vanilla Flavor
description:
A modpack for my friends, based upon a Vanilla + experience with Create as its bigger game changing mod. 
A focus on optimization and QoL changes is done in order to allow anyone to play even with potato computers !
body:
![A minecraft modpack Title in the style of Minecraft base game title.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf030efe1fe488fdc5eb0780786ef7227146194f.png)
# Henkō's Creation - Vanilla Flavor

> **Important:** To ensure the best performance and compatibility, make sure you're running **Java 17** for Minecraft 1.20.1. You can download the correct version of Java from [here](https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?os=windows&arch=x64&package=jre&version=17).


## A Beautifully Enhanced Minecraft Adventure

Welcome to a carefully crafted Vanilla+ modpack, designed to give you the **ultimate Minecraft experience**! This pack is all about refining the game we already know and love, by enhancing performance, ironing out bugs, and polishing visuals, while still staying faithful to that classic Minecraft feel. Whether you're an explorer, a builder, or a technical player, this modpack will breathe new life into your game.

### Key Features:
- **A Seamless World Expansion:** The world generation has been completely re-imagined to offer you breathtaking landscapes and biomes, all while keeping the aesthetic style of Minecraft that we hold dear. Using mods like **Terralith** and **Tectonic**, the overworld now boasts a wide variety of new biomes, stunning caves, mountains, and forests that feel like a natural extension of the game. You’ll stumble upon vast deserts, towering cliffs, and lush valleys as if they were always meant to be part of Minecraft.

  ![An image of a landscape with rocky formations in a turquoise sea.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/120f11e50aa661d500e94470107c12d4e6a082ce_0.webp)

- **Overhauled Nether and End Dimensions:** Your adventures won’t stop at the overworld! Prepare for a completely new challenge in a **revamped Nether** thanks to **Incendium**, filled with eerie biomes, strange creatures, and structures that make survival even more intense. As for the **End dimension**, it has been vastly expanded with projects such as **Nullscape**, offering not just a final boss fight but an entire world to explore, full of floating islands, lush alien forests, and ancient ruins. Both dimensions have been re-imagined while staying true to the hauntingly beautiful tones of the base game.

- **Create Mod Integration:** While the modpack preserves much of the vanilla experience, one major gameplay addition takes center stage—**the Create Mod**. This mod allows players to build complex mechanical systems, from simple automation setups to entire factories that will blow your mind. Add-ons to the Create Mod ensure that there’s always something new to discover in your engineering and automation adventures, without overwhelming you if you're more familiar with traditional Minecraft gameplay.

### Visual and Sound Enhancements:
This pack goes beyond just gameplay improvements. It’s all about making Minecraft look and feel better, without deviating from its charm. Expect to see:
- **Enhanced lighting effects** for a more immersive atmosphere
- **Improved textures** that sharpen the world’s details without breaking the signature pixel art
- **Ambient sounds** that create a richer soundscape, helping to immerse you fully in your environment

### Multiplayer Features:
For those diving into multiplayer, the modpack introduces a few key features to enhance the cooperative (and competitive) experience! **Land claiming** allows you to protect your builds, ensuring that no one can tamper with your hard work. You can also team up with friends using the **Teams and Friends system**, making collaboration easier and more fun. Plus, with **proximity-based voice chat**, communication becomes crucial—just be mindful when exploring dangerous areas like the Deep Dark, as talking too loudly near a **Warden** could spell disaster!


### OptiFine Parity:
If you’re an avid user of **OptiFine**, you’ll be pleased to know that this modpack supports most of the features you’re familiar with:
- **Shaders** for more realistic lighting and reflections
- **Connected textures** that allow blocks like glass and bookshelves to look seamless
- The famous **zoom function** that lets you see distant details
- **OptiFine-required resource packs**, so you can bring in all your favorite visual enhancements with ease

### Built for Everyone: From High-End PCs to Low-End Machines
We understand that not everyone is running on a high-end gaming PC, and this modpack is designed to offer **maximum flexibility**:
- For high-performance machines, the inclusion of mods like **Distant Horizons** gives you insane render distances, offering breathtaking views that stretch as far as the eye can see.
- For those with lower-end PCs, simply disabling shaders and a few demanding options (such as Distant Horizon) will allow you to achieve **smooth gameplay comparable to competitive gaming clients**. So, no matter your setup, you’ll be able to enjoy everything this modpack has to offer!

### Perfect for Long-Term Play
This modpack was created with a **long-term multiplayer server** in mind for friends to enjoy together, but it’s equally well-suited for solo adventures or your own server. We’ve built this pack to grow and evolve over time, with **frequent updates** ensuring you always have something new to explore, fix, or optimize.

Feel free to dive into this Vanilla+ modpack, whether you’re looking to explore new biomes, perfect your engineering skills, or just enjoy the beauty of Minecraft with a fresh twist. We’ve balanced everything to make sure the game feels like a **natural extension** of the base experience, perfect for long-term play without losing that familiar Minecraft magic.

Happy crafting and exploring!

title: PixelArt
description: Create pixel art in Minecraft from images
body:
yeah, that's right you can make any pixel art from small to extremely large.

# PixelArt Mod Usage

## Commands

### Render

```
/pixelart render <url>
/pixelart render <maxheight> <url>
/pixelart render <orientation> <url>
/pixelart render <maxheight> <orientation> <url>
```

### Erase

```
/pixelart erase <url>
/pixelart erase <maxheight> <url>
/pixelart erase <orientation> <url>
/pixelart erase <maxheight> <orientation> <url>
```

### Undo

```
/pixelart undo
```

## Parameters

*   `<url>` - Direct URL to an image (PNG, JPG, etc.)
*   `<maxheight>` - Maximum height in blocks (1-100)
*   `<orientation>` - Either `vertical` (default) or `horizontal`

## Examples

```
/pixelart render https://example.com/image.png
/pixelart render 50 https://example.com/image.png
/pixelart render horizontal https://example.com/image.png
/pixelart render 50 vertical https://example.com/image.png
/pixelart erase https://example.com/image.png
/pixelart undo
```

title: Collect Emerald
description: Emerald in item frame to collect items
body:
![effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d52aa2b9ae6211bfad03365c2f433c652db1659b.jpeg)
## Features
- When an emerald is placed inside any item frame, it collects nearby items within a 33×33×33 area to its own location.
- When an item frame containing an emerald is attached to a chest, barrel, or shulker box, it will only collect item types that already exist in the attached container. If attached to an empty container, no items will be collected.
- If multiple "universal CollectEmeralds" exist around an item entity, the item will be collected by the nearest CollectEmerald. If multiple valid "container CollectEmeralds" exist, the item will split into several item entities and be evenly collected by them.
- If both a "universal CollectEmerald" and a "container CollectEmerald" exist around an item entity, the item will first be collected by the former, then redistributed by the latter.
- Compatible with the Large Barrel feature from the [carpet-tis-addition](https://modrinth.com/mod/carpet-tis-addition) mod.

## Usage
- Use this feature to easily implement an automatic item sorting storage system in the early game.

title: UltraSpawners [LITE]
description: UltraSpawners is a lightweight spawner management plugin featuring basic stacking, simple trust permissions, and economy based mob unlocking, designed for survival and economy servers.
body:
UltraSpawners [LITE]

UltraSpawners is in active development.
The plugin works, but some features are incomplete, unstable, or disabled.
Expect bugs and breaking changes.

Advanced spawner management plugin for Paper 1.21.x Minecraft servers.
Free and open source.

Issues and bug reports:
https://github.com/KoopaCode/UltraSpawners/issues

Community support:
https://discord.gg/UafKUcTKSp

## Features

- **Spawner Items**. Break any spawner to receive a drop with full data preserved
- **Stacking**. Merge spawners of the same type on one block with configurable limits
- **Upgrade Tiers**. Config-driven spawning upgrades per tier
- **Economy Integration**. Optional Vault support for upgrades
- **Multi-Database**. SQLite by default or MySQL
- **Anti-Dupe**. Atomic saves and NBT validation
- **TPS Guard**. Automatic scaling during low TPS
- **GUI Menu**. Visual upgrade interface
- **Admin Commands**. Full inspection and control

## Installation

1. Download the compiled JAR from Modrinth
2. Place `UltraSpawners-x.x.x.jar` in the `plugins/` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Configure `plugins/UltraSpawners/config.yml`
5. Reload with `/ultraspawners reload`

## Configuration

### General
```yaml
general:
  prefix: "&8[&5UltraSpawners&8] &r"
  debug: false
```

### Drops
```yaml
drops:
  dropOnBreak: true
  dropOnExplosion: true
```

### Stacking
```yaml
stacking:
  enable: true
  maxStackPerBlock: 64
  mergeDifferentTypes: false
```

### Upgrades

Fully config-driven tiers.

```yaml
upgrades:
  enable: true
  maxTier: 4
  paymentMode: ITEMS
  tiers:
    0:
    1:
```

### Economy
```yaml
economy:
  vaultEnable: false
  vaultDisabledMessage: "&cVault is disabled"
```

If Vault is disabled or missing, Vault-based upgrades are blocked.
All other features continue to work.

### Performance
```yaml
performance:
  spawnCapPerTrigger: 20
  enableTpsGuard: true
  tpsThreshold: 15.0
  minimumSpawnAtLowTps: 1
```

### Storage
```yaml
storage:
  type: SQLITE
  sqlite:
    filePath: "plugins/UltraSpawners/database.db"
  mysql:
    host: "localhost"
    port: 3306
    database: "ultraspawners"
    username: "root"
    password: "password"
    useSSL: false
    maxPoolSize: 10
```

## Database Setup

### SQLite
No setup required. The database is created automatically.

### MySQL
1. Create a database
2. Set credentials in `config.yml`
3. Tables are created on first startup

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|--------|-----------|-------------|
| `/ultraspawners reload` | `ultraspawners.admin` | Reload config |
| `/ultraspawners give <player> <type> [stack] [tier]` | `ultraspawners.give` | Give spawner |
| `/ultraspawners inspect` | `ultraspawners.use` | Inspect spawner |
| `/ultraspawners settype <type>` | `ultraspawners.edit` | Change mob |
| `/ultraspawners setstack <amount>` | `ultraspawners.edit` | Set stack |
| `/ultraspawners settier <tier>` | `ultraspawners.edit` | Set tier |
| `/ultraspawners menu` | `ultraspawners.menu` | Open menu |

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `ultraspawners.use` | false | Basic use |
| `ultraspawners.admin` | op | Admin access |
| `ultraspawners.give` | false | Give spawners |
| `ultraspawners.edit` | false | Edit spawners |
| `ultraspawners.menu` | true | Access menu |

## Anti-Dupe Protections

- Atomic database writes
- NBT validation on items
- Range and sanity checks
- Chunk load validation
- Persistent storage on restart

title: MultiBreak
description: Paper plugin to give tools custom, multi-block breaking patterns.
body:
# What is "multi-break"?
MultiBreak uses packets, particles and plugin code to break multiple blocks at once in a certain shape given by the data on an item, which can be configured using the command.
The player will be slowed down to the block it will be the slowest at breaking.

# Configurability
You can configure the width, height and depth of the Multi Break system. You can also configure the offsets and rotations for extra customizability.

# Use case
You may own a prison server and want to configure a multi-break for different kinds of pickaxes as a special enchant/feature.

# Compatibility
Currently the plugin is set to be compatible with 1.20.3+, because this version makes it possible to rely off paper instead of ProtocolLib. For versions <v0.8, which are compatible with 1.18, ProtocolLib v5.1.0 was used, however I advise heavily against this since the plugin used to be full of bugs.

# Additional features
- Ping compensation: adjust for players with high ping, syncing the block break animations.

# Permissions
"multibreak.admin" for commands

title: Flower Bonemealing
description: A simple mod that allows you to spread small flowers by right-clicking them with bone meal.
body: # **ABOUT** The "Flower Bonemealing" mod is intended to solve one simple issue: Flower farming. When playing survival, I found myself to be annoyed by the fact only tall flowers can be bonemealed to drop a copy of themselves. When playing on Bedrock, however, I learnt that it is a feature to be able to right click a small flower with bonemeal to spread more of it. This is my attempt of replicating this feature in a more Minecraft Java Edition like way. ## **USAGE** Like the about section describes, simply right-click a flower with some bone meal to spread more of it. The main purpose is to farm dyes. ## **CONFIGURATION** This mod is highly configurable. It contains a block tag called `flower_bonemealing:blacklist` to which you can add flowers that should not be spread. Additionally, the mod contains config options that let you set the spread range of flowers on all three axes individually, as well as a decimal number to control how successful spreading is. ## **COMPATIBILITY** This mod works with flowers from all mods by default if they tag their flowers as `minecraft:small_flowers`. The way it works is that it checks whether the interacted block is of this block tag and then does a series of checks to ensure it only spreads to positions the block would survive, meaning all base blocks like dirt are also compatible by default and don't need to be tagged. ## **PRESENTATION**

Right-click the wand to open a GUI to cast spells. Type the spell in the box (all lowercase) and click "Cast" to cast a spell, or press "N" while holding the wand to open a GUI where there a bunch of spells in buttons. - Lumos- Gives you night vision for 200 seconds.

title: Cinematic Flow
description: Cinematic Flow is a mod that helps you create cinematic camera movements between points in your world.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/xZcqVmteC8Y" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


# Cinematic Flow

Cinematic Flow is a mod that helps you create cinematic camera movements between points in your world. Instead of walking or flying to show off your builds, you can set up a path that automatically moves your camera while you sit back and watch.

## How It Works

The mod gives you a set of tools in your inventory when you use the `/cinema start` command. These items let you:

- **Set markers** at different locations in your world
- **Remove markers** if you place them in the wrong spot  
- **Set a focus point** that your camera will look at during movement
- **Edit individual markers** to control timing and names
- **Adjust settings** for different movement styles

Once you've placed at least two markers, use the start item to begin recording your cinematic. Your camera will move from marker to marker.

## What Makes It Different

Most camera mods are complicated or require learning complex commands. Cinematic Flow keeps things simple - just right-click with the tools to place markers where you want your camera to go. The mod handles all the movement calculations for you.

You can choose between different movement styles like `linear` paths or `curved Catmull-Rom` splines. Each marker can have its own timing, so you can slow down at important parts of your build and speed up through transitions.

## Perfect For

- **Builders** who want to showcase their creations
- **Content creators** making videos  
- **Server owners** creating tours of spawn areas or important builds
- **Players** who just want to experience their world from a new perspective

The mod works entirely server-side, so everyone on a multiplayer server can see your camera movements. No need for everyone to install it separately.

## Simple Setup

1. Install the mod on your server or in singleplayer
2. Use `/cinema start` to get your tools
3. Right-click with the marker tool to place points along your desired path
4. Right-click with the start tool to begin your cinematic
5. Use the stop tool to end recording and return to normal gameplay

title: WildEncounters [PT/BR] [Cobblemon]
description: O WildEncounters adiciona a relva selvagem dos jogos de Pokémon.
body:
---

🟢 WildEncounters ⚪

Este projeto é um fork do projeto (WildEncounters) para PT/BR, com a ajuda de @Jaozin.

WildEncounters no mod Cobblemon. Esta datapack traz a icônica mecânica da Relva Selvagem do Pokémon para o Minecraft, permitindo que os jogadores encontrem Pokémon selvagens aleatórios enquanto caminham pela relva!

⚙️ Como funciona 📖



Ao andar num pequeno pedaço de relva, há uma pequena chance de um Pokémon selvagem aparecer. Estes Pokémon aparecerão perto do jogador, adicionando um elemento emocionante e imprevisível à sua exploração. Personalize os tipos de Pokémon que podem aparecer e suas taxas de spawn. Quer esteja recriando uma experiência clássica de Pokémon ou adicionando um toque único ao seu mundo Minecraft, esta datapack dará vida às suas aventuras!

🕒 Comandos do WildEncounters 🛠️

  • Você pode usar /function wildencounters:change_cooldown para alterar o intervalo de tempo de espera entre encontros selvagens. Para alterar o tempo, basta clicar com o botão esquerdo em + ou - para adicionar ou remover o tempo de espera. O tempo padrão é de 21 ticks ou 1 segundo em tempo real (o 1 tick extra que é adicionado é para se alguém quiser que os encontros não tenham tempo de espera, o cronômetro possa detectar se o tempo de espera foi reiniciado ou não). Esteja ciente de não alterar o tempo de espera enquanto um jogador estiver com o cronômetro em andamento ou isso pode causar bugs;
  • Você pode usar /function wildencounters:reset_cooldown para redefinir o tempo de espera para o seu estado original (21 ticks ou 1 segundo). Este comando pode ser útil se o tempo de espera estiver bugado;
  • Você pode usar /function wildencounters:uninstall para desinstalar a datapack. Depois de executar este comando, remova a datapack da pasta datapacks e execute /reload;

📝 Mudar Pokémon 📝

Nota Importante: Modificar datapacks pode ser desafiador para iniciantes. Prossiga com cautela! ⚠️

Para personalizar os Pokémon que aparecem, você precisará descomprimir a pasta datapack e colocá-la na sua pasta datapacks. Depois de descomprimida, navegue até o seguinte local: 
WildEncountersDatapack\data\cobblemon\molang\random_spawn
Neste arquivo, você encontrará uma lista de todos os Pokémon que podem aparecer na relva. Para alterar um Pokémon da lista, altere esta parte da função: 
t.roll == 1 ? {
    q.run_command('pokespawnat ' + q.player.x + ' ' + q.player.y + ' ' + q.player.z + ' rattata lvl=' + t.random_level);
    q.player.tell('§aA wild Rattata has appeared!');
    return 1;
};
Se você quiser mudar o Pokémon para um Pikachu, você mudaria a parte da função para isto: 
t.roll == 1 ? {
    q.run_command('pokespawnat ' + q.player.x + ' ' + q.player.y + ' ' + q.player.z + ' pikachu lvl=' + t.random_level);
    q.player.tell('§aA wild Pikachu has appeared!');
    return 1;
};
Se quiser alterar o nível de spawn de um Pokémon, basta alterar a parte lvl= para algo como lvl=10, removendo "+ t.random_level". Não se esqueça de fechar o ' após lvl=10.
Você também pode alterar a chance de um Pokémon aparecer modificando esta linha: t.roll = math.random_integer(1, 720);. A chance de um Pokémon aparecer é de 35/720, ou cerca de 5%. Você pode alterar a chance de um Pokémon aparecer alterando o valor correto 720 para outro.

Para adicionar mais Pokémon, basta adicionar estas linhas no fincheiro spawner, com os valores corretos: 
t.roll == 36 ? {
    q.run_command('pokespawnat ' + q.player.x + ' ' + q.player.y + ' ' + q.player.z + ' arceus lvl=' + t.random_level);
    q.player.tell('§aA wild Arceus has appeared!');
    return 1;
};
Se o último valor for 36, os próximos serão 37 e assim por diante.

Tem algum problema? Pode entrar no servidor de discord oficial do Cobblemon e procurar por "WildEncounters" e fazer suas perguntas lá, ou alternativamente, pode mandar-me uma mensagem no discord.

title: Ping Mod
description: Adds the ability to ping.
body:
# Ping Mod – Quick Communication Made Easy

Ping Mod is a lightweight and easy-to-use mod for Minecraft **1.20.1** that lets you place visual pings in the world to help with communication and navigation. Perfect for multiplayer teamwork or solo exploration, this mod makes it easy to point things out quickly without needing to type or explain.

## How to Use:

- Press **H** (default keybind) to place a ping where you're looking.
- The ping will appear in the world as a visible marker for nearby players to see.

> **Important Tip:**  
> Make sure your **Entity Render Distance** is turned up in your video settings, or you might not see pings that are far away.

title: Space Update
description: dannytaylor's April Fools' 2025 "Update"
body:
# ![Space Update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VJngGiES/images/bbe5ae1f318ef91bb4a9e8584e20d806eccee541.png)

Introducing... space! (what a stellar idea!) This update adds not one, but TWO new dimensions! The Space Station, and The Moon!  

The Space Station is a void dimension above the overworld, that contains just one thing... the space station! If you keep going up, your gravity will soon switch as you approach the moon.  

The Moon is a dimension made of Moon Stone and is covered in craters, and contains Crystals! Moon Stone can be used to craft Moon Bricks. Not only can you craft Crystal Blocks that are difficult to break, but you can also use Crystals to craft Crystal Wings and The Pulser Block.  

The overworld gets an upgrade too with Lead (don't taste it, it's poisonous!), and a new structure "The Facility", which unless you have a way to fly beyond the height limit, and breathe without oxygen, you might just want to find... which you can do by crafting a Lead Compass!  

## Requirements  
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net)  
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)  
- [Luminance](https://modrinth.com/mod/luminance) 1.0.0-alpha.5 (Embedded, servers require the luminance jar included in this release)  
- [Minecraft](https://minecraft.net/) 1.21.4  

## 
![Caution: Flashing Lights. This mod contains flashing lights and may not be suitable for players with photosensitive medical conditions. If you experience lightheadedness, altered vision, twitching, involuntary movements, disorientation, confusion, or temporary loss of awareness, please stop playing immediately and seek medical advice.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VJngGiES/images/58d11be49e3e2c25493c9b0d0822167063faa826.png)

## Changes  
- Updated Menu  
- Added Bloom  
- Added Lead  
- Added Lead Lamp  
- Added Space Station Dimension  
- Added Moon Dimension  
- Added Breath of the Cosmos, and Heavy Footed enchantments  
- Added Moon Stone  
- Added Moon Brick, Moon Bricks, Cracked Moon Bricks, Moon Brick Stairs, Moon Brick Slab, Moon Brick Wall, and Chiseled Moon Bricks  
- Added Crystal Ore, Crystal, Crystal Block, Crystal Stairs, Crystal Slab, Crystal Wall, Crystal Glass, Crystal Glass Pane, and Crystal Wings  
- Added Pulser Block  
- Added Steve Co. Supply Crate  
- Added Moon Slime, Moon Slime Spawn Egg, and Moon Slime Ball  
- Added Bright Day Music Disc  
- Added Moon, and Sun Painting
- Added Space Air  
- Removed Herobrine  

### Menu  
- Updated button textures to be space themed  
- Updated the title screen panorama with several space themed panoramas  
- Updated the title screen music with the following:  
  - `dtaf2025:music/devoid`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/cosmic`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/light`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/aware`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/dark`  
- Replaced box blur shader with gaussian blur shader  

### Post Effects  
#### Gaussian Menu Blur  
- This post effect replaces the menu blur shader  
- The post effect is located at: `assets/dtaf2025/post_effect/gaussian.json`  
#### Bloom  
- This post effect will always render  
- The post effect is located at: `assets/dtaf2025/post_effect/bloom.json`  
- The strength can be adjusted in the Space Station Settings...

### Dimensions  
#### Overworld  
- Lead Ores generate in the same way as Iron Ores  
- Facility Structure that generates in the `minecraft:plains` biome  
#### Space Station  
- Entities that are 96 blocks above the overworld height limit will be teleported to the bottom of the space station dimension  
- Entities that are 16 blocks below the space station height limit will be teleported to 48 blocks above overworld height limit  
  - If the entity doesn't have slow falling, they will be set on fire for 32 seconds (or until they are in water).  
- Generates a space station at `0, 64, 0` on first world generation.  
- You can't breathe here without the `Breath of the Cosmos` enchantment  
- The only biome that generates here is `dtaf2025:space`  
- Gravity is 0.16x that of the overworld, unless wearing boots with the Heavy Footed enchantment  
#### The Moon  
- Entities that are 96 blocks above the space station height limit will be teleported to 48 blocks above the moon height limit  
- Entities that are 96 blocks above the moon height limit will be teleported to 48 blocks above the space station height limit  
- The only biome that generates here is `dtaf2025:the_moon`  
- Gravity is 0.16x that of the overworld, unless wearing boots with the Heavy Footed enchantment  
### Biomes  
#### Space  
- Nothing generates here, it's a void biome.   
- You can't breathe here without the `Breath of the Cosmos` enchantment  
- The following music is played in this biome:
  - `dtaf2025:music/devoid`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/cosmic`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/light`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/aware`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/dark`  
#### The Moon  
- This dimension is made of Moon Stone, with Crystal Ore, Craters, Moon Rovers, and spawns Spiders, and Moon Slime.  
- You can't breathe here without the `Breath of the Cosmos` enchantment  
- The following music is played in this biome:  
  - `dtaf2025:music/devoid`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/cosmic`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/light`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/aware`  
  - `dtaf2025:music/dark`  

### Enchantments  
#### Breath of the Cosmos  
- When worn on head, the entity can breathe in `#dtaf2025:no_oxygen` biomes, without space air
- Found in Facility Structure  
#### Heavy Footed  
- When worn on feet, gravity returns to normal in space dimensions  
- If worn in a dimension that has normal gravity, gravity becomes 1.94x that of normal  
- Found in Facility Structure  

### Moon Stone  
- Generates in `dtaf2025:the_moon` biome, as the moon equivalent of stone  
- It can be smelted into Moon Brick, which can be crafted into its block variants  

### Crystal  
- Can be found in ore form in `dtaf2025:the_moon` biome  
- Can be used to craft Crystal Blocks, Crystal Stairs, Crystal Slab, Crystal Wall, Crystal Glass, Crystal Glass Pane, Crystal Wings, Pulser, and Steve Co. Supply Crates  
#### Crystal Wings  
- This can be crafted using 1 crystal, and 4 phantom membranes  
#### Pulser
#### Steve Co. Supply Crate  
- This can be crafted using a crystal, and a chest  
- Opens a screen that tells the player to get a Supply Crate Key from the Minecraft Store  
  - When the player presses that button, the official [Minecraft Shop](https://shop.minecraft.net/) is opened in their browser, this feature is meant as a joke  
##### Developer's Note  
We took the "Steve Co. Supply Crates" (also known as "Locked Chests") from Minecraft Beta 1.4,  
and made them link to the actual minecraft shop. See [here](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Locked_chest) for more info on the original!  
This mod contains a reference to "Supply Crates" (a.k.a. "Loot Boxes", "Crates", "Gambling"), which we do not support, nor do we endorse the use of these for exchange of real-world currency. These are predatory practices designed to cause harm, and we encourage you to avoid them.  
This reference was intended to make fun of companies that use these predatory practices.  

### Moon Slime  
#### Mob  
- Moon Slimes look similar to their overworld counterparts, but are blue instead of green  
- Moon Slimes have twice the health, movement speed, and attack damage compared to their overworld counterparts  
- Moon Slimes will attack and convert overworld slimes if they are to ever be near each other  
#### Moon Slime Ball
- Unlike overworld and nether slimes, Moon Slimes drop Moon Slime Balls which can be consumed quickly  

### Bright Day Music Disc  
- Found in Space Station and Moon loot chests  
- Plays [dannytaylor - Bright Day](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lsb9qSkNLVE) when inserted into a jukebox  
- Has a comparator output of 10  

### Paintings  
#### The Moon  
- 1x1 painting of the moon  
#### The Sun  
- 2x2 painting of the sun from the moon  
#### Facility Poster  
- 2x2 painting of a minecraft player silhouette  

### Space Air  
- Entities that are in `#dtaf2025:no_oxygen` biomes can breathe when in or next to space air  


## Attributions  
- [Emafire003/StructurePlacerAPI](https://github.com/Emafire003/StructurePlacerAPI)  
  - We forked StructurePlacerAPI for use of structure generation (specifically for the space station).  
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net)  
- [FabricAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)  
- [Minecraft](https://minecraft.net/)  

##  
This mod was created for April Fools' 2025, and is likely to contain bugs. Use at your own risk.  

Licensed under LGPL-3.0-or-later.  

**This mod is not affiliated with/endorsed by Mojang Studios, Microsoft, Snow Commerce, or The Official Minecraft Shop.**  
The Minecraft Logo, name, and some game assets are property of Mojang Studios and fall under Minecraft EULA.

title: Klsts' Nether Utilities
description: Adds biome-specific features to Nether Biomes
body:
Have you ever felt the Nether Biomes don't have much things to do once you explore them once? No reaseon to revisit them?

This mods aims to make the Nether expirience more enjoyable by adding cool resources and features to Nether biomes.

 

There 3 new resources, which can only be found in their respective biome and can't be placed anywhere else (like Budding Amethyst) . This resources are:

 

Crimson Truffles. Found on fallen fungi on Crimson Forests. When eaten will extinguis the player.
Warped Truffles. Found on fallen fungi on Warped Forests. When eaten will despawn nearby Endermen.
Ignite. Found on Ignite Crystals on Basalt Deltas. Has many uses, such as creating a block which crystallices lava nearby!

![Truffles on fallen fungi](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88d56a8de0a5df47b480326b2618edd21678b663.png)

 

 

Also there is a new structure called the Bone Temple, which has a Bone Vault that spawns loot multiple times when feeding it bones.

![The Bone Temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7dfdc12d438b934140faf55ca4b9a7cd03962ca6.png)

 

There are other features which generate in all the Nether, to make it more fun to explore (some of them also have loot!).

![Gold Ruin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aaad36d92029c0aa5c72ff7287937da3e6da0503.png)

And finally there are new biome specific mobs, to enhance the atmosfere of the biomes. Theese are:

![Babilin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4be49c79144c9b6025c10308fd016d0ae7977f9e.png)![Zombified Babilin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd8badcbc030644780e28d89692fffce9dddc9a9.png)![Necrodraco](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b2bb3cec78ba8faa631a3eec174974014513a97.png)![Magnemone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f99b58a8345bbc63d10c3d92cabab8809eb1dff4.png)


 Also other important changes:
   - Piglins can now barter Netherites Hoes (1 in 500) and other items of the mod
   - Added some items of the mod to Nether Fortresses loot

I hope you like the mod! Any feedback is apreciated!

This mod is made using Mcreator.

# Description

title: CivPak
description: A relatively minimal modpack made to enhance the experience on 'civ' type servers. This pack is specifically formulated around CivMC and its rules, so if you use this pack on another server, do your own research to make sure everything here is compliant!
body:
# CivPak
Unofficial modpack aimed for use on multiplayer servers with Civ plugins

## What is this for?
CivPak is a fairly lightweight modpack built on Fabric intended to enhance 'Civ' style minecraft servers—that is, servers usable on a vanilla client featuring the block reinforcement plugin Citadel, and the block-based in-game action-tracking plugin JukeAlert. This pack was built specifically with the server CivMC in mind, and has been formulated around its rules.

## Mod Selection
Includes:
* Journeymap with a custom config designed to be as compliant as possible with CivMC's rules. (if you have performance issues, I recommend turning the entity radar off)
* GammaUtils for a more customizable fullbright experience compared to the server's freely available in-game /gamma command (which simply provides the Night Vision effect).
* The Snitch Mod to provide better management, placement, and visualization of owned snitches on a Civ server.
* LambDynamicLights for a generally more immersive experience using torches and other light-emitting blocks/items. **I recommend setting this mod to *fast* in its settings/config for a good balance between performance and quality on the vanilla client.**
* Various performance optimization mods including Sodium.

## Disclaimers

### About Server Rules
If you play on any server with this modpack, please review that server's rules and/or verify with that server's admin(s) to ensure everything on here is allowed. I've done my best to make sure all the mods here are above board, but some servers may have particularly strict rules and I'd always recommend due diligence to avoid any bans.

### Modpack Non-Officiality (unless specified otherwise by authorized parties)
**This modpack shall not be acknowledged to be official in any capacity for play on CivMC or other minecraft server, and shall not be construed as such, unless stated in a publicly available capacity by such server's owners or authorized persons to make that decision.**

### Licensing
This curated collection of mods does not carry a preset license due to differing and potentially incompatible licenses of constituent mods. **The license, or lack thereof, on this collection shall not be construed to provide rights to the end user that may or may not conflict with those outlined by the licenses of any mods contained witin, and use of said mods is still subject to their individual terms on an individually-considered basis.** Due to this individually-considered relationship between end-users and mods, users should carefully consider potential consequences for redistribution of this pack outside of the Modrinth platform. Due to the unique nature of the agreement Modrinth requires from Authors for content hosted on the Modrinth Platform under its [Terms of Use](https://modrinth.com/legal/terms), privileges implicitly granted here by said Terms may not apply elsewhere.

Any unique assets created by the pack author (CrazyGrape) provided by this modpack are to be considered under an All Rights Reserved basis unless otherwise specified.

title: Simple Join Message
description: Plugin to send a welcome message on player join.
body:
# Simple Join Message

**Latest Version**: 1.1

## Description
Simple Join Message is a lightweight Bukkit/Spigot plugin designed to enhance player experience by sending a customizable welcome message whenever a player joins the server. Striving to be as small as possible, this plugin adds minimal overhead while providing essential functionality for server owners. It supports gradient and colorful messages using Minecraft's color codes (e.g., `&a` for green, `&c` for red). For any questions or support, please reach out to me on discord.

## Features
- Sends a configurable welcome message to players upon joining.
- Supports gradient and colorful characters using Minecraft color codes.
- Easy to set up with a simple configuration file.
- Extremely lightweight, minimizing impact on server performance.

## Installation
1. Download the plugin JAR file.
2. Place the JAR file into the `plugins` folder of your Bukkit/Spigot server.
3. Start the server; the plugin will generate a `config.yml` file for message customization.
4. Edit `config.yml` to set your preferred welcome message.

## Configuration
Modify the `welcome-message` entry in `config.yml` to personalize your greeting.

<details>
<summary>Default config.yml</summary>

```yaml
welcome-message: "Welcome to the server!"
```
</details>

body:
## What is MiniZone?
**MiniZone** is a modpack designed to keep the vanilla feel of Minecraft while adding new features and improving the overall experience. It’s perfect for SMP servers, offering subtle changes without altering core mechanics.

## What does it add?
It adds a lot of things, and here are some examples:

- ✔️ Ad Astra (Space mod)
- ✔️ BetterX (BetterEnd and BetterNether)
- ✔️ Create and its addons
- ✔️ Sodium and optimization mods
- ✔️ EMI and its addons
- ✔️ Quality of Life mods
- ✔️ Yung's mods for improved exploration
- ✔️ 200+ mods enhancing the vanilla experience

## FAQ
### Why did you make a modpack?
I wanted a modpack that keeps vanilla gameplay intact while adding fresh features. The goal was to create a balanced and optimized experience for SMP servers, with no unfair advantages for players. Keep it fair, keep it fun!

### Can I use it on my server?
Yes! MiniZone is designed for both PvP and PvE servers, with a focus on multiplayer balance and performance. Get your friends together and dive in!

### Does it change Minecraft too much?
No, MiniZone stays true to the core vanilla gameplay. It only adds features and optimizations without drastically altering the way Minecraft is played.

### How does it perform?
MiniZone includes mods like Sodium and FerriteCore to ensure performance is optimized, even on large servers. It’s lightweight enough to run smoothly on most systems.

### Is it beginner-friendly?
Absolutely! The modpack includes quality-of-life improvements and intuitive features, making it easy for both new and experienced players to enjoy.

### Can I disable any Items, and is Custom tools, armor, and swords are disabled?
Yes! Custom tools, armor, and swords are disabled by default, keeping the vanilla balance intact. But if you want to try them, you can easily enable these features in the config. Enjoy the flexibility to play the way you like!

title: World Balance
description:
An attempt at nerfing unbalanced features.
Structures are rarer, villages always spawn abandoned, no Trader Llamas, convert Wandering Trader to a Villager & more!
body:
Minecraft is currently pretty poorly balanced, I made these changes to try improve it somewhat. There's many more changes I want to make, but here's an early version of the pack!

# Features:

## 💎Wandering Trader tweaks
- added trade to convert them to a villager
- will not spawn with trader llamas anymore

_Now killing him truly does not give you anything, and he is happy to convert to a villager for some cake!_

![Wandering Trader has a cake trade to convert him to a Villager](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/YX5Oloic/images/80e8af085476f6025a24102891f9b426fe6f692a.png)

I suggest also using a datapack to change the Wandering Trader's trades to be more useful.

## 🏘️Village tweaks
- all generated villages are abandoned, only spawning zombie villagers
- villages are way rarer, ~2k blocks between them
- removed hay bales, animals and crops from villages
- adjusted village chest loot, removing tools, armor, obsidian, diamonds, changing ingots to nuggets and reducing amounts of other items

_Villages give players way too much free stuff for being a peaceful structure. My solution is to make them abandoned, rarer and removing most of the loot. This way if you do find one its special and you have to use other ways to get villagers (curing or wandering trader)._

I also suggest using these two datapacks to balance villagers:
- [Villager Restock Balance](https://modrinth.com/datapack/villager-restock-balance)
- [Librarian's Balance](https://modrinth.com/datapack/librarians-balance)

## 🐪Other tweaks
- camels will now spawn naturally in deserts
- cave spiders spawn in deserts at night instead of normal spiders (due to them being similar to scorpions)
- made ruined portals generate more rarely
- made rabbit jump height a bit higher so they dont get stuck on edges of blocks as often

title: Combatant [BEING REVAMPED]
description: The new age of combat.
body:
im fully reworking the mod (so silly)

# Credits

Before we begin, I want to credit some people. Thanks to PlazmaZX(plazmazx on discord) for giving every amethyst armour and tool texture!


![Combatant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ayOegD8J/images/6addc9ed8f66386003499a07ebf1a8055f50a8fd.png)

Combatant is a mod that changes combat by adding new enchants, changing weapons, and adding some new interesting weapons which change your playstyle, instead of adding millions of ores and repetitive, boring weapons with unchanging stats. Please refer to the official wiki for more in-depth info!

# New Weapons:
### Aethers' Horn:
The Aethers' Horn is a disruptive weapon, meant for getting away or dealing low damage to groups of enemies. The Horn has two attacks, which can be changed by enchants. The first one registers when you hit a block, and causes a small explosion, which launches your enemies away from you, and launches them in the air. The second registers when you hit an entity, and causes the enemy to be pushed towards you.
### Amethyst Aspect
The Amethyst Aspect is an alternative to the sword and axe, a heavy-hitting sword meant for dealing with heavier targets. It has 10 attack damage, and is quite slow. It can be upgraded.
### The Heartbreaker
The Heartbreaker is the upgraded version of the Amethyst Aspect, dealing 12 attack damage. The Heartbreaker has an additional ability, which deals additional armour-piercing damage if the enemy is freezing. The Heartbreaker can be combined with Frostbite. However, this will apply a 4 second cooldown, using the new cooldown mechanic.

# New Armour:
### Amethyst Armour
Amethyst armour is a new armour set, which is an *alternative* to netherite. It offers a protection level between iron and diamond armour, however, in return, it grants you the ability to shoot dragons breath using your armour ability key(K by default). This has a 10 second cooldown.

# New Smithing Templates:
### Amethyst Upgrade:
There is a new amethyst upgrade template, which can be rarely found in mineshaft chests. It can be combined with diamond tools(only the sword right now) and diamond armour to make a new tool/armour set!

# New Enchants:
### Frostbite
Frostbite is a new heavy-hitting weapon(axe, amethyst aspect, heartbreaker, etc.) enchant, which freezes enemies as if they are in powdered snow depending on the level. Cannot be combined with Smite or Cleaving.
### Cleaving
Cleaving is another new axe enchant, which disables any right-click abilities of your items in your main and off-hand. This applies an effect, and can only be applied if the effect hasn't been yet applied.
### Combustion
Combustion is an enchant which gives the on-block-hit attack a bigger radius, but doesn't push enemies back. Generally, use this if you want to learn how to use the weapon, as the radius is really precise, and all of your shots have to be well-timed to be useful in tricky situations.
### Flames of Hell
This enchant is an enchant for dealing medium damage in a large area, and for somewhat annoying your enemies at times. It applies a new effect, Haephaestus' Flames, which deals damage based on the level of the effect every 5 ticks(half a heart at level 1, 2 hearts at level 4).
### Wind Dash
Wind Dash is probably my favourite enchant so far. It allows you to travel really fast, at the cost of dealing a lot of damage(2 hearts in full protection 4 netherite, but blast protection works better) to the user. If you have to quickly get away, this is your best shot. It allows you to travel by pushing you forward 2 times the amount that the Horn would push your enemies backwards when you hit any block at any distance. This means that if you are careful, you can chain jumps! It also works on your velocity, so jumping up or using potions before the push will increase it's distance.
### Crystallization
Crystallization changes the ability of The Heartbreaker to a passive one, making it slow down enemies instead of helping to deal more damage.

# New Items:
### Coins
Coins are a creative-only item(subject to change), which can be used for maps, quests, etc.

# New Blocks:
### Refined Slate
![Refined Slate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ayOegD8J/images/9286237ee792ea1f95cd602f9f8530e7f3e7b298.png)
Refined Slate is the only group of blocks so far. It's a pale, grey-ish, soft block type, not fit for gradients, but instead for more of japanese-esque builds. They have a cheap recipe, and can be used for the Mystic Table.
### Mystic Table
The Mystic Table is a table made using refined slate, netherite scrap and a gold block. This block allows you to craft the new weapons, currently only being one weapon, aka, the Aethers' Horn.

![Combatant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ayOegD8J/images/068dce94e7bae9783177e21f71eecdf03293d76c.gif)

Please note this isn't compatitable with optifine, as far as I understand. I will try to track down the source of the issue before the next update.

title: Blossom
description: A minecraft security plugin, protecting against server scanners (and soon malware!)
body:
# Blossom

Blossom is a security mod for scanners and soon malware scanning.
## FAQ

### X IP did Y on my server, can you blacklist it?

**No**, this only is for mass scanners and other people. The process of blacklisting IPs is automated and no manual additions will be made unless there's a extreme case.

### What do blacklisted IPs see?

**Simple:** It looks like the minecraft server isnt even on. Blossom will cancel the connection to the port immediately.

### Why?

Recently, many scanners have been spam joining servers with usernames, spamming peoples console.
The IPs often change, so we have honeypots all over the world detecting when they ping, and add them to a blacklist. 

### Is there chances of false positives?

**No.** The IPs of the sensors are not shared and cannot be easily fingerprinted. No legitimate user will be blocked

description: Prevent crops from growing by doctoring farmland
body:
# Don't Grow NOW!

Prevent crops from growing by doctoring farmland

---

Tired of those pesky players trampling on your farms? Want to stop crop growth for aesthetic purposes? Then Don't Grow NOW! is just the right mod for you! Just apply some fermented:tm: bone meal to farmland and you're good to go!

## Gameplay

*Fermented Bone Meal* can be crafted using 8 bone meals and 1 fermented spider eye. It can be applied on farmland by right clicking or by dispensing it into farmland, turning it into *Doctored Farmland*. It prevents:

* Farmland blocks from dehydrating and turning into dirt
* Crops from growing
* Players and mobs from trampling on farmland blocks

Doctored farmland can also be picked up when broken with a shovel enchanted with Silk Touch, to be moved somewhere else.

Doctored farmland can be converted back into normal farmland by right clicking with a water bottle or using a dispenser to do so and crops will be able to grow again.

# Donut Economy



Donut Economy is a powerful and lightweight Fabric mod designed for Minecraft 1.21.1, inspired by the popular economy systems found on servers like Donut SMP. This mod provides a robust foundation for server owners to implement a dynamic economy with ease.



## Features



- **Player Balances**: Each player has a persistent balance that is saved on the server.
- 
- **Shards System**: A prestige currency system (Shards) that can be used for special rewards or rank-ups.
- 
- **Commands**: Comprehensive set of commands for players and admins to manage money and shards.
- 
  - `/balance` - Check your current balance.
- 
  - `/pay <player> <amount>` - Send money to another player.
- 
  - `/shards` - Check your shard balance.
- 
  - `/sell` - Sell the item in your hand for money (server-configurable prices).
- 
- **Server-Side Shop**: A basic shop system that allows players to sell items back to the server.
- 
- **Optimized Performance**: Built with performance in mind, ensuring minimal impact on server TPS.
- 


## Installation



1. Download the latest version of the mod.
2. Place the `.jar` file into your server's `mods` folder.
3. Restart your server.
 


Enjoy building your own economy with Donut Economy!

title: Custom Totem Particles ported
description: Fanciest totem particles in the west! Ported
body:
Me and my friend chatgpt (mostly me trust) ported this mod to 1.21.11! Have a fun!
original mod: https://modrinth.com/mod/custom-totem-particles
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Version 2.9!

Version 2.9 is finally out, adding gradients and tons of small improvements! This also brings the mod to a mostly complete state, meaning future updates and ports will be much faster! If you want to see a release for less common versions like 1.20.6, just ask.
Explaining the configuration
Categories

The configuration of the particle is split up into categories, which can be enabled and disabled at any time.

    General
        Global mod toggle - enable / disable the mod completely.
        Particle type - replace the totem particle with a different kind, for example criticals (this option ignores most parameters)
        Multiplier - see more or less particles when you pop a totem
        Show own totem particles - whether or not to show particles from yourself.
    Emitter settings (The emitter is what makes the particles coming from the player)
        Emitter lifetime - how long the particle will emit particles for (game default is 30 ticks)
        Vertical offset - move the emitter up or down
        Emitter moves with player - if enabled, the emitter will move with the player
    Misc
        Hide on ground - particles will be hidden when they touch the ground
        Collisions - Whether or not particles will collide with blocks
        Light Level - How brightly the particle will appear. setting to -1 will use world lighting.
    Color
        Blend colors - If enabled, will take the first two given colors and set the particle's color to a random color inbetween them, making a nice gradient
        Starting color - you can now add as many starting colors as you want; if you want colors to appear more often than others, just add a duplicate entry
        Color transitions - you have two seperate transitions, explained more below
        Fade to color - the target color to start fading to
        Fade speed - how fast to fade to that color
        Fade at % - at what percent of the particle's lifetime to fade at (e.g. if the lifetime is 60 ticks, 50% will start fading after 30 ticks)
    Rainbow
        Start Color - Will set the starting color of the particle to some random color from the rainbow
        Rainbow over time - Will change the particle color to be a part of the rainbow over time (If you want the particle colors to be synced, set the starting color to be a single color)
        Speed - how quickly the particle goes through the rainbow
    Alpha
        Minimum / Maximum alpha - randomly chooses an opacity of the particle between the specified values
        Fade out / Fade on ground - Specify when and how fast to fade out when the particle reaches a specific age / is on the ground
    Scale
        Minimum / Maximum scale - randomly chooses a scale between the specified values
        Scale over time / Scale on ground - specify when and how fast to scale when the particle reaches a specific age / is on the ground
    Age
        Minimum / Maximum age - randomly choose a age for how long the particle exists in ticks
    Movement
        Minimum / Maximum velocity multiplier - randomly choose a velocity multiplier for the particle
        Custom velocity
            Customize min/max X,Y and Z velocity independently!
        Gravity
            Minimum / Maximum starting gravity
            Gravity over time, change gravity at set speed at set lifetime
    Rotation
        Minimum / Maximum starting rotation
        Minimum / Maximum rotation speed
        Change at %
        Amount
        Smart mode - if enabled, the particles will lose speed over time if the "Amount" value is set to a negative number, regardless of the direction of their rotation. Vice versa for a positive number.
        Rotate on ground - whether or not to rotate particles when they are on the ground

Default Minecraft values

    Gravity = 1.25
    Velocity multiplier = 0.6
    Scale = 0.75
    Age = 60-72
    Emitter age - 30

title: World Remembers Dear Diary
description: A personal Minecraft diary that turns your discoveries, deaths, victories, rare finds, and quiet little moments into a living record of your journey. Write your own notes, browse automatic memories, and let your world remember what happened.
body: **Dear Diary** adds a personal travel diary to Minecraft. It remembers the story of your world: first discoveries, dangerous fights, strange places, rare finds, quiet progress, funny accidents, PvP victories, and the moments that make a playthrough feel alive. Instead of being just another checklist, the diary slowly becomes a record of your journey. Open it through the in-game GUI, write your own notes, browse old memories, mark favorite entries, create chapters, search through your story, and return to the moments that shaped your world. ## A diary that writes with you Every player gets their own personal diary. You can write manual entries whenever you want, but the mod can also create automatic memories when something important happens. These entries are written like short travel notes, not like raw logs or achievement messages. Over time, your diary turns into a living chronicle of the world. ## Features - Beautiful book-style diary GUI - Manual diary entries - Automatic memories from gameplay events - Favorites, filters, sorting, and search - Journey chapters for long playthroughs - Share selected memories in chat - Clickable coordinates for remembered places - Small in-game notification when a new memory appears - Markdown export for saving your full diary outside the game - Automatic diary backups - Configurable automatic memories - Works in singleplayer and multiplayer ## What can the diary remember? Dear Diary can record many kinds of moments, including: - First steps in a new world - Deaths and dangerous accidents - Important discoveries - Boss fights - Rare items and strange artifacts - Exploration milestones - Building and crafting progress - PvP victories and milestones - Memorable moments from supported content mods The goal is not to spam the diary with every tiny action. The goal is to preserve the moments you may actually want to read later. ## Mod compatibility Dear Diary includes optional memory support for: - The Twilight Forest - The Aether - Deeper and Darker - Iron’s Spells ‘n Spellbooks - L_Ender’s Cataclysm - Create - Farmer’s Delight - Waystones - Fungal infection - Scorched guns 2 These mods are optional. Dear Diary works perfectly fine without them. ## For modpacks and servers Dear Diary fits especially well in survival, RPG, exploration, adventure, and long-term server worlds. It gives players a reason to look back at their journey, remember where they have been, and keep a more personal connection to the world. Automatic memories can be configured or disabled, so modpack authors and server owners can decide how active the diary should be. ## Supported - Minecraft 1.21.1 - Fabric - NeoForge

# HeavyCoreChance **HeavyCoreChance** lets server owners configure the drop chance of the **Heavy Core** from Ominous Vaults in Trial Chambers. The Heavy Core has a ~7.5% chance to drop by default — making the Mace one of the most frustrating items to obtain in vanilla survival. With this plugin you can adjust that to whatever suits your server, without touching a single loot table or data pack. --- [](https://discord.gg/7Sa9VmmWZX) [](https://ko-fi.com/justbuddy) --- # Support If you find any bugs or have any suggestions join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/Pjm9GFuSyG). --- ## Features - Set the Heavy Core drop chance to **any value from 0% to 100%** - Defaults to **7.5%** — the exact vanilla rate — so nothing changes until you want it to - Reload the config live with `/hcc reload`, **no restart required** - All other Ominous Vault loot is **completely untouched** --- ## Config ```yaml # plugins/HeavyCoreChance/config.yml # 0.0 = Heavy Core never drops # 7.5 = Vanilla default (~1 in 13 vaults) # 100.0 = Heavy Core always drops heavy-core-drop-chance: 7.5 ``` --- ## Commands & Permissions | Command | Permission | Default | |---|---|---| | `/hcc reload` | `heavycorechance.reload` | OP only | --- ## Requirements | | | |---|---| | **Server software** | [PaperMC](https://papermc.io) | | **Java version** | 1.21.x | ---

# World Protector

A lightweight, server-side region protection mod for Fabric `1.20.1` focused on fast setup, clear commands, and reliable enforcement.

## Features

- Cuboid region selection with a wand (`/wp wand`)
- Region creation, deletion, listing, and detailed inspection
- Per-region configurable protection flags
- Strong server-side event checks for block, interaction, PvP, and damage rules
- Persistent region storage across restarts
- Dimension-aware regions
- Admin bypass with dedicated test mode (`/wp test`)
- Selection preview particles while using the wand
- Straightforward command aliases for faster workflow

## Commands

- `/wp help`
- `/wp wand`
- `/wp create <name>`
- `/wp delete <name>`
- `/wp list`
- `/wp info <name>`
- `/wp <name>` (direct region info shortcut)
- `/wp where`
- `/wp flag <name> <flag|all> <true|false>`
- `/wp test`
- `/wp test cancel`

## Supported Flags

- `block_break`
- `block_place`
- `interact`

- `entity_interact`

- `fire_damage`

title: Player Dummies
description: Combat Training Dummies for Your Server
body:
# ⚔️ PlayerDummies

![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.18.2+-green)  [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1475583552564363274?logo=discord&logoColor=blue&label=Discord)](https://discord.gg/Vb263HmsPq)  [![GitHub Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/PetarMc1/PlayerDummies?label=GitHub%20Issues)](https://github.com/PetarMc1/PlayerDummies/issues)

This plugin depends on [**Citizens**](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/citizens.13811/).

---

## ⚠️ Early Development Notice

PlayerDummies is currently in early development.  
While fully functional, you may encounter bugs or missing features.
If you do:

- Open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/PetarMc1/PlayerDummies/issues) or
- Join the [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/Vb263HmsPq)

Your feedback helps improve the plugin <3

---

# Overview

PlayerDummies is a lightweight plugin that adds realistic combat training dummies to your Minecraft server.

Perfect for:

- PvP servers
- Practice arenas
- Damage testing zones
- Combat tutorials
- Minigame lobbies

PlayerDummies creates fully interactive Citizens NPCs that:

- Accurately simulate real player damage (including armor and enchantment reduction)
- Support all weapons, armor tiers, enchantments, and potions
- Provide real-time combat feedback in your action bar
- Never die or get knocked back

**Train smarter. Test faster. Improve your combat.**

---

# Key Features

## Realistic Combat Dummies
- Citizens NPCs simulate real player damage behaviour
- Supports all weapons, armor tiers (Leather → Netherite), enchantments, and potions
- Accurate critical hit detection, mace fall-damage bonus, and Strength potion tracking
- Projectile support - arrows, tridents, snowballs and more all register hits

## Real-Time Damage Tracking
- Live display in your **action bar** (or chat, if configured): `Damage: 7.5 (3.8 ❤)`
- Shows both raw damage dealt **and** hearts lost after armor/enchantment reduction
- Reflects what you would actually deal to a fully-geared player

## Full Customisation via GUI
- **Shift + Right-click** a dummy to open the **Dummy Manager GUI**
- Rename your dummy with custom colour codes
- Change the skin to any Minecraft username (Citizens integration)
- Equip any armor set through the dedicated **Armor Editor** - helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots
- Pick up your dummy from the same GUI

## Persistent & Owner-Protected
- Dummies survive server restarts (saved per-UUID under `plugins/PlayerDummies/data/`)
- Only the placer can manage their dummy by default (configurable)
- Automatic orientation on placement - dummy faces you

---

# Requirements

### Required:
- Minecraft 1.18.2+
- Spigot or Paper
- Java 17+
- **Citizens** (required - plugin will not load without it)

### Optional:
- PlaceholderAPI (for placeholder support)

---

# How It Works

## For Server Owners

### Installation

1. Place the JAR into your `plugins/` folder
2. Install **Citizens** (required)
3. Restart your server
4. Configure settings in `plugins/PlayerDummies/config.yml`

### Configuration
Config files are in `/plugins/PlayerDummies`.

### Permissions

All permissions default to **op**.

| Permission | Description |
|---|---|
| `playerdummies.give` | Use `/dummies give` |
| `playerdummies.reload` | Reload the plugin config and messages |
| `playerdummies.admin` | Access admin commands: `list`, `remove`, `info` |

---

## For Players

### Step 1 - Get a Dummy

```
/dummies give <player> <amount>
```

You will receive a **Player Dummy** item (a player head) in your inventory.

### Step 2 - Place It

- Hold the dummy item and **right-click a block**
- The dummy spawns on top of the block, automatically facing you
- One dummy item is consumed per placement

### Step 3 - Manage via GUI

**Shift + Right-click** the dummy to open the **Dummy Manager**:

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| 🏷️ Set Display Name | Click, then type a name in chat (supports `&` colour codes) |
| 🎭 Set Skin | Click, then type a Minecraft username in chat |
| 🛡️ Armor Editor | Opens a GUI to equip helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots |
| 📦 Pick Up Dummy | Removes the dummy and returns the item to your inventory |
| ↩️ Back | Close the menu |

**Inside the Armor Editor:**
- Drag armor pieces into the four armor slots
- Shift-click armor from your inventory to auto-fill the correct slot
- Click **Save Armor** to apply changes to the dummy
- Closing without saving returns any items you placed back to your inventory

### Step 4 - Test Damage

- Attack the dummy normally
- Your action bar shows: `Damage: X.X (X.X ❤)` - actual damage dealt after accounting for the dummy's armor and enchantments
- Test any weapon, enchantment, potion, critical hit, or projectile combination
- The dummy **never dies or moves**

---

# Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/dummies give <player> <amount>` | `playerdummies.give` | Give dummy items to a player |
| `/dummies reload` | `playerdummies.reload` | Reload config and messages |
| `/dummies list` | `playerdummies.admin` | List all saved dummies |
| `/dummies remove <uuid>` | `playerdummies.admin` | Force-remove a dummy by its UUID |
| `/dummies info <uuid>` | `playerdummies.admin` | Show details about a dummy (owner, location, type) |

> **Aliases:** `/dummy` and `/dummies` both work.

---

# Use Cases

### ⚔️ PvP Practice Arenas
Train against a fully-geared dummy before entering competitive zones.

### 🔬 Damage Testing Labs
Optimise builds, enchantments, and potion combos with accurate feedback.

### 🎮 Minigame Lobbies
Keep players engaged while waiting for a game to start.

### 📚 Combat Tutorials
Teach new players mechanics in a safe, controlled environment.

---

# API for Developers

An official API is currently in development.  
Stay tuned for integration features.

---

# Why Choose PlayerDummies?

- ✅ Lightweight & optimized
- ✅ Accurate armor & enchantment damage simulation
- ✅ GUI-based dummy management
- ✅ Built for modern Minecraft
- ✅ Persistent storage
- ✅ Simple and intuitive

---

# Support & Updates

### Found a bug?
Report it here:  
https://github.com/PetarMc1/PlayerDummies/issues

### Want a feature?
Suggest it in the [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/Vb263HmsPq)

---

# Screenshots

### Action Bar Damage Display
![Action Bar Damage](https://files.petarmc.com/images/playerdummies/actionbar_dmg.png)

### Custom Skins (Citizens Integration)
![Custom Skins](https://files.petarmc.com/images/playerdummies/dummy_skin.png)

---

### Thank you for using PlayerDummies! ⚔️

title: Supply
description: Automatically supplies (refills) items in your hand as you use them.
body:
### 📌 about
**Supply** is a highly configurable client-side utility designed to keep your workflow uninterrupted. Whether you are building, farming, or fighting, this mod automatically supplies your hand the moment you run out.

### 🛠️ features
- **intelligent caching:** Tracks what was in your hand before it ran out, allowing the mod to make smart decisions about what to supply next.
- **dual hand support:** Fully supports supplying items to both the Main Hand and Offhand.
- **seamless swapping:** If the item is in the hotbar, it changes your selection; if it's in the inventory, it moves it to your hand.
- **loyalty awareness:** Detects when you throw a weapon with the Loyalty enchantment and waits for it to return, rather than instantly filling the slot with a different item.
- **throwable control:** Optionally prevents auto-supplying when throwing items like Eggs or Snowballs (tagged under `supply:throwables`) to stop accidental spam, while still allowing it if you drop the stack manually.
- **smart eating:** If you consume your last food item, the mod will only search for more food if you are still hungry.
- **copy search:** Always searches for an identical match first, strictly checking for matching Enchantments, Durability, and Data Components.
- **audio feedback:** Plays a subtle sound when a supply is successful, so you know you're locked and loaded.
- **continuous building:** Optionally supplies any available block item when your current stack runs out, allowing you to keep placing blocks without interruption.
- **in-game configuration:** Every behavior can be toggled via the config screen to fit your specific playstyle.

##### Found a bug? Please open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/aaavein/supply/issues).

title: BlockRevive
description: A LightPaper weight plugin to regenerate any blocks in any region you make.
body:
# **BlockRevive** - Advanced Block Regeneration Plugin

BlockRevive is a powerful and feature-rich Minecraft plugin for Paper servers that enables automatic block regeneration in designated regions. Perfect for mining servers, resource worlds, and custom game modes where you want blocks to respawn after being mined.

**Supported Versions:**
The recommended versions are currently 1.21 to 1.21.10,
Other Minecraft versions may work, but they haven't been tested.

## 🌟 Key Features
- **Region-Based Regeneration System** - Define custom 3D regions where blocks automatically regenerate after being broken
- **Full Nexo Integration** - Complete support for Nexo custom blocks with proper ID detection and regeneration
- **WorldEdit Schematic Support** - Paste schematics and automatically create regeneration regions
- **Visual Selection Tool** - Easy-to-use enchanted blaze rod wand for selecting regions (left/right click to set positions)
- **Particle Boundaries** - Visualize region boundaries with orange particle outlines
- **Customizable Regeneration Times** - Set different regeneration times per block type, per region, or globally
- **Centralized Holograms** - Display all regenerating blocks in a single paginated hologram per region
- **Individual Block Holograms** - Optional countdown timers above each regenerating block (toggleable)
- **Look-Based Hologram Display** - Holograms appear only when looking at regenerating blocks (reduces clutter)
- **Flexible Drop Control** - Configure whether blocks drop items and experience
- **Particle Effects** - Customizable particles for breaking, regenerating, and bedrock states
- **Sound Effects** - Optional sound notifications when blocks regenerate
- **Permission System** - Control who can bypass regeneration mechanics
- **Region Groups** - Organize multiple regions into groups for easier management
- **Per-Region Configuration** - Each region gets its own config file for granular control
- **Auto-Save System** - Automatic data saving to prevent loss on server crashes
- **Block Placement Prevention** - Optionally prevent players from placing blocks in regeneration regions
- **Full Tab Completion** - Complete command and argument auto-completion
- **Debug Mode** - Built-in toggleable debug logging for troubleshooting
- **WorldGuard Compatibility** - Works alongside WorldGuard for region protection


## 📋 Requirements
- Minecraft: 1.21+ (Paper recommended)
- Java: 21+
- Optional: Nexo (for custom block support)
- Optional: WorldEdit or FastAsyncWorldEdit (for schematic features)
- Optional: WorldGuard (for region protection compatibility)

## 🎮 Use Cases
- **Mining Servers** - Create renewable ore farms and mining worlds
- **Resource Worlds** - Allow infinite resource gathering without world regeneration
- **Custom RPG Worlds** - Renewable resource nodes for progression systems
- **Prison Servers** - Automated mine resets without manual intervention

## ⚡ Performance & Technical
- Efficient region management with optimized block tracking
- Async block regeneration to prevent server lag
- Smart caching system for block types and regeneration data
- Auto-save intervals to preserve data during crashes
- Supports unlimited regions and regenerating blocks

## 🔧 Easy Setup
- Drop the JAR into your plugins folder
- Restart the server
- Use /blockrevive wand to get the selection tool
- Select your region and use /blockrevive create <name>
- Configure block times in the region's config file
- Done! Blocks will now regenerate automatically

## 📦 Commands Overview
- Region creation and management
- Block-specific regeneration time configuration
- Schematic pasting with auto-region creation
- Region visualization and inspection
- Hologram positioning and management
- Region grouping for batch operations
- Manual save and reload functions

## 🛡️ Permissions
- blockrevive.admin - Full access to all commands and features
- blockrevive.bypass - Break blocks normally without regeneration
- blockrevive.region.<region> - Allow Player to mine in certain regions

## 📝 Version Information
- Plugin Name: BlockRevive
- Author: Turretedash7

title: Fluffy Dandelions
description: A whimsical micro-mod adding Fluffy Dandelions that can be plucked, placed, or “blown” to grant temporary Luck with charming particle and sound effects.
body:
**Fluffy Dandelions** is a cozy little mod that introduces a brand new flower into Minecraft: the **Fluffy Dandelion**.

It may look like a simple decorative plant at first, but it comes with a special interactive mechanic that brings a touch of magic and playfulness to your world.

✨ **Features**

- Naturally spawning flower that gently releases soft, drifting particles as it sits in the world.
- Spawns in **Forests, Flower Forests, and Plains**, blending seamlessly into natural biomes.
- Interactive blowing mechanic – hold the flower in your hand, crouch (Shift), and Right-Click to blow its fluffy seeds into the air.
- Stack usage – blowing consumes one dandelion from your hand, making the effect feel precious and rewarding.
- Luck effect bonus – blowing on the dandelion has a **25% chance** to grant you the Luck effect for a short duration, turning a simple moment of playfulness into a helpful advantage.
- Custom sound effect – enjoy a soft, cozy “blow” sound to match the action.
- Flower pot support – display it in a pot for an extra cozy decoration.
- Compostable – just like other plants in Minecraft.


![Blowing Fluffy Dandelion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f016c3a736ffc446a3d2351d0d599292e50692e6.gif)

🌬️ **Why Fluffy Dandelions?**

Minecraft is full of big adventures, but sometimes it’s the little details that make a world feel alive. The Fluffy Dandelion is a small, cozy addition that blends naturally into the game while giving players a fun new way to interact with nature. Blow the seeds, hear the sound, feel the calm – and maybe even enjoy a bit of good fortune along the way.

title: Makertastic Totem Shattering
description: A sub-data pack from Makertastic Experience that aims to balance the Totem of Undying in a new way.
body:
# About

Makertastic Totem Shattering is a sub-data pack from [Makertastic Experience](https://modrinth.com/datapack/makertastic-experience), created by me, as I consider this feature good enough to make an independent data pack of it. If you like this, you should also check [Makertastic Experience](https://modrinth.com/datapack/makertastic-experience), as it has even more funny features to play with!

# Features

Added the Totem of Eternal Life. It's crafted with a Totem of Undying and a Nether Star. It works just like the Totem of Undying, except when it saves you, it shatters instead of disappearing completely. When shattered, it won't protect you from death anymore until it recharges. That takes about 20 minutes, as long as as it stays in your inventory.

To keep things balanced, evokers from raids no longer drop the Totem of Undying. You can only find it by killing evokers or looting chests in woodland mansions, and if you are REALLY lucky, you can find it in ominous vaults from trial chambers. Also, Evokers spawned in raids will now use their Totem of Undying in battle, instead of dropping it on death.

# Credits

Special thanks to [Torrezx](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/torrezx/) and [Minho](https://www.patreon.com/cw/minhocreates) for their contributions in this project!
