title: Auto Login & Auto Register
description: Forgot your password again? Have to think of a password for /register again? Well this mod fixes that, adding auto register, and auto login!
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ea7e6c15624e44a806ffb3ee173cff84c493bff.png)
---


```
Forgot your password again? Have to think of a password for /register again? Well this mod fixes that.
```

![Auto Login](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/711a30186877013d1dcbc8dbf5ee587f42e7aaa6_0.webp)

## Features

• **Auto Login Detection** - Automatically detects login prompts and logs you in  

• **Password Storage** - Saves your passwords per server/username combination (in plain text currently)

• **Auto Registration** - Generates random passwords when you need to register (configurable context + password length) 

• **Manual Commands** - Use `.autologin` and `.autoregister` commands to manually register/login if auto detection failed or disabled

• **Configurable Patterns** - Customize login/register auto detection patterns (so it can work in a specific server)

## Configuration

### Setup
The mod creates a `config/autologininfo` folder in your Minecraft directory containing:
- `config.txt` - All mod settings and patterns
- `playerstoredinfo.txt` - password storage (server:username:password format)

**Manual Commands:**
- `.autologin` - Forces immediate login attempt using saved password
- `.autoregister` - Forces immediate registration with new generated password

### Configuration Options

**Delay Settings:**
- `usedelay=true/false` - Enable/disable delay before auto-login
- `delayseconds=1` - Seconds to wait before attempting login

**Detection Patterns:**
- `loginpattern="login"` - Text to detect login prompts
- `registerpattern="register"` - Text to detect registration prompts
- `autodetectloginprompt=true/false` - Enable auto-login detection
- `autodetectregister=true/false` - Enable auto-registration detection

**Command Formats:**
- `commandformatlogin="/login $p"` - Login command template ($p = password)
- `commandformatregister="/register $p $p"` - Register command template

**Password Generation:**
- `passwordlength=6` - Length of generated passwords
- `contentpallet="abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"` - Characters to use

**Behavior Controls:**
- `disableonceloggedin=true/false` - Stop checking after successful login
- `disableonceregistered=true/false` - Stop checking after successful registration
- `showdebugmessages=false` - Enable/disable all mod messages in chat

**Auto-Save:**
- `autosave=true/false` - Automatically save passwords from manual commands

# Crops & Plants v2.0.0

This mod aims to add more flora to the game that is actually useful, and not just a decoration

Lotus Chips - Grant a short Speed II burst when eaten;
Fungi Of a Lotus Leaf - Can only be stacked to 1, grants Saturation II for a decent amount of time when eaten
Golden Apple Stew - Gives the regular golden apple effects but for longer time

- A new effect - Heracleum Juice, that damages affected entities when exposed to sunlight,
Has potion variants that are brewed from a heracleum juice bottle and a water bottle

- New Block Entity - Cultivation Barrel, that passively generates every type of fungi (can output items with a hopper)

title: Creeper's Alternative Start
description: Changes Minecraft progression!
body:
Ever thought that the beginning of minecraft worlds were too easy? Well, with Creeper's Alternative Start™, you can change that.

In CAS, you can't punch trees, so get flint and knap it on a rock. Combine a shard from knapping and a stick to make a flint knife. Break grass with the knife to get Grass fibers. Combine 3 fibers to make Grass string. With string, make a flint hatchet and pickaxe. With the pickaxe, mine copper to make copper tools! (Equivalent to stone tools)

Minecraft Progression has been altered! Instead of going straight to the nether after getting diamonds, you have to kill the Elder Guardian. Turtle Armor can help you kill it, as even though the default armor bars of it are weaker than iron, it has more armor toughness, knockback resistance, and, with the full set equiped, grants you water breathing for 4 minutes. Iroll is a post EG metal made from combining gold and Iron and putting it into a Blast Furnace, which needs blackstone now, requiring you to go to the nether. Anvils will need this Iroll, making repairing hard early game and enchantments impossible pre-EG. But, to kill the dragon, you must kill the wither first! The Enchanting Table also requires a piece of endstone, meaning you must kill the dragon before an enchanting table is given.

**Look at Advancements for a more complete Guide!**

body:
🌪️ Toxic Storm – Survive the Poison
Toxic Storm is a deadly survival mod that transforms Minecraft into a fight for your life against a massive toxic storm. After three days in a new world, the storm awakens — and from that point on, survival becomes a desperate race against time, poison, and chaos.

⏳ You Have 3 Days
When you enter a new world, you have three in-game days to gather supplies, craft gear, and prepare. After that, the toxic storm begins — and only one place is safe: your original spawn point.

🛑 The Safe Zone
A small protected area around your spawn is the only place where the storm can't reach you.

Stepping outside it means instant death from the poisonous clouds.

Even hostile mobs like zombies and creepers spawn inside the safe zone, making it your only refuge and your greatest threat.

🧪 Toxic Resistance Potion
You’re not entirely helpless — using apples, you can craft a special potion that grants temporary immunity (2 minutes) to the toxic storm.
Use it wisely to explore, relocate, or escape when the storm shifts to another location.

💀 What Happens in the Storm?
☠️ Instant death outside the safe zone without protection

💣 Random TNT bombardments

🧟 Mob spawns inside the safe zone

⚡ Sudden teleportation events to random locations

🔧 Features
Global toxic storm starts after 3 days

Potion system that adds risk-reward choices

Perfect for chaos survival, hardcore maps, or content creators

⚠️ Early Development Notice
Toxic Storm is still under active development. Expect bugs and experimental mechanics. Feedback is welcome to help shape the final experience.

title: Crafter Spells
description: CrafterSpells introduces a collection of utility spells to enhance your Minecraft experience, inspired by the Summoner Spells from League of Legends.
body:
![Crafter Spells](https://i.imgur.com/sn0FMPD.png)

# CrafterSpells

CrafterSpells introduces a collection of utility spells to enhance your Minecraft experience, inspired by the Summoner
Spells from League of Legends. This magic system is designed to complement vanilla gameplay while adding new strategic options for players.

![Spells Menu](https://i.imgur.com/sOnIOIB.png)

## How to Use

All Crafter Spells are given to players by default and can be viewed and selected by accessing the Craft Spells screen by pressing the `M` key (Default).
At any one time, only two Crafter Spells can be assigned from the menu in two dedicated spell slots that appear next to your hotbar. Press the assigned keys (default: `V` and `B`) to cast the spell in each slot. Some spells have immediate effects, while others have cooldowns or special mechanics.

## Spells List
<details>
### Barrier

Creates a magical barrier around you that increases your armor rating and renders a translucent shield effect. The barrier absorbs incoming damage, protecting you from harm.

**Effect:** Increases armor rating
**Duration:** 10 seconds
**Cooldown:** 20 seconds

---

### Bore

Creates a tunnel through solid blocks in the direction you're looking. Perfect for mining or creating quick pathways through mountains.

**Effect:** Bores a cylindrical tunnel (radius 1, length 12 blocks)
**Cooldown:** 40 seconds
**Note:** Doesn't affect bedrock or liquids

---

### Ghost

Transforms you into a ghostly form, allowing you to move 20% faster and pass through solid blocks. Perfect for exploration and escaping tight situations.

**Effect:** 20% increased speed, no-clip through blocks, partial invisibility
**Duration:** 10 seconds
**Cooldown:** 40 seconds

---

### Growth

Enriches the soil in a radius around you, causing crops to instantly grow. A helpful spell for rapid farming and food production.

**Effect:** Instantly grows crops in a 6-block radius
**Cooldown:** 120 seconds
**Note:** Similar to bone meal but affects multiple plants simultaneously

---

### Heal

Restores a portion of your missing health and can also heal a nearby ally you're looking at. A vital spell for survival and team play.

**Effect:** Heals 40% of missing health (minimum 2 health points) for you and a targeted ally
**Range:** 16 blocks for ally targeting
**Cooldown:** 40 seconds

---

### Nourish

Quickly restores hunger and saturation for you and an ally you're looking at. Never worry about food during long expeditions again!

**Effect:** Restores 60% of missing hunger and 40% of missing saturation
**Range:** 16 blocks for ally targeting
**Cooldown:** 120 seconds

---

### Saturate

A combat spell that drains the hunger of opponents, preventing them from sprinting. Gives you a strategic advantage in PvP encounters.

**Effect:** Reduces target's hunger by 8 points, sets saturation to 0, and applies Hunger effect
**Range:** 20 blocks
**Cooldown:** 120 seconds

---

### Snowball

A two-phase spell. First cast throws a magical snowball that marks the first entity it hits. Second cast teleports you directly to the marked entity.

**Phase 1:** Throws a snowball projectile that marks the first entity hit
**Phase 2:** Teleports to the marked entity
**Range:** 20 blocks (projectile), 50 blocks (teleport range)
**Cooldown:** Only applied after teleportation or if the snowball misses - 40 seconds
</details>

## Planned Features

- Additional spells with unique effects
- Configuration
- Multi-Language Support

description: A mod that makes eggs more functional, allowing them to be boiled and fried
body:
In this mod, you can cook and eat eggs in various ways, making eggs a more useful and exciting food item in Minecraft! There are two primary methods for preparing eggs: boiling and frying.


<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/-EoCPoPTf_g" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


# Boiling Eggs:

To boil an egg, place a Raw Egg in a campfire or furnace. After the egg is cooked, you’ll receive a Boiled Egg that restores 4 Hunger bars and leaves its Egg Shell when eaten.

## Steps to Boil an Egg:
1. Place a Raw Egg in a furnace.
2. Wait until the Raw Egg cooks, transforming into a Boiled Egg.
3. Eat the Boiled Egg to restore 4 Hunger bars.



# Frying Eggs:
To fry an egg, you will need a Frying Pan. After crafting the Frying Pan, to crack your egg and pour it into the pan, craft using the recipe in Image 3 and you’ll obtain the Egg On Pan item.

Cook the Egg On Pan in a furnace until it turns into a Fried Egg On Pan. Eating this Fried Egg On Pan restores 5 Hunger bars and, once eaten, you’ll get back the Frying Pan item that is empty.

## Steps to Fry an Egg:
1. Craft a Frying Pan.
2. Craft as in the image below to crack an egg and pour it into the pan, transforming it to Egg On Pan item.
3. Cook the Egg On Pan in a furnace until it turns into a Fried Egg On Pan.
4. Eat the Fried Egg On Pan to restore 5 Hunger bars. Once eaten, the Frying Pan item will be returned to your inventory.

title: Horse Armor Smithing
description: A unique take on craftable horse armor, making it upgradable via smithing!
body:
So, as you may (or may not) know, there is only 1 type of horse armor that is craftable: Leather Horse Armor. A lot of people don't think that makes much sense, myself included, and a lot of people make datapacks to fix that and allow for crafting of other variants. 

The issue is, though, these recipes are oftentimes pretty pricey, costing up to 5-6 of the material you want to use. Who's willing to spend 5-6 of their well earned diamonds to keep their horse armored up? I'd rather not.

That's the main idea behind this pack. It's a cheaper alternative to various craftable horse armor packs. Instead of using large amounts of material in a crafting table, you can upgrade your horse armor using just 2 ingots/diamonds in a smithing table!

![A gif showing the 3 recipes available for horse armor upgrading](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fdc999ff0ba48ac4e0b78564a489dfd3d87eb6b1.gif)

title: Expanded Entity Armor Model
description: This is a Resource pack that turns on parts that vanilla hides without breaking other resource packs!
body:
# Expanded Entity Armor Model
## What does the Resource Pack does?

Vanilla uses 2 models for armor models:

**[entity]_outer_armor.JEM** for the helmet, chestplate and boots, these models show all the parts/cubes in it: right/left legs, right/left arms, body, head, and headwear.

**[entity]_inner_armor.JEM** for the leggings, this only shows the right/left legs and the body, but for some reason it vanilla hides the rest: right/left arms, head, and the headwear.

This Resource Pack turns on these parts, and adjusts the heads to not interfere with the player skin, however this isn't the only thing it does, it also adjusts the armor model to fit better with the slim player and all other entities that can wear armor in vanilla (anyone can suggest me an entity from a mod in the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/SanguardMC/Expanded-Entity-Armor-Model/issues)

The entity changes are made so they don't break other resource packs that add other armor textures, you can use the models in the pack. However, I'd highly appreciate it if you included a link to this pack, as it required a lot of effort to re-model the entity armor manually with the correct UV without breaking everything.

## How can it be used?

The Pack allows you to create things like gloves or something like the Maid armor for my [Resource Pack,](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/spectrumcraft-pack) which also includes these models

The Resource Pack also includes a Template armor that can be used with [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)

You can use the Armor Template [Blockbench model](https://github.com/SanguardMC/Expanded-Entity-Armor-Model/releases/tag/BB-Model) on the GitHub Repository, or you have the armor template armor that's inside the pack and the model:

|Template Armor|Armor Template Model|
|-|-|
|![Template Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Rc79ILyk/images/555ca0f72f915200ccbf70071e7a610c731d1ba3.png)|![Armor Template Model](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Rc79ILyk/images/97e9600b6436b711af246b0805e03d9bd65190f5.png)|

Red/Green is the outer layer, while the Blue/Yellow is the inner layer

## Dependencies

You'll only require [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) in order to work, but I'd recommend CIT Resewn if you want to add armor to your resource pack and use the template armor

As far as I'm concerned, Optifine doesn't support entity armor CEM models, so I'm not sure if it works

## Credits
- [Traben](https://modrinth.com/user/Traben) & Infinity-lily
  - For helping me know how to show these hidden parts in Traben's discord server
- [Shizotoaster's Ultimate Armor Patch](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ultimate-armor-patch/gallery)
  - For the inspiration of adapt all models to fit the entities but without destroying other Resource Packs

title: PeterWolf’s Planes
description: Peter Wolf’s Planes adds a fully‑steerable biplane to Minecraft, bringing a lightweight, vintage‑style aviation experience to the game.
body:
# PeterWolf’s Planes 

![planes mod banner ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/McTtzw3T/images/b10e03807ec6d841ec4c05ee0046baef2c4a1baa.png)

## Overview
Peter Wolf’s Planes adds a fully‑steerable biplane to Minecraft, bringing a lightweight, vintage‑style aviation experience to the game. The mod introduces realistic flight physics, speed‑dependent control surfaces, a functional HUD, and a polished visual presentation (custom icon and ModMenu banner).

## Features
* Steerable Biplane Entity – Fly a biplane that responds to mouse look (pitch & roll) and keyboard A/D for yaw/rudder.
* Speed‑Dependent Controls – Control surface effectiveness scales with forward speed; at a standstill the plane is unresponsive, and responsiveness ramps up linearly as you accelerate.
* Aerodynamic Lift Tuning – Lift is calibrated to overcome gravity at roughly 35 km/h (≈ 0.486 blocks/tick), providing a smooth take‑off and realistic stall behavior.
* Improved Gliding Physics – Reduced drag at low throttle and enhanced lift allow graceful glides and energy exchange (climbing slows the plane, diving speeds it up).
* Larger Landing‑Gear Wheels – Wheels are now 4 × 10 × 10 blocks, with custom textures for a sturdier ground stance and better visual appeal.
* Cockpit HUD – A glass‑morphic overlay shows current speed (m/s & km/h), altitude, vertical speed (color‑coded), and throttle/brake status.

## Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.2 (or newer) and the Fabric API.
2. Download the latest peterwolfs_planes-*.jar from Modrinth.
3. Place the JAR file into your mods/ folder.
4. Launch Minecraft – the biplane item appears in the Creative tab under Peter Wolf’s Planes and can be crafted or given via commands.

## Usage
* Equip the Plane item and right‑click to mount.
* Throttle: Use the assigned key (default W/S). Negative throttle triggers wheel brakes on the ground.
* Steering: Move the mouse to control pitch (up/down) and roll (left/right). Yaw is assisted by a small rudder mix.
* HUD: Automatically appears while riding; press H to toggle.

title: Simple Ore Vein Miner
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that lets players toggle ore vein mining with a hotkey.
body:
# Simple Ore Vein Miner

**Simple Ore Vein Miner** is a lightweight Fabric mod that lets players toggle ore vein mining on and off with a hotkey.

When enabled, mining one ore block with a pickaxe will automatically mine connected ore blocks of the same type. When disabled, mining works normally.

## Features

* Toggle vein mining with the **V** key
* Mines connected ore blocks of the same type
* Supports vanilla ores and deepslate ore variants
* Requires a pickaxe
* Works in singleplayer
* Works on multiplayer servers when installed on both client and server
* Includes a 64-block safety limit to help prevent lag
* Lightweight and simple to use

## How to use

1. Install **Fabric Loader** for your Minecraft version
2. Install **Fabric API**
3. Put **Simple Ore Vein Miner** in your `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft
5. Press **V** to turn vein mining on or off
6. Mine an ore block with a pickaxe

## Supported ores

* Coal Ore
* Iron Ore
* Copper Ore
* Gold Ore
* Redstone Ore
* Emerald Ore
* Lapis Ore
* Diamond Ore
* Nether Gold Ore
* Nether Quartz Ore
* Ancient Debris
* All vanilla deepslate ore variants

## Multiplayer

For multiplayer servers, this mod should be installed on **both the client and the server**.

The client handles the hotkey toggle, and the server handles the actual vein mining.

## Supported versions

Available versions currently include:

* Minecraft **1.21.4**
* Minecraft **1.21.11**
* Minecraft **26.1.x**

Make sure to download the correct file for your Minecraft version.

## Requirements

* **Fabric Loader**
* **Fabric API**
* **Java 21** for Minecraft 1.21.x versions
* **Java 25** for Minecraft 26.1.x versions

## Future plans

Possible future updates may include:

* Configurable max vein size
* Toggleable actionbar messages
* Modded ore support
* Custom keybind options
* Ore blacklist/whitelist config

## Elytra Break Pop

You're flying. Everything's fine. Then you're **not flying anymore**.

No warning, no flash, nothing. Your elytra just quietly died and now you're plummeting at full speed wondering what went wrong. By the time you realize it, you're already taking fall damage.

**Elytra Break Pop** adds the one thing that should've been in the game from the start — when your elytra breaks, it triggers the totem of undying animation using the broken elytra itself. Loud, visual, impossible to miss. You'll know the exact moment it happens.

The mod is extremely lightweight. It runs a single check in the background and does nothing until your elytra actually breaks — which hopefully isn't that often. No config files, no settings menu, no performance impact worth mentioning. Just install it and forget it exists until the one moment it saves you from a very embarrassing death.

Client-side only. Works on any server without any server-side installation.

title: Immortal Locator
description: A client-side fabric mod which allows you to find stronghold with only one Eye of Ender.
body:
# Immortal Locator (仙定)
A client-side fabric mod which allows you to find stronghold with only one Eye of Ender.

Inspired by [Simple Stronghold Finder](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-stronghold-finder), fixed some bugs and rewritten in Kotlin.  

> The name of this module is inspired by the ancient Chinese legend of a sage pointing the way.  
> 本模组名称灵感来源于中国古代仙人指路传说。

## Features
- Find stronghold with only one Eye of Ender.
- Minecraft 1.21.11 compatible.
- I18n supported.
- A fancy effect when found a stronghold.
- We love immortal locator so much. (仙定仙定我们喜欢你)

## Overview

This tool leverages the behavior of the Eye of Ender in Minecraft Java Edition to locate strongholds efficiently with only one throw of the Eye of Ender. Strongholds in Minecraft generate in rings around the world origin (X=0, Z=0). The locations follow a specific pattern, with a fixed number of strongholds per ring and distributed roughly evenly around the ring.

### Stronghold Generation Rings

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/01dbf039-3e2d-4ddf-8d5c-4140c4823df8)


There are 8 rings containing a total of 128 strongholds. Below is a breakdown of the stronghold distribution:

| Ring | Number of Strongholds | Distance from Origin (blocks) |
|------|-----------------------|-------------------------------|
| 1    | 3                     | 1,280–2,816                   |
| 2    | 6                     | 4,352–5,888                   |
| 3    | 10                    | 7,424–8,960                   |
| 4    | 15                    | 10,496–12,032                 |
| 5    | 21                    | 13,568–15,104                 |
| 6    | 28                    | 16,640–18,176                 |
| 7    | 36                    | 19,712–21,248                 |
| 8    | 9                     | 22,784–24,320                 |

### Key Stronghold Properties

1. Strongholds are placed at equal angles from the origin within each ring.
2. Strongholds do not generate partially above ground. If any part would extend above sea level, it is replaced with air.
3. Occasionally, strongholds generate in oceans, usually covered by terrain.

## How It Works

This implementation calculates the intersection of the Eye of Ender’s trajectory with the stronghold rings using simple geometric principles. Here is how the process works:

1. **Recording Eye Movement:**

    - The program captures two positions (`pos1` and `pos2`) of the Eye of Ender during its flight. These positions are recorded with a delay to ensure that the trajectory is properly traced.
    - If the Eye travels strictly along one axis (indicating a degenerate case), the calculation is aborted.

2. **Adjusting Coordinates:**

    - To simplify calculations, the coordinate system may be swapped (X becomes Z, and vice versa) depending on which axis the Eye traveled farther along. This ensures the slope of the line remains manageable.

3. **Calculating the Trajectory:**

    - Using the two recorded points, the slope of the trajectory is determined:
    - This slope is used to predict where the trajectory intersects with the Minecraft world grid.

4. **Finding the Ring:**

    - The tool calculates the radial distance of each potential intersection point from the origin

    - It checks whether the distance falls within one of the predefined stronghold rings. The distance ranges for each ring are carefully defined.

5. **Aligning to Minecraft Grid:**

    - Since strongholds are aligned to a 16x16 grid, the calculated coordinates are snapped to the nearest grid point

6. **Evaluating Accuracy:**

    - For each potential stronghold location, an accuracy score is calculated based on how closely the Eye’s trajectory aligns with the grid point. Higher accuracy indicates a higher likelihood of a stronghold being present.

7. **Sorting and Displaying Results:**

    - The program ranks the identified stronghold locations by accuracy. Up to 5 of the best candidates are displayed in the in-game chat, showing:
        - Overworld coordinates (X, Z)
        - Nether coordinates (X/8, Z/8)
        - Accuracy score

## Usage

1. Equip an Eye of Ender.
2. Throw the Eye and wait for the results to appear in the chat.
3. Travel to the provided coordinates to locate the stronghold.

# 🌌 **Above The Known Sky** 🌌

**Above The Known Sky** is a carefully curated Minecraft modpack focused on **exploration, atmosphere, and meaningful long-term progression**.
It is designed for players who enjoy discovering systems naturally, exploring unfamiliar worlds, and advancing through **knowledge, preparation, and curiosity rather than speed**.

> This is **not** a fast-paced or heavily guided experience. The modpack rewards patience, observation, and thoughtful progression.

## 🧭 Exploration Comes First

Exploration is not optional — it is **core to progression**.

The overworld is enhanced with **new biomes, structures, and points of interest**, making every journey meaningful. Exploration can lead to rare discoveries, powerful artifacts, and new progression paths.

> Key exploration-focused mods include:
> 
> - **Alex’s Mobs** – A richer, more believable ecosystem
> - **Artifacts** – Powerful items discovered through exploration
> - **Supplementaries** – Deeper world interaction and immersion
  
The world is meant to **feel alive, dangerous, and worth exploring**.

## 🌍 Beyond the Overworld

The journey does not end on the surface.

With **Ad Astra**, players can eventually travel into space and explore distant celestial bodies. Space exploration is a **late-game milestone**, requiring preparation, infrastructure, and technological understanding — never a shortcut.

## ⚙️ Technology With Purpose

Technology exists to **support progression**, **not replace it**.

Mods like **Create** introduce mechanical systems and automation that reward creativity and problem-solving. Automation is powerful, but earned, and always integrated into the broader experience rather than rushing players to the endgame.

## 🎧 Atmosphere, Balance & Stability

- Immersive ambient sounds and visual enhancements
- Unified resources and recipes using **Almost Unified**

title: Minecraft: Refreshed Edition
description: A collection of mods made to breathe new life into the old Minecraft experience.
body:
![Refreshed Edition Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84924b049c37a95da4d5c477f96a81de2a412265.jpeg)

Minecraft Refreshed Edition is a modpack aiming to "Refresh" Minecraft's gameplay and visuals whilst still staying true to the original game (and maybe bring back some of the older features lost to time).

There are too many tiny changes in this modpack to go over every single one here, but here are the biggest ones:

**Feature Update Mods**

- Amplified Nether - DOUBLES the Nether's height.
  
- Fancy Menu - Revamps the main menu.
  
- Missing Wilds - Adds fireflies, and improves the birch forests adding fallen trees and new flowers.
  
- Explorify - Adds brand new structures that resemble vanilla's structure style.
  
- Friends & Foes - The Mob Vote Mobs!!
  
**Quality of Life Mods**

- Right Click Harvest - Right click crops with a hoe to harvest and automatically replant them.
  
- Crops Love Rain - Crops grow faster in the rain.
  
- Continue Button - Join your last played server or world straight from the main menu.
  
- Cherished Worlds - Favorite your worlds saving them from accidental deletion.
  
- Kaffee's Dual Ride - Have two people on the same horse!
  
- Screenshot Viewer - Let's you see your screenshots in game.

And last, but not least...

**Parity & Fun Mods**

- Controlify - Adds controller support.
  
- Skin Shuffle - Adds a skin gallery similar to Bedrock Edition that allows you to change your skins in game.
  
- Comfortable Campfires - Gives you the regeneration effect when huddled around a campfire.
  
- First Person Model - Allows you to see your whole character's body (You worked hard on that skin, now you can actually see it!)
  
- Sitting+ - Lets you pose and sit on the ground (with special poses when certain conditions are met)
  
- Sound Physics Perfected - Adds reverb in caves, muffling behind walls, and more I can't possibly explain (Check out the mod page for more info, I don't fully understand how it works myself, but I *love* it.)

- Effective - Adds cascades at the bottom of waterfalls, splashes when items fall into water, biome ambience, and much more.

Those are the main features in the pack, but there are SO many more. Keep an eye out as you play in your world, you'll find a lot more in the pack than this list shows (just a friendly piece of advice, _maybe_ prepare a little harder for the Ender Dragon Fight. Just in case.)

ANYWAYS, there are some features not yet in the pack that are worth mentioning. The following (short) list is features I plan to implement in the future.

**Planned Features:**

Tutorial Worlds -
- One of my favorite things from the Xbox 360 edition of Minecraft was the Tutorial Worlds. It was an easy way to get into the game and even when you knew what you were doing they were always fun to explore and find new secrets (anyone remember the Stampy's Lovely World replica??). The plan after the release of Refreshed Edition 1.0 is to bring back one or two of the old tutorial worlds retrofitted for the newer versions and also create a completely new Tutorial World from scratch to have a new take on the subject. I'm unsure when this will be finished, but it's on the list of plans!

![TutorialWorld (TU46)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91e56f7b3751a8049a322ad9277afc7d35e43cf7.jpeg)

Minigame Servers -
- My ACTUAL favorite thing from Xbox 360 edition was the minigame servers! Having a button on the main menu to just hop into a dedicated minigame with other people and have some fun (the Elytra one was undoubtedly the best and I will die on that hill) was amazing. This one is a _huge_ maybe, since a public server of this sort would be way out of my area of expertise, but if there would be people willing to help make this possible (helping with builds, datapack stuff, maybe some modding, etc...) it would go a long way to making this possible. I would _love_ to make this happen, so if you're interested, let me know through the discord.

![Minigame Server](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8176881d1aabdb057a2d905bcfef171db146660.jpeg)

If there's any feedback you want to give about the modpack or if you want to follow along with its development, come join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/kGasSAsP4R)!

title: JATiCA
description: Add JAOPCA materials to Tinker's Construct
body:
# JATiCA
JATiCA (**J**ust **A** **Ti**nkers' **C**onstruct/**C**ompatibility **A**ttempt) is a mod that adds materials registered in JAOPCA as Tinkers' Construct materials.  
Since this is an addon mod developed by a third party, please direct any questions or bug reports about this mod to me, not to the developers of JAOPCA or Tinkers' Construct.

🌐[日本語](https://github.com/BlueSheep2804/JATiCA/blob/master/README_ja.md)

## Setup
1. Install JAOPCA, Tinkers' Construct, and JATiCA.
2. Launch Minecraft.
3. Open `config/jaopca/modules/jatica_materials.toml` and add the names of the JAOPCA materials you want to add as Tinkers' Construct materials to `passiveMaterialWhitelist = []`.  
    Setting it to `["*"]` will add all materials registered in JAOPCA as Tinkers' Construct materials.
4. Restart Minecraft.
5. Open `<material_name>.toml` in `config/jaopca/materials/` and configure the material properties in the `[jatica]` section.  
    By default, no parts are generated, so set the required parts to `true`.
6. Restart Minecraft, and the Tinkers' Construct materials will be added.

## Changing Material Names
If you want to change the material names displayed in Tinkers' Construct, add a key like `material.jatica.<material_name>`.  
> <material_name> Small Blade, <material_name> Mattock, etc.
```json
{
    "material.jatica.amethyst": "Cool Amethyst"
}
```
If you want to change the material names displayed in JAOPCA, add a key like `jaopca.material.<material_name>`.  
> Molten <material_name>, Block of <material_name>, etc.
```json
{
    "jaopca.material.amethyst": "Cool Amethyst"
}
```

## Acknowledgments
Thanks to the developers of JAOPCA and Tinkers' Construct.
- [JAOPCA](https://github.com/TheLMiffy1111/JAOPCA)
- [Tinkers' Construct](https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct)

title: TwitchChat
description: Mod for forward Twitch Chat to In-Game Chat!
body:
# 🎮 TwitchChat for Minecraft Fabric

[![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modloader-Fabric-1976d2?logo=fabric)](https://fabricmc.net/)
[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21+-62b47a?logo=minecraft)](https://www.minecraft.net/)
[![License: GPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPL3.0-green.svg)](https://github.com/everyofflineuser/TwitchChatMC/blob/dev/LICENSE)
[![Twitch4J](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependency-Twitch4J-9146ff?logo=twitch\&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/mod/twitch4j)

A Fabric mod that brings your Twitch chat directly into Minecraft. Messages are displayed in the in-game chat with a **Twitch icon prefix** (via built-in resource pack) and colored usernames.

![TwitchChat in action](https://i.postimg.cc/PqBDW8vx/2025-09-17-18-35-41.png) *TwitchChat in action*

![TwitchChat with Streamotes](https://i.postimg.cc/9F8rPqvh/2025-09-17-23-46-32.png) *TwitchChat with Streamotes*

---

## ✨ Features

* 📺 Display Twitch chat directly in Minecraft
* 🟣 Twitch **icon prefix**
* 🎨 Usernames use Twitch’s assigned color (default white) [WIP]
* ⚙️ Easy setup with `/twitchchat` command
* 📁 Configurable via JSON file
* 🔄 Auto connect/disconnect when entering/leaving a world or connect/disconnect a server

---

## 📦 Installation

### Requirements

* [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
* [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
* [Twitch4J (Required)](https://modrinth.com/mod/twitch4j)
* [Streamotes (Recommended)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/streamotes)

### Steps

1. Install **Fabric Loader 1.21.8**
2. Download and place in `mods/`:
    * Twitch4J
    * Streamotes (optional)
    * TwitchChat
3. Launch Minecraft

---

## 🎮 Usage

### Command

```
/twitchchat <username>
```

Example:

```
/twitchchat minecraft
```

### Config file

Edit `config/twitchchat.json`:

```json
{
  "twitchChannel":"everyofflineuser",
  "formatMessage":"✌ %s: %s"
}
```

---

## 🖼 Standart Message Format

```
[TwitchIcon] Username: message
```

* Prefix is a **Twitch icon** from the built-in resource pack
* Username uses Twitch color (or white by default)
* Message text is light gray

---

## ⚙️ Settings

* In-game commands
* `config/twitchchat.json`

---

## 🔧 Compatibility

* Minecraft **1.21+**
* Fabric Loader
* Twitch4J (required)
* Streamotes (recommended)
* Compatible with most mods that don’t override chat

---

## ❓ FAQ

**Q: Mod doesn’t work?**
A: Check Twitch4J is installed – it’s required.

**Q: Messages not showing?**
A: Verify the Twitch channel name and that the stream is live.

**Q: Can I change colors?**
A: Yep, in config/twitchchat.json

---

## 🐛 Bug Reports

1. Ensure dependencies are installed
2. Check game logs
3. Report issues on \[GitHub Issues]

---

## 📜 License

Licensed under the **GPL-3.0**. See [LICENSE](https://github.com/everyofflineuser/TwitchChatMC/blob/dev/LICENSE).

---

## 🤝 Credits

* Fabric team – mod loader
* Twitch4J devs – Twitch API library
* Streamotes team – emote integration
* Minecraft modding community – support and ideas

title: Seva ya Season 6 Modpack
description: Modpack for the 6th Season of the Seva ya SMP
body:
This is for a private SMP, but I it's easy to have it here. The following is the changelog for the modpack overall:

The Modpack is completely serverside, so the installation of these mods are completely optional, the following ones can be installed to the client to enchance the experience.

<details>
<summary>Suggested Mods</summary>

  [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat): This mod will not only allow you to voice chat from within the game, it also enables custom horns/music discs etc.
  
[Armor Poser](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-poser): This mod will make it a lot easier to pose armor stands

[Item Swapper](https://modrinth.com/plugin/itemswapper): This mod allows you to swap to similar items in your inventory from your hands.

[Elytra Trims](https://modrinth.com/mod/XpzGz7KD): Allows you to see the trims you can apply to your elytras.

</details>

----------------------------------

<details>
<summary>Currency, Missions and Milestones</summary>
The world starts with a worldborder, the nether and the end is blocked off. To enable them again you need to use "Sevayic Currency".
You can see and deposit to Milestones by using the ``/milestone`` command. As you unlock the milestones more of them will open up, some of them might even unlock some additional mods!

Our main currency this season aren't diamonds, instead we have Sevayic Shards, Sevayic

Every week missions will be given out randomly, you need to right click a "Mission Log Block" to get your missions granted to you, which then you can use ``/missions`` command to see this weeks missions.

Missions have 5 difficulties:
Easy missions can be completed without much preparation, and they can be completed by yourself
Medium and Hard Missions are harder, and require witnesses to complete.

Assigned missions are created by admins and require the person who made them to grant them to you. These missions will be given out my the people in our server working on big projects! For example if someone is working on a Zoo, they can make an assigned mission for the delivery of a Warden, we promote projects so the payment for these missions come out of the server, not the project owner.

Eternal missions are missions that you have to keep going for the rest of the server, they are generally for opening and maintaining a shop. After being paid for them if you can't maintain a shop you will lose the mission and have to pay the 1.5x the reward as a penalty.
</details>


<details>
<summary>The Sevayic Trader</summary>
The wandering trader has gotten quite the upgrade, and now it trades using sevayic materials, and all of it's trades are active at all times, it's trades upgrade as more milestones are complete and it will help you get the grindier items much easier. And who knows, it might help you get some special items as well.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Side Milestones</summary>
Aside from unlocking dimensions, the Milestones will also let you unlock the following mods:

- [Patbox's Brewery](https://modrinth.com/mod/brewery)
- [More Tools](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-tools)
- [Glide Away](https://modrinth.com/mod/glide-away)
  
</details>

<details>
<summary>Lenient Death</summary>
When you die your tools/weapons/armor will no longer drop. You still will need to go back and pickup everything else.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Changes to Villagers</summary>
Villagers have once again been majorly nerfed, 
  
- You no longer get XP out of trading
- High Quality Foods (Cooked Porkchops, Chickens, Golden Carrots) are badly prepared. Meaning that they have a 10% chance to give you Hunger when eaten.
- Diamond Items Sold by the Villagers are shoddily made, they are tiered between Iron and Regular Diamond tools.
- The Librarian villagers no longer sell enchanted books, instead they sell soul lanterns, chiseled bookshelves and tinted glass.

To balance this out, villagers no longer need to restock any of their trades!

</details>

<details>
<summary>Changes to Enchanting</summary>
  
Not only is there [revamps to the existing enchantments](https://modrinth.com/datapack/seva-ya-new-enchants) the modpack also has [new enchants](https://modrinth.com/datapack/seva-ya-new-enchants). All of these enchants but Sculk Thrive can be obtained from the enchanting table, including curses.

With the enchanting table "weakened" and the villager trades gone, there needs to be a new way to get enchantments repetably. This is where the Enchanting Trims come to play. With the enchantment trims, a book and some sevayic currency on a smithing table you can get any Max Level Book you want given you have it's trim, just like other Trim Templates these can also be duplicated. 

To see how to obtain each enchantment there's a tab on the advancements screen.
</details>


<details>
<summary>New Food and Fishes?</summary>
We are planning to add more Fishes and Food to the game, sadly these features are not ready yet.

For now the only one we have is that Hoglins now drop Chewy Porkchops, a porkchop that takes longer to eat and gives slightly less saturation/hunger. 
</details>


<details>
<summary>Changes to Farming</summary>

Thanks to [Harvest with ease](https://modrinth.com/mod/W4Ajthd2), while holding a hoe you can right click crops to auto harvest them and even get some XP out of it. Better hoes have a bigger range but do keep in mind that this takes durability away from your hoe.

[Hoes also have bigger ranges based on their size when tilling](https://modrinth.com/mod/9vlChzlU).
</details>

<details>
<summary>Changes to Recipes</summary>
Alongside some recipes to make the game easier, we also have some nerfs to some recipes.

- Flight Rockets now require fire charges to craft, alongside that fire charges now also can't be crafted with charcoal.
- Tuff can be crafted with cobblestone and gravel 
- Calcite can be crafted with diorite and bonemeal
- Soul Sand can be blasted to Tinted Glass
- Tuff and Calcite can be used to craft concrete with 3 times the yield
- Powered Rails can be crafted with copper (Vanilla Tweaks)
- Most items can be redyed (Vanilla Tweaks)
- All stone can be used for stone tools ([Stone is Stone](https://modrinth.com/mod/P4chhBIh))
</details>


<details>
<summary>Changes to World Generation</summary>
Just like every other Seva ya Season, the world generation is made to be more exciting.
This time we will have: 
  
- [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith)

- [Amplified Nether](https://modrinth.com/datapack/amplified-nether)
 
- [Nullscape](https://modrinth.com/datapack/nullscape)
  
- [Structory](https://modrinth.com/datapack/structory)
  
- [Repurposed Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/repurposed-structures-fabric)
  
- [Underground Rivers](https://modrinth.com/mod/Y7J94SaP)
  
</details>



<details>
<summary>Vanilla Tweaks</summary>
We have the following Vanilla Tweaks Datapacks enabled:
  
- Armor Statues: You can use ```/trigger as_help``` to get the armor stand book, this book can be used to edit armor stands. An item frame with this book can also be powered to animate armor stands
- Custom Nether Portals: Nether Portals can be in any shape and can include crying obsidian
- Mini Blocks: Mini blocks can be crafted using a stone cutter for most blocks in thge game
- Silence Mobs: You can disable the sounds of any mob by naming it "silence_me"
- Storm Channeling: You can throw a channeling trident directly upwards at world height, this will use 60% of your trident's durability
- Anti Enderman Grief: Endermen no longer pickup/drop blocks
- AFK Display: AFK players will have their names turned into gray
- Coords HUD: By using ```/trigger display_hud``` you can view your coords and time
- Nether Portal Coords: By using ```/trigger nether_portals:nether``` or ```/trigger nether_portals:overworld``` you can calculate the coordinates where a nether portal should be.
- Workstation Highlights: By using ```/trigger villager_workstation:show``` while looking at a villager you can see where it's workstation is.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Carpet</summary>
We have the following Carpet Patches active:

- persistentParrots: Parrots will not fall from your shoulders when you take really small damage
- renewableDeepslate: Deepslate will generate instead of cobblestone under Y=0 when flowing lava touches water.
- lagFreeSpawning: Optimized mob spawning
- missingTools: Glass can be broken fast with a pickaxe.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Some other features</summary>
  
- [Bundle as Quiver](https://modrinth.com/mod/IN9qauZM): Your bow can pull items from your bundles
- [Camera Obscura](https://modrinth.com/mod/camera-obscura): Allows you to take images from inside the server and turn them into maps
- [CopperGratesBubbleThru](https://modrinth.com/mod/NJiz0kE3): Copper Grates don't block bubble elevators
- [Ice Prevents Crop Growth](https://modrinth.com/mod/6rPhicfw): Ice under farmland freezes the crops on that farmland in place
- [IndyPets](https://modrinth.com/mod/indypets): Animals can be put into wander mode, so you don't need to make them sit at all times, they can later be called with goat horns 
- [Just Mob Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/jzTUm9hE) and [Just Player Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/YdVBZMNR): Mobs and players drop their heads when they die
- [Lil Guy](https://modrinth.com/mod/9srQd7ap): Named baby mobs don't grow up
- [Perfect Accuracy](https://modrinth.com/mod/ochFsQSn): No randomness on bows and other projectiles
- [Seeking Hearts](https://modrinth.com/mod/4ATKNIA0): Creaking Hearts give redstone comparator energy equal to how close to the center they are to someones screen
- [Soaring Phantoms](https://modrinth.com/mod/d4Rp6J8P): Phantoms only spawn when you're in high altitudes
- [Vaulted End](https://modrinth.com/mod/1wndQzER): End cities have 1 Elytra per player

</details>


<details>
<summary>Some extra QoL stuff</summary>

- [Slime](https://modrinth.com/mod/qpnMRvwM): use ```/slime``` to see slime farms
- [Where Is It](https://modrinth.com/mod/FCTyEqkn): use ```/whereis``` to see where an item is in containers around you
- [CalcMod](https://modrinth.com/mod/calcmod): Need to know how many shulker boxes of stone you need to craft 1000 comparators? No? Ok. Calc is short for calculator btw
</details>

description: A modpack that puts the Create mod in forefront while adding many quality of life mods!
body:
# Create but Better

**Create but Better** is a Minecraft modpack designed to put the **Create mod** at the center of the gameplay experience. This modpack enhances the **mechanical and automation aspects** of Minecraft, allowing players to construct **intricate contraptions, efficient factories, and steampunk-inspired machinery**. But that's not all—this modpack also introduces **tons of new structures, powerful bosses, and exciting exploration opportunities**, making it a **perfect blend of creativity, automation, and adventure**.

## Features

### 🔧 Core Focus on the Create Mod  
This modpack ensures that **Create** remains the central feature, refining the vanilla experience while adding **enhanced automation possibilities**. From **mechanical power to kinetic energy systems**, everything revolves around the creativity and engineering that Create offers.

### ⚙️ Expanded Automation & Machinery  
Build **massive contraptions, transport networks, and fully automated factories** using **belts, cogs, windmills, and steam engines**. With improved mechanics and additional tweaks, automation feels **smoother and more intuitive** than ever.

### 🏰 Tons of New Structures  
The world is filled with **unique dungeons, ancient ruins, hidden laboratories, and steampunk-inspired cities**. These new locations are not just for show—many hold **valuable loot, puzzles, and challenges** for players to uncover.

### 🔄 Quality-of-Life Enhancements  
To make gameplay more enjoyable, the modpack includes **interface improvements, inventory management tweaks, and performance optimizations** that help keep large-scale builds running efficiently.

### 🤝 Compatibility & Integration  
The modpack ensures **seamless integration** between Create and other mods that complement its mechanics. Everything is carefully selected to **enhance the experience without overshadowing Create’s core mechanics**.

### 🎨 Steampunk Aesthetic  
With its focus on **gears, kinetic motion, and mechanical power**, Create but Better embraces a **steampunk-industrial style** that brings a unique and visually appealing atmosphere to Minecraft.

# What is RCS for?
RCS is datapack, that adds recipes for some stones which are in Create mod. These cannot be farmed without datapack. So for example you can build automatic zinc farm with RCS!
# Has RCS any requirements or limitations?
You need Create mod.
# Why is there different version for Fabric and Forge?
It's because Fabric and Forge use different "units" of fluid. I cannot set unit in datapack, so there have to be two different versions. Specifically, Forge is using milibuckets (1000 mB = 1 bucket), but Fabric is using droplets (81000 droplets = 1 bucket)

title: Damage Overhaul
description: A mod that overhauls damage and armor calculations.
body:
# Damage Overhaul

Damage Overhaul is a mod for Minecraft 1.16.2 and higher aiming to add damage typing and change the armor and damage calculation formula. Simply put though, it recalculates armor based on the amount of damage, and how spread out the damage is amongst typing. A larger damage hit will render much more profoundly on an entity than many small typings, and armor will feel less effective on bigger hits. This all feeds into an exponential decay calculation to make armor less effective the more you have of it against a bigger attack. The aim of this is to make it feel like larger attacks feel more profound, while with armor, you can shrug off smaller hits. This mod is extremely customizable, from being able to modify variables in the calculations, to being able to define your own damage types, to being able to modify what damage a tool deals. This all occurs through YAML files in the configuration directory.

***

This mod is Fabric only. I am not considering a Forge port at this time. If you want to port it, it's licensed under GPL-3, so have a go as long as you credit me and license it under GPL as well.

***


It does this through a few targeted Mixins into the LivingEntity and PlayerEntity classes. While these mixins are required in order to make the custom damage calculations, these mixins are slightly invasive, and **THIS WILL RENDER SOME MODS INCOMPATIBLE WITH THIS MOD.** As I find incompatibilities with this mod and others as raised through issues, I will mark them incompatible on my end.
 
 #### Marked Incompatible:
 - None yet!
 
***

### Required Mods:
*Duh.*
- Fabric Loader: 0.10.8 or greater

*Required for the custom particles this mod adds as indicators.*
- Fabric API: 0.29.3 or greater

*Required as part of the config screen this mod generates.*
- Cloth Config API (Fabric): 4.8.3 or greater

### Suggested Mods:
*Suggested for many reasons, but that includes the mods screen, and configuring the mod in-game.*
- Mod Menu: 1.15.0 or greater

*Suggested for the guidebook, which is currently incomplete, but not necessary.*
- Patchouli: 1.16.2-44-FABRIC or greater

title: ViveMonkeCraft
description:
Gorilla Tag-style VR locomotion for QuestCraft and Vivecraft 1.2.X (Minecraft 1.21.4-1.21.6). Grab walls, floors, and ceilings with your VR controllers and physically swing through the world.
Claude Code is Highly Used In this project
body:
# ViveMonkeCraft

---

#### Minecraft 1.21.4-1.21.5 · Fabric · QuestCraft / Vivecraft 1.2.X Only

---

#### Minecraft 1.21.9 - 26.2 · Fabric · PCVR /ViveCraft 1.3.X only

---

## What It Does

#### ViveMonkeCraft brings Gorilla Tag-style locomotion to QuestCraft/Vivecraft 1.2.x. Grab walls, floors, and ceilings with your VR controllers, then physically push and pull yourself through the world. Releasing your grip while moving quickly converts your momentum into a jump.

---

## Intended Experience

#### ViveMonkeCraft is inspired by Gorilla Tag locomotion but adapted for Minecraft's physics, collision system, and world scale. As a result, movement will feel similar in concept but not identical to Gorilla Tag.

---

# ✨ Features

- Gorilla Tag-style hand-grab locomotion
- Physical climbing, swinging, and wall push-off
- Momentum-based throw/jump on release
- Two physics modes: stable Speed-based (default) and **GT-Physics (Beta)**, a faithful anchor-based port of the official GorillaLocomotion algorithm
- Real Monke: shrink your collision box to fit through 1-block tunnels (client + server enforced)
- Monke Model: render players legless with a tunable torso/arms/head, synced so everyone with the mod sees it
- Hand-model clamping: your hands plant on the block surface instead of sinking in
- Step assist: instant step-up onto ledges, or the classic upward boost
- Ice wall & ice floor physics (with an experimental "ice floor acts like ice wall" toggle)
- Adjustable gravity (zero-G capable) and air/ground/floor friction
- VR comfort vignette + grip smoothing (motion-sickness reduction)
- **Optional lowered camera so your hand hitboxes line up with your real hands**
- **Hand-hitbox markers (green/red) for learning the grab range**
- Barrier blocks are invisible to the mod, so admins can wall off areas
- Built-in presets: **Tutorial, Default, Long Arms, Zero Gravity, Speed Run**
- Configure **every** setting in-game with `/vmc set`, no Mod Menu/Cloth needed
- Auto-applies the Default preset on first launch

---

## 🖥️ Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21.4 - 1.21.8
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3
- QuestCraft
- Vivecraft 1.2.x
---
- Minecraft 1.21.9 - 26.1.2
- PCVR
- ViveCraft 1.3.X 
---
Not compatible with:
- Non-VR gameplay other than seeing your friends without legs


#### The mod automatically disables itself when VR is not active.

---

### 🎮 Platform notes

- **QuestCraft / Vivecraft 1.2.x only**: On non-VR clients the mod detects VR is inactive and does nothing except show other player models without legs.
- Cloth Config and Mod Menu are optional soft dependencies. Without them, use `/vmc set` or edit the `.properties` file.

---

## Multiplayer 

- **Singleplayer & "Open to LAN" / Essential** works with just this client mod; a LAN host automatically authorizes guests, no extra files for anyone.
- **Dedicated servers**: the mod stays **off** until the server installs the companion **ViveMonke server mod**. This is a deliberate server-side opt-in, so it can't be used on servers that haven't allowed it.
- The server mod is on my GitHub page/in Source.

---

## 📐 e = ∑∞ⁿ⁼⁰ ¹ₙ Movement physics

| Feature | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Grab detection** | Hand touch sphere (radius 0.12 blocks) extended by `handReachMultiplier` so you can reach surfaces without fully reaching in real life |
| **Swing measurement** | Uses your **real** hand position (not the extended one) so reach doesn't make motion twitchy |
| **Pull strength** | Configurable (Default ≈ 2.5×). Swing a little, move more. *Ignored in GT-Physics anchor mode, which is always 1:1* |
| **GT-Physics (Beta)** | Hands anchor in world space and your body is dragged to keep them planted; tunable drag gain, push strength, unstick distance, ice slip |
| **Throw / jump** | On release, if averaged swing speed > threshold, you're flung at `swing × jumpMultiplier`, hard-capped at `maxJumpSpeed` |
| **Grip smoothing** | Low-pass filter on grip velocity to kill VR tracking noise and reduce motion sickness |
| **Wall slide** | Low wall-stickiness slides you down; the slide ramps in over ~½ s so quick pushes keep momentum but you can't hover one-handed |
| **Floor stickiness** | 1.0 = stop dead on contact, 0.0 = full momentum kept |
| **Ground / air friction** | Tunable; air friction 0.0 = launches carry speed indefinitely |
| **Gravity multiplier** | Scales gravity while not gripping. 0.0 = zero-G float; op-locked via `/vmc gravity` |
| **Step assist** | Clears ledges while moving: instant step-teleport onto the block, or an upward boost |
| **Real Monke** | Collision box capped to 0.5 blocks (1-block tunnels) without shrinking your model, width, or reach |
| **Barriers** | Barrier blocks are invisible to the mod, so you can barricade areas it can't bypass |
| **GUI guard** | Opening any menu (inventory, chat, settings) fully suspends locomotion so you never drift |

---

## 🧊 Ice Physics

- Ice is grabbable on all faces but too slippery to climb. You slide off rather than stick.
- Ice walls/ceilings can be **pushed off** for momentum, but not used as reliable climbing surfaces.
- Ice is frictionless with a speed cap of `player speed × 0.4`.
- **Experimental:** an option to make ice **floors** behave like ice **walls** (pure push-off, no glue)(Its quite Broken still).

---

## 🛠️ Configuration

Three ways to change settings. All write to the same `.minecraft/config/vivemonkecraft.properties` file:

1. **Mod Menu + Cloth Config**: full slider/toggle screen from the Mods list, organized into Presets, Movement, GT-Physics, Reach & Body, Jump & Gravity, and Visual pages. Includes the preset dropdown.

2. **`/vmc set <setting> <value>`**: change **any** setting by name in-game (tab-completes). Works **without** Mod Menu or Cloth Config.

3. **Edit the `.properties` file** directly, then run **`/vmc reload`** (or toggle the mod off/on).

**Presets:** Tutorial (easiest to move), Default, Long Arms, Zero Gravity, Speed Run. Selectable in-game; the Default preset is applied automatically on first launch.

---

## 🥽 QuestCraft Installation

- Use the QuestCraft built-in mod loader.
- With files: use SideQuest and drop this mod into the `mods` folder.

---

## 📥 PC ViveMonkeCraft Installation

1. Install Minecraft 1.21.4.
2. Install Java 21.
3. Install Fabric Loader 0.19.3.
4. Install Vivecraft 1.2.x.
5. Place ViveMonkeCraft in your `mods` folder.
6. (Optional) Install Mod Menu and Cloth Config for the graphical settings menu.
7. Launch the game in VR.

---

### </> Commands

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/vmc` | Toggle the mod on/off |
| `/vmc on` / `/vmc off` | Enable / disable explicitly |

title: Village Bounties
description: Turn villages into useful quest stops with bounty boards, including biome-specific jobs, kill & deliver bounties, and a vanilla-friendly structure & rewards.
body:
**Village Bounties** is a lightweight bounty mod / village quest mod that adds bounty board structures to villages, giving you simple, immersive quests to pick up while exploring your world.

Find a board, take a job, hunt mobs, deliver items, earn rewards, and bring a little more purpose to every village you visit.

It is designed to feel vanilla-friendly, modpack-friendly, and useful for adventure, RPG, exploration, and vanilla+ worlds and modpacks.

[![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-Village%20Bounties-F16436)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/village-bounties)
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-Village%20Bounties-00AF5C)](https://modrinth.com/mod/village-bounties)
[![Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-NeoForge-orange)](https://neoforged.net/)
[![Feedback](https://img.shields.io/badge/Feedback%20%2F%20Bug%20Reports-Google%20Form-4285F4)](https://forms.gle/EcBN6wE6GabWuHRS8)

## Release 1.0 Out Now!
## Features

**Village bounty boards**: Find bounty boards in villages and use them to pick up local tasks.

**Two bounty types**: Complete kill bounties for vanilla mobs or delivery bounties for attainable items.

**Per-player progress**: Active bounties are tracked per player, so each player can work on their own job.

**Difficulty variety**: Boards can offer easy, medium, hard, and **elite** bounties with different target amounts and rewards.

**HUD tracking**: A compact and configurable HUD addition helps track your active bounty while you play, without needing a separate item or book.

**Village-friendly worldgen**: Bounty boards and structures are designed to fit into villages without overwhelming or replacing existing village structures.

**Easy Config**: Allows changing of bounty reward, reward amounts, and more, even in-game! Great for modpack authors who want to fine-tune the experience.

**Lightweight quest / bounty system**: Village bounties are simple, easy to follow, and fit the current village economy structure.

\-

## How It Works

Find a bounty board in a village, choose a bounty, and complete the task.

Bounties can ask you to hunt vanilla mobs or deliver items for villagers. Your active bounty is tracked per player, and the HUD tracker helps you keep an eye on your progress while you play.

Once the job is done, return to any bounty board to turn it in, claim your rewards, and pick up another bounty.

Bounties refresh after you complete a job. Completing a bounty also gives you one manual refresh, which you can use to reroll the board.

\-

## Advanced Bounty Configuration

For developers, modpack creators, and anyone else who wants further customization:

The bounty item and reward pools are located in: `data/village_bounties/bounty_pools`

Changing the values and IDs in these JSON files lets you customize bounty targets, quantities, rewards, and difficulties without editing the mod’s code.

\-

## FAQ

**Do I need NeoForge?**

Yes. Village Bounties is built for NeoForge on Minecraft 1.21.1, currently updating for 26.2.

**Does this need to be installed on both client and server?**

Yes. Install it on both sides for multiplayer.

**Is it vanilla-friendly?**

Yes! Village Bounties only adds 1 block, while the bounties and structures are built around vanilla mobs, items, and village-style placement.

**Where do I find bounty boards?**

Look in villages. Boards generate inside village-friendly structures designed to fit naturally into village areas.

**Can I use this in a modpack?**

Yes! Feel free to include it in your modpack.

**Is this a beta?**

Yes. Balance, bounty variety, and village board placement may still be adjusted as the mod improves.

**Does it need any dependencies?**

Nope! Just download it, put it in your `.minecraft\mods` folder, and play.

**Is Village Bounties a questbook mod?**

No. Village Bounties does not add a full questbook system. It adds simple bounty board quests found in villages.

\-

## Known Issues

* Bounty board structures may not always spawn in modded biomes.
* Tiny villages (4 buildings or fewer) do not spawn bounty boards. (Not a bug- There aren't enough villagers for a bounty board! They don't have the economy!)

## Planned Changes

* Increased bounty variety.
* Advancements. ✅
* Improved Multi-language support for Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian.
* Various performance improvements. 75%✅
* Further config support and options. 75%✅
* Further modpack and mod compatibility. 25%✅

# LobotomyInc

Lobotomise and optimise your villager with nametags. Default name is "Lobotomized"
You can configure names in config


## Default Config:

```

{
  "lobotomize_villagers_enabled": true,
  "free_nametag": false,
  "exact_names": [
    "lobotomized"
  ],
  "advanced_matching": {
    "match_contains": false,
    "contains_list": [
      "@"
    ],
    "match_prefix": false,
    "prefix_list": [
      "!"
    ],
    "match_suffix": false,
    "suffix_list": [
      "#"
    ],
    "match_surround": false,
    "surround_list": [
      "$"
    ]
  }
}
```

- "free_nametag" - Naming villager with name(s) in config does not consume the nametag
- "match_contains" - Villager name contains specific symbol
- "match_prefix" - Specific symbol is prefix(start) of villager name
- "match_suffix" - Specific symbol is suffix(end) of villager name
- "match_surround" - Villager name is surrounded by specific symbol

Write names like this ["name1", "name2" ...]


## How it works
Optimised villager have their pathfinding fully disabled so it's best to use mod for optimizing tradehalls while having villager in 1x1 box near job block. Their brain is turned off until trades need to be restock.

title: Frozen Nether Roof
description: A frozen roof to the Nether with new biomes, structures, and a miniboss
body:
![A nether gateway structure ascending from the Nether to the frozen Nether roof, with the words "Frozen Nether Roof, By Braytonk" superimposed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59988d126f430241fdf65c20be94f10f3fe2fe03.png)
## Braytonk's Frozen Nether Roof
This datapack adds a frozen sub-dimension on top of the Nether roof, which can be accessed through the new Nether Gateway structures that generate throughout the Nether. In this frigid wasteland, you can find new biomes, mobs, and Stray Tower structures containing a unique miniboss fight.  

## Biomes
### Ice Flows
The first biome you will encounter, the Ice Flows, are a network of icy pathways spreading across the Nether roof.
Breaking through the ice with jagged spikes, you will find its two sub-biomes, the Ice Pillars and the Basalt Pillars.
### Frozen Wastes
The frigid mirror to the familiar Nether Wastes, the Frozen Wastes are a barren expanse of snow sprinkled with pockets of powdered snow.
### Icecap Forest
Breaking the monotony of the endless wastes, the Icecap Forests spring up from soulsand patches with strange basalt and ice tree-like features.
### Blackstone Peaks
Cutting deep into the frozen Nether sky, these menacing mountain ranges are formed from the underlying blackstone. A long fall is not the only danger that awaits you in these precipitous heights.

## Structures
### Nether Gateway
These imposing spires connect the lower Nether to its frozen roof, and are located in Ice Pillars or Basalt Pillars in the middle of the Ice Flows. Watch out for the Wither Skeletons and Magma Cubes in the toasty lower level and for Strays and Ice Cubes in the frigid upper level.

### Navigation Tower
These mysterious structures can be found in any biome in the lower Nether. They contain wither skeletons and a diorama of the Nether with a lodestone at the top, representing its matching Stray Tower.

If the [Updated Nether Fortress](https://modrinth.com/datapack/updated-nether-fortress) datapack is present, the Navigation Tower generates with Nether Fortress bridges around itself.

### Stray Tower
Use a Nether Gateway to get to the roof and follow the lodestone in a Navigation Tower, and you will find the matching Stray Tower perched atop the Blackstone Peaks. Brave the Strays and deteriorating ice floors to reach the Stray Champion at the top.

## Mobs
<details>
<summary>Ice Cube</summary>

![An Ice Cube mob](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/374e7d7dcc3127aaf770649864708fd7889fab05.gif)

The Ice Cube is the frozen cousin of the Slime and Magma Cube. When killed they split into smaller Ice Cubes and drop snowballs. The Ice Cube spawns in the upper level of the Nether Gateway, and can be summoned by the Stray Champion.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Stray Champion</summary>

![A Stray Champion Mob](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04fe4b7c4c178447a5bc23d4f6bbaea3180e8295.gif)

This miniboss waits for you at the top of the Stray Tower. Once challenged, it will raise a frozen arena for the duel. Damage it sufficiently or knock it down a level to progress through the three phases of the fight. At each phase it attacks more and breaks more ice with each attack. Can you prove yourself the spleef champion and defeat it before you succumb to the cold or fall to your doom?

</details>

title: Magnet Blocks
description: Minecraft mod that adds blocks of magnets as on the mineshild 4 server
body:
# English

Magnet Blocks is a mod that adds magnet mechanics from the "Mineshield 4" Minecraft server (a Russian-language YouTube server).

Mod Mechanics

*   **Dual Polarity:** Each magnet has two modes: Attraction and Repulsion.
*   **Redstone Control:** Apply a redstone signal to the magnet to completely disable it.
*   **Polarity Switching:** To change a magnet's polarity, simply right-click it with an Iron Axe. (Yes, it's not the same as on MSh4, but the problem is that implementing the mechanic of changing polarity via lightning strike on a lightning rod is difficult).
*   **Specific Target Attraction:** The magnet does not affect everything randomly. It chooses specific targets:
    *   **Players:** Only if they are wearing magnetic armor (Iron, Netherite) and/or are holding a magnetic item in their main or off-hand.
    * **Other Entities:** Attracts Ender Pearls, Iron Golems, Anvils (in the form of falling blocks), and mobs with equipped armor (iron/netherite) and/or attractable items
*   **Magnet Network:** The true power is revealed when magnets are combined. If magnet blocks are placed next to each other, they form a single network.
    *   **Unified Control:** Any action applied to one magnet in the network (disabling with redstone or changing polarity) is instantly propagated to all connected magnets.
*   **Magnetic Storms:** Occasionally, magnetic storms will occur in the world. They affect the polarity, strength, and radius of magnets. After the storm ends, all magnets return to their previous state.
    *   **Storm Management:** You can turn off, create, and remove storms.
*   **The /magnet Command:** Using this command, you can manage "phantom" magnets. Create, delete, modify, etc. You can also manage storms.
*   **Whitelist:** You can whitelist the player's nickname and he will always be attracted to the magnet.
*   **Temperature:** depending on the temperature of the magnet (the lower the temperature, the stronger the magnet), the strength of the magnet varies
*   **The hum:** magnets emit a hum indicating the work and strength of the magnet

# Русский

Magnet Blocks - это мод добавляющий механику магнитов с майнкрафт сервера ютуберов "Майншилд 4" (сервер русскоязычный)

Механики мода

*   **Двойная полярность:** Каждый магнит имеет два режима: Притяжение и Отталкивание.
*   **Управление редстоуном:** Подайте на магнит редстоун-сигнал, чтобы полностью отключить его.
*   **Смена полярности:** Чтобы изменить полярность магнита, просто нажмите по нему ПКМ с Железным топором. (да, не как на мш4, но проблема в том что реализовать механику при попадании в магнит молнии через громоотвод сложно)
*   **Притяжение определённых целей:** Магнит воздействует не на все подряд. Он выбирает конкретные цели
    *   **Игроки:** Только если на них надета магнитная броня (железная, незеритовая) и/или в основной или второй руке находится магнитный предмет
    *   **Другие сущности:** Притягивает Эндер-жемчуг, Железных големов, наковален (в виде падающих блоков) и мобов с экиперованой броней (железо/незерит) и/или притягивающимися предметами 
*   **Сеть магнитов:** Истинная сила раскрывается при объединении магнитов. Если поставить блоки магнитов рядом, они образуют единую сеть.
    *   **Единое управление:** Любое действие, примененное к одному магниту в сети (отключение редстоуном или смена полярности), мгновенно распространяется на все соединенные магниты.
*   **Магнитные штормы:** Иногда в мире будут магнитные штормы, они влияют на полярность, силу и радиус магнита, после завершения шторма все магниты вернутся в прежний вид
    *   **Управление штормами:** вы можете выключать, создовать и убирать штормы
*   **Команда /magnet:** с помощью этой команды вы можете управлять "фантомными" магнитами. Создавать, удалять, изменять и тд. Также можно управлять штормами
*   **Белый список:** вы можете вписать в белый список ник игрока и он будет приятгиватся к магниту всегда
*   **Температура:** в зависимости от температуры магнита (чем меньше - тем сильнее магнит) сила магнита меняется
*   **Гул:** магниты издают гул обозначающий работу и силу магнита

title: Proximity Crafting
description: A crafting table that uses items from nearby containers, modded storage blocks, your inventory, and backpacks so you can craft without moving items between inventories.
body:
# Proximity Crafting

![Proximity Crafting Icon](https://github.com/Maeiro/Proximity-Crafting/blob/main/img/icon256.png?raw=true)

[![ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/U7U3EQ9EW)

Stop running back and forth between chests just to craft something.

**Proximity Crafting** is a Forge **1.20.1** mod that adds a special crafting table capable of using ingredients directly from **nearby containers, modded storage blocks, your inventory, and compatible backpacks**.

The table scans nearby inventories and lets you craft using items stored in your base without manually moving them into your inventory first.

Works with **most modded containers automatically**, making it compatible with many storage mods out of the box.

***

# 📜 Crafting Recipe

![Proximity Crafting Recipe](https://github.com/Maeiro/Proximity-Crafting/blob/main/img/recipe.png?raw=true)

Craft the **Proximity Crafting Table** and place it near your storage area to start crafting using nearby items.

***

## 🎥 Showcase

### Vanilla Recipe Book Integration

![Vanilla Recipe Book Showcase](https://github.com/Maeiro/Proximity-Crafting/blob/main/img/prox-vanilla-book.gif?raw=true)

Crafting automatically pulls ingredients from nearby inventories while still working seamlessly with the **Vanilla Recipe Book**.

Showcase with **3 different containers** (one modded, from Iron Chests) and **even a backpack**, taking 4 ingredients from separate containers to build a piston.

***

# ✨ Features

### 📦 Craft Using Nearby Storage

The **Proximity Crafting Table** scans nearby inventories and builds a shared ingredient pool from:

*   nearby containers (chests and compatible inventories)
*   modded storage blocks
*   player inventory _(configurable)_
*   compatible backpack mods, like Sophisticated Backpacks

Recipes can pull items **directly from nearby storage systems**.

***

### 📖 Full Vanilla Recipe Book Support

Works naturally with the **Minecraft Recipe Book**, including:

*   automatic recipe filling
*   nearby ingredient detection
*   live availability tracking

You can instantly see which recipes are craftable using nearby resources.

***

### 🧮 Live Ingredient Panel

When a recipe is selected, a dedicated panel displays the **remaining ingredients available nearby for that recipe**.

It shows:

*   how many of each ingredient are available in nearby containers
*   the total amount detected across all valid sources
*   live updates while crafting

This makes it easy to see **how many times a recipe can still be crafted** using nearby storage.

***

### ⚙️ Configurable Container Scanning

Server configuration allows control over:

*   **scan radius**
*   **minimum inventory size**
*   **blacklisted block entities**

This prevents machines or special blocks from interfering with crafting.

***

### 🚀 Fast Crafting Workflow

Built-in shortcuts speed up crafting dramatically:

*   **Alt + Left Click** → Load ingredients for **1 recipe unit** (For EMI only)
*   **Shift + Left Click** → Load the **maximum craftable amount**
*   **Mouse Wheel** → Increase or decrease the recipe amount

⚠️ **Note:**  
In **EMI**, normal left-click opens the recipe view.  
Because of that, **Alt + Left Click** is required to load a recipe directly into the crafting grid.

***

# 🔌 Mod Integrations/Recomendations

### FastSuite _(optional, but not avaliable on Modrinth)_

*   **__HIGHLY__** recommended.
*   It significantly improves recipe lookup and crafting-related performance, which also helps Proximity Crafting interactions such as incremental scroll loading.

***

### JEI _(optional)_

*   Recipe transfer support
*   Craftable-only filtering compatible with nearby ingredient sources

***

### EMI _(optional)_

*   Recipe transfer support
*   Craftable-only filtering compatible with nearby ingredient sources

***

### Sophisticated Backpacks _(optional)_

If installed, backpack inventories are automatically added as ingredient sources.

Backpacks behave as an extension of the player inventory and follow the same configuration rules.

***

# 📦 Requirements

*   **Minecraft:** 1.20.1
*   **Forge:** 47.x
*   **Java:** 17

***

# ⚙️ Configuration

The mod automatically generates **Forge TOML configuration files** for both server and client.

### Server Config

`proximitycrafting-server.toml`

Main options include:

*   `scanRadius` → container detection radius
*   `minSlotCount` → minimum inventory size to be considered valid
*   `blockEntityBlacklist` → blocks excluded from scanning
*   `maxShiftCraftIterations` → max batch crafting amount

***

### Client Config

`proximitycrafting-client.toml`

Main options include:

*   `autoRefillAfterCraft` → automatically refills the crafting grid after taking the crafted output
*   `includePlayerInventory` → includes the player inventory as an ingredient source
*   `sourcePriority` → defines extraction order (`CONTAINERS_FIRST` or `PLAYER_FIRST`)
*   `rememberToggleStates` → remembers UI toggle states between openings
*   `proximityItemsPanelOpen` → last remembered state of the ingredients panel
*   `proximityItemsPanelOffsetX` → horizontal offset of the ingredients panel
*   `proximityItemsPanelOffsetY` → vertical offset of the ingredients panel
*   `jeiCraftableOnlyEnabled` → last remembered state of JEI Craftable Only
*   `emiCraftableOnlyEnabled` → last remembered state of EMI Craftable Only

***

## 🐞 Bug Reports & Issues

Found a bug? Have sugestions?

Please report it on GitHub or my Discord with logs, screenshots, and your mod list if possible:

➡️ **Issues tracker:**

[https://github.com/Maeiro/Proximity-Crafting/issues](https://github.com/Maeiro/Proximity-Crafting/issues)

***

## 📜 License, Modpacks & Code Usage

This mod is released under the **GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0)**.
