title: Datapack Sync
description: This mod is intended to let admins remotely make changes to the datapack files on their server.
body:
**What does it do?**  
This mod currently only supports uploading and downloading the datapacks folder to and from the server, though it was originally intended to work for the entire world folder.  

**For what reason would anybody use this?**  
I made this mod, because a friend of mine had a private creative server and I wanted to do command stuff. Eventually there were too many command blocks for it to be fun to change stuff anymore and for reasons this friend could not give me access to the server files for me to put my commands in a datapack.  
I could still do it with a datapack, I'd just have to bother my friend every few minutes to upload my datapack to the server. That or keep using the botherful command blocks.  
So here is the solution to my dilemma!  
When faced with two bad choices just take option 3! Make a mod to safely allow server admins to update the datapacks folder remotely.  

I guess you could also use it to speed up the process of uploading datapacks to your server, if you use some third party serverhost.  

I recommend using this mod alongside [Basically Restart](https://modrinth.com/mod/basicallyrestart) and [Advanced Backups](https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-backups).

**How to use the mod?**  
This mod requires fabric api, make sure to have it installed.
In your minecraft folder (`%appdata%\.minecraft` by default) there should be a new `fetched_worlds` folder. In here are more folders, named after the IP of the servers from which you have fetched the datapacks (the datapacks folder is part of the world folder).   

This mod currently has two commands, both of which require permission level 4 by default.  
- `/worldaccess-push` Uploads your datapacks folder to the server
- `/worldaccess-pull` Downloads the servers datapacks folder

From those descriptions you should already know how to use this mod.  


**Config**  
The config file of this mod is located in `config/WorldAccess.properties`. It has the following options:
- `filterFileExtensions` A comma seperated list with file extensions to allow or block depending on filterMode. By default only files that are to be expected in a datapack are listed here.
- `allowExtensionless` Should files without a file extension pass the file extension filtering step? Must be `true` or `false`, defaults to `true`, as some people may leave notes in these files.
- `filterMode` Either `whitelist` or `blacklist` no files except those in filterFileExtensions will be let through when in whitelist mode, which is the default.
- `filterHeaders` A comma seperated list of hexadecimal file headers. Files with these headers will be blocked regardless of the filter mode. By default Windows and Linux executable headers and java class and jar files are on here.
- `readPermissionLevel` The permission level required to perform a `/worldaccess-pull`. This option has no effect on the client. Defaults to `4`
- `writePermissionLevel` The permission level required to perform file operations on the server. This option has no effect on the client. Defaults to `4`


**What is the worst that can happen?**  
This mod makes direct changes to your worldfiles. I recomend you use this alongside [Advanced Backups](https://modrinth.com/plugin/advanced-backups).

I might regret including this section, but... oh well.  
Starting off with two things that are unlikely to happen in a private server, but still far more likely than the stuff further down: You could do a `/worldaccess-push` and then get timed out, because for example your internet connection is slow or you have a very large datapack.
This would result in the server having an incomplete version of the datapack with some files missing. If you were to then reconnect and run `/worldaccess-pull` you would download the incomplete datapack and end up deleting your locally stored copy. Very unfortunate.  

The other thing that could happen is two or more people uploading datapacks in rapid succession, overriding one of their versions in the process, as there is no such thing as automatic versioning in this mod. To avoid this just don't have multiple people working at the same time and everything should be fine.  

Now we come to spooky scary hackers.  
Don't give permission level 4 to strangers and you're safe.  
If you do end up with someone having write access who wants to harm you then this is the worst they can do:  
- Upload malware to the server. This mod pervents read/write requests outside your world folder, so no autoruns. Contrary to common belief, having a virus on your device is not actually dangerous, so long as you don't execute it. The default config makes uploading malware in any form that can be executed quite difficult, so running it accedentally is quite unlikely. Not anything to worry about here.
- Upload lots of big files to use up your disk space, which could cause some janky OS bugs if the server is on your main disk.  

**Issues**  
Should you encounter any bugs not already listed on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/Mabeeck/World-Access/issues) or find a security vulnerability, please do [report it](https://github.com/Mabeeck/World-Access/issues/new).
You may also open an issue, should you want to request for me to add in a feature or port to a specific version.  
Please remember: I am doing this in my free time and may not come around to fulfilling your request, but it's worth a try.

title: RHSignItem
description: Do you want to add a personalized signature to your item? Or maybe rename it? Look no further! ☄️
body:
![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RHX0R3/RHSignItem/refs/heads/main/rhsignitem_paper.png)
With RHSignItem you are able to add a signature to an item of your choice.

![https://img.shields.io/bstats/servers/11372?color=green?label=Servers](https://img.shields.io/bstats/servers/11372?color=green?label=Servers) ![https://img.shields.io/bstats/players/11372?color=green?label=Players](https://img.shields.io/bstats/players/11372?color=green?label=Players) [![https://img.shields.io/discord/422802721280622594?color=%237289da%20&label=Discord&logo=Discord&logoColor=white](https://img.shields.io/discord/422802721280622594?color=%237289da%20&label=Discord&logo=Discord&logoColor=white)](https://raidersheaven.eu/discord) Made with love in Germany 🇩🇪
# Features ## Commands ### /sign With this command you can sign an item instantly. The lore will be determined by the content under `SHORT` inside of the `config.yml`.

Here is a list of all arguments for `/sign`: * `/sign help` → will show you a list of all commands. * `/sign ` → creates a signature with a custom text, depending on the `DEFAULT` content * `/sign delete` → removes an applied signature * `/sign lock` → will lock an item to prevent adding a signature with `/sign` or `/sign ` * `/sign unlock` → will free an item from it's locked state and allows signatures again * `/sign version` → shows you some version information **Example:** ``` /sign That item is so awesome and rare,
that every player wants to own. ``` ### /rename With the command `/rename ` you can change an items displayname. It uses color formats and placeholders here too!

**Example:** ``` /rename This is a cool item name! ``` ## Formatting All messages within the configuration and language files support **MiniMessage**. To learn how to use it, please visit the [Adventure](https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format.html) website.

I highly recommend using the **MiniMessage** format, as it is also the current best practice for all users of Paper and it's derivatives. Legacy formats such as `&` or `&#rrggbb` will *kinda work* too, but are **not** recommended!

You can also use all placeholders from the **PlaceholderAPI** and it's expansions! ## Language Files **RHSignItem** ships with some default language files: German, English and Russian. You can change these as you desire. But you can also create a new file and integrate it. In this case, make sure to properly set the `locale` to the files name in the config. ## Auto-Locking In order to make the signing process as easy as possible, you can enable the `auto-lock` setting. After that, every new signature will automatically set the locked state onto the item.

If you want to specify that feature, while only allowing players with the correct permission to do that, activate it through the `permission-based` setting. Players will need the `rhsignitem.command.sign.lock.auto` permission. ## Optional Offhand Requirements With the `offhand-item-mode` setting you can choose, if the player needs to hold an item in his offhand in order to create a signature with `/sign` or `/sign `.

`type` determines the item that is needed.

Also you can choose, if the item should be used. * durability -1 * amount -1 ## Item Blacklist As a server owner or administrator, you probably don't want all items to be allowed for signatures. **RHSignItem** comes with a blacklist feature, that can easily be configured and extented. ## Vault integration If you want to make the commands only usable through a payment, just toggle it's setting inside the `config.yml` file! You can set a fixed price for executing any command, toggle each command and choose, which ones should be set behind a paywall. Also you can toggle messages when using the payment system. # What does it look like in-game? [![https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RHX0R3/RHSignItem/refs/heads/main/rhsignitem_paper_preview.jpg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RHX0R3/RHSignItem/refs/heads/main/rhsignitem_paper_preview.jpg)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RHX0R3/RHSignItem/refs/heads/main/rhsignitem_paper_preview.jpg) # Permissions The plugin requires a player to have the respective permissions listed below: * `rhsignitem.*` → grants access to **all** plugin commands * `rhsignitem.admin` → grants an override status to *delete* and *unlock* (for administrative purposes) * `rhsignitem.command.sign` → `/sign` and `/sign help` * `rhsignitem.command.sign.sign` → `/sign ` * `rhsignitem.command.sign.delete` → `/sign delete` * `rhsignitem.command.sign.lock` → `/sign lock` * `rhsignitem.command.sign.lock.auto` → for **auto-lock** with permission based command handling * `rhsignitem.command.sign.unlock` → `/sign unlock` * `rhsignitem.command.sign.version` → `/sign version` * `rhsignitem.command.rename` → `/rename ` # Support If you need help with **RHSignItem**, you can join the [RaidersHeaven server](https://raidersheaven.eu/discord/) on Discord. Just post inside the [#rhsignitem-paper-plugin](https://discord.com/channels/422802721280622594/931212109293977640) channel.

Since support is provided exclusively by me, there may be delays and longer response times as I cannot read all messages immediately or only at certain times of the day. Thank you for your understanding! # Metrics collection **RHSignItem** collects anonymous server statistics through [bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/RHSignItem/11372), an open-source statistics service for Minecraft software. You can opt out in ` plugins/bStats/config.yml ` at anytime. ![](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/RHSignItem.svg)

title: Smart Elytra
description: Smart Elytra lets you swap between flight and armor with a single keypress (G). Featuring a server-safe 3-tick sync method (switch > equip > return), it ensures reliable performance and bypasses anti-cheat issues on multiplayer servers.
body:
# **🦅 Smart Elytra (Hotbar-Sync)**

Smart Elytra is a specialized utility mod for Fabric 1.21, engineered for maximum reliability on multiplayer servers. Forget fumbling through your inventory or wasting precious hotbar time—swap between flight and combat readiness with a single, intelligent keypress.

## **✨ Key Features**

### **⚡ 3-Tick Hotbar Logic:**
To prevent Anti-Cheat flags and "ghost items," the mod executes the swap in three precise steps:

**Tick 1:** Switches to the item's hotbar slot.

**Tick 2:** Equips the item via right-click simulation.

**Tick 3:** Instantly returns to your original selected slot.

### **🛡️ Best-Armor Detection:**
Automatically scans your hotbar for the strongest chestplate (Netherite > Diamond > Iron, etc.) when swapping out of your Elytra.

### **🌐 Server-Optimized:** 
Built to handle latency and lag. By spreading actions across game ticks, it mimics natural player behavior, making it safe for most PvP and survival servers.

### **⌨️ Fully Bindable:**
The default key is 'G', which can be changed anytime in the Minecraft controls menu under the 'Misc' category.

## **🎮 How to Use**

Place your Elytra or your Chestplate into any slot of your Hotbar.

Press G (default) to trigger the swap.

The mod handles the rotation and equipping in a fraction of a second.

### **📦 Installation**

Requires Fabric Loader and Fabric API.

Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.

title: ElytraFusion
description: A armor-utility plugin that allows players to fuse Chestplates with Elytras to create high-tier, protective flight-wear with customizable particle trails.
body:
# 🕊️ ElytraFusion
The ultimate "Late-Game" flight & protection solution.

ElytraFusion solves the age-old Minecraft dilemma: *"Do I wear my armor for protection, or my Elytra for mobility?"* Now, you can have both.

This plugin allows players to infuse any tier of Chestplate directly into an Elytra using a Smithing Table. The result is a high-performance flight-wear item that retains full defensive stats without sacrificing your ability to soar.

## ✨ Key Features

🛡️ **All Material Tiers** – Leather, Copper, Chainmail, Gold, Iron, Diamond, and Netherite infusions. Each tier can be enabled or disabled individually.

🔨 **Native Smithing** – Crafting uses the 1.20+ Smithing Table system for a seamless vanilla feel.

✨ **Dynamic Trails** – Unique, customizable particle effects that trail behind you based on your armor tier. Global on/off toggle and per-tier opt-out.

📜 **Enchantment Merging** – Automatically combines enchants (like Protection IV and Mending) from both items.

🏷️ **Custom Name Carry-Over** – Named your Elytra? The fused result keeps it by default. Configurable.

🔄 **Reversible Fusion** – Players can split a fused Elytra back into the exact original Elytra and Chestplate with `/ef split`, guarded by a clickable chat confirmation. Works on older fusions too with a best-effort fallback.

💬 **Fully Configurable** – Adjust armor values, toughness, durability, particles, and every player-facing message via `config.yml`. Supports `&` color codes and `{placeholders}`.

🧩 **Safe Updates** – Drop in a new `.jar` without deleting your config. Missing keys fall back to packaged defaults at runtime, and a `config-latest.yml` reference is only generated when something new is available.

## 🛠️ How it Works

**The Fusion:** Place a Smithing Template, an Elytra, and your Chestplate into a Smithing Table.

**The Result:** You receive an Infused Elytra that grants the specific armor points of the chestplate used — plus its enchantments and (optionally) its name.

**The Maintenance:** Repair your gear in an Anvil using the base material (e.g., use Diamonds to repair Diamond Infused Elytras).

**The Split (optional):** Changed your mind? Hold the fused Elytra and run `/ef split` — confirm in chat and get your original items back.

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| *(Smithing Table fusion)* | Fuse an Elytra with any Chestplate | `elytrafusion.use` *(default: true)* |
| `/ef split` | Split a fused Elytra back into its original items (with confirm prompt) | `elytrafusion.split` *(default: true)* |
| `/ef give <player> <tier>` | Instantly give an infused elytra | `elytrafusion.admin` *(default: op)* |
| `/ef reload` | Reload config settings instantly | `elytrafusion.admin` *(default: op)* |

> 💡 **Tip:** Because `elytrafusion.use` is a real permission, you can use LuckPerms contexts to restrict fusing to specific worlds, regions, or ranks — e.g. allow fusing only at spawn, or only for donators.

## 💬 Support & Suggestions

Need help? Have a cool idea for a new feature? Join our community!

🗨️ [Discord](https://discord.gg/e2Pb4hfQah)

## 📊 Statistics

We use bStats to collect anonymous usage data to help improve the plugin. You can view our public metrics on the bStats dashboard!

title: RMotd
description: You can make your own refreshing message of the day when you press refresh button
body:
# 🎲 RMotd

A small Minecraft server plugin to serve rotating MOTDs (Message of the Day) and let server operators manage MOTDs at runtime.

# 🤑 Features

- Rotating MOTDs from `config.yml` (round-robin).
- `/randommotd` command: toggle random-rotation on/off.
- `/motd create <name> <motd...>` command: add a new MOTD to `config.yml` at runtime.
- `/motd reload` command: reloads the `config.yml`.

# 🖌️ Configuration

```yaml
random_motd_enabled: true
motds:
  - "<gradient:red:blue>Welcome to our server!</gradient>"
  - "<yellow>Explore the world of Minecraft with us!</yellow>"
  - "<green>Join us and have fun!</green>"

messages:
  invalid_input: "<red>Invalid input, Please use 'true' or 'false'</red>"
  setting_updated: "<green>Random MOTD feature updated to <status></green>"
```

# 🕹️ Commands

- `/randommotd` — Toggle random MOTD rotation (reads/writes `random_motd_enabled` in `config.yml`).
  - Permission: `rmod.randommotd` (declared in `plugin.yml`).

- `/motd create <name> <motd...>` — Add a MOTD entry to `motds` in `config.yml` and save it. The `<name>` is used only in the confirmation message currently. Provide the MOTD content as remaining args.
  - Example: `/motd create welcome <green>Welcome to our server!</green>`
  - Operator-only by default (only ops or console can run it). If you prefer permission-based control, see Permissions below.

- `/motd reload` — Reloads `config.yml` from disk. Operator-only.

# 🎭 Permissions

- `rmod.randommotd` — used for the `randommotd` command.
- `rmod.motd` — reserved for `/motd` (plugin.yml documents it). Currently the plugin enforces operator-only usage for `/motd`; if you prefer permissions, change the check to `sender.hasPermission("rmod.motd")` in `MotdCommand`.

title: SmartMobsPlugin
description: A plugin that turns ordinary hostile mobs into challenging opponents while maintaining the vanilla aesthetic of the game.
body:
# SmartMobs - Intelligent Enhanced Mobs System

SmartMobs is an innovative Minecraft plugin that transforms ordinary hostile mobs into challenging opponents while maintaining the vanilla aesthetic of the game. The plugin not only increases mob stats but also grants some of them unique abilities, making every encounter with monsters a unique challenge.

## 🌟 Key Features

### 🎯 Natural Mob Evolution
- Two development tiers: Hardened and Elite (configurable spawn chances)
- Unique thematic names for each mob type
- Logical progression from simple mutations to advanced evolutionary forms
- Ability to automatically increase the spawn chance of enhanced mobs based on distance from the world spawn.

### ⚡ Smart Abilities
- **Skeletons**: Increased firing rate, triple shot for elites
- **Creepers**: Faster fuse, charged form for elites
- **Spiders**: Web trap, enhanced jump, poisonous bite for elites
- **Endermen**: Improved teleportation, water resistance
- And many other unique abilities for each mob type

### 🛠️ Full Customization
- Enable/disable individual mob types
- Customize spawn probabilities
- Configure difficulty scaling
- Adjust health, damage, and speed multipliers
- Custom names and colors for each mob
- Flexible configuration of special abilities

### 🎮 Preservation of Vanilla Spirit
- Natural names that harmonize with Minecraft lore
- Balanced difficulty, not artificial enhancement
- Integration into the existing mob ecosystem
- Names only displayed when looking at the mob

### 🚀 Performance Optimization
- Efficient mob processing on spawn
- Smart system of checks and fast event filtering
- Minimal impact on server performance

## 📋 Supported Mobs

The plugin covers all major hostile Minecraft mobs:

| Normal Mob               | Hardened                | Elite                     |
|--------------------------|-------------------------|---------------------------|
| Zombie                   | Rotting Wanderer        | Corrupted Vagabond        |
| Skeleton                 | Eternal Sentinel        | Bony Echo                 |
| Creeper                  | Scorching Visitor       | Thunderous Rupture        |
| Spider                   | Silken Assassin         | Web Sovereign             |
| Enderman                 | Abyssal Drifter         | Spatial Rift              |
| Witch                    | Swamp Potionmaster      | Shadow Sorceress          |
| Phantom                  | Nightmare               | Ethereal Scream           |
| Blaze                    | Fire Spirit             | Hellfire Core             |
| Ghast                    | Misty Phantom           | Celestial Lament          |
| And 40+ more mob types!  |                         |                           |

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the **latest release**
2. Place the `.jar` file in your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Configure the settings in `plugins/SmartMobs/config.yml`
5. Use `/smartmobs reload` to apply changes

## ⚙️ Configuration

The plugin uses a flexible YAML configuration system. Main settings:

```yml
# SmartMobs Settings
# Plugin messages
messages:
  # General messages
  no-permission: "<red>❌ You don't have permission to use this command."
  only-players: "<red>❌ Only players can spawn mobs."
  unknown-subcommand: "<red>❌ Unknown subcommand."

  # Spawn command
  spawn-usage: "<yellow>Usage: /smartmobs spawn <mob> <hardened|elite>"
  spawn-no-permission: "<red>❌ You don't have permission to spawn mobs."
  spawn-mob-disabled: "<red>❌ Mob <white>{mob}</white> is disabled in config."
  spawn-unknown-mob: "<red>❌ Unknown mob type: <white>{mob}"
  spawn-not-living: "<red>❌ This type is not a living entity."
  spawn-unknown-variant: "<red>❌ Unknown variant: <white>{variant}"
  spawn-success: "<green>✔ Spawned <yellow>{variant}</yellow> <gray>{mob}</gray>."

  # Reload command
  reload-no-permission: "<red>❌ You don't have permission to reload the plugin."
  reload-success: "<green>✔ SmartMobs config reloaded."

# Spawn chances for different mob types
chances:
  hardened: 0.05 # Initial chance for hardened mob spawn
  elite: 0.01 # Initial chance for elite mob spawn
  radius-complication: true # Whether to increase mob difficulty based on distance from spawn
  world-radius: 10000 # World radius up to which difficulty scaling occurs
  radius-levels:
    - from: 0.0 # zone start (0 = spawn)
      to: 0.33 # zone end (0.33 = one third of world-radius)
      hardened: 0.5 # hardened chance at zone end
      elite: 0.05 # elite chance at zone end
    - from: 0.33
      to: 0.66
      hardened: 0.5
      elite: 0.5
    - from: 0.66
      to: 1.0
      hardened: 0.2
      elite: 0.8

# Enable/disable modifications for each mob
enabled-mobs:
  # OVERWORLD - Neutral and passive
  wolf: true
  bee: true
  iron_golem: true
  snow_golem: true
  rabbit: true
  # ... and so on for all mobs

# Base characteristics for hardened mobs
hardened:
  hp-multiplier: 1.25
  damage-multiplier: 1.25
  knockback-resistance: 0.5
  name-visible: true

  # Individual names for each mob type
```

title: More Vanilla Enchantments Levels (MVEL)
description: A lightweight mod that raises vanilla enchantment levels, designed for large modpacks and to complement difficulty mods like Progressive Time Difficulty.
body:
# More Vanilla Enchantments Levels (MVEL) - v1.0.2

## Overview
**More Vanilla Enchantments Levels** is a lightweight, server-side mod that increases the maximum levels of vanilla enchantments.

While it works perfectly on its own, it is **specifically designed and balanced to be played alongside [Progressive Time Difficulty (PTD)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/progressive-time-difficulty)**.

In modpacks with scaling difficulty, vanilla enchantments often become obsolete against high-level mobs. MVEL solves this by allowing your gear to scale in power alongside the threats you face.

**Server-Side Friendly:** This mod can be installed on the server, and players can join with a vanilla client.

## Key Features

### 1. Balanced for Hardcore Gameplay
The enchantment levels have been tuned to match the brutal scaling of PTD's Hardcore Mode:
- **Combat Ready:** Sharpness, Protection, and Power now scale up to level **10**. This is essential to counter mobs that can deal 2.5x damage and have massive health pools.
- **Economy:** Looting and Fortune scale to level **7**, rewarding high-risk gameplay with better drops.
- **Durability:** Unbreaking now goes up to level **12**, ensuring your gear survives prolonged battles against tough enemies.
- **Mobility:** Depth Strider scales to level **8** for superior underwater movement.

### 2. High Compatibility & Stability
The mod uses a robust Mixin strategy that targets both the base `Enchantment` class and its specific subclasses. This ensures maximum compatibility with other mods that might also modify enchantment behavior, preventing common crashes.

### 3. Lightweight & Simple
No complex configurations or new items. Just install and play. The mod is designed to be a simple, "fire-and-forget" addition to your modpack.

## Affected Attributes
The primary change is an increase in the return value of `Enchantment.getMaxLevel()`. The exact level increase varies per enchantment and is designed to be balanced for enhanced gameplay.

---
*Developed by Tontoque28*

title: Undead Variants
description: Vanilla-style undead mob variants
body:
## Undead Variants

**Undead Variants** is a small, content-focused mod that fills in missing undead variants found in vanilla Minecraft.

Rather than introducing new systems or mechanics, this mod focuses on extending existing vanilla logic in ways that feel consistent and lore-friendly.  
All behaviors are built on top of vanilla rules, code paths, and conventions.

The goal is to expand the world in a natural way, without altering how Minecraft fundamentally works.

***

## Dependency

*   Requires **MobCivics**

***

## Current Features

### Drowned Villager

*   Adds a **Drowned Villager** entity that integrates with vanilla undead behavior
*   Villagers killed by a Drowned will convert directly into a Drowned Villager
*   Supports vanilla-style drowning conversion:
    *   Conversion only begins after the entity has been fully submerged for a continuous period of time
    *   Once conversion starts, the process is irreversible and will complete even if the entity leaves the water
*   Drowned Villagers are capable of using tridents, matching vanilla Drowned combat behavior
*   Correctly participates in vanilla monster hunter advancement
*   Conversion respects Forge living conversion events
*   Properly triggers vanilla combat advancements
*   Includes proper attributes, rendering, synchronization, localization, and spawn egg support
*   Under certain conditions, Drowned Villagers can replace vanilla Drowned during natural spawning

### Drowned Piglin

*   Adds a **Drowned Piglin** variant extending Piglins into a drowned undead form
*   Piglins can convert into Drowned Piglins through prolonged submersion, following vanilla-style drowning rules
*   Drowned Piglins retain Piglin identity while adopting Drowned-like movement and combat behavior
*   Fully capable of using tridents, including ranged attacks consistent with vanilla Drowned AI
*   Properly triggers vanilla combat advancements
*   Uses vanilla navigation, targeting logic, and equipment handling where applicable

### Husk Villager

*   Adds a **Husk Villager** variant extending desert-based undead logic to villagers
*   Villagers killed by a Husk will convert directly into a Husk Villager
*   Inherits vanilla Husk traits, including:
    *   Immunity to burning in sunlight
    *   Application of the **Hunger** effect on successful attacks
*   Uses vanilla Zombie-based AI and attribute scaling
*   Affected by undead-targeting enchantments such as **Smite**
*   Fully integrated with vanilla combat logic and advancements
*   Includes proper rendering, attributes, localization, and spawn egg support

***

## Development Status

**Status: Release**

All currently implemented undead variants are stable and suitable for regular gameplay and modpack use.

***

## Design Philosophy

*   **Vanilla-first**  
    Behaviors are derived directly from vanilla code paths and conventions.
    
*   **Content-focused**  
    Adds new variants by extending existing entities instead of introducing parallel systems.
    

***

## For Modpack Authors

*   Safe to add to existing saves
*   Designed to integrate cleanly with vanilla-aligned modpacks
*   No gameplay-affecting configuration required

***

## Planned Features

*   Additional undead variants inspired by vanilla behavior
*   Optional data-driven configuration for spawn and conversion rules

***

## Compatibility

*   Minecraft 1.20.1
*   Forge or NeoForge (depending on release)

title: ClusterComputers
description: Kubernetes-powered computers in Minecraft
body:
ClusterComputers is a Minecraft mod for running Kubernetes-powered computers in
Minecraft.

ClusterComputers works similarly to other computer mods like ComputerCraft and
OpenComputers. However, other computer mods tend to provide limited environments
that only allow running Lua scripts. The goal of ClusterComputers is to provide
a fully-customizable environment that allows for running any type of code that
you want.

It accomplishes this by running a pod in Kubernetes for each computer that you
create in Minecraft. The pod contains a regular container that provides full
access to the Linux command line and allows you to use any programming language
that you wish. You can also run regular command-line programs within the
container, such as vim or emacs.

The default container image comes with a Python library that allows you to
control computers using Python, but you can also use other languages, or use a
different container image altogether.

Although running a pod for each computer provides a lot of customizability, it
does come with downsides. Before you can use this mod, you need to set up a
Kubernetes cluster, which requires technical knowledge. The pods are also
relatively expensive to run compared to an embedded Lua environment.

# Links
⚠️ This mod requires external setup. Before you can use it, you need to set up a
Kubernetes cluster and deploy the required ClusterComputers components to it.

- [Installation](https://gitlab.com/clustercomputers/mod#installation)
- [Configuration](https://gitlab.com/clustercomputers/mod#configuration)
- [Usage](https://gitlab.com/clustercomputers/mod/-/blob/master/doc/usage.md)
- [Changelog](https://gitlab.com/clustercomputers/mod/-/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)

The world is dead, and the survivors are being hunted. This modpack drops you into an infinite, decaying metropolis where the environment is just as lethal as the monsters.

## 🪨 Prison Dimension

**Prison Dimension** is my very first Minecraft mod, made for one simple goal:  
to trap your friends in a bleak, depressing prison world… possibly forever.

This mod adds a brand-new **gray, lifeless dimension** where **pillagers spawn** and escape is not guaranteed.

---

### 🔐 How it works

- Obtain a **Key** from a **Level 3 Toolsmith Villager**
- Use the key to craft **Handcuffs**
- Build a special portal:
  - Same shape as a Nether portal
  - Made from **Smooth Stone**
- Use the **Handcuffs** on the portal to activate it

This opens a portal to the **Prison Dimension**.

---

### 🧱 No escape

To prevent your friends from escaping the way they came, you can now **craft Bedrock**:

- **8 Obsidian** surrounding **1 Nether Star**

Use the crafted Bedrock to **block the portal** and permanently trap players inside the Prison Dimension.

---

### ⚠️ Warning

This mod is intended for **chaotic multiplayer fun**.  
Players trapped in the Prison Dimension may be stuck **forever** unless a server admin intervenes.

Use responsibly… or don’t.

### A Minecraft mod that adds more apples and more carrots. 

[**View source code on GitHub**](https://github.com/Strange-GuyPerson/MoreApplesAndMoreCarrots) **|** [**Report issues and bugs**](https://github.com/Strange-GuyPerson/MoreApplesAndMoreCarrots/issues)

More Apples and More Carrots is a mod that expands on the food options in Minecraft by adding new types of apples and carrots, fitting in with vanilla Minecraft's enchanted golden apples, regular golden apples, and golden carrots. You can now get different "tiers" of apples and carrots that are made from various materials, like wood, stone, iron, diamond, and netherite. Apples come in both regular and enchanted variants, while there are only regular, unenchanted carrots. This is done in order to improve consistency, as enchanted golden carrots also do not exist in vanilla Minecraft. This mod also adds a creative mode exclusive apple: the God Apple, which grants the player overpowered buffs when consumed. 

Support for more game versions and a Fabric port will be added in the future. However, I will **not** be porting this mod to Minecraft versions below 1.20, and I will **not** be making a Forge port of this mod. Support for more languages are also coming soon!

# Other Additions/Changes to Vanilla Minecraft

- Enchanted golden apples are now craftable with this recipe: ![Crafting recipe for the enchanted golden apple (an apple surrounded by four gold blocks and four experience bottles)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f00b84c9f4900b4ac5390d52fccfbbbcf88d95f4.png)

- The **How Did We Get Here?** advancement now needs saturation and health boost effects in order to be completed (since saturation and health boost are now obtainable in survival mode with this mod). 

- The **A Balanced Diet** advancement now requires the player to consume all apple and carrot variants added by this mod (excluding the God Apple, which is creative mode exclusive).

title: Clans
description: Clans from ZDev is an advanced plugin for Minecraft that adds a full-fledged clan system with many features to the server
body:
Clans from ZDev is an advanced plugin for Minecraft (Paper 1.20.1) that adds a full—fledged clan system with many features to the server:

⒈ Clan Creation and Management:
Players can create their own clans, invite members, assign ranks, establish a clan house, and manage the internal structure.
⒉ Clan Menu:
A convenient interactive menu for managing the clan, viewing information, members, achievements, economy, and settings.
⒊ Wars and alliances:
The ability to declare wars on other clans, form alliances, and maintain diplomatic relations.
⒋ Economy:
Built-in clan balance system, support for integration with Vault to work with the server economy.
5 Flexible rights system:
All basic actions are protected by permissions, which allows you to flexibly configure access for players and groups.

A resource pack where all apples are replaced with pearto, including some modded ones!

It was tested on 1.18+ and it worked on all of them. May support previous versions down to 1.13, but those are untested

mental illness

Actively working on it with some of the more popular mods

title: Terrainless Superflat
description:
Superflat too easy? Try this!

No grass, dirt or bedrock layers in the Overworld.
Just the structures from the Classic Flat preset if your world was generated in 1.17.1 or earlier

As of 1.1.1, In 1.21+ worlds you will automatically spawn in a village!
body:
Do you find Superflat too easy? Try this!

There are no grass, dirt or bedrock layers in the Overworld.
The Overworld is just the structures you would find in the Classic Flat preset if your world was generated in 1.17 or later.

Due to technical limitations, Strongholds and Mineshafts generate lower in the world than an upgraded Classic Flat world. Village paths are still at Y-level 4, though.

In 1.21+ worlds, you will automatically be teleported to a dirt path in a village, which will be set as your spawnpoint.

In 1.20.x worlds, starting in Creative is recommended to set spawn at a village, as most of the time you'll spawn above the Void and end up in a death loop. 
You could also use a mod for this if you're brave enough to try Hardcore!

Created by Klinbee, TechHeadFred and TheFantasticSoap to give players a way to generate a Skyflat-style world in modern Minecraft versions without the lag caused by falling sand/gravel/concrete powder/anvils or decaying leaves.

Unfortunately, we weren't able to bring back Axolotls spawning in any biome as well, you'll have to manually make a world in 1.17 or 1.17.2 for them!

title: WikiRaze's Recommended
description: A client-side modpack for vanilla play with nicer visuals, and "good-to-have" mods. This is my recommended mods list if you want the golden median between modded and vanilla.
body:
Hi I'm **WikiRaze** and this is my **Recommended** Mods list! I have always wanted a stricly vanilla experience. But over the years I have started to stretch that idea somewhat and added some vanilla-enhancing mods and resourcepacks. I often get questions about which mods I use, or which I recommend. So if you are like me, and just want to enhance vanilla without letting it feel modded, then this modpack is for you.

_It's not vanilla, it's not modded. It's juuuust right._

# Vanilla compatible
This is a **clientside** modpack which can be used on all vanilla servers. 

## Nicer visuals
- **Physics Mod** (adds physics animations to some objects)
- **Iris Shaders** with **Complementary Shaders** (enhances the vanilla feel, but not too much)
- **Fresh Animations** (resourcepack which adds animations to mobs)
- **3D Skin Layers** (makes the player model look nicer)
- **Invisible Armor** (lets you actually see your friends skins, can be disabled as it is a resourcepack)
- **Not Enough Animations** (adds 3rd person animations to the player model)

## Helping hands
- **Mod Menu** (lets you see which mods are installed)
- **ViaFabric** (lets you join older minecraft servers)
- **Zoomify** (zoom in using "C")
- **Xaero's Minimap** & **Xaero's World Map** (generates a world map of places you've been)
- **Simple Voice Chat** (lets you talk ingame on servers which support it)
- **Stendahl** (adds quality of life features to books, signs and chat)

## "Optifine"-textures compatible
- Entity Model Features
- Entity Texture Features
- CIT Resewn (not updated yet, so not yet included)

These three mods lets you use resourcepacks which adds features not found in the vanilla game. Like connected textures, alternate textures and such.

## Lag reducing
- Sodium
- Entity Culling

This modpack does not have lag-reducing as one of it's main features. If your computer is slow you might want to add some more mods. However this should get you started. Try it out and see if it works for you. It does for me!

title: Balance Wood Cutter
description: Balanced wood recipes for Stonecutter
body:
Minecraft recipes have problems with mathematics. You spend 6 oak planks to get 4 stairs. You spend more blocks to get fewer blocks, and the stairs also have less volume than solid planks. The same problem applies to a fence where 3 posts cost 5 planks, or a fencegate that takes 4 planks for 1 gate. The intermediate crafts of sticks further aggravates the situation. This wastes a lot of resources and time, especially when preparing for large projects.

And Mojang previously provided alternative recipes in Stone Cutter to solve these problems. And many other data packs picked up the idea, adding recipes for wood to the Stone Cutter. But these recipes are either too unbalanced or too inconvenient. Therefore, I provide my vision of recipes for the wood:
![Tree of wood recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/wDLhVExH/images/81ed6889aa6c50f0d31a1c12cc372e2bd8b7c822.png)


I tried to maintain a balance between ease of construction: having 1 plank you have a choice of 9 building blocks: stairs, slabs, sign, fence, fencegate, button, pressure plate, door, trapdoor. And the cost of crafting: 6 stripped logs = 6 hanging signs, then all logs/wood can be used for hanging signs in this ratio; trapdoors, doors, fences, etc. are obtained in no more than one item. There are also no items that are too expensive and less popular in mass build: chests, лодки, composters or lecterns. And the entire craft process goes only in one direction: log to stripped, wood, stripped wood; stripped log to stripped wood; and all log/wood to planks or hanging signs.

Among other things, I have added recipes for buttons and pressure plates for stone and polished blackstone for the Cutter.

Thanks to this [data pack](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/minecraft-but-stonecutter-can-cut-wood/) for the starting point of my project.

title: (AI Mod) FBX Player Models
description: Tired of vanilla skins? FBX Player Models lets you upload any 3D model and use it as your player skin.
body:
# FBX Player Models

Use a 3D model as your Minecraft player skin.

FBX Player Models lets you pick an `.fbx` model and show it on your player. Other players can see it too when they also have the mod installed.

This mod is experimental. It was made for fun, so some models may not work perfectly.

## About builds

All builds are always experimental and alpha.

## What You Can Do

- Use an `.fbx` model instead of a normal Minecraft skin.
- See your model on the main menu.
- Change your model in game with `/skin`.
- Use custom models on multiplayer servers.
- Let server players upload models if they have permission.

## How To Use A Model

1. Install the mod.
2. Join a world or server.
3. Run `/skin`.
4. Choose your `.fbx` file.
5. Open **Edit Model Rig** if the arms, legs, head, or body do not move correctly.
6. Use **Auto Bind** first. If needed, click each body part and choose the right bone by hand.

Your settings are saved after you choose and edit your model.

## Best Model Type

For the best chance of working, use a simple model exported from Blender.

Good models usually have:

- Low detail.
- One material.
- A texture.
- Clear bone names.
- A file size under **3 MB**.

The rig names like `Head`, `Chest`, `Right Arm`, `Left Arm`, `Right Leg`, and `Left Leg` can help the mod guess the right body parts.

## Things That May Not Work

FBX files can be very different from each other. This mod does not support every advanced model feature.

These may not work well yet:

- Very large models.
- Very complex materials.
- Shape keys or blend shapes.
- Advanced animation setups.
- IK, constraints, or complicated rigs.
- Models exported from tools other than Blender.

If a model does not load, try a simpler Blender export.

## Multiplayer Uploads

Servers store uploaded models in the world save.

Operators can upload models by default. Operators can also allow or block uploads for other players:

Allow players:
```
/fbxplayermodels uploadperm <playername> yes
```
Deny players:
```
/fbxplayermodels uploadperm <playername> no
```

Uploaded files must be **3 MB or smaller**.

## FBX Mobs

The mod can also show FBX models on special entities.

Example commands:

```
/summon fbxplayermodels:view_entity ~ ~ ~ {Model:"this_file.fbx"}
/summon fbxplayermodels:hostile_entity ~ ~ ~ {Model:"this_file.fbx"}
/summon fbxplayermodels:tameable_entity ~ ~ ~ {Model:"this_file.fbx",TameItem:"minecraft:apple"}
```

The model file must already be on the server in its FBX mob model folder.

## Help And Feedback

- [Report a bug or suggest an idea](https://github.com/aksulightning/FBXPlayerModels/issues)
- [Contribute code](https://github.com/aksulightning/FBXPlayerModels/pulls)

## Credits

FBX Player Models is based on [AllTheSkins by 1TheCrazy](https://github.com/1TheCrazy/AllTheSkins).

The Cowbell adds a new terrifying monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-513, also known as The Cowbell.


SCP-513 is an old, rusted cowbell that can naturally be found on the ground in the world. You can pick it up and carry it, but never ring it. If you do, the sound of a loud bell will emit, and you will be cursed with the Curse of the Bell effect. As a result, you'll start to see SCP-513-1, a tall, thin, gray figure with a sinister face. It watches you from a distance, but when you approach, it disappears, only to reappear elsewhere. The eerie sound of its breathing will alert you to its presence. What’s worse, SCP-513-1 can harm you while you sleep, making it even more relentless. To break the curse, your only option is to die. However, if you want to avoid SCP-513 entirely, you can imprison it in a Gel Block.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-513 spawn?

SCP-513 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-513.

</details>



![SCP-513](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd00d1fec88f8eac43d48ceb4a5e85362f72eea0.png)

SCP-513 is an old, rusted cowbell. When the player sneaks and right-clicks it, they can pick it up. However, if they don’t sneak and right-click, the bell will ring loudly, affecting all nearby players with the "Curse of the Bell" effect. This curse also applies if the bell is used in the player's inventory. If the player sneaks and uses the bell in their inventory, they can place it back down. The "Curse of the Bell" effect causes the player to start seeing SCP-513-1, a tall, slender, gray creature. The more worse the curse becomes, the more frequently SCP-513-1 appears. Whenever the player sees SCP-513-1, it will disappear shortly after, but if the player tries to sleep, SCP-513-1 will attack and cause damage.

title: SCP-303, The Doorman
description: A terrifying presence that appears behind doors and fills you with fear.
body:
The Doorman adds a new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-303, also known as The Doorman.


SCP-303 is an invisible humanoid anomaly that manifests when players attempt to close doors. Though rarely seen, its presence is unmistakable, marked by growling from the other side. Once spawned, it prevents players from opening the door out of sheer fear, and only the bravest may dare to try. But those who do will regret it, as SCP-303 will attack viciously upon being disturbed.

title: Timless' Simple Zombie Infection
description: A simple zombie infection mod.
body:
**Timeless Simple Zombie Infection** adds a slow, deadly infection system to Minecraft. Getting hit by a zombie isn't just a minor inconvenience anymore — it could be a death sentence. The infection spreads through multiple stages over time, getting worse the longer you ignore it. Penalties stack up, your options narrow, and if you wait too long, you die and come back as one of them. The good news? Everything you were carrying comes back with you. Your items sit inside the zombie until someone kills it and picks them up. No item loss, ever.

The mod comes with suppressor and antidote syringes to give you a fighting chance, a HUD indicator so you always know how bad things are, and infection commands for server admins or modpack makers who want more control. The zombification system handles full inventories, Curios slots, and Sophisticated Backpacks without breaking a sweat — all stored safely and dropped when the zombie goes down.

It's designed to make survival feel genuinely threatening. If you're building or playing in a zombie apocalypse, wasteland, horror, or hardcore modpack, this fits right in.

**Features**
- Zombie-type mobs can infect players
- Three-stage timed infection progression
- Visual infection timer
- Configurable infection duration and infection chance
- Suppressor and antidote syringes
- Infection HUD indicator
- Commands for infecting, clearing, and controlling infection
- Death by infection transforms the player into an infected zombie
- Full item preservation — inventory, armor, offhand, and Curios slots all saved and dropped on kill
- Works even with completely full inventories
- Forge config support
- Compatibility with [The Lost Cities](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-lost-cities), [Corpse](https://modrinth.com/mod/corpse), [Corpse x Curios API Compat](https://modrinth.com/mod/corpse-x-curios-api-compat), [Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks) & [Hardcore Revival](https://modrinth.com/mod/hardcore-revival) when using v1.0.5 or up

**Modpacks & Videos**
Want to throw this in your modpack? Go for it — I'd actually love to see it in more packs. Same goes for YouTube videos, streams, or any kind of content. You don't need to ask permission, just drop a credit and a link back to this page somewhere visible. It doesn't have to be anything fancy — a mention in the description or the modpack listing is more than enough. It helps the mod get found by people who might enjoy it, and honestly it's just nice to know where it ends up.

**Requires [Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib) & [Epic Core API](https://modrinth.com/mod/epic-core-api)**

title: Vivarium [Horror]
description: A psychological horror mod where you are the monster, and The World is your victim.
body:
Content Warning: Blood, Self-harm

Vivarium is a psychological horror mod, designed to make you feel guilty for your in-game actions. You are the monster, and The World is your victim.

The mod does not contain custom hostile entities, and the progression is based on your activity.
You will see changes in the environment, animal behavior, and in your perception of reality.

Multiplayer does not work, and will crash immediately.

What a lively world

Features:

-Butterfly animal, feeds on the...

-Vitaflower block, reactive flora that can be crafted into Cyan Dye

-Grasshopper animal

-Bird animal, can appear as an American Robin or a Mourning Dove

-Blood Liquid, found in the bowels of the earth

-Fully functional in-game config menu, including a "pace" setting to convienently adjust speed of events to your liking

<details>
<summary>Spoilers</summary>
-Central "Guilt" variable that drives the mod, incremented upon killing mobs or mining most blocks
  
-Event where a broken log will bleed and a pool of blood will form

-Event where you will be caved in and teleported somewhere adjacent to disorient you

-Water and fog will slowly turn red as the mod progresses

-Music will pitch down as the mod progresses

-Neutral mobs will be aggro'd immediately at a point in mod progression

-Killing mobs will occasionally cause a blood effect

-Occasional sound effects (heartbeat underground, crying otherwise)

-Passive mobs will flee after a certain point in progression

-Hostile mobs will spawn more frequently as the mod progresses

-Hallucinated carvings will appear on blocks when you stare at a certain block for a long time

-Rain will be made of blood after a certain point in progression

-The sun will change to a crying eye after a certain point in progression.

-Vitaflowers will close or wilt when you get near

-Heat wave event where armor will cook you while in the sun

-Massive tree structure known as the World Tree, the World Heart can be found underneath

-Volcanic eruption event

-Thunderstorm event with heavier lightning than normal

-Dream sequence where you will find a knife which is used to complete the mod's progression
</details>

body:
# MAX FPS Pro: The HIGH-END Performance & Visual Powerhouse

**Engineered by Z.XP.XP.900. Built for Dedicated Systems (16+ GB RAM) and Ultimate Aesthetics.**

MAX FPS Pro is the premium, high-end offering in the Z.XP.XP.900 performance lineup. This pack is designed for systems running **16GB or more of dedicated RAM** and powerful dedicated GPUs. It delivers maximum FPS while incorporating **advanced shader support, beautiful lighting, and the highest graphical fidelity** possible. This is the ultimate choice for content creators and players seeking the best possible visual and performance experience combined.

## ⚠️ CRUCIAL WARNING: Hardware Check

This modpack is built exclusively for **powerful, dedicated systems** with high-end CPUs and GPUs. **It is strongly advised NOT to test this pack on weak or integrated-graphics computers**, as the default high-stress configurations may result in a decrease in FPS and stability compared to the Lite or Balance tiers.

---

## ⚙️ Core Architecture: Graphics & Stability Focus

title: KillStreakReward
description: A Plugin That Lets You Get Rewards Or Just BroadCast In Chat When You Get A Specfic Kill Streak
body:
# **KillStreakReward**

Give your players rewards for kill streaks!  
This lightweight plugin tracks player kill streaks and gives rewards (items or commands) when they reach certain thresholds. Fully configurable, simple to use, and colorful in-game messages.

------------------------------------------------------------

## ✨ Features
- Tracks kill streaks (resets on death).
- /killstreak command to view your streak.
- /killstreak reload (for admins) to reload the config.
- Action bar messages showing streak count.
- Configurable rewards per kill streak threshold.
- Rewards can be items, commands, or none.
- Optional broadcasts, titles, and sounds when streaks are hit.
- Works on Minecraft 1.20+ (Paper/Spigot).

------------------------------------------------------------

## 📝 Commands
- /killstreak → Show your current kill streak.
- /killstreak reload → Reload config (admin only).

------------------------------------------------------------

## 🔑 Permissions
- killstreak.use → Allows /killstreak (default: everyone).
- killstreak.admin → Allows /killstreak reload (default: OP).

------------------------------------------------------------

## 🛠️ How to use
1. Drop the plugin jar into your server’s plugins/ folder.
2. Restart the server (a config.yml will be created).
3. Edit config.yml to set your thresholds and rewards.
4. Run /killstreak reload to apply changes.

------------------------------------------------------------
✅ Simple. Flexible. Perfect for PvP servers.

If you have limited RAM, You can try and follow [this guide](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/wiki/Ultra%E2%80%90Low-Memory-Footprint) to configure ModernFix.

title: Assisted Progression
description: A simple mod to help you along the way
body:
# Mod Requirements
- NeoForge only, version 20.4.72-beta or above

# Assisted Progression
Over the years and across various mods, there are ideas for blocks and items that don't fit some overall theme, but are still nice to have. This mod is a repository of sorts for those ideas. While every idea may not be completly novel, there are plenty of simple to use items and blocks that assist along the way in modded minecraft.


## Credits
----------
pauljoda - Developer

powerchug - Textures


## Permissions
----------
You are free to use this mod in any pack on whatever platform as long as proper credit is listed.

# Items

## Spawner Relocator
![Spawner Relocator Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/spawner_relocator_recipe.png)

The spawner relocator allows you to pick up, and place a vanilla spawner. Hold right click, and release when looking at a spawner to pick it up, and reverse to place. This is a one use item.


## Magnets
### Magnet
![Magnet Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/magnet_recipe.png)

The magnet allows you to attract things towards the player. Shift right click to toggle activation. The base magnet does not require power, however there may be some things you would not want brought to you while active. Use with caution.

### Electric Magnet
![Electric Magnet Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/electric_magnet_recipe.png)

The electric magnet is similar to the base magnet, but does require power to operate. The advantage being that this will only pull items and xp orbs towards the player.


## Trash Bags
### Trash Bag
![Trash Bag Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/trash_bag_recipe.png)
![Trash Bag Menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/trash_bag_menu.png)

The trash bag allows you to set filters that will automatically void items on pickup. The base trash bag supports one item. If you have JEI installed, you can click and drag items from JEI to the filter slots to set the filter without the need of the item. The bags will match tags and damage of the item in the filter.

### Hefty Bag
![Hefty Bag Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/hefty_bag_recipe.png)
![Hefty Bag Menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/hefty_bag_menu.png)

The hefty bag allows you to do the same thing as the trash bag, but with more filter slots,


## Pipette
![Pipette Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/pipette_recipe.png)

The pipette can be crafted with any type of glass and two panes. It can hold up to a full bucket of fluid, and will drain and fill fluid handling blocks with right click. Particularly useful for small fluid amounts that need moved around in mods like Tinker's Construct.


## Parashoes
![Parashoes Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/parashoes_recipe.png)

The parashoes are proof that a pun can become a good idea. This pair of shoes, has a parachute that will slow your decent. Wear these to glide from heights safely.

## Climbing Gloves
![Climbing Gloves Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/climbing_gloves_recipe.png)

Climbing gloves allow you to scale vertical surfaces while they are in your inventory. Combined with the parashoes, they are an excellent way to traverse large caves, ravines, and mountains.

 
## Mob Net and Mob Net Launcher
![Net Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/net_recipe.png)
![Net Launcher Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/net_launcher_recipe.png)

The mob net and mob net launcher are items used to capture and move mobs. Use the launcher to launch a net at a mob, once hit the mob will be trapped in the net. Right click the ground to respawn the exact mob, or right click a spawner frame (see [spawner frame](https://github.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/wiki/Blocks#spawner-frame)), to create a vanilla spawner of that type. The launcher does require power to operate.

# Blocks

## Ender Pad
![Ender Pad Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/ender_pad_recipe.png)

The ender pad is a way to warp on the horizontal axis. The arrow will face away from the player when placed, and if you sneak while standing on top it will send you to another ender pad in the direction the arrow points, up to 20 blocks. It will send you through walls so it is a great way to move in and out of an area that may not have a normal access. 

## Player Plate
![Player Plate Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/player_plate_recipe.png)

The player plate is a pressure plate that will only activate when players are on top.

## Spawner Frame
![Spawner Frame](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauljoda/Assisted-Progression/main/screenshots/spawner_frame_recipe.png)

On its own, the spawner frame is a simple block; however, when a mob net with a captured mob is right clicked onto the frame it will transform into a vanilla spawner of that type of mob. This is a one way process and the spawner will not revert back to a frame.

title: Craftomatic
description: Automatically craft items by using a template item to tell the crafter how to make what you want.
body: # Craftomatic Automatically crafts new items based on a template. NOTE: This is beta and we are experimenting with two types of crafters: a passive one which you can simply put a hopper under to collect items, and an active one which behaves like a dropper, like the vanilla Crafter in Minecraft 1.21. It's unclear whether we'll keep both. This block allows you to automatically craft items. You place an item into the left slot, and the grid will update to show you the items it needs to craft it. If multiple items could be used (as in the case of dyes), arrows will appear above and below the template item to allow you to choose the specific recipe you want. You can also use the scroll wheel while hovering over the template item to switch between recipes. ## How is this different than the Vanilla Crafter in 1.21? This block uses a template to tell the crafter what you want to make. With that knowledge, it can pull in the appropriate items from hoppers place around it. This means you can make each hopper only hold one item type and the crafter knows what to do. Drop an item in the left well and it will show the ghost items for what it expects. If Instead you have an item that can be crafted in several ways, it will provide arrows to select the input ingredients you want to provide. ## Hopper (Passive) Variant In this setup, you only need to place a hopper underneath the crafter to receive the results. In this variant, you can up up to 5 input hoppers around the crafter, so it can pull in up to 5 items in once cycle. For items that leave items behind, e.g. honey bottles -> honey blocks will leave empty honey bottles, those items will also flow out the bottom. No item will craft until remaining items are all gone. ## Dropper Variant This one behaves more like the upcoming Vanilla crafter in that it works like a dropper and requires a Redstone signal to make it work in the same way. It even has a mouth! Due to the fact that it requires power, you can only put up to 4 hoppers around it, so it can't input quite as fast. However, when crafting items that leave items behind, the dropper variant will attempt to spit all of them out with the result item at the same time, while the hopper variant has to wait for enough cycles for the grid to clear before it starts crafting new items. ## Pros and Cons There are pros and cons to both variants. Personally, while originally gravitating towards the dropper variant, I have found myself using the passive variant because it's just simpler (no Redstone clock involved). The passive variant also is easily tileable for use in a sorter, etc. while the dropper variant requires power which might affect a nearby component. It might be workable, but it's harder. The dropper variant can be faster, as it can run on a redstone clock whereas the passive variant can operate only at hopper speed. The hopper variant can only output from the bottom, whereas the dropper variant is directional. ## Stateful Crafting If you don't put a template item in, the table behaves as a stateful crafter. What that means is if you start to craft something and forgot something, when you close the UI, the items are still in the table. It should otherwise behave like a normal crafting table. ## Crafting Recipes There are two recipes for the two variants. The key difference is the item at the bottom. For the passive variant, a Redstone block is used (to represent that it is self-powered). For the dropper variant, a dropper is used instead. ![Crafting Screenshots](https://i.imgur.com/DQ0Bn25.png)

body:
# muffinhunt-datapack

This is the MuffinHunt datapack! You'll find features packed for MuffinHunts!

## What is a MuffinHunt?

A MuffinHunt, in short, is a variation of Manhunt, with extra rules. Among those rules are other changes like having starting kits (which are mostly for balancing), automatically increasing kits, and more. You can find a full list of rules and explanations about the series [here](https://osfanbuff63.github.io/muffinhunt-datapack-docs/WhatIsAMuffinHunt).

## How To Use

Place the zip file that you downloaded in your Minecraft world (.minecraft/saves/[worldname]/datapacks by default) folder and you are good to go! You can trigger the functions manually, but you will not need to run any commands beyond `/trigger StartMuffinHunt` to work. You'll find them under namespace `muffinhunt:`. You will have to manually assign tags, however while a MuffinHunt is running, you can do `/function muffinhunt:dev/assign_permanent_tags`. This will assign tags that will not be removed on the end of the MuffinHunt.

Don the armour of a medieval knight, forge your blade, and carve out your place in a world full of history - with a touch of ancient **Greek and Roman** heritage alongside it.
 
Tend your farm. Forge your blade. Build your settlement. **EwMedieval** turns Minecraft into the medieval world you always wanted.

body:
**3x3 Pickaxes** adds survival-friendly wide mining tools to Minecraft.

Craft special 3x3 versions of every vanilla pickaxe tier and mine a full 3x3 area with one block break. Drops are sent directly into your inventory, XP still drops normally, and enchantments like Fortune, Silk Touch, Unbreaking, Mending, and Efficiency work like you would expect.

The mod is designed to stay simple and server-friendly. Instead of adding custom textured items, the tools are based on vanilla pickaxes with a special green name and lore, making them easier to use on servers and crossplay setups.

## Features

- 3x3 Wooden Pickaxe
- 3x3 Stone Pickaxe
- 3x3 Iron Pickaxe
- 3x3 Golden Pickaxe
- 3x3 Diamond Pickaxe
- 3x3 Netherite Pickaxe
- Mines a 3x3 area based on the direction you mine
- Drops go directly into your inventory
- Extra drops fall normally if your inventory is full
- XP from ores still drops
- Supports Fortune and Silk Touch
- Supports normal enchanting, repairing, renaming, Unbreaking, and Mending
- No commands
- No config needed
- No custom textures or resource pack required

## Crafting

Each 3x3 pickaxe is crafted using the normal pickaxe shape, but with normal pickaxes as the ingredients.

## Important

This mod changes mining behavior, so it must be installed on the server for multiplayer.

For singleplayer testing, install it in your client mods folder and open a singleplayer world.

## Compatibility

This mod is made for Fabric and Minecraft 1.21.11.

Because it avoids custom item textures and uses vanilla pickaxe items with custom data, it is designed to be simple and server-friendly.

title: Replication Upgrade
description: Adds improved versions of some replication components and the Energy Materializer.
body:
![Content](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VhgVnRWY/images/e0b46bc9f89d70eb4233bb864b55c929e850606f.png)

# Replication Upgrade

Adds improved versions of some replication components and the Energy Materializer.

### Improved Replicator

A replicator that works like the base Replication replicator but is **faster** (shorter cycle by default). It uses the same matter network and chips.

---

### Matter Tanks

Two higher-capacity matter tanks that behave like the base Replication Matter Tank but store **more matter**:

- **Deep Matter Tank** – typically **2×** the base tank capacity (configurable).
- **Abyssal Matter Tank** – typically **4×** the base tank capacity (configurable).

They connect to matter pipes and participate in the same network. Capacity multipliers can be adjusted in the mod config.

---

### Energy Materializer

A machine that **converts RF/FE (energy) into matter** and outputs it into the matter network.

- Connect it to your power grid and to matter pipes (or adjacent matter tanks).
- Choose which matter type to produce in the GUI; production rate is configurable (slider).
- It draws power and fills the network with the selected matter, so you can feed replicators or other machines without only using Disintegrators.

Energy capacity and max production multiplier are configurable. Optional: you can define conversion recipes (which matter types are available and their energy cost) via an external JSON file (see config for the path).

title: Worlium
description: Worley noise-based cave generation
body: Worlium replaces all vanilla cave generators with a Worley-noise-based carver modeled on the classic [Worley's Caves](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/worleys-caves) mod by fluke. The Worlium carver produces sprawling, winding, interconnected tunnels. From a gameplay perspective, the underground becomes a massive, labyrinth-like cave system that feels both claustrophobic and expansive. The mod ships for both Fabric and NeoForge through a shared common module that implements the carver as a custom `DensityFunction` (`worlium:worley_caves`). The density function samples a seeded 3D Worley F1/F3-edge cellular noise warped by a 2D Perlin displacement field, applies a depth-scaled warp amplitude so caves become more chaotic closer to bedrock, and eases the cutoff back toward solid near the surface. ## Features - replaces all vanilla caves with a Worley noise-based carver - more performant than vanilla worldgen due to the mod's disabling of carvers - custom aquifer logic (prevents caves from being flooded with water) - first-class support for [Moderner Beta](https://modrinth.com/mod/moderner-beta)'s world preset - increased diamond rarity - removal of diorite, andesite, and granite blobs - large lava lakes near bedrock (y=-63 to y=-56) ## Known Issues - when close to aquatic biomes (oceans, rivers, etc) the carver will occasionally terminate with a flat stone wall - the current aquifer removal logic uses biome tags, which works pretty well but is horrible for compatibility with other worldgen mods/datapacks ## Compatibility - **Moderner Beta** is **supported**. All other datapacks that modify worldgen are **unsupported**. - **Cave Overhaul** is technically compatible, but I'd recommend against using it alongside Worlium.

title: MSG DonutSMP
description: A highly-configurable DonutSMP-style private messaging system for Paper servers (Java 17). Features vanish-aware messaging, persistent ignore lists with GUI management, MiniMessage formatting, PlaceholderAPI placeholders, and optional bStats metrics.
body:
# msgDonutSMP

A highly-configurable DonutSMP-style private messaging system for Paper servers (Java 17). Features vanish-aware messaging, persistent ignore lists with GUI management, MiniMessage formatting, PlaceholderAPI placeholders, and optional bStats metrics.

## Features

- Full message flow: `/msg`, `/r`, `/msgignore`, `/msgunignore`, `/msgignorelist`, `/msgreload`.
- Vanish protection that checks Paper visibility and supports PlaceholderAPI vanish tags (OR gate).
- Persistent ignore storage with a head-based GUI list for quick unignore actions.
- MiniMessage-powered configurable message and format output.
- PlaceholderAPI expansion for last partner and ignore stats.

## Commands & Permissions

- `msg.use` — Use messaging and ignore commands (default: true)
- `msg.bypass.vanish` — Allow messaging vanished players (default: op)
- `msg.bypass.ignore` — Exempt player from being ignored (default: op)
- `msg.admin` — Reload config/data and admin actions (default: op)

Example commands:

- `/msg <player> <message>` — Send a private message.
- `/r <message>` — Reply to your last conversation partner.
- `/msgignore <player>` — Add a player to your ignore list.
- `/msgunignore <player>` — Remove a player from your ignore list.
- `/msgignorelist` — Open ignore list GUI.
- `/msgreload` — Reload `config.yml` and data (requires `msg.admin`).

## Config (high level)

The plugin ships with `config.yml` exposing:

- `options.allow-ignore-staff` — Whether staff can be ignored.
- `placeholderapi.differentiate-vanished` — Append vanished suffix in placeholders.
- `placeholderapi.vanished-suffix` — Suffix appended for vanished players.
- `placeholderapi.vanish-placeholders` — PlaceholderAPI vanish tags (OR logic).
- `formats.sent` / `formats.receive` — Message format templates.
- `messages.*` — All user-facing text (MiniMessage-compatible).
- `gui.title` — Ignore list GUI title.

Use MiniMessage tags and hex colors in format/message entries. PlaceholderAPI placeholders are used when PlaceholderAPI is present.

## Notes for Server Owners

- Vanish detection supports both Paper visibility and configured PlaceholderAPI tags.
- Ignore data is persisted by the plugin and reloaded on startup.

## Technical

- Java: 17+
- Target: Paper (1.20.2+)
- Optional: PlaceholderAPI (softdepend)

title: Saltpeter Gunpowder
description: A vanilla-friendly, immersive, well researched gunpowder crafting mod with no feature creep and no world generation tweaks.
body:
### About --- Ever wish there was an immersive & well researched, vanilla friendly way to craft Gunpowder that doesn't alter world generation, use weird items in the recipe, or have janky crafting steps? Saltpeter Gunpowder is here to help, offering 2 very simple features: A recipe to turn basalt into saltpeter, and a recipe using that saltpeter to craft gunpowder!

### Explanation --- Real life gunpowder consists of roughly 75% potassium nitrate (aka saltpeter), sulfur, and 10% charcoal (yes, charcoal specifically - not *just* carbon). Originally, I was going to add a sulfur ore to the nether, but then I had a realization: Blaze powder IS sulfur! So, with the sulfur problem solved, I decided to see if any vanilla items could substitute potassium nitrate while remaining believable. Unfortunately, saltpeter is a very strange material largely only found in caves, specifically where bats are concerned (often immersing bat guano in water, then filtering it after a while to get the potassium nitrate powder). I decided to simplify my search: what in minecraft could potentially contain Potassium in great enough quantity to be able to be extracted? I looked into a lot of things, eventually landing on the different rocks in Minecraft, and learned that Basalt is consists mostly of oxides of silicon, iron, magnesium, aluminum, titanium, calcium, and... potassium!. And while potassium oxide is ***not*** potassium nitrate, I decided that it wouldn't be too big of a suspension of belief to say that you could extract saltpeter from basalt; fitting that basalt even has "salt" in its name!

### Recipes --- #### Saltpeter #### Gunpowder

Both recipes are shapeless, meaning you can put them in the crafting grid any way you want.

title: ViewInventory
description: You can view and edit other players' inventories.
body:
# ViewInventory
**ViewInventory** is a powerful Minecraft Spigot/Paper plugin designed for server administrators and moderators. It allows you to seamlessly view and manage the inventories and ender chests of other online players in real-time. Whether you need to conduct investigations, provide support, or simply observe, ViewInventory offers a smooth, intuitive, and interactive experience.

### Key Features

* **Real-time Synchronization**: Any changes made to the target player's inventory (by them or you) are instantly reflected in the GUI you are viewing, and vice-versa.

* **Offline Player Support (View Only)**: While direct editing of offline players' inventories is not supported due to data integrity concerns, you can still view their inventory contents.

* **Custom GUI Layout**: A user-friendly 6x9 GUI is provided, clearly displaying the target player's armor, offhand, and main inventory slots.

* **Creative Mode Utilities**: In creative mode, you can use the middle-click (block selection) to copy items from the target's inventory to your cursor, mimicking vanilla behavior. You can also pick up the target player's head.

* **Intuitive Controls**: Standard inventory click actions (left-click, right-click, shift-click) work as expected to move and manage items.

Tab Completion: Easy-to-use command with tab completion for subcommands and player names.

### Commands

`/viewinventory <inventory|enderchest> <player>`

**Aliases**: `/vi <in|ec> <player>`

<details>
<summary>Permissions</summary>

This plugin employs a permission system (adopted in version 1.1-beta~), enabling granular control over features. Players with OP permissions are granted all permissions by default.

**1.** The process of updating the GUI display (copying the target player's inventory to the GUI)

**2.** The process reflecting click actions (copying what the viewer clicked in the GUI to the target's inventory)

When clicking rapidly, process 1 would overwrite process 2. This caused the GUI to revert before changes were saved, resulting in items disappearing.

## Solution
To eliminate this conflict, we fundamentally changed the approach.

### Prioritize Click Operations
> Valid click operations performed by the viewer within the GUI (such as item movement) are now handled by Bukkit's standard functionality. This ensures the exact same processing as Minecraft's normal inventory operations, preventing item disappearance.

### Synchronize Changes Later
> The modified GUI contents are now copied to the target player's inventory one tick after Bukkit completes the click operation. This completely eliminates processing conflicts and ensures changes are reflected safely.

### Control Only Custom Slots
> Plugin intervention is now limited solely to clicks on special slots like the trash can or glass panes. These operations cancel the event and are safely handled by the plugin.

This approach—“leave processing to Bukkit and reflect results later”—achieves both stability and a vanilla-like feel, eliminating the item disappearance bug.

</details>
