title: Tcheam
description: A modpack specifically designed for the Tcheam discord, but anyone is free to download. Install and update the modpack with a single click!
body:
# Custom Modpack for the Tcheam discord.

Features optimization, quality of life, and some game changing mods for an entry in the modded space.

## Performance

Heavily based on the famous Fabulously Optimized modpack, Tcheam focuses on performance first. Using many well-established mods, you can expect much better performance than vanilla Minecraft.

## Tweaks

Through powerful quality of life mods, such as Mousetweaks and AppleSkin, Minecraft keeps its identity while gaining capabilities vanilla players can only wish for. Enjoy Distant Horizons for mind-boggling render distance at little additional cost!

Other mods like Create and Chipped are included to add decoration but also functionnality. Staying close to vanilla is a chosen objective of this modpack, so create is not necessary for advancing and its balancing is made to fit vanilla playthroughs.

## Future-proof

Running on 1.20.1 and fabric, Tcheam is a modern modpack that is based on modern frameworks and recent minecraft versions.

Older versions were developped for 1.21.8 and 1.21.1. These are not up to date and will not be updated. These versions are still listed for completeness but are not recommended.

## Additional considerations

To run this modpack, it is recommended to allocate at least 8GB of RAM, this is lessened if you choose to disable Distant Horizons. Edit: Jesus, I don't know if 8 is enough, try 16 at least.

## For your own Server

For some reason, as of 0.3.0, BetterStats has a tendency to invalidate player data. The mod can remain client side, but should be removed on the server. Dynmap is disabled by default. To make the modpack easy to install, it is the server owner's responsibility to enable it.

title: Vanish‎
description: A Simple Vanish Plugin
body:
# Vanish Plugin

A lightweight, fully configurable vanish system for Bukkit/Paper servers, giving staff the power to slip in and out of sight without a trace—and even audit their own stealthy movements.

---

## 🌟 Features

- **Toggleable vanish**  
  `/vanish` or `/v` to vanish; `/unvanish` or `/uv` to reappear. True toggle behaviour—no more “stuck” states.  
- **Tab-list hiding**  
  Vanished players are removed from the TAB list.  
- **Combat & interaction disable**  
  While vanished, you cannot:
  - Deal damage (`features.disable-damage`)
  - Target or be targeted by mobs (`features.disable-target`)
  - Pick up items (`features.disable-pickup`)
- **Chat blocking**  
  Vanished players cannot send chat messages (`features.disable-chat`).  
- **Action-bar indicator**  
  A subtle “[VANISHED]” bar above your hotbar (`features.action-bar`).  
- **Silent join/quit**  
  Vanished players join and leave with no public messages (`features.silent-joinquit`).  
- **Logging & audit**  
  - Records every `/…` command a vanished player runs.  
  - Logs vanish/unvanish events.  
  - Console and real-time viewers see all events.  
- **Real-time log viewing**  
  `/consolevanish` toggles your personal vanish-log feed.  
- **Runtime config reload**  
  `/vanishsettings reload` (alias `/vs`) reloads `config.yml` without a server restart.  

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission         | Default | Description                                 |
|--------------------|---------|---------------------------------------------|
| `vanish.use`       | OP      | Allows use of `/vanish`, `/v`, `/unvanish`, `/uv`. |
| `vanish.see`       | OP      | Can still see vanished players in-game.     |
| `vanish.reload`    | OP      | Allows `/vanishsettings reload`.            |
| `vanish.log`       | OP      | Allows toggling/viewing live vanish logs via `/consolevanish`. |

---

## 🛠 Commands

- `/vanish` (alias `/v`)  
  Toggle vanish on/off.  
- `/unvanish` (alias `/uv`)  
  Force unvanish.  
- `/vanishsettings reload` (alias `/vs`)  
  Reload `config.yml`.  
- `/consolevanish`  
  Toggle real-time vanish logging feed.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (`config.yml`)

```yaml
features:
  hide-from-tab:    true
  disable-damage:   true
  disable-chat:     true
  disable-target:   true
  disable-pickup:   true
  action-bar:       true
  silent-joinquit:  true
  logging:          true

messages:
  vanish:       '&aYou have vanished.'
  unvanish:     '&cYou are visible again.'
  no-permission:'&cYou don''t have permission.'
  cannot-chat:  '&cYou cannot chat while vanished.'
  action-bar:   '&7[&eVANISHED&7]'
  log-prefix:   '&e[VanishLog]&r '

title: A Minecraft Movie: Cinema Weapons
description: Adds 2 weapons themed around the cinema experience of the A Minecraft Movie.
body:
# Everyone always makes mods about the a movie itself, but never the actual experience watching it.

**Well, I've got you all covered! (all of you like 2 people that thought the same.)**

Introducing Movie.

This is absolute cinema indeed.

**This mod introduces 2 new weapons and a couple other items like popcorn and soda, all of which will be explained below.**

**(Check the gallery if you want a more simple explanation.)**

## Progression:

**The first thing you will need to do is find a Farmer Villager.**

**They will now sell you Popcorn and Soda themed around the a movie.**
  - **Eating and drinking them will leave you with the empty container.**

**If you then happen to find a chicken jockey, then you'd be surprised to see it drops a new item, the Illager Token Pass.**
  - **Using this, you can make the 2 new weapons out of the popcorn and soda.**

## Crystallized Soda Sword

**The crystallized soda sword is a blade made out of ice, amethyst, and soda.**
  - **Right clicking will cause a soda sweep attack, which will throw out soda in front of you, damaging whatever is in the way.**
  - **Has a custom enchantment, Releasing Beam, which turns the sweep attack into a beam of soda.**

## Popcorn Rocket Launcher

**The popcorn rocket launcher is a literal rocket launcher, that can shoot popcorn fireworks.**
  - **(Yes, this is the cinema experience, stay with me!!)**
  - **This can shoot out Popcorn Rockets, another new item that is crafted with fireworks and popcorn.**
  - **The rocket projectile travels in a straight line, and will explode throwing popcorn everywhere upon collision.**

**Has 3 custom enchantments, Infinite Set, Rocket Armor, and Popper.**
  - **Infinite Set works just like infinity on a bow, where as long as you have at least 1 ammo in your inventory, you can keep shooting it and it will not be used up.**
  - **Rocket Armor makes the rocket travel through a couple entities it hits. Though, sometimes it bounces off them instead.**
  - **Popper replaces the rocket functionality with one like a party popper. Instead of using popcorn rockets, it uses popcorn buckets. This also works with Infinite Set.**
  - **Entities in front of you will be damaged by the party popper functionality.**

title: LocalizedBook
description: Adds an ability to localize hardcoded 'name', 'landing_text' and 'subtitle' values in Patchouli's book.json.
body:
# LocalizedBook

## Description

The `LocalizedBook` mod enhances your Minecraft experience by allowing the localization of hardcoded values such as 'name', 'landing_text', and 'subtitle' in Patchouli's `book.json`. This functionality is essential for modpack developers and content creators who wish to offer multilingual support for patchouli books from other mods that hardcode these values.

## Features

- Localize `name`, `landing_text`, and `subtitle` in Patchouli books.
- Easy configuration using TOML format.
- Default setting options to revert to original text.

## Installation

1. Install Fabric API/Forge and Patchouli mod.  
2. Download `LocalizedBook` and place it in your `mods` folder.  
3. Restart Minecraft to complete the installation.

## Configuration

To configure your books for localization:  
1. Navigate to `.minecraft\config\localizedbook\mainconfig.toml`.  
2. Add your book entries under the format:  
"modid:bookid" = ["custom name or 'default'", "custom landing text or 'default'", "custom subtitle or 'default'"]  
You can also write translation keys there just like in Patchouli.

For example, to customize the Botania Lexicon:  
"botania:lexicon" = ["Botania Guide", "Welcome to the world of Botania", "Your Guide to Botany and Magic"]  

You can set any value to `"default"` to use the default value from the book.json.

## Usage

After configuring your books, the changes will take effect in-game after you restart minecraft. Ensure that your book IDs are correctly entered to reflect the changes properly.  

Enjoy a fully localized experience in your Minecraft modded environment!

title: Gild N' Glisten
description: Eat Glistering Melons!
body:
**Hello! This is my first _(of hopefully many!)_ mods for Minecraft!**

The goal of this mod is to provide **Glistering Melon Slices** as a good mid-end game food source on par with golden carrots, as prior they have little to no use outside of brewing potions (and distracting piglins!)

Glistering Melon Slices will feed you around 3 hunger, and can always be eaten.  However, at the cost of providing no saturation, _they heal you for around 2 hearts of health!_ Cool right?

This mod also introduces a new block, the **_Gilded Melon!_**
The Gilded Melon is a gold variant of the Melon block that can be crafted primarily by using 9 glistering melons, just like normal melons!
Gilded Melons require an axe of iron or higher tier to break, and yield **3-7 Glistering Melon Slices**, just like a normal melon!
Also just like a normal melon, you can use fortune to rack up to 9 Glistering Melon Slices from a Gilded Melon!

**The last 2 items added respectively are the Melon Plating, and Melon Plating Mold.**

The **Melon Plating** can be used on a placed/grown Melon Block to _convert it instantly into a Gilded Melon!_ (This feature was primarily to help with automation from various other mods!)

The **Melon Plating Mold** is the item required to craft a Melon Plating.
This item is crafted by forming a ring out of 4 iron ingots, and 4 iron nuggets. Craft the Melon Plating Mold in the middle of a _Gold Bar_ and a _Bucket of Lava_ to recieve a Melon Plating!
This recipe will also return the Melon Plating Mold and a Empty Bucket in the crafting grid!

I can't wait to see what people do with this mod, happy crafting ^^

While 2 of these books can be obtained from wandering traders, the other 9 can only be acquired from innkeepers. Once you obtain a book, similar to the smithing template copying system in vanilla Minecraft, you can copy it using a special book, a vanilla book, and glowing ink sac. Additionally, each book has a rarity and offers a unique ability when right-clicked.

Drinks & Foods:
Additionally, Inn In The Road adds drinks and food items that can only be purchased from innkeepers in exchange for gold coins. These include: juice, beer, coffee, water glass, and cake slice.

Lastly, Inn In The Road adds a bunch of achievements to your game, for example: the "dizzying events" achievement when you find beer.

title: Immersive Skyblock
description: A datapack which creates a Skyblock overworld, nether and end dimension, complete with biomes, empty structure bounding boxes and integrated immersive portals compatibility.
body:
# Immersive Skyblock
This Datapack adds a set of Skyblock dimensions and configurations for Immersive Portals, allowing you to seamlessly walk from your survival world to a minimalist skyblock let's play with seperate inventories.


### Dependencies
[Immersive Portals](https://github.com/iPortalTeam/ImmersivePortalsMod) and [Dimensional Inventories](https://modrinth.com/mod/dimensional-inventories) are the core mods required to add full functionality to the pack.

I recommend my custom-made [Multiversal Vanilla](https://modrinth.com/modpack/multiversalvanilla) modpack for the best experience. It's been thoroughly tested and contains as many performance-enhancing mods as possible without conflicting with immersive portals, as well as some QOL mods and some extra visual and audio enhancement goodies.

### Installation
1) Install your preference of the optional dependencies above.
2) Back up your Minecraft world.
3) Drop the datapack into your world folder.
4) Drop the preset from the [github repo](https://github.com/SlyAquaGuy/immersive-gamemodes/tree/main/dimensionalinventories) into the dimensionalinventories folder or configure Dimensional Inventories using `/diminv`.

# Features 

### Vanilla First
The datapack minimally works on a vanilla installation *(you can use `/tp` to swap dimensions)*, the recommended mods only enabling immersive travel between gamemodes using portals and seamless inventory swapping.

This implementation using Mojang's inbuilt dimension system means that your vanilla Minecraft world stays vanilla; if there's a version change or datapack update that renders the pack unusable, you're left with a vanilla world free from any modifications and some empty portals.

### Balanced Dimensions
Care was taken to ensure the datapack doesn't enable any major exploits in a world.
- Achievements and statistics don't progress in skyblock. *(configurable)*
- Items and mobs can't be transported across different gamemodes. 
- No player interaction across gamemodes. *(can't mine blocks on other side of portal)*

**Skyblock Features**
- Classic skyblock void with island.
- Skyblock portal requires a fully oxidised copper frame and is lit using flint & steel.
- Nether Island with basic blocks included.
- All biomes and important structure bounding boxes are generated.
- End portals, spires, the exit portal and the dragon are all generated. Good luck! 
- End Ships generate, making elytra and shulker boxes obtainable.

## Credits
Special thanks to Qouteall for [Immersive Portals](https://github.com/iPortalTeam/ImmersivePortalsMod) and Thomilist for [Dimensional Inventories](https://modrinth.com/mod/dimensional-inventories).

Huge shoutout to BluePsychoRanger for their [Skyblock Datapacks](https://github.com/BluePsychoRanger/SkyBlock_Collection) I adapted for the worldgen. Skyblock wouldn't have been possible without it.

title: Streamer Tweaks
description: A Fabric mod that displays Twitch chat directly in Minecraft, designed to enhance interaction during streams. Future updates will add moderation features such as message deletion and user bans.
body:
# StreamTweaks – Connect Minecraft with Twitch

StreamTweaks is a Fabric mod that bridges your Minecraft gameplay with Twitch, making streaming more interactive and engaging.
It allows you to see Twitch chat directly inside Minecraft and provides tools for smoother interaction with your audience.

## Features

### 💬 Display Twitch Chat in Minecraft
- Stay connected with your viewers without leaving the game.

### 🚀 Planned Enhancements
- Chat moderation tools (ban, delete, etc.)
- Event notifications (follows, subs, raids)
- Audience interaction features

## Usage

### Step 1 — Authenticate with Twitch

```
/twitch login
```

A clickable link appears in chat. Click it to open the Twitch authorization page in your browser. After approving, a success message is shown in Minecraft. If you don't complete the authorization in time, the request will time out — just run `/twitch login` again.

> **Note:** No Twitch Developer account or app setup is required. StreamTweaks uses its own built-in Twitch application. Your credentials are saved locally and persist across game restarts, so you only need to log in once.

### Step 2 — Connect to a Twitch Channel

```
/twitch connect <channel>
```

Replace `<channel>` with the Twitch channel name (e.g., `/twitch connect etwas`).
Chat messages from that channel will start appearing inside Minecraft.

### Step 3 — Disconnect from a Channel

```
/twitch disconnect <channel>
```

Stop receiving chat from the specified channel. Tab completion is supported to list your currently connected channels.

### Logging Out

```
/twitch logout
```

Logs out of Twitch and automatically disconnects from all subscribed channels.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.8+
- Fabric Mod Loader

title: Flingshot - More Than Just a Slingshot
description: A versatile slingshot weapon that gives copper a new purpose through unique ammo, combat options, and utility.
body:
![Flingshot Banner](https://i.ibb.co/ZRhKFsb5/flingshot-banner-final.png) **- The Fabric version of Flingshot requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)** About 5 years after the Caves and Cliffs update introduced Copper as a new mineral, I have come back to Minecraft and noticed how Mojang has barely added any interesting uses for this new ore. That's when I came up with the idea of porting part of an old mod I made, [Earthbounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/earthbounds), into a standalone expansion introducing a new, vanilla friendly weapon: **The Flingshot**
--- The Flingshot's objective is to finally give a clear purpose to this underwhelming ore, while adding a new interesting twist to combat, have it be in PvE or PvP. The Flingshot is an early to late game mid - long range weapon, which uses Bucks as its primary ammunition. To use it, simply hold a buck in one hand, the Flingshot in the other, and use it like you would a Bow!
--- ## Features - Flingshot - **Copper Buck**: Basic ammunition for the Flingshot - **Obsidian Disc**: PvP alternative to Copper Bucks, effective against armored targets. Disables shields on hit! - **Frost Blast**: Crowd control buck, damages and freezes enemies in an area upon landing. - **Glimmer Goo**: Utility buck, places Glimmer Goo Splat upon hitting a block. - **Shimmer Shell**: Premium buck, does very high damage in an area. Careful not to hurt yourself! - **Fire Charge**: Sets enemies or blocks hit ablaze - Glimmer Goo Splat - Multiface block similar to Glow Lichen, found in dripstone caves in patches of 12 / 36 - Emits a modest amount of light - Has slippery properties when placed on the ground, similarly to ice - Five Enchantments unique to the Flingshot - **Precision I-V**: Heavily improves the Flingshot's accuracy. - **Force I-III**: Increases the range which Bucks can be flung. Incompatible with Agility. - **Agility I-III**: Reduces the movement slowdown while loading the Flingshot. - **Automation I**: Allows the Flingshot to fire automatically when fully drawn - **Versatility I**: Allows the Flingshot to fling item drops - Eight new advancements related to the Flingshot - Recipe book implementation - Customizable parameters through Neoforge's built-in config GUI or through Fabric's [Mod Menu](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/modmenu) --- ## The Flinger's Lifestyle The Flingshot isn't the easiest weapon to craft, requiring 3 Copper Ingots, 1 Amethyst Shard, 2 Strings and 1 Rabbit Hide. It's got a durability of 285, which is about 30% less compared to a Bow - getting Unbreaking III on this is definitely recommended. By default, this weapon is highly inaccurate. This is to balance its potential damage output earlier in the game. In the mid to late game, this weapon can evolve into one of three playstyles, based on which enchantments you pick. ### The Skirmisher The Agility enchantment allows you to move extremely swiftly while shooting. Combined with Automation, the Flingshot starts to feel like a machine gun!
--- ### The Sniper The Force enchantment allows the Flingshot to become nearly as effective as a bow at long ranges. Combined with Shimmer Shells, you can bombard hard to kill monsters or players from afar.
--- ### The... Tosser? Versatility is a very strange enchantment, as it turns the Flingshot into a utility item more than anything. It simply allows you to toss __any item stack__, which combined with Force III, can come in handy to pass items from player to player from afar. Or I suppose you can play ball with your friends? Up to you!
--- ## Configurable parameters
Spoiler To ensure a positive experience to as many players as possible (And compatibility with modpacks and in servers), I have made some aspects of the mod configurable. Below is what you're able to tweak yourself!
- Glimmer Goo Worldgen: Whether you want Glimmer Goo to generate in Dripstone Caves
- Glimmer Goo Patch Rarity: How rare you want Glimmer Goo Patches to be (Lower number = more common)
- Glimmer Goo Patch Min Blocks: The mimimum amount of blocks that should generate per patch (roughly)
- Glimmer Goo Patch Max Blocks: The maximum amount of blocks that should generate per patch (roughly)
- Recoverable Copper Bucks: Whether players can pick up Copper Bucks stuck to blocks
- Ammo Tooltips: Whether Bucks should have descriptive tooltips on their use
- Versatility Item Flinging: Whether the Versatility enchantment is allowed to toss Item Stacks
- Versatility Item Blacklist: A list of items that should not be tossable with the Versatility enchantment (Separate each item with a comma)
- Versatility Tag Blacklist: A list of item tags that should not be tossable with the Versatility enchantment (Separate each tag with a comma)
## Questions?
Spoiler Q: Can I add this mod to X modpack?
A: Absolutely! As long as you don't claim the mod as your own.

Q: Does Flingshot work in Multiplayer?
A: It absolutely should. If there's issues, feel free to contact me below.

Q: Can I make a video on this mod?
A: I'd be stoked for you to do that! Remember to credit me in the description though ;)

Q: I've found a bug / my game crashed!
A: If you encounter any issues with Flingshot, I'd appreciate it if you could report them in the Issue Tracker.

Q: I've got an idea for a feature you could implement...
A: Feel free to contact me down below. Can't promise I will add whatever feature you suggest, but I will definitely take it into consideration!
 

Join Tomrom's Discord Server for support, feature requests or simply to keep up to date with new versions / mods!

title: Enhanced Netherite Armour
description: Gain Fire Resistance when wearing a full set of Netherite armour.
body:
![Enhanced Netherite Armour](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa3e16e6dfe2ed3d34722c0f7f86b9347872058a.jpeg)

# Enhanced Netherite Armour

Give Netherite gear the extra heat-proof edge it deserves, for both players and their horses.

**Enhanced Netherite Armour** is a simple Fabric mod that grants **Fire Resistance** while a player is wearing a full Netherite armor set, and can also protect horses wearing Netherite Horse Armor from fire and sinking into lava.

For players, wear all four pieces:

- Netherite Helmet
- Netherite Chestplate
- Netherite Leggings
- Netherite Boots

Take off any one piece, and the effect is removed again.

---

## ✨ Features

- Full-set Netherite Fire Resistance
- Instant effect removal when the set is incomplete
- Commented config file
- Optional player toggle with `/ena enable` and `/ena disable`
- OP-only `/ena reload`
- Optional LuckPerms support
- Optional Mod Menu support
- Optional compatibility with Armored Elytra and supported armored elytra datapacks
- Optional Fire Resistance for horses wearing Netherite Horse Armor

---

## ‼️ Supported Armor Combinations

By default, the mod works with the standard full Netherite set:

- Netherite Helmet
- Netherite Chestplate
- Netherite Leggings
- Netherite Boots

When `horseFireProtection` is enabled, horses wearing Netherite Horse Armor also receive Fire Resistance, float upward in lava instead of sinking, can path through lava more like they do through water when following food, and dismount riders when fully submerged in lava.


When `armoredElytraSupport` is enabled, the mod also supports:

- Netherite Helmet
- Netherite Armored Elytra
- Netherite Leggings
- Netherite Boots

Support works with:

- The [**Armored Elytra**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/elytra-armor) mod by DorkixAzIgazi
- The [**Armored Elytra**](https://www.vanillatweaks.net) datapack by Vanilla Tweaks
- The [**Plated_Elytra**](https://mc.voodoobeard.com/) datapack by VoodooBeard

Armored Elytra mod or datapacks are **not required**. If supported armored elytra items already exist, they can still be recognized from their item data.

---

## ⚙️ Config

The config file is written as commented JSON:

- `config/enhancednetheritearmour.json`

Available options:

- `enabled`  
  Master switch for the mod

- `useLuckPerms`  
  Enables LuckPerms permission checks when LuckPerms is installed

- `allowPlayerToggle`  
  Lets players use `/ena enable` and `/ena disable`

- `armoredElytraSupport`  
  Enables support for Armored Elytra items and supported datapack formats

- `horseFireProtection`

title: NAT-Whitelist

body:
![NAT WHITELIST BANNER](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3668fef1486fe33343bcbdc792bddd742bec2787_0.webp)
## What is
NAT-Whitelist is a powerful and flexible whitelist management plugin for Minecraft servers. It allows server administrators to easily control who can join the server, with support for both MySQL and SQLite databases.

## Features

- Add or remove players from the whitelist using commands
- Supports both MySQL and SQLite for storing whitelist data
- Automatically fetches correct usernames from Mojang API
- Option to kick non-whitelisted players automatically
- Option to remove offline players from the whitelist
- Customizable messages using MiniMessage format
- Easy integration with Bukkit/Spigot servers
- Log with Discord webhooks (on, off, add, remove, join but no whitelited)

## Commands

| Command                | Description                                 |
|------------------------|---------------------------------------------|
| `/whitelist add <name> <another name>`    | Adds a player to the whitelist            |
| `/whitelist remove <name><another name>` | Removes a player from the whitelist        |
| `/whitelist list`          | Lists all whitelisted players              |
| `/whitelist reload`        | Reloads the plugin configuration           |
| `/whitelist enable`        | Enables the whitelist                      |
| `/whitelist disable`       | Disables the whitelist                     |
| `/whitelist removeoffline` | Remove offlines players                    |

## Permissions

| Permission                   | Description                                      |
|------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| natwhitelist.reload          | Allows you to reload the configuration             |
| natwhitelist.add             | Allows you to add a player to the whitelist        | 
| natwhitelist.remove          | Allows you to remove a player from the whitelist      | 
| natwhitelist.on              | Enables the whitelist                    | 
| natwhitelist.off             | Allows you to disable the whitelist                | 
| natwhitelist.removeoffline   | Allows offline players to be removed         | 
| natwhitelist.bypass          | Allows joining even without being whitelisted    |

description: Shader- and Distant Horizons–ready client pack, optimized for entry-level gaming PCs or devices like the Steam Deck, compatible with unmodded multiplayer.
body:
# About

This modpack focuses on **Complementary Shaders** and **Distant Horizons** for extended render distance.  
It adds a curated set of performance, visual and quality of life mods (map, HUD, voice chat, VR/controller support) while keeping **vanilla gameplay** and full compatibility with **unmodded survival servers**.  
It is tuned for **HeXHub.net**, but works on most vanilla and Paper-based survival servers.

## Core intent

- **Complementary Shaders by EminGT** enabled and preconfigured.  
- **Distant Horizons** for long-range terrain.  
- Only client-side visuals, performance tweaks and UI/QoL features, no gameplay changes.  
- Helper mods such as the minimap are preconfigured for fair play, avoiding xray-like cave view, mob radar or similar unfair information.  
- No freecam-style spectator mods included.

## Settings policy

- Preconfigured: graphics, shaders, map and a few utility mods (per edition), so everything works out of the box without unfair advantages.  
- Keybinds: only cleaned up to resolve conflicts between mods. Important vanilla and core mod keys keep their usual positions, less important mod keys are moved or unbound.  
- Other options such as sound, mouse and general gameplay settings stay close to vanilla defaults.  
- **Your Options Shall Be Respected (YOSBR)** keeps your own settings on updates. Pack defaults are only applied on fresh installs or when a mod is added and its config does not exist yet.

## Handheld Edition
Tuned for handhelds and low to mid PCs.  
Tested on **Steam Deck OLED**.

## Other Editions
- **[Potato](https://modrinth.com/project/hexhub.net-optimized-potato)** – optimized for very weak PCs and laptops.  
  Tested on a notebook with **i7-7200U** and **8 GB RAM**.

- **[Enhanced](https://modrinth.com/modpack/hexhub.net-optimized-enhanced)** – higher visual quality without unnecessary performance cost.  
  Tested on **Ryzen 7900X**, **RTX 3070**, **32 GB RAM**.

## Current status
**Alpha**. Active development, frequent updates, possible issues. Feedback via Discord is welcome.

## Licenses and attribution
Third-party mods and resources remain under their original licenses. No relicensing of third-party files is performed.   
The full list of included mods and dependencies appears on this version page.  
Only pack-specific files (configs, assets, texts) are under this project’s **CC-BY-NC-4.0**.

title: Glaze
description:
A QOL mod for the DonutSMP Minecraft server.
Glaze has a couple of unique features such as a trade vouch system and command keybinds and more!
body:
# 🍩 Glaze
The essential Auction House & trading companion for DonutSMP.
Tired of jumping back and forth to check item prices? Glaze brings market data directly to your inventory - and helps you trade safely with a built-in vouch system. Built specifically for the DonutSMP community, this lightweight Fabric mod ensures you never misprice an item or get scammed again.

## New Features
⌨️ **Command & Chat Keybinds**
You can now bind any command or chat message to a specific key. Instead of typing the same thing repeatedly, just hit a button and let Glaze handle it.

![Mod Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a09b3bf277634dd8996f30d86c0ab457e610403c.png)
## ✨ Features

- Price Tooltips: Hover over any item to instantly see its lowest Auction House price.
- Stack Pricing: Hold shift over any stackable item to see the full stack price, respecting each item's true max stack size.
- Shulker Valuation: Hover over a shulker box to see its total AH value including all contents. Hold shift for a full per-item breakdown.
- Smart Caching: Prices are fetched in the background and cached for 5 minutes, keeping the game smooth and your API usage low.
- Price Reload: Press R while hovering any item to force a fresh price fetch instantly.
- Auto Token Detection: Run /api on the server and Glaze automatically saves your API token - no copy-pasting needed (Note that you can also set it mannually by using "/glaze api set <key>").
- Vouch System: Vouch for players you've successfully traded with. Build trust in the community. (Note: vouches are currently stored locally only - cross-player sharing is coming in a future update.)
- Advanced Auction Search: Quickly find items while browsing the AH.
  - Press 'Y' while hovering over an item to search for it instantly.
  - Press 'U' to search for the item with its specific enchantments included.

- ### 📜 Advanced Chat Rules System
* **Command Interception** – Intercept any outgoing message or command and automatically redirect it to a different output.
* **Smart Prefix Matching** – Create intelligent shortcuts. For example, setting `/r` → `/reply` with **Prefix Match** enabled allows `/r hello` to automatically execute as `/reply hello`.
* **Granular Control** – Each rule features:
    - **Custom Labels**: Keep your configuration organized with unique names for every rule.
    - **Toggleable State**: Enable or disable specific rules on the fly without deleting your setup.
    - **Input/Output Mapping**: Define exact triggers and their corresponding results.
* **Visual Feedback** – Optional `[Glaze]` notifications appear in chat to confirm exactly when a rule has been triggered.
- **Command Keybinds:** a way to bind commands to key so that when you press the key it runs the command

## 🛠️ Commands
### API

/glaze api set <key> - Manually set your DonutSMP API key.
/glaze api delete - Wipe your API key from local config.
/glaze api view - View your currently saved API key.

### Vouches

/glaze vouch add <player> - Vouch for a player you've traded with.
/glaze vouch remove <player> - Remove a vouch you previously gave.
/glaze vouch view <player> - View all vouches a player has received.

## 📦 Installation

Ensure you are running Fabric 26.1.
Install the Fabric API (required).
Download the Glaze .jar and drop it into your mods folder.
Launch the game - if you've already run /api on DonutSMP, your token is saved automatically!

##
### ⚠️ A Note on Development
This mod is in active development and started as a learning project. While I strive for stability, some features are still being refined. The vouch system in particular is designed to eventually support shared cross-player data - the foundation is already in place.
Found a bug? Have a suggestion? Open an issue on the [Github Repository](https://github.com/RubyImpala/Glaze).

### 📜 License
Licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. Stay open, stay free.

title: Better Smithing Upgrades
description: Upgrade any equipment on the smithing table, without losing enchantments.
body:
![Better Upgrade Templates Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3D3O1DPX/images/9f6299fc39d11306ae45a8c6d402f9fb01880e67.png)

About

This mod expands the concept of smithing upgrades beyond Netherite, adding upgrade recipes for all tools and armor from Wood and Leather up to Diamond.

You can now keep the same gear throughout your playthrough and upgrade it along the way, without losing your enchantments!

Content

Basic Upgrade Smithing Template: Similar to the Netherite Upgrade Template but for lower-tier equipment. Can be found in most structures or crafted from Quartz and a couple other ingedients.

Iron Upgrade Part: Used to upgrade Wood, Stone, Leather or Chainmail equipment to Iron level. Craftable from 4 Iron Ingots. Can be found in many loot chests.

Gold Upgrade Part: Used to upgrade Iron equipment to Gold level. Craftable from 4 Gold Ingots. Quite common in loot chests but less than its Iron counterpart.

Diamond Upgrade Part: Used to upgrade Gold equipment to Diamond level. Craftable from 4 Diamonds. Quite rate, can only be found in certain structures.

Netherite Upgrade Part: Used to upgrade Diamond equipment to Netherite level. Craftable from 4 Netherite Ingot (gives x4 Upgrade Parts). Can be found only in the rarest and most difficult to access structures.

Base Edition vs. Advanced Edition

• The "base" edition adds the above content without altering the base game.
• The "advanced" edition adds the above content and removes vanilla crafting recipes for iron, gold and diamond equipment, forcing gear progression using smithing upgrades.

Pick the one that best fits your playstyle!

Tools for modpacks

You can make any equipment upgradable to iron/gold/diamond/netherite tier (including equipment from other mods), using item tags:

• Make an item upgradable to iron tier: upgradable/iron_[axe/boots/chestplate/etc.]
• Make an item upgradable to gold tier: upgradable/gold_[axe/boots/chestplate/etc.]
• Make an item upgradable to diamond tier: upgradable/diamond_[axe/boots/chestplate/etc.]
• Make an item upgradable to netherite tier: upgradable/netherite_[axe/boots/chestplate/etc.]

Structure is as follows: better_smithing_upgrades:{tag}

Compatibility

Show spoiler

- Create
- Sophisticated Backpacks
- Farmer's Delight
- Create Jetpack
- Tom's Simple Storage

Credits

All custom textures used (if any) are either created by me or have a license that allows modification and distribution.

I make every effort to comply with project license obligations and to always credit the original owners. If you believe your name is missing from the credits or if you decide to change your project's license, please contact me.

Credits:
- Malcolmriley's Repository (CC License) for the upgrade parts textures.

Dependencies

This mod has no dependencies.

Installation

Add the .jar mod file into your mods folder.

Alternatively, you can browse the CurseForge launcher for the mod (if it doesn't show up, try typing the autor's name). Once found, click "Install" to add it to your modpack.

Permissions

You are free to include this mod in any modpack, public or private.

title: Refined Enchanting
description: Level up your gear! Refined Enchanting adds RPG stats, tool badges, sleek tooltips, and a robust API for modders.
body:
# ✨ Refined Enchanting
**Stop rolling the dice. Start master-crafting.**

A polished Vanilla+ overhaul that replaces random enchanting with level-up gear growth, a ‘pick-your-power’ master-crafting system, and a modder-friendly API.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/68VbJE6sP2g" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

## 📈 Level Up Your Gear
Your tools aren't static anymore. They gain **Experience (XP)** just by being used:
*   **Swords & Bows**: Gain XP by defeating mobs.
*   **Shields**: Gain XP by blocking attacks.
*   **Armor**: Gain XP by Dealing damage.
*   **Pickaxes & Shovels**: Gain XP by mining blocks.
*   **Axes**: Gain XP by chopping logs.
*   **Hoes**: Gain XP by Harvesting crops.
*   **Fishing Rods**: Gain XP by Fishing.

As your tool levels up, it unlocks the ability to hold more powerful enchantments.

---

## 💎 Pick Your Enchantments
Forget the random "spinning slot machine" of the old enchanting table. Refined Enchanting gives you control:

1.  **Open the Table**: Put your tool and some Lapis inside.
2.  **Pick Your Power**: You’ll see a list of every enchantment that tool can handle.
3.  **Pay the Price**: Each enchantment has a **Tool Level Requirement** and a **Lapis Cost**. 
4.  **No More Randomness**: If you meet the requirement, the enchantment is yours. No surprises.

---

## 🚀 How to Get Started
**Craft a tool** → **Use it to gain XP** → **Enchant once requirements are met.**

---

## 🛠️ For Modders & Pack Authors
We believe in empowering the community. Refined Enchanting features a robust, well-documented mod core:
*   **Data-Driven**: Customize XP weights, enchantment costs, and level-up rewards using standard JSON datapacks.
*   **Extensible Events**: Hook into every lifecycle stage, from XP gain to tool rendering overlays.
*   **[Official Wiki](https://github.com/BoboTweaks/Refined-Enchanting/wiki)**: Comprehensive guides for both players and developers.

---

### 🔗 Quick Links
*   **[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/BoboTweaks/Refined-Enchanting/issues)**: Found a bug? Let us know.
*   **[Modder Wiki](https://github.com/BoboTweaks/Refined-Enchanting/wiki)**: Build your own synergies.

**Whether you’re a player or a modder, Refined Enchanting gives you control, progression, and creativity.**

title: Create: Inhibitor
description: A lightweight Create add-on that introduces a rotational-powered mob-blocking field generator. Perfect for large Create factories, underground megabases, and long dark train tunnels where mobs shouldn’t be part of the experience.
body:
Create Inhibitor

A Create add-on that adds a rotational-powered mob-blocking field generator — perfect for large Create factories, underground megabases and long, dark train tunnels.

A lightweight mid-game utility block. Scales with RPM, integrates into Create's kinetic network, and includes an in-game Ponder scene.

Overview

The Rotational Inhibitor is a kinetic block that prevents natural hostile mob spawns in a radius around itself. The faster it spins, the larger the protected area. It is designed as a mid-game Create utility with a relatively high stress requirement so it fits into Create progression.

How it works

  • Protection radius = RPM × 0.25 (capped at 64 blocks)
  • Only prevents natural hostile mob spawns; does NOT affect spawners, eggs, or passive mobs
  • Updates dynamically as RPM changes
  • Stress unit is 8SU per block radius

Usage

  1. Place the Rotational Inhibitor where you want coverage.
  2. Connect it to a Create kinetic network (shaft, gearbox, speed controller, etc.).
  3. Apply rotational power! The block will prevent hostile mob spawns in its radius.
  4. Increase RPM to expand the protected area.

Quick controls

Shift + Right-Click - Toggle Debug Visualization
Right-Click - Toggles light on or off

Crafting

This block is crafted via Mechanical Crafters. No manual crafting recipe available.

Tips

  • Chain multiple inhibitors for mega coverage without lighting every block.
  • Use Create's Speed Controller to fine-tune radius in dangerous areas.
  • Perfect for mob-proofing long rail lines and huge underground halls.

Ponder

Includes a Create Ponder scene teaching players how to place, power, and scale the inhibitor. Found in the Create Ponder index under Utility. (this is still a WIP)

Compatibility

Works alongside other Create add-ons.

Required:
- Forge 47.4.0
- Create 6.0.8 or compatible versions

title: Farting
description: Occasionally, players fart when they crouch.
body:
# Farting
That's it. That's the mod.

This mod requires three mods:
- [Polymer](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymer)
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)
- [Fzzy Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/fzzy-config)

With Polymer, this mod is entirely server-side.

## Features
- Occasionally, when crouching, players will fart.
- Fully data-driven farts, allowing you to configure their weights, particles, sounds, velocity, and (soon) effects.
  - There are two default farts, normal fart and big fart.
    - Normal fart is a short burst with a small particle cloud that pushes you forward slightly.
    - Big fart is a larger burst with a bigger, darker particle cloud that launches you up in the air a bit. This one is rare.
- The chance of a fart happening can be configured (between 0 - 1, 0 being not at all and 1 being 100% of the time).
- Farts trigger sculk sensors; this can be disabled, but it is enabled by default.
- Editing the fart sounds can be done via resource pack.

I question my life decisions every day.

## Issues
If you have any questions, suggestions, or bugs, please [make an issue here](https://github.com/justanoval/farting/issues).

- [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/farting)

## Disclaimer
This mod will not be ported to Forge or any other mod loaders.

description: A Spigot/Paper plugin that adds simple but handy commands.
body:
![Simple QoL (quality-of-life) Commands logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5860a657313918733acba33242cda43c10704828_0.webp)

**Simple QoL Commands** is a Spigot plugin that adds simple, but handy commands. Currently, the plugin features 10 commands.

<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>
  
- "/spawn":\
  Usage: /spawn\
  Teleports the executor to the world spawn.

- "/tpa":\
  Usage:  /tpa <accept|decline|cancel> <username>\
          /tpa <username>\
  Sends a teleport request to another player.

- "/home":\
  Usage: /home <tp/set> <number>\
  Sets a home point that you can teleport to at any time.  

- "/back":  
Usage: /back  
Teleports the executor to the place where they last teleported, or to their last death location (only if _enable-back-command-on-death_ was set to _true_).  

- "/warp":  
  Usage: /warp <warp_name/create/remove>  
  Similar to _/home_, but is managed by the server's admins.  

- "/fly":  
  Usage: /fly <player>  
  Enables flying for yourself or a specific player (if you have OP).

- "/nightvision":  
  Usage: /nightvision OR /nv  
  Grant night vision to yourself.  

- "/stack":  
  Usage: /stack <item>  
  Stacks the same item from your inventory to your main hand.  

- "/hat":  
  Usage: /hat
  Swaps an item in your main hand with your helmet slot.  

- "/trash":  
  Usage: /trash  
  Opens a double-chest GUI accessible to all players. When you put items in it, all players can see and take them, kinda like a double ender-chest, but it works for anyone. After about 1.5 minutes, all the items in the trash bin will be cleared.
</details>

title: Better Channeling
description: Adds multiple levels to the Channeling enchantment with progressively stronger effects, while staying true to vanilla behaviour.
body:
# Better Channeling

**Better Channeling** is a lightweight Fabric mod that enhances the Channeling enchantment by introducing multiple levels with distinct behaviours, while staying as close to vanilla gameplay as possible.

## ✨ Channeling Enchantment Levels:

1. **Channeling I** 
    - Behaves exactly like vanilla: tridents summon lightning **only during thunderstorms**.
2. **Channeling II**
    - Allows lightning strikes **during any rain**, not just thunderstorms.
    - **Rare**: Appears in about **5-6% of all Channeling enchantments** at level 30.
3. **Channeling III**
    - Enables lightning strikes **at any time**, regardless of weather.
    - **Not obtainable via enchanting table**. Can only be acquired by **combining Channeling II** tridents or books using an **anvil**.

## 🛠️ How to Install
1. **Download the mod**
   - Find the version that matches your Minecraft version.
     - Format: `1.0-1.16.1` → Mod version 1.0 for Minecraft 1.16.1
   - Download the `BetterChanneling-<version>.jar` file.
2. **Install Fabric Loader**
    - Download and run the [Fabric installer](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/).
    - Fabric **API is not required** for this mod.
3. **Install Better Channeling**
   - Place the downloaded `.jar` file into your `mods` folder:
     - `~/.minecraft/mods` (or your instance folder if using a launcher like MultiMC or Prism)
   - If you don’t have a `mods` folder, launch Minecraft with Fabric once to generate it.
4. **Verify Installation**
   - Launch Minecraft with Fabric.
   - In a creative world:
      - Search for "Channeling" in the creative inventory.
      - You should see three enchanted books (Channeling I, II, III).
   - You can also use `/enchant @p channeling 3` to test tridents directly.

## 🧪 Mod Compatibility

- Works in both **single-player** and **multiplayer**.
- When **installed on a Fabric server**, it should function correctly, **even if players do not have the mod installed client-side**.
- However, it is **recommended** that both **client and server have the mod installed** to ensure proper enchantment visibility (e.g., seeing Channeling II and III in creative menus or enchanting tables).
- Does **not** require the Fabric API.
- Should be compatible with **any mod that does not directly modify Trident or Channeling behaviour**.
- If you discover an incompatibility with another mod, please [open an issue](https://github.com/MaxTKB/BetterChanneling/issues) so it can be investigated and resolved if possible.

## 🔄 Uninstalling the Mod

- This mod **should be safe to remove from existing worlds**, uninstalling Better Channeling will **not corrupt** your world or cause issues.
- Any tridents enchanted with Channeling I, II or III will **retain their enchantments**, but will behave like standard **vanilla Channeling** tridents after the mod is removed.
- This makes the mod **safe to add or remove** from modpacks and multiplayer servers without permanent impact.
- If you experience any issues after uninstalling, feel free to [open an issue](https://github.com/MaxTKB/BetterChanneling/issues) so it can be looked into and resolved.

## 📚 About the Mod

This mod uses Mixins to adjust the behaviour of:
- The `TridentEntity` class
- The `ChannelingEnchantment` class

Its goal is to offer a more interesting experience for the Channeling Enchantment without deviating much from the core mechanics of the game.

## 🙌 Special Thanks
Shoutout to the chatter in [Feinberg's](https://www.twitch.tv/feinberg) Twitch chat who originally suggested the idea for this mod, your spark of inspiration made this possible!

Additional thanks to [Nischhelm](https://www.curseforge.com/members/nischhelm/projects) for advice and suggestions about enchantment power.

title: Journey Titles
description: Lets you add Titles to Areas with Signs
body:
**Want to add Titles to the regions your buint in your map?**

This is a reworked version of the [Original](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/journey-area-title-generator/) Datapack by HopeVox

This Datapack lets you add Titles to Signs and displays them for everyone coming in range.

Craft different tiers of Titles to set the Signs range:

![crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09b2b4db75b39353b0c0c7229b3cf7c8b2954738.png)

- Copper Title: 10 Blcoks range
- Iron Title: 20 Blocks range
- Gold Title: 50 Blocks range
- Diamond Title: 100 Blocks range
- Netherite Title: 200 Blocks range

To Create a Title, place a Sign, write something on its front side (the one facing you when placed) and right-klick any of the Titles on that Sign.
You can't place multiple Titles on one Sign.
If the Sign is broken, the Title item you used on it will drop.

If you add glow ink after adding the Title, it will be displayed underlined.

If you can't remember wich Signs have Titles, hold a Title Item and all Signs with Titles on them will display their Title tier as a small block.

This Datapack also supports Titles in the range of other Titles.
The Titles will only be displayed if you enter the range of a specific Title after you have left it.

Since I had to use Integer UUIDs for the Titles, the pack will stop working if you place more than 2147483647 Titles in one World.

title: LocateBiome
description: Adds the /locatebiome command from 1.16 into earlier versions.
body:
### Functionality
LocateBiome adds the /locatebiome from the vanilla 1.16 snapshots to 1.15.2 and 1.14.4 (no, I will not port this to other versions). It will print the coordinates of the closest biome the player specified in the command to chat (see "Usage" below). This mod only needs to be installed on the server to work, however it will also work on the client.

### Usage
Example: */locatebiome minecraft:plains*

You can substitute minecraft:plains with any vanilla or modded biome. The command will suggest you all possible biomes that you can insert here.\
The message that this command will print, if successful in finding the given biome, contains a clickable green text which will prepare a teleport command to the found coordinates which contain the searched biome.

# 🌌 Fidelity

**See and hear Minecraft the way it was meant to be.** **Fidelity** is a complete overhaul of the game's graphics that pushes the limits of how Minecraft looks without losing its essence. This pack changes the familiar blocky world into a stunning, living environment by adding over 100 carefully chosen mods. The core gameplay stays the same, though. ## ✨ Great Visuals **Next-Gen Rendering:** Uses **Iris Shaders**, **Sodium**, and **Distant Horizons** to create cinematic lighting and draw distances that go on forever. * **Living World:** With **Fresh Animations**, **Not Enough Animations**, and **Wavey Capes**, you can move around easily. With "Windy," "Wakes," and "Particle Rain," the environment even feels alive.* The 3D Overhaul: The world gets more depth and texture that you can almost feel with things like "Actually 3D Stuff," "3D Skin Layers," and "Baha's 3D Beds." * **Clean UI:** A simple experience with **Smooth GUI**, **Blur+**, **Immersive Hotbar**, and great fonts. ## 🎧 Immersive Audio * **Soundscapes:** Deepen your immersion with **AmbientSounds**, **Presence Footsteps**, and **Sound Physics Remastered** for realistic echoes and environmental depth. * **Curated Music:** Enjoy a richer soundtrack with the **Stellarity Music Addon**, **Celeste Music Cassettes**, and the **True Ending** Ender Dragon themes. ## 🛠️ Modern Utilities * **Seamless Navigation:** Stay oriented with **Xaero’s World Map** and **Minimap**. * **Social & Connectivity:** Built-in **Essential** support for easy friend invites, **Simple Voice Chat** for proximity audio, and **Chat Heads** for a better social feel. * **Technical Polish:** Optimized with **Lithium**, **FerriteCore**, and **ImmediatelyFast** to ensure the smoothest frame rates possible. ## ⚙️ Performance & Flexibility Fidelity is built to be inclusive. Every high-fidelity feature is modular and fully configurable. * **High-End Ready:** Max out your settings for a true "Next-Gen" masterpiece. * **Optimized for All:** Using a laptop or an older rig? ![mr knight](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c644d127d511af0ccfb012a494bf8e9dafd5b8b4.png)

mr knight has quite the scary enemy, as he has 1000 health. To put that in perspective, netherite swords only do 8 damage. He can notice you from quite far away, and will sprint quickly at you, so just try to avoid him.

# miniature knight
![miniature knight](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd9a23ae6805ca08346e11f387eef9a33eac7378.png)

miniature is just as fast as mr knight, but has half the health and attack power, so not as bad as mr knight. However, miniature knight is only 1 block tall and can open doors, so make sure to invest in iron doors asap.

# Mr. Kite's Market
![Mr. Kite's Market](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1fdef01fe3b5ebc8c348c6e6623c4ae252a4d06.png)

When either mr knight or miniature knight is defeated, they will drop a mr knight coin. These coins can be used at Mr. Kite's Market to buy special goods.

# Important Items
![important items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0313689be7641c4730cf35dac4225025b441fe2d.png)

Items 1-4 are the mr knight tools, which are slightly better than netherite, and can be crafted out of mr knightium ingots, which can be made from raw mr knightium, found in the mr knight dimension. The 5th item is an ingot of mr knightium. The 6-9 are the mr knight armor, which are also slightly better than netherite and can be crafted from mr knightium ingots.

# Additional things
You can make anti knighting potions to avoid getting knighted. the brewing recipes are:

![potion of anti-knightening recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2cfb63176603bcfb4ae818600938f543c62e28de.png)

an awkward potion + essence of mr knight = anti-knightening potion. This potion lessens damage from mr knight. 

![strong potion of anti-knightening recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1292d26566b3aa6db06211cd6066999eab0181a0.png)

adding another essence of mr knight will make the effect last longer

> mr knight is coming on the new moon btw

scallywag for making the mod (crazy)

title: SCP-6096, The Blanket Ghost
description: Be afraid when the Blanket Ghost haunts you in the night...
body:
The Blanket Ghost adds a terrifying new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-6096, also known as The Blanket Ghost.


SCP-6096 is a creature that hides beneath a blanket. During the night, it can spawn, and it will possess one of three different faces. Once it appears, it will relentlessly chase the player until the day, at which point it disappears. If SCP-6096 gets too close, you will become unable to attack anything. The only way to banish SCP-6096 temporarily is with a Crucifix. Should SCP-6096 catch up to you and attack, you’re very likely dead.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-6096 spawn?

SCP-6096 can spawn during the night on the surface in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-096.

</details>



![SCP-6096](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/503214f1ed718bdeefb7b3f93381ae9e67ca19b3.png)

SCP-6096 is a creature lurking beneath a blanket. It spawns at night and can have multiple faces. When exposed to direct sunlight, SCP-6096 disappears. This entity seeks out the nearest player, always knowing their location. While SCP-6096 is slow, it is incredibly resilient and is immune to most forms of damage. If SCP-6096 attacks a player, it vanishes and delivers an instant one-hit kill when unprepared. Additionally, it causes all players within a 16-block radius to be unable to attack.

 

- Config File not inculed.
- You are all allowed to use this mod in your modpacks!
- Do not port my mods without permission!

title: Wescraft: Desire Paths
description: This mod adds erosion to grass upon stepping on it, creating desire paths.
body:
**Wescraft: Desire Paths** is a mod from the Wescraft Project that add more realism to Minecraft by eroding the grass as you travel. Retracing your steps may create desire paths.

### What are desire paths?

**Desire paths** are paths that are made artifically and unintentionally by **stepping on foliage**. Walking on grass blocks periodically erodes the top grass layer into coarse dirt. The **interval in which the grass is eroded**, as well as the **erosion chances** are configurable.

### Manage your lawn!

Sometimes, grass can be essential for decorational purposes, you may not want to trample the ground. **Wescraft: Desire Paths** adds a new enchantment called **Soft Step**, disabling erosion when wearing the enchantment on boots.

### Plans to expand the mod:
  - Add more steps of erosion
  - Make more block "erodable"
  - Modify the new block textures

Visit the **discord server** to report bugs or suggestions!

title: Just a Very Powerful Performance Pack
description: A NeoForge-based, de-duplicated, full-path performance pack that aims to provide a clean ~3× client / ~6× server speedup while preserving vanilla semantics and visual fidelit
body:
This pack contains **only proven optimizations** that measurably improve **FPS/TPS**.  
Redundant tweaks and overlapping features that may introduce regressions are intentionally excluded.

It is built for **NeoForge 1.21.x**, preferring NeoForge-native builds of major optimization mods to maximize compatibility between client and server.


## **Core Principles**

### **• De-duplication**

Avoid overlapping features that cause conflicts or “negative synergy.”  
Every included mod has a distinct, non-overlapping role.

### **• Async \& Parallel-First**

Prioritize optimizations that offload or parallelize:

* rendering
* particle processing
* chunk IO
* entity \& block-entity logic

### **• Low Visual Footprint**

No aggressive visual downgrades.  
Vanilla 12-chunk render distance, full-quality leaves — performance gains come from engineering, not uglifying.



## **Author Benchmarks** *(author-provided)*

* **5070laptop**: ~3× FPS in normal scenes; ~5–6× in extreme loads
* **i7-13th gen, heavy entity SP**: stable **~20 MSPT** @ vanilla view distance
* **Server tests**: With async pipeline + C2ME, **2048-furnace setups maintain ~20 TPS** even on weak CPUs



## **Included Major / Verified Mods**

### **• Flerovium**

General engine-level performance improvements.

~~**• AsyncParticles**~~

Offloads particle simulation and rendering to multi-threaded pipelines.

### **• [Iris (Async Fork)](https://github.com/Lonmo0208/Iris)**
_Licensed under LGPL-3.0_                                                                                
An asynchronous, performance-tuned fork of Iris:

* reduces shader-related main-thread stalls
* smoother shader loading
* pairs efficiently with Sodium and async rendering stack

### **• Accelerated Rendering**

GPU compute-shader–based entity \& block-entity renderer.  
Replaces per-frame CPU vertex transforms with GPU caching + parallel transforms, significantly reducing CPU load in entity-dense scenes.

### **• Sodium (NeoForge)**

Modern and stable client-side rendering optimizations.

### **• Lithium (NeoForge)**

Logic and tick performance improvements.

### **• C2ME**

Multi-threaded chunk IO and region management.

### **• Entity Culling**

Skips rendering of entities and block entities outside camera visibility.

### **• Additional Mods**

Reese’s Sodium Options, ImmediatelyFast, ModernFix, Noisium, MoreCulling, GPUTape, Krypton FNP, Ixeris, and all other provided mods are included with tuned configs and preserved filenames.



## **FAQ**

### **• Does this change vanilla gameplay?**

No — all vanilla semantics and mechanics are preserved.

### **• Server-friendly?**

Yes. Fully compatible with NeoForge servers and async-heavy environments.

---
本整合包仅包含**经过验证、确实能够提升 FPS / TPS 的性能优化**。  
任何可能引入回退、冲突或负优化的冗余与重叠调整，均被有意排除。

整合包基于 **NeoForge 1.21.x** 构建，优先选用 **NeoForge 原生版本**的主流性能优化 Mod，以最大化客户端与服务端之间的兼容性。



## **核心原则**

### **• 模块去重（De-duplication）**

避免功能重叠、相互干扰或产生“负协同效应”的优化。  
每一个被纳入的 Mod 都拥有清晰、独立且不可替代的优化职责。

### **• 异步 / 并行优先（Async & Parallel-First）**

优先采用将负载从主线程中卸载或并行化的优化方案，包括但不限于：

* 渲染流程
* 粒子处理
* 区块 IO
* 实体与方块实体逻辑

### **• 低视觉侵入（Low Visual Footprint）**

不采用激进的画面降级手段。  
保持原版 **12 区块视距**、完整树叶与高画质表现 —— 性能提升来自工程优化，而非“丑化画面”。



## **作者实测数据** *(由整合包作者提供)*

* **5070笔记本**：常规场景下约 **3× FPS**，极端负载场景可达 **5–6×**
* **i7 第 13 代，单人模式，高实体密度**：在原版视距下稳定维持 **~20 MSPT**
* **服务端测试**：结合异步处理链路与 C2ME，在弱 CPU 环境下  
  **2048 熔炉阵列仍可维持 ~20 TPS**



## **主要 / 已验证 Mod 组成**

### **• Flerovium**

通用的引擎级性能优化。

### **• AsyncParticles**

将粒子模拟与渲染卸载至多线程执行，降低主线程负载。

### **• [Iris（异步 Fork）](https://github.com/Lonmo0208/Iris)**
_采用 LGPL-3.0 许可证_  
一个以性能为导向的 Iris 异步分支版本：

* 显著减少 Shader 相关的主线程阻塞
* 提供更平滑的 Shader 加载体验
* 可高效配合 Sodium 与整合包内的异步渲染体系使用

### **• Accelerated Rendering**

基于 **GPU 计算着色器** 的实体 / 方块实体渲染加速方案。  
通过 GPU 缓存与并行变换，取代逐帧的 CPU 顶点变换，在高实体密度场景中显著降低 CPU 占用。

### **• Sodium（NeoForge）**

现代、稳定的客户端渲染性能优化。

### **• Lithium（NeoForge）**

核心逻辑与 Tick 层面的性能优化。

### **• C2ME**

多线程区块 IO 与区块管理优化。

### **• Entity Culling**

跳过摄像机不可见的实体与方块实体渲染。

### **• 其他包含 Mod**

Reese’s Sodium Options、ImmediatelyFast、ModernFix、Noisium、MoreCulling、GPUTape、Krypton FNP、Ixeris 等所有其余 Mod 均按原文件名保留，并已针对兼容性进行配置调整。



## **FAQ**

### **• 是否会改变原版玩法？**

不会 —— 整合包完整保留原版语义与机制，不包含任何玩法改动。

### **• 是否适合服务器使用？**

是的。  
完全兼容 **NeoForge 服务端**，并针对高并发、异步负载环境进行了设计。

title: WayHomes
description: WayHomes is a lightweight Fabric mod that lets you save and teleport to unlimited personal waypoints, with a clean in-game interface.
body:
# Homes

**Homes** is a lightweight Fabric mod that lets you save and teleport to unlimited personal waypoints, with a clean in-game interface.

## Features

- **`/sethome <name>`** — Save your current position as a home
- **`/home <name>`** — Teleport to a saved home
- **`/delhome <name>`** — Delete a home
- **`/lookhome`** — Open a GUI showing all your homes with teleport and delete buttons

## Interface

The `/lookhome` command opens an in-game screen listing all your homes with their coordinates and dimension. Click **TP** to teleport instantly, or **X** to delete. Supports scrolling if you have more than 8 homes.

## Details

- Homes are saved **per player UUID** in a `homes.json` file inside the world folder
- Data **persists between sessions** — your homes survive server restarts
- Works in both **singleplayer and multiplayer**
- No limit on the number of homes per player

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2+
- Fabric API 0.146.0+

## Glowing ores and more with the old-school minecraft look!
**Ever wanted to have glowing ores with minecraft's old-school textures completely in vanilla?**                    
**This texture pack does just that! (and even more...)**

EPAP is meant to be used as a patch that goes **_on top_** of not only Minecraft's built-in "Programmer Art" texture pack but also [THGABS' Programmer Art Fix](https://modrinth.com/project/d1nRD7RG) texture pack. (see image below)

<details>
<summary>Setup Example</summary>

![Setup Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/241ece5fc747e27f3fcbfa3932145038e76adaff.png)

</details>




### EPAP features emissive textures for:
- All stone, deepslate and nether ores (except coal)
- Crimson & Warped stems and fungi
- Creaking hearts
- Observers
- Crafters
- Copper bulbs
- Redstone rails
- Respawn Anchor
- Crying Obsidian
- Redstone repeaters & Comparitors
- All command blocks
  
**This texture pack is still a work in progress and some things are still missing**
### Planned additions for the future:
- Emissive redstone dust
- Magma
- Shroomlight
- Glowstone
- All sculk related blocks

title: IFR25KU Official Standard Client ModPack 202509
description: Client-side Modpack for the standard play environment envisioned by the IFR25KU developer — September 2025 Edition.
body:
## Client-side Modpack

This Modpack is a client-side variant of the server Modpack.

The sections below reuse the server Modpack description.

Differences from the server edition:

- To enhance the gameplay experience, it includes several optional mods.

## Concept

This Modpack provides the standard mod setup envisioned by the [IFR25KU](https://modrinth.com/mod/ifr25ku) developer.

There are two editions of this Modpack:

- [Server Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/ifr25ku-server-2509)
- [Client Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/ifr25ku-client-2509)

The contents of this Modpack are identical to those on the official *IFR25KU Server*, which also serves as a testbed for IFR25KU.

This Modpack lets you reproduce that setup.

## Included Mods

Below is a summary of included mods.

For the complete list of mods, see the dependencies on each version’s page in the Versions tab.

### Main Mods

These are the principal mods that define this Modpack, listed in order of thematic importance.

1. [IFR25KU: The Institute of Fairy Research 2025 Kakera Unofficial](https://modrinth.com/mod/ifr25ku) - Representation of the *MirageFairy* worldview
    - *MirageFairy* unfolds in a science-fiction world governed by fantastical physical laws.
    - The *MirageFairy2024* storyline is set on a planet where plants have gone feral after being modified by an ancient civilization known as **The Institute of Fairy Research**.
    - Original crops and crossbreeding to create improved cultivars.
    - Equip fairies obtained from items such as Mirage Flour to gain various passive effects.
    - Tools crafted from various mod-specific materials.
1. [Magitech -Arcane Engineering-](https://modrinth.com/mod/magitech_mod) - Fusion of technology and magic
    - *Magitech* constructs magical theory through science and treats mana like electricity, blending the romanticism of the Industrial Revolution with the mystique of arcane arts.
    - Tools crafted through parts synthesis.
    - Magic-based combat.
    - Alchemy-driven crafting.
1. [Mekanism](https://modrinth.com/mod/mekanism)
1. [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
1. [Ars Nouveau](https://modrinth.com/mod/ars-nouveau)
1. [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)
1. [Refined Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/refined-storage)
1. [Applied Energistics 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/ae2)

The overall theme of this Modpack is technology and magic, with agriculture and logistics as subthemes.

Some mods provide adventure elements such as biomes and dungeons, along with ways to upgrade equipment and player abilities.

### Gameplay Enhancement Mods

These mods are included to improve the gameplay experience.

- [Tom's Simple Storage Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/toms-storage)
- [Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries)
- [Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks)
- [Rechiseled](https://modrinth.com/mod/rechiseled)

Several other mods also add or tweak minor features.

### Integration and Dependency Mods

Also included:

- Add-on-like mods for the above mods
- Integration mods between the above mods
- Dependencies required by the above mods

## Official Discord

For support and info on the official *IFR25KU Server*, join the Discord linked on this page (primarily in Japanese).

title: xTntRun
description: 💣 xTntRun - The Classic Minigame, Reinvented! 💣
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/080a1121662b950f41ca5b502d9712c92460733b_0.webp)
# 💣 xTntRun - The Classic Minigame, Reinvented! 💣

Bring the excitement and chaos of the classic **TNTRun** to your server with **xTntRun**! This plugin allows you to quickly and easily set up the popular minigame where players must run on a platform that vanishes beneath their feet. The last player standing wins!

Designed to be **lightweight, efficient, and extremely customizable**, xTntRun is the perfect solution for any server looking to add a fun and competitive minigame for its community.

---

## ✨ Key Features

* 🚀 **Multi-Arena Support:** Create as many arenas as you want! Each can have its own unique setup to keep the fun going.
* 📋 **Interactive Selector GUI:** A sleek and user-friendly menu that allows players to see all available arenas, view their status (waiting/in-game), and join with a single click.
* 📊 **Detailed & Dynamic Scoreboard:** Display crucial information like the map name, remaining players, and game state. The scoreboard automatically updates for waiting, starting, and in-game phases.
* ⚙️ **Highly Customizable:** Modify **absolutely everything**—from messages and titles to items and menus—through the easy-to-edit `config.yml` and `messages.yml` files. Full HEX color support included!
* ⚔️ **Customizable Skill Items:** Add an extra layer of strategy with items like:
    * **Double Jump:** An in-air boost to save yourself from a fall! (Fully configurable).
    * **Punch Bow:** Annoy your opponents and knock them into the void!
* 🏆 **PlaceholderAPI Integration:** Use a wide range of placeholders to display TNTRun stats in any other compatible plugin, such as scoreboards or tablists.
* 🎉 **Victory Celebrations:** Make the winner feel special with customizable fireworks, sounds, and particle effects at the end of the match!
* 👨‍💻 **Simple Admin Commands:** Manage your arenas, set the main lobby, and reload the configuration with intuitive and powerful commands.

---
 
## 🔗 Dependencies

For xTntRun to work correctly, you will need to install the following plugins:

1.  [**PlaceholderAPI**](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.624/): (Required) Necessary for all placeholders to function.
2.  [**WorldEdit**](https://dev.bukkit.org/projects/worldedit): (Required for setup) Needed to save your arena schematics.

---

## 🛠️ Commands

### Player Commands

``/tntrun join <arena>``   - Join a specific arena.
``/tntrun leave``          - Leave your current arena.
``/tntrun menu``           - Open the arena selection menu.


### Admin Commands
``/tntrun create <name>``        - Create a new arena.
``/tntrun setlobby <arena>``     - Set the waiting lobby for an arena.
``/tntrun setspectator <arena>`` - Set the spectator spawn point for an arena.
``/tntrun save <arena>``         - Save the arena and make it available for players.
``/tntrun setlobby``             - Set the main server lobby (where players go after a game).
``/tntrun reload``               - Reload the plugin's configuration files.


---

## 📈 Available Placeholders

Use these placeholders with PlaceholderAPI to display stats anywhere on your server.
``%tntrun_players%``              - Total players across all TNTRun arenas.
``%tntrun_wins%``                 - A player's total wins.
``%tntrun_losses%``               - A player's total losses.
``%tntrun_map_name%``             - The name of the map the player is in.
``%tntrun_arena_players%``        - Current players in the player's arena.
``%tntrun_arena_max_players%``    - Max players in the player's arena.
``%tntrun_countdown%``            - The current countdown timer.

title: Ladders Made Better
description: Ladders Made Better aims to make ladders more efficient, useful and better!
body:
# Ladders Made Better

Vanilla ladders are slow, difficult to place efficiently, have limitations of support and don't feel usable

**Ladders Made Better!** aims to make ladders more usable by adding functionalities like :

**Multiple Ladder Placement using mouse scroll**
- Now you can place multiple ladders in upward/downward direction by scrolling the mouse       button and selecting the number of ladders you want to place 

**Floating ladder placement**
- Ladders can be placed floating if they have a sturdy support above them (so floating chains can be placed if ladders are placed downwards - and also configurable for upward chains)

**Increased Ladder Climb speed**
- Increased the ladder climb speed from the slow 0.2 to a configurable 0.2-0.5 (0.4 by default)

**Jumping made possible from standing on ladders**
- Now you can easily jump on/from ladders without any stuttering or momentum breaking movement

The great thing about the mod, is that its entirely configurable so that you don't have to strictly play on values set by someone else
Feel free to drop any issues regarding the mod in the comment section - that helps in making the mod more error free!

**Functions in detail:**
![Config File](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57dc3565cac6c00d0f2146e00b396e56602cf20a.png)
**How to configure?** : Run the mod once, and then go to the `.minecraft/versions/<neoforge version>config` folder. Find the `lmb-common.toml`, open it using any text editor, and change the values as per your liking (Note that values are set to a max limit which is written above the field in order to avoid exploitation), save the file and you are good to go!

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/IM-ytedjAvc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**MultiLadder Placement** : Works only if the `canPlaceMultipleLadders` field in the `config` file is set to true (already set to true by default). If ladders are held in hand, a small text `Place ladders : x/total ladders in inventory (bound by max limit)` appears on the screen. 
Hold the scrolling button (can be changed in controls -> key binds, set to Left Control by default)
![Scrolling Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5894c58d42163aa37fdb585660b4eebe8e93901c.png)
and scroll the mouse wheel to set the x number of ladders to be placed. A maximum configurable 128-400 ladders from the inventory can be placed in one go to avoid lagging (change `totalLaddersPerPlace` value)  
[_**Also to note that floating ladders in a chain, can be only placed when placing downwards, as placing upwards requires every ladder to have a support**_ (even this is configurable by changing `shouldPlaceFloatingLaddersUpwards` to `true`)]

**Ladder climb speed** : Made ladder climb speed faster, configurable by changing `ladderClimbSpeed` 

(Apologies for a bad-formatted description lol)
Enjoy!

title: Duck Mod
description: Adds a client-sided, toggleable duck to your game to follow you around, with an optional server-side component.
body:
> Note: This mod is archived as all of the features are now available with [PetsMod](https://modrinth.com/mod/pets-mod), an updated and upgraded version of DuckMod with more features.


![Duck Mod's Banner.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6abf2f39d37fc3b5eac5cac850f39945e2f7c497_0.webp)

Duck Mod requires Cloth Config API and Fabric API.
# The Client
When installed on the client, this mod will enable your new best friend, a custom duck! This duck will follow you around wherever you go, and is customizeable with different skins. It will work on any server, and is toggleable with /duck ```on/off```. 

Beware, your duck may occasionally quack to get your attention!

<details>
<summary>List of Useful Commands</summary>
  
- /duck <on/off>
  
      toggles the duck on or off.
  
- /duckname <name>

      sets the duck's custom name to whatever you specified.

- /resetduckname 

      resets the duck's name.

- /teleportduck

      teleports the duck to you, in case it gets suck
      note: animalsl can only teleport if their owner is on the ground. this includes the duck.

- /duckspecies <mallard/pekin>

      changes the species of the duck. by default, the duck is a mallard.


</details>

# The Server

When installed on the server, this mod adds ducks to the game that will spawn naturally. They spawn in:

- Plains
- Cherry Blossom Forests
- Beaches
- Forests
- Dark Forests
- Jungles

They spawn in groups of one to seven, of different species which are random and will not change depending on whether you have /duckspecies set to mallard or pekin. You can tame them with seeds, similar to a chicken.

# Future Plans

Even if this mod doesn't go anywhere, this is definitely my favorite mod that I have created and will definitely be getting updated soon. We hope to:

- Be able to toggle off quacking
- Add NEW duck skins, such as female mallards or wood ducks.
- Be able to interact with the duck in different ways.

We will be adding more pets to your game soon - so make sure to look out for those!

# FAQ

**Q: Why isn't this mod on the latest version?**
A: This mod only supports a few versions for now, however it will be updated consistantly - if a new update comes out, just hit that heart to get notified when it updates and I will get it ported to the latest version in a couple of days!

**Q: Why isn't this mod on my favorite version?**
A: Right now, we only support a couple of versions. However, I am taking version requests - please open an issue on my Github and I'll get right on it?

**Q: Is Neoforge/Forge support ever coming?**
A: Short answer: unfortunately not. However, if you are on neoforge, please consider using [Sinytra Connector](https://modrinth.com/mod/connector) with the [Forgified Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/forgified-fabric-api) and the Neoforge version of [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium?loader=neoforge).

(Unfortunately, as of writing it doesn't look like connector is on modern, but this may change in the future, so keep it in the back of your mind!)

**Q: What's next for the Pets team?**
