title: EventManager
description: EventManage is a PaperMC plugin designed to simplify large-scaled event management on your Minecraft server.
body:
# EventManage Minecraft Plugin

EventManage is a PaperMC plugin designed to simplify event management on your Minecraft server. With a robust command system, administrators can easily configure events using the `/eventmanage` command (with sub-commands like `details`, `start`, `stop`, and `edit`), while players can join events with the `/joinevent` command.

## Key Features

- **Boss Bar Display:** Shows the event name (and how to join) on a boss bar that alternates between red and blue every half-second while the event is active.
- **Teleportation:** Seamlessly teleports players to the event's start location in the specified world.
- **Permission-Based Access:** Admin commands (`eventmanager.admin`) are restricted to administrators, and player commands (`eventmanager.player`) are available to regular players.

## Built With

- [PaperMC API](https://papermc.io)
- [Maven](https://maven.apache.org)
- [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com)

Contributions and feedback are welcome!

## How to Use

1. Download the plugin JAR.
2. Move the JAR to your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart/start your server.
4. Run `/eventmanage` (if you are an admin) to see a list of available commands.
5. Run `/eventmanage edit` to see a list of commands related to editing the currently-stored event.
6. Run `/eventmanage start` (if you are finished editing the event details) to start the event, display a message on the bossbar, and allow joining the event.
7. When the event ends, run `/eventmanage stop` to remove the bossbar message, and disable joining the event.

title: MineCord Link
description: MineCord Link is a Minecraft plugin that links your Minecraft server to Discord, enabling seamless communication between the two platforms.
body:
# MineCord Link

MineCord Link is a Minecraft plugin that links your Minecraft server to Discord, enabling seamless communication between the two platforms.

## Features

- Connect your Minecraft server chat with a Discord channel
- Send Minecraft server events to Discord:
  - Player join/leave notifications
  - Player death messages
  - Player advancement achievements
- Execute Minecraft commands from Discord
- Share player coordinates between Minecraft and Discord
- Automatic plugin updates
- Cross-chat toggle to enable/disable chat synchronization
- Display online players list in Discord
- Server start/stop notifications in Discord
- Customizable bot activity status
- Link Minecraft and Discord accounts

## Commands

### Minecraft Commands
- `/mcl reload` - Reloads the plugin configuration (requires `minecordlink.reload` permission)
- `/mclcoords [location name]` - Share your current coordinates in the game and Discord
- `/mcllinkdiscord [code]` - Generate or enter a code to link your Minecraft account to Discord
- `/mcltogglelistener <listener> <on|off>` - Toggle individual listeners on or off (requires `minecordlink.togglelistener` permission)

### Discord Commands
- `/ping` - Responds with "Pong!" to check if the bot is active
- `/admin <command>` - Executes a Minecraft server command (only for authorized users)
- `/setup` - Sets up the bot for the current server and channel (requires Discord Administrator permission)
- `/players` - Displays a list of online players
- `/crosschat` - Toggles the crosschat feature on or off (only for authorized users)
- `/linkminecraft [code]` - Link your Discord account to your Minecraft account or generate a link code

Arcanmira adds a new dimension with a huge amount of content.

Curseforge page is [Here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/arcanmira)



In order to get to this dimension, you will have to find the Realm Ruins. It spawns in any Overworld biome on the surface, and you will have to craft the Ancient Ingot into an Ancient Igniter to light the portal in the ruins.



Another way to get to the Dimension is to enable the Start in Arcanmira gamerule when creating a new world.



If you want to go into this mod blind, then DO NOT read any further. Advancements within the mod are a good way to try and figure out mechanics without looking them up.



New Additions:

# Blocks

Chert:

 -This is a common stone that makes up the underground of Arcanmira. It can be used as Stone Tools and decoration. Some Overworld ore can be found in this stone.

Rocky Chert:

 -This is a variant of Chert that spawns on the surface of the Stone Gardens biome.

Shadowy Chert:

 -This is a variant of Chert that spawns on the floor and ceiling of the Shadowed Caves biome.

Mossy Chert:

 -This is a decorative variant of chert that can be found naturally in Mining Stations. It can be crafted with Small Cavity Overgrowth and the respective chert block.

Cavitite:

 -A common decorative stone found in the Mossy Cavity.
 
Hydestone:

 -A common stone found in mountains in Arcanmira. It is used to duplicate Armor Trims and for decor. Emeralds may generate in this stone. There is six different types of Hydestone: Normal, Elder, Gray Dungeon, Dark Gray Dungeon, and Black Dungeon Hydestone, and Ghostly Hydestone. All Hydestone types can be dropped from their respective Hydes.

Hyde Totem:

 -This block is placed by the Overlord. It spawns a Hyde when a player gets too close.

Hyde Statue:

 -This functional block can always be found at the center of Hyde Villages. It can be used to check your standing with the Serene Hydes. If you reputation is bad, then you can offer Fractured Shards to the statue to make amends.

Quarry Rock:

 -Uncommon stone found exclusively in Mining Stations. It is a decorative block, and ores may be found in it.

Rhyolite:

 -A common stone found in patches in any biome that can be used for decoration. It is used in crafting some of the important blocks.

Gypsum:

 -White stone found commonly in the Crystalline Grotto biome that is used for decoration.

Volcanic Rock:

 -A common stone found in the Volcanic Flow biome.

Yellow Calcite:

 -A stone type that spawns as small boulders in the Magnolia Forest biome.
 
Crystal Flesh:

 -A brittle red stone found only in the Peering Caverns.

Eyebulb:

 -Hanging crystal eyeball blocks found in the Peering Caverns. Breaking these without Silk Touch will spawn an Eyeling.

Peering Crystallizer:

 -A rare block found in the Peering Caverns. Killing a living mob near this block will cause an Eyebulb to sprout.

Laventurf:

 -A grass block that generates in most biomes in Arcanmira.
 
Sunsta Laventurf:

 -An orange variant of Laventurf that generates in the Sunsta Forest.

Lavenpodzol:

 -This is a variant of Lavendirt that spawns in patches in the Ringlet Forest and Archlit Slopes biomes.

Mossy Lavendirt:

 -This is a variant of Lavendirt that spawns in the Mushroom Highlands biome. Arcanmira mushrooms can survive on this block at any light level.

Lavendirt:

 -A common dirt that is found in most Arcanmira biomes.

Ashy Sand:

 -Black colored sand found in the water of most Arcanmira biomes. It can be smelted into Ashy Glass.

Mira Lily:

 -A common flower found in most Arcanmira biomes that can be grown from Laventurf and crafted into dye.

Archlight Bloom:

 -Another common flower found only in the Archlit Slopes biome. It can be grown from Laventurf, but only if the Laventurf is in the Archlit Slopes biome.

Whirlyflowers:

 -These flowers are similar to Pink Petals. They can be found in some Arcanmira biomes and come in four colors: Green, White, Purple, and Red.

Sualgae:

 -A very common water plant found in Arcanmira. It can be brewed into potions of Blinding Light or cooked into food.

Splash Berries:

 -A bush plant found in the Wetlands and Volcanic Flow biome that has berries that can be picked and eaten.

Sogweed:

 -A common water plant found in the Wetlands biome that can be made into Soggy Satchels.

Cave Mold:

 -A common plant found in caves that has no use.

Lichenfungus:

 -This weird plant can be found deep underground, specifically in the Fungal Caves biome. It is a decorative block, with the Small Lichenfungus being used in Shrungcap Stew.

Midnight's Veil:

 -This moss-like plant can be found growing on trees in the Veilgrove.

Shadecoral:

 -A purple coral found in the waters around Veilgroves.

Crushing Coral:

 -A gray two-block tall coral found in the waters around Veilgroves.

Bubbly Arcoral:

 -A magenta coral found in Veilgroves that occasionally produces Bubbles. These can regenerate your breath and will pop if you stand on them.

Oceanic Bulb:

 -A glowing plant found in Veilgroves.

Tree Grass:

 -This is a green grass plant found mostly on trees in the Stone Gardens biome.

Arcane Amaranth:

 -This is a flower found in the Stone Gardens biome.

Candyfluff:

 -This is a flower found in the Stone Gardens biome.

Puklik Flower:

 -This is a two-block tall flower found in the Stone Gardens biome.

Shadowmoss:

 -This hanging plant can be found in the Shadowed Caves biome and crafted into the Ominous Cloak and Ominous Hood.

Shelf Fungus:

 -A common mushroom found in the Archlit Slopes and Mushroom Highlands biomes.

Shrungcap:

 -A yellow mushroom found in the Mushroom Highlands biome. The Tall shrungcaps can get very large.

Rare Mushrooms:

 -These three blocks (Hydden Gem, Ink Cap, and Archmorel) can be found in the Mushroom Highlands biome (These can also be found rarely in Archlit Slopes, Shadowed Caves, and Hytes). They are made into Shrungcap stew.

Cavity Overgrowth:

 -A common red cave moss, found primarily in the Mossy Cavity.

Cave Algae:

 -An uncommon plant found growing on Chert in the Deeplume Caves.

Lumen Berries:

 -Vines that grow fruit found in Deeplume Caves.

Deeplume:

 -A hearty glowing stalk found in the Deeplume Caves.

Lumeworm Silk:

 -A bioluminescent block found in the Deeplume Caves.

Grumbleroot:

 -This is a vegetable found often in Wetlands and Hyde Villages. It is very similar to carrots. They can only be planted on Lavendirt blocks near water.

Archlit Wood:

 -A new white wood set found in the Archlit Slopes biome. Blue Apples can drop from the leaves.

Magnolia Wood:

 -A new wood set found in the Magnolia Forest biome, with small bushes also in the Stone Gardens. The trees have Magnolia Flowers on the ground near them.

Veiled Wood:

 -A new dark purple wood set found in the Veilgrove biome.

Petronck Wood:

 -This rocky wood set can be found in the Stone Gardens biome. Mining the canopy blocks can rarely yield a Geode, which can be cracked and displayed or crushed into raw materials with a Geode Cracker.

Ringlet Wood:

 -This blue wood set can be obtained from the thin Ringlet Trees in the Ringlet Forest.
 
Sunsta Wood:

 -This orange wood type is found in the Sunsta Forest biome.

Arcane Bricks:

 -This uncommon resource can be obtained from Locked Chests within Arcane Ruins. It can be used in a Repair Forge to fix tools, along with decorative blocks such as Flower Pots and Brick Blocks.

Locked Chest:

 -This is a block found in Arcanmira Structures, mainly Arcane Ruins. They can be oped to drop some loot, and can be reset with a Curious Key. Opening these near Serene Hydes will anger them and reduce your reputation.

Tool Smithing Forge:

 -This block can be used to trim Altorite Tools with a Tool Trim. They work like a Smithing Table.

Framed Glass Panes:

 -These are decorative versions of Glass Panes made with Eldbrass. You can make them in every color and as an Ashy or colorless one.

Eldbrass Forge:

 -This is a useful crafting block that is used to make Hardened Plating.

How to forge Hardened Plating:

![Forging Hardened Plating](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/389/recycle-bin-file-explorer-10_16_2024-2_40_32-pm.png)

Geode Cracker:

 -This utility block can be used to crack Petronck Geodes.

Malachite:

 -This common green stone is purely decorative and can be obtained from Hyde Dungeon loot, higher tier Hydes, or from the Overlord.

Orange Crystals:

 -These are uncommon crystals found in the Crystalline Grotto biome. The crystal shards can be used in quite a few recipes.

Salt:

 -A pink decorative block found in the Salt Mines. Salt Chunks are used to make Salt Lamps and food items.

Salt Lamp:

 -A small decorative light block.

Plated Debris:

 -This is an ore version of Hardened Plating. It can be smelted into scraps.

Lost Supplies:

 -This block can be found in Arcane Ruins and Mining Stations. When opened, they can give Gear, Ores, Food, Wood, and more.

Plated Core:

 -A rare block found in Abandoned Cities used to craft the Chargeblade.

Key Repair Station:

 -This block is used to fix Broken Keys.

How to fix a key:

![Key Repairing](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/388/screenshot-10_16_2024-2_37_11-pm.png)

Safe Doors:

 -This block is found in Sanctums and can be unlocked by using a Safe Key.

Spawner Obelisk:

 -This block is found in some Arcanmira structures. It will spawn mobs based on the block beneath it when a player activates it by getting too close. They will recharge after an hour.

Treasure Rubble:

 -This rare block is found in the Ashy Sand pile in Safe Rooms. When mined, it will drop valuable loot, such as Broken Safe Keys and Ores. 8-12 of these blocks generate in each Safe Room.

Shadow Treasure Rubble:

 -This is a variant of Treasure Rubble that spawns in Sanctum Safe Rooms during a Shadow Event. The loot contained within it is different compared to Treasure Rubble.

Glaring Safe:

 -This block is found in a few structures in Arcanmira. They are unlocked with Tattered Keys and will drop some loot.

Altorite Alloy Press:

 -This crafting station is the only way to craft Altorite Ingots. It can be crafted with Ancient Ashes.

How to press an Altorite Ingot:

![Pressing Altorite](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1011/348/2024-11-09_19.png)

Respawn Ritual Altar:

 -This is a rare block that is crafted with Altorite Ingots. By placing an Orange Crystal Shard and then Ancient Ashes into the block, you will be able to set your spawn point in any dimension.

Arcane Radar:

 -Crafted with Altorite, this rare block can be used to highlight nearby entities by placing either an Orange Crystal Shard or Eldbrass Ingot into the block and then right-clicking it.

Repair Forge:

 -This block can be crafted by Upgrading an Eldbrass Forge with Altorite in a Smithing Table. It can use Arcane Brick to repair tools without costing experience or raw materials.

Arcane Altar:

 -This block is found in Safe Rooms and will contain a rare item upon opening.

Spike Traps:

 -Crafted with Crusher Teeth, this block will, when powered, hurt entities standing on it.

Shadow Wall:

 -This block can be crafted with Shadow Flesh. It is only visible and collideable when there is no light nearby.

Daylight Altar:

 -This block can be crafted from a Fractured Shard. It is used to skip 4 in game hours after every ritual.

Haunted Brazier:

 -Crafted with a Fractured Shard and Eldbrass, this block will spawn mobs when it is lit. Killing all of these mobs will net a reward. During Shadow Events, this block will only spawn Embersouls.

Embiric Bricks:

 -This is a decorative block made with Embiric Powder and Arcane Brick.

Embiric Lanterns:

 -These is crafted with Embiric Powder and either a Saltpewter Lantern or Eldbrass Lantern. It will despawn Shadowhydes and Apparitions near it.

Tablet Binder:

 -A utility block used to put spells into a Spell Tablet.

Gilded Crate:

 -This is a rare block found in Hyde Dungeons (See Hyde Dungeon below for chances) that will drop a Tool Trim and experience when broken.

# Items

Deeplume Stew:

 -A filling food item crafted with Deeplumes.

Grumbling Stew:

 -Soup made from Grumbleroot and Salt.

Blue Apple:

 -This common item can be obtained from Archlit Leaves. It is slightly better than a normal apple.

Enchanted Blue Apple:

 -This is a very rare item found in Safe Rooms. It is much stronger than an Enchanted Golden Apple.

Fruit Salad:

 -A food item made with every Arcanmira fruit.

Hardened Plating:

 -This alloy resource can be forged with an Eldbrass Forge. It is used for gear that is about as strong as Netherite, and is used to make Altorite.

Safe Keys:

 -These items are used to open Safe Doors. They are found in most loot chests in Arcanmira and can drop from Elder Hydes.

Tattered Keys:

 -This key can be dropped from Glarewraiths and Glarecadavers, along with being found in most Arcanmira Structures. They are used to unlock Glaring Safes.

Curious Keys:

 -These can be obtained from Goblits by trading them a Curious Pearl. They are used to reset Locked Chests.

Soggy Satchel:

 -A common item crafted with Sogweed and Eldbrass that can hold up to 9 slots of 32 items each.

Ancient Ashes:

 -This is a very rare item found in Safe Rooms used to craft Ancient Ingots and Altorite Alloy Presses.

Altorite:

 -This valuable alloy can be used to craft Altorite Gear, which is much stronger than Netherite. The full armor set has a special ability that can be activated with a keybind. (Default is V)

Tattered Cloth:

 -This is an uncommon item dropped by Glarewraiths. It can be crafted into an Ominous Cloak and Ominous Hood, which, when both are worn, will give the player some benefits, like going invisible when sneaking.

Eyestone:

 -This is an uncommon item dropped by Eyespirits that is used to craft Safe Keys.

Hauntfish:

 -A near invisible fish that can only be caught by fishing in Arcanmira. It is a food item.

Invisible Sushi:

 -A food item made with Hauntfish.

Crusher Meat:

 -This item is dropped from Crushers and can be cooked for a very good food source.

Crusher Tooth:

 -A common item dropped from Crushers that can be crafted into Spike Traps.

Hydebone:

 -This item has a 1/14 chance of dropping from Cloaked. It is used to craft the Chargeblade and Chargehammer.

Fractured Shard:

 -This rare item drops from the Shattered when they despawn in the daytime. It is used to make Daylight Altars and Potions of Guarding, along with repairing your Serene Hyde reputation.

Protective Wax:

 -This item can be obtained from trading with Serene Hydes. It can be used to make common mobs (such as the Hyde and Glarewraith) from despawning when a Shattered spawns.

The Shatterer:

 -This is a large sword made from Protective Wax and Fractured Shards. It can be used to hurt the Shattered, which will cause it to despawn.

Embiric Powder:

 -A rare dust that drops from Haunted Braziers and Embersouls. It has a few uses.

Ember Idol:

 -This item functions like a Totem of Undying. It will save you from death and make you immune to all damage, but you will instantly die after 10 seconds.

Armornite Gear:

 -This gear is between Netherite and Altorite. It can be made with an Armornite Plate and Plated gear, plus an upgrade template. The gear is stronger during Shadow Events or if you are in dark areas.

Overlord Ingots:

 -These are rare items crafted from Netherite Ingots and an Overlord Scrap dropped by the Overlord. It is used to make Altorite.

Quarry Pickaxe:

 -A rare item that can be obtained by trading Diamonds with Goblits. It mines in a 1x2 area, so it is very good for strip mining.

Chargeblade:

 -This weapon is crafted from a Plated Core, Tattered Cloth, and a Hydebone. It does relatively little damage but can be charged up to deal a lot of damage.

Chargehammer:

 -This is a souped-up version of the Chargeblade. It gains charges from killing mobs with it in your offhand, with there being no limit to the charges it can hold. It will deal 20% of the total hit damage back to the person using it.

Spell Tablet:

 -A utility item that can be found in Sanctums. Spells can be bound to it using a Tablet Binder.

Spell Parchment:

 -Scrolls found in most Arcanmira structures. These are used to add a spell to a Spell Tablet.

Potions of Blinding:

 -This item can be brewed with Sualgae and Awkward potions. It will blind any attacker by reducing their mob follow range by 75% and instantly kill Eyespirits.

Potions of Guarding:

 -This item is brewed from a Fractured Shard and Awkward potions. It gives the user extra Armor and Armor Toughness. There are 2 levels for this potion.

Potions of Death's Touch:

 -This special potion can be found exclusively in Abandoned Cities and Burial Chambers. It inflicts Wither of 30 seconds.

Curious Pearl:

 -This uncommon item can be found in some Arcanmira structures. Trading this item with a Goblit will get you a rare item.

Smithing Templates:

 -There are 5 new Armor Trims in this mod:

  -Concealed can be found in Sanctum chests

  -Plated can be found in Safe Rooms

  -Underhalls can be found in Black Hyde Dungeons

  -Mourner can be found in Burial Chambers

  -Arcane can be found in Arcane Ruins

 -2 New Tool Trims used for Altorite Tools:

  -Both Chargeline and Malevolent can be found in Gilded Crates within Hyde Dungeons

 -And 3 new upgrade templates:

  -The Plating Upgrade is found by looting Lost Supples, Sanctum Chests, Hyde Dungeons, Trading with Goblits, and by killing Overlords.

 -The Armorite Upgrade can be found in Safe Rooms' Treaure Rubble during Shadow Events

  -The Altorite Upgrade can be found in Safe Rooms

Music Discs:

 -There are 6 new discs in this mod:

  -Hydden is found in Safe Rooms

  -Overlord of Arcanmira can be obtained from defeating the Overlord

  -Wondrous can be obtained by trading Diamonds with Goblits

  -Dungeon Crawling can be found in Dark Gray and Black Hyde Dungeons

  -Awakened can be found in Burial Chambers

  -Shadow Events can be found in Safe Rooms' Treaure Rubble during a Shadow Event

# New Enchantments

Cooldown Reduction:

 -This enchantment can be found in a few structures in Arcanmira. It will reduce the cooldown on the Altorite Armor's special ability by 10 seconds. Maximum level is one.

Overcharge:

 -This enchantment can be found in a few structures in Arcanmira and can be put on a Chargeblade to allow you to overcharge the item by one per level. Maximum level is three.

Renewability:

 -This enchantment can be found in a few structures in Arcanmira. It will give the Chargeblade 1-2 charges back when killing a mob. Maximum level is one.

Atk: 15

Def: 15

Drops:

 -1 Armornite Plate (60%, affected by Looting)



The Glarecadaver:

![The Glarecadaver](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e80ac7250b9b6988b2d01bd816984bbb7b7d4e3f.png)

A miniboss mob found in a Burial Chamber. It has a lot of health and can use spells to try and defeat the player. It may heal with a spell when on low health.

Stats:

Hp: 120

Atk: 20 (+5s of Wither II)

Def: 0

Drops:

 -1 Tattered Key

 -1-2 Tattered Cloth (50%)



## BOSS

The Overlord:

![The Overlord](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/604/boss.png)

This is a very strong Boss mob that spawns in Sanctums. The Overlord does not move, and it can spawn minion Hydes to aid it in battle, along with Dungeon Hydes when it gets lower. When the Overlord summons Hydes, it will stop targeting players, which can allow for openings for attacking. It has strong knockback, and it will use a ranged Curse move to attack targets that are not near it. This curse does 6 damage and bypasses armor and enchantments.

Stats:

Hp: 400

Atk: 17

Def: 20

Defeating this boss will give you these following items:

 -1 Arca Gem (75%)

 -1-3 Overlord Scrap with a +35% chance for a second one per level of Looting and +20% chance for 1-2 extra with Looting

 -1 Overlord of Arcanmira Music Disc (50%)

 -5-37 Hydestone

 -10-17 Malachite

 -1 Darkmetal Ingot (50%)

 -1 Broken Safe Key



The Overlord has a variant known as the Shadow Overlord.

![The Shadow Overlord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2598dd07690144740b9bd336d03c48a9161542d4.png)

Shadow Overlords are much stronger, as they have more health, more attack damage, and use their Curse move more often. These mobs will also only spawn Black Dungeon Hydes, Shadowhydes, and Armored Shadowhydes to aid it in battle.

Stats:

Hp: 750

Atk: 18

Def: 20

Defeating this boss will give you these following items:

 -1-2 Arca Gem

 -1 Overlord of Arcanmira Music Disc (50%)

 -1 Altorite Ingot (50%)

 -10-17 Shadow Flesh

 -1 Armornite Plate

 -1 Hardened Plating (~28.6%)

 -1-2 Key Mold (~21.4%)

 -3-6 Darkmetal Ingot (~7.1%)

 -1-3 Broken Safe Key (50%)

 -1 Safe Key (50%)

 -3-4 Overlord Scrap with a +35% chance for a second one per level of Looting and +20% chance for 1-2 extra with Looting

# Biomes

Archlit Slopes:

![Archlit Slopes](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1216/820/minecraft-forge_-1-20-1-singleplayer-6_10_2025.png)

This is an uncommon mountainous biome filled with Archlit Trees. It is one of three biomes that Hydestone generates naturally in.



Crystalline Grotto:

![Crystalline Grotto](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/488/crystalline-grotto-png.png)

This is a common cave biome that Sanctums can be found in. It is the only place to get Orange Crystals naturally.



Deeplume Caves:

![Deeplume Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/469/deeplume-png.png)

A small and rare biome found deeper underground. The cave is covered in Algae and Lumen Berry Vines.



Flowering Shrublands:

![Flowering Shrublands](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/491/flowering-shrublands-png.png)

This is a rare sub-biome of the Shrublands. Magnolia Trees generate very sparsely here, and the surface is covered with Whirlyflowers, with the Green Whirlyflowers being exclusive to this biome.



Fungal Caves:

![Fungal Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/492/fungal-png.png)

This cave biome is found deep under mountains, mainly Archlit Slopes. It is the only place where the Fongre spawns.



Hytes:

![Hytes](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/606/minecraft-forge_-1.png)

This is an uncommon mountain biome. it is the only place in Arcanmira that is always snow-covered and it is one of three biomes that Hydestone generates naturally in.



Magnolia Forest:

![Magnolia Forest](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/493/magnolia-png.png)

A very common biome that consists of Magnolia Trees with Magnolia Flowers and Yellow Calcite generating on the forest floor.



Mossy Cavity:

![Mossy Cavity](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/470/mossy-cavity-png.png)

A common cave biome with a lot of Cavity Overgrowth growing on the floor and Cavitite in the walls.



Mushroom Highlands:

![Mushroom Highlands](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1216/821/minecraft-forge_-1-20-1-singleplayer-6_10_2025.png)

This is a rare mountainous biome filled with Shrungcaps. There are three rare mushrooms found here, and it is one of three biomes that Hydestone generates in.



Peering Caverns:

![Peering Caverns](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/471/peering-png.png)

An uncommon biome usually found under mountains. Many Eyebulbs grow from the floor and ceiling, and Eyespirits are the only mob that spawn naturally here.



Ringlet Forest:

![Ringlet forest](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/42/ringlet-forest-png.png)

This is an uncommon surface biome found near Shrublands and Archlit Slopes. The Ringlet Trees in this biome are very thin, only being an eighth of a block thick. The leaves can be cut off of the trees with Shears or regrown with Bone Meal.



Salt Mines:

![Salt Mines](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/481/salt-png.png)

An uncommon cave biome filled with Salt speleothems. Saltpewter Ore generates exclusively in this biome.



Sea:

![Sea](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/45/sea-png.png)

This is a very common biome that can have Splash Berries on islands. It generates in areas with low continentialness.



Shadowed Caves:

![Shadowed Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/494/shadowed-png.png)

This is a cave biome found inland. The floor and ceiling are covered with Shadowy Chert, with Shadowmoss growing on the ceiling. The Shadowborn will only spawn within this biome.



Shrublands:

![Shrublands](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/47/shrublands-png.png)

This is another very common biome. It contains a lot more Lavengrass than any other biome.



Stone Gardens:

![Stone Gardens](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1625/495/stone-gardens-png.png)

This is a rare biome found in more continential areas of Arcanmira. the ground here is made of Laventurf and Rocky Chert, with new flowers and Tree Grass dotting the landscape. Most of the foliage in this biome grows on top of the Petronck Trees, as they are rich in minerals and provide shelter for the plants. You can get Geodes from mining the canopies of the Petronck Trees. This is the only biome that the Crumblehyde and Rockwraith spawn in.


Sunsta Forest:
![Sunsta Forest](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1359/319/2025-10-16_12-34-16-png.png)
This is an uncommon forested biome that generates near coasts. Sunsta Laventurf covers the floor of this biome, with Sunsta Grass and Red Whirlyflowers on the forest floor.


Veilgrove:

![Veilgrove](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/51/veilgrove-png.png)

A rare biome found out in the sea. There are special trees here, along with Purple Whirlyflowers on the ground and special corals in the water. Glarewraiths don't burn here and they are the only mob that spawns.



Volcanic Flow:

![Volcanic Flow](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/605/minecraft-forge_-1.png)

This is an uncommon biome that is usually found near the sea. Jagged Crags of Volcanic Rock generate here, along with Splash Berries.



Wetlands:

![Wetlands](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/55/wetlands-png.png)

This is a semi-rare biome that is similar to the Shrublands but has much less Lavengrass and the surface is covered with pools of Water. Splash Berries, Grumbleroots, and Sogweed are found here.

# Structures

Realm Ruins:

![Realm Ruins](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/633/minecraft-forge_-1.png)

This is an uncommon Overworld structure that you have to find in order to enter Arcanmira. You can find Enchanted Diamond and Iron Gear here, along with some supply items.



Arcane Ruins:

![Arcane Ruins](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1216/824/minecraft-forge_-1-20-1-singleplayer-6_10_2025.png)

These are small ruin structures found on the surface of Arcanmira. They consist of a group of ruined buildings with Locked Chests in them. A new Armor Trim can be found here, along with Arcane Brick, which is exclusive to this structure.



Hyde Village:

![Hyde Village](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/59/hyde-village-png.png)

This is a common, usually small town found in most forests and plains of Arcanmira. There are generally few houses with chests, but opening these will anger the Serene Hydes living here.



Wayfinder's Tower:

![Wayfinder's Tower](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1288/53/wayfinders-tower-png.png)

This is a semi-common structure found on the surface of Arcanmira. A chest that usually contains a map can be found here, with a Glaring Safe containing the maps to rarer structures.



Burial Chamber:

![Burial Chamber](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1181/822/minecraft-forge_-1-20-1-singleplayer-5_8_2025.png)

This is a very small dungeon found everywhere in Arcanmira. The Glarecadaver will spawn in this structure and there are Glarewraith Spawners in some. The loot here is contained within Glaring Safes, and the layout of each one depends on the biome it spawned in.



Mining Station:

![Mining Station Entrance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25f1de0ff289578cb5f8f55585a825b984f90377_0.webp)![Small Mining Station](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/271eb9ecaed8bba3d8f94bd4e082ba69791efd8c.png)![Medium Mining Station](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b0b42e1e4f50596cc03961b74efcffb6ed0067f_0.webp)![Large Mining Station](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b53e1ee453aefde77d5844dfec3ad9f3c6b47b3b_0.webp)

This is an uncommon structure found in most forested and mountainous inland biomes. There will always be an entrance to this structure on the surface with a ladder and staircase leading down into the main complex. This complex has three variants: Small, Medium, and Large. The lower complex contains mined deposits of Quarry Rock, some Lost Supples, and Goblits wandering around, with Cavity Overgrowth found often in the chambers. Plated Debris can be found rarely in the mines.



Hyde Dungeon:

![Gray Hyde Dungeon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1fd92cc6cdc9291960177e6421225cd4106845cc_0.webp)![Dark Gray Hyde Dungeon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d5a7fbb3c1ead92d7725576b865131720543f7d_0.webp)![Black Hyde Dungeon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a330115796c5961f560e771537848a79caf0e9a0.png)

This structure can be found from Y=-30 to Y=30 in mountainous biomes. The structure consists of a certain type of Dungeon Hydestone, and the color depends on which variant it is. The Gray Hyde Dungeon is the easiest to conquer, while the Black Hyde Dungeon is the most difficult and contains the most loot. These structures can be found with a map that you can obtain from the Wayfinder's Tower.



Abandoned City:

![Abandoned City](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1181/825/minecraft-forge_-1-20-1-singleplayer-5_8_2025.png)

This is a very rare structure found on the surface of non-coastal Arcanmira biomes. Many Cloaked patrol the streets, with each house having a Glaring Safe in it. The Plated Core, which is used to craft the Chargeblade, can be found here.



Sanctum:

![Sanctum](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/992/632/minecraft-forge_-1.png)

By far the most valuable structure in this mod, it is a semi-rare structure found in mountainous inland areas and cave biomes. The Overlord Boss can be found here, along with Safe Rooms that contain a bunch of loot, and a portal to leave the dimension. The second floor may contain extra Spawner Obelisks and Chests. If you come here during a Shadow Event, the mobs spawned here will be much harder, including the Overlord. The loot in Safe Rooms and from the mobs is much better during this time.



Report bugs [Here](https://discord.gg/65Y5pn2TAW)

title: Boat Thunderstorm (weather)
description: Simply changes weather type after spending some time in a boat.
body:
**Boat Thunder – Enhance Your Ocean Adventures!** Looking to add more excitement to your boat journeys in Minecraft? Boat Thunderstorm is the perfect mod for you! This mod triggers a (vanilla) thunderstorm after the player has been sitting in a boat for a while. It introduces a new level of unpredictability, making long boat trips more thrilling and immersive. ![Q&A](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e909371aac228886bbba097e811ddd2ee74155ba.png)

● ● ●

Q&A

Where can I run this mod?

>...

You can run this mod on both Client and Server side.

Does everyone need mod installed to join my Server?

>...

No! Only dedicated server needs to have mod installed, other players can join without mod installed. This includes singleplayer worlds connected with LAN or Essentials etc. where only host needs mod installed.

Will this mod work with modded?

>...

There is a uncommon chance that boats or ships from different mods will trigger thunder because my mod checks for vanilla boats, only way is if devs made them a part of Boat class.

Are you going to make compatibility with other mods in the future?

>...

I might make compatibility with other modded ships at some point, but don't expect it in near future.

Any incompatibilities or dependencies?

>...

No incompatibilities to current date by my knowledge. No dependencies either, just put the jar file in mods folder.

What software was used for mod's creation

>...

It was created in Eclipse IDE.

title: Recipes+
description: Tired of wasting resources? This pack adds metal/block recycling, overhauled stair/slab crafting, and better mob loot (+shedding chickens). Blast raw blocks, clone pottery sherds, and have armor stands with arms! Includes a brand-new achievement.
body:
## Metals Recycling!

Do you find yourself with too many metal items and no idea what to do with them, so you just toss them in a chest and forget they exist? Well, no more! As of 26.1-Snapshot 3, a new 'count' option has been added to furnaces. Enjoy finally decluttering your storage!

[If you don't want it, unzip the file, go to: data\recipes_plus\function\tick.mcfunction and delete the last command]

### The datapack adds 167 new recipes at the moment
+1 for the smithing table              
+5 for the stonecutter              
+56 for the blasting furnace

**limited_crafting is true by default; some recipes are unlocked after the item is found or an achievement is made.**

**59 of the new recipes represent slabs being made back into blocks     
56 of the new recipes represent stairs being made into slabs        
23 of the recipes represent the copying of sherds
Chiseled blocks recipes reshaped            
New wool (and moss) logic**             
~~New achievements for killing zombies, skeletons, creepers, spiders and endermen~~

### Let me know if you have any other ideas for this datapack, you can comment on CurseForge

Further updates and modifications for compatibility with other versions were made by myself_

title: LifeLink
description: When One Person Dies, Everyone Dies.
body:
a lifelink datapack. when one person dies, everyone in the session dies. this pack is inspired by lifelink events from the past.

what marks the difference in this pack is the reward track i have designed for it. here's how it works: someone mined diamonds? everyone gets diamonds. someone crafted an enchanting table? everyone gets lapis. this was my way of making the experience more fun, and less likely to become a miserable slog. it also helps keep it from reaching beyond a 4-6 hour experience.

if you want to play without this reward track, just download a Plain_ version.

title: Mproject
description: A massive weapon mod adding legendary swords with unique abilities, new devastating effects, and chaos magic. Created primarily for the residents of the Maluch dormitory.
body:
# MProject v2.9 — Mod Description
**Author:** Mak3785 | **Version:** 2.9 | **Forge 1.20.1**

---

Welcome to **MProject** — a Forge mod that expands Minecraft with a new arsenal of weapons, unique survival mechanics, and chaotic world events.

---

## ⚔️ Weapons

The mod adds **16+ custom swords**, each with its own passive abilities and active skills. A few highlights:

- **Nether Sword** — Fire resistance, pacifies Blazes and Wither Skeletons, shoots a large fireball on right-click.
- **Nether Wither Sword** — Upgrade of the Nether Sword. Adds a Wither Aura that damages all nearby enemies every 2 seconds, shoots a Wither Skull.
- **Blade of Purity** — Passive shield: blocks all negative effects from being applied to you.
- **Blade of Purity Soul Drinker** — Reflects your negative effects onto nearby enemies instead of letting them affect you. Permanently increases your max health on kill.
- **Spring Sword** — Heals and protects during the day; curses you at night. Long-range root ability and instant crop growth.
- **Techno Blade** — Three hotkey abilities: mass debuffs, mass levitation, and a powerful speed burst.
- **Hyperion** — Slows nearby enemies passively; doubles damage against approaching enemies; pulls all enemies inward and explodes on right-click.
- **Scylla** — Deals 1.5× damage when attacking from behind.
- **Valkyrie** — Builds attack speed stacks with each consecutive hit.
- **Legion Commander** — Commands up to 8 legionnaires across 10 progression ranks with formations, special units, and a sacrificial strike ability.

---

## 🛠️ Tools

- **Fire Pickaxe** — Ignites surrounding blocks and mobs when breaking blocks.

---

## 🍎 Special Items

- **Randomsphera** — A chaos artifact. Random outcome every use: could give you a legendary sword or blow you up.
- **Pill of the Deceiver** — Take on another player's appearance. Mobs won't target you while disguised.
- **Diamond Apple** — A powerful consumable with a strong effect bundle.
- **Ender Pouch** — Opens your ender chest from anywhere.
- **Mirror Teleport** — Saves your bed coordinates and teleports you back instantly.

---

## 🧪 Effects & Potions

7 new custom effects, all brewable and available as splash, lingering and arrow variants:

| Effect | What it does |
|--------|--------------|
| **Fragility** | Multiplies all incoming damage |
| **Corrosion** | Rapidly damages and weakens armor |
| **Binding** | Completely locks your inventory and UI |
| **Heavy Heart** | Pulls you toward the ground — jumping becomes nearly impossible |
| **Kickback** | Randomly launches you in unpredictable directions |
| **Paranoid** | Hallucinations, phantom spawns, random screen distortions |
| **Slippery Feet** | You can't stop sliding |

---

## ✨ Enchantments

- **Soulbound** — Item stays with you on death.
- **Greed** — Auto-collects all drops directly into your inventory.
- **Smokescreen** — Arrows create a smoke cloud and hide enemy nametags on hit.
- **Mining 3×3** — Breaks a 3×3 area per swing.
- **Player Tracker** — Compass always points to the nearest player.
- **Doubleshot / Triple Shot** — Fire 2 or 3 arrows at once.

---

## 🌍 World Events

- **Blood Moon** — Hostile mobs spawn stronger and better equipped.
- **Green Moon** — No hostile mobs spawn. A peaceful night.
- **Acid Rain** — Damages players in the open, oxidizes copper, corrodes armor.
- **Chaos Storm** — Lightning strikes, enchantments shuffle randomly, minibosses spawn.

---

## 🏟️ Hunger Games System

Built-in Hunger Games support with a shrinking world border (`/hgbarrier`) and a weighted structure spawning system (`/hgstructure`) for generating full arenas. State persists through server restarts.

---

## 🤖 Iron Golem Upgrades

- Heal them with iron ingots.
- Villages automatically maintain at least 2 golems.
- Golems taunt nearby mobs, redirecting aggro away from villagers.

---

📖 **Full wiki (all items, crafting recipes, commands):**
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lc9BmU_2RtVLV3eJUoMeIBcFXu9A4cn9/view?usp=sharing

---

> ⚠️ **Texture Notice:** Most textures used in this mod were sourced from various authors across the community. All rights to those textures remain with their original owners. The mod author makes no claim of authorship over these assets.

title: Model Changer
description: A fabric mod change player models to 3D Models with .glb format
body:
ModelChanger is a client side Fabric mod that lets you use custom 3D `.glb` models in Minecraft.

Place your models in the `minecraft/ModelChanger` folder, open the config screen, and select the model you want to use. The mod includes a live preview, player replacement support, and full transform controls so you can fine-tune your model directly in game.

Features
- Load custom `.glb` models from a local folder
- Automatic model folder creation
- Bundled models included in the mod are copied to your `ModelChanger` folder on first launch
- Live model preview in the config screen
- Replace the local player model
- Optional player replacement for other players
- Automatic scaling to player size
- Animation support
- Easy folder access from the config screen

Configuration
- Replace Players
- Replace Player Limit
- Replace Player Range
- Auto Scale To Player
- Allow Animations

Transform Settings
- Scale
- Offset X
- Offset Y
- Offset Z
- Rotation X
- Rotation Y

# EN

## AuthMe Mask

Client-side privacy mod that prevents AuthMe passwords from being exposed on stream.

### Feat
- Masks sensitive commands in chat history:
  - `/login`, `/l`
  - `/register`, `/reg`
  - `/changepassword`, `/cp`
- Visually masks password while typing in chat.
- Toggle from Mod Menu.
- No server/plugin changes needed.

### Note
- Client-side only.
- Real command is still sent to server.
- Compatible with AuthMe flow on servers.

### Req
- Minecraft 1.21+
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu
- Java 21+

# TR

## AuthMe Mask

Yayında AuthMe sifrenin gorunmesini engelleyen client-side gizlilik modu.

### Oz
- Sohbet gecmisinde hassas komutlari maskeler:
  - `/login`, `/l`
  - `/register`, `/reg`
  - `/changepassword`, `/cp`
- Yazarken parola kismini `*` olarak gizler.
- Mod Menu uzerinden ac/kapat.
- Sunucu/plugin degisikligi gerektirmez.

### Not
- Tamamen client-side calisir.
- Sunucuya giden komut degismez.
- AuthMe davranisini bozmaz.

- Fabric Loader

- Java 21+

title: Frametica
description: Powerful cinematic cutscenes builder
body:
# Frametica - Cinematic Cutscene Framework for Minecraft

Frametica is a powerful and comprehensive mod for Minecraft Forge that provides a complete toolkit for creating cinematic cutscenes and animated sequences directly within the game. Designed for content creators, map makers, and server administrators, Frametica enables you to craft professional-quality cinematic experiences without leaving Minecraft.

## Purpose and Function

Frametica serves as a specialized framework for creating, managing, and playing back cinematic cutscenes in Minecraft. The mod allows players to record camera paths by placing waypoints throughout the world, then replay those paths as smooth, cinematic camera movements. This functionality is essential for:

- **Map Makers**: Create immersive introductions, story sequences, and narrative transitions
- **Content Creators**: Produce cinematic footage for videos and showcases
- **Adventure Map Developers**: Implement cutscenes that enhance storytelling and player immersion

## Core Features

### 🎬 Cutscene System
- **Create and Save Cutscenes**: Record camera paths by placing waypoints and save them with custom IDs
- **Playback Control**: Play, pause, resume, and stop cutscenes with precise timing control
- **Queue System**: Chain multiple cutscenes together for extended sequences
- **Wait Points**: Add pauses at specific waypoints to create dramatic timing
- **Single Player Focus**: Currently optimized for single-player use (multiplayer support coming in future updates)

### 📹 Advanced Camera Control
- **Dynamic FOV**: Automatically adjust field of view during cutscenes for cinematic effects
- **Camera Roll**: Apply camera tilt (roll) for dynamic camera angles
- **Smooth Movement**: Professional-grade camera interpolation ensures fluid motion
- **No-Clip Mode**: Camera moves freely through blocks during cutscenes
- **Gravity Control**: Disable gravity for seamless aerial shots

### 🎨 Interpolation Methods
Choose from multiple interpolation algorithms to achieve different movement styles:
- **Linear**: Constant speed movement
- **Bezier**: Smooth, curved paths (default)


### 🎭 Visual Effects
- **Cinematic Bars**: Add letterbox bars (black bars) for true cinematic presentation
- **Particle System**: Integrated particle effects management
- **GUI Hiding**: Automatically hide HUD elements during cutscenes for clean footage
- **Player Model Rendering**: Debug tools for visualizing player positions

### ⚙️ Advanced Features
- **Custom Duration**: Set specific playback durations or use automatic calculation
- **FPS Control**: Adjust target FPS (30-300) for different recording needs
- **Smoothness Control**: Fine-tune transition smoothness
- **Persistent Storage**: Cutscenes are saved and persist across game sessions

## Usage

### Creating Your First Cutscene

Follow these simple steps to create and play your first cinematic cutscene:

1. **Start Recording Waypoints**
   - Stand at your starting position and look in the direction you want the camera to face
   - Type `/ft add` to place your first waypoint
   - Type `/fta v` to show placed points
   - Move to your next desired camera position and adjust your view angle
   - Type `/ft add` again to place another waypoint
   - Repeat this process for all positions you want in your cutscene (minimum 2 waypoints required)

2. **Add Optional Wait Times** (Advanced)
   - If you want the camera to pause at a specific waypoint, use `/ft add <seconds>` where `<seconds>` is how long to wait
   - Example: `/ft add 2.5` will add a waypoint with a 2.5 second pause

3. **Save Your Cutscene**
   - Once you've placed all your waypoints, save them with a unique ID
   - Type `/ft save <id>` where `<id>` is a name for your cutscene (e.g., `/ft save intro_scene`)
   - Your waypoints are now saved as a reusable cutscene

4. **Play Your Cutscene**
   - Type `/ft play <id>` to play your saved cutscene (e.g., `/ft play intro_scene`)
   - The camera will automatically move through all your waypoints smoothly
   - You can pause with `/ft pause`, resume with `/ft resume`, or stop with `/ft stop`

5. **Clear and Start Over** (Optional)
   - If you want to create a new cutscene, use `/ft clear` to remove all current waypoints
   - Then repeat the process from step 1

**Example Workflow:**
```
/ft add                    # Place first waypoint at spawn
/fta v
[Move to position 2]
/ft add                    # Place second waypoint
[Move to position 3]
/ft add 1.5                # Place third waypoint with 1.5 second pause
[Move to position 4]
/ft add                    # Place final waypoint
/ft save my_first_cutscene # Save the cutscene
/ft play my_first_cutscene # Play it back!
```

### Basic Workflow

1. **Record a Path**: Use `/ft add` to place waypoints at desired camera positions
2. **Add Wait Times** (optional): Use `/ft add <waitTime>` to add pauses at waypoints
3. **Save the Cutscene**: Use `/ft save <id>` to save your recorded path
4. **Play the Cutscene**: Use `/ft play <id>` to replay your cinematic sequence

### Command Reference

#### Main Commands
- `/ft add [waitTime]` - Add current position as a waypoint (with optional wait time in seconds)
- `/ft save <id>` - Save current waypoints as a cutscene with the specified ID
- `/ft play <id> [duration]` - Play a cutscene (auto-duration or custom duration in seconds)
- `/ft list` - List all saved cutscenes
- `/ft pause` - Pause the currently playing cutscene
- `/ft resume` - Resume a paused cutscene
- `/ft stop` - Stop the current cutscene
- `/ft clear` - Clear all waypoints

#### Quick Aliases (`/fta`)
- `/fta p` - Pause
- `/fta r` - Resume
- `/fta s` - Stop
- `/fta l` - List cutscenes
- `/fta c` - Clear waypoints
- `/fta v` - Toggle particle effects

#### Debug Commands
- `/ft debug mode` - Toggle debug mode
- `/ft debug player` - Toggle static player model rendering
- `/ft debug cinematic` - Toggle cinematic bars
- `/ft fps [value]` - Get or set target FPS (30-300)
- `/ft smooth [on/off/factor]` - Control transition smoothness

## Content Guidelines Compliance

This mod is designed for legitimate use in:
- Adventure maps and custom game modes
- Server events and presentations
- Content creation and video production
- Educational and demonstration purposes

The mod does not provide any unfair gameplay advantages, cheating mechanisms, or exploits. All features are intended for creative and cinematic purposes within the bounds of normal gameplay.

## License

This project is licensed under the MIT License. This license allows for free use, modification, and distribution, **with the requirement that you must include the original copyright notice and license text when redistributing or using this mod**. Attribution to the original authors (Nulled, Askiphy) is required.

## Support

For issues, feature requests, questions, or contributions, you can get help through:

- **Discord**: Join our Discord server for support and community discussions

The mod is actively maintained and updated based on community feedback.

---

**Note**: This mod currently works best in single-player mode. Multiplayer support is planned for future updates. The mod requires both client and server components, which are automatically active in single-player worlds.

body:
Geo Tracer – Advanced Block & Chunk Scanner for Minecraft


Description:
Geo Tracer is a powerful utility mod for Minecraft that allows players to analyze and scan their world efficiently. With Geo Tracer, you can:

Retrieve block information at any position in the world.

Scan rectangular areas, cubes, or spherical regions for blocks.

Get detailed block counts in a radius, including non-air blocks only.

Inspect chunks on the surface or within a region.

Designed for modpack creators, world explorers, and technical players, Geo Tracer provides accurate world data while keeping performance in mind. Whether you want to map resources, plan builds, or debug world generation, Geo Tracer gives you precise control over chunk and block scanning.

Features:

getBlockAtPos(x, y, z) – Returns the block at a specific coordinate.

getBlocksInRect(startX, startY, startZ, endX, endY, endZ) – Scans small areas for non-air blocks.

getBlocksOnSurfaceInChunk(BlockX, BlockZ) – Finds top blocks of a chunk.

getCubeFromRadius(x, y, z, radius) – Scans a cubic region around a point.

getSphereFromRadius(x, y, z, radius) – Scans a spherical region around a point.

Why Geo Tracer?
Geo Tracer is designed to be lightweight, efficient, and easy to integrate with other mods like ComputerCraft or CC:Tweaked. It allows detailed analysis of your world while respecting Minecraft’s performance limits.

Disclaimer:
Geo Tracer is a utility mod. It does not modify gameplay or provide unfair advantages in multiplayer. All functionality is aimed at technical exploration and building efficiency.

mind, RedstoneFlux provides a universal energy system for Minecraft plugins.

---

## ✨ Features

* ⚡ Universal energy system for Bukkit-based Minecraft servers
* 🚀 Built with Kotlin and DSL-first design
* 📆 Easy integration with Paper and Folia
* 🔌 Modular and extensible API
* 🔍 Emphasis on performance and maintainability

---

## 🔧 Getting Started

### Requirements

* Minecraft 1.20.6 or newer (Paper)
* Java 17+
* Gradle or Maven for dependency management

### Installation

RedstoneFlux is planned to be published on JitPack.

Add the following to your `settings.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
pluginManagement {
    repositories {
        gradlePluginPortal()
        maven("https://jitpack.io")
    }
}
```

And in your `build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
repositories {
    maven("https://jitpack.io")
}

dependencies {
    implementation("com.github.Jadiefication:RedstoneFlux:<version>")
}
```

---
## 🧱 Project Status

This project is under active development. While the core systems are evolving, the latest usage documentation and API references are maintained in the project's [wiki](https://github.com/Jadiefication/RedstoneFlux/wiki).

For practical examples and guidance, please refer to the wiki, which provides up-to-date instructions and tutorials for working with RedstoneFlux.

title: ChatTools
description: A cross-server chat management plugin designed for Minecraft Velocity servers. It supports global message synchronization, custom server display names, and cross-server private messaging, enhancing player communication in multi-server environments.
body:
# ChatTools - Velocity Cross-Server Chat Plugin
![Velocity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Velocity-3.4.x-blue) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-17-green) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPLv3-green.svg)

**ChatTools** is a cross-server chat management plugin designed for Minecraft Velocity servers. It supports **global message synchronization**, **custom server display names**, and **cross-server private messaging**, enhancing player communication in multi-server environments.

> **Note**: This plugin is AI-developed to simplify cross-server chat management.

---

## Features
- **Cross-Server Message Sync**:
  - Messages sent by players on any sub-server are broadcast to all online players in real-time.
  - Message format includes **server alias** and **player name**.
- **Custom Server Names**:
  - Define server display names via configuration files (e.g., `lobby` → `Main Lobby`).
- **Cross-Server Private Messaging**:
  - Use `/tell` or `/msg` to privately message players across servers.
  - Messages are visible only to the **sender**, **receiver**, and **console**.
  - Supports tab-completion for online player names.
- **Dynamic Configuration**:
  - Use `/chattools reload` to reload configurations without restarting the server.
- **Compatibility**:
  - Supports Velocity 3.4+ and Minecraft 1.16+.

---

## Installation
### 1. Download the Plugin
Download the latest `ChatTools.jar` from [GitHub](https://github.com/NSrank/ChatTools) or other distribution channels.

### 2. Install the Plugin
Place the downloaded `ChatTools.jar` into the `plugins/` directory of your Velocity server.

### 3. Start the Server
Start the Velocity server. The plugin will automatically generate the default configuration file at `plugins/ChatTools/config.yml`.

---

## Usage
### Commands
| Command                    | Permission             | Description                                                         |  
|----------------------------|------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|  
| `/chattools reload`        | `chattools.reload`     | Reload the plugin configuration file to apply changes immediately.  |  
| `/tell <player> <message>` | `chattools.command.tell` | Send a private message to a player across servers.                 |  
| `/msg <player> <message>`  | `chattools.command.tell` | Alias for `/tell`.                                                |  

### Examples
1. **Cross-Server Chat**  

A player in the `Lobby` server sends:

```
  [Main Lobby] Steve: Hello everyone!
```  

  A player in the `Survive` server replies:

```   
  [Survival World] Alex: Welcome to Survival!
```

2. **Cross-Server Private Message**:
```
  [Main Lobby] Steve → [Survival World] Alex: How's it going?
```

---

## Configuration
The configuration file is located at `plugins/ChatTools/config.yml`:
```yaml  
servers:
  lobby:
    name: "Main Lobby"
    color: "AQUA"
  survive:
    name: "Survival World"
    color: "GREEN"
  minigame:
    name: "MiniGame Zone"
    color: "YELLOW"
```
- **Keys** (e.g., lobby) are **Velocity server IDs**.
- **Values** (e.g., Main Lobby) are **display names** used in chat.

---

## Support and Feedback
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvements, please contact us through the following channels:

-  **GitHub Issues**: [Submit an issue](https://github.com/NSrank/ChatTools/issues)

---

## License & Disclaimer  
- **Development Statement**: This plugin is AI-developed to provide efficient chat management for the Minecraft Velocity community.

- **License**: Licensed under GNU General Public License v3.0. You are free to use, modify, and distribute it under the license terms.

- **Disclaimer**: The developer is not responsible for any issues arising from the use of this plugin.

---

## Acknowledgements
Special thanks to the following technologies and tools:

- [Velocity API](https://papermc.io/software/velocity)
- [SnakeYAML](https://github.com/snakeyaml/snakeyaml)
- [Adventure API](https://github.com/KyoriPowered/adventure?spm=a2ty_o01.29997173.0.0.7c5733f51H3mj8)

---

body:
# Nerfstick
This plugin allows server owners to further customize when and where debug sticks can be used. With this plugin, debug sticks can be safely given to players in survival. This plugin prevents players from using debug sticks in protections where the member isn't allowed to build such as worldguard regions and griefprevention claims. You can also customize exactly which properties of which block types can be modified.

## Setup for Luckperms
Here's what I use on my server and it's a good starting point. [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/) works with regex and that's what the r= means in the permissions below, but some permission plugins might not support this, so if you're not using Luckperms, look into that some more.

Set **minecraft.debugstick.always** to true to allow players to use the debug stick outside of creative mode.

Set **r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.\*.waterlogged** to **false** in context of dimension-type **the_nether**. This is to prevent waterlogging blocks in the nether where water normally cannot be placed.

Set these permissions to true. It's a whitelist of blocks that could be modified with the stick, and when new updates come out, you may want to add more block types to this list.
* nerfstick.use.minecraft.barrel.\*

title: HTGLoggers
description: Logs player commands, chat, join, leave events, and offers API for custom log management.
body:
# PLUGIN NIE BĘDZIE WSPIERANY

## Publiczne Pluginy w SIECI:
- [SpigotMC](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/htgloggers-public-api.119346/) 
- [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/bukkit-plugins/htgloggers-beta-public-api-beta)

## Dokumentacja
Właśnie otworzyliśmy dokumentacje dla naszego plugina zapraszam na strone [HTG Docs na temat HTGLoggers](https://htg-docs.gitbook.io/htg-docs/).

## HTGLoggers
HTGLoggers to potężny i łatwy w użyciu plugin do logowania dla serwerów Spigot, idealny dla administratorów, którzy potrzebują szczegółowych zapisów aktywności graczy i wydarzeń na serwerze.

## Funkcje
- **Logowanie dołączenia/wyjścia graczy**: Automatyczne rejestrowanie, gdy gracze dołączają lub opuszczają serwer.
- **Logowanie czatu i komend**: Rejestruje wszystkie wiadomości na czacie i używane komendy, ułatwiając monitorowanie.
- **Dostosowywalne formaty logów**: Możliwość konfigurowania formatu logów, w tym znaczniki czasu i style wiadomości.
- **Łatwa integracja**: Bezproblemowo współpracuje z innymi pluginami, takimi jak HTGClient, dla lepszego zarządzania zdarzeniami.
- **Lekki i wydajny**: Optymalizowany pod kątem wydajności, zapewnia minimalny wpływ na działanie serwera.
- **API do zarządzania plikami**: Oferuje API do tworzenia plików logów i bezpośredniego wysyłania logów do tych plików.

## Konfiguracja
Łatwo kontroluj, które wydarzenia są logowane i jak się pojawiają w pliku `config.yml`:

```
logging:
  enabled: true  # Czy logowanie jest włączone

  format:
    timestamp_format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"  # Format znacznika czasu
    join_format: "[{time}] Player joined: {player}"
    quit_format: "[{time}] Player left: {player}"
    chat_format: "[{time}] Chat - {player}: {message}"
    command_format: "[{time}] Command - {player}: {command}"
    teleport_format: "[{time}] Teleport - {player} to {location}"  # Nowy format logowania teleportacji
    advancement_format: "[{time}] Advancement - {player}: {advancement}"  # Nowy format logowania osiągnięcia
    block_break_format: "[{time}] Block Break - {player}: {block}"  # Nowy format logowania niszczenia bloków

  events:
    log_join: true    # Loguj dołączenia graczy
    log_quit: true    # Loguj wyjścia graczy
    log_chat: true    # Loguj wiadomości na czacie
    log_commands: true  # Loguj użycie komend
    log_teleport: true  # Loguj teleportacje graczy
    log_advancement: true  # Loguj zdobycie osiągnięcia przez graczy
    log_block_break: true  # Loguj niszczenie bloków przez graczy
```

Aby uzyskać więcej szczegółów, odwiedź [HTGLogger Wikipedia](https://github.com/WaleonGames/htgloggers/wiki) i [HTG Docs na temat HTGLoggers](https://htg-docs.gitbook.io/htg-docs/).

- experienced performance drops with the other versions
- don't want to "waste" storage space on texturepacks you might not use
- want the GUI and texture tweaks of "Sunfur Edit" but don't like the 3d models and/or custom sky

title: Custom Cartesians
description: View and Customise Critical Ingame Information!
body:
# Custom Cartesians



## About The Custom Cartesians Mod is a client-side only Minecraft Mod that allows you to view and customise critical in-game information. It adds an additional Coordinate Display HUD which can be customised to only display a specific coordinate axis. This can be useful in protecting ingame locations that are being shared publicly.  This HUD is non invasive to the vanilla F3 Debug screen and will hide itself when the vanilla GUI is used. The HUD can also be toggled off.  ## Features - Customisable and Toggleable Coordinate HUD - Customise Coordinate display - Config file - Compatibility with Cloth Config and ModMenu  - Keybindings for easy toggling of features. Keybinding actions will also sync to the Config file   ## Installation This mod is client-side only. Do not install this on dedicated servers. ## Dependencies - Fabric API (Required) - Cloth Config API (Required, Preinstalled in this mod) - Mod Menu API (Optional, install if you like an Ingame Config GUI) ## Usage ### Using the Config options 1. Open the Configuration File. This can be done via minecraft/config/customcartesians/client.toml or the Mods -> Custom Cartesians -> Configure Button if you have Mod Menu Installed. 2. Set the configuration option "toggleOverlay" to True. 3. Click "Save" in the File Editor program if you have opened the client.toml file. If you are using Mod Menu, click the "Save and Quit" button.  ### Using the Keybinds There are a number of keybinds provided by the mod which allow you to configure the mod easily. To toggle specific Coordinate displays, hold down the "Mod Base Setting" Keybind then press on the corresponding Keybind for the Coordinate. For example, to toggle the Y Coordinate, use "Left ALT + H" (By default)   ## Screenshots The Config GUI that is generated when Mod Menu is installed alongside this mod.

The HUD with only the Y coordinate shown

## Terms of Use General/distribution/mod packs: You are free to use this mod for personal use. You may use it for non-commercial public use as well, as long as you link back to this thread or CurseForge page and use official download links. If you wish to put this mod in a modpack that is redistributed commercially, please contact the owner about it so we can discuss this further. ### Modpacks You can use this mod in your modpack. You don’t have to ask for permission as long as you credit the author. You may not reupload this mod on other platforms. ### Licensing This project is licensed under GNU Public v3. More information about this license can be found in the License.MD file within the Github repository. You may NOT redistribute this mod by itself in a way that allows you to earn money off of it. These terms can be subject to change.   ## Issues Please report any issues to the issue tracker linked at the top of this page. ## Compatibility This mod will be available for Forge in the future as well. ## Planned Features - Ability to move the HUD to different screen positions - Provide more information on the HUD if needed. ## Credits Treblero, for the original idea

title: Potion Limiter
description: BLOCK POTION EFFECTS AND RECIPES!!!
body:
## Take full control of every potion on your server.

PotionLimiter lets you disable any potion in the game on a per-tier basis. Whether you want to ban Strength II in PvP, remove Instant Health from competitive play, or block all negative potions from being thrown at players — PotionLimiter handles it all with a single config toggle or a click in the GUI.

In-game GUI via `/potionlimiter ui` or `/pl ui` with live toggling — no restart needed.

Features:

- Individual on/off toggle for every potion in the game
- Blocks drinkable, splash, lingering, and tipped arrow variants
- `/pc reload` to apply config changes instantly

**No need to use the config.yml , do `/pl ui` or `/potionlimiter ui` and you can ban / allow potions from there , use the arrows in the ui to get to the different pages ( you can do either )**
