title: Apollo's Enchantment Rebalance
description: A thoughtful and thorough rebalance to the vanilla enchantments and their underlying systems.
body:
# Apollo's Enchantment Rebalance (AER)

This experimental mod is designed to alter and address issues with Minecraft's enchantment system. The enchanting system is flawed, but I do not believe its core mechanics are unsalvageable.

The goal of AER is to improve the enchanting experience while being **minimally destructive**. Only a handful of enchantments were either removed or entirely rebuilt with new names.

## Important Notes

This mod is **incomplete**! I still have changes and additions I plan to make, so this is by no means a finished product. It will likely remain in beta until at least the release of 1.22.

## Core Changes

<details>
<summary>Anvils</summary>
Repair costs have been greatly simplified.

- Renaming and repairing items is free.
- Enchanting an item with a normal enchantment costs 3 levels for each enchantment level added. Some examples of costs with this system:
  - Unenchanted sword + Sharpness 2 book would cost 6 levels (Sharpness 0 -> 2).
  - Efficiency 2 pickaxe + Efficiency 2 book would cost 3 levels (Efficiency 2 -> 3).
- Enchanting an item with a treasure enchantment costs 15 levels.
- The invisible `repair_cost` data on items that made repairing/enchanting them more expensive in the future is no longer used.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Grindstones</summary>
Across the board, grindstones give more XP for disenchanting items. Treasure enchantments now give a lot of bonus XP, making them useful to save up if you need a lot of XP in a pinch.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Enchanted Books</summary>
All enchantments on books have icons indicating what gear the enchantment can be applied to. For example, the Feather Falling enchantment uses a boots icon. 
  
- If the enchantment applies to multiple types of gear, it cycles through the icons one at a time. 
  
- If the enchantment applies to most gear/items like Unbreaking and Curse of Vanishing, it uses a book icon instead.


Enchanted books now stack to 16.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Enchantment Levels & Incompatibilities</summary>
The max level of each enchantment in vanilla is arbitrary and confusing to remember. AER simplifies this by making curses and treasure enchantments cap at 1 level and all other enchantments cap at 3 levels. Numerous enchantments have been altered to work with the 3-level max structure.


(*In the future, there may be some rare item/mechanic allowing you to unlock a level 4 enchantments. No promises, though.*)


In addition to this, the incompatibility mechanic has been modified. 
- There are **no** incompatibilities between non-treasure enchantments. 
- Only one treasure enchantment can be applied on an item.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Treasure Enchantments</summary>
Treasure enchantments now have a gold color! :3
</details>


## Gear Changes

These changes are relatively small and meant to supplement the enchanting changes.

<details>
<summary>Changes</summary>
  
- Golden tool durability increased from 32 to 120.

- Trident durability increased from 250 to 500.

- Horse armor has durability.

- Maces disable shields.

- Base shield downtime reduced from 5 to 1.5 seconds.

- Tridents have unlimited piercing through mobs.
</details>

## Individual Enchantment Changes

There's a lot of changes to get into.

Every enchantment with a ⭐ next to it is a treasure enchantment, being limited to 1 level and not being acquirable via the enchanting table.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Aqua Affinity</summary>

- Merged with Respiration.
- Each level increases submerged mining speed by 200%, with the max level being stronger than vanilla Aqua Affinity 1.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Bane of Arthropods</summary>

- Renamed to **Exterminator**.
- Removed original effect of increasing damage and applying effects to arthropods.
- When a mob is killed with Exterminator, nearby mobs of the same type get a short Slowness and Weakness effect, making them easier to attack.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Blast Protection</summary>

- Damage protection from explosions per level increased from 8% to 12%.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Breach</summary>

- Applicable to axes.
- Removed original effect of bypassing `15% * level` of armor.
- The victim's shield downtime is increased by `1 * level` seconds.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Channeling ⭐</summary>

- Effects apply in rain, not just thunderstorms.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Depth Strider ⭐</summary>

- Applicable only to leggings.
- Water movement speed is only 90% as efficient as vanilla's Depth Strider 3.
- Movement speed in fluids when travelling up/down without swimming significantly increased.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Efficiency</summary>

- Mining efficiency values adjusted to account for lower max level of 3. Efficiency 3 is equivalent to vanilla's Efficiency 5.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Feather Falling</summary>

- Prevents trampling of crops when jumping on them.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Fire Aspect</summary>

- Time victim is ignited reduced from `4 * level` seconds to `3 * level` seconds.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Fire Protection</summary>

- Renamed to **Fire Guard**.
- Applicable only to chestplates.
- Damage protection from fire per level increased from 8% to 12%.
- Burning time reduction increased from `15% * level` to `25% * level`.
- Fire overlay opacity is now decreased by `(20% * level) + 10%`, maxing out at 70% opacity reduction.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Flame</summary>

- Applicable to crossbows.
- Instead of igniting the victim for a consistent 5 seconds, burning time is `3 * level` seconds *minus the time the arrow spent flying*.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Fortune ⭐</summary>

- Fortune 1 is equivalent to vanilla's Fortune 3.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Frost Walker ⭐</summary>

- Frosted Ice spawns under the user's boots even while jumping, making sprint jumping while wearing them viable.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Impaling</summary>

- Damage increase against aquatic mobs changed to damage increase against anything when the trident is thrown.
- Damage increase reduced from `2.5 * level` to `2 * level`.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Infinity</summary>

- Applicable to crossbows.
- No longer literally infinite arrows provided you have a single arrow. The chance for projectiles to not be consumed when used is the same as Unbreaking: 50% on level 1, 66% on level 2, and 75% on level 3.
- Effect applies to all projectiles, not just normal arrows.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Knockback</summary>

- Applicable to axes, tridents, and maces.
- Knockback amount reduced from `1 * level` to `0.75 * level`.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Looting</summary>

- Applicable to axes, tridents, and maces.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Loyalty</summary>

- Return speed increased by one level compared to vanilla, e.g. Loyalty 2 is equivalent to vanilla's Loyalty 3.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Mending ⭐</summary>

- XP effectiveness in repairing durability halved.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Multishot</summary>

- Applicable to bows.
- Each level adds one projectile shot, with Multishot 3 shooting 4 projectiles.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Piercing</summary>

- Piercing amount raised from `1 * level` to `(2 * level) - 1`, making the Arbalistic advancement still obtainable.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Power</summary>

- Renamed to **Bolt**.
- Applicable to crossbows.
- Damage increase reduced from `(0.5 * level) + 0.5` to `0.4 * level`.
- Projectile uncertainly is reduced by `25% * level`.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Projectile Protection</summary>

- Renamed to **Projectile Plating**.
- Damage reduction from projectiles reduced from `8% * level` to `2% * level`.
- Knockback from projectiles is reduced by `12.5% * level`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Protection</summary>

- Damage reduction reduced from `4% * level` to `(2% * level) + 4%`, capping out at 40% damage reduction for a full set.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Punch</summary>

- Knockback amount reduced from `1 * level` to `0.75 * level`.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Respiration</summary>

- Removed.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Riptide</summary>

- No longer works in rain.
- Trident can be used as normal if Riptide wouldn't apply.
- Added a short grace period of a few ticks after leaving water where Riptide can still apply.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Sharpness</summary>

- Applicable to tridents.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Silk Touch ⭐</summary>

- No change except becoming a treasure enchantment.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Smite</summary>

- Renamed to **Reaper**.
- A short Wither effect is applied to undead mobs upon being hit.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Soul Speed ⭐</summary>

- Increases step height by 0.5 when active on soul sand/soil.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Swift Sneak ⭐</summary>

- *Slightly* more effective than vanilla's Swift Sneak 3.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Thorns</summary>

- Applicable only to chestplates.
- Damage against victim changed from a random value between 1 and 5 to a random value between 1 and `level`.
- On top of being damaged, the victim will receive a short Poison effect that deals an extra point of damage.
- Damage and poison effects will only apply if the damage against the chestplate wearer is direct. Ranged attacks will no longer trigger it from afar.
</details>

## Loot Changes

Random/generic enchanted books are sorted into two tiers: **weak** and **strong**.

- Weak books have 1-3 enchantments (favoring 1) at levels 1-3 (favoring 1). There is a 25% chance of rolling 1-2 treasures/curses on top of that.
- Strong books have 1-4 enchantments (favoring 2-3) at levels 1-3 (favoring 2). There is a 40% chance of rolling 1-2 treasures/curses on top of that.

The treasure enchantments that can be rolled in these books are Fortune, Silk Touch, Frost Walker, and Mending.

With all further entries, this is alongside removing the existing enchanted book rolls from the respective loot table.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Elder Guardian</summary>

- 40% chance of Depth Strider book
</details>

<details>
<summary>Ancient City</summary>

- 10% chance of generic strong book
- 20% chance of Swift Sneak book, 20% chance of being cursed
- 10% chance of Mending book, 20% chance of being cursed
</details>

<details>
<summary>Desert Temple</summary>

2 rolls of the following:
- 40% chance of nothing
- 20% chance of generic strong book
- 20% chance of Blast Protection 2-3 book
- 20% chance of Unbreaking 2-3 book
</details>

<details>
<summary>Dungeon</summary>

- 25% chance of generic weak book
- 50% chance of book with random levels of random combination of Fire Guard, Reaper, and Exterminor
</details>

<details>
<summary>Jungle Temple</summary>

2 rolls of the following:
- 40% chance of nothing
- 20% chance of generic strong book
- 20% chance of Thorns 2-3 book
- 20% chance of Unbreaking 2-3 book
</details>

<details>
<summary>Mineshaft</summary>

- 20% chance of generic weak book
- 20% chance of Efficiency 1-3 book
- 20% chance of Fortune book
</details>

<details>
<summary>Ocean Ruins</summary>

- 25% chance of generic weak book
- 25% chance of book with random levels of random combination of trident and fishing rod exclusive enchantments
</details>

<details>
<summary>Ominous Vaults</summary>

__Other book rolls are not removed!__

- ~25% chance of Wind Burst 1 book
</details>

<details>
<summary>Pillager Outpost</summary>

- 25% chance of generic strong book
- 25% chance of book with random levels of random combination of Quick Charge, Bolt, Infinity, and Piercing
</details>

<details>
<summary>Ruined Portal</summary>

- 33% chance of generic weak book
- 33% chance of Silk Touch book

In addition to the book rolls:

- 60% chance of 3-6 nether gold ore
</details>

<details>
<summary>Stronghold Corridor</summary>

- 20% chance of generic weak book
</details>

<details>
<summary>Stronghold Crossing</summary>

- 40% chance of undyed bundle
- 10% chance of generic strong book
</details>

<details>
<summary>Stronghold Library</summary>

2 rolls of the folloing:
- 40% chance of nothing
- 60% chance of generic strong book
</details>

<details>
<summary>Trial Chambers Supply</summary>

- 1-2 randomly colored bundles
</details>

<details>
<summary>Woodland Mansion</summary>

2 rolls of the following:

- 35% chance of randomly colored bundle
- 65% chance of generic book at a level above Strong.
  - 1-5 enchantments, all amounts have equal chance
  - Levels favor 2 and 3 over 1
  - 50% chance of rolling treasure or curse, favoring treasure
</details>

## Other Changes

- Added a supply room to trial chambers. It is a common room, but capped at one per structure. It has an anvil, a smithing table, a supply chest, and a hallway entrance/exit.

- Added an advancement for killing two fish with one trident throw, Spear Fishing.

title: ReviewX
description: A simple review plugin for players
body:
# ReviewX - Player Feedback System for Minecraft Servers

## Overview

ReviewX is a lightweight yet powerful plugin that transforms how server owners collect player feedback. By providing a familiar book interface for players to write reviews, server administrators can gather valuable insights about their server directly in-game without relying on external platforms.

## Key Features


### 🔖 In-Game Review System

ReviewX empowers your players to submit detailed feedback using Minecraft's native book interface. This seamless integration encourages more players to share their thoughts, as they don't need to leave the game or visit external websites.

### ⏱️ Balanced Cooldown System

To prevent spam or abuse, ReviewX implements a configurable cooldown system that limits how frequently players can request review books. Server administrators can adjust this cooldown period based on their community's needs or disable it entirely.

### 📚 Organized Storage

All submitted reviews are automatically saved to the plugin's "reviews" folder with timestamps and player information, making it easy to track feedback over time. Each review is stored in a separate text file with metadata including:

- Player name
- 
- Player UUID
- 
- Submission date and time
- 
- Complete review content

### 👑 Admin Management Tools

Server operators and staff with proper permissions gain access to powerful review management

commands:
- `/readreviews` - View the current review in the list
- 
- `/readreviews next` - Navigate to the next review
- 
- `/readreviews prev` - Go back to the previous review
- 
- `/readreviews list` - See all available reviews with their identifiers

### 📢 Staff Notifications

When enabled in the configuration, online staff members with the appropriate permission will receive notifications whenever a player submits a new review, ensuring important feedback doesn't go unnoticed.

### 🛡️ Permission-Based Access

ReviewX includes a comprehensive permissions system:

- `reviewx.use` - Allows players to request review books (default: true)
- 
- `reviewx.read` - Grants access to read submitted reviews (default: op)
- 
- `reviewx.nocooldown` - Bypasses the cooldown timer (default: op)

## Why Choose ReviewX?

### Enhances Player Engagement

By providing an in-game feedback mechanism, you show players that their opinions matter. This cultivates a stronger sense of community and investment in your server's development.

### Streamlines Feedback Collection

No more directing players to external Discord channels, forums, or websites. Collect all feedback in one place, right within Minecraft, where the experience is fresh in players' minds.

### Intuitive Interface

Players are already familiar with Minecraft's book interface, making the review process straightforward with no learning curve or complicated commands to remember.

### Lightweight & Resource-Efficient

ReviewX is designed to have minimal impact on server performance while providing maximum functionality. Reviews are stored as simple text files, ensuring the plugin remains lightweight regardless of how many reviews are submitted.

### Easy Implementation

With simple commands and a straightforward configuration file, ReviewX can be up and running on your server in minutes. No database setup or complex configuration required.

## Installation

1. Download the ReviewX plugin JAR file
2. 
2. Place it in your server's plugins folder
3. 
3. Restart your server or use a plugin manager to load it
4. 
4. Configure settings in the config.yml file if desired
5. 
5. Start collecting valuable player feedback!

## Usage


### For Players:

- Type `/review` to request a review book
- Write your feedback in the book
- Sign the book to submit your review

### For Admins:

- Use `/readreviews` to browse through submitted reviews
- 
- Reviews are automatically saved to the plugin's folder
- 
- Configure cooldown periods and notifications in the config.yml

---

Whether you're running a small community server or a large network, ReviewX provides the tools you need to gather and manage player feedback effectively. Start listening to your community today!

title: Cobblemon Scroll Cases
description: Adds CS:GO-style roulette cases for Cobblemon, with tiered Iron, Gold, and Diamond boxes, NPC trades, Pokemon rewards, and Cobblemon item drops.
body:
# Cobblemon Scroll Cases

Cobblemon Scroll Cases adds CS:GO-style roulette case opening to Cobblemon. Open Iron, Gold, and Diamond scroll cases to roll for Pokemon and Cobblemon items with animated spinning rewards.

## Features

- CS:GO-style roulette case opening GUI
- Three case tiers: Iron, Gold, and Diamond
- Separate reward pools for each case
- Pokemon rewards with randomized levels
- Cobblemon item rewards such as balls, candies, healing items, and rare items
- Scroll Trader NPC with villager trade GUI
- Rarity tiers:
  - **SSR** - Gold
  - **SR** - Purple
  - **R** - Blue
  - **N** - Normal

## How to Play

1. Install Fabric, Fabric API, and Cobblemon.
2. Add this mod to your `mods` folder.
3. Join your world or server.
4. Spawn the Scroll Trader with:

```mcfunction
/cobblescroll spawntrader


Trade with the NPC:

10 Iron Ingots = Iron Scroll Case
10 Gold Ingots = Gold Scroll Case
10 Diamonds = Diamond Scroll Case
Right-click a scroll case to open it.

Watch the roulette animation and receive your reward.

Case Types
Iron Scroll Case
Best for early gameplay. Contains normal Cobblemon items and common Pokemon, with pseudo-legendary Pokemon as rare SSR rewards.

Gold Scroll Case
A stronger mid-tier case. Rewards better Pokemon, higher levels, and better Cobblemon items than Iron.

Diamond Scroll Case
The rarest case. Contains rare Pokemon, high-level rewards, Master Balls, rare candies, and other valuable Cobblemon items.

Commands
/cobblescroll spawntrader
/cobblescroll givecase iron
/cobblescroll givecase gold
/cobblescroll givecase diamond
/cobblescroll preview iron
/cobblescroll preview gold
/cobblescroll preview diamond
/cobblescroll reload
Showcase Video
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kEbLKdYjCwg

Requirements
Minecraft 1.21.1
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Cobblemon

description: Transforms certain minecraft crafting into rituals featuring beautiful particle effects
body:
# 🔮 Rituals Plus

**Rituals Plus** transforms certain minecraft crafting into rituals featuring beautiful particle effects.

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 How It Works

1. **Create Ritual**: Use `/ritual create <id>` while holding an item
2. **Craft Normally**: Attempt to craft the ritual item at any crafting table
3. **Ritual Begins**: Particle effects and boss bar appear
4. **Wait and Watch**: Stay near the crafting table until ritual completes
5. **Receive Reward**: Item drops upon successful ritual completion

### 🎪 Ritual System
- **Crafting**: Convert any recipe into a timed ritual
- **Themes**: Choose from 8 unique particle themes:
  - **Default**: Red dust circle
  - **Soul Fire**: Soul fire flame circle with floating souls
  - **Nether Star**: Portal particles with white ash
  - **Electric**: Electric spark particles with lightning
  - **Moonlight**: Soft white and blue glowing particles
  - **Lava Falls**: Flowing lava with fire effects
  - **Sculk Growth**: Sculk sensor effects
  - **Frost Circle**: Ice and snow winter effects
  - **Ancient Rune**: Magical runic patterns

### ⚙️ Customization
- **Editor**: Beautiful inventory interface for managing rituals
- **Settings**: Adjust duration, circle radius, and themes per ritual
- **Creation**: Create rituals for any item with simple commands
- **Config**: All rituals save automatically between restarts

### 🔧 Features
- **Crafting Tables**: Prevents breaking tables during active rituals
- **Cross-World Support**: Works in all dimensions and worlds

## 🎮 Commands

- `/ritual create <id>` - Create ritual for held item
- `/ritual edit` - Open ritual management GUI
- `/ritual stop` - Stop your current ritual

title: No Trades
description: Restricting villager trading. Fully configurable via Mod Menu with per-profession whitelisting.
body:
# No Trades

**No Trades** is a lightweight utility mod designed to fix the progression balance in Minecraft by restricting villager trading.

Villager trading often bypasses the core gameplay loop, allowing players to obtain end-game gear (like Mending books or Diamond armor) too early. This mod gives server admins and modpack creators full control over this mechanic.

## Features

*   **Complete Control:** Globally disable trading interactions with Villagers and Wandering Traders.
*   **Hybrid Logic:**
    *   **Server-side:** Enforces the rule securely. Hackers or players without the mod cannot bypass the restriction.
    *   **Client-side:** Improves UX by preventing the interaction animation (hand swing) and GUI opening entirely.
*   **Granular Configuration:** Don't want to ban trading completely? Use the **Whitelist** feature to allow specific professions (e.g., allow Butchers but ban Librarians).
*   **Mod Menu Integration:** Easily toggle professions ON/OFF via a user-friendly settings screen. No manual config editing required.

## Configuration

You can customize:
*   **Global Toggle:** Turn the mod on/off instantly.
*   **Wandering Trader:** Allow or disallow trades with the Wandering Trader separately.
*   **Profession Exceptions:** A dynamic list of all registered professions (including modded ones). Simply toggle the ones you want to allow.
  ![Mod_Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33e96f82bc2628535128de35ceb7da3041aaac4a_0.webp)

## Compatibility

This mod works seamlessly on:
*   **Singleplayer:** For self-imposed challenges.
*   **Multiplayer:** As a server-side enforcement tool (players do not strictly need the mod installed, but it is recommended for the best experience).

When killed, honey slimes can drop honey clumps which can be crafted into a honey clump block or smelted into a crystallized honey brick. Honey clump blocks can be smelted into honey blocks. Crystallized honey bricks can be used to create brick blocks, stairs, slabs, walls, and a chiseled brick variant. title: RealPermissions
description: GUI Permission Management made easy.
body:
# RealPermissions Plugin

Welcome to the **RealPermissions** plugin page!  
RealPermissions is a brand-new GUI-based permissions management plugin.

## Statistics  
[Plugin Statistics on bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/RealPermissions/19519)

## Found an Issue?  
Report it [here](https://github.com/joserodpt/RealPermissions/issues) or message me on Discord.  

**Discord:** [Join the Discord Server](https://discord.gg/SK7M7f2Yk)

## Features  
- **Integration with RealScoreboard, RealMines, RealRegions, and RealSkywars!**  
- **Integration with Plugin Permissions** installed on the server.  
- **YAML Configuration** for easy setup and customization.  
- **Simple and Performant GUI Interface** for intuitive management.  
- **Powerful Command Syntax** for advanced control.  
- **Timed Rank Support** for temporary rank assignments.  
- **Permission Inheritance Support** for streamlined management.  
- **Tab and Chat Customization** per rank.  
- **Rankup Command** for smooth rank progression.  
- **Plugin Settings via GUI** for easy configuration.

## Commands & Permissions  

All main plugin commands require the `realpermissions.admin` permission.  

### Command List

1. **Default Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions` or `/rp`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Opens the RealPermissions GUI for managing permissions and ranks. If used by the console, displays plugin information.

2. **Reload Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions reload` or `/rp rl`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Reloads configuration files, including language settings, ranks, and player data.

3. **Rank Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions rank <rank>` or `/rp r <rank>`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Opens the Rank GUI for the specified rank to manage permissions and members.

4. **Players Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions players` or `/rp p`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Opens the Players GUI to manage player-specific permissions and ranks.

5. **Ranks Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions ranks`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Lists all available ranks with their prefixes or opens the RankViewer GUI for players.

6. **Set Superuser Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions setsuper <player>` or `/rp setsu <player>`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Toggles superuser status for the specified player.

7. **Set Rank Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions set <player> <rank>` or `/rp s <player> <rank>`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Assigns the specified rank to a player.

8. **Set Timed Rank Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions settimedrank <player> <rank> <duration>` or `/rp str`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Assigns a timed rank to a player for the specified duration in seconds.

9. **Clear Timed Rank Command**
   - **Command:** `/realpermissions cleartimedrank <player>` or `/rp ctr`  
   - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
   - **Description:** Clears the timed rank for the specified player.

10. **Rename Rank Command**
    - **Command:** `/realpermissions rename <rank> <new name>` or `/rp ren`  
    - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
    - **Description:** Renames the specified rank to a new name.

11. **Delete Rank Command**
    - **Command:** `/realpermissions delete <rank>` or `/rp del <rank>`  
    - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
    - **Description:** Deletes the specified rank, except for the default rank.

12. **Manage Rank Permissions Command**
    - **Command:** `/realpermissions permission <add/remove> <rank> <permission>` or `/rp perm`  
    - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
    - **Description:** Adds or removes a permission node from a rank.

13. **Manage Player Permissions Command**
    - **Command:** `/realpermissions playerperm <add/remove> <player> <permission>` or `/rp pperm`  
    - **Permission:** `realpermissions.admin`  
    - **Description:** Adds or removes a permission node for a specific player.

## PlaceholderAPI Placeholders  

- **%realpermissions_rank_name%** – Returns the player's rank name.  
- **%realpermissions_rank_prefix%** – Returns the player's rank prefix.  
- **%realpermissions_rank_permission_count%** – Returns the number of permissions assigned to the rank.  
- **%realpermissions_timed_rank_time_left%** – Returns the remaining time for the player's timed rank.  
- **%realpermissions_player_permission_count%** – Returns the total permissions count for the player.

## Support  
If you encounter any issues, contact me via DM on Here or join the Discord server.

## Like the Plugin?  
Don't forget to give it a **heart**!

title: NotHunt - No Compass Manhunt!
description: Minecraft Manhunt, Tracker over all dimensions (even The End), Alerts, Multiple runners, Numerous Objectives, Tweaks, WHAT ELSE DO YOU WANT?
body:
# NotHunt Datapack

A comprehensive Minecraft manhunt datapack with extensive customization options, multiple game modes, and advanced tracking features.

---

## 📥 Installation

1. Download the datapack
2. Navigate to your Minecraft world's datapacks folder:
   - `.minecraft/saves/[Your World Name]/datapacks/`
3. Place the `NotHunt` folder into the datapacks directory
4. Load or reload your world

### Loading the Datapack

If the world is already running, reload the datapack using:
```
/reload
```

You'll see a yellow message in chat: "NotHunt Loaded. Click to open settings menu and start another game!"

---

## ⚙️ Configuration & Settings

### Opening the Settings Menu

Only operators (OPs) can configure the datapack. To open the settings menu:
```
/function nothunt:settings
```

This will display an interactive menu in chat where you can configure all game settings by clicking on options.

---

## 🎮 Game Settings Overview

### **Runners Objective**
Choose what the runners must accomplish to win:

- **Kill the Ender Dragon** *(Default)* - Classic manhunt where runners must defeat the Ender Dragon
- **Get a Diamond** - Runners win when one player obtains a diamond
- **Go to the Nether** - Runners win when one player enters the Nether
- **Survivor** - Runners must survive for a set amount of time

### **Game Timer**
Set a time limit for completing objectives (except Survivor mode):
- **Disabled** - No time limit
- **5, 10, 20, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, or 180 minutes**

If runners don't complete their objective within the time limit, hunters win.

*Note: In Survivor mode, this setting determines how long runners must survive.*

### **Choose Runners Randomly**
Automatically select runners at the start of the game:
- **Disabled** - Manually choose runners
- **1-20 runners** - Randomly select this many players to be runners

### **Glow Hunters When They're Close**
- **Enabled**: Hunters glow (visible through walls) when within 15 blocks of a runner
- **Disabled**: No glowing effect

### **Alert Runners When Hunters Are Close**
- **Enabled**: Runners receive a chat alert when hunters are within 20 blocks
- **Disabled**: No alerts

### **Hunters Boost**
Give hunters a permanent effect throughout the game:
- None
- Fast Swimming (Dolphin's Grace)
- Fire Resistance
- Haste (faster mining)
- Invisibility
- Jump Boost
- Night Vision
- Water Breathing
- Double Hearts (40 hearts instead of 20)
- Speed Boost

### **Runners Boost**
Give runners a permanent effect throughout the game (same options as Hunters Boost)

### **Hunters Countdown**
Freeze hunters at the start to give runners a head start:
- **Disabled** - Hunters can move immediately
- **15 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute, 5 minutes, or 10 minutes**

### **Runners Lives**
Number of times each runner can die before being eliminated:
- **1-5 lives**

---

## 👥 Managing Players

### Adding Players to the Match

#### **Automatic Selection**
If "Choose Runners Randomly" is enabled in settings, runners will be selected automatically when the match starts.

#### **Manual Selection**

1. After configuring settings, click **[Done]** in the settings menu
2. The game will enter preparation mode
3. Players can join as runners using the trigger command:
   ```
   /trigger JoinRunners
   ```

4. **Operators** can manually add players as runners:
   ```
   /execute as <PlayerName> run trigger JoinRunners
   ```
   Example:
   ```
   /execute as Steve run trigger JoinRunners
   ```

5. Once all runners are selected, start the match:
   ```
   /function nothunt:preparation/start
   ```

### Team Assignment

- **Runners** - Players who must complete the objective
- **Hunters** - All other players who joined the match (not selected as runners)
- **Spectators** - Players who join after the match starts or were not added to the match

### Removing Players

To remove a runner during preparation phase, they can use:
```
/execute as PlayerName run function nothunt:preparation/leaverunners
```
This toggles their runner status.

---

## 🧭 In-Game Compasses (Hunter Tracking)

Hunters have access to a powerful tracking system to locate runners.

### **How to Use Tracking**

Hunters can track specific runners using the compass system:

1. **Open tracking menu**:
   ```
   /trigger Track
   ```

2. **Select a runner** - Click on a runner's name in chat to track them

3. **Switch targets** - Use `/trigger Track` again to change which runner you're tracking

### **Toggle HUD**

Runners can toggle their HUD on/off:
```
/trigger Hud
```

---

## 🏁 Ending a Match

### **Manual End**

Operators can manually end the match at any time:
```
/function nothunt:endmatch
```

### **Automatic Win Conditions**

The match ends automatically when:

**Runners Win:**
- All runners complete the objective (Kill Dragon/Get Diamond/Enter Nether)
- Runners survive the timer in Survivor mode
- In timed modes, if at least one runner is alive when time runs out (unless objective-specific)

**Hunters Win:**
- All runners are eliminated (die more times than their life count)
- Time runs out before runners complete their objective (in timed modes)

---

## 🔧 Troubleshooting

### The datapack isn't working
1. Make sure you have operator permissions
2. Run `/reload` to reload the datapack
3. Check that the datapack is in the correct folder

### Players can't join as runners
1. Ensure the match hasn't started yet
2. Make sure players have the trigger permission enabled
3. Try using the manual command: `/execute as <Player> run trigger JoinRunners`

### Compass not working
1. Make sure you're a hunter (not a runner or spectator)
2. Use `/trigger Track` to initialize tracking
3. Ensure there are runners in the match

### Game won't start
1. Ensure at least one runner is selected
2. Run `/function nothunt:preparation/start` after selecting runners
3. Check that you completed the settings configuration

---

## 📝 Commands Reference

| Command | Who Can Use | Description |
|---------|------------|-------------|
| `/function nothunt:settings` | OPs only | Open settings menu |
| `/reload` | OPs only | Reload the datapack |
| `/trigger JoinRunners` | All players | Join runners team (preparation phase) |
| `/trigger Track` | Hunters | Open runner tracking menu |
| `/trigger Hud` | Runners | Toggle HUD display |
| `/function nothunt:preparation/start` | OPs only | Start the match |
| `/function nothunt:endmatch` | OPs only | End the current match |

title: Divinity Engine
description: Divinity Engine is a modular Minecraft framework that brings gods, blessings, curses, and divine favor into gameplay.
body:
**Divinity Engine** is a powerful and expandable Minecraft modding framework that brings an entire pantheon of gods—and their divine systems—into the game. Designed for both players and mod developers, this mod transforms the survival experience into a realm of faith, favor, and divine consequence.

In this framework, players can **form bonds with powerful gods**, perform rituals at their shrines, earn favor through god-aligned actions, and gain access to powerful **blessings**. These blessings grant both passive and active abilities—from radiant explosions and water dashes to beast tracking and ghostly movement—each themed uniquely to their deity. But power comes at a price. Players who neglect their gods or act against them may find themselves **cursed**, suffering divine retribution with effects as creative as they are punishing.

Shrines to each god are spread across the **Overworld, Nether, and End**, and every interaction—from gaining favor to activating blessings—must be done in front of a shrine, reinforcing a ritualistic style of play. Favor is tracked individually per god, encouraging commitment, loyalty, and intentional play.

For modders, Divinity Engine is fully **extensible**. The core mod provides the shrine system, favor tracking, blessing loadouts (max 3 active at once), and curse mechanics, but leaves god definitions and shrine structures open for **addons to register custom pantheons**. Whether you're adding a single deity or a whole mythos, integration is seamless.

---

## 🔧 Core Features

- **Favor System**: Earn or lose favor with individual gods through shrine-based actions.
- **Blessings**: Equip up to 3 at a time—passive and active divine powers with unique gameplay effects.
- **Curses**: Fall too far into disfavor, and suffer thematic, gameplay-altering punishments.
- **Shrine Interactions**: Worship and divine interactions happen *only* at shrines—emphasizing location, ritual, and devotion.
- **Modular Design**: Gods, blessings, curses, and shrines are all addon-compatible. Other devs can create and register their own gods and structures.
- **Lore-Friendly Design**: Each god has a personality, flavor text, quotes, and thematic alignment to build immersive pantheons.
- **Blessing Loadout System**: Players can only have 3 blessings active at a time, promoting balance and strategy.
- **Dimension-Based Shrines**: Gods reside in different vanilla dimensions (Overworld, Nether, End), making exploration part of divine discovery.

---

Whether you want to become a **Champion of the Sun**, a **Beast-bound hunter**, or a **Fate-marked trickster**, *Divinity Engine* opens the door to a deeper, more dynamic Minecraft experience where **faith shapes fate**—and gods are watching.

A mod to port pause-while-empty-seconds server property to older versions.
Unlike some other mods, executeing commands while the server is paused still works.

When the server is paused the world tick gets skiped, after unpausing evereything continues as usual. It save peformance if the server has a lot chunk loaders.

#### Easy configuration with commands:

- `/pause status` - shows if pausing is enabled and the delay.
- `/pause set delay <secconds>` - sets the delay after which the server is paused.
- `/pause set enabled <true/false>` - turn pausing on and off.
- `/pause reload` - reload the config from file.

**You can configure every setting individually in `auto-pause.json`**

title: No Spoiler Recipe Book
description: A Minecraft datapack that makes the recipe book give you the recipe only after you craft the item for the first time.
body:
Do you think that Minecraft is better experienced by discovering every crafting recipe by yourself and that the Recipe Book ruins the experience by giving away all the recipes in the world when you collect an item from the ground? Worry not, with this datapack you won't have to worry about getting spoilers!

This datapack changes the recipe book to only show a recipe when you craft the corresponding item, if you smelt your first iron, for example, you won't unlock the flint and steel recipe, but you'll also have to find flint and craft it, only then you will be able to see the recipe in the book.

If you already have started a world and you want to use the datapack, open your world to LAN enabling cheats (if you don't have them already enabled) and use the command ```/recipe take your_username *``` to delete all your unlocked recipes, this way you will start fresh!

I created this pack because of a Twitch streamer that started playing the game blind, and he refused to use the book in order to have the most immersive experience. I thought "Wait, there are no mods that make the recipe book show only what you already crafted?" and to my disbelief no one made something similar! So I learnt how to create datapacks and here we are.

This datapack is fully open source, on GitHub you can find the script I created to automate the process and the instructions to port the datapack to your desired version. You are freely allowed to make your own version of the datapack for every version of the game that you wish for and upload them online (you don't have to give me credit, but if you do I will appreciate it :)

Note: this is for the vanilla game, if you want to use it with another datapack you'll have to convert the datapack's recipes with the script on GitHub.

# Cluckifer (Quilt/Fabric/NeoForge)  
Cluckifer is a fork of [Fleecifer](https://modrinth.com/mod/fleecifer), but it makes chickens hostile instead of sheep.  

## Mod Requirements  
- [Quilt Loader](https://quiltmc.org/) (Recommended)

- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/)

## FAQ
- **I've got another mod that changes chicken behavior, is this compatible?**
    - Cluckifer has not been tested with other mods that change chicken behavior, you may experience issues under this circumstance.
- **Can I use this in a modpack or video?**
    - Yes, you can use this mod in modpacks or videos.
- **Will you backport this mod?**
    - I am unlikely to port to specific versions, as this mod was made for fun. However, other developers are free to port this mod, as long as they adhere to the conditions of the LGPL-3.0-or-later license.
- **Can I remove the re-texturing of the chicken?**
    - The eyes are separate textures located at `cluckifer:textures/entity/chicken/chicken_eyes.png`, and `cluckifer:textures/entity/chicken/chicken_eyes_emissive.png`, which you could replace with blank textures using a resource pack.

title: Infection
description: Infection is a datapack which adds an infection to the game, a new challenge that makes harder to survive.
body:
Infection is a datapack which adds an infection to the game, a new challenge that makes harder to survive.

Effect

This new effect can affect you at any time if you are not wearing a face mask. It reduces the movement speed, the attack damage, the attack speed and deals constant damage (the armor protects it). The only way to heal it is by eating a honey stew or dying, that is, milk does not work with this effect. It has its own behavior depending on the dimension and how long the player has been infected.

Overworld:
  • 1 min = -20% movement speed & -20% attack damage.
  • 2.5 min = 1 point of damage (3 sec).
  • 7 min = -50% attack speed, -40% movement speed & 2 points of damage (2 sec).
  • 12 min = -40% attack damage & 4 points of damage (1.5 sec).
The Nether:
  • 1.5 min = -30% attack damage, -30% movement speed, -50% attack speed & 4 points of damage (2 sec).
  • 5 min = -50% attack speed, -50% movement speed & 9 points of damage (1.5 sec).
The End:
  • 1 min = -30% movement speed, -30% attack damage & 6 points of damage (2 sec).
  • 6 min = -40% movement speed, -50% attack speed, blindness & 10 points of damage (1.5 sec).
  • 12 min = -60% movement speed, -60% attack damage & 14 points of damage (1.5 sec).
Other dimensions: Same as the overworld.

Grace Period

Is a period of time during which you can't be infected. There is both global and individual grace pediod.

  • Global: 25 minutes from the creation of the world or the installation of the datapack.
  • Individual: 5 minutes per player, resets on death.

Face Mask

This new item is necessary wear to avoid getting infected. It has no armor points, it can't be re-dyed and the armor trims aren't seen on them. It has 80 durability, but loses 1 every 2.5 minutes. It can be crafted with any wool and two strings. If you try to dye a face mask or apply a trim on them, you will simply lose material. DON'T DO IT.

The zombies, husks, drowneds, skeletons, strays, piglins and zombified piglins have a chance to spawn with a random color face mask.

Honey Stew

It is a new stew based on medieval medicines, which were made with flowers and honey. It is crafted with a suspicious stew and 4 honey bottles. The only way to remove the infection from the player without dying, is by eating the honey stew, with a 40% chance of effectiveness. Also by eating it, you will lose all the negative effects you have, like an intermediate between the milk bucket and the honey bottle.

Advancements

  • Adventure → Safety Over Style: Obtain a Face Mask
  • Husbandry → Bee Our Guest → The Sweetest Stew: Eat a Honey Stew

Warning

Optifine is recomended for a better experience with the datapack, but it's not totally necesary. However, the resource-pack is totally necesary.

Credits

  • Ándogo_Myler for creating the texture of the effect.
  • Torrezx for helping to create the gallery images.
  • Minho for beta-testing.

body:
# Disable Back Perspective

A client-side Minecraft mod for Fabric that **disables the back perspective** (the camera facing the back of the player's head). This can be toggled with a keybind.

## Installation

1. Install **Fabric Loader**.  
2. Place the mod `.jar` in your `mods` folder, alongside **Fabric API**.  
3. Launch Minecraft with Fabric.

## Usage

- The mod is **active by default**, meaning you can only switch between **first-person** and **third-person front** (camera facing the player's face) perspectives using Vanilla's "Toggle Perspective" keybind.  
- You can toggle the mod on or off with a keybind (default: `\`).  
- The keybind can be changed in Minecraft's settings.

## Notes

- **Client-side only** — safe to join any server (vanilla, modded, Paper, etc.).  
- Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

title: Salt's Inventory Update
description: A complete overhaul of the minecraft inventory system. Turning every container into a window, where multiple can be open at the same time.
body:
# Salt's Inventory Update

**Salt's Inventory Update is early in development.** Please report any issues you find, especially UI bugs, item movement problems, multiplayer weirdness, or compatibility issues.

Salt's Inventory Update reworks Minecraft inventory management into a flexible desktop-style interface. Instead of every container taking over the whole screen and repeating your player inventory underneath it, inventories open as separate movable windows that can stay on screen together.

![mutiple chests open at one time](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/933d2a9239a50fee4eb8e202b122e51c3ce839f0.png)

## Desktop-Style Inventory Windows

Containers, your player inventory, creative inventory, and character controls open as individual windows. Windows can be moved, minimized, focused, pinned, locked, and, where supported, resized.

This makes it easier to compare inventories, move items between containers, keep useful windows nearby, and organize your screen around the way you actually play.

![Chest open and a stone cutter open](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/120e65b09b84b770020f2b05ee90cd067cec52fb.png)

## A Cleaner Player Inventory

The player inventory is split away from container screens. Your main inventory appears as its own window, while the hotbar stays as the actual hotbar on the HUD instead of being duplicated inside every inventory screen.

The result is less repeated UI, more usable screen space, and a more natural workflow when moving items between storage, tools, and your active hotbar.

## Interactive Hotbar And Offhand

When the Salt desktop is active, the real hotbar becomes interactive. You can move items into, out of, and around the hotbar directly, and the offhand slot is also available beside it.

You can also hold `Alt` with no inventory windows open to interact with the hotbar using the mouse.

![Hovering over an item in the Hotbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af42081e77bc109e89813cb53fe41765d0b72fda.png)

## Character Window

Armor, player preview, health, hunger, XP, potion effects, and the 2x2 crafting grid are moved into a dedicated Character Window opened with `C`.

This keeps the main inventory focused on storage while still giving you quick access to equipment, status, and small crafting.

![Character window and Inventory window](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fdfa1efb7a2bddb23435554166aa0b22e4d98af0.png)

## Optional Expandable Inventory

Salt's Inventory Update includes an optional expandable inventory system. When enabled in the config, players can spend XP levels to unlock extra inventory slots over time.

Extra slots save with the player, sync in multiplayer, and behave like real inventory storage for item movement, searching, dropping, and clearing.

## Move While Managing Inventory

The inventory desktop is designed to feel less like a full pause screen. You can keep windows open while still moving around, and hold `Alt` to give the mouse back to camera control when needed.

This is especially useful when sorting loot, working around storage rooms, or managing items while staying aware of the world.

## Pinning, Ghost Pins, And Saved Layouts

Windows can be pinned so they reopen where you left them. Optional ghost pins let windows collapse into translucent previews instead of disappearing completely, making frequently used containers easier to return to.

Window positions, sizes, lock states, and pin modes are saved per world or server.

![ghost pin preview over the world](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7e79607a37db0969c02358c25c42dcdc1ccf9e8.png)

## Configurable Experience

The mod includes an in-game config screen available through:

- `/saltsinventory config`
- `/salts_inventory config`
- Mod Menu on Fabric

You can toggle the mod, enable expandable inventory, change window placement behavior, allow resizing, enable snapping, configure ghost pins, adjust ghost opacity, and tune the hold-to-close-all timing.

## Compatibility And API

Salt's Inventory Update includes a desktop window API for other developers who want to make their own container UIs compatible with Salt's window system.

The API lets mods register custom desktop windows, render their own UI inside Salt windows, handle custom inputs, sync server payloads, use virtual item grids, support resizing, and save per-window state.

API docs: https://salt-and-fries.github.io/Salt-s-Inventory-Update/

Developers are encouraged to try the API and report anything that makes compatibility difficult.

## JEI Compatibility

When Just Enough Items is installed, Salt adds a dedicated JEI desktop window opened with `H`. It keeps JEI browsing inside Salt's movable window system instead of sending you back to a full-screen menu.

The JEI window supports JEI search syntax, ingredient tabs, Favorites, Recent lookups, recipe and uses pages, category and crafting-station tabs, recipe history, `R`/`U` hover lookups, bookmarks, and Move Items buttons for compatible open Salt crafting windows.

![Item List Menu JEI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/433b260c5eff86e565393bdd8190d1dd24528ef9.png)
![Uses Screen JEI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3350d97e78d816803eb66691a0e790c603360d99.png)

## Mod Compatibility

Salt's Inventory Update includes built-in compatibility work for Tom's Simple Storage, including desktop-style support for storage terminals, crafting terminals, filters, links, emitters, and filing cabinets.

Unsupported modded screens should fall back to their normal UI instead of being forced into a Salt window.

## Multiplayer Notes

For multiplayer, Salt's desktop features need server-side support from the mod. If a remote server does not support Salt desktop networking, the mod will disable the desktop behavior for that server instead of trying to desync inventory state.

## Why Use It?

Salt's Inventory Update is for players who want inventory management to feel more flexible, persistent, and powerful. It helps when organizing storage, comparing containers, crafting, managing equipment, and moving items around without constantly reopening full-screen menus.

title: Better Furnace Minecarts
description: Give the Furnace Minecart a second life! Control your ride with a custom GUI, parking brakes, and directional boosts.
body:
🚂 Better Furnace Minecarts

Better Furnace Minecarts transforms the often-ignored vanilla furnace minecart into a fully controllable, miniature steam locomotive. Stop throwing coal at a wooden box and start managing your rail system like a real engineer!


✨ Features

**Custom GUI**: No more accidental fueling! Right-click any furnace minecart to open its control panel and manage its internal inventory.

**Parking Brake**: Use the integrated Brake system to lock your minecart in place. Perfect for parking at stations or loading resources without the cart rolling away.

**Directional Boost**: Forget unpredictable movement. Face the direction you want to travel and hit the BOOST! button to launch your locomotive exactly where you need it to go.

**Auto-Refuel System**: The cart features a dedicated fuel slot. It will automatically "consume" coal or charcoal from its internal inventory as long as the brake is released.

**Immersive Experience:**

**Visuals**: A working furnace flame animation in the GUI shows you exactly when your engine is running.

**Sound**: Custom sound effects including steam hisses, fire crackling, and rhythmic rail-riding sounds for that authentic steam train vibe.




⚙️ Compatibility & Technicals

**Fabric 1.20.1**: Designed specifically for modern Fabric setups.

**Multiplayer / Server Ready**: Fully synchronized. Multiple players can view the GUI, see fuel levels, and hear the sounds simultaneously.

**Modpack & Create Friendly**:

**The Shift-Bypass**: Need to use a Create Mod Wrench or attach a Coupler? Simply Sneak (Shift) + Right-click to bypass the custom GUI and interact with the minecart using other mods' tools.

**Physics**: Works alongside other rail mods without crashing.



📖 **How to use**
1. Place a Furnace Minecart on a rail.
2. Right-click it to open the menu.
3. Place Coal or Charcoal into the fuel slot.
4. Toggle the Brake to "Ready".
5. Look in your desired direction and press BOOST!.
6. _Optional_: To use Create Mod couplings or wrenches, hold Shift while right-clicking.


🛠 **Installation**

1. Make sure you have the Fabric Loader and Fabric API installed.
2. Drop the .jar file into your mods folder.
3. Enjoy your new locomotive!

Sword that cuts Everything adds a new weapon. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-6572, also known as the Sword that cuts Everything.

title: Fast Async Backups
description: A simple async world backup mod for neoforge which is compactible with sable (create & addons + aeronautics) c2me, scalableLux
body:
# World Backup

Simple, reliable world backups at the press of a key — or the tip of a command.

Ever had your world corrupted by a rogue mod, a power outage, or just a bad decision with WorldEdit? **World Backup** lets you create instant, compressed zip backups of your entire world folder with a single command. Backups run asynchronously so your server never freezes, and automatic rotation keeps your disk from filling up.

---

## ✨ Features

- **Instant backups** — Create a full `.zip` backup of your world with `/backup <name>`
- **Non-blocking** — Backups run on a separate thread; your server stays responsive
- **Automatic rotation** — Old backups are pruned automatically based on a configurable limit
- **Configurable** — Set your backup limit via command or JSON config file
- **Safe by default** — Name validation prevents path traversal attacks
- **Conflict-friendly** — Copies your world to a temp directory first, then zips from the clean copy. Files locked by other mods (Sable, etc.) are retried automatically with increasing backoff.
- **Server-wide broadcast** — All players see backup progress and completion messages

---

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/backup <name>` | Creates a timestamped zip backup with the given name |
| `/backuplimit <number>` | Sets the maximum number of backups to keep (1–1000) |

**Examples:**

```
/backup before-portal          →  before-portal_2025-06-03_21-30-00.zip
/backup vanilla-test           →  vanilla-test_2025-06-03_21-31-15.zip
/backuplimit 25                →  Sets the rotation limit to 25 backups
```

All players can use these commands by default — no operator permissions required.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

The backup limit is stored in `backup/backup_config.json` inside your server directory. It is created automatically on first use and can be edited directly:

```json
{
  "backupLimit": 10
}
```

The limit can also be changed in-game with `/backuplimit <number>`.

---

## 📁 Where are backups stored?

Backups are saved to the `backup/` folder inside your server directory (next to your world folders). Each backup is a compressed `.zip` file named in the format:

```
<name>_<YYYY-MM-DD_HH-mm-ss>.zip
```

---

## 🔄 Compatibility

World Backup is designed to coexist peacefully with other mods:

- **Sable** — Fully compatible. World files are copied to a temporary directory before zipping, so Sable's file locks don't interfere. Retried up to 5 times with increasing backoff.
- **Ice and Fire, Dread Land, and other dimension mods** — All sub-levels and custom dimensions are backed up.
- **Any file-locking mod** — The copy-first strategy combined with retry logic handles files locked by other mods without skipping data.
- **Any world type** — Works with vanilla, modded, and custom world formats.

---

## 🛠 Technical Details

- **Copy-first strategy** — World folder is copied to a temp directory using `Files.copy` (path-to-path), which on Windows uses the `CopyFileEx` API to handle locked files
- Backups flush all chunks to disk before copying (`saveAllChunks`)
- Asynchronous execution via `CompletableFuture` — no server tick lag
- Automatic retry with backoff (up to 5 attempts) for temporarily locked files
- Temp directory is cleaned up automatically after backup completes (even on failure)
- Backup rotation deletes the oldest files first by modification time
- Safe filename validation: only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores allowed

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Install NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.1+
2. Drop `worldbackup-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods/` folder
3. Start the server — backups are ready to go

No configuration needed to get started. Just `/backup my-backup` and you're set.

title: SSC Perma Form Storage
description: Addon for Shape Shifter Curse. Undo permanent transformations and store them in items to reuse later!
body:
This mod adds items that allow you to undo permanent transformations as well as collect them for later reuse! You can also share and trade them with other players! Everything is done through simple crafting and eating of items.

**Requires: [Shape Shifter Curse](https://modrinth.com/mod/shape-shifter-curse)**

[![Shape Shifter Curse](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d375be9e551322f75ad2897f424e63154ffbe680.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/shape-shifter-curse)

## Undo permanent form and store it:

### Craft an Empty Gilded Echo Shard
All crafting is done on a **Smithing Table**. The recipes are:
- Morphscale Core + Echo Shard + Gold Block
- Morphscale Core + Cracked Echo Shard + Gold Ingot

You will receive an Empty **Gilded Echo Shard** that can be eaten.

Naturally, you'll need to acquire at least one Echo Shard to get started, but the alternative recipe provides a way to reuse the same Gilded Echo Shard again and again without needing to hunt down another Echo Shard. However, owning several Gilded Echo Shards will allow you to store many forms at the same time.

![recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/157abab5b561cdc8ce3f2afd478ce3ad8ac8f9bf.png)

### Eat the Empty Gilded Echo Shard
You must be in a permanent form.

You will transform back into a human and receive a **Gilded Echo Shard** that contains the permanent form you just had and can be kept for later. Any player can use it, so it can be given away, traded, or even stolen if you don't protect it.

![undo transformation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/097041e8712491856425dc1185881236637ef740.png)

![shard storing the form](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0850033dc303d3ee8a697fecde0bb392ebb3293f.png)

## Regain the stored form:

### Eat a Gilded Echo Shard that stores a form
You must be a human.

You will transform into the permanent form stored in the Shard and receive a **Cracked Gilded Echo Shard**. You can use it to make a new Empty Gilded Echo Shard without needing to sacrifice another Echo Shard.

![reuse transformation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78551ca7d0d6d486a5d1fe3f858dee967e58e810.png)

![cracked shard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ca614900226d3ce1bbb5212a439ebf0f8da0c76.png)

# The lore
I tried to conform to Shape Shifter Curse's lore as best as I could based on what I know about how it works. In the original mod, gold is used to counteract the curses' effects (through Golden Apples), while the Echo Shard is used to reach the final permanent forms.

In this mod, Echo Shards and gold are combined to make both undoing and regaining permanent forms possible. The Echo Shard is used to extract and trap the curses for later use, while the gold is the catalyst that gives the Echo Shard this power.

The Morphscale Core is just there to make reusing the same Gilded Echo Shards reasonably expensive and to better tie this mod to the original mod.

title: Old School Jail
description: A jail mod for fabric servers, just like the good old days!
body:
# Old School Jail Mod

A classic jail mod for Minecraft Fabric servers - just like the good old days!

## Features

- **Jail Players**: Jail players with customizable time limits and reasons
- **Jail Management**: Set multiple jail locations and delete them as needed
- **Permissions System**: Full integration with Fabric Permissions API (works with LuckPerms and other permission mods)
- **Smart Restrictions**: Jailed players cannot:
  - Break or place blocks
  - Interact with blocks (buttons, levers, etc.)
  - Use commands (except `/jail time` to check their sentence)
  - Teleport or escape (automatic teleport back to jail)
- **Configurable**: Extensive config file for customization
- **Data Persistence**: All jails and jailed players are saved and restored on server restart
- **Auto-Release**: Players are automatically released when their sentence expires
- **Original Location Tracking**: Players are teleported back to their original location upon release (configurable)
- **Logout/Login Handling**: Players remain jailed across logout/login and are auto-released if sentence expired offline
- **Multiple Jails**: Create multiple jails and choose which one to send players to
- **Essential Commands Compatible**: Fully compatible with [Essential Commands](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential-commands) - the recommended companion mod

## Commands

### Main Commands
- `/jail <player> <time> <reason>` - Jail a player in the first available jail
  - Time is based on config setting (default: minutes)
  - Example: `/jail Steve 30 Griefing the spawn`


- `/jail <player> <jail_name> <time> <reason>` - Jail a player in a specific jail
  - Example: `/jail Steve spawn 30 Being annoying`


- `/jail release <player>` - Release a player from jail early (teleports back to original location if enabled in config)

- `/jail time` - Check your own remaining jail time (available to jailed players)
- `/jail time <player>` - Check any player's jail time (admin only - requires `oldschooljail.jail` permission)
- `/jail list` - List all currently jailed players with details (admin only - requires `oldschooljail.jail` permission)

### Admin Commands
- `/jail set <jail_name>` - Set a jail at your current location
- `/jail set <jail_name> <x> <y> <z>` - Set a jail at specific coordinates
- `/jail delete <jail_name>` - Delete a jail (automatically releases all prisoners)

## Permissions

The mod uses the Fabric Permissions API and supports any permissions plugin that implements it (LuckPerms, etc.)

### Permission Nodes
- `oldschooljail.jail` - Allows jailing players
- `oldschooljail.release` - Allows releasing players
- `oldschooljail.set` - Allows setting jail locations
- `oldschooljail.delete` - Allows deleting jails
- `oldschooljail.immune` - Makes a player immune to being jailed
- `oldschooljail.time` - Allows using `/jail time` (granted to all by default)
- `oldschooljail.jail` - Also allows using `/jail time <player>` to check other players' jail time

**Note**: If no permissions plugin is installed, the mod falls back to OP level 2 for admin commands.

## Configuration

The config file is located at `config/oldschooljail.toml` and is automatically generated on first run with helpful comments.

### Config Options

The TOML file includes detailed comments for each option. Here's what you can configure:

**Time Settings:**
- `input_unit` - Time unit for commands (SECONDS, MINUTES, or HOURS)
- `max_sentence_seconds` - Maximum sentence length in seconds

**Restrictions:**
- `block_commands` - Block all commands except /jail time
- `block_teleportation` - Auto-teleport back if player escapes >50 blocks
- `block_block_breaking` - Prevent breaking blocks
- `block_block_placing` - Prevent placing blocks  
- `block_interaction` - Prevent interacting with blocks

**Release Settings:**
- `teleport_back_on_release` - Teleport players back to original location when released (if false, players must walk out manually)

**Messages:**
- `release` - Message on manual release
- `jail_expired` - Message when sentence expires

All settings include helpful comments in the config file explaining what they do!

## Installation

1. Download the oldschooljail-[version].jar for your MC version
2. Place the JAR file in your server's `mods` folder
3. Ensure you have Fabric API installed
4. (Optional) Install a permissions plugin like LuckPerms for advanced permission control
5. (Recommended) Install [Essential Commands](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential-commands) for full oldschool experience
6. Start your server

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft Version**: 1.21.2-1.21.11
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric
- **Required**: Fabric API
- **Recommended**: LuckPerms or other Fabric Permissions API compatible plugin
- **AFK Compatibility**: Fully compatible with [Essential Commands](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential-commands) - the recommended companion mod

# Jade Plugin for Paper

A Paper server plugin that provides Jade server-side data to Fabric clients. When a player with the Jade mod connects, the plugin responds with entity and block information that the Jade HUD overlay displays.

## Requirements
- Paper 1.21.6 (26.1.2) or compatible
- Fabric client with Jade mod installed

## How It Works
The plugin intercepts Jade's custom network payloads using Paper's plugin messaging system. When a Fabric client joins:
1. Client sends `jade:client_handshake` with protocol version
2. Plugin responds with `jade:server_handshake` listing available data providers
3. Client periodically sends `jade:request_entity` / `jade:request_block`
4. Plugin queries the server world and responds with `jade:receive_data` (NBT format)

## Implemented Features

### Protocol (5/5)

- [x] `jade:server_handshake`
- [x] `jade:request_entity`
- [x] `jade:request_block`

title: LagScope
description: LagScope is an all-in-one plugin that analyzes server lag in real time and actively optimizes entities, redstone, and explosions to keep performance stable.
body:
## LagScope

LagScope is a performance analyzer and lag control plugin for Paper and Purpur (1.21+).

---

### Smart Lag Control

LagScope tracks TPS, MSPT, entities, chunks, and activity spikes.

* Detects lag-heavy chunks immediately.
* Identifies problematic mechanics (entities, redstone, explosions, hoppers).
* Applies targeted limits instead of global wipes.
* Offers multiple lag modes ranging from "Light" to "Aggressive."

The goal is a stable server without unnecessary interference with gameplay.

---

### Active Protection Modules

The plugin is modular, allowing all optimizers to be toggled or tuned individually:

* **Entity Limiter:** Prevents entity and projectile spam per chunk.
* **Entity Cleaner:** Triggers smart cleanup when thresholds are exceeded.
* **Explosion Control:** Manages TNT and explosion spam.
* **Redstone Limiter:** Stops redstone clocks and massive update storms.
* **Hopper Optimizer:** Reduces hopper lag without breaking technical systems.
* **Mob AI Optimizer:** Scales down AI intensity based on server load.
* **Vehicle Limiter:** Limits minecart and boat physics spam.
* **Action Limiter:** Prevents abuse of items or abilities.
* **Lag Protection:** Automatically escalates measures based on current TPS/MSPT.

---

### In-Game Analyzer & GUI

Identify the source of performance issues directly within the game:

* Live TPS and MSPT display.
* List of the most resource-intensive chunks.
* Entity and tile-entity counts.
* Module status overview.

Management is handled through an in-game GUI, reducing the need to manually edit configuration files.

---

### Performance First

* Event-driven logic without unnecessary background tasks.
* Chunk-aware limiting avoids global punishment for all players.
* Built specifically for modern Paper and Purpur APIs.
* Safe for large SMPs and professional networks.

LagScope focuses on stability through intelligent management rather than simple destruction.

---

### Commands

* `/lag` – Open the performance overview GUI.
* `/lag clear` – Manually trigger a smart cleanup.
* `/lag mode <light|normal|aggressive>` – Change the optimization strength.

---

### Ideal For

* SMP and Survival servers.
* PvP servers with high TNT or redstone usage.
* Large communities with high entity counts.
* Network and high-player-count servers.

description: An opaque glass sphere with decorative patterns and a wooden core that, once “attached” to someone, cannot remain alone.
body:
![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_7178a87f-97e4-4c6b-9172-71fea629f37c.png) *** **The Lonely Ball** mod adds __five new items__ _(SCP, documentation, label and more…)_ and __one structure__ to the game. The mod is heavily inspired by **SCP-104** from the **SCP Foundation Universe**. **SCP-104** is an opaque glass sphere with decorative patterns and a wooden core that, once “attached” to someone, cannot remain alone. **●** **Mod** __made by__ : TheCaptainFoxy (me) ● __Mod created with__ MCreator ● Join __my discord__ for __support/question/suggestions/sneak-peaks__ and more! _TCF Discord_   __FAQ__ 
Spoiler

 ► Where can I find the mod content?

SCP-104, its documentation, its label and all the new items can only be found inside the SCP-104 containment chamber structure.

 

► Where does the structure spawn?

The structure spawns in every overworld biome at surface level, with approximately one structure every 3,000 blocks.

 

You can find it using /locate command

 

► How can I place the document?

Right-click to read the document.  
Shift + right-click to place it.

  *** ![SCP-104 Label](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf8db0d25b424da7907fc90c7c40585d05097221_0.webp) *** ![SCP-104](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0a1b29006a4b29ed1ba375895f81506eed8db9e.png)

SCP-104 | The Lonely Ball

*** **SCP-104** is an **opaque glass sphere** with decorative patterns and a wooden core that, once “**attached**” to someone, **cannot remain alone**. Anyone who comes into physical contact with **SCP-104** will undergo an "**imprinting**". From that moment on, the sphere will become __linked to the subject__.   **SCP-104** will imprint only on the __first person who touches it__. The only ways to break the link with **SCP-104** are __death or entering a "near-death" state__. To enter the "__near-death__" state, the linked subject must be the target of any instance of **SCP-104** and be reduced to exactly **half a heart** of health. At that moment, the subject’s vision will turn black for **10 seconds**, and they will be unable to move or perform any actions, as they will be unconscious. After 10 seconds, the subject will recover, and the **bond** with the sphere **will be broken**.   If the linked subject moves more than **9 meters (9 blocks)** away from the sphere and remains at a distance greater than 9 meters for more than **5 Minecraft minutes (83 ticks / approximately 4 real-life seconds)**, the sphere will disappear from its current location and reappear within a maximum distance of **2 meters (2 blocks)** from the subject. If the sphere is in the inventory of someone who is **not** the linked subject, and the subject remains more than **9 meters (9 blocks)** away for over **5 Minecraft minutes**, the sphere will disappear from the holder’s inventory and reappear within **2 meters (2 blocks)** of the linked subject.

_If the linked subject is holding the sphere in their hand, it will be considered within the **9-meter range** and therefore will not teleport._

  If the sphere is **destroyed**, it will __not drop__ as an item. However, if it has already undergone imprinting, it will **reappear** within the usual time frame within **2 meters (2 blocks)** of the linked subject.   If you attempt to drop **SCP-104** while it is in your inventory, one of the following may occur: * It may shatter, since throwing a glass sphere onto the ground _is not the smartest idea_. * If it has already imprinted on the subject, it will remain bound to them and cannot be dropped.   If the linked subject is **within 9 meters (9 blocks)** of **SCP-104**, the sphere will remain in place. However, once __every in-game hour__, it will slowly move **1 foot** __closer to the subjec__t until it eventually makes __contact and remains there__. (The sphere moves **1 foot every hour** [approximately 1,000 ticks / 50 real-life seconds]. After **3 hours** [**3,000 ticks / 2 minutes and 30 seconds real time**] it will have moved **1 meter** [**1 block**]. The teleportation time (when the sphere is more than **9 meters** away) and the movement interval (when within **9 meters**) can be modified using the gamerule: `SCP104RealLifeTime` _If the gamerule is set to **false**, the timings remain as previously described: _**5 in-game minutes** (approximately **83 ticks / 4 real-life seconds**) before teleporting when farther than 9 meters._ _**3 in-game hours** (approximately **3,000 ticks / 2 minutes and 30 seconds real time**) to move 1 block when within 9 meters._ _If the gamerule is set to **true**, the timings are converted to real-life time:_ * 5 real-life minutes before teleporting when farther than 9 meters. * 3 real-life hours to move 1 block when within 9 meters.   _**The Lonely Ball** is compatible with **every** mod._ ***   __Show all content__  
Spoiler

 

 

Reacher

The Reacher is a metal arm with a portable claw, operated using a trigger.

The Reacher can be used to pick up SCP-104 (Shift + Right-Click on it) without making physical contact, preventing it from imprinting on the user.

This allows SCP-104 to be safely moved around.

The Reacher is not craftable and can only be found in SCP-104 containment chambers.

 

Reacher with SCP-104

The Reacher with SCP-104 is the Reacher when it is holding SCP-104.

 

  • If the instance of SCP-104 held by the Reacher is imprinted on the player holding it, it will not teleport, as it is within the 9-meter range.

 

  • If the SCP-104 instance is imprinted on a subject who is far away, it will disappear from the Reacher and reappear within 2 meters of that subject after the appropriate time.

 

Attempting to drop the Reacher with SCP-104 will break SCP-104, returning the Reacher to its empty state.

 

While holding the Reacher with SCP-104, it is impossible to remove it from the main hand, open the inventory, or change its hotbar slot. This is to prevent accidental contact with SCP-104, as the only safe way to handle it is to keep it in hand.

 

Right-clicking on the ground will place SCP-104, returning the Reacher to its empty state.

   
SCP-104 Containment Chamber

SCP-104 can only be found inside the SCP-104 Containment Chamber/Cell.

The structure spawns in any Overworld biome at surface level and is rare. 

  

SCP-104 Document & SCP-104 Label

The SCP-104 documentation can be found inside the SCP-104 Containment Chamber together with The Lonely Ball and the Reacher.


The documents are readable, while the label provides information about the SCP’s classification and risk level.

  _● SCP Documents: _        [SCP-104 Document](https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-104) ● You have permission to use this mod in your modpacks! _● Check out my other Mods:_ _[My CurseForge Profile](https://www.curseforge.com/members/thecaptainfoxy/projects)_ _[My Modrinth Profile](https://modrinth.com/user/TheCaptainFoxy)_

title: AngelsAndTaverns
description: Smart villagers and realism, the world feels alive
body:
AngelsAndTaverns: The World Feels Alive

AngelsAndTaverns is a realism and horror-focused mod that makes Minecrafts villagers truly feel alive with smarter behaviors, relationships and a few unsettling surprises.


..Smarter Villages..

Villagers no longer stand around aimlessly. They talk, form friendships, react to their surroundings, and behave more like real people. You’ll see them helping each other, panicking during danger and even showing emotions that change depending on what’s happening around them.


..A Darker World..

As night falls, the game takes on a more eerie tone. Torches might disappear or go out. Nights last longer than they should. Strange noises echo through the world when your alone.

The world starts to feel alive but not in a comforting way.


..Development Status..

This mod is still in very early development, and some features may not work properly in single-player yet. Expect bugs and odd behavior it’s all part of the early testing process. Updates will continue to improve villager AI, add new horror events and make the world even more immersive.


..Why You’ll Want It..

If you’ve ever wanted your Minecraft world to feel alive, reactive and a little unsettling, AngelsAndTaverns is for you.
It’s a blend of realism and atmospheric horror that makes every night feel different and every village feel real.

# Faster Fireworks

Faster Fireworks adds three progression-based Elytra rockets that launch you much harder than vanilla while keeping normal Firework Rockets unchanged.

## What It Adds

- **Swift Rocket**: `1.9x` boost, flight duration `2`, crafts `3`
- **Burst Rocket**: `2.35x` boost, flight duration `3`, crafts `2`
- **Hyper Rocket**: `2.85x` boost, flight duration `4`, crafts `1`

## Crafting Progression

- **Swift Rocket**: paper + gunpowder + redstone
- **Burst Rocket**: crafted from Swift Rockets + blaze powder + glowstone dust
- **Hyper Rocket**: crafted from Burst Rockets + phantom membranes + nether star

## Configurable

All tier values are configurable in:

`config/fasterrocketsmod.json`

Each tier has:

- `speedMultiplier` (clamped to `1.0` - `10.0`)
- `flightDuration` (clamped to `1` - `10`)

## Compatibility

- Minecraft `1.21.10`
- Fabric Loader `0.18.1+`
- Fabric API
- Java `21+`

Works in singleplayer and multiplayer. Vanilla Firework Rockets are unaffected.
