title: Idiot's Saccharine Totems
description: Adds a few craftable totems, including the Totem of Keeping, and a lickable totem core which can be imbued with potions, and a block that preserves velocity.
body:
> NOTE (again): This mod used to not work in servers... mostly because of a stupid lil thing i did. > **NOW, it works perfectly fine :> (1.2.3 and later)** > Transdimensional **_Totem of Keeping_** issues fixed **(1.2.4 and later)**. > Use `/isttok restoreFromDimensions` to **recover any lost _Totems of Keeping_**. # Idiot's Saccharine Totems Adds 5 new craftable totems without completely ruining the vanilla progression. Adds a new effect called Ferrous and also Ferrous Metal and Block. Totems may be found in different loot or be crafted. ![Le Totems](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/441221648140b7f87c256fea06f739e70fd5a480.png) ## Totems > NOTE: All added totems need to be held in one of the hands. Does not support inventory totem mods, yet. Default Ferrous Effect does not work with shaders. So, a glint is used in place of it when a shader is loaded. Glint might not work properly depending on the shader. - **Totem of Keeping -** Totem which DOES NOT prevent death. But instead, stores the inventory items on death and lets you use it to get them back after respawn. Does NOT preserve inventory layout as I was too lazy to implement it. Items not fitting in the inventory are dropped forward when the totem is used. - **Totem of Ferrous -** Gives a ferrous effect for a few seconds and Resistance and Fire Resistance for half minute on use. Ferrous reduces most physical damage including wither by 90% to at most one heart of damage up until half a heart health and reduces magical damage by 65%. - **Totem of Tenacity -** Slightly aggresive but nerfed version of the normal Totem of Undying. - **Totem of Perseverance -** Close but slightly defensive compared to the normal Totem of Undying, still nerfed. - **Totem of Insanity -** Bombards and overwhelms you with multiple effects. You end up tanky and aggressive, but also vulnerable after a while due to hunger and wither. ## Ferrous family of items - **Ferrous Metal -** Used to craft the totem core and the clamped ferrous linkage. - **Clamped Ferrous Linkage -** Used to brew the Potion of Ferrous. - **Ferrous Metal Block -** Items and entities maintain their horizontal velocity when in collision with the block. (Slightly unbalanced... but fun :) - **Totem Core -** Used to make the totems. Can be imbued with a potion effect using honey and sugar. When licked, gives the effect of the imbued potion for a bit. No limit on the number of times you can lick (might need to balance this ;-; ) Formula used to get the duration (in ticks) for the imbued effect ```java max(1, 12 * (sqrt((duration / 10) + 1) - 1)) * sign(duration - 1) + 1; // Feedback much appreciated! ```
Recipes

![Ferrous Metal Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccfeb4a482e2d3af0302d66fc2d7598201e28825.png)

Use command `/tokdev entries` to see any persistent Totem of Keeping death inventory entries. # Compatibility - **EMI** - **REI** - **Trinkets** *(Totem of Keeping holds trinkets, too. Does not support Trinket Totem, yet)* - **Sinytra Connector**

title: Portal Corner Link
description: Control which Nether portals link together using glazed terracotta corner markers. Place matching patterns on both portal frames and they'll always find each other — no more random portal connections!
body:
**PortalCornerLink by MajinGuil**

Control Nether portal linking with colored glazed terracotta corner markers.

## What It Does
This mod lets you control which Nether portals connect to each other. Instead of relying on unpredictable vanilla portal linking, you create unique "signatures" for your portals using glazed terracotta blocks placed at their corners.

## How It Works
It's really simple:

- Place glazed terracotta at the corners of your portal frame — you don't need all four, even one or two corners work!
- Do the same pattern on the destination portal
- Travel through — the portal with the best matching corner pattern is selected
- No corners at all? The mod defaults to vanilla behavior — fully backward compatible!

## Pattern Matching Rules
- You don't need all 4 corners — partial patterns are supported, more matches = higher priority
- Horizontal orientation doesn't matter — patterns are matched even when mirrored
- Tiebreaker — if multiple portals match equally, vanilla distance priority is used
- All 16 glazed terracotta colors work — mix and match to create unique signatures

![Portals Linking](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78aaf1fa524b19f5f9c9f1052a050205625f4602.png)

## Credits
This is an updated and improved fork of the original mods by Starbidou (corner-portal-linking) and Dakes. All credit for the original concept and implementation goes to them.

title: Celest Combat Xtra
description: A simple plugin that tags players in PvP and kills those who disconnect to prevent combat logging. but a better version with more features
body:
# CelestCombat-Xtra

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-blue.svg)](https://github.com/ptthanh02/CelestCombat)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-1.21--1.21.4-purple.svg)](https://papermc.io/)
[![Folia](https://img.shields.io/badge/Folia-Supported-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/PaperMC/Folia)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Server-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/WpYZkrdNVe)

A comprehensive combat management plugin for **SwordPvP, CrystalPvP, and competitive Minecraft servers**. Prevents combat logging, blocks escape mechanics, integrates with major protection plugins, and provides advanced item restriction systems—all highly configurable.

---

## Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.21 – 1.21.4
- **Server:** Paper, Purpur, or Folia
- **Java:** 21+

### Optional Dependencies

| Plugin | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| **PlaceholderAPI** | Placeholders for scoreboards, tab lists, holograms |
| **WorldGuard** | Safezone barriers and region protection |
| **GriefPrevention** | Claim-edge barriers and claim protection |

---

## Installation

1. Download the latest release
2. Place the `.jar` in your server’s `plugins` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Edit `plugins/CelestCombat/config.yml`
5. Reload with `/celestcombat reload` or `/ccx reload`

---

# ⚔️ Combat System

* **Combat tagging** – Players who hit or get hit stay in combat for a set duration (e.g. 20 seconds).
* **Action bar timer** – Shows remaining combat time in blue text (e.g. *"Combat: 19s"*).
* **Command blocking** – Blacklist or whitelist commands during combat (e.g. block `/tpa`, `/home`).
* **Admin protection** – Staff kicks/bans don’t trigger combat-log penalties.
* **Flight control** – Disable creative flight while tagged.
* **Nametag & boss bar** – Optional opponent name and countdown.

![Configurable Nametag](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/configurablenametag.png)
![Combat Timer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/combattimer.png)

---

# 📋 Action Bar Cooldowns

All timers appear in one line above the hotbar, separated by vertical bars.

* **Combat** – Blue countdown until you can leave combat.
* **Ender Pearl** – Red countdown before you can use pearls again.
* **Trident** – Light blue countdown for trident throws.
* **Wind Charge** – Light blue countdown for wind charges.
* **Mace** – Red countdown after mace hits.

Items on cooldown also show a **white wipe overlay** on the hotbar so you can see at a glance which items are ready.

![Cooldowns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/cooldowns.png)

---

# 🚫 Configurable Item Blocking

## Disabled Items (in combat)

Add items to `disabled_items` in `config.yml`. While in combat, players **cannot use** these items at all.

**Example:** `SUSPICIOUS_STEW`, `ELYTRA`, custom items.

Players see a pink action bar message: *"You cannot use [item] while in combat!"*

![Configurable Blocking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/configurableblocking.png)

## Cooldowned Items

Add items with cooldowns in `cooldowned_items`. After use, the item is locked for a set time (e.g. 10 seconds for Chorus Fruit).

* Action bar shows the countdown (e.g. *"Chorus Fruit: 9s"*).
* Physical cooldown overlay on the item in the hotbar.
* Applies in combat and/or out of combat (configurable).

![Configurable Cooldowns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/configurablecooldowns.png)
![Item Cooldown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/itemcooldown.png)

---

# 🛡️ Elytra Combat Rules

* **Block glide & fireworks** – No flying or firework boosting while in combat.
* **Strike counter** – After repeated tries (e.g. 2 strikes), the plugin acts:
  * **Unequip** – Elytra is moved to inventory.
  * **TEMP_BREAK** – If inventory is full, the elytra is broken for 30 seconds and then restored.
  * **DROP** – If inventory is full, the elytra is dropped at your feet.

A crossed-out elytra icon shows when elytra use is blocked.

![Elytra](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/elytra.png)

---

# 🔮 Ender Pearl & Trident

### Ender Pearl
* Cooldown with action bar timer.
* Optional block in combat.
* Per-world cooldown control.

### Trident
* Cooldown with action bar timer.
* Optional block in combat (throw & riptide).
* Per-world bans (e.g. no tridents in Nether).

---

# 💀 Harming Arrow Control

Controls Arrows of Harming from bows and crossbows.

* **Block shooting** – Set `bows_allow_harming` or `crossbows_allow_harming` to `false` to stop loading and firing harming arrows.
* **Block damage** – Set `no_damage: true` to cancel all harming arrow damage to players (arrows still fire but deal 0 damage).
* **Dispensers** – Optional block for dispensers.
* **Potions** – Optional block for harming potions (drink, throw, dispense).

Players see: *"Harming is disallowed on this server!"*

![Harming Arrows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/harmingarrows.png)

---

# 💥 Explosive Controls

Toggle prevention for:

| Item            | Message                               |
|-----------------|----------------------------------------|
| End Crystal     | *"End crystals are disabled here."*   |
| Respawn Anchor  | *"Respawn anchors are disabled here."*|
| Bed (Nether/End)| *"Beds are disabled in this dimension."* |
| TNT Minecart    | *"TNT minecart explosions are disabled."* |

All messages appear in pink on the action bar. Use `prevent_placement` / `prevent_use` / `prevent_explosion` in `config.yml`.

![End Crystal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/endcrystal.png)  
![Respawn Anchor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/respawnanchor.png)  
![Bed Blocking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/bedblocking.png)  
![TNT Minecart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/minecartblocking.png)

---

# ✨ Enchant Limiter

Stops overpowered enchants (e.g. Sharpness 255).

* **REVERT** – Clamp to max level (e.g. Sharpness V).
* **DELETE** – Remove the item.
* Per-world and bypass permission.
* You can see that this max stick gets sharpness reverted.

![Enchant Limiter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/enchantsreverted.png)

---

# 📦 Item Limiter

Limit how many of each material a player can hold (e.g. max 64 diamonds, 3 netherite ingots, 1 totem).

* Drop excess or remove.
* Per-world control.
* Action bar notice when denied.

---

# 🔒 Regearing Block (Combat)

While in combat:
* **Ender chest** – Blocked.
* **Shulker boxes** – Blocked.
* **Bundles** – Blocked.

Chat: *"You cannot access enderchests/shulkers/bundles while in combat!"*

---

# 🛡️ WorldGuard Safe Zone

Uses **WorldGuard** to stop players from escaping combat into no-PvP regions.

* **Red barrier** – Visual barrier at region borders.
* **Push-back** – Pushes players away from the barrier.
* **Chorus fruit** – Blocks teleporting into safe zones.
* Per-world settings.

![Safe Zone Barrier](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/safezonebarrier.png)

---

# 👶 New Player Protection

Protects new players for a configurable time (e.g. 10 minutes).

* **PvP protection** – Can’t be damaged by players.
* **Boss bar** – Green bar with *"PvP Protection: 8m 44s"*.
* **Removal** – Protection ends when they attack another player.
* Per-world settings.

![New Player Protection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vanillaxtra/celestcombatxtra/f5cf7afe9d9ee40cfaafe0f16a88a5ace7105c9b/assets/newplayerprotection.png)

---

# 🏆 Kill Rewards

Run commands when a player gets a kill. Use in `kill_rewards.commands`:

| Placeholder | Description |
|-------------|-------------|
| `%killer%` | Killer’s name |
| `%victim%` | Victim’s name |
| `%killer_uuid%` | Killer’s UUID |
| `%victim_uuid%` | Victim’s UUID |
| `%killer_health%` | Killer’s health when reward runs |
| `%victim_health%` | Victim’s health (usually 0) |
| `%killer_max_health%` | Killer’s max health |
| `%victim_max_health%` | Victim’s max health |
| `%world%` | Victim’s world name |
| `%x%`, `%y%`, `%z%` | Victim’s block coordinates |

* Global or per-victim cooldown. Example: `donutcratecore shards give %killer% 10`

---

# 🔌 Integrations

## PlaceholderAPI

| Placeholder | Description |
|-------------|-------------|
| `%celestcombat_in_combat%` | `true` or `false` |
| `%celestcombat_time_left%` | Remaining combat seconds |
| `%celestcombat_opponent%` | Opponent name |
| `%celestcombat_opponent_display%` | Opponent display name |
| `%celestcombat_pearl_cooldown%` | Pearl cooldown seconds |
| `%celestcombat_trident_cooldown%` | Trident cooldown seconds |
| `%celestcombat_wind_cooldown%` | Wind charge cooldown seconds |
| `%celestcombat_pearl_ready%` | `true` or `false` |
| `%celestcombat_trident_ready%` | `true` or `false` |
| `%celestcombat_wind_ready%` | `true` or `false` |



---

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---------|------------|-------------|
| `/celestcombat` | `celestcombatxtra.command.use` | Main command (shows help) |
| `/celestcombat help` | `celestcombatxtra.command.use` | Display help |
| `/celestcombat reload` | `celestcombatxtra.command.use` | Reload config and messages |
| `/celestcombat tag <player1> [player2]` | `celestcombatxtra.command.use` | Manually tag players in combat |
| `/celestcombat removeTag <player\|world\|all>` | `celestcombatxtra.command.use` | Remove combat tags |
| `/celestcombat killReward clear [player]` | `celestcombatxtra.command.use` | Clear kill reward cooldowns |
| `/celestcombat newbieProtection add/remove/check <player>` | `celestcombatxtra.command.use` | Manage newbie protection |
| `/celestcombat config` | `celestcombatxtra.command.config` | Browse and edit config in-game |

**Aliases:** `/ccx`, `/celestcombat`, `/combat`

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|------------|---------|-------------|
| `celestcombatxtra.command.use` | OP | Use all plugin commands |
| `celestcombatxtra.command.config` | OP | Browse and edit config in-game |
| `celestcombatxtra.update.notify` | OP | Receive update notifications |
| `celestcombatxtra.bypass.tag` | false | Bypass combat tagging (no combat-log punishment) |
| `celestcombatxtra.bypass.enchant_limit` | OP | Bypass enchant level limits |
| `celestcombatxtra.bypass.item_limit` | OP | Bypass item limiter (per-material caps) |
| `celestcombatxtra.bypass.spear_control` | OP | Bypass spear lunge cooldown and damage rules |

---

## Configuration

Main config: `plugins/CelestCombat/config.yml`

Notable sections:

- `combat` – Duration, command blocking, nametag, boss bar
- `item_restrictions` – Disabled items, cooldowned items
- `elytra` – Elytra abuse prevention
- `item_limiter` – Per-material limits, per-world
- `enchant_limiter` – Enchant caps, per-world
- `enderpearl`, `trident`, `windcharge`, `mace`, `spear_control`
- `kill_rewards` – Commands and cooldowns
- `newbie_protection` – Duration, display, worlds
- `safezone_protection` – WorldGuard barriers
- `claim_protection` – GriefPrevention integration

Use `/celestcombat config` to browse and edit in-game (with permission).

---

title: CRD Hat Mod
description: Cosmetic hat system with /hat, /pickhat, and /glint commands using CustomModelData.
body:
# CRD Hat Mod

Cosmetic hat system for Fabric servers using CustomModelData on items.

## Features

- **`/hat`** — Swap your held item with your head slot (or vice versa)
- **`/pickhat [page]`** — Opens a GUI to browse and apply hat models automatically populates with the CRD numbers #0–100. Slot 0 resets back to default.
- **`/setmodel [id]`** — Set custom model data on the held item. Without an ID, opens a model picker GUI. With an ID (0–100), directly applies that model. Use 0 to reset.
- **`/glint`** — Toggle enchantment glint on/off for the held item
- **Automatic 3D rendering** — Helmets with CustomModelData automatically have their equipment asset stripped so the 3D item model renders instead of flat armor textures
- Previews in the GUI match your actual hat item type (diamond helmet, wool, leather, etc.)

## How it works

Wear any helmet, run `/pickhat`, and click a hat to apply that CustomModelData value. Any resourcepack using CRD will map these values to the 3D models. Use `/hat` to quickly put any item on your head or take them off. Use `/setmodel` to apply models to any held item.

## Installation

Drop the jar into your server's `mods/` folder. Requires Fabric Loader and Fabric API.

title: Kalu Gale Yaka
description: A psychological horror mod featuring a terrifying 20-second darkness mechanic, massive Kalu Gal structures, and the Gale Yaka.
body:
# **Kalu Gale Yaka**
_A psychological horror experience that turns Minecraft survival into a true nightmare._

Dare to step into the dark? The Kalu Gale Yaka mod introduces a terrifying new lore-driven biome, ancient cursed tools, and an unrelenting boss entity that will actively stalk you through the shadows. Designed for hardcore survival players, this mod replaces standard Minecraft exploration with a deeply unsettling psychological horror experience.

 
## **🌑 The Kalu Gal Peaks Biome**
Forget the standard Overworld. When you stumble upon the towering, dark stone mountains of the Kalu Gal Peaks, you will realise you are entirely alone.

Pitch-Black Waters: The rivers run thick and dark, plunging players into absolute, blinding zero-visibility if they dare to dive underneath.

Dead Silence: The game's normal rules do not apply here. No pigs, no cows, no passive animals will spawn to keep you company.

The 20-Second Nightmare: The moment you cross the border into this cursed land, a heavy, blinding Darkness effect will wash over you for exactly 20 seconds, disorienting you just long enough for the hunt to begin.

 ![Larger and New Biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24a4a52cf51e48940f6767e2db6cedc270c3f931.png)

👁️ The Gale Yaka 
This is not a normal mob. The Gala Yaka is a terrifying entity locked inside a massive, randomly generated structural house within the peaks.
The Stalker: He possesses a massive 256-block tracking radius. Once you are in his territory, he knows exactly where you are.

**Psychological Warfare:** As he hunts you, he will speak directly to you in the game's chat window, using a chilling mix of English and Sinhala dialogue ("Oya mava maruwat mama oyage pitipasse tamai enne").

**Heavy Hitter:** Boasting 100 Health (50 Hearts) and incredible speed, he cannot be knocked back. Running is your best option.

![The Yaka](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/313f6e129a9a2e9980c96a1e2e6e0337c6f7c91c.png)

You can only kill the Gale Yaka Mob using the "Kalu Gal Sword". It has the best Damage and the Fastest Attack Speed in Minecraft tools.

## **⚔️ Ancient Kalu Gal Tools**
Surviving the peaks requires wielding the cursed stone yourself. Search the biome for hidden Mossy Lore Chests and craft a brand-new tier of powerful equipment:

**• Kalu Gal Sword
• Kalu Gal Pickaxe
• Kalu Gal Axe**

All items and spawn eggs can be found in the custom Kalu Gale Yaka Creative Tab, and you can also craft them on a crafting table using Obsidian blocks.

## **🏚️ Custom Structures**
Explore the dark mountains to find carefully spaced, terrifying custom structures. Discover hidden lore chests covered in cobwebs, but beware—if you find the massive Gala Yaka House, the 5 entities waiting inside are ready for a bloodbath.
At- @MrMattRanger

There will be a lot of Bugs, Pls tell us all in our [Discord](https://discord.gg/Fx4NkH2rpq).

title: Not So Shrimple (Reshrimpled)
description: Unofficial 1.20.1 Forge port of Not So Shrimple by peeko32213. Adds bait-summoned Crayfish variants, shipwreck Maneaters, the River-Prawn Greatclaw weapon, prawn food, and upgrade stones.
body: ![Preview](https://i.imgur.com/qEM4m1I.png) **Not So Shrimple is back on Minecraft 1.20.1.** This is an **unofficial Forge port** of [Not So Shrimple](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/not-so-shrimple-forge), originally created by **peeko32213**. All original content belongs to the original author and credited contributors. This port is distributed under the MIT License used by the original project. ## What Is This Mod? **Not So Shrimple** adds dangerous crustacean-themed creatures, animated weapons, upgrade items, and strange aquatic encounters to your world. This port keeps the spirit of the original mod while adapting it for **Minecraft 1.20.1**, **Forge 47+**, and **GeckoLib 4**. ## Creatures ### Crayfish ![Crayfish](https://i.imgur.com/FXdMCQw.png) Crayfish are hostile semi-aquatic mobs with multiple variants. They are tough, aggressive, and come with different visual styles depending on how they are summoned. In this port, crayfish no longer spawn naturally. Instead, they are summoned using a **Bucket of Bait**. Crayfish variants include: * Normal variants from regular water * Ice variants from cold biome water * Blood/fire variants from Nether lava * Rare special variants ### Maneater ![Maneater](https://i.imgur.com/BgAw8T0.png) The Maneater is a hostile shell creature found near shipwrecks. Its spawning has been reworked for this port so encounters feel more controlled and less spammy. Maneaters can appear near: * Shipwrecks * Beached shipwrecks Spawn rates are intentionally limited, making each encounter feel more deliberate. ## Bucket of Bait The **Bucket of Bait** is the new way to summon crayfish. Craft it using a bucket and raw fish, then throw it into water or lava. After a short delay, it has a configurable chance to summon a crayfish nearby. Summoning rules: * Throw into water to summon normal or ice crayfish * Throw into cold biome water for ice variants * Throw into Nether lava for blood/fire variants * The summoned crayfish appears nearby, not directly on top of the bait * Summoned crayfish briefly glow so they are easier to find ## River-Prawn Greatclaw The **River-Prawn Greatclaw** is a custom animated GeckoLib weapon. It features: * Heavy melee damage * Durability-based use * A ground-slam attack * A visual block-wave effect * Area damage that scales with fall speed The harder you fall, the wider the slam impact becomes. ## Items The mod also includes: * Raw Prawn * Cooked Prawn * Smithing Stones * Somber Stones * Purging Stone * Crayfish and Maneater spawn eggs Smithing and Somber Stones can upgrade supported equipment, with configurable caps and tag-based blacklist/whitelist support. ## Coming In A Future Update A new mob is already being prepared for a future update. It is not available in the current release yet, but development has already started. More details will be revealed once the creature is closer to release. ## Changes In This Port * Updated to Minecraft **1.20.1** * Updated to Forge **47+** * Updated to **GeckoLib 4** * Added a Creative Tab * Reworked crayfish spawning into the **Bucket of Bait** system * Reworked Maneater spawning to happen only near shipwrecks * Added River-Prawn Greatclaw slam block-wave visuals * Added config options for bait summoning and special sounds * Fixed crashes, invalid tags, loot table issues, animation parsing issues, model overlap/flicker issues, and config edge cases ## Requirements * Minecraft **1.20.1** * Forge **47+** * [GeckoLib 4](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib) * Java **17** ## Credits * Original mod: **peeko32213** * Original models and textures: **Alpha** and **Gec Master** * Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge port: **Y221** ## License This port is distributed under the **MIT License**. Original mod: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/not-so-shrimple-forge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/not-so-shrimple-forge) ## Community Follow the development of the mod, share ideas, and stay updated here: **YouTube:** [https://www.youtube.com/@YAPILabs](https://www.youtube.com/@YAPILabs) **Discord:** [https://discord.gg/KYGyy9jFCz](https://discord.gg/KYGyy9jFCz)

title: FriendLink
description: FriendLink is an experimental Fabric client mod that backports Minecraft's official Friends / P2P multiplayer flow to Minecraft 26.1.2.
body:
# FriendLink

FriendLink is an experimental Fabric client mod that backports Minecraft's official Friends / P2P multiplayer flow to Minecraft 1.21-26.1.2.

It uses Mojang/Microsoft services for friends presence, official signaling, TURN auth, and WebRTC transport.

## Status

Experimental. The current build is focused on validating the official P2P path on Minecraft 26.1.2.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21-26.1.2
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Microsoft accounts with Minecraft friends / online presence enabled

## Notes

- FriendLink does not include, distribute, or replace Minecraft itself.
- This is not a custom server relay.
- The official flow depends on Microsoft services and may be unstable on restricted or high-latency networks.
- Both clients should use the same mod build.
- Players must be Minecraft / Microsoft friends before they can connect through FriendLink.

## Usage

1. Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API for your Minecraft version.
2. Download the FriendLink jar that matches your Minecraft version and place it in the `mods` folder.
3. Make sure both players are Minecraft / Microsoft friends.
4. Both players should start Minecraft with FriendLink installed.
5. One player opens a world and starts the FriendLink host flow.
6. The other player joins through the FriendLink friend connection flow.
7. After joining the same world, TPA commands can be used for non-cheat teleport requests.（1.21.X）


## License

FriendLink is licensed under GPL-3.0-only. See `LICENSE`.

body: # 💰 CrownEconomy > **The best economy plugin for Paper, Purpur, Spigot, and Bukkit servers.** Premium auction house, stunning GUIs, 100% customizable. Built for survival, SMP, factions, and RPG servers. ![Paper Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-Compatible-8b5cf6?style=for-the-badge) ![Purpur Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/Purpur-Compatible-ff9f00?style=for-the-badge) [![github](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/available/github_vector.svg)](https://github.com/FrostedGuy0/CrownEconomy) [![hangar](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/available/hangar_vector.svg)](https://hangar.papermc.io/FrostedGuy/CrownEconomy) [![discord-plural](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/social/discord-plural_vector.svg)](https://discord.gg/cCUVWxcuAw) **CrownEconomy** is the best economy plugin and best auction house plugin for Paper, Purpur, Spigot, and Bukkit 1.21.1 servers. If you're looking for a simple, powerful, and 100% customizable economy suite that your players will actually enjoy, you've found it. Clean bordered GUIs. Instant feedback. Smart expiry handling. Deep configuration. **Vault-compatible** out of the box. No bloat, no ugly menus, no compromises. Supports Paper, Purpur, Spigot, and Bukkit 1.21.1+. Whether you're building a survival economy, an SMP marketplace, or a full RPG server, **CrownEconomy** is the last economy plugin you'll ever need. *** ## 🔍 Why CrownEconomy? Every other auction house plugin for modern Minecraft servers either looks outdated, barely configures, or breaks under load. CrownEconomy was built from scratch to be the definitive, modern answer to server economy: * 🏆 **Best auction house plugin** for Paper, Purpur, Spigot, and Bukkit 1.21.1, cleaner, faster, and more configurable than anything else * 🎨 **100% customizable** - every GUI title, filler material, button icon, message, price limit, tax rate, and border element * ⚡ **Simple & lightweight** - drop-in install, zero database setup required, fully running in under 5 minutes * 🏦 **Vault-compatible** - seamless integration with EssentialsX, GemsEconomy, CMI, and every Vault economy plugin * 🔐 **LuckPerms integration** - give VIPs, MVPs, and donors more listing slots automatically via permissions * 🛡️ **Offline seller payouts** - sellers always get paid, even if they're offline when their item sells * 📦 **Configurable market flow** - clean browsing, categories, search, my listings, and transactions history * 💾 **Reliable data saving** - listings and player transactions are saved automatically, so nothing is lost * 🗺️ **Actively developed** - built to grow with more economy features over time * 💬 **Dedicated support** - active Discord with fast responses and a growing community *** ## 🏛️ Auction House Features > The most polished, feature-rich, and player-friendly AH plugin available for 1.21.1 servers. ### 🖥️ GUI & Browsing * **Clean centered browsing GUI** - readable layout with no clutter * **Configurable listing slots** - fully controlled from `gui.yml` * **4 sort modes** - Low -> High, High -> Low, Soon -> New, New -> Soon * **Category filters** - All, Weapons, Armor, Tools, Resources, Food, and Blocks * **Live search** - search by item name, seller name, or material * **Confirm purchase screen** - full breakdown of item, price, tax, and seller before any money moves * **Refresh support** - refresh the current menu without reopening the whole flow ### 💸 Economy & Listings * **Configurable tax system** - set any percentage cut taken from the seller on each sale * **Min & max price limits** - prevent price dumping or price gouging with hard server-wide limits * **Global AH cap** - limit how many active listings can exist at once * **Per-rank listing slots** - VIPs and donors automatically get more listing slots via permissions * **Offline seller payouts** - Vault balance credited the moment an item sells, online or not * **Material blacklist** - permanently block any item or material from ever being listed * **Permanent or timed listings** - set duration to `0` for permanent listings ### 📦 Listing Management * **My Listings panel** - dedicated GUI for players to view and right-click cancel their own listings * **Transactions GUI** - track listed, purchased, sold, cancelled, and expired activity * **Transaction stats** - see total sold worth and total bought worth * **Expired item handling** - unsold items auto-return on expiry * **Configurable expiry duration** - set exactly how long listings stay active before expiring * **Listing data persistence** - every listing saved on create, purchase, cancel, expiry, and shutdown *** ## 🔌 Dependencies ### Required * **Paper, Purpur, Spigot, or Bukkit 1.21.1** or a compatible fork * **Vault** * **A Vault-compatible economy plugin** ### Recommended * **LuckPerms** for rank-based listing limits and permission tiers ### Compatible With * EssentialsX Economy * GemsEconomy * CMI Economy * Any other Vault-compatible economy plugin ![vault](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vault-Required-f7c948?style=flat-square) ![luckperms](https://img.shields.io/badge/LuckPerms-Recommended-8e6cff?style=flat-square) ![yaml](https://img.shields.io/badge/Data-YAML-4caf50?style=flat-square) *** ## 🔌 Compatibility | 🔧 Integration |✅ Status |📋 Notes | | ------------------- |-------------- |------------------------------------------------- | | Vault |✅ Required |Economy bridge for balance, withdraw, and deposit | | Paper 1.21.1 |✅ Required |Primary supported platform | | Purpur |✅ Compatible |Paper fork fully supported | | Spigot 1.21.1 |✅ Compatible |Bukkit/Spigot API supported | | Bukkit 1.21.1 |✅ Compatible |Bukkit API supported | | LuckPerms |⭐ Recommended |Per-rank listing slot tiers | | EssentialsX Economy |✅ Full support |Via Vault | | GemsEconomy |✅ Full support |Via Vault | | CMI Economy |✅ Full support |Via Vault | | Any Vault economy |✅ Full support |If it hooks Vault, it works | > ⚠️ **Required:** Vault + any Vault-compatible economy plugin > ⭐ **Recommended:** LuckPerms for per-rank listing tiers *** ## 🌍 Multi-World & Multiverse Support (NEW) > Fully integrated multi-world auction house system built for modern server networks. ### 🌐 Multiverse Integration * ✅ Full support for **Multiverse-Core** * Works seamlessly across multiple worlds * Automatically detects world context for listings and browsing ### 🗺️ Auction House Modes * **Global Auction House** * One shared AH across all worlds * **Per-World Auction Houses** * Each world has its own independent AH * **Group-Based Auction Houses (NEW)** * Link multiple worlds to share the same AH ### 🔗 World Grouping System * Create custom world groups inside config * Example: * `world`, `world_nether`, `world_the_end` → share one Auction House * `spawn` → separate Auction House * Full flexibility for: * Survival clusters * Lobby vs gameplay separation * Game-mode specific economies ### ⚙️ Configuration Control * Enable / disable AH per world * Assign worlds to groups easily * Switch between: * Global * Per-world * Group-based modes * Fully configurable inside `config.yml` *** ## ⚙️ Improvements (Latest Update) * Improved backend handling for **multi-world environments** * Optimized **auction syncing across worlds and groups** * Better performance in **large multi-server setups** * Cleaner and more scalable **configuration structure** *** ## 🛠️ Fixes (Latest Update) * Fixed auctions not syncing correctly between worlds * Resolved GUI inconsistencies in multi-world setups * General bug fixes and stability improvements ## ⚙️ Configuration > 100% customizable - nothing is hardcoded. Core values live in `config.yml`, GUI layout lives in `gui.yml`, and all text lives in `messages.yml`. ``` general: prefix: "&8[&bCrown &3Economy&8] &r" currency-symbol: "$" decimal-places: 2 auction-house: enabled: true max-auction-house-listings: 0 max-transaction-history: 0 min-price: 1.0 max-price: 1000000.0 default-duration-hours: 0 max-duration-hours: 168 tax-rate: 5.0 auto-save-seconds: 60 expiry-check-seconds: 60 return-check-seconds: 60 listing-limits: - permission: "crowneconomy.admin" limit: 100 - permission: "crowneconomy.ah.maxlistings.mvp" limit: 20 - permission: "crowneconomy.ah.maxlistings.vip" limit: 10 - permission: "default" limit: 5 ``` ### 🎨 What You Can Customize * 🖼️ Every **GUI title, filler material, button icon, slot, and border element** * 💬 Every **player-facing message** - full `&` color codes and `{placeholders}` throughout * 💰 **Min/max listing price**, **tax rate**, **listing duration**, **global listing cap**, **transaction history cap** * 🏅 **Per-rank listing limits** via permissions * 🔘 **Module toggles** - enable or disable the AH independently * 🚫 **Material blacklist** - block any item by name, keep your economy clean * 🏷️ **Prefix and currency formatting** - customize the default branding and money display *** ## 📋 Commands | 💬 Command |📖 Description |🔐 Permission | | ------------------ |---------------------------- |---------------------- | | /ah |Open the Auction House |crowneconomy.ah.open | | /ah help |Show AH help |(any player) | | /ah sell <price> |List your held item for sale |crowneconomy.ah.sell | | /ah search <query> |Search all active listings |crowneconomy.ah.search | | /ah mylistings |View your own listings |crowneconomy.ah.open | | /ah cancel <id> |Cancel one of your listings |crowneconomy.ah.cancel | | /ah refresh |Refresh the open menu |crowneconomy.ah.open | | /ce |Show CrownEconomy help |(any player) | | /ce help |Show the command help |(any player) | | /ce reload |Reload the plugin config |crowneconomy.reload | | /ce refresh |Refresh the plugin |crowneconomy.refresh | | /ce version |Show plugin version & status |(any player) | **Aliases:** `/auctionhouse` · `/ceconomy` · `/ce` *** ## 🔐 Permissions | 🔑 Permission |👤 Default |📋 Description | | ------------------------------- |---------- |----------------------------- | | crowneconomy.ah.open |true |Open the Auction House GUI | | crowneconomy.ah.sell |true |List items for sale | | crowneconomy.ah.bid |true |Purchase listings | | crowneconomy.ah.cancel |true |Cancel own listings | | crowneconomy.ah.cancel.others |op |Cancel any listing (staff) | | crowneconomy.ah.search |true |Use live search | | crowneconomy.ah.maxlistings.vip |false |VIP - 10 listing slots | | crowneconomy.ah.maxlistings.mvp |false |MVP - 20 listing slots | | crowneconomy.admin |op |Full admin access + 100 slots | | crowneconomy.reload |op |Reload config via command | | crowneconomy.refresh |op |Refresh plugin state | *** ## 🛠️ Installation > ⏱️ Up and running in under 5 minutes. 1. 🖥️ Ensure you're running **Paper, Purpur, Spigot, or Bukkit 1.21.1** or a compatible fork 2. 🏦 Install **Vault** and a Vault economy plugin such as EssentialsX Economy, GemsEconomy, or CMI Economy 3. 🔐 _(Recommended)_ Install **LuckPerms** for rank-based listing limits 4. 📂 Drop `CrownEconomy.jar` into your `/plugins/` folder 5. 🔄 Start or restart your server 6. ✏️ Edit `plugins/CrownEconomy/config.yml`, `gui.yml`, and `messages.yml` to your liking 7. ▶️ Use `/ce reload` or `/ce refresh` to apply changes > ⚠️ **Reload note:** `/ce reload` reloads configuration and refreshes the plugin state. Active listing data is **not** wiped. *** ## 🗂️ Data Storage > 💾 Your listings are always safe - CrownEconomy saves on every action. * ✅ Saved on every listing **create**, **purchase**, **cancel**, and **expiry** * ✅ Saved on every clean **server shutdown** * ✅ Persisted in `plugins/CrownEconomy/auction-data.yml` * ✅ Auto-save, expiry checks, and return checks run in the background * 📌 No database setup required *** ## 🚧 Roadmap > CrownEconomy is just getting started. The full economy suite is on the way. | 🔮 Module |📋 Description |🚦 Status | | ----------------- |---------------------------------------- |---------- | | 🏛️ Auction House |Full-featured server marketplace |✅ Released | | 🛒 Player Shop |Chest or GUI shops with auto-restock |🔄 Planned | | 💱 Trading System |Secure face-to-face player trades |🔄 Planned | | 🏦 Bank System |Account interest, shared balances |🔄 Planned | | 📊 Economy Stats |Server leaderboards, transaction history |🔄 Planned | *** ## 🎯 Perfect For * 🌲 **Survival servers** - give players a real marketplace to trade resources * 👥 **SMP servers** - the go-to economy layer for any multiplayer survival experience * ⚔️ **Factions servers** - control the economy with taxes, blacklists, and rank limits * 🧙 **RPG servers** - fits naturally into any custom economy and progression system * 🏙️ **Towny servers** - player-driven markets with full Vault integration * 💎 **Donor-tier servers** - reward VIPs and MVPs with more listing slots automatically *** ## 💬 Support & Community > 🙋 Need help? title: The Spell Library
description: A code-driven library that provides developer-friendly utilities. It serves as a solid foundation for creating highly customizable spells and rituals.
body:
This library provides useful tools to develop spells and rituals, with an integrated mana and scroll system. **This mod is currently in alpha**

## Currently Provided

- **Mana system:** Mana regeneration is based on the player's current health. Lower health results in a lower mana regeneration rate.

- **Scrolls:** Spells are found in the form of scrolls. By default, all registered spells are added to scrolls. These scrolls are items that can be used to cast the spell they contain.

- **The Decryptor:** In survival mode, scrolls are encrypted when found. To decrypt one, you must place it in the Decryptor. Once decrypted, it becomes readable only by you. Other players must decrypt it themselves. However, scrolls can still be used while encrypted, at your own risk. In creative mode, all scrolls are readable.

- **Rituals:** This mod also provides a ritual system with ticking and phase management. Rituals can be triggered by spells or other code. They are useful for multi-phase spells or those that require NBT data.

## Planned Features

- Spell Book

title: NeoAuthMe
description: An AuthMeReloaded fork that aims to adapt 1.21.10’s new async login pipeline.
body:
# NeoAuthMe 6.1.0

**The best authentication plugin for Paper 1.21.11+!**

## ⚠️ Important Notice

**This version requires server software version 1.21.11 or later.** **Only Paper 1.21.11+ is guaranteed to work and receive support.** Other server software (Spigot, Bukkit, Folia, Purpur, and other Bukkit/Spigot-based forks) may work but are not officially supported and will not receive bug fixes or support for issues specific to those platforms.

**⚠️ This plugin will NOT work on:**
- Server software versions below 1.21.11
- Forge, Fabric, or other mod loaders

## 📖 Description

Prevent username stealing on your server! NeoAuthMe is a powerful authentication plugin that secures your Offline mode server or increases your Online mode server's protection.

NeoAuthMe disallows players who aren't authenticated to perform actions like placing blocks, moving, typing commands, or using the inventory. It can also kick players with uncommonly long or short player names or kick players from banned countries.

## ✨ Key Features

### 🔐 Security & Authentication
- **Username spoofing protection** - Prevents account theft
- **E-Mail Recovery System** - Recover lost passwords via email
- **Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)** - TOTP support for extra security
- **Session Login** - Stay logged in across server restarts
- **ForceLogin Feature** - Admins can login to any account via console command
- **Avoid "Logged in from another location" messages**

### 🤖 Anti-Bot System
- **Built-in AntiBot System** - Automatically detects and prevents bot attacks
- **Countries Whitelist/Blacklist** - GeoIP-based access control
- **IP-based restrictions** - Associate usernames with IPs

### 💾 Database & Storage
- **MySQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB support**
- **Cached database queries** - Optimized performance
- **Custom MySQL tables/columns** - Useful for forum database integration
- **Automatic database backup** - Never lose your data
- **Built-in database converter** - Convert between database types easily

### 🔄 Migration & Import
- **Import from other plugins**: Rakamak, xAuth, CrazyLogin, RoyalAuth, vAuth
- **FlatFile to SQL converter** - Migrate from old auths.db format
- **Multiple password hash support** - Compatible with various forum systems

### 🌍 Localization
- **Editable translations and messages** - Full customization
- **Multiple language support** - See [translations list](https://github.com/Yur1nn/NeoAuthMe/blob/master/docs/translations.md)
- **Custom message files** - Create your own translations

### 🔧 Advanced Features
- **Inventory protection** - Protect player inventory until authentication (requires ProtocolLib)
- **Quit location saving** - Restore player position on login
- **Compatible with Citizens2, CombatTag, CombatTagPlus**
- **Compatible with Minecraft mods** like BuildCraft and RedstoneCraft
- **Multiple password encryption algorithms**: SHA256, ARGON2, BCRYPT, PBKDF2, and more
- **Forum integration support**: PHPBB, VBulletin, Xenforo, MyBB, IPB3, IPB4, WordPress, and more

## 📋 Requirements

- **Java 21+** (required)
- **Paper 1.21.11 or later** (REQUIRED - only officially supported platform)
- **Minecraft 1.21.11+** (required)
- ProtocolLib (optional, required for some features like inventory protection)

**Note:** This plugin is officially supported only on Paper 1.21.11+. Other server software (Spigot, Bukkit, Folia, Purpur, and other Bukkit/Spigot-based forks) may work but are not guaranteed and will not receive support for platform-specific issues.

## 🔗 Links

- **GitHub**: [Yur1nn/NeoAuthMe](https://github.com/Yur1nn/NeoAuthMe)
- **Documentation**: 
  - [Configuration Guide](https://github.com/Yur1nn/NeoAuthMe/blob/master/docs/config.md)
  - [Command List](https://github.com/Yur1nn/NeoAuthMe/blob/master/docs/commands.md)
  - [Permission Nodes](https://github.com/Yur1nn/NeoAuthMe/blob/master/docs/permission_nodes.md)
- **Support**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Yur1nn/NeoAuthMe/issues)

## 🎮 Quick Start

1. Download the JAR file
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Start your server (Paper 1.21.11+)
4. Configure NeoAuthMe in `plugins/NeoAuthMe/config.yml`
5. Players will need to register and login to play!

## 📝 What's New in 6.1.0

- ✅ Updated to Paper 1.21.11+ API compatibility

## 📝 What's New in 6.0.1

- ✅ Removed version-specific branching logic - Simplified codebase
- ✅ Single-branch workflow - Easier maintenance
- ✅ Code cleanup - Removed unused methods and simplified comments
- ✅ Improved maintainability

## 📝 What's New in 6.0.0

- ✅ Updated to Paper 1.21.11+ API compatibility
- ✅ Switched to `AsyncPlayerSpawnLocationEvent` for better performance
- ✅ All plugin references renamed to NeoAuthMe
- ✅ Improved teleportation handling for new Paper API
- ✅ Better thread safety and event handling

## 📜 License

GNU GPL v3.0 - See LICENSE file for details

---

**Note**: This is a fork of AuthMeReloaded, updated and maintained for Paper 1.21.11+ by Yur1nn.

title: Overgeared Recipes
description: Compatibility recipes for Overgeared
body:
# Overgeared – Mod Compatibility Datapack

This datapack adds **recipe compatibility** for **[Overgeared](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/overgeared)**, integrating items and materials from other mods into Overgeared’s progression and crafting systems in a consistent, intuitive way.

The idea is to make Overgeared **play nicely with a broader mod ecosystem**, without breaking immersion or player expectations.

***

## Features

*   Adds Overgeared-compatible recipes for items from supported mods
*   Focuses on logical integrations rather than aggressive rebalancing
*   Lightweight datapack — no scripts, no performance impact
*   Safe to add to existing worlds

***

## Supported Mods

This datapack currently adds compatibility for:

*   **Apotheosis**
*   **Aquaculture 2**
*   **Aquaculture Delight**
*   **Archbows**
*   **Dungeon’s Delight**
*   **\[Let’s Do\] Farm & Charm**
*   **\[Let’s Do\] Herbal Brews**
*   **Farmer’s Delight**
*   **Hardcore Torches**
*   **Iron’s Spells and Spellbooks**
*   **Jaden’s Nether Expansion Delight**
*   **Locks – Unofficial**
*   **Minecraft Comes Alive**
*   **Macaw’s Roofs**
*   **Macaw’s Windows**
*   **Some Minecraft recipes that use iron**
*   **Jaden’s Nether Expansions**
*   **Nether’s Delight**
*   **No Tree Punching**
*   **Runic Enchanting**
*   **Realm RPG: Sea Dwellers**
*   **Smallships**
*   **Thin Air**
*   **Tough As Nails**
*   **TheDragon’s Traps Mod**

***

## Requirements

*   **Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1**
*   **Overgeared** mod

***

## Installation

### Singleplayer

1.  Download the .zip file from this website
2.  Open your Minecraft saves folder
3.  Place the datapack folder into:  
    `saves/<your_world_name>/datapacks/`
4.  Place the datapack also into the resourcepack folder and select it for loading (this will update the language files for tool types)
    `minecraft/resourcepacks/`
5.  Launch the world
6.  Run `/reload` or re-enter the world
7.  Confirm installation with `/datapack list`

### Multiplayer / Server

1.  Stop the server
2.  Place the datapack folder into:  
    `<server_root>/world/datapacks/`
4.  Place the datapack also into the resourcepack folder and select it for loading (this will update the language files for tool types)
    `<server_root>/resourcepacks/`
3.  Start the server
4.  Run `/reload` if the world is already loaded

***

## Configuration

For certain mod compatibilities, I've included new tool types for blueprints, however Overgeared requires the configuration file to be updated with this new list, which this datapack cannot overwrite.

To configure this, go to your instance folder and navigate to config and look for overgeared-common.toml.
In there, look for a line that contains `availableToolTypes` and replace the entire value after the `=` sign with this:

`["sword", "axe", "pickaxe", "shovel", "hoe", "knife", "fillet_knife", "machete", "cleaver", "mattock", "bow", "helmet", "chestplate", "leggings", "boots", "horse_armor"]`

***

## Issues & Contributions

If you encounter:

*   Missing integrations
*   Recipe conflicts
*   Balance concerns
*   Suggestions for additional mod support

Feel free to open an **issue** or submit a **pull request**.

Contributions are welcome!

***

## License

This project is licensed under the **MIT License**.

You are free to:

*   Use it in modpacks
*   Modify it
*   Redistribute it
*   Fork it for your own projects

As long as you include the original license and copyright notice.  
See the `LICENSE` file for full details.

***

## Credits

*   **stirdrem** — Author of Overgeared mod
*   All supported mod authors for their excellent work

***

title: MedievalCreate
description: Vanilla + Create modpack with medieval mods
body:
This modpack includes a variety of medieval-themed mods along with the Create mod. It's designed for multiplayer gameplay with friends, perfect for medieval roleplay with factions, trade, warfare, and more.

###  Realistic Seasons
- Experience seasonal changes that affect your farming and body temperature:
  
- Spring & Fall: Best time to plant carrots and potatoes and perfect temperature
  
- Summer: Ideal for wheat and onions but really warm
  
- Winter: Perfect to grow cabbage but really cold
  
- Manage your food supply wisely, your army and your workers will need the food

###  Automation with Create & Workers

body:
# [ZH] Happy-Yes-Wathe (HYW) 

为 Wathe 提供更多可配置项，打造更轻松、更具自定义活力的阳光游戏体验。

## 功能特性

### 1. 高度自定义
- **解除锁定**：解锁被原模组强制锁定的视距 (Render Distance)、亮度 (Brightness) 等设置（亦可根据需求重新锁定）。
- **参数调整**：自由调整平民 (Civilian)、义警 (Vigilante)、杀手 (Killer) 的体力上限、体力恢复速度及全局移动速度。
- **按键解锁**：可配置解锁原版强制禁用的聊天栏、指令栏 (`UNLOCK_CHAT_AND_COMMAND`) 及跳跃功能。

### 2. 多地图适配支持
尝试为完全自定义的地图提供支持，不再局限于原版的列车地图。
- **原版模式 (Original)**：检测玩家是否处于原定准备区域。
- **简单自定义 (Simple_Custom)**：通过手持特定物品切换准备状态。
- **严格自定义 (Strict_Custom)**：需同时满足上述两种条件方可准备。
*注意：目前适配功能仍在测试中，已知问题包括准备人数显示异常、严格模式判断失效及部分翻译键缺失。*

### 3. 动态多语言环境
- **自助润色**：初次运行将自动解压语言文件至配置目录，支持玩家手动修改翻译。
- **内置支持**：由 AI 辅助提供繁体中文、日语、英语的完整支持。

### 4. 更多功能
- **金币补给**：当游戏接近结束时（如 3:25），为所有玩家发放可配置数量的金币以加速对局。支持“严格模式”（仅匹配一次特定时间）或“宽松模式”（匹配所有符合后缀的时间点，如XX3:25）。
- **其他**：待增加

---

> **另**：本 Mod 的缩写衍生自中文互联网的一个迷因，请不要过度在意。本模组几乎完全由AI生成，如果您打算使用这个模组，请充分理解这一点。


# [EN] Happy-Yes-Wathe (HYW) 



Providing more configuration options for Wathe to create a more relaxed, sunny, and customizable gaming experience.

## Features

### 1. High Customization
- **Unlock Restrictions**: Unlock settings forced by the original mod, such as Render Distance and Brightness (can be re-locked if needed).
- **Attribute Adjustments**: Freely adjust the Max Sprint Time, regen speed, and global movement speed for Civilians, Vigilantes, and Killers.
- **Key Unlocking**: Configurable options to unlock the Chat/Command bar (`UNLOCK_CHAT_AND_COMMAND`) and Jumping functionality.

### 2. Multi-Map Adaptation
Attempting to provide support for fully custom maps, not limited to the original train map.
- **Original Mode**: Detects if players are within the default preparation area.
- **Simple_Custom**: Toggle ready status by holding specific items.
- **Strict_Custom**: Requires both conditions to be met simultaneously to be ready.
*Note: Adaptation features are currently in testing. Known issues include incorrect ready-player counts, Strict Mode logic failures, and missing translation keys.*

### 3. Multi-language Support
- **Player Refinement**: Language files are automatically extracted to the config directory on the first run, allowing players to modify translations manually.
- **Built-in Support**: Full support for Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and English, assisted by AI.

### 4. More Features
- **Gold Subsidy**: Grants a configurable amount of gold to all players as the game nears its end (e.g., at 3:25) to accelerate the match. Supports "Strict Mode" (matches specific time once) or "Loose Mode" (matches all applicable timestamps).
- **Others**: To be added.

---

> **P.S.**: The abbreviation of this mod is derived from a meme on the Chinese internet; please don't take it too seriously.This mod is generated almost entirely by AI. If you intend to use this mod, please proceed with a full understanding of this fact.

title: ChatAnnouncementPlugin
description: Lightweight Bukkit/Spigot plugin for sending periodic chat announcements with configurable messages, delay, random/sequential order, and color support.
body:
# 📢 ChatAnnouncementPlugin

**ChatAnnouncementPlugin** is a lightweight, customizable Minecraft plugin that automatically sends periodic chat announcements to all players. Perfect for welcoming players, sharing tips, or promoting server events.

---

## 📦 Features

- ✅ **Configurable Messages** — Add as many announcement lines as you want in `config.yml`.
- ⏱️ **Custom Delay** — Choose how often announcements are sent.
- 🔀 **Random or Sequential** — Send messages in order or pick them randomly.
- 🎨 **Color Code Support** — Use `&a`, `&b`, etc. for colored and formatted messages.
- 🔄 **Hot Reload** — Reload messages and settings without restarting the server using `/chapreload`.
- 🧩 **Highly Compatible** — Works with Bukkit 1.1-R5 and later, including Spigot, Paper, and forks.

---

## 🔧 Commands

| Command        | Description                              |
|----------------|------------------------------------------|
| `/chapreload`  | Reloads the plugin’s configuration file. |

---

## 🛡️ Permissions

| Permission           | Description                              | Default |
|----------------------|------------------------------------------|---------|
| `chap.reload`        | Allows the player to reload the config.  | `op`    |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

```yaml
# ChatAnnouncementPlugin configuration
messages:
  - "&aWelcome to the server!"
  - "&bRemember to join our Discord!"
  - "&eVote daily for rewards!"

# Delay in seconds between announcements
delay: 60

# If true, messages are picked randomly; if false, they are in order
random: false

title: SmokeShow
description: Click a lit Campfire/Soul Campfire, Torch/Wall Torch with any of the 16 vanilla dyes and watch the smoke snap into that color. Hold sneak while dyeing to switch that column of smoke into rainbow party mode. Cancel smoke key to clear all smoke particles.
body:
**SmokeShow** – Right-click a lit Campfire, Soul Campfire, Torch or Wall Torch with any of the 16 vanilla dyes and watch the smoke instantly snap into that colour. One tap and your cosy little chimney is firing neon blue, deep crimson, or whatever suits the build. Hold sneak while dyeing to switch that column of smoke into rainbow party mode, smoothly cycling through bright hues that look awesome in bases, paths, mini-games or birthday worlds, straight-up eye candy.

Try combining two separate dye colors to blend new colors, letting you create extra shades beyond the vanilla set (purple-leaning blues, warmer oranges, softer greens, etc.)

Lay down coloured or rainbow torches along your paths and tunnels so you never get lost again: blue trail to the ice base, green to the farms, purple to the End portal, rainbow torches everywhere.

Each dye also spawns a little burst of sparkles and sound, giving players clear feedback that their colour has been applied. There’s a “stop all smoke” key (default Page Down) that cancels all smoke rendering on your client, and putting a campfire out with a shovel wipes the tint clean so you can experiment like crazy without wrecking your builds.

SmokeShow is lightweight and friendly as client-side only or client-and-server, and is designed to feel like a natural extension of vanilla Minecraft. No menus to learn: if you can place a campfire and right-click with dye, you already know how to use it.

Perfect for family servers, creative worlds, classroom builds, YouTube maps – anyone who wants more magic and colour floating up from their campfires and torches. With 16 dye colours plus animated rainbow smoke, a few smartly placed campfires and torches turn your world into a glowing network of coloured waypoints in the sky. Screenshots honestly don’t do it justice – seeing the smoke and torches pulsing with colour and rainbow swirls as you run through your world looks freakin’ amazing. Drop it in and start decorating the sky.

Try different Textures packs the results might be cool 😉 
/Smokeshow clear to remove all colour or delete SmokeShow folder in yourworld\Minecraft\Data to reset. Leave comments/feedback on YT comments section, video below.

title: Jurassic Fantasy
description: Adds four new dinosaurs... Or, to be more precise, dinosaur hybrids. And some utilities and equipment as well!
body:
Have you ever imagined what hybrids of dinosaurs and modern animals would look like? Well, this mod is an answer! In the vast world of Minecraft, you will find:
* **Butterflodoc**. Literally, a six-legged sauropod with butterfly wings. This mob is peaceful and cute, but it will defend himself if you try to kill him. 
  Moreover, it drops nothing. To get its loot, you need to right click on him with Brush once a minute. It can drop either Butterflodoc Dust or Butterflodoc Scale. You can eat this Dust or use it as a potion ingredient to get Butterflight effect. Under this effect, you can press U very frequently, and with each tap, you will be pushed upwards. Butterflodoc Scale Armor provides this effect constantly when full set is equipped.
  You cannot tame Butterflodoc but can ride him whenever you want. Press U to make it fly up. You can breed them using Spore Blossom as well.
* **Triparrotops**. This mob is also peacefull... Well, not at all. It will attack if you sprint nearby it. You can also shear it once a minute to get feathers. Triparrotops can be breeded with Glow Berries. It drops its meat and horns. Horns can be transformed into bones. Moreover, they are used as ingredients for Bone Dagger or Bone Glaive.
* **Tigertaurus**. Rapid and ruthless, this mob will attack you and other animals. However, you can turn it into your trusty friend using Triparrotops meat. When tamed, this mob will obey orders given by Horn, Bone Dagger or Bone Glaive. It can follow you, sit or wander around protecting you. When killed, it will drop its horns and hide. Stripped Hide Armor will make all the tigertaurus neutral towards you. When full set equipped, you also get lifesteal which restores 1 HP each time you attack.
* **Spinobear**. Even more deadly than the previous one. It cannot be tamed, but if you give it a bottle of honey, for one minute it will become so calm that you can ride it. You can also breed them using Honey Blocks. When killed, it will drop its cresc. Using this cresc and warped stem and planks, you can craft Spinobear Raft which is much faster than usual boat.

I don't know if the mod will be developed further. I'm planning to add some realistic cretacious dinosaur fauna, but it will be released as another project.

MCAutoRestart — продвинутый плагин для автоматического перезапуска Minecraft сервера с гибкими настройками. Плагин позволяет настроить перезапуск сервера по расписанию или интервалу, с полностью настраиваемыми оповещениями, поддержкой нескольких языков и удобным управлением.

- **Гибкие настройки оповещений**: настройка времени, частоты и заблаговременных предупреждений
- **Команды управления**: включение/отключение перезапусков, установка времени и интервалов, немедленный перезапуск

### 🛠️ Команды
- `/autorestart enable` - Включить автоматический перезапуск
- `/autorestart disable` - Отключить автоматический перезапуск
- `/autorestart status` - Просмотр статуса и времени до следующего перезапуска
- `/autorestart set time HH:MM` - Установить фиксированное время перезапуска (добавляет новое время в список)
- `/autorestart set interval <часы>` - Установить интервал перезапуска в часах (1-24)
- `/autorestart reload` - Перезагрузить конфигурацию плагина
- `/autorestart now` - Выполнить немедленный перезапуск сервера (требует подтверждения)

### 🔒 Права доступа
- `mcautorestart.admin` - Доступ ко всем командам плагина (по умолчанию для операторов)

### ⚙️ Конфигурация и преимущества
- **Удобная конфигурация**: все настройки в одном файле `config.yml`
- **Мультиязычность**: встроенная поддержка русского, английского, немецкого и испанского языков
- **Открытый исходный код**: возможность изучить и модифицировать плагин под свои нужды
- **Низкое потребление ресурсов**: оптимизированный код, не влияющий на производительность сервера
- **Совместимость**: работает с большинством версий Minecraft и популярных серверных платформ
- **Простота использования**: минимальные настройки для начала работы, понятный интерфейс команд

### 📢 Управление оповещениями
- Включение/отключение всех оповещений
- Настройка максимального времени предупреждения
- Гибкая настройка интервалов оповещений (в минутах и секундах до перезапуска)

### 📦 Исходный код
Исходный код плагина доступен на GitHub: [https://gitlab.com/OccupiedNine220/MCAutoRestart](https://gitlab.com/OccupiedNine220/MCAutoRestart)

## 📋 Description
MCAutoRestart is an advanced plugin for automatic Minecraft server restart with flexible settings. The plugin allows you to schedule server restarts by interval or specific times, with fully customizable notifications, multi-language support, and convenient control.

### ✨ Key Features
- **Two operation modes**:
  - **Interval mode**: restart every X hours (e.g., every 4 hours)

title: Surface Ore Pebbles
description: Adds small pebbles that occasionally generate on the surface above vanilla ores such as copper, lapis, gold, iron and diamond. When you find these diamonds, there will always be a pocket of ore somewhere below the pebble.
body:
## Summary:

This mod adds new "Ore Pebbles" which will generate on the surface above their corresponding ores. 

These will only generate occasionally; NOT over every ore pocket. The more rare the ore, the more rare the pebble.

They will only generate above overworld ores in stone layers and include copper, iron, gold, redstone, lapis and diamond.

Breaking the pebble will give a chance to get that ore or gem as well, but it is only about 50/50. They may also drop nuggets.

If you find a pebble, there will almost always be a pocket of ore straight down, anywhere from 6 to 48 blocks below the pebble.

These pebbles do not generate above deepslate ores or in water.

## Inspiration:

This was inspired in part by the game Vintage Story, which has a similar mechanic. It was also inspired (as I am sure Vintage story was as well) by how real-world ores are often located; by surface deposits that can be seen without digging. Prospectors would then start to mine the area near where surface deposits were found in hopes of locating a richer vein of ore.

## Vanilla Integration:

This game adds 6 new blocks, each one meant to look like a pebble made out of its corresponding ore.

It does NOT alter ore generation, ore drops, or any other in game mechanics.

It will make finding ores easier and one could acquire a diamond without a pickaxe becasue no special tool is needed to mine out the pebbles.

## Remember: Never dig straight down!

## And good luck!

title: HardCraft
description: A mod that makes minecraft harder
body:
This mod adds new mechanics that make basic Minecraft playthrough more difficult. At the moment is in BETA testing.

# Mechanics

## Block armor
In this mod zombies and skeletons can wear blocks as armor. If you have the normal mode of the mod, you will not be able to get a mob with a strong block at the beginning of the game, but on the hard mode zombies with obsidian can appear at the beginning.![Zombie and skeletons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78131e0c25f3fb6bfd4181236e7fbc10db715349_0.webp)

## Regeneration and blood
Now regenerating health through eating food doesn't work. Now regeneration happens if you have enough blood or with the help of medicine. If the blood values are low, you will die.

- **Plantain** - grows in the forest. Stops the bleeding.
- **Bandage** - created from wool and thread. Can be used 4 times. Stops the bleeding.
- **Medicinal mixture** - brewed in the Brewing Stand from plantain. Regenerates 0.5 hearts.
- **Syringe** - created in Brewing Stand from golden apple. Regenerates 2 hearts.
- **Medical kit** - created from Medicinal mixture, syringe, bandages. Can be used 2 times. Regenerates 3 hearts and stops the bleeding.![Items for HP regeneration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83e5092dec5fe2ff598cfeb410538c900e97da28.png)

## Mob effect
With some chance, mobs will receive amplified effects.

## Hot Core
Now being at the depth of a mine or in the nether is not safe and the player will start to burn. To save the player can use a fire resistance potion or Ice armor.

## Hidden traps
Just walking through the forest can also be dangerous, as there are traps with dynamite and a potion dispenser. There are also traps from the End that can also ruin your day.![Potion trap](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a681bc4de963830e00473bcc63ecc5abb24728d6.png)

## Custom Craft
Now some of the recipes have been changed.

## Acid Rain
Now even the morning rain is dangerous because someone has added acid to the rains.

## Meteorite
You still think flying rocks aren't dangerous? Now meteorites will fall from the sky. In hard mode meteorites will spawn more often. You can also turn off the meteorite drops![Meteorite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e7d73672938181768285f5c44ec7bed91b02e4b_0.webp).

## Parasite
Now drowning in water can lead to poisoning and a parasite. To prevent the parasite from killing you, you must take an antidote.

## Strange mixture
Do you want to become strong to defend yourself against endless waves of monsters? For this purpose I added Strange mixture, but there is one problem with the mixture...

## Dark night
Sometimes the night can be dark, making it hard to see and the mobs stronger.

## Bedrock ore and drill
Now in Bedrock you can find ore that will be mined forever! But for this you need a special drill together with the drill head.![Bedrock drill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06f7eba0291063ae096e2a88fb3c553761f0d1a1.png)

# Mobs

## Face

- HP : 1
- Damage : 5
- Speed : High
- XP : 3
![Face](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5704dcbb8769a5bbf4f8c6a00a5e6670bb2eb4c4_0.webp)

## Nether Face

- HP : 2
- Damage : 8
- Speed : High
- XP : 6
![Nether Face](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a69a5956cc7ba2d95708504e8463394528c3c88_0.webp)

title: Ghastbusters
description: Bust some ghosts with the Ghastbusters mod!
body:
This mod introduces tools and items from the Ghostbusters universe into Minecraft!

# **New items**

Get ready to bust some ghosts with the **_proton pack_**!

The proton pack locks enemies you shoot at in place and makes them glow if they're invisble! They consume proton charges which are stored in the pack!
_(You need the firing mechanism and the backpack to use it!)_

Search for ghosts using the _P.K.E. scanner!_

This item shows how close you are to nearby invisible entities. A great tool for finding those invisible friends during PVP!

See at night with the new _Etco Goggles_!

This piece of "fashionable" headware lets you see at night! But with the cost of a green overlay. 

## **Look the part!**

Rock the jumpsuits worn by one of the first movie's protagonists or your own!


# **New Rides**

Meet the Etco-1, the iconic car from the first Ghostbusters movie, and it's unfurnished sister the Etco-0. The Etco-1 is equipped with 4 slots for proton packs and their blasters!

# **More Storage!**

Meet your lockers! With slots to store your full getup and some busting equipment these are a must have for any Ghastbuster! They come in three variants; red, gray, and white.

The _Ghost Trap_ works like a shulker box that you can access through your inventory. 9 Extra spots right at your disposal!


# **Get slimed!**

Meet _Etcoplasm_ that strange green goop from the first movie. An extremely viscous fluid that sucks players into it's center!

Is regular etcoplasm too weak for you? Try _Supercharged Etcoplasm_! It flows rapidly and pulls mobs into the center. Players stuck in the goo report severe cases of blindness, nausea, slowness, and the inability to mine blocks.

Or try _Repulsive Etcoplasm_ a type of ectoplasm that pushes mobs away. It spreads really fast, so be careful with it!

# **Just the Beginning**

This mod will be constantly getting updates. So check back reguarly to get new changes.

**Support for full survival mode gameplay coming soon!**
_(Current Status: Partial)_

title: Dukette's Planks
description: This is a resourcepack that adjusts the textures of wood, being a reimagination of what it could be based on personal subjective taste, while still staying faithful to vanilla minecraft.
body: # Dukette's Planks --- ### Have you ever thought the vanilla wood blocks could use a reiteration? Does the consistent and even planks, with muted colors, bore you? Have you ever wanted to build with a certain wood type, but find the colors unappealing? Well, maybe this is for you! I am trying my best to remain vanilla in the texturing and coloring, while putting my own touch on all blocks wooden. My goals with this resourcepack is to fix small issues with the models and textures, giving them all slightly my shape, unique textures and colors that are more easily workable, while looking close to the original types. Fence posts and fence gates doesn't simply just copy a template of the normal plank texture; they have their own textures instead. The buttons look more like buttons, hinges will move when gates or doors gets opened or closed, planks will feel more as if someone used the wood they have laying around to build the blocks, and potentially more <3 --- ![Village 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gcNempaJ/images/1bdfe2cf1f3cb5abec8774a5f0fa1b54473b46ac.png) Plains village without the resourcepack, and with the resourcepack turned on. --- **Pictures showing progress of the resourcepack can be found by checking out the gallery <3** Do you want to feel like a knight, both with new armors and halberd tools? Do you want special mob armors? Then please check out my profile for more :D Are you looking for even more resourcepacks, or maybe skins, or one of my builds? Then check out my planetminecraft account! Other links:

title: Mini Build
description: a 16x resource pack that allows you to build miniature cities !
body:
## About

Mini Build lets you create miniature towns by replacing the texture of certain blocks with miniature facades, roofs, roads and plants ! So far, this pack contains 50 facade textures, 11 roof textures, 3 tree textures and 2 road texture.

This texture pack is far from finished, as I plan to add more architectural styles and new textures over time.



## Modified blocks list
### Building textures :

**Old buildings :**
- planks and slabs : acacia, bamboo, bamboo mosic, birch and oak
- sand : red sand, sand and suspicious sand
- terracotta : red, orange,  light gray and white
- glazed terracotta : brown, lime, orange, pink
- concrete powder : light blue, orange
- bone block
- bricks
- sandstone

**Modern buildings :**
- concrete blocks : black, blue, brown, cyan, gray, light gray, white, yellow and red
- concrete powder : black, blue, brown, cyan, gray, light gray, red and white
- terracota : basic and brown terracota
- quartz : pillar, bricks and chiseled block
- red sandstone
- birch log
- brown mushroom block
- mushroom stem
- calcite
- polished diorite
- white glazed terracotta

### Roof textures :
- black, cyan, light blue, gray, brown, red, orange, white, green, light grey and lime wool

### Road texture :
- dark oak and acacia log

### Tree textures :
- allium, dandelion and lilac



## Warning

This texture pack is for construction only, not for play ! I also recommend using it in a superflat world.

Lastly, I recommend always placing glazed terracotta between two other buildings, as their texture changes rotation from one side to the other.

# StrikeTeam Utils ``A better way to handle Minecraft Teams 🫂`` **StrikeTeamUtils** is a plugin made to help you handle scoreboard teams easier.
It allows you to teleport a whole team, enable glow, mass adding players to teams and much much more.

_Notice! [parameter] means required, (parameter) means optional_ * **/tu create [TeamName] [Color]** - Creates a new team with these settings. ➕ * **/tu remove [TeamName]** - Removes a team. ➖ * **/tu addPlayer [TeamName] [Player]** - Adds a player to the team. * **/tu organizeplayers** - Add each online player to a random team 🎲 * **/tu addPlayer [TeamName] [Player]** - Add specific player to a specific team. 🙍‍♂️ * **/tu tpTeam [TeamName] [Player]** - Teleports a specific team to the player. 🔭
