body:
![Warsenal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0641c7c15eed7f9d9d98396d27bd562c11e6663.png)

Warne's Arsenal (or Warsenal) was made with the mentality of quality over quantity, meaning that each weapon was designed with special care and individual purpose. No weapon was added without heavy thought and indepth mechanics to make them all feel unique and connected in a satisfying way.

![Weapons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eaec7afa3942af5621b8d3a37d85def5aea79ad0.png)

As stated before, each weapon or feature has many indepth mechanics, and not all interactions a weapon has will be listed. Keep that in mind while playing as you might encounter new things a weapon can do while experimenting.

### Ignition Cutlass
- Found in nether fortress loot.
- Movement increases this weapon's heat overtime, attacking enemies will convert excess heat into additional damage.
- Moving slowly will also decrease your heat, so stay on the move to keep it up.
- Enchantable with Flamelash.
### Flail
- Found in mineshaft minecart chests rarely.
- Throw the flail to shoot it forward a short distance, before returning.
- If an entity is hit with the projectile, it sticks onto them until you pull it back. Pulling the flail off a player also reels them in slightly.
- Enchantable with Recuperation and Lengthen.
### Auric Katar
- Found in desert temples.
- Comboing attacks speeds up the attack speed and increase the damage with every consecutive hit. Caps at 5 attacks.
- Your combo resets if you do not land a fully charged hit for 3 seconds.
- Enchantable with Engage.
### Buckler
- Found in pillager-based structures.
- A light-weight alternative to the shield, allowing you to sprint while holding it up.
- Has only 3 hits of resistance before breaking, or breaks by being hit with a weapon. Parrying with quick timing resets your resistance count.
### Clunky Spade
- Found in trail ruins archeology.
- Can convert paths back into dirt alongside having additional range to attack.
- (If Carved is installed) Enchantable with Clinging

All Warsenal weapons do share some general properties, they are all unbreakable alongside being only enchantable with books. Keep this in mind when making weapon layouts or maxing your tools.

![Changes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc7904156765ce62a55217adbe678f33ccfc1ca4.png)

### Trident
- Tridents now have 0.5 attack range.
- Riptide now decreases air/water drag when used, shooting you further.

![Info](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec2e9ae373a1216b92a23cc24dce4905724fc71d.png)

A quick questionaire and explaination for some stuff regarding this mod and others. 

**Q: How can I tell you guys if there are any bugs?**

A: The link to our discord is right on this page, just join and contact one of us and let us know. We want to make sure our mods are bug-free.

**Q: What's up with the "(If ______ is installed)" features on mods?**

A: This is essentially just compatability between mods we make, however a majority of features added with this contingency are instead additional bonus content for each of these mods instead of conventional consistancy additions. Basically, you get more bonus content if you have the 2 specific mods installed.

**Q: Am I good to add or show this in my modpack/video?**

A: 100%, you don't need permission either, the only ask is that when our mod is included in a video that we are credited or a link to the mod is provided.

**Q: Is there anywhere I can get an even deeper review on this mod's features?**

A: Currently, we are planning to make a deep dive video into everything Warsenal. This includes development, smaller details and features and a background on each weapon alongside their individual purposes. Unfortunately, it's not done yet, but we will update this page to include it here once it's done!

title: Damage Correction
description: Smooths combat by compensating near-lethal damage, ensuring clean kills without altering core balance.
body:
# Damage Correction Mod

When a single attack is already enough to decide the outcome, this mod automatically fills in the small remaining difference, delivering a cleaner and smoother combat experience.

## Design Goals

Have you ever charged up a powerful attack for ages, only to see the enemy left with a tiny sliver of health?

Or lost the fight because a boss survived with just a bit of HP and turned the tables?

This mod exists exactly for those moments!

It evaluates the final damage result. If the damage dealt by the player is *almost* enough to kill a creature, the mod will make up the difference and finish the job.

Combat. Feels. Good.

## Mechanics

### Calculation Logic

* `finalDamage`: The final effective damage (after armor, enchantments, etc.)
* `healthBefore`: The target’s health before taking damage

```
IF
healthBefore > finalDamage
AND
healthBefore - finalDamage <= finalDamage * k
```

Where:

`k` determines how much remaining health (relative to the damage dealt) is considered close enough to trigger full damage correction.

### Example

* Monster health: 10
* Final damage dealt: 8

Remaining health: 2

With the default setting `k = 0.5`:

`2 <= 8 * 0.5  → True`

👉 An extra 2 damage is applied, instantly killing the monster.

But if the monster’s health is 20:

```
20 - 8 = 12
12 > 8 * 0.5 → False
```

👉 No correction is applied; damage is handled normally.

## Configuration

The following options can be modified in
`damage_correction-common.toml` under the `config` folder.

![this is a Mod config page image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0857c0ad766488df4adacd5f17ca5542f8105b38_0.webp)

title: VoidWorldGenerator
description: This is a simple plugin that allows you to create a void world!
body:
# VoidWorldGenerator (VWG)

**VoidWorldGenerator (VWG)** is a lightweight plugin that allows you to create completely void worlds — ideal for lobbies, minigames, or custom builds.

---

## Step 1: Install the Plugin

- Download the `VoidWorldGenerator.jar` file.
- Place it in your server’s `plugins` folder.

---

## Step 2: Restart the Server

- Restart (not reload) the server to load the plugin.

---

## Step 3: Configure World Generation

### Option A: Using Bukkit World Generation

1. Open your `bukkit.yml` file.
2. Add the following:

    ```yaml
    worlds:
      <WORLD_NAME>:
        generator: VoidWorldGenerator
    ```

3. Replace `<WORLD_NAME>` with the name of the world you want to generate.
4. Restart the server again to generate the world.

### Option B: Using Multiverse-Core

If you're using [Multiverse-Core](https://dev.bukkit.org/projects/multiverse-core), run the following command:

```bash
/mv create <WORLD_NAME> normal -g VoidWorldGenerator
```
---

## Step 4: Teleporting

### Option A: Bukkit World Generation

Run the following command:
```execute in minecraft:<WORLD_NAME> run tp @s 0 65 0 ```

### Option B: Using Multiverse-Core

Run the following command:
```mvtp <WORLD_NAME>```

---

If you need any further assistance, feel free to join the discord server!

title: Throw-a-TNT
description: Throw primed TNT from your inventory with a right click! Instead of placing tnt, you can now chuck it with customizable fuse time, and throw intensity!
body:
# Throwable TNT Plugin

**Version:** Paper/Spigot 1.21.5
**Author:** TomMustBe12

---

## Overview

This plugin adds a fun and chaotic new feature - **Throwable TNT**! Players can right-click while holding TNT to throw a primed TNT projectile. TNT is removed from the player’s inventory in Survival mode and explodes after a customizable short fuse.

Server admins can configure the TNT speed and fuse time, and players can toggle the feature on or off with simple commands.

---

## Features

- **Throw TNT by right-clicking** while holding TNT  
- Works in survival and creative and consumes one TNT per throw in survival
- **Primed TNT** is spawned and follows a realistic trajectory  
- Configurable **fuse duration** and **velocity multiplier**  
- OP controlled toggle with `/tnttoggle` for when not in use 
- Admin commands for global TNT settings  
- Full permission control for toggles and admin actions  
- Config means settings are persistent across reboots.

---

## Commands & Permissions

### `/tnttoggle`  
- Toggles throwable TNT on/off for the executing player  
- Permission: `throwabletnt.toggle` (default: OP only)

### `/tntspeed <speed>`  
- Sets the global speed multiplier for thrown TNT  
- Example: `/tntspeed 1.5`  
- Permission: `throwabletnt.admin` (default: OP only)

### `/tntfuse <ticks>`  
- Sets the global fuse time in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second)  
- Example: `/tntfuse 40` sets a 2-second fuse  
- Permission: `throwabletnt.admin` (default: OP only)

### `/throwabletnt reload`  
- Reloads the plugin’s configuration  
- Permission: `throwabletnt.admin` (default: OP only)

---

## Permissions Summary

| Permission             | Description                                  | Default |
|------------------------|----------------------------------------------|---------|
| `throwabletnt.toggle`  | Allows players to toggle throwable TNT       | OP only |
| `throwabletnt.admin`   | Allows configuring fuse/speed and reloading  | OP only |

---

## Usage Instructions

1. **Make sure you’re holding TNT in your hand.**  
2. **Right-click** (air or block) to throw the TNT.  
3. If you’re in **Survival mode**, one TNT will be removed from your inventory.  
4. The TNT will fly forward, then **explode** after the set fuse time.  
5. Use `/tnttoggle` to enable or disable your own throwable TNT usage.

---

## Example

```text
/tnttoggle          # Enables or disables throwable TNT for you
/tntspeed 2.0       # Sets the throw speed to double the normal velocity
/tntfuse 60         # Sets fuse time to 3 seconds
/throwabletnt reload  # Reloads config

title: IntuitiveAdjustableFog
description: A very simple spigot plugin that allows you to adjust the world fog that became (partially) controlled by the server in 1.18
body:
This is a very simple plugin that aims to allow server owners to customize the distance at which world fog appears. This is controlled by the server as of 1.18+.

The actual distance that the fog uses seems to be the minimum between the client's view distance and the server's view distance. This plugin modifies outgoing packets to tell the client that the server's render distance is higher than it actually is.

The only permission is `intuitiveadjustablefog.ignoreme`. Packets sent to players who have (or inherit) this permission will not be modified by this plugin.

## Dependencies:
- [PacketEvents](https://modrinth.com/plugin/packetevents)
- [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/)

### Inspiration:
This plugin is heavily inspired by the [ClearFog plugin](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/clearfog.98448/). I used that plugin on a 1.20.4 server but since it does not support 1.21, I had to reimplement its functionality into my own plugin when I updated.

A more modern take on [Creeper Confetti](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/creeper-confetti) and [Creeper Firework](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/creeper-firework) using gamerules and adding more  
configurable behavior. Additionally it works completely server-side and does not require  
clientside installation like _Creeper Firework,_ it also is more performant and configurable  
than the vanilla tweaks datapack and still allows for things like charged creepers dropping  
mob heads.  
  
  
  
# Usage
```
# Destroys blocks and damages entities according to mobGriefing gamerule, but also explodes a firework  
gamerule creeperExplosionBehavior FIREWORK_DESTROY_EXPLOSION  
  
# Creeper explodes normally but does not destroy nearby blocks, similar to mobGriefing=false, but also explodes a firework  
gamerule creeperExplosionBehavior FIREWORK_KEEP_EXPLOSION  
  
# Creeper does not explode but deals damage to nearby entities, but also explodes a firework  
gamerule creeperExplosionBehavior FIREWORK_DAMAGE_EXPLOSION  
gamerule creeperExplosionBehavior DEFAULT  
  
# A firework explodes where the creeper was standing instead of exploding  
gamerule creeperExplosionBehavior FIREWORK_ONLY  
  
# Vanilla Behavior, destroys blocks according to mobGriefing gamerule  
gamerule creeperExplosionBehavior DESTROY_EXPLOSION  
  
# Creeper explodes normally but does not destroy nearby blocks, similar to mobGriefing=false  
gamerule creeperExplosionBehavior KEEP_EXPLOSION  
  
# Creeper does not explode but deals damage to nearby entities  
gamerule creeperExplosionBehavior DAMAGE_EXPLOSION  
  
# Creepers simply vanish from existance before exploding  
gamerule creeperExplosionBehavior NONE
```

title: APIMachine
description: Create RESTful API for your Minecraft server with PlaceholderAPI values.
body:
# APIMachine

Create a RESTful API for your Minecraft server, with custom values, such as a PlaceholderAPI placeholder value.
## Requirements

- A [Paper](https://papermc.org) server
- [PlaceholderAPI](https://placeholderapi.com) Plugin

## Wiki

You can view the wiki [here](https://mallusrgreat.gitbook.io/mallusrgreats-plugins/). This page is a go-to if you want to learn about all the features this plugin offers. This modrinth page only covers the basics.


## Installation

Installation is very typical.

- Download the plugin
- Put it in (server folder)/plugins
- (Re)start your server.

## Usage

If you haven't touched the config.yml file, then you should be able to see the default page at `(machine ip):4567/api/global`
Right now, it simply shows your Minecraft server's name with the `%server_name%` placeholder from the PlaceholderAPI expansion named Server.
If you don't want an advanced use of it, changing the default values will do just fine.

To disable the Sonic boom with the Fabric Version you need to run the command /gamerule DoSonicBoom false

To disable the Sonic boom with the Forge Version you need to run the command /gamerule CanWardenSonicBoom false

title: Fossils Delight
description: A cross compatability addon between farmer's delight and fossils and archeology: revival. Use your prehistoric creatures to make food!
body:
# Fossils Delight      
**This project adds new ways to make food using dinosaurs and other prehistoric creatures from Fossils and Archeology: Revival, using equipment and other foodstuff from farmer's delight.**  
![A 3x3 wall of ancient planks that has dodo eggs, thawed stew, waffles with honey and berries, proto sukiyaki, meganeura tail, trilobite boil, tiktaalik maki, coelacanth sashimi and jurassic brochette on glow items frames. Located on a beach, there is a full size ceratosaurus skeleton from f/a in the background and a cooking pot from farmers delight in the background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43b2afda34c901218f3227bdd0e87ae387df1da2.png)
# Feature list:
**Firstly, there are a lot of new food items! These are:**     
- proto sukiyaki          
- waffles       
- waffles with honey and berries          
- citipati waffles          
- citipati waffles with honey and berries           
- ginger megalograptus            
- jurassic brochette            
- tiktaalik maki          
- coelacanth sashimi        
- meganeura tail        
- leaf wrapped rice        
- thawed stew         
- Trilobite boil          
- escamoles        
- dodo scrambled eggs   
                   
The mod also now allows you to make the farmers delight items **cabbage rolls**, **dog food** and **barbeque on a stick** using not just regular animal meat, but dinosaur meat as well!    
# Recipes & Usage
![Proto sukiyaki, which gives 15s of strength and 180s of nourishment, shown to be made using 2 pasta, 1 dino meat, 1 chicken essence, one cabbage, and one mushroom. Also shown to be stored in a bowl.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/291d338d070c05f0aac42e7060490a962907ecee_0.webp)      
**As of currently, the mod adds no new cooking blocks. You can use a **cooking pot** for some recipes and a **crafting table** for some others. I recommend discovering the recipes yourself by using a mod like JEI or REI!**
# Purpose and why you should download this mod    
**One purpose of this mod is expanding on farmer's delight purpose, which is improving the current food system of minecraft**. This mod extends that to not just the vanilla minecraft food system, but also the fossils and archeology food system, making modpacks with both feel more complete and consistent               

**The other purpose of this mod is to give more uses to the fossils and archeology foods.** Currently fossils and archeology adds a few new foods, mostly prehistoric creature meat, but also new berries and plants. Those were pretty redundant in normal fossils and archeology, since they were hard to get and had no advantages over normal vanilla foods. This mod solves that, by giving those new uses in both normal farmers delight recipes and completely new recipes, making them unique and worth the effort!

**So, if you want your modpack with fossils and archeology and farmers delight to feel more consistent or if you want to give new uses to your prehistoric foodstuffs, this mod is for you!**
# Future plans
Regarding new versions of fossils and archeology, fossils delight will stay on the latest version of f/a. That means, when f/a updates to 1.21.1, fossils delight will update with it, and will drop 1.20.1 support. If ever f/a updates to a version that doesn't have farmers delight, the addon will not update to that version.     

Regarding new features, the future is uncertain, but feast blocks and possibly a new prehistoric stove are likely. Suggestions are also very much welcome, which can be done via the discord server or the issues tab.

Special thanks to FoggyHillside for making the end's delight addon, which was often used as reference for the code.           
Special thanks to victorwing for making one of the base mods, farmers delight.    
Special thanks to Lesbian, Cassian and MehVahdJukaar for making the fabric port of farmer's delight, allowing fossils delight to support fabric as well.
Also want to thank all the people in the discord server that supported the project and made suggestions.     
Last but not least, special thanks to darkpred, dip, poetyrannus, Rob and all other past and present f/a devs for making fossils archeology. We wouldn't be here without you.

Whatever you do, you are NOT allowed to use the code or textures of this mod to make money or profit in some way. However, making videos showcasing or using the mod is allowed.

title: Create: Aeronautics Weightworks
description: Fixes and changes the mass values for Copycats blocks when using Create: Aeronautics, allowing them to work correctly with airplane physics.
body:
Create: Aeronautics Weightworks is a compatibility addon that rebalances the mass of Copycat blocks for Create: Aeronautics.

Most Copycat blocks are assigned a mass of 0.01kpg, allowing builders to use decorative and functional Copycat blocks without significantly increasing the weight of their airships. This helps reduce unnecessary mass while maintaining compatibility with Create: Aeronautics' physics system.

Features
Sets most Copycats blocks to a mass of 0.01kpg
Improves compatibility between Copycats and Create: Aeronautics
Reduces airship weight from decorative blocks
Lightweight and server-friendly
Perfect for builders who use large amounts of Copycats blocks
Why?
By default, some Copycats blocks can contribute more mass than desired. Weightworks standardizes their mass values, making airship weight calculations more predictable and builder-friendly.

Build bigger. Fly lighter. ⚙️🚀


Report Issues Here: [Github](https://github.com/GWStudios-YT/Create-Aeronautics-Weightworks/issues)

title: Coolite
description: This visualizes the cooldown of Hoplite's items!
body:
# Coolite
## ⚠**it does not work with lunar client**

A lightweight Fabric client-side mod that displays item cooldowns as a HUD overlay.

Designed for servers using custom cooldown systems via the Apollo protocol.

---

## Features

- **Cooldown HUD** — Shows active item cooldowns with a progress bar and remaining time
- **Custom Model Data support** — Renders the correct custom item texture when a CMD is assigned
- **Configurable position & scale** — Place the HUD anywhere on screen
- **Left / Right layout** — Choose whether the HUD grows to the right or to the left

---

## Usage

| Action | Description |
|---|---|
| `/coolite` | Open the config screen |
| Mod menu | Click the config button on the Coolite entry in [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) |

### Config options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| X / Y | HUD position as a 0–1000 screen ratio |
| Scale | HUD size multiplier (0.1–10.0) |
| L / R | Direction the HUD expands toward |

> **Note:** The default HUD position may not suit your screen resolution or GUI scale.
> It is strongly recommended to open the config screen and adjust the position and scale to fit your setup before playing.
> The config screen shows a live preview so you can fine-tune it in real time.

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.x
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) *(optional — for in-game config access)*

---

## Notes

> This mod is intended for use on specific servers that send cooldown data via the Apollo protocol.
> It will not display anything on servers that do not support this.

---

* Heart Piece
* Heart Container

Found in multiple structures (see Structures) and archeology.
With four of them you can craft a Heart Container.

Right-click with it in your hand and you will gain one heart (with a maximum of ten Heart Containers consumed)

Some of them can be directly obtained by completing one of these advancements:
* Adventuring Time
* A Furious Cocktail
* Hero of the Village
* Monsters Hunted

Or by defeating one of these bosses _for the first time_:
* Ender Dragon
* Wither
* Elder Guardian

One time per player.
## Structures
* Stronghold
* Bastion
* Desert pyramid
* Ancient city
* Jungle temple
* End city
## Note
This is _my_ take on how Heart Containers should be implemented in Minecraft. It has some design choices that you may not like depending on your play style.

title: Leaderboard Hologram
description: Server-side hologram leaderboards for Fabric with friendly presets, aggregate stats, themes, and live refresh.
body:
# Leaderboard Hologram

Most Minecraft servers already have good player statistics. The problem is that those numbers usually stay buried in menus, commands, or files that normal players never look at.

`Leaderboard Hologram` brings those stats into the world itself.

You can place floating leaderboard boards at spawn, in a mining area, inside a minigame lobby, or anywhere else you want players to immediately notice progress. It is meant for servers that want public goals, visible competition, and a cleaner way to show long-term activity without forcing players to install anything on the client.

This mod is fully server-side.

## What The Mod Does Well

- Creates in-world hologram leaderboards using Minecraft display entities
- Lets you create boards with friendly preset names instead of memorizing raw statistic paths
- Supports custom raw paths when you want full control
- Stores boards by name so moving, refreshing, editing, and removing them later stays manageable
- Formats play time and similar values in a readable way instead of dumping ugly raw numbers
- Refreshes automatically and can also be updated manually
- Includes visual themes so boards do not all look the same
- Works well for survival servers, hubs, community servers, and progression-focused worlds

## Presets And Broader Tracking

The mod is built to be practical, not just technical.

That means you are not limited to awkward raw keys every time you want to make a board. There are friendly presets for common things like:

- play time
- deaths
- mob kills
- villagers traded
- diamonds collected
- iron collected
- emeralds collected
- logs chopped
- total blocks broken
- total items crafted
- total items used

Some presets also combine more than one underlying statistic so the result makes more sense for real server use.

## Designed For Actual Server Owners

The focus here is ease of use first:

- commands are easier to remember
- boards survive restarts
- the display is meant to be readable in normal gameplay
- setup does not require a client mod
- different Minecraft versions use their own matching jar builds

In other words, this mod is meant to be something you can install, configure, and keep running without babysitting it all the time.

## Example Uses

- a spawn leaderboard for total play time
- a mining leaderboard for diamonds collected
- a survival progression board for total blocks broken
- a village board for player trading activity
- a PvE area board for mob kills

## Example Commands

```mcfunction
/leaderboard create quick play_time
/leaderboard create preset miners diamonds_collected 10
/leaderboard create preset builders blocks_broken_total 10
/leaderboard settheme miners gold
/leaderboard refresh

Need Help?
If you find a bug on a specific Minecraft version, contact me on Discord:

v_eno

It has a 6.66 block range and does 22 damage (11 hearts). ### Ability #### Freeze ⌛ 20s (Mobs), 30s (Players) For mobs, using this ability in a 8 block radius would give them Slowness 127 for 4 seconds. Does 5 damage. ### Ability #### Thunderstorm ⌛ 30s In a 16 block radius, for every entity within that radius, summon 3 lightning bolts, which are each apart from each other by 10 ticks (500ms), which hit the entities. It will stun the entities (and prevent them from attacking) for 1.5s. title: Locator Bar (< 1.21.6)
description: Replicates the 1.21.6 Locator Bar feature for Paper 1.16.5–1.21.5. Displays nearby players on your Action Bar with distance-based icons and directional tracking.
body:
Brings the **1.21.6 Locator Bar** feature to Paper 1.16.5–1.21.5. Shows nearby players on your Action Bar with real-time directional tracking. No client-side mods required. ## How it works A bar appears above your hotbar showing the position of nearby players. Icons change based on distance: - **⬤** — Close (0–179 blocks) - **■** — Medium (179–230 blocks) - **●** — Far (230–281 blocks) - **•** — Very far (281+ blocks) Vertical arrows (**ꜛ ꜜ**) indicate when a player is above or below you. Each player is assigned a unique color for easy identification, which also appears in the tab list. ## Hiding from the bar Players are hidden from the Locator Bar when: - Sneaking - Under Invisibility effect - Wearing a mob head or carved pumpkin
Commands
- `/locatorbar` — Toggle the bar on/off - `/locatorbar on` — Enable - `/locatorbar off` — Disable - `/locatorbar reload` — Reload config
Configuration
All settings are customizable in `config.yml`: - `update-interval` — Refresh rate in ticks (default: 1) - `fov-degrees` — Field of view (default: 120°) - `bar-width` — Width of the bar in characters (default: 51) - `max-range` — Maximum tracking distance (0 = unlimited) - `distance-thresholds` — Customize icon distance breakpoints - `very-far-icon` — Custom icon for max distance - `show-vertical-arrows` — Toggle vertical arrows - `vertical-threshold` — Height difference to show arrows (default: 10) - `color-tab-names` — Color player names in tab list (default: true) - `hide-sneaking`, `hide-invisible`, `hide-masked` — Toggle hiding conditions

title: Server ResourcePack Manager
description: Server Resource Pack Manager with multi pack support
body:
# Server ResourcePack Manager

Multi Server ResourcePack Manager for a single dedicated server.

## Features

- Multi ResourcePack introduced in 1.20.3 is supported
- Automatic calculation of ResourcePack hash
- Simple configuration file
- Reload command to update ResourcePacks without server restart
- Send command to re-apply ResourcePacks to player(s)

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/) modloader on your Minecraft server.
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin).
3. Install the mod from [Releases](https://github.com/jimchen5209/ServerResourcePackManager/releases) or [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/server-resourcepack-manager).
4. Start server to generate config

## Configuration

The configuration file is located at `config/server-resource-pack-manager.json`. You can add multiple ResourcePacks by specifying their URL.

| Name | Description | Default |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `autoSend` | Automatically send ResourcePack(s) on player join | `true` |
| `promptMessage` | Message displayed to players when prompting for ResourcePack(s) | `""` |
| `required` | Whether to enforce server ResourcePack(s) | `false` |
| `resourcePacks` | List of ResourcePack URLs | `[]` |

### Multi ResourcePack

The order of ResourcePacks in the list determines the order they are applied.

The first ResourcePack will be applied first, followed by the second, and so on. If there are duplicate ResourcePack keys, the first occurrence takes precedence.

#### Example

```json
{
  "autoSend": true,
  "promptMessage": "",
  "required": false,
  "resourcePacks": [
    "https://path/to/resourcepack1.zip",
    "https://path/to/resourcepack2.zip"
  ]
}
```

In this example, `resourcepack1.zip` will be applied first, followed by `resourcepack2.zip`.

Applied resource packs will be shown in the in-game settings menu in this order.

![Image showing order in game](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/18dc5224-7f46-46ce-91e9-562fd8a7b262)

## Commands

- `/resourcePackManager reload` - Reload the configuration file and update ResourcePacks.
- `/resourcePackManager send [player]` - Re-apply ResourcePacks to the specified player, or yourself if no player is specified.

\* Icon generated with Nano Banana

title: Daggercraft
description: An attempt at a complete overhaul themed around my own writing and a few things from other franchises I thought fit in.
body:
Daggercraft is intended to be a sort of overhaul experience inspired by my own and some friends' writing, with some elements from other things I like [Namely Protectrons, Mister Handys, and Battle Droids], and some decisions made based around the setting of Minecraft.

- Adds a few new workbenches, some new villager professions, overhauls villager trades, and adds a lot of new entities to populate villages and make them more liveley and self-sustainable.

- Completely overhauls the armor system, adds a bunch of new armors [early game AND late game], and adds in defenses against specific damage types.

- Completely overhauls the weapons system, adds new weapons for early game and lategame, and adds, well daggers.

- Adds races [which can be disabled via gamerule] that affect various things about how you play and can be switched using the Orb of Renewal.

- Changes how various 'factions' work and adds new ones [The Void, The Light, The Imperials, Endarian, and a couple others], also adding instances of certain entities that are in different factions than normal [Village-alligned pillagers for example].

- Adds Robots, some of which are craftable, some of which can become loyal to the player, and some of which are always part of a set faction. They can be modified to varying degrees depending on the type of robot.

- Added a few redstone components [Automation Pusher and Automation Puller (Used for moving block entities), directional input block (a directional redstone component with some weird mechanics of its own), amemist comparator, (A block that checks if the block below it is powered and can check through transparent blocks)].

- A surplus of new entities, some hostile, some neutral, and some passive.

- Adds in a few new structures with their own loot and aesthetic.

- Adds new consumable items and changes a few consumable items from vanilla are altered

This mod is planned to have a lot of customization via gamerules for an optimal experience. Some number gamerules exist to reduce lag. 

Currently this mod is in an Alpha state and could be heavily bug ridden and any bugs should be reported.

There is a Discord server for feedback and documentation. 

IT IS HEAVILY RECOMMENDED YOU USE NERUINA JUST IN CASE

Unencumbered: You can move normally.
![Hotbar Weight Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a225794aae0a120926c25bc7c942f51ed3c8720.png)    

Encumbered: You can no longer sprint.
![Encumbered Hotbar Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e1f18bba972bc35d5fba092144769c6074dce2e.png)   

Over Encumbered: You can barely move (no sprinting, jumping, slower movement, and sinking in fluids).
![Over Encumbered Hotbar Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25210cfd643edca84b5cc540695ac13c51f69f87.png)    

### Features
--- 
- 🔧 Configurable weights, encumberment thresholds, and UI.
- 🎒 Support for shulker boxes and some backpack mods (Sophisticated Backpacks).
- 🐎 Riding entities takes into account your weight
- ✈️ Elytra considers weight
- 🖥️ User-friendly GUI with a helpful weight indicator icon.
- 🌍 Multiplayer support!
  
### Planned Features
--- 
- 🔄 Further mod support (Curios Slot, Backpacks, etc.).
- Version back/forward porting (1.20.x and above. Others upon request to popular versions)
--- 
More updates to come! Questions? Check us out on [Discord](https://discord.gg/B7FzPb7kJU) 🎮

<details>
<summary>Mod Setup</summary>
In order to modify weight values, you must create a datapack to override or add your own mod's weight values. The datapack should be dropped in the world's datapacks folder.
  
  
  Datapack Example:
  ```
  -DataPackName
  |-pack.mcmeta
  |-data
   |-encumbered
    |-data_maps
     |-item
      |-item_weights.json
  ```
  
  item_weights.json should be in the format:
  ```json
  {
    "values": {
      "minecraft:stone": {
        "replace": true,
        "value": {
          "weight": 12.0
        }
      },
      "modid:item": {
        "replace": true,
        "value": {
          "weight": 1.0
        }
      },
      "#minecraft:logs": {
        "replace": true,
        "value": {
          "weight": 10.0
        }
      }
  }
  ```
  
  The pack.mcmeta file should look like this:
  ```json
  {
      "pack": {
          "pack_format": 34,
          "description": "Pack Description Here"
      }
  }
  ```
  
###   Configs
--- 
  Config/encumbered-client.toml:
  - Contains configs that are independent of the server. Each player can modify these values at will on their client
  - Config/encumbered-server.toml: Contains configs that are consistent across all players. Anything changed here will change for all players.


</details>

Standing on blocks like Netherrack, Crimson Nylium, or Nether Bricks will slowly damage your boots. If they break, you'll take direct damage!

Entering the Basalt Deltas biome without a Carved Pumpkin on your head will cause blindness and slowness due to the ash-filled air.

Walking on Soul Sand or Soul Soil applies the Wither effect, making these blocks even more dangerous.

### Warped Nylium Levitation
Stepping on Warped Nylium gives you a levitation effect, adding a unique twist to exploration.

Survival Reborn: A New Era of Minecraft Survival
Modpack Description:

Welcome to Survival Reborn, where your Minecraft survival experience is transformed into an epic adventure full of new possibilities! This modpack is designed for players who crave more immersive terrain, diverse biomes, challenging mobs, and an array of fresh items and game mechanics that breathe new life into the classic survival gameplay.

In Survival Reborn, we’ve enhanced the world with custom terrain generation, expanded biomes, and added a variety of unique mobs, making each step you take more thrilling and unpredictable. Whether you're exploring vast new landscapes, facing off against fierce creatures, or crafting advanced tools and magical items, there's always something new around the corner.

Here’s a look at the exciting features that make Survival Reborn the ultimate survival experience:

Features:
🌍 Enhanced Terrain Generation
Dynamic World Generation: Say goodbye to the old, predictable terrain. Survival Reborn uses custom world generation tools to create breathtaking landscapes with towering mountains, deep ravines, sprawling forests, and hidden valleys. No two worlds are ever the same!
Realistic Elevations: Witness dramatic cliff faces, towering plateaus, and massive underground caverns filled with secrets. The land feels alive, with dynamic features like river networks, glaciers, and erosion-based landscapes that make every new area a joy to explore.

Exotic Biomes: Discover a vast array of unique biomes, each with its own atmosphere, resources, and challenges. From the mystical Frostwood Forests to the dangerous Blasted Wastes, the world is full of new places to uncover.
Dimensional Adventures:
Unlock mysterious new dimensions, including the Emerald Abyss—a shimmering, alien world full of ancient ruins, dangerous creatures, and powerful artifacts waiting to be found.

Survival Tools: Manage your hunger, health, and thirst with dynamic survival mechanics that require attention to detail. New food items, brewing recipes, and healing potions keep you on your toes in the wilderness.
New Crafting Systems: Craft powerful gadgets, enchanted equipment, and build complex contraptions with new machinery and magical components that bring fresh life to Minecraft’s crafting system.
🐉 Challenging Mobs and Creatures

Passive Creatures: Not all new creatures are hostile. Meet peaceful mobs like the Moonlight Deer that provide valuable resources, or the Frostbeak Birds that can lead you to hidden treasures.

Boss Battles: Massive bosses now roam the world, challenging even the most seasoned adventurers. Defeat them to claim legendary loot, powerful relics, and unique rewards that will aid you on your journey.
Why Choose Survival Reborn?
Immersive World: With the combination of new biomes, creatures, and terrain, every Minecraft world feels fresh and exciting. Say goodbye to the mundane, and say hello to an ever-changing adventure!
Challenging Yet Rewarding: Whether you’re a seasoned survival expert or a newcomer to modpacks, Survival Reborn offers a difficulty curve that keeps the gameplay engaging while still offering rewards that make your hard work worth it.
For the Adventurer and Crafter Alike: This modpack appeals to those who love both exploring the wild and crafting new tools, items, and machines to survive in the world.
Are you ready to begin your new adventure?

Dive into Survival Reborn today,
and discover a whole new world full of untold stories, epic challenges, and endless possibilities! Whether you’re building your empire, surviving in the harshest of environments, or uncovering ancient secrets, there’s always something new to explore.

title: Stracciatella Modpack
description: Aiming to provide a vanilla experience with more focus on Survival gameplay, visual enhancements, small QoL improvements and a more varied progression tree. Uses vanilla as a base but with a bit more flavour (hence the name :3).
body:
# Stracciatella Modpack

## contents

1. overview
2. changes from vanilla
3. mod details + list
4. modpack patchnotes

## 1. overview

minecraft version: 1.21.1, modpack version: 3.0.0

Feature complete. Do not expect new content. There might be minor additions, bugfixes or mod updates.

To keep your minecraft settings, worlds and various other stuff when upgrading  from older versions (modrinth does not seem to do a good job at this *sigh*)
1. download the modpack directly
2. extract it
3. copy the contents of the `mods` and `config` folders to your already existing instance, overwrite existing files.

Aiming to provide a vanilla experience with more focus on Survival gameplay, visual enhancements, small QoL improvements and a more varied progression tree. Uses vanilla as a base but with a bit more flavour (hence the name :3). Pretty much configured out of the box for the intended experience. detailed information below, comments/reasons in ().

There are some currently disabled mods in the mod folder, I still left them in there, see `3. mod details + list` for details.

***WARNING!!!***

opening video settings with Controlify enabled crashes the game. Everything else works as intended. As far I can tell, it has something to do with Fabric's loading order, which Controlify completely reorders (and thus, breaks compatability with some mods). have not tested which mods need to be disabled for it to work. Controlify is disabled by default. enable at your own risk.

## 2. changes from vanilla

### major gameplay changes
- added bundles: 64 items per bundle, interact with right-click, scroll to change the selected item.
- added seasons: 8 days = 1 week, 3 weeks = 1 month, 4 months = 1 year. I have **not** thoroughly tested how it affects vanilla survival gameplay, but it's probably fine lol. Snow falls in the autumn and winter and accumulates over multiple layers. better get those shovels ready.
- added heat and cold mechanics, there's equipment to stay cool/warm and various vanilla items that also help. works with the seasons mod (:D).
- added copper rails, they oxidise over time, but faster than gold when clean. can be stopped via wax, or cleaned manually. (also apparently minecarts can load chunks now, not tested.)
- full 3 degrees of freedom (roll/pitch/yaw) airplane/bird like controls when using an elytra. THE. BEST. MOD. fight me. (finally adds a good reason to get an elytra >:3c)
- same flight mechanics now also for swimming, disabled by default (is cool but not very practical)
- ingame voice chat (simple voice chat)
- compass now shows coordinates and facing direction. no more coordinates in the F3 menu (adds a reason for the compass to exist and immersion and makes early game navigation non-trivial)
- added new biomes that use all vanilla blocks for some more visual interest without introducing extra blocks or items that won't be compatible with the existing ones.
- added a instant polaroid like camera, bit janky with the ThirdPerson mod, but way too cool to remove just because of that.

### SFX/VFX/UI
- added dynamic lighting. torches don't work underwater, but lanterns do!
- miniature shader pack. lightweight, close to vanilla, not looking out of place imo (feel free to change settings, use another, or disable all together. however, it's not the intended art direction anymore (something something death of the artist))
- added the third person player model to the first person view. also added some animations for typing/using a GUI/idle (immersion, honestly I think it adds so much to the vibes when a game does this :D (also shaders with shadows look wierd without))
- more realistic sound engine and footstep sounds. (feel free to change if it's too annoying)
- more particles, prettier water when it rains
- prettier clouds, especially during the sunset/sunrise. clouds now adapt to the current weather (overcast when it rains).
- various misc visual improvements (connected textures, prettier snow, fog, leaves, etc. try it out to see for yourself.)

### QoL changes/tweaks (Quality of Life)
- added gender (including blåhaj) :3
- crafting stairs now results in 6 stairs instead of 4. 2 slabs can be crafted back into blocks.
- player heads now visible in chat messages and command completions, sort of like a pfp.
- bonemeal now works on pretty much all plants.
- improved vanilla bows and arrows. burning arrows now ignite wood (>:D), infinity works with all arrow types, bows now show the correct arrows.
- spyglass can now zoom (scrollwheel), see mod menu for more options.
- can now properly read books in a lectern and read the titles of books stored in a chiseled bookshelf.
- change/mute the volume of any soundeffect in the game (accessible via the mod menu).
- added vertical slabs.
- changed librarian, less random and more focus on exploration.
- changed trident, now craftable.
- better banners, more utility (more patterns + ASCII characters, usable on beds and elytras, can now hang vertically).
- 4 more pot shapes, pots now dyeable and sherds can now be duplicated.
- you can now click through signs, no more fiddly chest storage nonsense.
- items do not despawn upon death, death location gets posted in the chat.

### changed keybinds (just set whatever you want, those are the ones I use)
- "V" **voice chat:** show settings/GUI
- "O" **shader:** open shader settings
- "K" **shader:** disable/enable shader (enabled by default, no it will not burn down your computer or house)
- "M" **misc:** opens the map.
- "Shift" **misc:** sprint
- "Ctrl" **misc:** crouch (like it should be >:3c)
- "ESC -> "Mods" **mods:** opens mod menu, look around and tinker to your hearts content :D
- "F4" **mods:** toggles smoothed camera (combine with F1 for pretty views of pretty scenery)
- "F6" **mods:** toggle between third person model and default first person view.
- "F7" **mods:** also opens the mod menu
- "F10" **mods:** opens footstep configuration menu

### misc
- changed crash sound effect (not the crash pipe anymore)

## 3. mod details + list

disabled mods
- Controlify: **can result in crash:** did work before but can't figure out why it now crashes the game. at least we have crash.wav :3c. considered not vital.
- Shoulder Surfing Reloaded: **works as intended:** is the default view upon starting the game, got annoying fast when restarting the game often
- Just Enough Items: **works as intended:** found it a little too distracing, you're more than welcome to enable it
- Distant Horizons: **works as intended:** did not work well with the seasons or shader, still there if you want to have the option

mod list
- see the up to date [list on modrinth](https://modrinth.com/modpack/stracciatella-modpack/version/latest)

setting up this modpack on a server
1. copy the `mods` and `config` directories to the server directory 
2. start the server
3. disable `Tinkerer's Smithing (tinkerers-smithing-*.jar) ` on the client(s)
4. disable `Fog Overrides (fogoverrides-*.jar)` on the server
5. success! (game still crashes when leaving the server, but that's considered not vital for now, will look into this later.)

## 4. modpack patchnotes

see [the built in modrinth patchnotes](https://modrinth.com/modpack/stracciatella-modpack/versions) for up to date patchnotes.

version 1.2.4
- changed ingame vc mod from simple voice chat (has an option for global chat) to plasmo voice chat (only local chat)

version 1.2.3 (hotfix)
- removed moonlight-lib (deprecated, and crashes the game when joining a server)
- removed craftable saddles (i forgor)
- various performance improvements

version 1.2.2
- froze development, no new functionality will be added. already installed mods might be tweaked, disabled by default, swapped for other similiar mods, or removed entirely.
- tweaked elytras, now only loose durability when using fireworks, slightly slower now (not sure about this lol)
- added animations for typing, using a GUI, or idle
- added JEI, disabled by default
- added being able to click through signs (less annoying storage UX)

version 1.2.1
- disabled controlify, it's installed but disabled by default, enable at your own risk. (see warning above)
- messed with the movement abilities a bit ~~too much~~, we'll just have to see if they need rebalancing.
  - current implementation: wall running (shorter than default) and slides (6s cooldown, more mindful use, less spam), no dodge roll (could negate all fall damage)
- disabled over the shoulder F5 perspective by default, since it was kind of buggy
- better combat with axes (can use sword enchantments and no extra durability loss)
- can now drink water using your hands, however not very efficient or healthy lol
- more mob drops (always at least 1 item), consistent Looting Enchantment scaling (+1 item per level). (less RNG and to make up for mobs being harder to kill, less incentive to build giant mobgrinders when you get more items per mob now).

version 1.2.0
- improved banners (more patterns, usable on beds and elytras, can hang horizontally)
- added a couple improvements to elytra UI/UX
- more pot shapes, added recipe to clone sherds
- craftable totem of undying, elytra (both need a wither star (widening the progression tree)), craftable enchanted golden apple (what else are you gonna do with all that gold), craftable chainmail.
- added new F5 perspective (better third person view)
- removed vertical stairs (mod didn't work properly with glass panes, vertical slabs still exist and work nicely with glass panes).
- added sitting on slabs or stairs
- added additional pet mode (right click to cycle, see text on screen)
- added gender (blåhaj included) :3

version 1.1.2
- movement (titanfall2 like movement + trampoline like blocks)
- more varied world gen (cliff under a tree)
- trident improvements
- vertical slabs and stairs
- VR support (not tested)
- balanced librarian
- now with less annoying crash soundeffect :D

title: Universal Anti-VPN
description: An anti-vpn plugin that can utilize multiple backend API's and has fallover management.
body:
# Universal Anti-VPN
Spigot Universal Anti-VPN with multiple backends and automatic fallover management.


## Supported backends
Currently all backends support API keys that you can use in this plugin to exceed the amount of free queries. These API keys should be purchased on their respective platforms and can be set in the config.yml of this plugin. Issues with API keys or false-positives should be handled by the respective backend provider and not this plugin.

- [KauriVPN](https://funkemunky.cc/shop)
- [Proxycheck](https://proxycheck.io/)

### Backend overview

| Backend     | Free queries   | can use API for more queries |
|-------------|----------------|:----------------------------:|
| KauriVPN    |    20000/month |      ✔️                      |
| Proxycheck  |    1000/day    |      ✔️                      |


## Plugin setup
After installing the plugin and having restarted your server, you will find a ``config.yml`` file. Here you can find multiple configurable settings but none are required to be adjusted to work. This means **the plugin can function properly without any configuration whatsoever**.

Below you will find a table of all configurable settings. Please note this omits the values for configuring your H2 or mysql database. If you are not familiar with this, just keep as is to use an H2 database which will work without configuration. We also omited the API's section where you can enable/disable API's and enter API-keys if wanted.

| Section   | Subsection | Setting | Allowed values | Notes |
|-----------|------------|---------|----------------|-------|
| Settings  | VPN        | alert   | true or false  | Whether or not an alert should be sent upon a player attempting to join with a VPN |
| Settings  | VPN        | kick    | true or false  | Whether or not a player attempting to join with a VPN should be kicked from the server |
| Settings  | cache      | enabled | true or false  | Whether or not we should cache values (**highly recommended**) |
| Settings  | cache      | type    | "H2" or "mysql"  | What cache type to use |
| Settings  | cache      | cleanup_interval   | any number  | How often the plugin checks for invalidated cached records in minutes |
| Fallback-protocol  |   | primary   | any supported backend  | What the primary backend is |
| Fallback-protocol  |   | fallback_protocol   | an array of supported backend(s)  | What order the fallback system uses. |

To go a bit more in-depth of the fallback_protocol setting; this setting uses an array of supported backend(s). This means if you want to, for example, use proxycheck as fallback API, this would be ``["proxycheck]"``. If you wanted to first attempt proxycheck and after that kaurivpn, this would be ``["proxycheck", "kaurivpn"]``. Please note this fallback-protocol is only used when the ``primary`` backend fails.


## Commands & Permissions
| Command                   | Permission        | Note              |
|---------------------------|-------------------|-------------------|
| /antivpn whitelist \<IP\> | antivpn.whitelist | Whitelists the IP |
| /antivpn block \<IP\>     | antivpn.block     | Blocks the IP     |

## Support
Join our discord for support [here](https://discord.gg/XkDPdEfcQJ).

title: Artifacts Of The Ancients
description: This plugin introduces unique artifacts with diverse acquisition methods into the game, unlocking new possibilities for players to interact with the Minecraft world. The artifacts imbue their owners with special abilities, such as manipulating the flow of
body:
## Artifacts Of The Ancients

This plugin adds several artifacts that, when obtained, grant players various abilities. These artifacts have unique methods of acquisition.

This comprehensive plugin includes three powerful artifacts, each of which bestows incredible abilities upon players:
##

### Time Artifact
Allows the player to slow down, speed up, or even completely stop the flow of time for a certain period.
>![gif](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qZydaXBv/images/f97e256cbc56b7f51bb9652bc40cc029a7677680.gif)
> 
<details>
<summary>Obtaining</summary>

To craft the Time Artifact, you will need a regular clock, which must be placed on a crafting table and surrounded by "Temporal Paradox Shards".


>![time_artifact](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qZydaXBv/images/f37deb27b9bcfce15f564982b129b2ff70ae128a.gif)

> 
This rare shard can be obtained by passing through a temporal rift, which sporadically appears in the world.

>![TemporalShard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qZydaXBv/images/5d64305d8746da67be2b2b262e0150138f556e91.gif)

</details>


##

### Seer's Compass
Grants the player the ability to see the world through the eyes of other players, allowing them to track their movements and actions.
>![time_artifact](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qZydaXBv/images/bfe0adef268332f9abd481b70b358939b79fc5af.gif)

<details>
<summary>Obtaining</summary>

To create the Seer's Compass, you will need to place the following ingredients on a special block called the "Scalkowing Crier": 8 echo shards, 4 ender eyes, 1 compass, 1 nether star, and 1 "Eye" armor trim. This will initiate the artifact creation process, resulting in the Seer's Compass.

>![gif](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qZydaXBv/images/b77863bac13982f3ac6b9fadd3dea4c20cc41a85.gif)
> 
</details>

##

### Guardian Amulet
When the player dies, the amulet will save all of their items, holding them until the owner retrieves the artifact. Upon retrieving the amulet, the player's items will be returned to them, but their experience will be taken. The amulet also displays the coordinates of the player's death.
> ![gif](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qZydaXBv/images/75a9b4dc035467fcd69a87bce1c0c3e957740f0c.gif)
> 
<details>
<summary>Obtaining</summary>

This amulet can be found in chests located in woodland mansions with a 30% probability.

> ![gif](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qZydaXBv/images/47b298393df448ef6e4b637927bb8be540fdb633.png)
>
</details>

## Plugin Commands:

| Command | Permission | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| /artefactinfo | AotA.usage | Obtain information about the artifacts |
| /magiccompass \<player\> | AotA.usage | Grant the Seer's Compass to the specified player |
| /giveguardianamulet \<player\> | AotA.usage | Grant the Guardian Amulet to the specified player |
| /timeartifact \<player\> | AotA.usage | Grant the Time Artifact to the specified player |
| /givetimeshard \<player\> | AotA.usage | Grant a Temporal Paradox Shard to the specified player |
| /spawnrift | AotA.usage | Summon a temporal rift |

## Permissions:
- AotA.usage - Allows the use of all commands from the "Artifacts of the Ancients" plugin.

##

> **This plugin is currently in development and will be updated, so expect new items and features in the near future!**

> _The open-source code of the plugin will be available in its final versions._
>

title: SweetPlayerMarket
description: A full GUI enhanced marketplace plugin, allow players to list their items as buy shop or sell shop.
body:
# SweetPlayerMarket

A global player market plugin for Minecraft.

> Default configurations are in Chinese. Check [localization](https://github.com/mcio-dev/localization) repository for English or other language.  
> And I am sorry about that the wiki is only Chinese available right now. In the future, we may translate it to English.

## Introduction

SweetPlayerMarket is a cross-server and database-supported global player market plugin.

Players can list their items on the global market by **selling** or **buying**, allowing other players to purchase or sell their items freely.

Additionally, you can restrict players' listing behavior, such as banning certain items from being listed, allowing only specific currencies for listing, or charging listing fees.

Leveraging the rich query parameters of the database, this plugin allows you to sort the item list with various conditions. For example, you can sort by `creation time`, `expiration time`, `price`, or `quantity` in either `ascending (smallest to largest)` or `descending (largest to smallest)` order.

This plugin continues to use the highly customizable GUI engine from my [PluginBase](http://plugins.mcio.dev/elopers/base/gui-config), allowing you to display the item list in **any custom layout** within the maximum `6*9` slot chest menu!

For more information, please refer to the plugin documentation at [MCIO Plugins](https://plugins.mcio.dev/docs/playermarket/intro).

## Features

+ MySQL database support and cross-server compatibility
+ Uses relational database features to filter and sort global market items by conditions
+ Highly flexible GUI configuration - all interfaces support custom layouts, text, click actions, etc.
+ Allows players to view and manage their own listed items
+ Players can list items via **commands** or **GUI**
+ Smooth and user-friendly item listing interface
+ Extensive listing restrictions to prevent players from listing unwanted items
+ Full localization support - almost all plugin text can be customized
+ Supports automatic, conditional, and probabilistic item listing by the system to provide rewards or rare items for players
+ Supports categorizing player-listed items

## Commands

Root command: `/sweetplayermarket`  
Aliases: `/playermarket`, `/spm`, `/pm`  
Parameters wrapped in `<>` are required; parameters wrapped in `[]` are optional.

Player Commands
| Command | Description | Permission |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/pm open` | Open the global market main GUI | `sweet.playermarket.open` |
| `/pm me` | View your own listed items | `sweet.playermarket.me` |
| `/pm tags` | Open the category selection menu | `sweet.playermarket.tags` |
| `/pm create <shop-type> <price> <currency> [amount-per-item] [total-stock]` | List an item on the global market | `sweet.playermarket.create` |
| `/pm create <shop-type> --menu` | Open the item listing menu | `sweet.playermarket.create` |

Admin Commands
| Command | Description | Permission |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/pm open [player]` | Open the global market main GUI for yourself or another player | `sweet.playermarket.open.other` |
| `/pm me [player]` | View listed items for yourself or another player | `sweet.playermarket.open.other` |
| `/pm tags [player]` | Open the category menu for yourself or another player | `sweet.playermarket.tags.other` |
| `/pm recalc tags` | Recalculate tags for all items | `sweet.playermarket.recalc` |
| `/pm recalc index` | Rebuild search index for all items | `sweet.playermarket.recalc` |
| `/pm server [player]` | View items listed by the special "Server" account (usually auto-listed) | `sweet.playermarket.server` |
| `/pm auto-deploy <config-name> <action>` | Test command for auto-listing functionality | `sweet.playermarket.auto-deploy` |
| `/pm reload assets` | Reload language files; auto-download if missing | OP/Console |
| `/pm reload database` | Reconnect to the database | OP/Console |
| `/pm reload` | Reload plugin configuration | OP/Console |

The `open` command supports these flags:
+ `--type=type` Filter items by type
+ `--currency=type` Filter items by currency
+ `--tag=tag-name` Filter items by tag

The `me` command supports these flags:
+ `--notice` Only show items with `notice_flag`
+ `--only-out-of-stock` Only show expired/sold-out items

The `create` command (both manual and GUI) supports this flag:
+ `--system=custom-name` List items as a system shop (requires `sweet.playermarket.create.system`)

## Permissions

Other available permissions for this plugin:
+ `sweet.playermarket.create.currency.vault` Allow listing items using Vault money
+ `sweet.playermarket.create.currency.playerpoints` Allow listing items using PlayerPoints points
+ `sweet.playermarket.create.currency.mpoints.<amount>` Allow listing items using MPoints currency
+ `sweet.playermarket.create.bypass.cost` Bypass listing fees
+ `sweet.playermarket.create.bypass.currency` Bypass currency restrictions
+ `sweet.playermarket.create.bypass.type` Bypass shop type restrictions (sell/buy)
+ `sweet.playermarket.admin` Global market admin permission, currently used to remove other players' items

title: Pride Tags
description: PrideTags is a Minecraft Fabric mod designed to help players express their identity in-game. It allows server players to manage and display pronouns and customize colors for player tags.
body:
# PrideTags

PrideTags is a Minecraft Fabric mod that helps players express their identity in-game. It allows server administrators and players to manage and display pronouns and customise player tag colours.

## Features

*   **Pronoun Display**: Configurable system to display pronouns (e.g., He/Him, They/Them, She/Her, Neopronouns) for players.
*   **Colour Customisation**: Support for customising tag colours via `PrideTagsColourConfig`.
*   **Persistence**: Configurations are automatically saved and loaded during the server lifecycle.
*   **Commands**: In-game commands to manage teams and tags.

## Installation

1.  Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/).
2.  Download the latest release of PrideTags.
3.  Place the `.jar` file into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
4.  Launch the game/server.

## Configuration

Configuration files are generated in the `config/pride_tags/` directory after the first launch.

*   **pronouns.json**: Defines the list of available pronouns.
*   **colours.json**: Handles colour definitions for tags.

You can edit these JSON files to add custom pronouns or modify existing ones.

## Commands

The mod registers commands to manage tags (handled by `PrideTagsTeamCommand`).
*   Usage usually involves standard command structures (e.g., `/pridetags ...`). *Check in-game autocomplete for specific syntax.*

## Building from Source

This project uses Gradle. To build the mod locally:

1.  Clone the repository.
2.  Open a terminal in the project root.
3.  Run the build command:

    *   **Windows**: `gradlew.bat build`
    *   **Linux/macOS**: `./gradlew build`

The compiled `.jar` file will be located in `build/libs/`.

## License

This project is licensed under the terms found in `LICENSE.txt`.

title: SCP-650, The Startling Statue
description: A statue that will always be behind you when not observed...
body:
The Startling Statue adds a new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-650 also known as The Startling Statue.


This black humanoid statue appears harmless at first, always standing still when observed. However, if a player looks away, SCP-650 will appear behind its target, mimicing the behavior similar to SCP-173. Even effects like Blindness allow SCP-650 to move freely. Occasionally, the statue changes its pose to further unsettle players, making its presence even more disturbing.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Why can SCP-650 still move when looking at it?

If you look at SCP-650, SCP-650 cannot move. However, if you stand too far away (approx. 60 blocks) the raycasting no longer works. The system behind raycasting is complicated and can sometimes lead to errors. 

If there are multiple SCP-650, raycasting can also fail.

► Where does SCP-650 spawn?

SCP-650 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-650.

► Does SCP-650 Mod work with SCP-131 Mod?

Yes! SCP-650 mod works with the SCP-131 mod.
</details>



![SCP-650](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c381d115dcbbed1f3978365398cd82189f700ca1_0.webp)

SCP-650 is a black humanoid statue that remains motionless when a player observes SCP-650, but once that sight is broken, it will instantly reposition itself behind it's target. While unable to attack directly, its stalking nature makes it highly unsettling. Blindness allows SCP-650 to move without restriction, similar to SCP-173. Rarely, SCP-650 changes its pose, increasing its unpredictability and psychological impact on nearby players. If a player wants to kill SCP-650, they would need a pickaxe.

 

- Config File not inculed.
- You are all allowed to use this mod in your modpacks!
- Do not port my mods without permission!

title: NeoBiosphere
description: Generate world as sphere with different biomes
body:
![](https://i.imgur.com/ShLzW2R.jpeg)

# NeoBiosphere

A Biosphere world generation mod for NeoForge 1.21.1.

NeoBiosphere generates large grid-aligned spheres in the Overworld (with an optional upper-hemisphere mode) while preserving vanilla biome sampling behavior. This allows different climate zones and terrain styles to appear naturally across different spheres. You can fine-tune sphere size, spacing, center height, bridge behavior, and more through configuration.

## Highlights

- Sphere-based Overworld generation with a clean grid layout.
- Multi-biome support based on vanilla noise biome sampling.
- Highly configurable parameters: radius, spacing, center Y, sphere block, bridge options, and more.
- Per-sphere variety: each sphere gets a random size and block type from configurable lists, while remaining deterministic across world reloads.
- Optional upper-hemisphere mode for sky-island or challenge-style gameplay.
- Automatic sphere-to-sphere bridges for smoother exploration.
- Compatibility-oriented implementation via Biome Modifier and noise routing integration.

## Requirements

- Minecraft: 1.21.1
- NeoForge: 21.1.216+
- Java: 21

## Installation

1. Install NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.1.
2. Put the mod jar into your `mods` folder.
3. Launch the game and create a new world.

Using a fresh world is strongly recommended to avoid broken borders with previously generated chunks.

## Configuration

Config file path in development environment: `run/config/NeoBiosphere.toml`

Typical path in normal client/server installations: `<game_dir>/config/NeoBiosphere.toml`

### Main Settings

```toml
[Settings]
radius = 128
min_radius = 128
spacing = 500
center_y = 62
sphere_block = ["minecraft:glass"]
only_upper_hemisphere = false
generate_bridge = true
bridge_block = "minecraft:oak_planks"
bridge_radius = 1
```

- `radius`: Maximum sphere radius.
- `min_radius`: Minimum sphere radius. Set equal to `radius` for fixed-size spheres; set lower to enable per-sphere random sizing.
- `spacing`: Distance between sphere center points on the grid.
- `center_y`: Y level of sphere centers.
- `sphere_block`: List of block IDs used for sphere shells. Each sphere randomly picks one type from the list, deterministically based on its grid position. For example `["minecraft:glass", "minecraft:stone", "minecraft:obsidian"]`.
- `only_upper_hemisphere`: Generate only upper hemispheres when enabled.
- `generate_bridge`: Enable or disable bridges between adjacent spheres.
- `bridge_block`: Block used for bridges.
- `bridge_radius`: Bridge radius (larger values make thicker bridges).

### Tuning Notes

- Overlap behavior depends on `spacing` versus `2 * radius`.
- If `spacing > 2 * radius`, spheres have gaps between them.
- If `spacing = 2 * radius`, spheres are tangent.
- If `spacing < 2 * radius`, spheres overlap.

Suggested presets:

- Classic style: `radius=128, min_radius=128, spacing=500, center_y=62`
- Compact exploration: `radius=160, min_radius=160, spacing=320, center_y=70`
- Challenge mode: `only_upper_hemisphere=true, generate_bridge=true`
- Varied spheres: `radius=180, min_radius=80, sphere_block=["minecraft:glass", "minecraft:stone", "minecraft:obsidian"]`

## Compatibility

NeoBiosphere is designed to support most terrain/ecology mod setups, but world generation is a high-conflict area. Please note:

- Usually compatible with:
  - Mods that mainly add mobs, vegetation, structures, or surface features.
  - Mods that append content through Biome Modifiers.

- Potential conflicts with:
  - Mods or datapacks that directly replace noise settings for `minecraft:overworld`, `minecraft:large_biomes`, or `minecraft:amplified`.
  - Mods that deeply alter Carver, Aquifer, or ChunkGenerator pipelines.

- Recommended approach:
  - Treat NeoBiosphere as the primary world-shape mod.
  - Test in a fresh world before finalizing load order and datapack priority in modpacks.

## Covered Overworld Noise Presets

Current version includes support for these Overworld presets:

- `minecraft:overworld`
- `minecraft:large_biomes`
- `minecraft:amplified`

## FAQ

### 1. Why does my old world look incomplete?

Changing world generation settings does not regenerate already created chunks. A new world is recommended.

### 2. Why are bridges not generating?

Check the following:

- `generate_bridge=true`
- `bridge_radius >= 1`
- `bridge_block` is a valid block ID

### 3. Why are spheres different sizes or using different blocks?

This is expected when `min_radius < radius` or when `sphere_block` contains multiple entries. Each sphere deterministically picks its own size and block type based on its grid coordinates, so reloading the world always produces the same sphere layout.

### 4. Why is the sphere shell block not applied?

Make sure each block ID in the list is valid, for example `minecraft:glass`. Invalid IDs can cause config load failure or fallback behavior. If using a single block type, the list must still be formatted as `["minecraft:glass"]`.

### 5. What should I do if another terrain mod conflicts?

First check whether both mods modify Overworld noise settings or Carver flow. In heavy conflicts, keep only one primary world-shape mod.

Issue tracker:

- https://github.com/mlus-asuka/NeoBiosphere/issues

title: ImprovedGrindstone

body:
# Improved Grindstone

Lightweight Paper 1.21.11 plugin that reroutes grindstone disenchantments into books, with optional cross-material transfer support.

## Features
- Slot 0: enchanted source item.
- Slot 1 can be either:
  - A normal book (optionally can be a special book) to extract enchantments into an enchanted book.
  - A compatible target item (same archetype, different material allowed) to transfer enchantments directly.
- Extraction keeps the source item (disenchanted) and gives an enchanted book with removed enchants.
- Transfer keeps the source item (disenchanted) and returns the target item with transferred enchants.
- Optional cursed-enchantment capture toggle.
- Separate XP-cost toggles for extraction and transfer.
- Separate configurable XP percentages (default 50%) based on estimated enchanting-table cost of the moved enchants.

- Commands:
  - `/improvedgrindstone toggle`
  - `/improvedgrindstone status`
  - `/improvedgrindstone cursed`
  - `/improvedgrindstone xp`
  - `/improvedgrindstone transfer`
  - `/improvedgrindstone transferxp`
  - `/improvedgrindstone specialbook`
  - `/improvedgrindstone reload`

## Configuration
Configure behavior in `config.yml`:
```yaml
feature-enabled: true
capture-cursed: true
book-xp-cost-enabled: true
book-xp-cost-percent: 50.0
transfer-enabled: true
transfer-xp-cost-enabled: true
transfer-xp-cost-percent: 50.0
require-special-book: false
special-book-ids: []
max-enchants-per-operation: 16
max-operation-item-bytes: 24576
```

`special-book-ids` accepts namespaced IDs (for example `dingus:blah`).  
If `special-book-ids` is empty, any non-vanilla namespaced marker is accepted (item model, plugin PDC key, or namespaced display name).

`max-enchants-per-operation` is a safety cap. If a source item has more enchantments than this value, the grindstone operation is blocked to avoid oversized/unstable enchant payload handling.
`max-operation-item-bytes` is an additional safety cap on serialized item size (source/result/bonus). If any item involved exceeds this size, the operation is blocked to prevent unsafe payload handling.

XP-cost notes:
- Vanilla enchantments use their estimated enchanting-table costs.
- Custom enchantments are assigned a rough vanilla-equivalent cost from their level, using the highest matching vanilla cost as the baseline.

## Compatibility
Designed for Paper 1.21.11.

# **Instant Harvest**
Overview
Instant Harvest is a Fabric mod that simplifies farming by letting you harvest and replant all crops in your current chunk with a single click. No more tedious row-by-row harvesting—just click once and watch your entire farm get collected and replanted automatically.

## **Features**
•One-Click Harvest: Left-click any fully grown crop while holding any item to harvest ALL mature crops in your current chunk instantly

•Auto-Replant: Seeds are automatically planted back in the same spots after harvesting

•No Special Tools Required: Works with any item in your hand—no hoe or specific tool needed

•Toggle System: Press the H key (configurable) to open a settings menu where you can turn the feature on or off

•Supported Crops: Wheat, Carrots, Potatoes, Beetroots, and Nether Wart

## **How to Use**
•Join your world—the feature is enabled by default

•Hold any item in your hand

•Left-click any fully grown crop in your chunk

•All mature crops in the chunk will be harvested and replanted automatically

•Collect the dropped items from the ground

•Press H to open the settings menu if you want to toggle the feature off

## **Known Limitations**
Only harvests crops within your current chunk, not your entire farm
Only fully grown crops are harvested—immature crops remain untouched
Requires the mod to be installed on the server side

This mod is intended to set a "hard cap" on mob spawns, configurable in the config, which you can see below. ⬇️ 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


```

[general]
	#Enable mob spawn limiter
	enableLimiter = true
	#If true, limits are per player cluster instead of global
	perPlayerMode = false
	#List of mob limits: [["minecraft:zombie","30"],["minecraft:enderman","8"]]
	spawnLimits = [["minecraft:zombie", "30"], ["minecraft:skeleton", "25"]]
	#Radius in blocks used for per-player cluster checks
	#Range: 16 ~ 512
	playerRadius = 128


```


</details>

You can set the cap to be based on a per-player basis or globally, alongside being able to change the type & number of mob that you want to limit the spawning of.

Alongside this, to avoid crowding when there are groups of players nearby to eachother, the per-player setting makes it so that it will only follow the limits of 1 player if there are several people nearby, the radius tells the mod how close the players have to be in order for it to only follow the limit of 1.

Say, for example, you installed a mod, which had some neat features but the spawn weights were all really weird & you got way more of one mob than you'd like, with this mod you can set the natural spawning to be any number you want, if you want there to be no more than 5 mobs of this type in the surrounding area? title: Item Despawn Timer

It helps players recognize valuable and custom items, prevents accidental item loss, and reduces the need for ClearLag-style.
body:
# Item Despawn Timer (IDT)
Visual Drop Management | Glowing Items | 1.18 - 1.21 Support

## Overview
Stop items from vanishing silently! Item Despawn Timer (IDT) is a lightweight and highly optimized utility plugin that displays a live countdown timer above every dropped item on the ground.

Whether you run a Survival, PVP, or RPG server, IDT helps your players spot valuable loot instantly with glowing outlines and precise despawn countdowns. It also helps reduce server lag by ensuring items are removed efficiently when their time is up.

## **✨ Key Features**
- **Live Countdown:** Shows exactly how many seconds are left before an item disappears. Smart Item Counting: Automatically displays the stack amount (e.g., `x64`) in Green, only when the amount is greater than 1.
- **✨ Glowing Effect:** Configurable glowing outline (spectral effect) makes items easy to spot in the dark or from a distance.
- **Clean Formatting:** Uses a minimalist design: <Item Name> <xAmount> | <Time>s.
 - Example: Diamond Sword | 120s
 - Example: Oak Log x64 | 30s
- **⚙️ Fully Configurable:** Change the despawn time using seconds (s), minutes (m), hours (h), or even days (d). Version Guard: Built-in safety feature that automatically disables the plugin on unsupported server versions (below 1.18) to prevent errors.
Lag Free: Items are physically removed from the world when the timer hits 0, freeing up server RAM.
  
**Compatibility**
• Supported Versions: Minecraft 1.18, 1.19, 1.20, 1.21+
• Software: Spigot, Paper, Purpur.
• Java Requirement: Java 17 or newer.
