title: Endurance
description: Adds a status effect that will save you from dying and (barely) keep you alive.
body:
# Description
This mod adds 2 new status effects that are inspired by Dead by Daylight. These status effects **only apply to players** for now.
- **Endurance**
- **Deep Wound**

Some enchantments and potions about these 2 status effects are also added.

This comes with a 32x resource pack for the textures in this mod. You can use it if you are using any 32x resource packs. Click [here](https://github.com/The-best-cat/endurance-fabric/releases) to download.

You can add this mod as a dependency and access the status effects in your code. The set up process is at the bottom.

Here are the simplified descriptions of the 2 status effects. For detailed explanation, please visit [Wiki](https://github.com/The-best-cat/endurance-fabric/wiki/Status-Effects).

## ![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9a399a4eb6f4935974ed47307646924f6acab27.png) Endurance
Prevents **fatal damage** once, leaving you at **1 HP** and applying **Deep Wound**. Removes all other Endurance effects.  
  
Does **not** trigger if you already have **Deep Wound**.

### Obtainable from
- Eating food
- Undying enchantment
- Potion of Endurance

### For each amplifier
- You will gain Deep Wound with the same amplifier of this status effect.

## ![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29fcf4598dff49f58a7acb3cb191f3881245fce9.png) Deep Wound
Removes all other status effects and applies **20 Bleed Points (BP)**. Lose 1 **BP/sec**, dies when all **BP** are lost.  

Taking damage increases **loss speed** and can cause **instant death** after multiple hits.

**Sprinting**, **eating**, and **drinking** slows down bleeding. **Increasing MP**, **taking damage** or **damaging mobs** pauses bleeding.

Health restoration is converted to **mending progress (MP)**, conversion rate is increased when sneaking. Remaining **still** and **sneaking** will gradually increase **MP**. 

**MP** is **gradually lost** if it does **not** increase within **5 seconds**.

Reaching **20 MP** removes **Deep Wound**, converting a portion of remaining **BP** into **Absorption** and granting **Regeneration IV** + **Speed I** for **2s**.

While suffering from **Deep Wound**, your vision will **slowly fade**. This can be turned on/off using this command ```/endurance showVignette true/false```.

![Orange frames = Mending progress, Special red hearts = Bleed points](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb7e1d74b8fd1833b5dd54cf3c0d19025afeb486.png)
- Orange frames = Mending progress
- Red hearts = Bleed points

### Obtainable from
- Triggering Endurance effect
- Borrowed Life enchantment
- Potion of bleeding

### For each amplifier
- Time it takes to lose all BP -2s
- Time it takes to fully mend -1s

# Set up
If you want to access the status effects in your own mods, follow this set up to depend your mods on this mod.

```
repositories {
    maven {
        url = "https://api.modrinth.com/maven"
    }
}

dependencies {
    modImplementation "maven.modrinth:deep-wound:{the_version}"
}
```

The version is in format ```x.y.z+[mc_version]``` e.g. ```1.0.0+1.21.7```.

The code is documented in the Wiki page. You also need to add the DuskyWisp's Library mod in your mods folder for your dev client to run. It can be downloaded via the link below. 

# Dependencies
- [DuskyWisp's Library (required)](https://modrinth.com/mod/duskywisps-library)

# Languages
- English (US)
- English (UK)
- Chinese (Taiwan)
- Chinese (Hong Kong)
- French (Canada)
- French (France)
### Huge thank you to ysob64 for translating to French!

# MISC
**Yes** you can include this mod in your modpacks. 

**Yes** you can use this mod as a dependency.

**Yes** you can post your mods that depend on this mod on mod platforms.

**Yes** you can freely use the textures in this mod.

**Yes** you can make the resource pack better and post it although I don't think anyone has got nothing better to do than doing this.

**Yes** I might release Neoforge version but I'm still learning.

**No** you cannot copy my code and post it somewhere else under your name.

**No** you cannot post this mod on other platforms under your name.

**No** you cannot modify this mod and claim it is yours.

**No** I will not backport to older versions.

### If there are any issues, please report it through my Email heinok.chow@gmail.com or through Github, thank you.

title: Better PvP
description: Adds cool new weapons, enchantments and more to enhance your PvP experience !
body:
**This mod adds items, enchantments, potions and armor to enhance your PvP experience !**

_(i) The images below show how to craft or obtain each feature. To see them in action, check out [the gallery.](https://modrinth.com/mod/mod-better-pvp/gallery)_
______________________________________________________________________________________________
# ✨ Features:

## Escape whistle:
Levitates the target in a beam of light, then teleports them 500 blocks away (random X or Z axis).

![Escape Whistle Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c06b1a510da0656442f430e19e10a73a17f3afdf.jpeg)

## Heal stick:
Restores the user to full health. Cooldown: 30 seconds (600 ticks).

![Heal Stick Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3714f2e70a79ffd7affe199065108690154653ae.jpeg)

## Scythe:
10% chance to destroy the off-hand item of the target on hit.

![Scythe Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb7d602b17f50a4ce3e43a65dfc831ab30adea16.jpeg)

## Slime Boots:
Grants the ability to double jump.

![Slime Boots Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6e283112d8934264b5650f06a1bba4f76e84330.jpeg)

## Anonymous:
Makes the entity using it invisible (when applied on helmet).

Obtainable via loot tables (enchantment books).

![Anonymous Fishing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/773ef5056b762199598089f59a90719d3f97df2b.jpeg)

## Life Steal:
Grants hearts to the owner of the enchantment after a hit.

Available through villager trades (librarians).

![Lifesteal Trade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac776b56a0be2c8a8c1e1476048cbd1c253eb14f.jpeg)

## Marking (I - II):
Grants invisibility when applied to a helmet.

Available through villager trades (librarians).

![Marking Trade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/22202e3dbd25a49f07af53f1b7d6cda33a3a2b68.jpeg)

## Water Walker:
Grants the ability to walk on water.

Available through villager trades (librarians).

![Water Walker Trade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ca351fa4edbff469276f4d5890074cd1d8645e1.jpeg)

## Dummy:
Player like entity only spawnable with an spawn egg used for testing purposes.

![Dummy image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27fcca7e3f740f90e69fa495515415ec661ae95b.jpeg)

## Potion Of Confused:
When applied, sets the target's health to 12 minus a random number (1-10) hearts.

![Confused Potion Brewing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da8327a05e8e25bffdd68a83796ae4655eb21123.jpeg)

## Potion Of Dizziness:
When applied, gives the target nausea and causes random sprinting and sneaking.

![Dizziness Potion Brewing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c40c8b6ac3dac2e7f8eacd850a4995c436250aa.jpeg)

## Potion Of Milk:
A splash potion that remove every effects from target.

![Milk Potion Brewing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11ba243d4fc2696eede1b011c50c89e77fae6129.jpeg)

# ℹ️ Info:
All potions in this mod can be brewed into splash or lingering versions

![Splash Potion Of Milk Brewing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cabfdb61f200999fe9f83563a23c589d9c324278.jpeg)
Adding gunpowder turns them into splash potions.

![Lingering Potion Of Confused Brewing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/505d5037d1bdeda8ea890257e77b24e413120429.jpeg)
Adding dragon's breath turns them into lingering potions.

# 💘 Support:
Support this mod by sharing and recommending it! Your feedback helps me create more content. Check out my other mods on my [profile page :)](https://modrinth.com/user/Polr)

<summary>Shaders</summary>

- [Complementary Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined) + [Euphoria Patches](https://modrinth.com/mod/euphoria-patches)

</details>  



## ⭐ Why should I choose this modpack? ⭐

I really love what [Actions & Stuff](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/oreville-studios/actions--stuff-1.4/61c7a786-d7ad-49e0-a710-817121cd9795) brings to the table for Bedrock Edition and I always wished for something like it for Java.  
But unlike other Modpacks aiming for a Actions & Stuff recreation, I wanted to make something like it, but still make it feel unique enough.
Long story short, this is my vision of what Minecraft could be!

### 🔧 Optimization

This Modpack was made with optimization and performance in mind, if you don't run the bushy leaves or most importantly.. shaders.. your dirty ol' washing machine could probably run it!

Well, that means it's also a great modding foundation, as you could *_technically_* throw some of your favorite mods in there and it *_should_* still work fine! (don't quote me on that)  
You can also tweak most mods in their respective config files, straight from the mod menu or remove the mods you don't like! I don't judge!

### 🤏 Carefully Handpicked Mods

I took the time to only add mods that work together flawlessly! I also didn't go overboard with the mods, only adding what was nessecary for my own vision. 

### 🔗 Versions

As Minecrafts developement goes on, this Modpack will also keep moving forward! If the mods allow it, I will keep updating it to the newest version of Minecraft so you can enjoy everything new while staying fresh! This will come with the cost of time, as I am not the mod creator and we shall respect the time and effort that goes into creating mods!

### 🖥 What makes this ALMOST Client-Side?

[Boids](https://modrinth.com/mod/boids), [Wet Sand](https://modrinth.com/mod/wet-sand) and some Features of [Subtle Effects](https://modrinth.com/mod/subtle-effects) are Server-Side. If you want to play on a Vanilla Server, just disable Boids and Wet Sand. Subtle Effects should still work mostly fine when only running on Client!

[*insert video here / this could be your video here*]

Have fun with **Stern's All Sorts & Stuff!** (SASS for short.. yes, I wanted it to sound like the word 'sassy'.. I'm not that funny)

If you are experiencing any issues, shoot me a message on discord: **sternensohn**

title: lifestealXX
description: A lifesteal plugin made by Robin
body:
# LifestealXX

A lightweight, production-ready Lifesteal plugin for Paper/Spigot 1.21.x. Players lose hearts on death, steal hearts on kills, craft Heart items, and use Revive Beacons to bring eliminated players back. Everything is configurable: min/default/max hearts, death penalties, item recipes, and more. Includes PlaceholderAPI support, admin tools, and hot-reload.

## ✨ Features

Configurable hearts system: set min, default, and max hearts.

Steal on kill: killer gains a heart (or drops a heart if at max).

Heart items: craftable and consumable only below a threshold (e.g. under 10 hearts).

Revive Beacon: revive eliminated players to a configurable heart count.

Droplogic: optional heart drops on non-player deaths or when killer is maxed.

Withdraw: convert your own hearts into Heart items.

Admin toolkit: get/set/add/remove hearts, eliminate/revive, give items, and reload.

PlaceholderAPI: clean placeholders for scoreboards, tabs, and holograms.

Hot reload: /lifesteal reload applies config & recipes without a restart.

## 🕹️ Gameplay (defaults)

Max hearts: 20 (40 HP).

Consume Heart items only when you’re below 10 hearts.

On player kill: killer gains 1 heart; if already at max, a Heart item drops.

On non-player death: Heart item drops.

At min hearts: player is eliminated (Spectator) until revived.

## 🔧 Commands

/withdraw [amount] — turn your hearts into Heart items (leaves a minimum set by config).

/revive <player> — revive an eliminated player (must hold a Revive Beacon).

Admin [/lifesteal or /ls]

get <player> — show hearts/elimination.

set <player> <hearts> — set hearts (respects min/max).

add <player> <amount> / remove <player> <amount>

revive <player> [hearts] — revive without a beacon.

eliminate <player> — set to min & Spectator.

giveheart <player> [amount] / givebeacon <player> [amount]

reload — reload data & config (re-registers recipes).

## 🔤 Placeholders

```%lifesteal_current_hearts%``` — player’s current hearts

```%lifesteal_max_hearts%``` — max hearts (from config)

```%lifesteal_display%``` — current/max (e.g. 9/20)
Aliases: ```%lifesteal_current%```, ```%lifesteal_max%```

## 🔧 dependencies
- [placeholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi)
- **java 21 required!**
## ⚙️ Config (config.yml)

- Fully configurable hearts, behavior, and both recipes (shape, ingredients, output), plus item name/lore/material/glint.
```
hearts:
  min: 0
  default: 10
  max: 20
  consume_below: 10
  lose_on_death: 1
  withdraw_min_remaining: 1
  eliminate_at_min: true

behavior:
  give_killer_heart_on_kill: true
  drop_on_nonplayer_death: true
  drop_when_killer_at_max: true

items:
  heart:
    material: NETHER_WART
    name: "&c&lHeart"
    lore: ["&7Consume to gain 1 heart", "&7Usable only when below 10 hearts"]
    glint: true
    recipe:
      amount: 1
      shape: ["RRR","RNR","RRR"]
      ingredients: { R: REDSTONE_BLOCK, N: NETHER_STAR }

  revive_beacon:
    material: BEACON
    name: "&b&lRevive Beacon"
    lore: ["&7Use /revive <player> while holding this"]
    glint: true
    recipe:
      amount: 1
      shape: ["NSN","SBS","NSN"]
      ingredients: { N: NETHER_STAR, S: NETHERITE_SCRAP, B: BEACON }
```
Reload in-game with: /lifesteal reload.

## ✅ Compatibility

Server: Paper / Spigot 1.21.x (Paper recommended; Purpur/Pufferfish/spigot compatible)

## 📦 Installation

Drop the plugin JAR into plugins/.

(Optional) Install PlaceholderAPI.

Start the server once to generate config.yml.

Tweak config & recipes, then /lifesteal reload.

## 🔐 Permissions

lifesteal.withdraw — use /withdraw (default: true)

lifesteal.revive — use /revive with a beacon (default: true)

lifesteal.admin — all admin commands (default: op)

title: Scorch
description: Additional blocks, structures, and re-balancing for the nether
body:
Scorch is a mod which adds new content to the nether and rebalances nether gameplay, particularly netherite mining.



**World Generation**

- Gravel replaced by ironsand
- Build height increased
- Nether is slightly higher and slightly deeper
- Annoying lava deposits no longer exist underground

**Pyrack**

- New ore that drops gunpowder
- Can be ignited for chain reaction explosions
- Great for searching for debris underground

![a vein of pyrack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c3abb182c0d3220191352f22a91c5d87854865e.png)

**Ignistone**

- Found deep underground near large deposits of ancient debris
- Turns into lava if mined without silk touch

![some ignistone near a patch of ancient debris](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/513e4995b27f1da7a273b8a61057a23da3f23a81.png)

**Crying Obsidian**

- Creates ignistone when placed above a lava source
- Creates netherrack when placed above flowing lava

![crying obsidian creating ignistone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4baeea0721363da6e3bd309802a7620569cc4f4c_0.webp)

**Ironsand & Ironstone**

- New nether blockset
- Mining ironsand will give ironsand clumps or flint
- Ironsand clumps can be smelted into iron nuggets
- Ironsand clumps can be crafted back into ironsand
- Ironsand can be crafted into ironstone
- Ironsand be used to smelt glass
- Ironsand be used to craft TNT
- Ironstone comes with slab, stair, chiseled, and wall variants
- Ironstone can also be crafted into burial urns, but the burial urns will not contain anything

![the ironsand and ironstone block palate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5799de55c1c5b446eb6bdc7f60d873c2770a0e0.png)

**Crypts**

- New structure made of Ironstone that spawns deep underground
- Inhabited by wither skeletons
- Lots of loot inside, especially if you break the Burial Urns or dig up graves
- You can find Totems of Returning here
- Being caught disturbing the crypt by Possessed Ironstone will cause the player to build up a curse
- Curse build up will awaken more of the crypt and reduce your maximum HP
- Curse build up persists beyond death, but it will go away after some time or when a golden apple is eaten
- You can craft Possessed Ironstone using ghast tears

![the crypt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6ca0845194d6bb0192d774c95cd14c5e0ef10e4_0.webp)

![health bar affected by cursed hearts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f36a9c078790ca6f5ba993a21e4f977d0bc5e4c.png)

_Thank you to SnakeBlock for the broken heart texture_

![possessed ironstone that is upset with the player](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3241f356c2af8ce5647f3075f7649ad7a052e360.png)

**Totem of Returning**

- Totems of Returning are a one-time use item which will safely teleport you to your spawn point when used
- Can be found in Burial Urns in Crypts

![totem of returning item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca1ccdb01fe051df14aca2923ed4a300cca9aa23.png)

**Striders**

- Striders can be sheared for string
- Strider hair can be styled with magma cream
- Striders will grow their hair back over time but this process can be accelerated using warped roots
- Striders will not grow their hair back if they are cold

![strider with curly hair](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8e964553b7bd6e1a356638f3a8cf99da0042b57.png)

**Misc Changes**

- Wither Skull and Nether Star item entities are immune to fire and lava
- Wither Skeletons have a 100% chance to drop a Wither Skull if killed by a ghast fireball
- Piglins give ironsand instead of gravel
- Water Bottles are craftable by adding a glass bottle and a ghast tear in the crafting menu
- Nether fog is nerfed so you can now see further

![view of the nether with the increased height and less fog](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d166c5711c619c46094bb9eb771f0bf9a8d0e27_0.webp)

title: Rusted
description: Rusted is an immersive modification that expands the copper oxidation mechanic (introduced in vanilla Minecraft) to Iron Blocks. Add realism and depth to your world by watching iron structures and blocks gradually succumb to corrosion, progressing through
body:
# <center>✨ RUSTED MOD ✨
![modpack title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1956eb7066704762c5f68138bac2e460bc5dd683.png)
### Corrosion Takes Hold of Your World
Rusted is a mod that extends the copper oxidation mechanic to iron blocks. Add realism and depth to your world by watching iron structures corrode through four realistic rust states. Your metal structures will never look the same again.

#

### Dynamic Iron Rusting
All Iron Blocks and their variants oxidize over time, passing through four distinct rust stages. This process is synchronized with the game's natural cycle.

### Environmental Impact
Rust doesn't develop evenly. The corrosion process is significantly accelerated when a block comes into contact with water or is exposed to rain, providing a strategic element of structural protection.

### Complete Control Over Maintenance
You have complete control over the rusting process of your buildings:
Use the Honeycomb to apply a layer of wax to any block, permanently stopping the rusting process at that stage. Dewaxing and Scraping: Use the Axe to remove the wax layer. Scrape away the rust layer, restoring the block to its previous, cleaner state.

title: Chunk-Monitor
description: A Minecraft server plugin for monitoring chunk MSPT, dropped items, and entities. When values exceed set thresholds, it sends notifications to players and the console.
body:
# ChunkMonitor - Block Performance Monitoring Plugin

A Minecraft server block MSPT usage, dropped items, and entity monitoring plugin. When values exceed the configured threshold, notifications are sent to players and console.

## Feature Highlights

### Core Monitoring Functions

- **MSPT Monitoring** - Real-time monitoring of individual chunk loading time (milliseconds per tick)
- **Entity Count Monitoring** - Statistics for total entities within a chunk, preventing lag
- **Dropped Items Monitoring** - Statistics for dropped items within a chunk, promptly detecting item accumulation issues

### Notification System

- **Dual-Channel Notifications** - Support for independent control of in-game chat notifications and console notifications
- **Cooldown Mechanism** - Only notify once per chunk within 5 minutes, preventing spam
- **Precise Localization** - Displays world name, chunk coordinates, and specific block coordinate ranges
- **Multi-Language Support** - Built-in Chinese and English, customizable message templates

## Configuration File

```yaml
# Chunk Monitor Plugin Configuration File
# All time intervals are in Ticks (1 second = 20 Ticks)

# Language Setting
# Supported: zh_CN (Simplified Chinese), en_US (English)
language: "zh_CN"

# MSPT Monitoring Configuration
mspt:
  enabled: true
  interval: 100  # Detection interval in Ticks
  notification-limit: 50.0  # Notification limit in milliseconds

# Entity Count Monitoring Configuration
entity:
  enabled: true
  interval: 80  # Detection interval in Ticks
  notification-limit: 200  # Entity count limit per chunk

# Item Drop Monitoring Configuration
item:
  enabled: true
  interval: 60  # Detection interval in Ticks
  notification-limit: 100  # Item drop count limit per chunk

# Cooldown Configuration
cooldown:
  duration: 5  # Notification cooldown in minutes

# Notification Configuration
notification:
  broadcast: true  # Send notification to all players
  console: true  # Send notification to console
  show-coordinates: true  # Show coordinate range

# Message Configuration
messages:
  zh_CN:
    # MSPT 通知消息
    mspt_alert: "§c[区块监控] §e世界: %world% §r| §e区块: [%chunk_x%, %chunk_z%] §r| §e坐标范围: X [%coord_min_x% ~ %coord_max_x%] Z [%coord_min_z% ~ %coord_max_z%] §r| §cMSPT: %value% ms §r(上限: %limit% ms)"

    # 实体数量通知消息
    entity_alert: "§c[区块监控] §e世界: %world% §r| §e区块: [%chunk_x%, %chunk_z%] §r| §e坐标范围: X [%coord_min_x% ~ %coord_max_x%] Z [%coord_min_z% ~ %coord_max_z%] §r| §c实体数量: %value% §r(上限: %limit%)"

    # 掉落物通知消息
    item_alert: "§c[区块监控] §e世界: %world% §r| §e区块: [%chunk_x%, %chunk_z%] §r| §e坐标范围: X [%coord_min_x% ~ %coord_max_x%] Z [%coord_min_z% ~ %coord_max_z%] §r| §c掉落物: %value% §r(上限: %limit%)"

    # 启用消息
    enabled_message: "§a[区块监控] 插件已加载"
    server_type_message: "§6服务器类型: %type%"
    disabled_message: "§c[区块监控] 插件已卸载"

  en_US:
    # MSPT Alert Message
    mspt_alert: "§c[ChunkMonitor] §eWorld: %world% §r| §eChunk: [%chunk_x%, %chunk_z%] §r| §eCoordinates: X [%coord_min_x% ~ %coord_max_x%] Z [%coord_min_z% ~ %coord_max_z%] §r| §cMSPT: %value% ms §r(Limit: %limit% ms)"

    # Entity Count Alert Message
    entity_alert: "§c[ChunkMonitor] §eWorld: %world% §r| §eChunk: [%chunk_x%, %chunk_z%] §r| §eCoordinates: X [%coord_min_x% ~ %coord_max_x%] Z [%coord_min_z% ~ %coord_max_z%] §r| §cEntity Count: %value% §r(Limit: %limit%)"

    # Item Drop Alert Message
    item_alert: "§c[ChunkMonitor] §eWorld: %world% §r| §eChunk: [%chunk_x%, %chunk_z%] §r| §eCoordinates: X [%coord_min_x% ~ %coord_max_x%] Z [%coord_min_z% ~ %coord_max_z%] §r| §cItem Drops: %value% §r(Limit: %limit%)"

    # Enable Message
    enabled_message: "§a[ChunkMonitor] Plugin enabled"
    server_type_message: "§6Server Type: %type%"
    disabled_message: "§c[ChunkMonitor] Plugin disabled"
```

title: Evol's 3D Totems - Angels or Demons?
description: This pack enhances the vanilla Totem of Undying by offering three distinct 3D models to choose from: a classic vanilla-like version, an angelic totem, or a demonic totem. Choose your style and add a unique flair to your Minecraft survival.
body:
# Evol's 3D Totems - Angels or Demons?

Welcome to the **Evol's 3D Totems - Angels or Demons?** resource pack! This pack enhances the vanilla Totem of Undying by offering three distinct 3D models to choose from: a classic vanilla-like version, an angelic totem, or a demonic totem. Choose your style and add a unique flair to your Minecraft survival.

## Features

- **Three Unique 3D Totem Models:**
  - **Vanilla-like Totem (Default):** A 3D model that stays true to the classic Minecraft aesthetic.
  - **Angelic Totem:** A celestial design featuring glowing wings and a holy aura, perfect for those who walk the path of light.
  - **Demonic Totem:** A fearsome design with dark, jagged features and an ominous glow, for those who embrace the shadows.
- **Immersive Experience:** Adds depth and character to the Totem of Undying, making each save from death more thematic.
- **Seamless Integration:** Designed to blend well with the existing Minecraft aesthetic while providing a refreshing visual update.

## Installation

1. **Download:** Download the `Evols_Totems_Angels_or_Demons_V1.00.zip` file.
2. **Locate Resource Packs Folder:**
  - Open Minecraft.
  - Go to `Options` -> `Resource Packs`.
  - Click on `Open Pack Folder`.
3. **Move the Pack:** Drag and drop the downloaded `.zip` file into the opened resource packs folder.
  - **DO NOT UNZIP THE FILE.**
4. **Activate:**
  - Return to Minecraft's `Resource Packs` screen.
  - You should see the pack in the list of available packs on the left.
  - Click the arrow button to move it to the "Selected Resource Packs" list on the right.
5. **Enjoy!** Click `Done` and your new totem will be active in-game. The default model is the vanilla-like version.

## How to Choose Your Totem Model

This pack includes all three models, with the vanilla-like version active by default. To switch to the Angel or Demon model, you will need to rename some files inside the `.zip` pack.

1. **Open the ZIP file:** Navigate to the `Evols_Totems_Angels_or_Demons_V1.00.zip` file. You can open it with a program like 7-Zip or WinRAR without unzipping the entire folder.
  
2. **Go to the Item Models Directory:** Inside the zip, navigate to the following path:
  `assets/minecraft/models/item/`
  
3. **Rename the Files:** You will see three files:
  
  - `totem_of_undying.json` (This is the active vanilla model)
  - `totem_of_undying.json.angel`
  - `totem_of_undying.json.demon`
  
  To change the active model, you need to rename the files. The game will only load the file named exactly `totem_of_undying.json`.
  
  **To use the DEMON totem:**
  
  - Rename the current `totem_of_undying.json` to `totem_of_undying.json.vanilla`.
  - Rename `totem_of_undying.json.demon` to `totem_of_undying.json`.
  
  **To use the ANGEL totem:**
  
  - Rename the current `totem_of_undying.json` to `totem_of_undying.json.vanilla`.
  - Rename `totem_of_undying.json.angel` to `totem_of_undying.json`.
4. **Save and Reload:** Save the changes in your zip archiver. In Minecraft, you may need to reload your resource packs by pressing `F3 + T` or by deselecting and reselecting the pack in the menu.
  

## Compatibility

- Requires Minecraft version 1.19 or higher.
- Compatible with most other resource packs that do not modify the `totem_of_undying` model or texture.

## Support & Feedback

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please visit my [Modrinth page](https://modrinth.com/user/Evol-Luci).

## Credits

- **Creator:** Luci_Evol
- **Original Demonic Totem:** By [douxPR](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/douxprs-3d-totem-of-undying) (updated and re-textured by Luci_Evol).
- **Original Angelic Totem:** By Luci_Evol (Heavily inspired by douxPR).

## License

This resource pack is licensed under [e.g., MIT License, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0]. See the `LICENSE.md` file for full details.

title: Server Backup
description: Automatic and manual server backup plugin with custom naming and easy restoration for Bukkit/Paper servers
body:
# ServerBackup

A comprehensive Bukkit/Paper plugin for automated and manual server backups with custom naming and easy restoration.

## Features

- **Automatic Backups**: Configurable scheduled backups (hourly, daily, weekly)
- **Manual Backups**: Create backups instantly with custom names
- **Easy Restoration**: Simple commands to restore any backup
- **World Selection**: Choose which worlds to include in backups
- **Additional Files**: Include plugins, configs, and other server files
- **Smart Cleanup**: Automatically remove old backups to save space
- **Batch Restoration**: Includes Windows .bat file for easy manual restoration
- **Tab Completion**: Full command auto-completion support
- **Permission System**: Granular permissions for different backup operations

## Commands

- `/backup` - Create a backup with default name
- `/backup create [name]` - Create a backup with custom name
- `/backup list` - List all available backups
- `/backup load <filename>` - Restore a backup
- `/backup delete <filename>` - Delete a backup file
- `/backup reload` - Reload plugin configuration
- `/backup help` - Show help information

## Permissions

- `serverbackup.use` - Basic backup commands (default: op)
- `serverbackup.admin` - Admin commands (reload, delete)
- `serverbackup.load` - Restore backups

## Configuration

The plugin creates a detailed config file with options for:
- Automatic backup intervals
- World selection
- Additional files to backup
- Cleanup settings
- Custom messages

## Requirements

- Bukkit, Spigot, or Paper server
- Minecraft 1.21+
- Java 21+

title: Witch of Many Colors
description: A Fabric Modpack based around Bewitchment, Spectrum, and the RPG Series, with Immersive Portals and Gravity for fun.
body: Based around Bewitchment, Spectrum, and the RPG Series, with Immersive Portals, Gravity, and Bits and Chisels for fun with sizes, this pack explores some of the unusual mods in Fabric. # Note about 1.0.4 update: The 1.0.3 pack version had a modified pack name. Fixing that in the 1.0.4 pack update apparently makes Modrinth install a separate profile. I don't know why this happens, as the pack id should be the same. To handle this, copy everything except the mods/ folder from the old profile to the new one. # Important Facts: * The biggest progression mods are Bewitchment (a rebuild of Witchery) and Spectrum (like ChromatiCraft) * Each of the RPG Series classes has spell books, and some have additional important items * Any RPG Series weapon can cast any RPG series spells (hammer cast fireball, etc.) * The biggest exploration mods are Wilder Wilds, Promenade, BetterNether, and BetterEnd * Hover over each inventory slot to see additional Trinkets slots (a terrible interface) * Put a lantern on your belt for hands-free dynamic lighting ## Portals * The Immersive Portals mod exists, use the Portal Wand to create and move portals * Use /portal delete_portal four times, once from each direction, to fully delete a portal * The Gravity mod exists, use /portal set_portal_nbt {teleportChangesGravity:true} looking at a portal * Portals that connect different sizes will shrink you, use /scale set 1 to reset ## Fun Items * Use a Spyglass to create constellations * Put banners on horses, which have some improvements and enchantable armor * Use a Scarf, a Scarf Stapler, and pieces of wool to make long scarves * You can make multi-block elevators (search in JEI for "Elevator") * There are multiple kinds of hammers, including weapons and 3x3 mining, choose carefully * The Bits and Chisels mod exists * There are Magnum Torches and Building Wands * Use Scythes to right-click harvest in an area, and replant ## Additional Notes * You can jump over fences * You can right-click things like ingots on the ground to place them * There are cosmetic armor slots and a menu for making your armor partially transparent * The /changedimension and /wits commands exist * Better Combat is recommended by the RPG Series, so it's been included * Gazebos probably doesn't work w/ Luki's Grand Capitals, but keeping it in just in case Icon made with Font generator # Setup guide for servers: ## Disable Universal Gravestones There's a server-only bug involving Universal Gravestones. It's probably an incompatibility with Immersive Portals. Removing the last item from your grave kicks you with DecoderException: IndexOutOfBoundsException, and you can't log in again for about a minute. Recommendation: disable Universal Gravestones on the server and /gamerule keepInventory true. Clients do not need to disable the mod. # Pickaxe and Material Tiers ## Pickaxes #### Tier 0 (Wood / can mine Stone) * Wood Pickaxe - Minecraft (vanilla) #### Tier 1 (Stone / can mine Iron Ore) * Stone Pickaxe - Minecraft (vanilla) * Copper Pickaxe - Mythic Metals #### Tier 2 (Iron / can mine Diamond Ore) * Iron Pickaxe - Minecraft (vanilla) * Aquarium Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Banglum Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Bronze Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Quadrillum Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Thallasium Pickaxe - Better End (unusual construction) * Cincinnasite Pickaxe - Better Nether #### Tier 3 (Diamond / can mine Obsidian) * Diamond Pickaxe - Minecraft (vanilla) * Resonarium Pickaxe - Deeper and Darker (must be found?) * Carmot Pickaxe - Mythic Metals (extra effect) * Durasteel Pickaxe - Mythic Metals (must be found?) * Kyber Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Legendary Banglum Pickaxe - Mythic Metals (extra effect) * Osmium Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Prometheum Pickaxe - Mythic Metals (extra effect) * Runite Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Steel Pickaxe - Mythic Metals (must be found?) * Stormyx Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Tidesinger Pickaxe - Mythic Metals (extra effect) * Terminite Pickaxe - Better End (unusual construction) * Nether Ruby Pickaxe - Better Nether (extra effect) * Cincinnasite-Diamond Pickaxe - Better Nether (extra effect) #### Tier 4 (Netherite / can mine some modded blocks like Unobtainium) (Some of these might actually be tier 5, but I don't have a way to check that) * Netherite Pickaxe - Minecraft (vanilla) * Warden Pickaxe - Deeper and Darker * Adamantite Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Celestium Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Hallowed Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Metallurgium Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Mythril Drill - Mythic Metals (has fuel and upgrades) * Mythril Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Orichalcum Pickaxe - Mythic Metals * Palladium Pickaxe - Mythic Metals (extra effect) * Star Platinum Pickaxe - Mythic Metals (must be found?) * Aeternium Pickaxe - Better End (unusual construction) * Fire Ruby Pickaxe - Better Nether (extra effect) ## Materials #### Tier 0 (can be mined by Wood Pickaxe) * Minecraft (vanilla): all stone blocks: Stone, Calcite, Diorite, etc. * Bewitchment: Salt Ore * Better End: Ender Ore, Amber Ore, Thallasium Ore #### Tier 1 (can be mined by Stone Pickaxe) * Minecraft (vanilla): many ores: Iron Ore, Copper Ore, etc. * Mythic Metals: Manganese Ore, Midas Gold Ore, Silver Ore, Tin Ore (not used) #### Tier 2 (can be mined by Iron Pickaxe) * Minecraft (vanilla): several ores: Diamond Ore, Gold Ore, etc. * Bewitchment: Silver Ore * Mythic Metals: Aquarium Ore, Banglum Ore, Carmot Ore, Kyber Ore, Morkite Ore, Osmium Ore, Platinum Ore, Prometheum Ore, Quadrillum Ore, Runite Ore, Stormyx Ore * Jewelry (RPG Series): Gem Vein * Better Nether: Cincinnasite Ore #### Tier 3 (can be mined by Diamond Pickaxe) * Minecraft (vanilla): Obsidian, Crying Obsidian, etc. * Mythic Metals: Adamantite Ore, Mythril Ore, Orichalcum Ore, Palladium Ore, Starrite Ore (not used) * Better Nether: Nether Ruby Ore #### Tier 4 (can be mined by Netherite Pickaxe) * Minecraft (vanilla): nothing requires this level * Mythic Metals: Unobtainium Ore

title: Klsts' Monsters
description: Adds various monsters and features
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04fd2fe31db3418d13cc27c2a3c3fa75c809be64.png)

This mods adds new mobs and mechanics to challenge the player!

![Monster Hearts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cad25c4fe5587535d48ab8c58f9b8792b99cb84.png)

First, monster mobs will have a chance of dropping Monster Heart Pieces, which can be crafted into Monster Hearts, used as a new resource for things of the mod, as Halloween Potions, Weapons, Armor . . .

![Halloween effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/568f926f2a18508617deab079e746cd843ac2fce.png)

Also, a new important potion effect : Halloween. This effect will kill the player if they try to sleep. On top of that, when hit, a Rotten Arm (new mob) will spawn and attack the entity with the effect. Halloween has a chance of being inflicted when waking up or sometimes by being attacked by an Undead mob. But Halloween has also some good properties! Like increasing Monster Heart Pieces chance of dropping, or boosting/activating some items, so balance it is key.

(There 2 new gamerules called DoHalloweenInNightmares, which if false won't inflict Halloween when sleeping, and UndeadInflictHalloween, which is the chance of inflicting Halloween when hit by an Undead, set to 0 to disable).

![Turnips](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7df45137d954cddc1628899a8c9b1c0f8785d1d9.png)

Halloween can not be cured using Milk, but can be cured using food made with a new Crop: Turnips!

Turnips can be found by breaking Wild Turnips, which generate randomly on the overworld. Also Farmer Villagers can trade Turnip-related-items.

![Mystic Runes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b54f617ae53b25ee99c05bc6d4a88821fcfb228.png)

Another new mechanic is Advanced Monsters! Monsters have a chance of spawning more powerful than usual, if they are around a 20+ lvl player (use gamerule MinimumAdvancedMonsterSpawnLevel). Also Monsters from this mod have extra quirks when Advanced, to make defeating them more difficult. When an Advanced Monster is killed by the player, it has a chance of dropping a Mystic Runes used in some things on the mod like Weapons, Armors . . . and alse they can drop Lootboxes, which give loot depending on which advancements the player has (only checks for getting iron, diamond, Ancient Debris, Netherite Armor).

Advanced Monsters Levels depend on the players level divided by MinimumAdvancedMonsterSpawnLevel, and will show up in the top left corner of the screen (by default) as an overlay.

(There is a new Gamerule called AdancedMonsterSpawnChance, set to 0 to disable Advanced Monsters from spawning).



Another new mechanic are Dire Hits, which are powerful blows dealt by some weapons and mobs. These attacks deal x1.5 damage and can be used alongside Critical Hits to deal extra damage, but some mechanics of the weapon such as Fire Damage or Poison won't take effect. To deactivate Monster Dire Hits use the gamerule: AllowMonsterDireHits. More info in the ingame guide.

![The Hunter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c406a631c3025d7b1f7a2da46e2d4680b14e47f0.png)

There is new Villager job, the Hunter! Their job block is the unactive Vampire Artifact, found in Vampire Fortresses, a new structure. They trade some items from the mod.

There are new red named enchantments wich can only be obtained in the new Sculk Vampire Artifact, using a new resource called Cursed Diamonds. Cursed Diamonds can be found in the new Structure, the Cursed Tower (or in Vampire Fortresses but more rarely) or by creating them using the Cursed Converter. 



And the most important part, the mobs! This mod adds 16 new Monsters mobs such as Vampires or Freepers, Creepers cold cousins. And 1 mini boss!

More info of the mobs in the ingame guide.

![Some of the Monsters](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf482665844ffea75f7869da5861b61e73d3dc48.png)

I hope you like the mod! Any feedback is apreciated!

This mod is made using Mcreator.

title: Scroll Scribing
description:
Make spell scrolls like a true wizard!

                                                                                 annoy me on discord if there is a problem
body:
Adds a recipe to craft custom spell scrolls!

To craft a spell scroll you need a sheet of paper, book or a book and quill.

Then you add an ink of choice.

You also add an arrow or spectral arrow for the projectile.

Lastly you can add Sugar, Gunpowder and Glowstone to your other hand to add modifiers to your spell!

Crouch to burn your scroll for extra stat points in exchange for durability!


annoy me on discord if there is a problem:
https://discord.gg/9GXYqDmC


When using a spellscroll you can put a piece of lapis, a gold ingot, redstone, a slimeball or an amethyst shard in the other hand to add an extra effect to your scroll! This will consume the item though so be carefull when using them.



* Stats explained:


Each spell scroll has the following attributes:

ammo: indicates the amount of projectiles you launch similair to the multishot enchantment.

speed: shows how fast your projectiles get launched (base projectile speed of 1)

damage: how much extra damage your projectiles deal (base damage of 1)

durability: amount of uses a scroll has

( durability = ink durability * paper durability )



* Ingredient effects:

Gunpowder: Increases projectile damage by 1

Glowstone: Increases Projectile damage by 2

Sugar: Increases Projectile speed by 1

Arrow: Adds 1 projectile to the spell

Spectral arrow: Adds 2 projectiles to the spell


Ink: adds 1 ink durability

Glowing ink: adds 2 ink durability


Paper: Adds 1 paper durability

Book: Adds 2 paper durability

Book and quill: Adds 4 paper durability



* Second hand effects:

Lapis: +2 damage, +1 speed

Gold ingot: heals 4 hp

Redstone: +5 damage, 4 magic damage taken by user

Slime ball: 1/2 x ammo, 2 x damage

Amethyst shard: +4 damage, -1 speed


* Burning a scroll:

consumes the entire scroll and adds the amount of times you can multiply it by 2 amount to the damage, speed and ammo. 
2 durability means +1 to all stats on cast, 
4 durability means +2  to all stats on cast, 
8 durability means +3 to all stats on cast

**This will only work when crouching and on full durability! This will consume the entire scroll!!!**

title: Living Fauna
description: Adds real-world animals to Minecraft, each with unique behaviors and interactions.
body:
# Living Fauna

**Living Fauna** adds real-world animals to Minecraft, each designed with unique behaviors and interactions to make the world feel more alive.

## Current Mob

### Mouse
- Natural spawning in forests and dark areas (above Y50)
- Steal food from accessible chests
- Nearby mice scatter when one mouse is attacked
- Drops raw mouse meat


### Stoat
- Natural spawning in taiga biomes, meadows, and snowy biomes
- Hunts mice, rabbit and chickens
- Running away from players
- Can be tamed with raw mouse
- Baby stoats/ermine
- Has brown stoat and white ermine variants


### Toucan
- Spawns naturally in jungle, sparse jungle, and bamboo jungles
- Has yellow and white variants
- Can be tamed with melon slice, wheat seeds, pumpkin seeds, melon seeds

### Snail
- Spawns naturally in swamps, mangrove swamps, jungles, dark forests, and lush caves
- Hides in its shell when hurt
- Can randomly hide while idle

### Skunk (Thanks for [@VoidioV](https://www.curseforge.com/members/voidiov/) for idea)
- Spawns naturally in forests, birch forests, taigas, meadows, and rarely in plains or old growth taigas
- More active at night
- Can be tamed with sweet berries or glow berries
- Sprays when threatened or attacked
- Spray gives poison, nausea, and blindness
- Runs away after spraying
- Tamed skunks can spray mobs attacked by their owner


## Goal

The goal of this mod is to make Minecraft’s wildlife feel more alive, natural, and fun.

title: Copper Repeaters and Comparators DP+RP
description: Changes redstone repeaters and comparators to be made out of copper instead of stone. Datapack and resourcepack.
body:
This pack includes both a **datapack** and a **resourcepack**, which **can be used independently** if you only want one or the other, but I recommend you use both.
This pack was made to give copper a bit more use and to make repeaters and comparators look a bit cooler.

Compatible with **VanillaTweaks' 3D Items** _(see below!)_

If you have any **questions, comments or suggestions**, please post them on the project's [Planet Minecraft page](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/copper-repeaters-and-comparators-dp-rp/).

# Datapack:
The recipes for redstone repeaters and comparators are **changed** to require **copper ingots** instead of stone.
The vanilla recipes are **overriden**, you can't craft them with stone anymore.

# Resourcepack:
Repeaters and comparators have a **new copper look**, drawn by me based on the vanilla textures. Repeaters **change oxidation level** depending on the delay you set.

# Installation:
Put the **datapack** zip (the name has **DP** in it) in your world's _datapacks_ folder, and the **resourcepack** zip (the name has **RP** in it) in your _resourcepacks_ folder.

# Compatibility:
This datapack **is compatible** with VanillaTweaks' "3D Items" texture pack. If you use it remember to put this resourcepack **above** 3D Items!

# Credits:
Every texture was drawn by me using GIMP based on the vanilla textures, for the VanillaTweaks compatibility I replicated the structure of their repeater and comparator inventory model's json and tweaked it to refer to my model instead of the vanilla one (this obviously overrides their inventory model when using the two packs together).
Thanks to the people on Stardust Labs' Discord server for giving me tips and feedback.

# License:
Do not redistribute the textures included in these packs without permission. Please give credit if you use this in a modpack, datapack-pack or resourcepack-pack.

title: Digga's Nextbots
description: This mods adds Nextbots to your world! Be careful
body:
The Digga's Nextbots mod adds new creatures called Nextbots! These 2D PNG creatures are from the game Garry's Mod and will hunt the player. Despite their funny looks and strange noises, these creatures should not be underestimated. Nextbots are very fast, dangerous and almost invincible. They can track you down without even seeing you and some even from far away. They are immune to any kind of damage except to player damage. Can you escape them or will you just be another victim of the Nextbots?

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Diggazuspat and Zcoper 
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit our Discord Servers!

Diggazuspat: [https://discord.gg/fWQ3rXPhgw](https://discord.gg/fWQ3rXPhgw)

Zcoper: [https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why are Mobs not spawning?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► How can I disable Nextbots breaking blocks?

Nextbots breaking blocks can be disabled if you set the gamerule "mobGriefing" to false.

► How can I add Custom Nextbots?

It is indeed possible to create your own nextbots, if you know how to make a ressource pack for mods, and change the texture and sounds of present nextbots. 

► How can I disable Nextbots?

You can disable the natural spawning of Nextbots by changing the gamerule "doNextbotSpawn" to false

► Where does the Nextbots spawn?

Nextbots can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster when the gamerule "doNextbotSpawn" is set to true.

</details>



![Nextbots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab364812818d86dcb77804e2a26f4b373f83b700.png)

Nextbots are new creatures from the game Garry's Mod. They are 2D PNGs with funny looks and strange sounds, but they are fast and dangerous. Nextbots spawn in the overworld and there are different variants such as Obunga, Selene Delgado Lopez, Sanic, Wise Mystical Tree and many more! If a player is within 50 blocks of a Nextbot, it will immediately track them down, so they can see you even through walls. Obunga Watches and Angry Munci can do this even at much further distances. So they'll already be hunting you without you knowing. They are fast, fit through small hallways, kill instantly when attacking, are immune to almost all types of damage except player damage, and have a lot of health. They can also break shields, not sink on powder snow and are also fast in the water. To make them even more dangerous, Nextbots can also jump high and destroy blocks such as glass, wood, doors or leaves. If you want to make Nextbots disappear, use the new item “Configurater” and right-click a Nextbot with it. They should despawn, but this item is only available in Creative mode or through cheats.

title: Sliders technology
description: Sliders technology brings back the dimensional-exploration concept from the 90s TV series Sliders
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/L1wFOus_-rQ" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Discord server for bug/request/ideas: https://discord.gg/u9nWGhWuYy

_"What if you could travel to parallel worlds? The same year, the same Earth, only different dimensions."_

**Slidersmod brings back the dimensional-exploration concept from the 90s TV series Sliders.
This mod adds the iconic timers from the show into Minecraft, along with a set of blocks and gameplay mechanics designed to stay fully Minecraft-friendly!
You’ll be able to explore completely random destinations — each with their own perks and dangers — for a duration you decide. Whether you take the risk is entirely up to you!**

# REQUIRED MOD :

- Mekanism (REQUIRED)

- Immersive portals (= lot of incompatibilities with Immersive portal, especially Securitycraft !) OPTIONNAL BUT STRONGLY RECOMMENDED

- In control ! OPTIONNAL BUT STRONGLY RECOMMENDED

- Per Dimension Game Rules OPTIONNAL BUT STRONGLY RECOMMENDED
- Patchouli OPTIONNAL BUT STRONGLY RECOMMENDED
**
 These 4 mods are actually REQUIRED BUT next update will make them optionnal **

# Mod Content

• Immersive Portals integration
The mod leverages Immersive Portals to reproduce a vortex effect as cool as the one from the series!

• Crafting progression inspired by Mekanism
Most recipes are built around Mekanism resources, ensuring the Sliders technology isn’t accessible too early in your playthrough.

• Multiple custom dimensions
Featuring a tier-based dimension system with spawn probabilities:

- dimensions populated only by cats,

- dystopian worlds where the Nether has conquered the Overworld,

- worlds where time flows differently,

- post-apocalyptic landscapes,

...and more!

Some dimensions apply bonuses or dangerous penalties to the player — explore carefully!



• Functional and damaged timers
A working timer allows you to explore a random destination among many custom dimensions for a predetermined duration.
But if you try to force an early return, you’ll damage your timer, sending you into uncontrollable jumps with random durations and random worlds!

• Overheat system
Use your timer too frequently and it will overheat, forcing you to wait before rolling the dimensional dice again.

• Upgrade system
A freshly crafted timer is unstable and unpredictable — upgrades can make it far more efficient:

- reduced cooldown,

- reduced overheat probability,

- increased exploration time,

- access to exotic high-tier dimensions,

- ... and more!

• Four types of timers
Each with its own vortex style and special abilities:

- Original Timer — the standard model.

- Egyptian Timer — can track previously opened vortexes.

- Exodus Timer — can store explored locations and return to them later.

- Logan Timer — targets the Overworld exclusively (upgraded versions allow increasingly precise landing points).



• Multiplayer-friendly utility blocks
To make the experience richer in multiplayer:

- Quantum Recall Station — open a return vortex on a previously marked player.

- Proto-synchronizer — share exploration destinations with other players.

- …and more to come.

• Raid system
Vortexes may spontaneously open and let through various “explorers”: villagers, wardens, or even your doppelgänger…
Sometimes it’s an opportunity to get a timer the “easy” way!

# PLANNED FEATURES

Custom timer: a timer with a custom model/vortex/vortex rotation (almost ready)
Bug fixes
New dimensions (open to suggestions !)
Forge 1.21 porting 
Forge 1.19.2 porting ?
Fabric porting ?

description: A mod that adds more functions to items!
body:
## Features:
Using pickaxes, you can now crack certain blocks into different ones! In a chain, you can get back some of the resources used to make what you're cracking down. Stone Bricks can be cracked into Cracked Stone Bricks. Then they can be cracked into Stone. Then Cobblestone! Then you can do it all again.

Shovels get the same function, but instead of cracking, they can grind! Stone into gravel, gravel to sand. Allowing the farming of sand or gravel, and making them renewable!

Sticks are the last thing to get a major update, they can be used to chisel certain blocks!

The three recipes in the mod, cracking, grinding, and chiseling are all data-driven and customizable in a data pack or addon mod.

title: signshop
description: All in one player shop solution for fabric
body:
# signshop
The all-in-one player shop solution for fabric servers. Idea based off 
chestshop for bukkit.

Still in alpha, although it runs on beocraft (decently large survival smp). technical documentation in the works.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Lmg-QklYE08" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Document index:
- 1 Player guide
- 2 Admin guide
  - 2.1 First setup
  - 2.2 Configuration
    - Message prefix
- 3 Technical documentation

# Player guide
> This section of the README contains a tutorial on how to use the mod as a 
> player, if you are looking for the admin guide, go down to the ***admin 
> guide*** section of the README.

To create a signshop hold a **redstone dust** in your main hand. Click on the 
chest containing the items, then click on the chest containing the price.
Chest containing the price at first must contain the item and the amount of
item(s) you plan to sell. The price chest must also contain the item you plan
on using as currency and in an amount you plan to charge.

After you have clicked on both the item and price chests click on a sign that
has `[trade]` as its first line. Sign has to have `[trade]` as its first line, 
the rest can have whatever text you want.

*Currently only chests work, although it is planned to make all containers work
in the future.*

# Admin guide
This section of the README goes over administration when using this plugin.
## First setup
This plugin requires a database connection, create a database and set the 
parameters in the config `config/signshop/config.properties`. Admin commands 
coming soon.

```properties
database.password=password
database.url=jdbc\:mysql\://localhost\:3000/signshop
database.user=user
```

## Configuration
Non-essential plugin configuration.
### Message prefix
You can change the prefix that is added to messages this plugin gives to
players and admins. In an example message `signshop >> Shop created 
sucsessfully!`, the prefix is `signshop >> `.
```properties
prefix=§2§lsignshop§r >> 
```
The prefix can be disabled by simply leaving this as an empty string.
```properties
prefix=
```

# Technical documentation
This section of the README goes over the technical inner workings of the
signshop mod.
> This part of the text is still being written.

title: Leveling Plus
description: A minecraft mod that adds a simple menu to the game that allows players to level up. Killings other creatures will grant you exp based on the health of the creature.
body:
This is a ligthweight mod created when I simply could not find an easy leveling up mod for players. This mod adds a few stats that can be leveled to make the player more powerful as the game progresses.

This rpg styled mod lets the player defeat enemies, either by themselves or with other players; to gain exp which once it fills their exp pool, they will level up. Upon leveling up the player gains points which can be put into different stats. Each level gain around 3 stat points [**which can be changed with a command (_all commands start with 'levelingplus'_)**], however there is a small chance for the points to be rerolled for a bonus amount which is random [_small roll 3-5, big roll 5-15_].

At the start of the game, each player gets random number in the stats. The stats included are;

- **Health** - [_range 10 - 45_] takes 4 points to gain 1 health
- **Damage** - [_range 1-5_] takes 2 points to gain 1 damage
- **Armour** - [_range 1-5_] takes 2 points to gain 1 armour
- **Tough** - [_range 1-10_] takes 2 points to gain 1 toughness
- **Speed** - [_no random_] takes 4 points to gain 1 speed {gives speed effect based on this number}
- **Agiliy** - [_range 3 - 5_] takes 10 points to gain 1 agility {attack speed}
- **Intellect** - [_no random_] takes 10 points to gain 1 intellect {at level 5 grants passive regen, at level 3 grants magic bonus damage, at level 10 grants life style to your attacks}

**No Range - the stat starts at 0**

**Range - the range you could start within for the stat. _THIS IS NOT THE LIMIT OF THE STAT_**

Commands:
_/levelingplusresetprogression_ - resets your character

_/levelingplussetexpprogression_ - this changes the amount of exp you need next time to level up [_default is 5 so from 5>10>15>20 etc_]

_/levelingplussetpointsperlevelup_ - this changes the amount of points you gain everytime you level up [_default is 3_]

_/levelingplussetskillpoints_ - this changes your skill points, not add but sets it

title: Featherlight Optimization
description: An ultra-lightweight optimization modpack for Fabric designed for maximum FPS, while enhancing the vanilla experience with carefully selected Quality of Life and immersion mods.
body:
### Featherlight Optimization

A modern Minecraft modpack that focuses on two key things: delivering the highest possible performance and enhancing the gameplay with subtle, "quality of life" improvements that feel like they belong in the vanilla game.

---

#### **Unleashed Performance**
Experience Minecraft like never before with a suite of modern performance mods. Powered by **Sodium, Lithium, and Iris**, this modpack dramatically boosts your FPS, eliminates stuttering, and reduces memory usage, ensuring a smooth experience even on less powerful computers.

#### **Vanilla, But Better**
Featherlight isn't just about speed. We've included a handful of carefully chosen mods to improve your day-to-day gameplay without adding complex content. Enjoy enhanced audio with **Ambient Sounds & Sound Physics**, convenient controls with **Mouse Tweaks**, and a more lively world with **Visuality** and immersive footsteps.

#### **Full OptiFine Parity**
Get all the features you love from OptiFine and more. This pack includes full support for **Iris Shaders**, dynamic lighting, zoom functionality (**Zoomify**), connected textures, and more. Any resource pack that requires OptiFine will likely work perfectly here.

#### **Play Anywhere, With Anyone**
This is a 100% client-side modpack. It contains no content mods, which means you can connect to **any vanilla server**, including your own or your friends' worlds. We've also included **Simple Voice Chat** and **Emotecraft** to make your multiplayer sessions more interactive and fun.

#### **The Featherlight Philosophy**
Built on the modern and lightweight **Fabric** loader, this modpack is designed to be a perfect, stable base. It's easy to update and you can freely add your own favorite mods on top. Our goal is to provide an experience that is fast, polished, and stays true to the spirit of Minecraft.

description: Escape commands in chat with backslash! Send "/command" as regular text by typing "\/command"!
body:
# Command Escape

A simple Fabric mod that allows you to escape commands in chat using a backslash. It can also be used with other things.

## Usage

Simply prefix any command with a backslash to send it as regular text:
- `\/help` → sends "/help" in chat instead of running the command
- `\/tp @p 0 100 0` → sends "/tp @p 0 100 0" as a message
- `\/gamemode creative` → sends "/gamemode creative" as text

Pretty useful if you want to send a command for someone to do and you don't want to do like `./help` or `,/help`, etc.

title: PartialKeepInventory
description: Fully configurable and modular alternative to keepInventory.
body:
# PartialKeepInventory
Frustrated when you lose all your important stuff and suddenly your world/server grinds to a halt? Hate how consequence free keepInventory feels? PartialKeepInventory aims to find a "happy middleground" between the two.

PartialKeepInventory is a highly modular alternative to using keepInventory; you can keep specific groups of items, certain slots and even individual items from being dropped upon death, as opposed to your whole inventory and levels.

## Usage
To start with, ensure that `keepInventory` is **disabled** and instead enabled the `partialKeepInventory` gamerule.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MillzyDev/PartialKeepInventory/refs/heads/main/assets/enablepki.gif)

### Enabling Features

Currently, nothing is set up and dying will behave as normal with `keepInventory` disabled. You need to enable "features" individually. For this example, we want to keep my tools and equipped armour when we die. So we enable the `tools` and `equipment` features, using the `partialKeepInventory features add` command. 

You can also check what features are enabled using the `partialKeepInventory features` command.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MillzyDev/PartialKeepInventory/refs/heads/main/assets/addpkifeatures.gif)

The complete list of features is as follows:
* `equipment` - Any items equipped in your armor slots
* `equippables` - Any items that are able to be equipped in your amor slots.
* `tools` - Any items with a tool component, such as pickaxes and shovels (should also include weapons)
* `hotbar` - Any items that are in your hotbar.
* `offhand` - Any items in your offhand.
* `epic/rare/common/uncommon` - Any items with the respective rarity, indicated by name colour (purple/blue/yellow/white).
* `experience` - Experience and levels
* `customList` - Any items added to the `itemList` using the `partialKeepInventory itemList add` command.

title: Skye Crates
description: The Crates plugin used for the SkyeNetwork Server
body:
# SkyeCrates

A Minecraft plugin for Paper/Spigot servers that adds customizable crates with native Minecraft loot tables and particle effects.

## Features

- **Native Minecraft Loot Tables**: Full support for Minecraft's loot table format, compatible with [Misode's Loot Table Generator](https://misode.github.io/loot-table/)
- **Particle Effects**: Customizable particle effects for each crate type with full control over particle behavior
- **Easy Configuration**: YAML configuration files for each crate type
- **Permissions**: Built-in permission system for admins and users
- **Commands**: Complete command system for managing crates
- **Paper API**: Built specifically for Paper 1.21.4+ with modern Java features

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.4+
- Paper server (recommended) or Spigot
- Java 21+

## Installation

1. Download the latest release
2. Place the JAR file in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure your crates in `plugins/SkyeCrates/crates/`

## Configuration

Each crate is configured in its own YAML file in the `plugins/SkyeCrates/crates/` folder.

### Crate Configuration Format

```yaml
name: <name of crate>

particles:
  type: <particle type>    # Bukkit Particle enum value
  deltaX: <x spread>       # How far particles spread on X axis
  deltaY: <y spread>       # How far particles spread on Y axis  
  deltaZ: <z spread>       # How far particles spread on Z axis
  count: <particle count>  # Number of particles per spawn
  speed: <particle speed>  # Speed of particles

loot: |
  <loot table JSON pasted here>
```

### Example Crate Configuration

```yaml
# Example Crate Configuration
name: "Example Crate"

# Particle configuration
particles:
  type: "FLAME"          # Particle type (see Bukkit Particle enum)
  deltaX: 0.5           # Particle spread on X axis
  deltaY: 0.5           # Particle spread on Y axis  
  deltaZ: 0.5           # Particle spread on Z axis
  count: 15             # Number of particles per spawn
  speed: 0.1            # Particle speed

# Loot table (JSON format from Misode's loot table generator)
loot: |
  {
    "type": "minecraft:block",
    "pools": [
      {
        "rolls": 1,
        "entries": [
          {
            "type": "minecraft:item",
            "name": "minecraft:diamond",
            "weight": 1,
            "functions": [
              {
                "function": "minecraft:set_count",
                "count": {
                  "min": 1,
                  "max": 3
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
```

## Commands

- `/skyecrates reload` - Reload plugin configuration
- `/skyecrates list` - List all available crates
- `/skyecrates give <player> <crate> [amount]` - Give a crate item to a player
- `/skyecrates place <crate>` - Place a crate at your target location
- `/skyecrates remove` - Remove a crate you're looking at

## Permissions

- `skyecrates.admin` - Access to all SkyeCrates commands (default: op)
- `skyecrates.use` - Allows using crates (default: true)

## Using Misode's Loot Table Generator

1. Go to [Misode's Loot Table Generator](https://misode.github.io/loot-table/)
2. Create your desired loot table using the visual interface
3. Copy the generated JSON from the output
4. Paste it directly into the `loot:` section of your crate configuration file

### Supported Loot Table Features

- **Multiple pools** with different roll counts
- **Weighted entries** for item rarity
- **Functions** like `set_count`, `set_damage`, `enchant_with_levels`
- **Conditions** for advanced loot logic
- **All vanilla items** and their properties

## Example Configurations

### Basic Crate
Simple crate with a single guaranteed diamond:

```yaml
name: "Basic Crate"
particles:
  type: "FLAME"
  deltaX: 0.5
  deltaY: 0.5
  deltaZ: 0.5
  count: 10
  speed: 0.1
loot: |
  {
    "type": "minecraft:block",
    "pools": [
      {
        "rolls": 1,
        "entries": [
          {
            "type": "minecraft:item",
            "name": "minecraft:diamond"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
```

### Treasure Crate
Advanced crate with multiple items and different rarities:

```yaml
name: "Treasure Crate"
particles:
  type: "VILLAGER_HAPPY"
  deltaX: 1.0
  deltaY: 0.8
  deltaZ: 1.0
  count: 25
  speed: 0.05
loot: |
  {
    "type": "minecraft:block",
    "pools": [
      {
        "rolls": {
          "min": 2,
          "max": 4
        },
        "entries": [
          {
            "type": "minecraft:item",
            "name": "minecraft:diamond",
            "weight": 5
          },
          {
            "type": "minecraft:item",
            "name": "minecraft:emerald",
            "weight": 8,
            "functions": [
              {
                "function": "minecraft:set_count",
                "count": {
                  "min": 2,
                  "max": 5
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
```

## Building from Source

```bash
./gradlew build
```

The compiled JAR will be in `build/libs/`

title: Mascom (Mass Commands)
description: Run any command as often as you like AT ONCE and easier than ever before :)
body:
Ever wanted to run one command multiple times but at once and without spamming the up-arrow and enter-key? This datapack makes it possible, easier than ever before! ### How to use Just run ``` function mascom:run {c:"",i:""} ``` and replace with the desired command and with how often you want the command to be run, it's easy as that :) ### Examples ``` function mascom:run {c:"summon sheep ~ ~ ~",i:"100"} ``` Summons 100 sheep at the players position ``` function mascom:run {c:"kill @e[type=!player]",i:"2"} ``` Kills everything but the player, twice. This instantly gets rid of any items the killed mobs might drop.
NOTE: Running `kill @e` will break most other datapacks ``` function mascom:run {c:"execute if predicate {'condition':'minecraft:random_chance','chance':0.1} run say There's a 10% chance of this message being displayed!",i:"100"} ``` Of course you can also use this with conditional commands like `execute if`. You could use it to test probability-based events! ## Interested in making your own datapacks? I am one of the founders of **Datapack Hub**, the perfect discord server for helping you do just that! Whether you are just getting started or have advanced questions, with ~2500 members and our team of verified helpers, we got you covered!

# 🌍 TRY THIS PLUGIN LIVE ON BOLT SMP

[![Bolt SMP](https://i.ibb.co/LMJLVWf/standard-3.gif)](https://discord.gg/UUaNzfZyc6)

# MagicMobControl

MagicMobControl is a powerful Minecraft plugin designed to give server administrators complete control over mob spawning. With this plugin, you can enable or disable specific mobs or even all mobs in the game, allowing you to tailor the gameplay experience to your community's needs.

## Features

- **Fine-Grained Control**: Enable or disable individual mobs or all mobs with simple commands.
- **User-Friendly Commands**: Easy-to-use commands make managing mob spawning a breeze.
- **Configurable Settings**: Customize which mobs are disabled directly from the config file.
- **Event Handling**: Automatically adjusts mob spawning behavior based on your commands.

## How It Works

When the plugin is enabled, it reads the configuration file to determine which mobs are disabled. Administrators can use commands to modify mob spawning settings dynamically. The plugin uses the Bukkit API to listen for mob spawn events, ensuring that the desired behavior is implemented seamlessly.

## Commands

MagicMobControl comes with the following commands:

### `/mmob enable <mob|all>`

Enables mob spawning for the specified mob type or all mobs.

- **Example**: To enable all mobs:

```
/mmob enable all
```

### `/mmob disable <mob|all>`

Disables mob spawning for the specified mob type or all mobs.

- **Example**: To disable the spawning of a specific mob:

```
/mmob disable zombie
```


### `/mmob help`

Displays help information for using the plugin commands.

- **Example**: To view help information:


```
/mmob help
```

## Configuration

The plugin allows customization through the `config.yml` file, where you can specify which mobs to disable at server startup. The configuration is simple and intuitive, making it easy for server admins to get started.

## Join Our Community

For support and to connect with other users, join our Discord server: [MagicMobControl Discord](https://discord.gg/UUaNzfZyc6).

**MagicMobControl** is the ultimate solution for server owners looking to customize their gameplay experience by controlling mob spawning effectively. Download it now and enhance your Minecraft server!

title: Keyconomy
description: An economy datapack based around trial keys. It has shops included!
body:
# Keyconomy

Keyconomy is a datapack-based economy based around the Trial Keys added to 1.21+. Requires [Retina](https://modrinth.com/datapack/retina) to run!

## Selling Keys
You can sell keys for money using `/trigger SellKeys`, which will sell trial keys for 25 and ominous keys for 100 by default, straight from your inventory.

## Withdraw
You can withdraw money from your account by doing `/trigger Withdraw set <amount>`, and you'll receive cash items that also get sold back when using the `SellKeys` command

## MakeShop
Looking at a barrel with items in it (It must be 1 type of item) and using `trigger MakeShop set <sell_price>` will turn it into a shop. You can interact with the shop to see details if you're a customer and restock if you're the owner. You can also hit the shop to either purchase from it if you're a customer or destroy it if you're the owner.

## CreativeShop
Same deal as MakeShop, except it can't be restocked, has unlimited items, and can only be destroyed or created if you're in creative.

## Config


### Sell Price
If you want to change how much a key sells for, you can do
`data merge storage keyconomy:config {trial_key:25,ominous_key:100}`


### Max Stock
If you want to change the max amount of stock a shop can hold at once, you can do
`data merge storage keyconomy:config {max_stock:5000}`. The default is 5000.


### Commands
If you want to disable a certain command, there's a few options. Changing it for everyone is done like this: `
data modify storage keyconomy:config commands merge value {sell:1b,withdraw:1b,shop:1b}`, where `0b` will disable the command. Per-player, you can enable it for someone by doing `tag <player> add key.shop`, and disable it by doing `tag <player> add key.no_shop`. If you want to undo this, you can do `tag <player> remove key.shop`, etc.


## Developers
The scoreboard for player money is stored in a scoreboard called `key.money`, and there's a unique player ID stored in `key.player.id`

title: Cobblemon: Hunters
description: Just a modpack for me n my friends, but if you'd like to use it that's alright! It has some adventure/exploration based mods and a couple QoL mods to go with Cobblemon as well!
body:
I made this modpack for me and my friends and wanted a way for them to access updates to it without having to send them the modpack every time.

That being said, feel free to use it if you'd like! It's a relatively simple modpack that doesn't add any Cobblemon not featured in the base mod, but does add features such as hostile Pokemon, a chaining system for increasing shiny odds, and other neat details. Many of the mods added outside of Cobblemon are there to incentivize exploration. The terrain and biomes you encounter are heavily modified by Terralith, without straying too far from what you'd expect in vanilla. Lots of new structures and points of interest to find, as well as revamps for many of Minecraft's existing structures. To help ease the process of traveling, there are a couple of mods that make aspects of your journey easier, such as backpacks and waystones.
On your travels, use the Exposure mod to take photos of landscapes and exciting finds! With joy of Painting, create your own paintings, with easels to help you get into that artistic vibe! Not a fan of the music that plays as you wander, whether its vanilla music or the many tracks added by The Immersive Music Mod? - GOLDEN_APPLE | | world-blacklist | List of worlds the `/itemfinder search` command can't be used in. | world-blacklist:
- world_the_end | | region-blacklist | List of WorldGuard regions the `/itemfinder search` command can't be used in. | region-blacklist:
- region1
- region2 | | search-radius | Radius (in blocks) around the player where items will be searched. | search-radius: 10 | | searched-chunks-per-tick | Amount of chunks that will be searched for items per tick. The higher the amount the fastest the search and the highest the impact on the server. | searched-chunks-per-tick: 15 | | item-found-effects-iterations | Amount of times the item found particles will be shown on containers with the searched item. | item-found-effects-iterations: 5 | | search-cooldown | Time (in seconds) between each item search. | search-cooldown: 5 | Messages, sounds and particles from the plugin are also configurable. title: TackProfiler
description: Patches TickProfiler to use a local copy of its libraries, instead of downloading them at startup.
body:
[TickProfiler](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tickprofiler) is a popular TPS-measurement mod from back in the day. It's in [a lot of 1.10-1.12 modpacks](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tickprofiler/relations/dependents).

Most TickProfiler versions try to download additional dependencies from https://jcenter.bintray.com/ at game startup, using a library called LibLoader. This *usually* works, but if you're offline, using an old version of Java that doesn't have the right HTTPS root certificates, or if JCenter is down - the download will fail and the game will crash.

To fix this, TackProfiler bundles a copy of all libraries TickProfiler wants to download, and patches TickProfiler's library-downloading code to use my local copies instead of attempting Internet connections.

Couple things to note:

* TackProfiler has an unusual filename (it starts with "# #TackProfiler"). Do not rename the file. The pound-signs are necessary to make Forge load TackProfiler before LibLoader so I can patch it.
* TackProfiler does not appear in the in-game mod list. This is normal. Watch the log for "TackProfiler initializing".

Questions? Comments? Just lonely? Join me on Discord: https://highlysuspect.agency/discord/
