title: Consulars' Cup Of Java
description: Brew coffee! Some coffees give powerful effects!
body:
# Cup Of Java

Cup Of Java is a mod that adds coffee to the game. These coffees are helpful for multiple reasons such as potion brewing and repelling phantoms.

## Basic Brewing

The main method of getting coffee is through brewing in a coffee maker. Coffee makers can be crafted with iron, a furnace, a cauldron, and a redstone dust like so:

![image](https://github.com/ConsularAtol/cup-of-java/assets/83845237/54e4788c-b16b-4587-927f-c2b9abe58fa8)

Once you've made a coffee maker, you can now start brewing.

![image](https://github.com/ConsularAtol/cup-of-java/assets/83845237/abf18b40-9fb8-4b40-bbfe-a657a1734057)

This is the coffee maker gui, brewing a coffee in it is simple. The bottom slot is where you'll place a mug of water. You can obtain a mug of water by crafting a mug and using it like a bottle on water. Here's the crafting recipe for the mug:

![image](https://github.com/ConsularAtol/cup-of-java/assets/83845237/f7614cda-2823-4ab9-a869-bc661f549763)

The next likely step is to get a coffee bean, coffee beans are obtained from coffee plants found in forest biomes. Their functionality is identical to sweet berry bushes, and are also farmable. Once you have a coffee bean, you can place it in the top slot of the coffee maker.

![image](https://github.com/ConsularAtol/cup-of-java/assets/83845237/588865eb-7e74-4f76-b954-22b783343d4b)

Already, with just these two items, we unlock our first coffee. With just water and a coffee bean, we can brew a black coffee. The black coffee is the most basic, and provides nothing other than food unless brewed with a potion (we will discuss that later).

## Advanced Brewing

Now that we know the basics of how the coffee maker works, we can more easily utilize the left and right slots of it. 

# Milk Slot

The slot on the left is the milk slot, brewing a coffee with milk provides a different output entirely. Any coffee that's brewed with milk will clear all negative effects as well as granting any postive effects it may have.

By simply adding milk to our black coffee recipe, we get the cafe au lait. The cafe au lait behaves identically to black coffee, but with the added benefit of being brewed with milk.

# Potion Slot

The slot on the right is the potion slot. By putting any potion in here, modded or vanilla, that potions effects gets added to the coffee. Simple as that, our coffee is slowly becoming a multi-purpose consumable.

![image](https://github.com/ConsularAtol/cup-of-java/assets/83845237/3c380c67-8e4c-4444-ba9e-0b1595d5c578)

# Ground Coffee Beans

Ground Coffee Beans allows for even more types of coffee to be brewed. Ground coffee beans can be put in place of regular coffee beans, and any coffee brewed with them instead grant the caffinated effect. The caffinated effect simple freezes your insomnia ticks, effectively preventing phantoms from spawning.

![image](https://github.com/ConsularAtol/cup-of-java/assets/83845237/ffc50db8-12db-462a-8057-b957fb77ad5b)

So, in the end, we have an item that restores hunger, clears negative effects, grants more effects, and repells phantoms. Who would've thought a crippling caffine addiction can do that? 

## Barista Villager

The barista villager is just a simple villager that sells their coffee related items to you. You can get one by simply bringing an enemployed non-nitwit villager to a coffee maker.

# Trades

Level 1 - Mug/Coffee Bean/Ground Coffee Beans

Level 2 - Black Coffee and Cafe Au Lait

Level 3 - Espresso and Latte

Level 4 - Black Coffee and Cafe Au Lait, both with a random potion

Level 5 - Espresso and Latte, both with a random potion
*random potions also include mods

## Coffee Summary

Black Coffee - Regular food item that can have effects

Cafe Au Lait - Clears negative effects

Espresso - Grants the caffinated effect

Latte - Combination of all of the above


**copius amounts of caffiene was consumed in the making of this mod**

title: YapiFix
description: Fixes world generation crashes caused by Feature order cycles in modded biomes.
body: YapiFix — Universal Worldgen Crash Fix (Forge 1.20.1) YapiFix is a lightweight **compatibility patch mod** for Minecraft 1.20.1 modpacks. It is designed to prevent _Feature order cycle found_ / FeatureSorter worldgen crashes caused by inconsistent placed-feature ordering between biome and worldgen mods. What changed in 2.0.0 Earlier versions of YapiFix fixed a small number of known mod conflicts manually. Starting with **YapiFix 2.0.0**, the mod uses a broader universal stabilization approach: it normalizes feature ordering after biome modifiers have finished running, helping prevent feature order cycles even when the exact conflicting mod pair is unknown. What YapiFix does * Helps prevent FeatureSorter / feature order cycle crashes * Applies a deterministic feature order during world generation * Runs as a final compatibility pass after other biome modifiers * Keeps existing targeted fixes for known problematic cases * Works as an “install it and forget it” worldgen compatibility patch What YapiFix does not do * Does not remove biome features * Does not remove biomes * Does not disable worldgen mods * Does not fix unrelated crashes caused by broken datapack JSON, missing registry entries, invalid configured features, or other mods’ mixins Useful for modpacks with * Atmospheric * Biome Fest * Aromatic * Blueprint-based biome mods * Large modpacks with many biome/worldgen mods Works with * Existing worlds * New worlds * Datapacks * Large modpacks Target Minecraft Version * Forge **1.20.1** Notes YapiFix was created to fix real-world worldgen crashes in production modpacks. Version 2.0.0 changes the philosophy of the mod: instead of only patching individual known conflicts, YapiFix now aims to prevent this entire class of feature-order crashes automatically. Usage & Permissions All rights reserved. You may freely use this mod in private modpacks and personal projects. If used in public modpacks or servers, a mention or message is appreciated, but not required. Distribution Reuploads to other platforms are not permitted without explicit permission. Linking to the Modrinth page is always welcome. Updates & Support YapiFix is updated on request. If you encounter a FeatureSorter cycle or similar worldgen crash that is not fixed by this mod, you may report it and I will review it when possible. ## Credits Special thanks to [**Saorise**](https://modrinth.com/user/Saorise42) for the updated logo. ## Community Follow the development of the mod, share ideas, and stay updated here: **YouTube:** [https://www.youtube.com/@YAPILabs](https://www.youtube.com/@YAPILabs) **Discord:** [https://discord.gg/KYGyy9jFCz](https://discord.gg/KYGyy9jFCz)

title: TomExpensive
description: TomExpensive is a lightweight, high-performance solution for Minecraft 1.21.1+ that removes the restrictive "Too Expensive!" limit in Anvils. It ensures your players can always repair and enchant their gear while providing modern utility features.
body:
# TomExpensive

TomExpensive removes the vanilla "Too Expensive!" anvil limit while keeping the real XP cost visible and charged in Survival mode.

## Features

- Shows true anvil costs above 40 levels in Survival, such as 120 levels.
- Keeps expensive anvil results clickable through ProtocolLib.
- Supports colored anvil renames with MiniMessage, legacy `&` colors, and hex colors.
- Allows free anvil use with the `tomexpensive.free` permission.
- Includes `/repair` for repairing the item in your hand.
- Checks Modrinth for newer versions without warning for older releases.

## Rename Colors

Use any of these formats in the anvil rename field:

- `&cRed Sword`
- `&#ff5555Hex Sword`
- `#55ffffCrystal Blade`
- `<gradient:red:gold>Dragon Axe</gradient>`

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/repair` | Repairs the item in your main hand. | `tomexpensive.repair` |

## Permissions

- `tomexpensive.repair`: Allows using `/repair`. Default: OP.
- `tomexpensive.free`: Makes anvil use cost 0 levels. Default: false.

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21.1+
- ProtocolLib 5.3.0+
- Java 21+

## Installation

1. Download the latest TomExpensive jar.
2. Install ProtocolLib on your server.
3. Drop TomExpensive into your server's `plugins` folder.
4. Restart the server.

![bStats](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/TomExpensive.svg)

title: Tis the Season
description: A small casual modpack focused on Serene Seasons and watching your world change around you.
body:
This modpack is focused on Serene Seasons and other mods that integrate well with it. I have tried to keep this modpack small while also still adding enough to make things more interesting than vanilla Minecraft. The main mods I have added to fit with Serene Seasons are:

- Upgrade Aquatic, Atmospheric, and Environmental - More biomes and variety of food as well as more varied wildlife.
- Farmer's Delight, My Nether's delight, Ender Delight and Fruits Delight- Bigger variety of food to ensure you can always grow something no matter what season it is!
- Spice of Life Onion Edition - To reward you for and encourage eating a bigger variety of food.
- Tectonic and Cliff Under a Tree (Clifftree) - To revamp terrain generation and make worlds more exciting to explore and also because I'm a sucker for worldgen mods.
- Haunted Harvest and Snowy Spirit - Changes villager behaviour in certain seasons and adds special holiday themed food and blocks!
- Better Days and Serene Seasons Plus - How much of a Minecraft day is daytime and how much is night now adjusts according to what season it is! Shorter days and longer nights in the winter, longer days and shorter nights in the summer!
- Seasonal Integration - A datapack I made specifically for this modpack that ensures all the mods I've added work properly with serene seasons in the intended way.

I have also have a secondary theme which is the world changing around you as you play as opposed to you changing the world with your actions (which you can still do by the way). I have used various different mods to achieve this including:

- Enhanced Celestials - To make nighttime more interesting every now and then and create some incentive to avoid skipping the night
- Respawning Animals - As animals can now despawn and respawn like monsters you won't find the same animals in the same places all the time! It simulates animals moving around the world and feels more realistic in that sense.
- In Control - To adjust mob spawn rates (passive and hostile) according to the season. Passive mobs no longer breed or spawn during non-tropical Winter so plan ahead!
- Saplanting - Saplings and various other plants will plant themselves in the ground if dropped as an item, allowing forests to regenerate by themselves after some wood harvesting or forest fires.
- Snow Real Magic - Snow builds up on top of various vegetation and flowers properly in Winter like it should!
- Dynamic Surroundings - Not only do all biomes have ambient sounds like nether biomes, it also changes according to what season it is and what the weather is doing!
- Pillager Caravans - Illager sometimes pass by while transporting various goods. Do you let them pass by with their ill gotten goods? Or do you risk death for some quick loot?

If you experience any issues with the modpack please let me know. I'm only one guy so it's impossible for me to catch every issue but I try my best!

Now get and out there and enjoy the seasons!

Welcome to **Light As Fabric**, an optimized experience for Minecraft designed to offer maximum performance without sacrificing visual quality. This pack is based on Fabric Loader and is perfect for those looking for a smooth, lightweight, and modern game.

## Key Features:
### - Improved Performance:
Thanks to the integration of mods like Sodium and Lithium, the game better utilizes your PC's hardware, ensuring a significant increase in FPS.
### - Improved Graphics:
Includes support for Iris shaders (a dedicated graphics card is recommended for good performance) and the Continuity mod to make blocks like glass or green grass look even better, as well as the LambDynamicLights mod to illuminate dark spaces even when holding light sources in one hand.
### - Lightweight:
The pack is designed to be high-performance without the use of many unnecessary mods; in fact, there are about 20 mods, all designed to make the game better.
### - Quality of Life:
Small additions like the Zoomify mod or the aforementioned LambDynamicLights mod make life easier without significantly disrupting the game.

## Technical Details:
### - Loader:
Fabric
### - Versions:
- 1.21.11 (1.0)
- 26.1 (1.1)
- 26.1.1 (1.1.1)
- 26.1.2 (1.1.2)

I will also update it for newer versions (1.21.11+)
### - Shaders:
Iris Shaders only.

## Installation:
You can download the .mrpack file and easily import it to Prism Launcher, Modrinth App, or any Modrinth-compatible launcher.

Thanks to the creators of the mods included in this pack.

title: Omniscience Awakened
description: Mod that makes hidden game elements visible without changing gameplay. Fork of the original Omniscience by thatDudo.
body:
Omniscience Awakened is a maintained and improved fork of the original Omniscience mod. It is designed for players who want better awareness of invisible game elements, while keeping the experience configurable and lightweight.

## Features
### See invisible entities
- Reveals invisible players, mobs, and other targeted entities
- Works through the mod’s configurable entity targeting groups
- Preserves normal invisibility behavior for untargeted entities

### Barrier block exposure
- Shows barrier blocks in survival mode
- No need to hold a barrier item

### Configurable alpha and rendering
- Adjustable opacity level for rendered invisible models
- Custom glow support for invisible entities
- Name tag visibility options with forced rendering modes

### Selective targeting
Choose which entity groups are affected:
- Players
- Monsters
- Villagers
- Animals
- Objects

Fine-grained control via the in-game config screen

### Blindness effect removal
- Optionally disable blindness fog and rendering effects

## Use on public servers
This mod is **not** intended for use on public servers unless you have **direct permission from the server owner**. If a server owner has not clearly allowed this type of mod, do not use it there.

Although the mod may function on servers, I do **not** endorse or support its use on public servers without explicit approval. I will not provide help for server-related issues, and any report involving unauthorized server use or server connection crashes will be closed.

If you choose to use this mod on a private server, that is your responsibility. If you use it on a public server without permission and are banned or otherwise penalized, that is entirely on you. No support will be provided for that use case.

## Credits
- Original mod developed by [digitalshadowhawk](https://www.curseforge.com/members/digitalshadowhawk/projects)
- Fabric port developed by [thatDudo](https://github.com/thatDudo)

Two fixes that enable 1.21.4+ crossbow carting:

title: Critical Crates
description: New ways to protect and store your items using cosmetic storage crates
body:
Critical Crates focuses on storage improvements for a variety of different types of players by providing a new crate block. These crates have a large number of variations from each type of vanilla wood to all current forms of glass. Some types may even have their own features! In addition, they can even be customized further with a decent assortment of upgrades to allow the player to attempt to solve a variety of storage issues, such as item destruction. However, pick your upgrade carefully as a crate can only handle being upgraded once.

This mod is currently only developed and maintained for NeoForge 1.21.1 and 1.21.11, but may be updated to newer and different versions/loaders in the future.

Below is the current list of features with possibly more to come!
________________________________________

<details>
<summary>Current Features (Spoilers)</summary>

Critical Crates uses a system to change between crates called foundations. There are currently three types of crates in the mod: Wood, Glass, and Iron. While wood crates can be crafted normally, the others cannot. To swap or change between any of these at a time, simply craft a foundation using pliers and right click on any crate with it. All currently stored items will seemlessly transfer between the old and new crate type so don't worry about removing them!

To view recipes for all the above, visit the [GitHub wiki](https://github.com/CriticalPickle/critical-crates/wiki).
________________________________________
All Vanilla Wood Crate Variants (as of 1.21.1): 
Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark Oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Bamboo, Crimson, and Warped

![All vanilla wood crates in a line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd3afa1138748527b159bea3b759cb5220b9b7cb.png)

Although, be warned **_wood crates can light on fire and destroy all of your items_** if not handled properly! Upgrade them or pick an appropriate type to prevent this disaster. Note, crimson and warped crates are in fact fire, but not lava, resistant despite being part of the wood crate group.
________________________________________
All Vanilla Stained Glass Crate Variants (from left to right): Normal, White, Light Gray, Gray, Black, Brown, Red, Orange, Yellow, Lime, Green, Cyan, Light Blue, Blue, Purple, Magenta, and Pink

![All vanilla stained glass crates in a line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6bae9dbc1bedac022c73ca3ee8d3c798e7742ed_0.webp)

The color can be changed by _**right clicking on any glass crate with a different dye**_ and can be removed by _**right clicking on a stained glass crate with a soap item**_.

In addition, glass crates also show or render the item put in their **_top left inventory slot_** as if it was inside the block. Change it to label what items are in this crate or just have something there for fun!

![Glass crate in jungle with oak crate inside](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cdbe2e8e5e23f95ea4f6665b8816604ea0918861.png)
________________________________________
Iron Crates

![All the iron crates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6de61b4d25c72f0d6a57612127919e7b66d25a5e.png)

Iron crates function exactly as you would expect by expanding the traditional crate size of a single chest to that of a double chest.

![Iron crate double chest inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c346ff7c009c0ab6cb4806358fb520e02c2a260_0.webp)

Additionally, iron crates are more durable. They have a higher toughness value than any base level crate type and will not catch on fire.
________________________________________
Five Current Crate Upgrades (from left to right): Obsidian Reinforcement, Lamp Simulator, Fireproofing, Slimy Framing, and Iron Supports

![All crate upgrades in a dark cave lit by lamp crates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dcbfef8d84388d9141b91f0be26c28727e896469_0.webp)

To add or remove an upgrade, simply **_right click with the correct item in hand_** and watch as it is seamlessly applied to or removed from the crate!

Here is what each one does, choose carefully as you can only pick one!

**1. Obsidian Reinforcement** -
Keep your items safe while creepers or other explosive enemies are about. Makes the crate blast or explosion resistant as with an actual obsidian block! No more easily destroyed storage systems or tons of items on the ground from one small explosion.

**2. Lamp Simulator** -
Remove every single dark spot without having to place a single torch. Light up your base with ease by providing a light source hidden and tucked away. It functions almost exactly the same as a copper bulb, but with an inventory! One redstone signal and no more scary monsters spawning around this crate.

**3. Fireproofing** -
No one likes a fast-spreading fire. Protect your wood crates from fire by adding this upgrade, but it also makes any crate completely resistant to lava as well! Don't believe me? Give it a toss into lava and try it for yourself.

**4. Slimy Framing** -
Cleaning up storage areas can take way too long. Designed for base cleanup, these crates are instantly breakable using a player’s bare hands! However, due to the bouncy nature of slimes, they also provide tons of bouncy fall damage reducing fun.

**5. Iron Supports** -
Storage space is everyone's worst nightmare. This upgrade operates exactly as the iron crate by adding three more additional rows to the base crate inventory. Try it out to gain way more room! Don't worry, if removed later, all items in the extra rows will simply drop onto the ground. However, note that while gaining more space, it does not give fire resistance as with the actual iron crate.

Each upgrade is also **_removable by default with the pliers item_** (far left in the photo). It is crafted with just one iron and two leather! However, if you want a real challenge try disabling the removal of these upgrades in the config files. The pliers are also used to craft each upgrade using their respective blocks or items.

</details>

________________________________________
For crafting recipes or more mod information, visit the [wiki](https://github.com/CriticalPickle/critical-crates/wiki).

This is actually my first mod and is **_currently in its earlier stages of public release_** so if you have any suggestions or find any bugs, please let me know using [Github](https://github.com/CriticalPickle/critical-crates/issues) or another communication method such as discord!

You may add this to any modpack or record any video with this mod, but please give credit somewhere in the description!

If you want to support me or have any additional questions, check out:
- CriticalPickle's YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@thecriticalpickle

title: Bunny's Prey Eyes
description: Turn your rabbit eyes into eyes that look straight ahead into eyes that look around like a real prey, so they could see the danger earlier.
body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d18fb719ba0cb5197a01165cae7eaeb923015105.png)

This resource pack enhances realism in Minecraft by adjusting the placement of rabbit eyes. Instead of being positioned on the front of the face, rabbit eyes are moved to the sides of the head just like in real life.

In nature, prey animals such as rabbits have side facing eyes to achieve a much wider field of vision, helping them detect predators more easily. This pack reflects that biological detail, giving rabbits a more authentic and immersive appearance in your world.

The change is subtle but meaningful, especially for players who appreciate realism and attention to detail in creature design.

Make sure you download and use the correct version of this resource pack for your specific Minecraft version. Using an incompatible version will result in the resource pack not working at all.

Here is a [quick guide to how to install texture packs](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I8BmnjowFrE) by _GuideRealm._

title: RC CoolDown
description: RC Cooldown is a powerful and flexible Spigot plugin that allows server administrators to set custom cooldowns on any Minecraft items, weapons, and enchantments.
body:
# RC Cooldown - Advanced Item Cooldown Management Plugin

## 📋 Overview

**RC Cooldown** is a powerful and flexible Spigot plugin that allows server administrators to set custom cooldowns on any Minecraft items, weapons, and enchantments. With support for multiple languages, visual cooldown animations, and intelligent use detection, this plugin provides a comprehensive solution for balancing gameplay and preventing item spam.

## ✨ Features

- **Universal Item Support**: Set cooldowns on any Minecraft item, weapon, or enchantment
- **Smart Use Detection**: Automatically detects item usage type (interact, consume, attack) and applies cooldowns accordingly
- **Visual Cooldown Animation**: Native Minecraft cooldown animation (like Ender Pearls) that matches your configured duration
- **Enchantment Support**: Set cooldowns on enchantments like Riptide, Channeling, and more
- **Multi-Language Support**: Built-in translations for English, Russian, Ukrainian, Spanish, and German
- **Click Type Configuration**: Choose between right-click or left-click activation for each item
- **Anti-Spam Protection**: Cooldown messages are rate-limited to prevent chat spam (max once per 3 seconds)
- **Easy Configuration**: Simple YAML configuration with default examples
- **Admin Commands**: Full command suite for managing cooldowns without editing config files
- **Automatic Reload**: Hot-reload configuration without server restart

## 🎯 Use Cases

- **PvP Servers**: Balance powerful items like Golden Apples, Ender Pearls, and weapons
- **Survival Servers**: Prevent item spam and create strategic gameplay
- **Minigame Servers**: Control item usage in custom game modes
- **KitPvP**: Balance kit items with custom cooldowns
- **Any Server**: Add cooldowns to any item for better gameplay balance

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the latest version of **RC Cooldown** from the releases page
2. Place the `.jar` file into your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server or use `/reload` command
4. Configure the plugin by editing `plugins/RCCooldown/config.yml`
5. Use `/rccd reload` to apply changes

## ⚙️ Config

### Basic Configuration

Open `plugins/RCCooldown/config.yml`:

```yaml
# Language: EN, RU, UA, ES, DE
lang: EN

items:
  # Enchantments
  enchantment:riptide:
    enable: true
    cooldown: 15
    click_type: right_click
  
  # Items
  ENDER_PEARL:
    enable: true
    cooldown: 20
    click_type: right_click
  GOLDEN_APPLE:
    enable: true
    cooldown: 5
    click_type: right_click
```

### Configuration Options

- **lang**: Language for plugin messages (EN, RU, UA, ES, DE)
- **enable**: Enable or disable cooldown for this item (true/false)
- **cooldown**: Cooldown duration in seconds
- **click_type**: Mouse click type (`right_click` or `left_click`)

## 📝 Adding Items

### Method 1: Edit Config File

1. Open `plugins/RCCooldown/config.yml`
2. Add your item under the `items:` section:

```yaml
items:
  DIAMOND_SWORD:
    enable: true
    cooldown: 10
    click_type: right_click
```

3. Save the file and run `/rccd reload`

### Method 2: Use Commands (Recommended)

Use the `/rccd add` command to add items directly in-game:

```
/rccd add <item_id> <click_type> <seconds>
```

**Examples:**
```
/rccd add DIAMOND_SWORD right_click 10
/rccd add riptide right_click 15
/rccd add BOW left_click 5
```

### Adding Enchantments

To add enchantments, simply use the enchantment name:

```
/rccd add riptide right_click 15
/rccd add channeling right_click 10
```

The plugin automatically detects if an ID is an item or enchantment - no prefix needed!

### Finding Item IDs

- Use `/rccd list` to see all active cooldowns
- Minecraft item IDs are in UPPERCASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES format (e.g., `DIAMOND_SWORD`, `GOLDEN_APPLE`)
- Enchantment names are lowercase (e.g., `riptide`, `channeling`)

## 🎮 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/rccd reload` | Reload plugin configuration | `rccd.admin` (OP by default) |
| `/rccd list` | List all active cooldowns | `rccd.admin` (OP by default) |
| `/rccd add <id> <click_type> <seconds>` | Add a new cooldown | `rccd.admin` (OP by default) |
| `/rccd delete <id>` | Remove a cooldown | `rccd.admin` (OP by default) |

### Command Examples

```
/rccd reload                    # Reload configuration
/rccd list                      # Show all active cooldowns
/rccd add MACE right_click 5    # Add 5-second cooldown to Mace
/rccd delete ENDER_PEARL        # Remove Ender Pearl cooldown
```

## 🌍 Languages

The plugin supports 5 languages:

- **EN** - English
- **RU** - Russian (Русский)
- **UA** - Ukrainian (Українська)
- **ES** - Spanish (Español)
- **DE** - German (Deutsch)

Change language in `config.yml`:
```yaml
lang: RU  # Change to your preferred language
```

Language files are automatically created in `plugins/RCCooldown/lang/` folder.

## 🔧 Mechanics

### Smart Use Detection

The plugin automatically detects how items are used:

- **Food/Consumables**: Cooldown activates after consumption
- **Weapons**: Cooldown activates after successful attack
- **Enchantments**: Cooldown activates after successful enchantment use (e.g., Riptide only activates when player actually flies)
- **Other Items**: Cooldown activates after successful interaction

### Visual Cooldown

- Native Minecraft cooldown animation appears in the inventory
- Animation duration matches your configured cooldown time
- Works exactly like Ender Pearl cooldown animation
- Cooldown does not reset or update during active cooldown

### Anti-Spam Protection

- Cooldown messages are limited to once per 3 seconds
- Prevents chat spam when players repeatedly click items on cooldown
- Item usage is still blocked, but messages are rate-limited

## 💡 Benefits

### 1. **Flexibility**
- Works with ANY Minecraft item, weapon, or enchantment
- No need to modify server code or use complex plugins
- Easy to add or remove cooldowns

### 2. **Smart Detection**
- Automatically detects item usage type
- No manual configuration needed for different item types
- Handles special cases like Riptide enchantment correctly

### 3. **User-Friendly**
- Visual cooldown animation for better UX
- Multi-language support for international servers
- Clear, informative messages

### 4. **Performance**
- Lightweight and optimized
- No performance impact on server
- Efficient cooldown tracking

### 5. **Easy Management**
- In-game commands for all operations
- No server restart needed for changes
- Simple YAML configuration

### 6. **Professional Features**
- Rate-limited messages prevent spam
- Proper event handling prevents exploits
- Reliable cooldown tracking

## 📋 Defaults

The plugin comes with pre-configured cooldowns for popular items:

- **Riptide** (enchantment): 15 seconds
- **Ender Pearl**: 20 seconds
- **Golden Apple**: 5 seconds
- **Enchanted Golden Apple**: 30 seconds
- **Firework Rocket**: 3 seconds
- **Mace**: 5 seconds

You can modify or remove these as needed.

## 🐛 Troubleshooting

### Cooldown not working?
- Make sure `enable: true` in config
- Check that cooldown value is greater than 0
- Verify correct `click_type` (right_click/left_click)
- Run `/rccd reload` after config changes

### Messages not in my language?
- Check `lang:` setting in config.yml
- Verify language file exists in `plugins/RCCooldown/lang/`
- Run `/rccd reload` after changing language

### Item not found when adding?
- Use correct item ID format (UPPERCASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES)
- For enchantments, use lowercase name (e.g., `riptide`, not `RIPTIDE`)
- Check spelling - use `/rccd list` to see examples

## 📄 Permissions

- `rccd.admin` - Access to all `/rccd` commands (OP by default)

## 🔄 Updates

The plugin is actively maintained and updated. Check the releases page for:
- Bug fixes
- New features
- Performance improvements
- Additional language support

## 📞 Support

For support, bug reports, or feature requests, please visit the plugin's page on Discord.

## 📜 License

This plugin is provided as-is for use on Minecraft servers.

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03385e6c706293ac645cf6ab16690c0cc90c1fc5.jpeg)
![1.5](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6c2d8a79fa992329c08e2b0b0279a055aee5ac4_0.webp)

![3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f519aa5e181e74bff6b7f1554ec963d589e3f27b.jpeg)
![4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98896579cb93c1ea9b2b67ac660fbde9fdd7b76b.jpeg)
![Core Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5fa571c9b3ed77a9049fcd895262be3aa1d5b6a_0.webp)

- 🏯 **Ancient Haunted Provinces**: Explore vast, atmospheric Japanese villages featuring custom architecture, mossy estates, and Torii gates.

- 👺 **The Great Shrine**: A sacred and dangerous structure at the village center, housing the throne room and the mod’s most prestigious treasures.

- 💣**The Oni Warlord**: A terrifying, sound-sensitive entity. If you run, he will find you. His presence is announced by a multi-stage explosion that leaves nothing but destruction.

- ⚔️ **The Endless Undead Legion**: Zombie Soldiers haunt the village streets and will continue to spawn indefinitely. Their numbers are limitless until you strike at the source.

- 👑 **The Duel of the Shrine**: Once you step into the Shrine's perimeter, it becomes a pure combat arena. The village forces will not interfere, leaving you in a life-or-death struggle against the Council of Leaders.

- ✨ **Divine Victory**: Defeating all five Leaders is the only way to break the curse. Once they fall, every remaining zombie in the village is instantly destroyed, and a victory celebration 
is broadcasted to all.

![Legendary Adversaries](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc5ae9301c76f29c5666b9dd3ff4536e385240cc_0.webp)

- **Oni Warlord**: A walking catastrophe that reacts to your footsteps. Only the quietest players can escape his devastating blast.

- **Zombie Soldiers**: Highly organized ranks including Swordsmen, Axemen, Spearmen, Archers, and Crossbowmen. They guard the village relentlessly as long as their masters live.

- **The Council of Leaders**: The ultimate challenge. Five distinct bosses—Leader - Swordsman, Leader - Axeman, Leader - Spearman, Leader - Archer, and Leader - Crossbowman—await you within the Shrine, equipped with enchanted Netherite gear.

![Explosives & Artifacts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7bd7d588041595dabfd31893c40eca2580a1781a_0.webp)

- **Warhead TNT**: A metallic, reinforced explosive with immense power and custom audio cues, far superior to standard TNT.

- **Soul Gunpowder**: A rare and volatile ingredient dropped by Oni Warlords, essential for crafting high-tier destructive items.

- **Shrine Loot**: The ultimate reward hidden behind the throne. These chests can only be claimed once the Council has been defeated.

![Exploration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e0354cadbc5ee96a244ea5c2107f76430c92f7c_0.webp)

Discover grand settlements surrounded by bamboo groves and stone lanterns. If you find yourself lost, local Cartographers can provide specialized maps to lead you directly to these hidden Japanese provinces.

title: ALIT: Magitech
description: The mod is set in a post-apocalyptic world far in the future, where technology has advanced to the point of being indistinguishable from magic, and humanity reduced back to the medieval era of technology.
body:
## **[Join the Discord Server](https://discord.gg/sqJW2Xu8Mk)**

**The mod is set in a post-apocalyptic world far in the future, where technology has advanced to the point of being indistinguishable from magic, and humanity reduced back to the medieval era of technology.**

![Tools & Weapons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b0c0ce8bf79db7856c7587b4748df8e4ea8b93c.png)

![Magiswords](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43e45ecb1c9e0a0e66863b2a1e04492958d93884_0.webp)

Magiswords are a category of swords that buff your attack damage based on the "Manatricity" (MT) you currently have. Also, depending on the type of Magisword, it can apply different effects on your target like setting them on fire, drowning them, etc.

![Magicasters](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5cb10390b7b8785352e4cd526b90ab6300bf7e55.png)

Magicasters are a type of modular tool that allows their users to create "Magicasts" that do various effects such as healing, explosion, Anti-Magi, etc.

You need to craft a Magicaster Station and use it to equip and empty Magicaster with Magicaster components, which control what the cast Magicast would do. If your Magicaster has Self-inflicted, fast, and regeneration components, the Magicaster would heal the user. If you replace the Self-inflicted to AOE, it would cast a bubble where mobs within would be healed. There are a lot of components you could mix and match to make Magicasters do various things!

![Magipower](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d3851c5a3a6155ada9dff53e775417ebad8f757_0.webp)

Magipower is an advanced tool with many varieties that gives you passive abilities, weaknesses, and 3 active abilities. You can get Magipower by killing a mob that has a specific Magipower or if you have a Magipower Container with Magipower stored inside. This is not magic, btw... :] There are 4 Magipowers you can find spawning alongside mobs (flame, wind, space, energy), and you can only get every other Magipower type by collecting Magipowers and merging them into a new kind of Magipower.


![Mobs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6b34a697fd208809825017a290bb1b77b840d69.png)

![Metal Person](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c601297fe5a9e3952cff5cdcfae18e176e0be9f.png)

A Metal Person is a non-human race that you can find and trade with. You can't trade with any of them as they are separated into jobs like Adventurer, Potion Seller, Debt Collector, Knight, etc. You can identify them by their green eyes from other variations. Metal People's minds are connected together and have a bounty/debt system that will punish whoever kills too many of this specific variant of Metal People (with green eyes).

![Possessed Metal Person](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3751625a0150ad81fb7a77e38267583e6952ad3.png)

The Possessed Metal Person is a variation of the Metal Person that has gone out of control and will kill any Human or Metal Person on site. They can upload themselves into another metal person's body if their current body is heavily damaged and the target body is killed. Their possession ability extends to players and can possess them and be a "Possessed Zombie". Be sure to kill them if you're strong enough, but avoid them when not prepared.

![Lost Metal Person](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b64f3ac160f2d4d049ac68fe7b814489ef1b9827.png)

The Lost Metal Person, a banished variation of the Metal people. They are not part of the Metal People's Bounty system and can be killed without consequence. Though you must be careful when approaching one, as their behavior/personality can be unpredictable. They can be neutral, but can also attack you on site, or be a coward, or a bounty hunter, etc.

![Pure Metal Person](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/509535ceb1b082ad0d91a4cb24a72eeca927a796.png)

Pure Metal People don't spawn naturally, but instead, body parts can be found in the "Overrun Facility" structure, which you use to assemble the Pure Metal Person. After you assemble it, you are now its master, and it will fight for you without second thought. Also, once you assemble it, you can freely give or take armor, weapons, and Magipower from your Pure Metal Person.

![ALIT: Sunlight Zombie mobs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f65fe34bed32816e6c11dd32ff470185f6b0533.png)

Since ALIT: Magitech is the sequel to ALIT: Sunlight Zombie, the mobs from the previous mod still exist, but do not spawn naturally. Careful with messing around with Sunlight Alchemy, as the Metal People (green eyes) have illegalized it. You can get more debt as you mess around with Sunlight Alchemy near a Metal Person. Too much debt will turn into a bounty later. Also, if not careful, you may cause another Sunlight Zombie apocalypse.


![Structures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5be4f1e5bd0a3243225e531d16df09a95cd475e.png)
![Ruined Magitech Workshop](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f886e50b5811f50b234c2863eaa6a9efb2717348_0.webp)
![Ancient Ruin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d04b10cb497e78a285c7df8bae4c89474b275b84_0.webp)
![Overrun Facility](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7340fa55ca873ef864bfe08e4a866d7d06105234_0.webp)

title: Paper Prefix
description: This Plugin adds a /prefix command, that allows players to easily set prefixes displayed in chat, tab and nametags.
body:
A simple and flexible prefix plugin designed for your PaperMC server. Give your players the ability to stand out and personalize their identity! **Paper Prefix** is a lightweight and user-friendly plugin that allows players to set their own custom prefixes, which will appear in chat, the player list, and above their nametags. **Features** * **Easy for Players**: Players can set their own prefix and color with a simple command: `/prefix set [color]`. * **Rich Color Support**: Supports all standard Minecraft colors, plus unique Bedrock colors like `netherite`, `emerald`, `amethyst`, and `minecoin_gold`. * **Seamless Integration**: Prefixes are automatically displayed in three key places: * In-game chat * The player list (tab menu) * Above player nametags * **Persistent**: Prefixes are saved and automatically re-applied when a player joins the server. * **Lightweight**: Designed to be efficient and not impact your server's performance. **Commands** The alias `/status` can also be used for all commands. | Command | Description | Permission | | --- | --- | --- | | `/prefix set [color]` | Sets your personal prefix. | `paperprefix.set` | | `/prefix remove` | Removes your current prefix. | `paperprefix.set` | | `/prefix join ` | Copies the prefix from another player. | `paperprefix.join` | **Permissions** | Permission | Description | Default | | --- | --- | --- | | `paperprefix.set` | Allows a player to set and remove their own prefix. | `true` | | `paperprefix.join` | Allows the player to copy another player's prefix with `/prefix join`. | `op` | **PlaceholderAPI Support** This plugin provides a PlaceholderAPI placeholder to show a player's prefix. `%paperprefix_prefix%` **Installation** * Make sure you are running a PaperMC or PaperMC-compatible server. * Download the latest `Paper-Prefix.jar` file from the [releases page](https://modrinth.com/plugin/paper-prefix/versions). * Drop the file into your server's `/plugins` folder. * Restart your server. That's it! No complicated configuration is needed. Your players can start setting their prefixes right away. ---

Thank you for using Paper Prefix!

- Intuitive command system and built-in guide for easy setup and management.

Decaf is a Minecraft modpack designed to create a Zen-like gaming experience by removing the HUD and enhancing the game's visuals. This modpack includes the Iris mod, which enhances the game's visuals with shaders, and the AutoHUD mod, which removes the HUD when it is not needed. These mods help to create a more immersive and beautiful gameplay experience as you explore and build in your stunningly enhanced world.

Decaf also includes several quality-of-life mods that assist with gameplay. With the Mouse Tweaks mod, you can easily manage your inventory and perform other actions with ease. The Sodium mod optimizes game performance for a smoother, more enjoyable gameplay experience, and other mods like Visuality and Starlight help with lighting and particles.

One of the great things about Decaf is that all the mods in the pack are client-side mods, meaning they do not need to be installed on the server. This makes it easy to play with friends who may not have the modpack installed, as you can still enjoy the enhanced visuals and streamlined gameplay features on your end. This also means that the modpack is customizable to suit your individual preferences.

body:
# Shattered Kingdom Data Pack

- Creates a 2000x2000 block world, split into two sides: Positive and Negative
- Players can be divided into two teams and work to build their 1000x2000 civilization bigger and better than the other side
- The center strip of the map (from x=150 to x=-150) is No Man's Land, a place where both teams can trade or fight
- Gives armor trims special effects when wearing just the chestplate OR even better effects when wearing the full set
- Gives some mobs more armor and weapons
- Adds five new "bindings" which give your weapons OP abilities
- Adds five legendary weapons with "binding" effects
- Includes a way to disable tnt and tnt minecarts
- Armor trims cannot be duplicated using the crafting recipe anymore, making getting an entire set extremely difficult
- Open-world mode with custom strucures and boss fights
- Three custom structures (Monument, Ancient City and Shipwreck) with more to come...


Best played with nether and end disabled so late game items can be introduced into the economy gradually with custom structures.

### Armor Trims:
Armor trims now provide bonus effects. Simply apply a chestplate for the level 1 effect or wear the full set of a trim to get the full effect. 


### Weapon Bindings:
You can bind your weapons with minerals such as nautilus shells, amethyst shards and more! Here are the effects of each: 
**Nautilus** - With all armor off, charge the "poseidon's blessing" attack (10min cooldown)
**Ender** - Crouch and hold for 3sec to teleport to where you are looking (1min cooldown)
**Amethyst** - Crouch to attack with a damage aura every 1 second (Uses levels)
**Copper** - Thunderstrike all nearby entities (3min cooldown)
**Chorus** - Crouch to levitate (Recharge by holding the weapon)
**Echo** - Unleash a *devastating* sonic attack. Deals critical damage to all nearby players (10min cooldown)

All bindings can be amplified by increasing their purity. Purity starts at 1 and goes to 5. The amount of bindings you need to increase purity increases exponentially each level. 1 binding for level 1, 2 bindings for level 2, 4 bindings for level 3, etc.
Some bindings amplify trim effects. For example, nautilus increases the effect of the tide armor trim. 



### Coming Soon:
- Effects for the Wayfinder, Host, Raiser and Shaper armor trims
- More weapon bindings
- More legendary weapons
- More Admin controls
- Full support for open-world mode


### NOTE:
This data pack was very specifically designed for the Shattered Kingdom SMP world and will need some major tweaking to setup and make work in your world. Requires some data pack knowledge and experience. The armor trim effects and weapon bindings will be available as a separtate pack with no setup needed soon. When they are available, I will put the links here.

title: Stage Tables
description: Allows game stages to be placed into weighted tables.
body:
This mod provides a framework for creating weighted randomized tables of Game Stages. If you do not know what a game stage is, it is highly recommended that you familiarize yourself with the Game Stage mod first. The basic idea of this mod is that modpacks cad define a table of game stages They can then use a command provided by this mod to award a player a random stage from that table. This mod also requires a basic understanding of CraftTweaker scripting to use it effectively.

For in depth examples, please checkout the GitHub page. There is also a Discord server where you can ask for help and advice.

Commands

  • /stagetable - Provides a list of all commands added by this mod.
  • /stagetable dump - Generates a file containing information about all the stage tables.
  • /stagetable award <player> <table> - Attempts to award a player with a random stage from the specified table.
  • /stagetable silentaward <player> <table> - Same as the award command, but doesn't notify the player about it.

Basic Terminology

  • Stage Table - A named table that contains stage entries.
  • Stage Entry - An entry in a stage table. Each entry has a stage that will be awarded, a weight value, and a list of conditions.
  • Stage Condition - A condition that must be met for a stage entry to be awardable to a given player.

Weighted Randomness

Weight is a form of probability system where the possible outcomes have unequal odds of happening The percent chance of any given outcome can be calculated by dividing the weight of a specific entry by the total weight of all entries in a table. For example if an entry has a weight of one, and the total weight is 9, there is a 10% chance of the first outcome. Weighted randomness is commonly used when the pool of outcomes needs to be flexible. If you are still unsure, you can run the dump command which will generate visual tables based on the tables that you have created.

CraftTweaker Scripting

Below is an example script that shows the various things made available. For more precise information please check here for the exact information.

// Basic imports used in this script
import crafttweaker.player.IPlayer;

// Creates a new stage table with the name exampleTable
val testTable = stageTables.createTable("exampleTable");

// Creates a new stage entry for stage "one" with a weight of 5.
val entryOne = testTable.createEntry("one", 5);

// Creates a new stage entry for stage "two" with a weight of 5.
val entryTwo = testTable.createEntry("two", 5);

// Prevent entryTwo from being selected unless the player has stage "four".
entryTwo.addStageCondition("four");

// Creates a new stage entry for stage "three" with a weight of 1.
val entryThree = testTable.createEntry("three", 1);

// Adds a custom condition to aquiring this entry using ZenScript.
// In this case, it's only valid if the player is in creative mode.
entryThree.addCondition(function(player as IPlayer) {
    return player.creative;
});

title: Ascendant Arcana
description: A complete enchantment overhaul with dozens of new enchantments and enhanced progression.
body:
# Ascendant Arcana

Ascendant Arcana is a mod that completely overhauls enchanting and enchantment-related progression, focusing on making enchantments unique modifiers to your tools, rather than glorified stat bonuses that made up most of your vanilla power.

## Progression

Enchanting is now open to the user much earlier than it previously was. An early version of the enchanting table, the **Copper Enchanting Table**, can now be crafted with copper, restorine, and a book! This Enchanting Table can only make common and uncommon enchantments, but its a very good source for early game enchantments!

## Enchanting

**Enchanting Tables are no longer random.** Enchantments are instead obtained with recipes inside the enchantment table, although what recipes you can and can't see depend on the surrounding blocks. Like before, the Enchanting Table gains power from Bookshelves. But unlike before, Chiseled Bookshelves now also contribute. Enchantments are locked based on their rarity and require a certain amount of power to unlock each rarity. Rare and Very Rare enchantments _require_ Chiseled Bookshelves to become unlocked, gaining extra power from each Enchanted Book inside.

Treasure Enchantments can also be placed inside nearby Chiseled Bookshelves to unlock their recipes in the Enchanting Table.

Most enchantments require Magical Scrap, which can be crafted with Gold Nuggets, Amethyst, and Lapis or obtained by scrapping enchanted items in the Grindstone.

<details>
<summary>List of Enchantments</summary>

### Bow/Crossbow

**Archer's Gambit**, a bow and crossbow enchantment that grants faster draw speed for each consecutive shot landed.

**Evoker's Wrath**, a bow enchantment that summons an Evoker Fang under the feet of the target.

**Hobbling Shot**, a bow and crossbow enchantment that very slightly reduces movement speed and jump height of shot targets, but stacks with each hit shot.

**Rejuvenating Shot**, a bow and crossbow enchantment that makes it heal for half the damage it would have otherwise done.

**Ricochet**, a bow enchantment that reduces base damage but makes the arrow ricochet and increase damage each bounce.

### Tool

**Smelting**, a tool enchantment that smelts the results of items mined.

### Shield

**Cleanse**, a shield enchantment that clears all status effects after blocking for a short duration.

**Deflect**, a shield enchantment that deflects most projectiles.

**Sonic Blast**, a shield enchantment that charges up a powerful sonic boom that ignores most forms of protection.

**Cross Counter**, a shield enchantment that increases attack damage after blocking an attack immediately after raising the shield.

### Melee

**Debilitating Chain**, a melee enchantment that sends all status effects to the nearest enemy after slaying an afflicted target.

**Pincushion**, a melee enchantment that reduces base damage and increases it for each arrow stuck in the target.

**Soul Burst**, a melee enchantment that makes slain enemies explode with AoE size and damage based on maximum health of the target.

### Trident
  
**Ambush**, a Trident enchantment that teleports you to hit enemies.

**Lifetide**, a trident enchantment that makes thrown tridents stick into their targets, healing them over time. You heal half as much.

**Sundering**, a trident enchantment that makes thrown trident stick into their targets, dealing slight damage over time and reducing the target's armor.

### Chestplate

**Protective Echo**, a chestplate enchantment that nullifies large instances of damage, instead spreading them out over time.

**Heart Enchantments** are a unique group of chestplate enchantments that provide passive benefits and are meant to be the cornerstone of a build. You can only have one heart enchantment at a time.

**Heart of the Nether**, a heart enchantment that increases all fire damage dealt.

**Bladeheart**, a heart enchantment that slightly increases all physical damage dealt.

**Witch Heart**, a heart enchantment that slightly increases all magical damage dealt.

**Heart of the Turtle**, a heart enchantment that reduces incoming and outgoing damage.

**Alchemist's Heart**, a heart enchantment that increases the amplifier of all positive potion effects applied to you.

### Leggings

**Strafe**, a leggings enchantment that reduces the slow while using an item and allows you to sprint in any direction.

**Surefoot**, a leggings enchantment that significantly increases kockback resistance and reduces the effect of slows on you.

### Boots

**Hellwalker**, a boots enchantment that crystalizes lava below you temporarily.

### Curses

**Curse of the Depths**, an armor curse that drags you to the bottom of water.

**Curse of Enfeeblement**, a curse that reduces maximum health.

**Curse of Inaccuracy**, a bow/crossbow curse that reduces accuracy.

</details>

## Repairing and Upgrades

**Stat bonuses are now found from Relics, a new item that can be found in chests, obtained from archaeology, vanilla bosses, and some magical enemies.** Early relics can be crafted from fairly simple resources, while later relics must be found or obtained by slaying bosses. Relics can provide bonuses to attack/mining speed, durability, damage, protection, or enchantment capacity.

Mending has also been removed. **Instead, caves can now generate with a new resource, Restorine, which acts as a universal repair ingredient.** Restorine even regrows on its own, similar to Amethyst Clusters, so once you've found a source you can keep going back for more. If you decide to use the item's original repair ingredient, it will repair double the amount it previously did!

## Compatibility

**Feature Compatibility:**

- **[EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi)** is supported and HIGHLY encouraged for this mod!
  - [EMI Loot](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi-loot) has an issue that shows relics as "Unknown Relic" instead of the relic actually dropped by that loot table.

**Supported Enchantment Mods:**
- [Majrusz's Enchantments](https://modrinth.com/mod/majruszs-enchantments)

## What's Next?

description: Simple, powerful, formattable nicknames and pronouns that display everywhere I could think of: nametags, chat, scoreboards, in commands, on the player list etc.
body:
# Nicknames Everywhere!

Simple, powerful <font color="#FF0000">f</font><font color="#CC3300">o</font><font color="#996600">r</font><font color="#669900">m</font><font color="#33CC00">a</font><font color="#00FF00">t</font><font color="#33CC33">t</font><font color="#669966">a</font><font color="#996699">b</font><font color="#CC33CC">l</font><font color="#FF00FF">e</font> nicknames and pronouns that display everywhere I could think of: nametags, chat, scoreboards, in commands, on the player list etc.

Comes with explicit support for:
- FancyMenu - NNE has a special FM placeholder! (see below)
- Simple Voice Chat - nicknames and pronouns show properly in SVC's GUI

## Features

- Set separate nicknames and pronouns
- Supports colourful formatting (I recommend https://www.birdflop.com/resources/rgb/ - use Colour Format -> MiniMessage)
- Enable/disable players being able to set their own nicknames and pronouns
- Set other players' nicknames and pronouns (requires permission level 2)
- Enable/disable nickname and pronoun formatting
- Set maximum lengths for nicknames and pronouns

### FancyMenu integration

NicknamesEverywhere includes native placeholder support for the **FancyMenu** mod, allowing you to dynamically display player nicknames and pronouns directly inside custom menus, layouts, and text elements:

> <font color="#7FEBE6">{</font><font color="#EB7F7F">"placeholder"</font><font color="#7F9EEB">:</font><font color="#E7C67D">"nicknameseverywhere_nickname"</font><font color="#7F9EEB">,</font><font color="#EB7F7F">"values"</font><font color="#7F9EEB">:</font><font color="#7FEBE6">{</font><font color="#EB7F7F">"username"</font><font color="#7F9EEB">:</font><font color="#E7C67D">"Joel4848"</font><font color="#7F9EEB">,</font><font color="#EB7F7F">"include_pronouns"</font><font color="#7F9EEB">:</font><font color="#E7C67D">"true"</font><font color="#7FEBE6">}}</font>
- Returns a player's formatted nickname (and optionally their pronouns)

## Commands

(All commands can use the alias `/nne`)

### Client

- `/nicknames setNick` and `/nicknames clearNick` to set and clear your nickname
- `/nicknames setPronouns` and `/nicknames clearPronouns` to set and clear your pronouns

### Admin

- `/nicknames admin setPlayerNick` and `/nicknames admin clearPlayerNick` to set and clear another player's nickname
- `/nicknames admin setPlayerPronouns` and `/nicknames admin clearPlayerPronouns` to set and clear another player's pronouns

### Config

- `/nicknames config allowNickFormatting <enabled|disabled>` to enable/disable formatting in nicknames/pronouns
- `/nicknames config allowSettingOwnNicknames <enabled|disabled>` to enable/disable players setting their own nicknames/pronouns
- `/nicknames config maxNickLength <0-255>` to set the maximum nickname length (0 = no limit)
- `/nicknames config maxPronounsLength <0-255>` to set the maximum pronouns length (0 = no limit)
- `/nicknames config usePronounsEverywhere <enabled|disabled>`  if disaabled, pronouns won't show in things like `/tellraw` or `/title` commands (I needed this for my server)

title: Tastes Like Vanilla+
description: Tastes Like Vanilla+ is a light modpack designed to enhance the vanilla gameplay experience, without requiring server-side mods.
body:
![Tastes Like Vanilla+ Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f31eb932b238f9675fc0f2452e461b942764f45.jpeg)

Minecraft is a beautiful game which has stood the test of time throughout it's long life. Rather than fully **reimagine** the game, _Tastes Like Vanilla+_ aims to **enhance** the base game. Rediscover the magical feelings we all hold so dearly of our first times on Minecraft.

The core themes of the pack are **exploration**, **rediscovery**, and **advancement**. The pack is "designed" to challenge players with various difficulty increases, encouraging cautious exploration, to enable building with countless additions to decorative blocks, and to incentivize long-term "grinding" with the technological based mods and added achievements to give players a reason to play beyond the "two week" phase.

The pack isn't perfect, but if you want to enjoy Minecraft beyond the first two weeks, it'll help allow you. Just remember -- Minecraft isn't competitive. The "best" does not matter. Your goal isn't to reach the destination: it's to enjoy the journey.

title: LodestoneLink
description: Adds a custom compass to teleport to lodestones connected to that compass.
body: # Teleport Compass Adds a **special compass** that lets players save **lodestone locations** and teleport to them through a simple menu. --- ## Overview The **Teleport Compass** allows players to quickly return to important places in their world. Players can: * **Left click a lodestone** to save it as a location * **Right click the compass** to open a teleport menu * Select a saved location to **teleport there instantly** Each compass stores its own locations, so every player can manage their own set of waypoints. --- ## How It Works ### Saving a Location 1. Hold the **Teleport Compass** 2. **Left click a Lodestone** 3. The location is saved to the compass If the **lodestone has a custom name** (renamed in an anvil), that name will appear in the teleport menu. --- ### Opening the Menu * **Right click the compass** to open the waypoint menu. The menu shows every saved lodestone location stored inside the compass. Click a location to **teleport to it**. --- ### Custom Menu Icons You can customize how a waypoint appears in the menu. If an **item frame is placed on top of the lodestone**, the item inside the frame will be used as the **icon in the teleport menu**. Example: * Put a **diamond** in the frame → the waypoint shows a diamond * Put a **sword** in the frame → the waypoint shows a sword If no item frame is present, a default icon is used. --- ## Crafting The Teleport Compass is crafted with the following recipe: ``` A A A A B A A A A ``` Where: * **A** = Diamond * **B** = Compass This recipe can be fully changed in the configuration. --- ## Configuration The plugin uses **MiniMessage**, so colors, gradients, and formatting can be fully customized. ```yaml item: displayname: "Teleport Compass" lore: - "<#0C26FF>Right click to open menu" - "<#0C26FF>Left click on Lodestone to add location" crafting: shape: - "AAA" - "ABA" - "AAA" ingredients: A: DIAMOND B: COMPASS menu: rows: 3 item: displayname: "Lodestone" lore: - "in {WORLD}" - "X: {X}" - "Y: {Y}" - "Z: {Z}" messages: unsafe: "This waypoint is unsafe to teleport to." max: "This teleport compass has reached the limit." ``` --- ## Features * Save **multiple lodestone locations** * **Simple teleport menu** * **MiniMessage support** * **Custom crafting recipe** * **Custom waypoint icons using item frames** * **Lodestone names automatically shown** * **Each compass stores its own locations** --- ## Compatibility * Minecraft **1.21+** * **Paper** * **Folia compatible** * No database required * Lightweight and simple to use --- ## Typical Use Cases * Mark **player bases** * Save **important survival locations** * Create simple **teleport networks** * Improve survival **quality of life**

description: Simple XP HUD with exact values and clear notifications.
body:
# EXP Viewer!

**EXP Viewer!** is a client-side HUD mod for Fabric (Minecraft **1.20.x**) that makes experience tracking clearer and more dynamic.

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00c3012448e6d4531aaa8918344a8786a2e4b220_0.webp)

It shows exact XP points in `current / required` format, displays gain/spend notifications, and adds clean level-up visual effects.

## Features

*   XP points display near the vanilla XP bar
*   Separate level display
*   Notifications for:
    *   XP gain
    *   XP spent on enchanting
    *   XP spent on repairs (anvil / Mending)
*   Optional notification icons
*   Level-up effects and particles
*   Optional custom bitmap font
*   Flexible animation system with detailed controls

## Dependencies

### Required

*   **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**

### Optional

*   **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)** (recommended for easy config access from the mods list)

### Dependency Notes

*   The mod is client-side only.
*   Servers do not need this mod installed.
*   Without Mod Menu, you can still use the in-game config command.

## Presets

* ### Standart

![Standart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7431bdf021e5e92e5a3d26527a8cf6b162af5fa3_0.webp)

* ### Compact 

![Compact](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70f5d84b896ba78b6c12fbc5135893d7399c676a_0.webp)

## Configuration

You can configure:

*   full mod enable/disable
*   XP notifications on/off
*   notification icons on/off
*   max visible notification lines
*   all animations globally or by specific groups
*   custom font on/off

## Compatibility

*   Minecraft: **1.20 – 1.20.6**
*   Loader: **Fabric**
*   Client-side only (no server installation required)

Detailed Feature Breakdown

*   XP value shown as `current / required` near the XP bar
*   Gain/spend notifications with optional icons
*   Separate animation toggles for:
    *   XP HUD fade
    *   notification motion
    *   level-up effects
*   Optional custom bitmap font rendering

## Who Is It For

EXP Viewer! is for players who want to:

*   track XP progress more precisely
*   see where XP is spent
*   get a cleaner, more informative XP HUD without UI clutter

## License

This project is distributed under the **MIT** license.

title: SP Adblock
description: Ad blocker for SPWorlds SP servers. Блокировщик рекламы для серверов СП.
body:
## English Description

# SP Adblock - Your Personal Chat Filter

Tired of spam, ads, and unwanted messages cluttering your chat? **SP Adblock** is a powerful client-side mod that gives you complete control over what you see by allowing you to create and manage flexible filter lists.

This mod is made for blocking ads in chat on SPWorlds SP5 server, but it should work anywhere. It works silently in the background, cleaning up your chat feed from everything you don't want to see.

### 🚀 Key Features

*   **🛡️ Cloud-Powered Dynamic Filters:** The mod automatically downloads and updates SP5 chat blocklists from GitHub URLs every time you launch the game. You'll always be protected by the most up-to-date filters!
*   **⚙️ Fully Customizable Local Filter:** Create your own personal blocklist of words using simple in-game commands.
*   **🔇 Persistent Player Muting:** Mute any player by their username. The mod saves their unique ID (UUID), so the mute will persist even if they change their name.
*   **🖥️ Convenient GUI via ModMenu:** Easily enable or disable any of your available filter lists (two defaults, your local list, and any custom ones you've added) through the ModMenu interface.
*   **📝 Support for Custom Filter Lists:** Simply drop your own `.json` file with keywords into the mod's config folder, and it will automatically appear in the GUI as a new, toggleable filter.
*   **🧠 Intelligent Chat Parsing:** The mod is designed to understand custom chat formats (e.g., `[Prefix] Nickname: message`), accurately separating usernames from the message content to avoid false positives.

### 🔧 How It Works

All settings are stored in the `config/spadblock` folder:
*   **`config1.json` / `config2.json`:** Local copies of the filters downloaded from GitHub.
*   **`local_words.json`:** Your personal blocklist, managed via in-game commands.
*   **`muted_players.json`:** The list of muted players (stores both username and UUID).
*   **any_other_file.json:** Just add your own file with keywords to this folder, and it will show up in the config menu!

### ⌨️ Commands

#### Filter Management
*   `/adblock add [word]` - Add a word to your local filter.
*   `/adblock remove [word]` - Remove a word from your local filter.
*   `/adblock list` - Display all words in your local filter.

#### Mute Management
*   `/mute [nickname]` - Mute a player. `Tab` completion will suggest online players.
*   `/unmute [nickname]` - Unmute a player.
*   `/mutelist` - Display a list of all players you have muted.

## Описание на русском языке

# SP Adblock - Ваш Персональный Фильтр Чата

Устали от спама, рекламы и нежелательных сообщений в чате? **SP Adblock** — это мощный клиентский мод, который дает вам полный контроль над тем, что вы видите, позволяя создавать и использовать гибкие списки фильтрации.

Этот мод был создан для блокировки рекламы в чате на сервере СП5. Он работает в фоне, незаметно очищая ваш чат от всего, что вы не хотите видеть.

### 🚀 Ключевые особенности

*   **🛡️ Динамические фильтры из облака:** Мод автоматически скачивает и обновляет списки блокировки по ссылкам на GitHub при каждом запуске игры. Вы всегда будете защищены актуальными фильтрами!
*   **⚙️ Полная кастомизация:** Создайте свой собственный локальный список блокировки слов с помощью простых команд прямо в игре.
*   **🔇 Гибкая система мьюта:** Замьютте любого игрока по нику. Мод запомнит его уникальный ID (UUID), поэтому мьют будет работать, даже если игрок сменит никнейм.
*   **🖥️ Удобный GUI:** Через **ModMenu** вы можете легко включать и отключать любые из доступных фильтров (Прыград, полная блокировка, локальный и любые добавленные вами).
  
*   **❗ Учтите, что по умолчанию включен только конфиг "Прыград".❗**
  ![Config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4449ad82e49177b9d27ee8729cd02e9d244455e7.png)
  
* **📝 Поддержка своих фильтров:** Просто добавьте свой `.json` файл со словами в папку мода, и он автоматически появится в GUI как новый доступный фильтр.
![Custom Config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41f81aac569ce50086217063f1374416da50d37c.png)
*   **🧠 Умная фильтрация:** Мод умеет анализировать сообщения с кастомными префиксами (например, `[Префикс] Ник: сообщение`), чтобы точно отделять ники от текста и избегать ложных срабатываний.

### 🔧 Как это работает

Все настройки хранятся в папке `config/spadblock`:
*   **`config1.json` / `config2.json`:** Локальные копии фильтров, скачанные с GitHub.
*   **`local_words.json`:** Ваш персональный список блокировки, управляемый через команды.
*   **`muted_players.json`:** Список замьюченных игроков (хранятся ник и UUID).
*   **`Любой_другой_файл.json`:** Просто добавьте свой файл с ключевыми словами в эту папку, и он появится в меню настроек!                                 
![config folder](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/701640348e6f66dde3e8c4f01d62ff1ae0d2c7cc.png)

### ⌨️ Команды

#### Управление фильтром
*   `/adblock add [слово]` — добавить слово в ваш локальный фильтр.
*   `/adblock remove [слово]` — удалить слово из вашего локального фильтра.
*   `/adblock list` — показать все слова из вашего локального фильтра.
![Block Words](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e2175b08e880a1b72cc1589d503774d4fd8c9cb.png)
#### Управление мьютами
*   `/mute [ник]` — замьютить игрока. Автодополнение по `Tab` покажет игроков онлайн.
*   `/unmute [ник]` — размьютить игрока.
*   `/mutelist` — показать список всех замьюченных вами игроков.
![Mute](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc4947a26b5f66d34e710265298a86f130a4246d.png)

body:
# EvoBiomes

Dynamic biome evolution for Paper/Spigot/Purpur. EvoBiomes gradually transitions selected regions through configurable biome chains (e.g., Plains → Savanna → Desert), applying visual and ecosystem effects along the way.

## Highlights
- Configurable biome evolution chains and transitional effects
- Gradual transitions: particles, messages, entities, and blocks
- Async selection, safe main-thread world updates
- Live‑reloadable rules (`rules.yml` in plugin data folder)
- Weather-aware pacing and player-density slowdowns (with TTL)
- Admin commands and developer API hooks

## Compatibility
- Servers: Paper/Spigot/Purpur
- Versions: 1.20, 1.20.1–1.20.6, 1.21, 1.21.1–1.21.10
- Built against `spigot-api 1.20.1` with `api-version: 1.20` for forward compatibility

## Installation
- Drop `EvoBiomes-1.0.0.jar` into `plugins`
- Start the server to generate config and rules
- Optional: edit `plugins/EvoBiomes/rules.yml` and run `/evobiomes reload`

## Commands
- `/evobiomes info` — show runtime settings
- `/evobiomes reload` — reload config and rules from disk
- `/evobiomes evolve <biome> <radius>` — force-evolve area around the player

## Permissions
- `evobiomes.admin` — access to all `evobiomes` commands (default: op)

## Configuration
`config.yml`
- `safe_mode`: limit biome updates per tick (default: true)
- `max_chunk_updates_per_tick`: budget for chunk processing (default: 5)
- `cycle_interval_ticks`: evolution cycle interval (default: 1200)
- `worlds`: list of world names to process
- `use_protocol_lib`: visual enhancements toggle (no compile dependency; falls back to Bukkit particles)
- `transitions`: toggles for `messages`, `particles`, `entities`, `blocks`
- `player_density`: `radius`, `slowdown_factor`
- `weather`: `rain_acceleration`, `thunder_acceleration`, `clear_slowdown`

## Rules & Effects
`rules.yml` (data folder)
- `chains` define ordered biome sequences per starting biome
- `effects` define transitional effects between steps using key `from->to`
- Effects include lists: `entities`, `blocks`, `particles`, and `message`

Example chains:
- `plains: [savanna, desert]`
- `forest: [dark_forest, jungle]`
- `taiga: [snowy_taiga, ice_spikes]`

## How It Works
- Scheduler runs asynchronously to select chunks; each chunk’s work is executed on the main thread for safety
- Transitional effects are applied before the biome switch (particles/messages/entities/blocks)
- Temperature/humidity hints are shown to nearby players
- Weather and player density modify pacing without blocking the server

title: InControlMob
description: Rule-driven mob control plugin for Paper 1.21
body:
### Overview
**InControlMob** is a Spigot/Paper plugin for **Minecraft 1.21** that gives server admins a powerful, rule‑driven system to control mob spawning, spawner behavior, summoned entities, loot, and experience. Rules are plain JSON files stored in `config/incontrolmob/`, hot‑reloadable, and validated on load so you can safely customize server behavior without code changes.

---

### Key Features
- Rule‑driven control for spawn, spawner, summon, loot, and experience events  
- JSON rules with schema validation and clear error reporting  
- Hot reload with `/incontrolmob reload` — no server restart required  
- Rich conditions: entity type, world, biome, light level, spawn reason, time of day, difficulty, nearby players, NBT match, WorldGuard region checks, and more  
- Powerful actions: allow/deny spawn, change health, set equipment, add potion effects, replace entity type, modify drops and XP, set entity flags (noGravity, invulnerable, glowing, persistent), velocity/passenger changes  
- Priority and control: rule `priority`, `enabled` flag, `continueOnMatch` option, and file order semantics  
- Safe and performant: asynchronous rule loading, atomic swap of rule sets, caching and indexing by entityType/spawnReason, debug logging controlled by config  
- Optional WorldGuard integration: region checks when WorldGuard is present; graceful degradation when absent  
- Admin tools: list rules, test rules, and export rules for sharing  

---

### Installation
1. Place the compiled `InControlMob.jar` into your server `plugins/` folder for Paper 1.21  
2. Start the server once to generate the `config/incontrolmob/` folder and sample JSON files  
3. Edit the JSON files to define your rules  
4. Use `/incontrolmob reload` to apply changes instantly  

**Default config.yml**
```yaml
enabled: true
debug: false
default-action: allow
max-rule-load-time-ms: 5000
rule-cache-size: 1024
```

---

### Commands
- `/incontrolmob reload` — reload all JSON rules and report errors  
- `/incontrolmob rules list` — list loaded rules with id, priority, and enabled state  
- `/incontrolmob rule test <ruleId> <entityType>` — simulate rule evaluation at your location  
- `/incontrolmob export` — export current loaded rules to a single archive  

**Permissions**
- `incontrolmob.reload` — allow reload  
- `incontrolmob.manage` — manage rules and export  
- `incontrolmob.test` — run rule tests  

---

### Examples
- **Block pigs**: add `deny_pigs_global` to `spawn.json`, reload, pigs will no longer spawn  
- **Strong zombies**: add `strong_zombies_plains_night`, reload, zombies in Plains at night spawn with 40 HP, iron sword, and speed effect  
- **Spawner replacement**: add a `spawner.json` rule to replace zombies with skeletons  

---

### Troubleshooting
- Enable `debug: true` in `config.yml` for detailed logs  
- On reload, check console for schema validation errors; invalid rules are skipped and reported  
- If WorldGuard checks fail, confirm WorldGuard is installed and compatible  
- For performance, ensure `rule-cache-size` is reasonable and avoid overly broad rules  

---

### Credits
This plugin was inspired by the [In Control! Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/in-control).  
**InControlMob** is an independent server‑side plugin built for Paper/Spigot, bringing similar rule‑based mob control features to multiplayer servers.

---

### License
Released under the **Creative Study Lab License.** (MIT‑style permissive). See the **[License](https://github.com/mahadimdinfo-rgb/InControlMob/blob/main/LICENSE)** file for details.
