title: StarChat
description: A simple chat plugin from Firestar311. Can be expanded upon with other plugins
body:
StarChat is a simple plugin for managing server chat. It can be as simple as a chat formatter or as complex as to use it for many different channels and rooms.

# Required Dependencies
Java 21  
[StarCore](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/starcore.110550/) 0.15.0

# Optional Dependencies
[PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)  
[Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/)

# Version Information
This plugin is a work in progress and very unstable. I am constantly adding, changing and removing things within this library. This is based on need in my other projects, of which are also works in progress and constantly changing and evolving. I expect things to stabilize as time goes on.

# Basic Information
StarChat is a plugin all about managing the chat of the server. It also serves as a library of sorts to extend upon by other plugins

# Roadmap
Take a look at the [GitHub Issue Tracker](https://github.com/StarDevelopmentLLC/StarChat/issues) for a list of changes and features planned

# Installation
[View the Installation Guide on the Wiki](https://github.com/StarDevelopmentLLC/StarChat/wiki)

# How to use
The [Official Wiki](https://github.com/StarDevelopmentLLC/StarChat/wiki) has pages on how to use different aspects of this plugin. This is kept up-to-date as updates pass

*This plugin is provided free of charge and under the MIT Open Source License. I will never sell this library anywhere. If you see it being sold, it is not by me and please report any of these cases to me directly. You can find [links to the Official Releases on the GitHub README file](https://github.com/StarDevelopmentLLC/StarChat/blob/main/README.md).*

title: Startklar
description: Alternative to /rtp that allows players to fly away with a boost from spawn!
body:
Startklar is a server-side Fabric mod for modern Minecraft versions that allows players to fly away without Elytra's
from the spawn.

When a player is jumping off of a cliff near the world spawn on the overworld, they automatically start flying. In this
flying mode, a player also does not need to worry about taking fall damage upon landing. When hitting shift
midair, they get a single boost.

***

<center>

### <big>More Details</big>

Here are several demonstrations showcasing the mod in action:

| ![A GIF showing how a player flies away from spawn, with one simple jump.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2k0qrwgn/images/967b7bea378cb2269e261428bb32c2141cf41609.gif) | ![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2k0qrwgn/images/15734ec4a9c7f3e4b2603b696e72bda535a401f8.gif) | ![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2k0qrwgn/images/8bb38aec52689ef2dcc8ac2b5e4cff3c9489b882.gif) |
|---|---|---|
| _**Fly Away From Spawn!**_ | _**Boost Away to new Horizons!**_ | _**Land Savely Without Dying!**_|

</center>

## Configuration

This mod comes with a TOML file on the server at `config/startklar/server.toml`, allowing to adjust a few aspects about
its behaviour. This is how it might look like:

```toml
# This message is being shown to the player when they have not used their boost yet midair.
# default: ᴘʀᴇss [sʜɪғᴛ] ғᴏʀ ᴀ ʙᴏᴏsᴛ!
boostIndicator = "To infinity and beyond!"
# The spawn range where players can start flying, measured in blocks.
# This is a box with the world spawn at the center.
# default: 32
spawnDiameter = 16
# Determines after how many blocks of fall distance the fly mode should be auto-toggled.
# range: 0.0 - 256.0
# default: 3.0
toggleAfterFallDistanceOf = 6.9
# The flight duration of the boost. Setting it to 0 means the boost is disabled.
# range: 0 - 3
# default: 1
flightDuration = 3
```

***

###### Startklar is distributed in the hope that it will be useful, but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the GNU Lesser General Public License for more details.

title: Hypixel Speed Builders Trainer
description: View, practice, and grind time on all of Hypixel's 350+ builds in your own world. Not affiliated with the Hypixel Network.
body:
# Hypixel Speed Builders Trainer View, practice, and grind time on all of Hypixel's 350+ builds in your own singleplayer world. **Compatible with Fabric 1.21.x**. More versions to come as released. Not affiliated with the Hypixel Network. ### Features - **Practice all 350+ Hypixel builds** - All builds as of `August 3rd, 2025` are included - **Realistic Functionality** - Mimics & supports Hypixel's "features" such as buttons on floor and **90-degree stair rotation placement** - **Advanced Automatic World Setup** - Instantly setup your world with `/spb setup` - **Different Modes**: - **Build Mode** - Creative powers with limited blocks, also restricts breaking and placing blocks outside of the platform - **Grind Mode** - Skips the build preview and enables replenishing blocks in order to keep practicing your time - **Time Recording** - Your times are viewable and recorded locally in `spbtrainer.json` within your config folder - **Customizble Preview Time** - Run `/spb config` to set preview time. Default is 5 seconds - **Customizble Keybinds**. Defaults: - `Grave Key` - Clear build area - `F6` - Restart - **Custom Builds Support** - Create and practice your own custom builds - **Randomized Layout** - Builds with set hotbars will be added soon, e.g., `colors` or `painting vertical` - **Builds Spreadsheet** - All Hypixel builds listed, as well as extra information. It can be found [here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1fSd1hopLb59BqAY-T0gyVs8ceevx1QD36Xqu-oSHJBA/edit?usp=sharing) ## Usage ### Dependencies Before installing this mod, make sure you have the following mods installed: - [WorldEdit](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldedit) - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
Dependencies download table for convenience!
*Note: All links take you straight to Modrinth downloads. It's easier to right click → `Open Link in New Tab`*
Fabric API version WorldEdit version
1.21 1.21
1.21.1 1.21.1
1.21.2 1.21.2
1.21.3 1.21.3
1.21.4 1.21.4
1.21.5 1.21.5
1.21.6 1.21.6
1.21.7 1.21.7
1.21.8 1.21.8
### World Setup 1. `Singleplayer` → `Create New World` 2. Set `Game Mode` to **Creative** 3. Set `Allow Commands` to **ON** 4. In the `World` tab, set `World Type` to **Superflat** 5. `Customize` → `Presets` → `The Void` (it will work without this, but you may have mob spawns, and it won't look as pretty) 6. `Create New World` 7. Once you're in the world, run `/spb setup` ### Commands *Important: Build names are formatted with no spaces and no capitals, e.g., `castleonahill`* - `/spb config` - Shows configuration in chat with interactable buttons - `/spb ` - Loads a build with a preview, then allows for building. Essentially a round of SPB - `/spb grind ` - Enables grind mode, which skips the previews, and automatically replenishes blocks in order to practice - `/spb stop` - Stops all previews and clears build region and inventory - `/spb reset` - Resets/clears the build area - **Default keybind: `Grave Key`** - `/spb restart` - Resets/clears the build, area, replenishes blocks, and begins a countdown to try again - **Default keybind: `F6`** - `/spb setup` - Sets up the world for the mod. Make sure you're in a superflat world with the void preset, with commands enabled! - `/spb create ` - Creates a custom build for whatever is on the platform - `/spb delete ` - Deletes your custom build - `/spb list` - Shows your custom builds - `/spb area` - Displays a message containing the build area - `/spb time ` - Displays your best recorded time for the build - `/spb time reset ` - Resets the recorded time for a build - `/spb view ` - Places the complete build for learning - `/spb buildmode ` - Toggles buildmode - `/spb help` - Shows this! ## Known Issues *Note: If any issues occur, which are not mentioned here, DM `ilovelifethankyou` on Discord for any questions, issues, or concerns. spbtrainer 1.21.4 is the **best** version.* - Signs don't leave inventory on `bus` build - Some builds don't have set hot bars yet - Please DM me builds with set hotbars - Some builds use wrong blocks - very minor issue that's being fixed as they appear - Please DM me builds with wrong blocks ## FAQ *Note: `ilovelifethankyou` on Discord for any questions, issues, or concerns not mentioned here.* ### Q: Can I use this mod on the Hypixel server? A: While it doesn't have multiplayer functionallity, you can log into servers with it safely. ### Q: Can I use this alongside other SPB mods? A: Yes. It doesn't interfere with [Boxeth's SpeedBuildersHelper](https://modrinth.com/project/aUJs6CKs). ### Q: Is there a 1.8.9 version? A: Due to complexity, previous verisions such as 1.8.9 will most likely not be available, but I'll check it out. ### Q: Is there a list of builds I can see? A: Click [here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1fSd1hopLb59BqAY-T0gyVs8ceevx1QD36Xqu-oSHJBA/edit?usp=sharing) for the Hypixel Builds Spreadsheet. ### Q: A build is missing! Where can I report it? A: Please DM `ilovelifethankyou` on Discord builds with set hotbars that aren't already added! ## Coming Soon - `/spb game` - Mimics a game of SPB, 2 simple, 2 easy, medium, hard, insane - More set hotbars for builds that have them ## Testers and Thanks - Thank you `DIX0` on Hypixel for providing many of the builds! - Thank you `HanaHippo` on Hypixel - Thank you `aembr` on Discord | `aembur` on GitHub for proofreading and restructuring README - And their amazing [GuessTheUtils](https://modrinth.com/project/49W6BOju) mod! ## To-Do List - Preview Video - `/spb builds` - Link to spreadsheet - One time in game toast notification for build spreadsheet

title: Magnolia
description: Dreams, nightmares, and a world with far too many secrets held from you
body:
![A top-down view of a minecraft world as a banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4413772e04a114f28770409d3d36af608c4f40f2_0.webp)
**Magnolia** is a 1.21.1 magic modpack focusing on world dynamics and interaction.


<details>
<summary>⚠️ Before You Play...</summary>
Magnolia is not a finished modpack, and does not currently reflect the final state I wish to see it in. It is still playable, some things just might not work as intended. You may find features that are broken, unpolished, or otherwise incomplete. The pack contains several mods and features that are not stable yet, and you may encounter strange happenings. Please report any all issues you find.
</details>



It was made with multiplayer in mind, built specifically for **Hyacinth**, the sister server of the pack. Keystone features and ideas of the pack include:
- **Esoterica**: You are expected to figure things out on your _own_, or with the help of friends. Many mechanics in the pack completely deviate from how they function in Vanilla (or even modded!) There are no quests or tutorials, and only a few things to guide you—learn with time.
- **Challenging Simplicity**: You're meant to have a reason to go out and explore the world, but only once you're ready. The pack is by no means a cakewalk.
- **Variety**: Progression is more varied than Iron -> Diamond -> Netherite. The enchants you choose and the tools you bring matter far more.

<details>
<summary>Pack Performance</summary>

  * Allocate atleast 4 GB of ram to Minecraft. Singleplayer can be very RAM hungry, and if you can, allocate 6-8 GB.
  * If you have a bad PC or are running Minecraft on a HDD, remove Distant Horizons.
</details>

This mod introduces Titanium, a new high-tier material that lets players push their gear beyond Netherite. Explore the world to collect Titanium Ore, refine it into ingots, and use a new craftable upgrade template to take your Netherite Sword to the next level.

Upgrading your sword with Titanium boosts its damage, durability, and overall combat effectiveness, giving you a powerful new end-game weapon without breaking the vanilla balance. title: IoTcraft
description: Connecting the virtual world with the physical.
body:
# IoTcraft
The IoTcraft mod allows the player's client to connect to an MQTT broker. Afterward, it can send and receive messages in the form of commands, triggers or other methods defined by the user.

## Requirements
Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/project/fabric-api), [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/project/cloth-config) and [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/project/modmenu) to function properly and for an easy setup.

## Setup
After booting up the game, navigate to the mod's config (either through the Mods button provided by Mod Menu or in the config folder) and set up the MQTT broker connection details.

body:
# Minecraft Mods for Hypixel Skyblock & Optimization 🏹✨

## Overview 🚀
This repository includes a collection of mods designed to enhance your Minecraft experience, particularly for **Hypixel Skyblock**. Whether you're looking for quality of life improvements, optimizations, or tools for dungeons and secrets, these mods have got you covered! 🏰💎

## Mods List 🛠️

### 1. **ctjs / ChatTriggers** ⚡
A powerful framework for **Minecraft Forge** that allows you to script client modifications using **JavaScript**. Perfect for creating custom scripts and enhancing your gameplay with easy-to-create features.  
- **Key Features**:
  - Scripted client modifications
  - Use JavaScript to modify your Minecraft experience
  - Enhance Hypixel Skyblock and other servers!

### 2. **DulkirMod** 🏆
This mod is specifically made to improve your **Hypixel Skyblock** experience. **DulkirMod** brings a variety of quality of life improvements, making your journey through the game smoother and more enjoyable.  
- **Key Features**:
  - Enhances the Hypixel Skyblock experience
  - Quality of life improvements
  - Easy installation and usage

### 3. **Dungeons-Guide** 🗺️
A must-have mod for **Hypixel Skyblock Dungeons** players. It helps you find secrets, solve puzzles, and provides other useful tools to assist you during your dungeon runs.  
- **Key Features**:
  - Guide to find **secrets** and **puzzles**
  - Additional **QOL** features for dungeons
  - Helps with dungeon efficiency and completion

### 4. **NotEnoughUpdates** 📚
This mod provides a **NEI-style interface** for viewing crafting recipes and item information within **Hypixel Skyblock**. It's an essential tool for Skyblock players looking to craft items quickly and easily!  
- **Key Features**:
  - View item crafting recipes and stats
  - Search through **Hypixel Skyblock** items with ease
  - Boosts your Skyblock efficiency

### 5. **Odin** 🛡️
A lightweight **Forge mod** for **Hypixel Skyblock**, designed to optimize performance while adding specialized features for **Kuudra** and **Dungeons**. Perfect for players who want additional functionality without sacrificing performance.  
- **Key Features**:
  - Focused on **Kuudra** & **Dungeons**
  - **Lightweight** to prevent lag
  - Enhances overall **Skyblock** gameplay

### 6. **Optifine** 🎮
A must-have for optimizing **Minecraft**. **Optifine** provides performance improvements and customization options, including dynamic lighting, better FPS, and visual enhancements.  
- **Key Features**:
  - Improves **FPS** and performance
  - Adds advanced graphical settings
  - **Dynamic lighting** and other visual enhancements

### 7. **Patcher** 🔧
This mod enhances your overall Minecraft experience by improving performance, fixing **Vanilla bugs**, and adding various **Quality of Life** features.  
- **Key Features**:
  - Performance improvements for **Minecraft 1.8.9** & **1.12.2**
  - Bug fixes and optimizations
  - Adds several **QOL** features to improve your experience

### 8. **SkyblockAddons** 🌟
A must-have **Minecraft Forge mod** packed with helpful features tailored to the **Hypixel Skyblock** experience. **SkyblockAddons** aims to improve your gameplay with various enhancements and quality of life features.  
- **Key Features**:
  - Enhance **Hypixel Skyblock** gameplay
  - Improve user interface and performance
  - Packed with useful features

### 9. **Skytils** 🌌
A versatile **Hypixel Skyblock** mod that improves your quality of life, helping you complete tasks more efficiently. It provides several utility features to enhance your Skyblock gameplay.  
- **Key Features**:
  - **Skyblock-specific features** for better gameplay
  - **QOL improvements** for a smoother experience
  - **Enhanced functionality** for Skyblock players

### 10. **WaterSolver** 🌊
This mod is a simple and effective **Water Board solver** for Minecraft. Ideal for players solving puzzles related to water flow or aqueducts!  
- **Key Features**:
  - Solves **water board puzzles**
  - Easy to use and set up
  - Helps players with complex water puzzles

title: FriendsCraft 2
description: This is a modpack perfectly designed for just having fun with your friends on an server!
body:
![This is the logo of FriendsCraft 2.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/685610b3ce423d77dde28da1ddcef4bfe5ee5af8.png)

FriendsCraft 2
-----------------
Do you want to have a great adventure with your friends in Minecraft without the game being filled with hundreds of mods? Then this modpack is exactly right for you!
This modpack is aimed at keeping Minecraft mostly vanilla, but it adds some quality of life features, as well as improving and making the boss fights more difficult, making the adventure more exciting! 

_Friends are not included!_

Versions
-----------------
There are 4 versions of the modpack:
- **Standard**: This version is intended for players who only want to join a server with this modpack. All mods that are only needed on the server side are not included in this modpack.
- **Low Performance**: Like the client version, this version is intended for players who want to join a server with this modpack. However, this version is only suitable for players who do not have a powerful computer, as most of the mods to improve the game's graphics have been removed in this version.

Features
-----------------
This modpack contains many functions and mods. Here are the most important ones:
- Thanks to many performance mods, the game should run smoothly and you can also use shaders.
- With the help of **Simple Voice Chat**, you can talk to other players in-game and thus interact better with each other.
- With **NoEmotecraft**, you can use emotes.
- Now you can harvest faster with **RightClickHarvest** by simply right-clicking your crops. Tip: With a hoe you can harvest several crops at the same time.
- Build a simple and efficient shop where your friends can buy something with the help of **Universal Shops**.
- Create amazing armor stands with special poses through **Armor Poser**.
- Sit on all possible stairs just by right-clicking them using the **Sit!** mod.
- So that you are no longer easily killed by your friends, you can use **Defense** to activate a shield with which your friends can no longer attack you, but you can no longer attack them either.
- **Enderpack** gives you the opportunity to always have an Enderchest on your back.
- With **Genshin Instruments**, you can introduce your friends to your great music in Minecraft.
- With **Camerapture**, you can record the most important moments with a camera and then hang these pictures on the wall anywhere, e.g. on your friend's wall.
- Craft an invisible item frame using **Invis item frame**.
- You die? No problem, because with **Hardcore Revival**, your friends can revive you as long as they are with you.
- Your friends don't want to save you and you really die? Then **You're in Grave Danger** is just right for you, which spawns a grave with all your items at your death point.
- Store your XP in bottles with **Bottle Your Xp**, but be careful: when you use it you don't get the same amount of XP back!
- Combine your elytra and your chestplate with the help of **Armored Elytra**.
- Your elytra can now look as beautiful as your chestplate with **Elytra Trims**.
- Do you have to protect your chests from your friends? Now you can lock them, your chests and not your friends, with a trial key.
- Now you can store 4 of your tools in your belt with **Utility Belt** and not fill your hotbar unnecessarily.
- Exploring is now much more exciting, as **Tectonic** makes world generation more complicated and exciting.
- The Wither is too easy for you? With the help of **Withering Heights: Revamped Wither**, the Wither fight becomes much more difficult.
- Getting to the End is now also more difficult, as **End Remastered** adds new special Ender eyes that can spawn in all kinds of structures. (The Wither also drops one)
- **True Ending: Ender Dragon Overhaul** makes the Ender Dragon fight much more difficult with new attacks.
- After you have defeated the Ender Dragon, you can explore the new structures in the End through **Medieval Buildings [End Edition]**.
- Includes [Stay True Texture Pack](https://www.9minecraft.net/stay-true-resource-pack/)
- Includes [Vanilla Tweaks Texture Pack](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/)
- And much more...

## FAQ
> **Q: Does RizenCraft support LAN or Multiplayer?**
> 
> **A:** Yes, RizenCraft is built for both singleplayer & multiplayer (server or LAN)
> 
> **Q: There's something wrong with the modpack, where to ask for help / bug report?**
> 
> **A:** For Bugs [github issues](https://github.com/RizenPaul/RizenCraft/issues), For help or requests [github pulls](https://github.com/RizenPaul/RizenCraft/pulls)

## Installation

**Manual installation:** 
1. Download the **RizenCraft** modpack from modrinth website
2. Install Modrinth app and launch it
3. Find the **+** (_create profile_) icon near the **gear** icon at the bottom left of the app
4. Choose "**From File**" and import the downloaded modpack **.mrpack** file
5. Go to Library and press Play button, ENJOY!

**Automatic installation:**
1. Download and install Modrinth app and launch it
2. Click the search (magnifying glass icon) button
3. Search for **RizenCraft** and click install
4. Go to Library and press Play button, ENJOY!

body:
## Official Reccomended Client Side ( Includes some world generation mods ) modpack for play.kismetgam.ing.

# What is this Pack?

**This Modpack is meant to be an ( Almost ) Entirely client side optimization + customization pack intended to be used on the Kismet Minecraft Servers. It Includes a couple mods that you lose some functionality without, such as voice chat and world generation mods, but these are not required for multiplayer.**

## Shader Reccomendations

For Low End PCS, It is Reccomended that you Disable shaders, as they come enabled my default.

If you have a more mid range PC and can generally handle shaders at Medium settings, I reccomend Switching to Complimentary Reimagined + Euphoria Patches, and switching to the Euphoria Patches Preset.

By Default, The Shaders Selected are Complimentary Reimagined + Euphoria Patches. I originally Chose Euphoria Patches, but raised some of the settings as my system can handle it without issue. For your own comparison I have a Ryzen 7 7700x and a rx 7800 xt.

### JayTAK Repair
Simple Minecraft server repair plugin that allows players to repair the item they are holding in their hands for the price of one of the base materials the item is made from.

For more information please visit my [GitHub](https://github.com/Jaytak/JayTAKRepairPlugin)

#### Commands & Aliases

```
/jaytakrepair
/jrepair
/jrep
/jr
```

#### Permission Nodes

``
jaytakrepairplugin.repair
``

Grants the player access to the command.

title: Yourscraft
description: Vanilla-style HD textures
body: Yourscraft is an HD texture pack which is extrapolated from the default 16X16 textures, partly by hand but mostly by a machine learning algorithm designed to increase the resolution of photographs. The general intent of the pack is to make a smooth pack with just the right amount of detail, without some of the unnecessary environment-specific details a lot of HD packs add, like faux directional shading or spots of algae on "underwater" blocks, in order to make textures that would be instantly recognizable compared to the defaults and that could be used with as many other blocks and in as many environments/build types as possible.

title: Tube Logistics
description: Smart Item Storage using Tubes
body:
(requires Fabric Language Kotlin)

Tube Logistics is a series of tubes.

The most basic is the Item Tube, which simply transports items. At forks, the direction is chosen randomly.

But the real power of these tubes is with a routing network. Placing a Routing Controller next to a Routed Item Tube creates a routing network. Within a network, the following tubes have special functionality:

- Item Provider Tube: Items in inventories adjacent to the tube will be provided to the network for requests.
- Item Requester Tube: A specified item will be requested from the network to maintain a specific amount in the adjacent inventories.
- Manual Requester Tube: This tube can be used by players to view the items provided by the network and to make individual requests.
- Processing Route Item Tube: Provides a recipe for automatic production of items. The left side of the UI contains the ingredients it should request, and the right side contains the outputs it should expect. When requested, the ingredients will be placed in inventories adjacent to the tube, and the results can be inserted anywhere in the network.
- Storage Route Item Tube: This tube acts as a destination for otherwise unrouted items that enter the network, placing items into all adjacent inventories.

title: Resource Replicator
description: Add a machine for copying items/fluids/chemicals.
body:
English

Resource Replicator

Place the item (or fluid/chemical) to be replicated into the block. As long as it is supplied with FE energy, the block will begin outputting the same resource. Simultaneously, the block's appearance will change in real-time to display the resource currently being replicated.

1.Item Replicator

*   Insert by right-clicking with the item in hand; sneak + right-click with an empty hand to clear the inserted item.
*   Supports an allow/deny list. Mod items and admin items are added to the deny list by default. Supports item ID/mod ID/tag.
*   Configurable processing speed and output multiplier per tier. Default output quantities: T1: 4/20t, T2: 16/15t, T3: 32/10t, T4: 64/5t, T5: 128/1t.
*   Configurable void function. Items input via pipes will be voided, with the voiding speed depending on the pipe's speed. Disabled by default.
*   Configurable number of output slots. Defaults to one buffer slot.
*   Configurable auto-output. When enabled, automatically outputs items to a container on one adjacent face.
*   Configurable energy consumption.

2.Fluid Replicator

*   Insert by right-clicking with a fluid bucket in hand; right-click with an empty bucket to clear all fluid inside.
*   Supports an allow/deny list. Supports item ID/mod ID/tag.
*   Configurable processing speed and output multiplier per tier. Default output quantities: T1: 1k/20t, T2: 2.5k/15t, T3: 5k/10t, T4: 10k/5t, T5: 25k/1t.
*   Configurable special output for water. Tick rate remains the same, output amounts are 1k, 10k, 100k, 1M, 10M.
*   Configurable special output for lava. Tick rate remains the same, output amounts are 10, 50, 100, 500, 1k.
*   Configurable void function. Fluids input via pipes will be voided, with the voiding speed depending on the pipe's speed. Disabled by default.
*   Configurable output tank buffer size. Defaults to 8000mB.
*   Configurable auto-output. When enabled, automatically outputs fluids to a container on one adjacent face.
*   Configurable energy consumption.

3.Chemical Replicator - Mekanism Compat

*   Insert by right-clicking with a tank containing a chemical in hand; right-click with an empty tank to clear all chemicals inside.
*   Supports an allow/deny list. Supports item ID/mod ID.
*   Configurable processing speed and output multiplier per tier. Default output quantities: T1: 10/20t, T2: 50/15t, T3: 100/10t, T4: 500/5t, T5: 1k/1t.
*   Configurable void function. Chemicals input via pipes will be voided, with the voiding speed depending on the pipe's speed. Disabled by default.
*   Configurable output tank buffer size. Defaults to 8000mB.
*   Configurable energy consumption.

No machines that produce FE have been added yet.

# Pure OptiFine Experience

This mod pack is designed to focus entirely on "Optifine" features. It cleans up features missing or added in other OptiFabric mod packs; nothing superfluous. Pure "Optifine" Power.

## Features
* Pure Performance: Focuses strictly on OptiFine and OptiFabric features.
* No Bloatware: Contains zero unnecessary or redundant mods.
* Vanilla Friendly: Keeps the core game pure while delivering maximum OptiFine power.

## Test Results
* Default Vanilla Minecraft: ~355 FPS
* With This Modpack: ~805 FPS

## System Specifications Used in Benchmarks
* CPU: Intel Core i5-12400F (12th Gen)
* GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
* Display Resolution: 1600x901
* Java Version: 25.0.2
* Graphics Driver: NVIDIA 591.74 (OpenGL 3.3.0)

## Why Choose This Modpack?
Most other modern modpacks come bundled with dozens of extra, unwanted configurations and tweaks. This project is built specifically for players who want a standalone, direct, and lightweight OptiFine experience on Fabric without any extra fluff.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Saf OptiFine Deneyimi

Bu mod paketi tamamen "Optifine" özelliklerine odaklanmak için tasarlandı. Diğer OptiFabric mod paketlerinde eksik olan veya fazladan eklenen özellikleri temizler; gereksiz hiçbir şey yok. Saf "Optifine" Gücü.

## Özellikler
* Saf Performans: Kesinlikle sadece OptiFine ve OptiFabric özelliklerine odaklanır.
* Gereksiz Eklenti Yok: Sıfır gereksiz veya fazla mod içerir.
* Vanilla Dostu: Maksimum OptiFine gücü sağlarken oyunun orijinal halini korur.

## Test Sonuçları
* Varsayılan Vanilla Minecraft: ~355 FPS
* Bu Mod Paketi İle: ~805 FPS

## Testlerde Kullanılan Sistem Özellikleri
* İşlemci (CPU): Intel Core i5-12400F (12. Nesil)

* Ekran Çözünürlüğü: 1600x901
* Java Sürümü: 25.0.2
* Grafik Sürücüsü: NVIDIA 591.74 (OpenGL 3.3.0)

## Neden Bu Mod Paketini Seçmelisiniz?
Diğer modern mod paketlerinin çoğu, istemediğiniz düzinelerce ekstra ayar ve modla birlikte gelir. Bu proje, Fabric üzerinde hiçbir fazlalık olmadan, sadece tek başına ve hafif bir OptiFine deneyimi isteyen oyuncular için özel olarak yapılmıştır.

title: Asyl Craft
description: A simple client side only modpack with great performance and utilitys.
body:
## ✨ Overview

This is a Fabric 1.21.10 client-side modpack built for players who want a smoother, cleaner, and more immersive Minecraft experience—without changing vanilla gameplay. Every mod included is fully client-only, meaning it works on almost any server with no setup required.

The goal of this pack is simple:
Better performance. Better visuals. Better utility. Vanilla gameplay.

### 🚀 Performance & Optimisation

This modpack includes a curated set of optimisation mods that significantly improve performance across the board:

Faster chunk loading & world generation

Higher and more stable FPS

Better memory usage and reduced stuttering

Smarter rendering and culling

Improved networking and packet handling

From rendering to redstone to chunk management, nearly every part of the game runs smoother and more efficiently.

### 🎨 Visual & Audio Enhancements

Enjoy a more immersive world without drifting away from the vanilla style:

Support for shaders (Iris included)

Optional high-quality shader presets bundled in

Better connected textures and smoother block models

Enhanced entity textures, models, and animations

Lightweight particle and environment improvements

More immersive footsteps and ambient sounds

Visual upgrades remain subtle and performance-friendly, with everything fully configurable.

title: Stackable Absorption Hearts
description: A datapack that lets you increase the level of the Absorption effect by eating multiple Golden Apples
body:
This Datapack makes it so eating multiple Golden Apples or Enchanted Golden Apples increases the level of the Absorption effect (yellow hearts), instead of only resetting its duration.

![The image shows the player with 18 hearts of Absorption, which is the result of eating two enchanted golden apples and a normal Golden Apple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd694612959af4ceea84ef5be8f32ec7cd84bc12.png)

This means eating two Golden Apples back to back will give you 4 extra hearts for the next 120 seconds. If you eat another Golden Apple before the duration is up, the hearts will be increased by another two and the duration will reset back to 120 seconds.

There is three versions of this datapack:
- Gradual Decrease: The stack of hearts currently active slowly decreases by 2 hearts ever 120 seconds. Personally I recommend this version!
- Instant Decay: The stack of hearts is removed all at once as soon as the 120s of duration are up
- No Stacking: The stack of hearts decreases by 2 hearts every 2 minutes. However eating multiple golden apples will NOT increase the absorption level

Additional information
- A normal Golden Apple will add 2 hearts
- An Enchanted Golden Apple will add 8 hearts
- By default, the maximum amount of hearts you can gain is 200. This value can be adjusted in the "data/stacking_golden_apples/fuction/apply_stacked_effect.mcfunction" file

**Installation**: This datapack is installed like all other datapacks. A tutorial on how to do that can be found [here on the wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tutorial:Installing_a_data_pack).

**Bugs**: If you find any bugs with this datapack, please open a new issue [here](https://github.com/MordorsElite/StackingAbsorptionHearts/issues)

title: Unbreaka-tools
description: Tired of your tools/armour breaking? Let's change that!
body:
I've recently played minecraft with the [Enchancement](https://modrinth.com/project/6hN1V6wJ) mod and fell in love with the ability to have tools that never break!

But! I've had problems including the mod into modpacks ­— either because of incompatibility or just mod loader issues — especially in versions of 1.21.1, and yet I wanted eternal tools.

So I decided to make a simple datapack that adds the `minecraft:unbreakable` component to all items in your hand, offhand and armor slots whenever some item changes durability.

I've tested it in 1.21.1, 1.21.5 and 26.1.2, but I imagine that any other version within that range will work!

If there is any item that is loosing durability and the datapack is not adding the `minecraft:unbreakable` component — like items on trinkets/curios/accessories slots — then just put that item on your offhand and cause any item on your mainhand to loose durability.

title: Debloat
description: Cleans up unnecessary items and loot tables to reduce inventory clutter
body:
Minecraft's item roster has expanded dramatically over time. Many mods try to keep up with more slots and storage items, but **Debloat** makes inventory-conscious tweaks to loot tables, recipes, and worldgen to keep your inventory free of junk in the first place! ## What does this mod do? Debloat's philosophy is that players should **opt-in** to the items they want to pick up — so it makes many foliage and variant blocks, like those associated with Lush Caves or Nether forests, **require a correct tool** to drop so they won't clutter the inventories of players who don't want them. Secondly, it **cleans up underground worldgen** by, for example, reducing the generation of some stone variants and limiting the depth Dirt and Gravel blobs can spawn at, while adjusting recipes to make sure these resources are still available abundantly if desired. Finally, it **merges items with the same functionality** — for example, Steak and Pork Chops — so they don't occupy separate slots in the inventory. These changes have been made very carefully to avoid affecting vanilla balance while cutting down on the most annoying 'bloat' items and making Minecraft's inventory system more elegant. I hope it can be a valuable addition to your personal suite of inventory solutions! _Your inventory during a mining trip **before** and **after** Debloat_ ## All Current Changes: - Signs and Hanging Signs merged into 1 item - placement is directional - Tall Grass only drops Seeds when broken with Hoe - Azaleas and Dripleaf only drop when broken with Hoe, Shears, or Silk Touch - Nether Wart and Warped Wart Blocks only drop when broken with Hoe - Crimson and Warped Roots only drop when broken with Shears - Poisonous Potatoes removed from potato loot tables - Rabbit Hide removed - replaced with Leather - Beef, Pork, and Mutton merged into a generic 'flank' item - Chicken and Rabbit merged into a generic 'haunch' item - Leaves won't drop sticks unless broken with Fortune - Cracked brick blocks crumble without Silk Touch - Mossy blocks will be scraped clean without Silk Touch - Amethyst Blocks shatter into Amethyst Shards without Silk Touch - Andesite, Diorite, and Granite removed from worldgen - Stone variants craftable with Calcite/Quartz at a 1:8 ratio - Underground dirt blobs removed below y=40 - Underground gravel blobs removed below y=0 - Geodes generate with Tuff instead of the unique Smooth Basalt - All recipes using nuggets fairly converted to full ingots - Nether Gold Ore and Gilded Blackstone drop 0-1 Raw Gold instead of 3-6 Gold Nuggets - Piglins drop 0-1 additional Gold Ingots with a 1/9 chance - Smelting down used gear returns a full ingot - excluding shovels - Clay Balls removed - Flower Pots and Bricks craftable with Terracotta for 4x output
## You Should Know Because Debloat removes some vanilla ingredients, many modded recipes will become inaccessible until they are adjusted. I do hope to eventually add support for go-to mods like Supplementaries and Create, but until then, Debloat is intended primarily for 'vanilla+' contexts. ## FAQ **You removed nuggets?!?** Yes! They may have made sense at the time they were added, but given the amount of strain players' inventory space is already under, yet another intermediary crafting component isn't justified. Trust me — vanilla recipes and loot tables can be made almost exactly the same cost with just ingots! There is absolutely no dire need for a 'nugget' item. **You removed chicken/mutton/rabbit/pork?** Yes! I cannot think of a single reason for Minecraft to distinguish every type of meat! Steak/Porkchops and Chicken/Rabbit are mechanically *identical* items. The only effect of merging these meat types is allowing them to stack in the inventory. **You removed Andesite/Diorite/Granite???** No!!! They are still in the game! They just don't spawn naturally, but they can be crafted more cheaply than ever with either Quartz or Calcite, making them available pre-Nether. If you want them, they're there. If not, they won't bother you. ## What Else Can I Do to Improve Minecraft's Inventory? [Terrastorage](https://modrinth.com/mod/terrastorage) is the best implementation of quick-stacking available. [TrashSlot](https://modrinth.com/mod/trashslot) and [InvMove](https://modrinth.com/mod/invmove) are simple changes that drastically improve the experience of using the inventory screen — please check out all of them. Thanks for checking out my silly little mod >^•w•^<

title: Drop Stacker
description: Fabric mod for Minecraft that automatically merges dropped item entities on the ground into stacked entities — reducing item lag on servers and singleplayer worlds. Configurable stack size, scan radius, and scan interval.
body:
# Drop Stacker

A Fabric mod for Minecraft that automatically stacks dropped item entities on the ground into a single entity, reducing entity lag and keeping your world tidy.

## Features

- Dropped items of the same type and NBT automatically merge within a configurable radius
- Stacks beyond vanilla's 64-item limit — up to your configured `maxStackSize`
- Colorful stack count label displayed above items:
  - 🟢 Green — 64 or below
  - 🟡 Yellow — 65 to 500
  - 🔴 Red — above 500
- Optional despawn countdown timer on the label:
  - 🟢 Green — plenty of time remaining
  - 🟡 Yellow — under 2 minutes
  - 🔴 Red — under 30 seconds
- Server-side merge logic only, no client-side desync
- New config fields are added automatically on server restart — no manual editing needed

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1.2
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) 0.19.1+
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)
- Java 25+

## Configuration

Config file is created automatically at `.minecraft/config/drop-stacker.json` on first launch:

```json
{
  "maxStackSize": 1000,
  "scanRadiusX": 5.0,
  "scanRadiusY": 2.0,
  "scanRadiusZ": 5.0,
  "scanInterval": 5,
  "showDespawnTimer": true
}
```

| Field | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `maxStackSize` | Maximum items per stacked entity | `1000` |
| `scanRadiusX` | Scan radius on X axis (blocks) | `5.0` |
| `scanRadiusY` | Scan radius on Y axis (blocks) | `2.0` |
| `scanRadiusZ` | Scan radius on Z axis (blocks) | `5.0` |
| `scanInterval` | Ticks between each scan | `5` |
| `showDespawnTimer` | Show despawn countdown on the label | `true` |

## Building

```bash
./gradlew build
```

Output JAR is in `build/libs/`.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

---

> [!CAUTION]
> I am not great at Kotlin and this project was built with AI assistance. There may be bad code, wrong patterns, or things that could be done much better. If you spot anything — **please open an issue or a pull request**. I genuinely appreciate it and will learn from it. Thank you.

# Mountain Toolkit: Scroll Control

**Scroll Control** is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod for **Minecraft 1.21.11** that makes scrolling feel more precise, flexible, and consistent across hotbar navigation and long item tooltips.

## Features

### Hotbar Navigation
- **Hotbar Left / Right Keybinds**
  - Scroll hotbar left by 1 slot
  - Scroll hotbar right by 1 slot

### Scrolling Options
- **Disable Scrolling** *(default: off)*
  - Disables hotbar scrolling behavior
- **Reverse Scroll Direction** *(default: off)*
  - Inverts scroll direction for hotbar actions
- **Prevent Overflow Scrolling** *(default: off)*
  - Prevents wrap-around between slot 1 and slot 9
- **CTRL Fast Scroll x4** *(default: off)*
  - Hold **CTRL** to scroll 4x faster when enabled

### Tooltip Controls
- **Scrollable Tooltips** *(default: on)*
  - Mouse wheel: scroll tooltip up/down
  - **Shift + mouse wheel**: scroll tooltip left/right
  - Activates when tooltip content is too large to fit on screen

## Compatibility
- **Mod Menu compatible** for easy in-game configuration
- **Client-side only** (no server installation required)

A feature-rich Minecraft Fabric mod that provides advanced teleportation capabilities, including homes, warps, spawn teleportation, and a `/back` command to return to previous locations.

## ✨ Features

### 🏠 Home System
- Set multiple home locations (up to 10 per player)
- Teleport to any of your saved homes
- Easy home management with list, set, and delete commands
- Tab completion for home names

### 🌟 Warp System
- Create public or private warp points (up to 254 per player)
- Public warps are accessible to all players
- Private warps are only accessible to their creator
- Tab completion for warp names
- Ownership validation for warp deletion

### 🔙 Back Command
- Return to your previous location after teleporting
- Works with spawn, home, and warp teleporting
- Returns to death location after dying
- Supports "ping-pong" teleportation between two locations

### 🏔️ Spawn Teleportation
- Quick teleportation to Overworld spawn

### 🎨 Visual & Audio Effects
- Beautiful particle effects on departure and arrival
- Portal particles with enchantment sparkles
- Immersive sound effects

### 🛡️ Safety Features
- Safe location finding with 3-block search radius
- Cross-dimension validation and support
- Input validation for home/warp names (alphanumeric, 1-32 characters)
- Automatic cleanup of player data on disconnect
- Protection against invalid world references

# 📋 Commands

### Home Commands
- `/home <name>` - Teleport to a saved home
- `/setHome <name>` - Set a home at your current location
- `/delHome <name>` - Delete a saved home
- `/homes` - List all your saved homes

### Warp Commands
- `/warp <name>` - Teleport to a warp point
- `/setWarp <name> <true|false>` - Create a warp (true = private, false = public)
- `/delWarp <name>` - Delete one of your warp points

### Other Commands
- `/spawn` - Teleport to Overworld spawn (works from any dimension)
- `/back` - Return to your previous location or death point

## 🎮 Tab Completion

All commands support intelligent tab completion:
- `/home` - Shows your homes
- `/delHome` - Shows your homes
- `/warp` - Shows all accessible warps (public + your private)
- `/delWarp` - Shows only your warps
- `/setWarp <name>` - Suggests `true` or `false` for privacy setting

title: Enwithered
description: Restrict Biomes by a timer system that will wither or kill  if you stay too long in it
body:
### Enwithered

Enwithered adds a new survival twist to Minecraft inspired by Enschrouded: certain places (like specific biomes or heights in the world) become dangerous if you stay there too long. A timer starts when you enter one of these risky areas. If you don’t leave in time, the environment “overwhelms” you — either knocking you out quickly or wearing you down bit by bit.

### What it feels like in game
- You wander into a restricted biome or climb too high/low.
- A timer quietly starts. You’ll get clear warnings (HUD cues and visual effects) so you know you’re on the clock.
- Leave the area before the timer runs out to stay safe.
- Stay too long and you’ll be defeated — instantly or gradually, depending on the settings.

### Why it’s fun
- Adds tension and route‑planning: dash in for loot, then get out before time’s up.
- Great for challenge worlds, speedruns, or cooperative “in‑and‑out” expeditions.

### Key features
- Area limits by place: Specific biomes can be marked as risky.
- Area limits by height: Going too high or too deep can trigger the timer.
- Clear feedback: On‑screen hints and atmosphere changes help you track your remaining time.
- Two danger styles: Quick defeat (instant) or slow drain (over time).
- Customizable: Server or world owners can tweak which places are risky and how the timer behaves.

### Customization (for world/server owners)
- You can configure which biomes or height ranges are restricted.
- Choose how fast the danger ramps up and whether defeat is instant or gradual.
- Adjust visuals and HUD cues to match your preferred level of urgency.

title: Starfall - The End Expansion
description: Completely transforms and overhauls the End dimension, creating an ethereal new world of mystery and beauty to explore.
body:
![Starfall](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05258465c9dbaef120ee8ebf19591fb0337f741e.png)

**Explore a reimagined End dimension filled with ethereal and magical biomes. Adventure across new lands, parkour around mini islands, create epic builds with the new blocks, and much more.**

## **About:**

Starfall fully overhauls and reimagines the vanilla End dimension and creates a brand new world to explore, with vanilla-friendly features and game mechanics that blend into the End dimension better than ever before. Unlike other end-upgrading mods, this one keeps the original End islands generation - but layers amazing and ethereal new biomes over them, changing the generation for each seperate landscape. Explore the rolling hills of the Ethereal Meadows, wander around a Hollow Grove to build with new wood types. Parkour around the Shattered Isles, explore four new structures for unique loot (and unique traps), or ride on a floating Leviathan to fight an army of Phantom Wisps!

## **Features:**

- 21 new blocks
- 4 new mobs
- 5 new biomes
- 4 new structures
- 14 new items

## **New Mechanics:**

 - Who needs Happy Ghasts? Older versions get a buff with huge floating Leviathans! If you can       find one, consider yourself lucky! They don't show themselves often.
- Ghost blocks are finally in vanilla! Kill Phantom Wisps to get a block of Phantom Crystals, which have no hitboxes! You can make secret entrances or parkour challenges with these new blocks.
- New light sources! Kill an Ender Beetle (you monster! They're so cute!) to get a Beetlelight, a new purple lamp to light up your bases. For a less agressive solution, mine a floating chunk of Stardust blocks and combine them with torches, and you'll have yourself a Star Lamp, a white, rocky material that emits strong light. These can also be found in the new structures! Speaking of which...
- Better loot than ever in the brand new structures! Find Luminite crystals, diamonds, smithing templates, netherite ingots, and more. You can also find some books that may have some clues about the mysterious story of the mod...
- New armour, tools and weapons! Luminite is now the strongest material in the game, and can be upgraded from diamond armour using a smithing table and new template. It can be found in large deposits scattered around the dimension, but you'll need to find a lot of it before you can make pristine crystals and upgrade your gear!  

## **Credits:**

Made entirely by FoxiMakesMods! (Subscribe to my youtube at @FoxiPlaysMinecraft!)
Created using MCreator!

title: Inventorio Fixes
description: A dirty collection of patches for the mod Inventorio targeting mod support
body:
# Inventorio… fixes?

Made specifically for the [Hardrock TerraFirmaCraft 3](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/terrafirmacraft-hardrock) modpack!

This project exists as a separate mod due to the 1.18.2 version of Inventorio no longer receiving updates, and as such Inventorio no longer accepting pull requests. I also don't really trust myself to write reliable code yet, so making my own mod is lower stakes >.<

Please support Lizard of Oz, the original creator of Inventorio, and RubixDev, the current maintainer! You can find the modrinth page for the mod [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventorio).

## List of patches:

### Inventorio:
*   Fix an edge case where the incorrect main hand may be targeted when creating or deleting an item when a tool is active (this should hopefully fix a good chunk of dupe exploits)
*   Fix incorrect mining speed being used when a tool is selected in the hotbar while another tool from a tool slot is active
*   Fix Inventorio slots not syncing on the client correctly when changing dimensions
*   Make items within the active tool popup dynamically update the item being used, instead of keeping a static cache! This, for example, makes it so that when the tool loses durability, the displayed item will also reflect that.
*   Make the temporary tool slot popup a little more responsive
*   Add extra convenience keybinds for explicitly opening a vanilla inventory, explicitly opening an Inventorio inventory, and changing the currently open inventory without having to reach your mouse to the switch in the top-right corner

The rest are "optional" and are only loaded when the matching mod is present:

### TerraFirmaCraft:
*   Fix Inventorio slots not respecting item stack sizes in some cases
*   Make Inventorio slots count for overburdening effects
*   Make the Stack Food keybind work in the Inventorio inventory

### Create Stuff 'N Additions:
*   Fix dropping an item applying a blank NBT tag to your offhand item, preventing it from stacking with other items of the same type (this is technically not caused by Inventorio but I still really needed to fix this :p)

### Tinkers' Construct:
*   Make the Soulbound modifier work for items that are in an Inventorio slot

### Hardcore Revival:
*   Make the "Press E to die" prompt work with the Inventorio inventory and not just the vanilla one

## Usage in modpacks

Go ahead! :D  
Though, as this mod depends on Inventorio, please give a careful read to Inventorio's terms first: [https://github.com/RubixDev/Inventorio#use-in-modpacks-and-with-other-mods](https://github.com/RubixDev/Inventorio#use-in-modpacks-and-with-other-mods)

** Still under developement**

**Simply Create & Chill is a lightweight but content-rich modpack centered around the ingenuity of the Create mod, expanded with thoughtful additions to make your world feel more alive, immersive, and fun. This isn’t a bloated tech pack or a fantasy overhaul – it’s a carefully curated experience that retains the feel of vanilla Minecraft, while giving builders, engineers, and adventurers the tools they’ve always wished for. From lush biomes and delicious food to mechanical marvels and visual polish, this pack empowers you to build better, play deeper, and explore further – solo or with friends.**

## ⚡Performance
Simply Create & Chill runs great, even on modest setups. With Sodium, FerriteCore, and other optimization tools, performance stays smooth and stable. You can build big contraptions or play with friends without worrying about lag or crashes.

## ⚙️Gameplay
The Create mod is the star, letting you build complex machines and beautiful structures. It’s supported by food, farming, decoration, and utility mods that expand your options without overwhelming the vanilla experience.

## 🏔️World Generation
The world feels handcrafted thanks to subtle worldgen enhancements. Rolling hills, natural forests, and immersive terrain create the perfect backdrop for exploration and building – without cluttering the map.

## 📶Multiplayer
Play with friends effortlessly. Voice chat, map sharing, and land protection make multiplayer smooth and intuitive. Build, automate, or explore together with zero hassle.

## ✨Visuals and Polish
Visual mods like Continuity, Clean Swing, and shader support bring subtle polish without changing Minecraft’s core style. The game looks sharper, cleaner, and more immersive – just the way it should.

## 🔮Philosophy
This pack expands Minecraft without replacing it. Every mod was chosen to enhance creativity and charm, not bury it under complexity. If you love Create and want a balanced, beautiful world – this is for you.

**Disclamer**: This mod is still in the beta stage, please join the discord if you encounter any issues that aren't mentioned here
![purple thang](https://i.imgur.com/sQrJK7P.png)
This mod adds a bunch of new guns to the game, all in a 2D art style that fits right in with the base game's look. Weapons are split into tiers, so you’ll start with older, simpler firearms and unlock more modern gear as you progress. It’s built to feel balanced and rewarding, whether you’re just surviving or diving deep into exploration.

One cool feature is the Dummy Gun System—it helps make the weapons work with mobs and other mods like MineColonies, so your NPCs and enemies can use them too. Just a heads-up: the mod’s still in beta, so expect bugs here and there. I’ve got a lot of updates planned, and I’m open to feedback and suggestions—especially for fixing bugs or adding features you’d like to see!
![purple thang](https://i.imgur.com/sQrJK7P.png)
Usage:


Just hit R to reload if you have the appropriate ammo for it. What ammo goes to which gun will be explained further in a futire update but in short:

pistols use pistol ammo (except for tier 1)
mid range infantry uses 

![purple thang](https://i.imgur.com/sQrJK7P.png)
 FAQ:


Q. What is the tier system?

A. To make it fit with survival playthroughs I locked the later guns behind an uncraftible part called the "Tier 2 Body" and "Tier 3 Body". As of now the tier 2 body is found in chests and the weaponsmith villager's trades and tier 3 need to be implamented still



Q. How to I give my gun to an npc like the Minecolonists?

A. The gun should convert automatically for the npc but if you ever want to switch them back and forth type /dummygun to pull up the gui



Q. What is a dummy gun?

A. The tldr is that minecraft has something I couldn't change to get mobs to hold them so theyre basicaly just reskinned bows. If I'm  being honest this is mainly just for role playing because it was impossible to have them use the normal guns

More Guns (obviously)
Animations  for the player and guns
Implementing the Tier 3 weapons

title: PixelRank
description: A lightweight Minecraft plugin for tracking and displaying leaderboards for mining, building, playtime, and deaths.
body:
# PixelRank: A Lightweight Minecraft Leaderboard Plugin

Fuel competition and encourage player engagement on your Minecraft server with PixelRank, a lightweight plugin that displays leaderboards for various player activities!  

**Track and display rankings in-game for:**

* **Blocks Mined:** See who's unearthed the most resources!
* **Blocks Placed:** Showcase your server's master builders!
* **Time Played:** Reward your most dedicated players!
* **Deaths (Optional):**  Add a bit of risk (and humor) by tracking player deaths! (Disabled by default)

**Features:**

* **Easy Configuration:**  Simple configuration files let you customize leaderboard settings to your liking.
* **Minimal Performance Impact:**  PixelRank is designed to have a very low impact on server performance, ensuring a smooth gameplay experience. 
* **Customizable Display:** Tailor the look of your leaderboards with configurable refresh intervals and display options.

**Coming Soon:**

*  [ ] More tracked stats! (Suggest your ideas in the Issues tab!)
*  [ ] Support for placeholder APIs for even more customization.

**Installation:**

1. Download the latest release jar file from the [Releases](https://github.com/CodeZhangBorui/PixelRank/releases) page.
2. Place the jar file in your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Start your server.
4. Configure the plugin settings in the `config.yml` file that's generated.
5. Read wiki [Here](https://github.com/CodeZhangBorui/PixelRank/wiki).

**Commands:**

* `/pixelrank rank`: Displays all ranks.
* `/pixelrank reload`: (Permission: OP/`pixelrank.admin`) Reloads the plugin's configuration.

**Bug Reports & Suggestions:**

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Please open an issue on the [Issues](https://github.com/CodeZhangBorui/PixelRank/issues) page.

**License:**

This project is licensed under the [MIT License](https://opensource.org/license/MIT).

description: Chess brought to Minecraft! Features move highlighting, en passant, and castling!
body:
This mod aims to add a nice GUI interface to minecraft for chess logic. In the past I've tried many chess mods that all have similar issues like no castling, no en passant, the king and queen being in the wrong spots, the list goes on. I'm very passionate about chess and I will try as hard as I can to make sure you have NONE of these issues with this mod. This uses a very popular and well written java chess library called "chesslib" by "bhlangonijr" for all move generation and logic.

Currently there's just one block in the mod called "Chess Board" that you can place down and interact with to open the GUI. It randomly selects you to be either black/white and you can't make moves for the other side so for now you're not able to play by yourself, this means you need to have friends to use this mod. I am planning on integrating a basic chess engine in the future but I would like to polish the mechanics as much as possible first.

Development on this project will be slower than my others because this is not my main focus at the moment.

title: TetherMine - Vein Miner
description: Sneak while mining ores or logs, and TetherMine breaks the farthest connected matching block first. The starting block breaks last, drops are delivered to your feet, and modded ores and logs are supported.
body:
![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/87OKjYBF/images/577a0778219cc648037a9a8bda40c5b89105b36f.gif)

TetherMine is a Fabric mod for singleplayer and servers that changes how ores and logs are mined while sneaking.

Sneak while mining an ore or log, and TetherMine will search connected matching blocks, break the farthest one first, and deliver its drops to your feet. Keep mining the starting block to work through the whole vein or tree. The block you started on breaks last.

TetherMine supports diagonal connections, vanilla ores, vanilla logs, raw ore blocks, ancient debris, and many modded ores/logs automatically when they follow common block ID names like _ore, _log, _wood, _stem, or _hyphae.

Server owners and singleplayer users can customize behavior with config/tethermine.json or Mod Menu:


```
{
  "max_scan_blocks": 256,
  "additional_blocks": [
    "minecraft:raw_iron_block = iron_ore",
    "minecraft:raw_gold_block = gold_ore",
    "minecraft:raw_copper_block = copper_ore",
    "minecraft:ancient_debris"
  ],
  "disabled_blocks": []
}
```


max_scan_blocks controls how many connected matching blocks TetherMine checks per mining attempt. The default is 256, which is enough for normal veins and large trees while keeping performance safe.

additional_blocks lets you add blocks that TetherMine should handle. Use block_id = family_key to connect a block to an existing group. For example, minecraft:raw_copper_block = copper_ore makes raw copper blocks mine with copper ore. You can also add a block by itself, like minecraft:ancient_debris, to make it work as its own group.

disabled_blocks lets you turn off specific blocks. For example, adding minecraft:diamond_ore prevents TetherMine from handling regular diamond ore, even though it would normally be detected automatically.

TetherMine is server-side only for multiplayer, so players do not need to install it to join a server that has it.

title: SnakePlayer
description: MOD that allows the player to become a snake
body: # Snake Player ![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2cd84ba8a5021ba1db66cbcd5505b984cf7a8a7f.png) ![image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd590835b4a95ff3f95d66ee26929227b19d6365_0.webp) MOD that allows the player to become a snake. The length of the player snake changes according to XpLevel. The number of segments is XpLevel+1. ## 0\. player NBT | NBT Key |Type |Purpose | | -------------------- |------- |------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | IsSnake |Boolean |Indicates whether the player is in "snake mode." | | SnakeHeadSize |Float |Stores the size of the player's head in snake mode. | | SnakeBodySegmentSize |Float |Represents the size of the player's body segments in snake mode. | | SnakeDamage |Float |Damage an entity suffers when it comes into contact with a player segment | | SnakeSpeed |Float |Determines the automatic movement speed of the player in snake mode. | ## 1\. Command ### 1.0. vanilla You can use vanilla commands to modify the experience. `/experience set @s 100 levels` ### 1.1. `/snake ` - targets: Specifies the player(s) to apply the command to. - DataParameter\_key: Specifies which attribute to modify. The following keys are available: 1. isSnake: A boolean (true or false) that determines whether the targeted player(s) should be in "snake mode." 2. headSize: The size of the snake's head (float, range: 0.1 - 10.0). 3. bodySegmentSize: The size of each body segment (float, range: 0.1 - 10.0). 4. damage: The damage dealt by the snake's body segments (float, range: >= 0). 5. speed: The movement speed of the snake (float, range: 0.0 - 0.75). Effect: Adjusts the corresponding attribute for the targeted players. Each attribute has specific valid ranges, and attempting to set a value outside these ranges will result in an error. ### 1.2.`/snake config [parameters]` Configuration to allow players to respawn avoiding other player positions already present. Find the respawn position by partitioning the rectangular region with one side L centered at cx and cz into a grid with size r. - set: Allows modifying configuration settings related to the snake system. * spread Enables or disables the spread functionality. true: Enables spreading. false: Disables spreading (default spawning). * spread\_pos Sets the spread position's center coordinates. cx: X-coordinate (double) cz: Z-coordinate (double) * spread\_Range Sets the maximum range within which the snake spreads. L: (double, range: 0.1 - 10000.0) * spread\_minimum\_distance Sets the minimum distance between spread entities. r: (double, range: 0.1 - 100.0) * segment\_experience Sets the segment's experience orb. segment\_experience: (int : 0 -) - get : Retrieves the current value of a configuration setting.

title: CC:Gamepad
description: CC: Gamepads adds a CC:Tweaked peripheral block which lets ComputerCraft computers read real gamepad/controller input from players.
body:
CC: Gamepads adds a CC:Tweaked peripheral block which lets ComputerCraft computers read real gamepad/controller input from players.

The controller is read on the player client, sent to the server, and exposed to Lua through a bound Gamepad Peripheral. This works in singleplayer, LAN, and dedicated multiplayer servers.
Requirements

    Minecraft 1.21.1
    NeoForge 21.1.x
    CC:Tweaked 1.117.1

How To Use

    Place a Gamepad Peripheral block next to, or connected by modem to, a CC:Tweaked computer.
    Hold a Gamepad item.
    Sneak-right-click the Gamepad Peripheral with the Gamepad item to bind it.
    Keep the bound Gamepad item in your main hand or off hand.
    Plug in/connect with bluetooth your/a controller and run Lua code on the computer.

Up to 4 players can send input to the same Gamepad Peripheral at once. Each player gets a slot from 1 to 4.
Lua Peripheral

Wrap the peripheral like any other CC:Tweaked peripheral:

local pad = peripheral.find("gamepad")

Functions
getPlayers()

Returns a list of connected controller states.

Each entry includes:

    slot: player slot, 1 to 4
    player: player name
    playerId: player UUID
    controllerId: client controller id
    controllerName: controller name
    guid: controller GUID
    buttons: numbered button table
    buttonNames: named button table
    axes: numbered axis table
    axisNames: named axis table
    updatedAt: server timestamp

getState(slot)

Returns the full state table for one slot.

Throws an error if no controller is bound to that slot.
isDown(slot, button)

Returns true if a numbered button is held.

Buttons:

    A
    B
    X
    Y
    Left bumper
    Right bumper
    Back/select
    Start
    Guide/home
    Left stick
    Right stick
    D-pad up
    D-pad right
    D-pad down
    D-pad left

isButtonDown(slot, name)

Returns true if a named button is held.

Names:

a b x y
leftBumper rightBumper
back select start guide home
leftStick rightStick
dpadUp dpadRight dpadDown dpadLeft

getAxis(slot, axis)

Returns a numbered axis value.

Axes:

    Left X, -1 to 1
    Left Y, -1 to 1
    Right X, -1 to 1
    Right Y, -1 to 1
    Left trigger, 0 to 1
    Right trigger, 0 to 1

getAxisValue(slot, name)

Returns a named axis value.

Names:

leftX leftY rightX rightY leftTrigger rightTrigger

getMaxPlayers()

Returns 4.
getButtonCount()

Returns 15.
getAxisCount()

Returns 6.
Events

When controller state changes, attached computers receive:

cc_events, "gamepad", slot, playerName, controllerId

Example:

local event, kind, slot, player, controllerId = os.pullEvent("cc_events")
if kind == "gamepad" then
  print(player .. " updated slot " .. slot)
end

Example Lua Program

This prints basic state for slot 1 and exits when Start is pressed.

local pad = peripheral.find("gamepad")
if not pad then
  error("No gamepad peripheral found")
end

print("Waiting for gamepad input...")

while true do
  local event, kind, slot, player = os.pullEvent("cc_events")
  if kind == "gamepad" and slot == 1 then
    local lx = pad.getAxisValue(1, "leftX")
    local ly = pad.getAxisValue(1, "leftY")
    local a = pad.isButtonDown(1, "a")
    local b = pad.isButtonDown(1, "b")

    term.clear()
    term.setCursorPos(1, 1)
    print("Player: " .. player)
    print(("Left stick: %.2f %.2f"):format(lx, ly))
    print("A: " .. tostring(a))
    print("B: " .. tostring(b))
    print("Start exits")

    if pad.isButtonDown(1, "start") then
      break
    end
  end
end

Multiplayer Notes

    Controller input is only accepted from the player who sent it.
    The player must be holding a Gamepad item bound to the target peripheral.
    Controller IDs and GUIDs are verified server-side.
    Packet sizes, string lengths, button counts, axis counts, and axis values are validated before the state is accepted.
    Player state is cleared when they disconnect or when their controller list changes.

title: Smart Optimization
description: This mod lowering or enlarge graphic settings based on your FPS
body:
# Smart Optimization

Smart Optimization is an adaptive performance optimization mod for Minecraft that automatically adjusts your graphics settings based on your current FPS.

The mod continuously monitors performance and dynamically applies or restores graphical settings depending on whether your game is running below or above your configured FPS thresholds.

This allows you to keep high-quality visuals most of the time while still ensuring smooth gameplay during heavy performance drops.

> ⚠️ This mod is still in active development. Features may change, and new optimization options will be added over time.

---

## Important stuff

**The update time is the time it takes to change the settings again. If you're not sure what value is the best for your device, then this section would be helpful.**

If you have a low-end PC or laptop and always want to play with a lot of FPS, I recommend setting the update time to a lower value like 30 (seconds)

If you want stable FPS, even if you have a good PC or laptop, I will recommend setting the update time to a higher value like 300 (seconds / 5 minutes).

**You can edit the update time in the chat with this command:
> /smartopt updatetime <seconds>**

_Note: The lowest value you can enter is 20 (seconds). The highest value you can enter is 600 (seconds / 10 minutes)_

---

## How it works

Smart Optimization tracks your average FPS over time.

* If FPS drops below the **low threshold**, the mod gradually reduces performance-heavy settings.
* If FPS rises above the **high threshold**, the mod restores your original settings step by step.

Before making any changes, Smart Optimization saves your original configuration so everything can be restored exactly as it was.

Optimizations are applied gradually in a controlled order to avoid sudden visual changes.

---

## Optimizations include

Depending on configuration, Smart Optimization can adjust the following:

* Entity render distance
* Entity shadows
* Particle effects
* Cloud rendering
* Simulation distance
* Render distance

Each category can be individually enabled or disabled.

---

## Commands

### FPS control

Set the FPS threshold for when optimization starts:

`/smartopt low <fps>`

Set the FPS threshold for when settings are restored:

`/smartopt high <fps>`

Set how often FPS is checked:

`/smartopt updatetime <seconds>`

---

### Configuration system

Enable or disable specific optimizations:

`/smartopt configure <setting> <true/false>`

Available settings:

* entitydistance
* entityshadows
* particles
* clouds
* simulationdistance
* renderdistance

Example:

`/smartopt configure particles false`

This prevents Smart Optimization from modifying particle settings.

---

### Status

View all current settings:

`/smartopt status`

This includes:

* FPS thresholds
* Update interval
* Enabled optimization options

---

## Features

* Adaptive FPS monitoring
* Gradual performance optimization
* Automatic restoration of original settings
* Fully configurable optimization system
* Lightweight client-side design
* No permanent visual changes

---

## Who is this mod for?

Smart Optimization is designed for players who:

* experience FPS drops in specific situations
* want better performance without permanently lowering graphics settings
* play on low-end or mid-range PCs
* use modpacks or heavy worlds
* prefer automatic optimization instead of manual tweaking

---

## Development status

This mod is currently in active development.

More features, optimization options, and configuration controls will be added in future updates.

title: Waterfall Limit
description: A lightweight Minecraft mod that limits the height of natural vertical waterfalls and lavafalls with visual evaporation effects.
body:
# Waterfall

![waterfall and lavafall with Complementary Shaders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1c6ce95b42623dd7f080fe18cd654eda208fed06_0.webp)

A lightweight and performance-friendly Minecraft mod that limits the height of natural waterfalls and lavafalls while adding immersive evaporation effects.

Waterfall prevents endless floating water and lava columns by detecting exposed vertical flows and causing them to dissipate after a configurable height limit. Designed to preserve natural-looking terrain generation without affecting rivers, oceans, canals, lava pools, or most player-built fluid systems.

## Features

* Limit the maximum height of natural waterfalls and lavafalls
* Smart fluid detection that only targets exposed vertical flows
* Vanilla-inspired evaporation and smoke particle effects
* Fully configurable through TOML config
* Multiplayer compatible
* Lightweight and optimized for minimal performance impact
![waterfall vanilla](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8db9a44f819b5d2d0f67f020f565babc16795156_0.webp)
![lavafall vanilla](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3fced5864466399401c155a61427674c13f788eb_0.webp)
## How It Works

The mod detects waterfalls and lavafalls by checking for vertical fluid columns surrounded by air on all four horizontal sides. Once the flow exceeds the configured maximum height, the fluid dissipates and visual particle effects appear.

### Not Affected

* Oceans and rivers
* Lava lakes and pools
* Water or lava touching solid blocks horizontally
* Aqueducts and enclosed fluid channels

## Visual Effects

When a flow reaches its limit, the mod generates immersive particle effects:

* Waterfalls produce cloud and falling water particles
* Lavafalls produce smoke and lava particles

## Configuration

Config file location:

`config/waterfall-common.toml`

```toml
#Enable or disable the mod entirely
enabled = true

[waterfall]
	#Maximum height (in blocks) of a vertical waterfall before it evaporates
	# Default: 12
	# Range: 1 ~ 100
	maxHeight = 12
	#Show cloud/splash particle effects when a waterfall evaporates
	enableEvaporationEffect = true
	#Density of evaporation particles (0.0 = none, 1.0 = maximum)
	# Default: 0.5
	# Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0
	particleDensity = 0.5

[lavafall]
	#Maximum height (in blocks) of a vertical lavafall before it evaporates
	# Default: 12
	# Range: 1 ~ 100
	maxHeight = 12
	#Show smoke/flame particle effects when a lavafall evaporates
	enableEvaporationEffect = true
```

### Default Settings

* Enabled by default
* Maximum flow height: 12 blocks
* Particle effects enabled
* Adjustable particle density

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* NeoForge 21.1.228+
* Java 21

# Craftsman's bows This is a port of an existing mod; originally written for Fabric, this ports it to NeoForge. Credits go to the original author: [Chuzume](https://github.com/Chuzume). Original Repository: https://github.com/Chuzume Original README below: This is a simple and small-scale mod that adds four vanilla-style long-range weapons.
I made this as a mod creation and Java coding practice. ## Items ### Shortbow ![Shortbow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e27a9e28dc3cf56bf69e44ccfd53d24d1d1ad139.png) - Faster charge, shorter range, and less damage - Your movement speed doesn't decrease even while charging the bow, so you can run while ready. - It seems to be good for quick attacks on mid-range enemies, or for keeping enemies at bay. ### Longbow ![Longbow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66eebf9d7dc38896dff08bd5885ba6e26d3a452e.png) - Slower charge, longer range, and more damage. - You will be zoomed in while holding the bow. - It looks like you'll be able to snipe from even further away than with a normal bow. ### Shot Crossbow ![Shot Crossbow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0dca520e6748f1aab5128eefd6df0a44452b3606.png) - A crossbow that fires five arrows at once. - It cannot be fired unless the bow is drawn all the way back. - Fired arrows ignore enemy invincibility frames. - You can't expect much accuracy and the range is short, but it is very powerful at close range. - Although it looks like a crossbow, the enchantments it can apply are bow enchantments. ### Repeater Crossbow ![Repeater Crossbow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/deaf27ffce1aa2f886dc8eeecb865c34e1c83fc9.png) - A crossbow with incredible rapid-fire. - Fired arrows ignore enemy invincibility frames. - When you aim it, it will begin charging, and after a while it will continue firing arrows. - Once charging is complete, you will be unable to move at all. - It is awful to use, and it uses a lot of arrows, but it has incredible destructive power. - Although it looks like a crossbow, the enchantments it can apply are bow enchantments. ## Used assets Sounds in the "erdie" folder: by [Erdie](https://freesound.org/people/Erdie/) ## Modpack If you want to use this mod in a modpack, please let me know.
