title: JJK Status Viewer
description: This feature displays information such as the probability of a black flash, the amount of cursed energy, and the spell formula during combat, and also allows the use of macros such as automatic guarding.
body:
# JJK Status

## English Version

**JJK Status** is a utility mod designed to enhance your experience with the **Jujutsu Craft (Gojo Satoru Mod)**. It provides a highly customizable HUD that displays essential combat information and includes various automation features to assist players in intense battles.

### 🌟 Key Features

#### 1. Advanced Status Overlay (HUD)
Monitor critical information in real-time without opening menus:
*   **Target Info:** Displays the name and HP of the entity you are looking at.
*   **Effective HP (EHP):** Calculates your actual durability by factoring in damage reduction from Domain Amplification, Simple Domain, and Resistance effects.
*   **Black Flash Probability:** Real-time calculation of your Black Flash chance based on your current state (ZONE, Deep Concentration, combos, health, etc.).
*   **Buff & Cooldown Trackers:** Shows the status of Domain Amplification, Simple Domain, and Guard, including precise cooldown timers.
*   **Technique Info:** Displays whether your Cursed Technique is currently usable and identifies the selected technique name.
*   **Cursed Energy Estimation:** Predicts the time remaining until your Cursed Energy is fully recovered.

#### 2. Powerful Automation (Toggleable)
Streamline your combat with configurable automatic functions:
*   **Auto Guard:** Automatically activates Guard when an entity is within a specified radius.
*   **Auto Domain Amplification:** Automatically toggles Domain Amplification during combat.
*   **Auto Reverse Cursed Technique (RCT):** Automatically manages RCT based on your health. You can set specific HP percentages for starting and stopping the technique.

#### 3. High Customizability
*   **GUI Configuration:** Access a dedicated settings screen to toggle any HUD element or feature.
*   **UI Positioning:** Full control over the HUD position with a simple drag-and-drop adjustment screen.

### 🛠 Requirements
*   **Minecraft Forge**
*   **[Jujutsu Craft (Sorcery Fight)](https://modrinth.com/mod/orca-jujutsu-craft)** (Variable & Effect dependency)

---

## 日本語版 (Japanese Version)

**JJK Status** は、**Jujutsu Craft (Gojo Satoru Mod)** のプレイをより快適かつ戦略的にするためのユーティリティModです。戦闘に必要な情報をリアルタイムで表示する高度なHUD（オーバーレイ）機能と、プレイヤーをサポートする各種自動化機能を提供します。

### 🌟 主な機能

#### 1. 高度なステータスオーバーレイ (HUD)
メニューを開かずに、重要な情報を常に把握できます。
*   **ターゲット情報:** 視線の先にいるエンティティの名前とHPを表示します。
*   **実質HP (EHP):** 領域展延、簡易領域、耐性などの軽減効果を加味した、実際の耐久値を算出して表示します。
*   **黒閃確率:** ZONE状態、深い集中、コンボ数、体力状況などから、現在の黒閃発生確率をリアルタイムで計算します。
*   **バフ・クールダウン管理:** 領域展延、簡易領域、ガードの発動状況と、再使用までの残り時間を秒単位で表示します。
*   **術式情報:** 術式が使用可能かどうか（焼き切れ状態など）や、現在選択中の技名を表示します。
*   **呪力回復予測:** 現在の回復速度から、呪力が全回復するまでの残り時間を予測します。

#### 2. 強力な自動化機能 (ON/OFF設定可能)
戦闘中の操作をサポートする便利な自動機能を搭載しています。
*   **自動ガード:** 設定した範囲内に敵を検知すると、自動的にガードを試みます。
*   **自動領域展延:** 敵との接近時に自動で領域展延を展開します。
*   **自動反転術式 (RCT):** 体力が一定以下になると自動で反転術式を開始し、設定した体力まで回復すると自動で停止します。

#### 3. 高いカスタマイズ性
*   **設定画面:** 専用のGUIから、各項目の表示/非表示や自動機能の挙動を簡単に変更できます。
*   **位置調整機能:** HUDの表示位置をドラッグ＆ドロップで自由に変更可能です。

### 🛠 必要要件
*   **Minecraft Forge**
*   **[Jujutsu Craft (Sorcery Fight)](https://modrinth.com/mod/orca-jujutsu-craft)** (本Modの機能はJujutsu Craftの変数やエフェクトに依存しています)

title: No Moon, No Problem
description: Fixes Goety's Necroturgy ritual to work in dimensions where the concept of moon and sun do not apply
body:
The Necroturgy ritual from Goety requires sculk blocks, non-wooden slabs, flower pots, and darkness. A logical restriction, yes. Except that darkness means *nighttime* darkness specifically, and the ritual cannot be performed in dimensions with no skylight.

This mod is a simple mixin which changes that check to be true if the skylight is below a certain value OR if the dimension doesn't have skylight. Nether and Ender necromancers for the win.

Yes, I did basically learn Minecraft modding for the express purpose of fixing this one issue I had with Goety. And yes, I know I could've just built a necroturgic altar setup in the Overworld, but I could accept that for the Sky or Storm ritual types. The fact Goety doesn't let you summon undead servants in the dimension filled with skeletons and zombified piglins specifically felt like it needed fixing.

title: Sneaky Creepers
description:
Creepers disguise as farm animals - Including Spring to Life variants! 

ETF+EMF Required
body:
[![A button to join vevetable's Discord server](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/061b7cfc70a1d7daa274911fd63a32c5b940b95c.png)](https://discord.com/invite/qDpgxvHH5n)

![Before, four regular creepers. After, four different farm animals (chicken, cow, pig, sheep).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de9543d9c6060258c82b1a0ec0c1369c430a10aa.jpeg)

## Description


**Welcome a challenge?**

This resource pack makes creepers disguise as farm animals when they spawn on _non-stone blocks_, this means you'll still find normal creepers in caves and in certain biomes that don't spawn farm animals.

Certain biomes only spawn one or two different farm animals, and creepers know! For example: in meadows, creepers will always be sheep! 

They will also blend in with the **warm and cold variants** using their respective biome tags! (only 1.21.5+)


## Compatabilities


- Warm and cold variants spawn correctly in the bigger biome mods such as **Biomes O' Plenty**, and **Oh the Biomes We've/You've Gone**. Untested in any other biome mods but it should work as long as the mod uses biome tags correctly.

- Unfortunately, **Fresh Animations** overrides this entire pack, Fresh Creepers and Sneaky Creepers _do not mix_.

- This pack will detect if the client is on 1.21.5 or higher to spawn warm and cold variants, you won't see mob variants if you're playing before the Spring to Life update, despite any installed backport mods.

- Ensure **EMF** and **ETF** are both installed _and_ updated, it _won't_ work on older versions of **EMF** or **ETF**!

title: TradeChanger
description: Advanced Villager Trade editor with GUI. Customize prices, currency, chances, and enchantments ingame!
body:
# 💎 TradeChange
**TradeChange** is a powerful and easy-to-use plugin for server administrators that allows you to fully control the economy of your residents. Forget about complicated manual configurations — set everything up through a convenient menu right in the game!

## 🔥 Key Features

* **🖥️ Convenient GUI:** Edit trades for all 13 professions through an intuitive interface.
* **💰 Dynamic prices:** Set a price range (for example, `10-20`). Residents will have a random but stable price within this range.
* **💎 Custom currency:** Tired of emeralds? Make residents trade for **Deep Slate Diamond Ore**, Gold, or any other item!
* **🎲 Chance control:** You decide the probability of an item appearing (from 0% to 100%).
* **📚 Full enchantment support:** Separate price settings for each book (Mending, Sharpness, etc.) in the Librarian.
* **🔄 Updating existing residents:** The plugin automatically updates trades even for old residents when interacting.
* **🏷️ Discount support:** The “Village Hero” and zombie healing mechanics continue to work on top of your base prices.

## ⚙️ How to use?

1.  Enter the command **/tradechange** to open the menu.

![Open Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2369d8b0bfd98cf6b4dc6c616418ed054c1dd6c9.png)

2.  Select the profession and item you want to change.
3.  Follow the instructions in the chat:
* Enter the price range (for example: `12-24`).
    * Select the currency (`1` - Emerald, `2` - Ore/Other).
* Set the appearance chance (`100` for guaranteed appearance)
4.  Done! All new and existing residents will use your settings.

## 📜 Commands and permissions

* `/tradechange` — Open the main settings menu.
* `/tradechange reload` — Reload the configuration.
* **Permission:** `tradechange.admin` (to use all features).

title: Crave & Feast
description: Reworks hunger to reward food diversity. Crave one food for double nutrition; overeating reduces gains.
body:
🥐 Crave & Feast

Make food diversity finally matter.

Crave & Feast redesigns Minecraft’s hunger system to reward variety and discourage repetition.

![Craving Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef2915bd12a591555ee57fdd62c421b6ad84c375.png)

Each player has one food they crave.
Eating that food gives 2× hunger and saturation,
while eating the same thing repeatedly provides reduced benefits.
This makes survival gameplay more balanced and flavorful — no more living on steak forever.

![Craving food](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58c3b5bcfaaa150850cb9af738644add3dc2d678.png)
![Never eaten](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1af1c125762794da42dd84b86c48c301727da2c.png)
![Rarely eaten](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/481d1f379eb107ea164dfee2d5bde584d4ebffd9.png)
![Often eaten](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b6e8039a9e8b8ea557072ff3a7fc752d647917a.png)

⚙️ Default Gameplay Rules

All values are configurable in config/crave_and_feast.json.
Here’s how the defaults work:

| Rule                            | Condition                               | Multiplier | Meaning                                        |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| 🍗 **Craving food**             | Current craving item                    | × 2.0      | Always gives double nourishment and saturation |
| 🥩 **First time eating a food** | Eaten ≤ 0 times                         | × 2.0      | “Never eaten” — strongest bonus for new foods  |
| 🍞 **Rarely eaten food**        | Eaten ≤ 7 times                         | × 1.4      | Still somewhat rewarding                       |
| 🍖 **Often eaten food**         | Eaten > 7 times                         | × 0.8      | Small penalty — you’re getting used to it           |
| ⏳ **Craving change interval**   | Every 24 000 ticks (≈ 20 min real-time) | —          | Your craving rotates automatically             |
| 🍴 **Craving limit per round**  | After 8 times eating the same craving   | —          | A new craving will be chosen early             |
| 📜 **Food history length**      | 32 entries                              | —          | Only the most recent 32 foods are remembered   |

HUD defaults:
- Position = (hudX: 10, hudY: 10)
- Shows your current craving icon and name

🧩 Features

- Dynamic craving system that changes automatically
- Diminishing returns for repetitive foods
- Simple HUD indicator showing your craving
- Fully configurable multipliers, timing, and history length
- Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer

✅ Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21.10
- Requires Fabric API
- Lightweight, safe to add or remove mid-save

title: Better Cave Sounds
description: A better cave detector for Minecraft.
body:
# Better Cave Sounds Datapack

**Version:** 1.0
**Author:** Pixelpaw P.
**Minecraft Version:** 1.21.x+

---

## Overview

Better Cave Sounds enhances the natural Minecraft cave ambience to make exploring underground more immersive and useful for cave detection. The datapack plays cave sounds only when you are truly underground, making it a natural "cave detector."

---

## Features

* Plays **ambient cave sounds** when:

  * Standing on **stone** or **deepslate** blocks
  * **Light level = 0** (completely dark)
  * **Y-coordinate < 63** (below sea level)
* Optional: Randomized pitch for a more natural feel
* Only triggers in actual caves, not dark surface areas
* Lightweight, built entirely using **vanilla Minecraft functions**

---

## Installation

1. Download the datapack folder.
2. Place it in your world’s `datapacks` folder:

   ```
   .minecraft/saves/<world_name>/datapacks/
   ```
3. Start your world and run the setup function once:

   ```
   /function better_cave_sounds:setup
   ```
4. The datapack is now active. Sounds will play automatically when exploring caves.

---

## Notes

* Works in **survival and creative modes**.
* The sound only triggers when all conditions are met.
* You can tweak pitch, sound type, or conditions by editing the `.mcfunction` files.

---

## Optional Tweaks

* Surrounding block checks to detect enclosed caves.
* Additional cave-related sounds for variety.
* Adjust Y-coordinate threshold for deeper or shallower cave detection.

# Who is Mellstroy
### Mellstroy is a famous Russian streamer known for his casino streams

## Mellstroy
- Health 20 HP
- Attack Damage 2 HP per hit
- Speed 0.3
- Behavior Neutral until attacked then aggressive

## How to spawn Mellstroy
- Place a gold block
- Stand within 10 blocks of it
- Type in chat three times "What kind of business is this, bitch" in English
or "Что за бизнес, сука" in Russian
- Mellstroy appears on the gold block
- The gold block disappears

## Drop
- 1 MellGem after death

## ITEMS

- MellGem A rare item dropped by Mellstroy
- Used to craft the Slot Machine
- Stacks up to 64

- Hat Grants the Politeness effect when used on the ground near Mellstroy Can also be eaten to apply the effect to yourself
- Stacks up to 16

1. - Slot Machine Symbols
1. - Fruit
1. - Gummy Bear
1. - Dog

- The slot machine can only be used if Mellstroy is near it

## EFFECTS

- Politeness Changes all Mellstroy voice lines to polite versions

- Gambling Addiction (Ludomania)
- How to get: Mellstroy picks up a diamond near you within 8 blocks
- Duration 5 minutes
- Effect 90 percent win chance in the slot machine

## SLOT MACHINE

## Crafting Recipe
- 8 iron blocks around a MellGem MellGem in the center equals 1 Slot Machine

## How to use
- Place the slot machine
- Mellstroy must be within 30 blocks
- Right click to open the interface
- Press the "Start" button
- Wait 3 seconds for the reels to spin
- 2 second delay before result
- Win or lose

## Winning conditions
- All 3 symbols match
- Reward 3 identical items plus 16 diamonds
- Win chance about 11 percent
- With Gambling Addiction 90 percent

## Features
- 30 second cooldown between spins
- Spinning animation
- Independent reel stopping
- No empty slots

### ACHIEVEMENTS

1. "What kind of business is this, bitch" Summon Mellstroy
1. "Mellstroy.game" Obtain MellGem
1. "Dodep" Craft the Slot Machine
1. "40 MILLION" Win in the Slot Machine hard achievement

title: Mining Ball
description: The Mining Ball data pack lets you instantly clear 10 \times 10 areas by throwing snowballs in Minecraft Java 1.16.2 to 1.21+. It replaces tedious digging with a simple, mod-free utility for rapid terraforming and excavation.
body:
# 💥 The Mining Ball: Instant Excavation at Your Fingertips!

Tired of spending hours clearing out land for your mega-base? Say goodbye to broken pickaxes, tedious grinding, and endless block-breaking. Meet your new best friend: **The Mining Ball**.

With this lightweight utility data pack, terraforming and massive excavations are just a throw away!

## 🌟 How It Works
It’s beautifully simple: **Just throw a snowball, and instantly mine a massive 10x10 area.** Whether you are hollowing out a mountain, building a massive underground bunker, or just trying to clear out a perimeter, the Mining Ball does the heavy lifting for you in a fraction of a second. 

## 🛠️ Why You'll Love It
* **Massive Time Saver:** Clear out massive chunks of land instantly. What used to take hours now takes seconds.
* **Builder's Best Friend:** Perfect for flattening terrain or creating massive underground perimeters for your farms and mega-bases.
* **Highly Compatible:** Fully functional across a wide range of versions (1.16.2 all the way up to 1.21+).
* **Easy Install:** It's purely a data pack! Drop it into your world folder and you are ready to go—no complex mod loaders required.

![Jj](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc7f7d71aa756b2d1de712dc84560ce0f9ef5f7d.png)


## ⚠️ Important Performance Note
*With great power comes... a tiny bit of lag!* Because Minecraft is being asked to break hundreds of blocks in a single tick, you will likely experience a short, temporary lag spike right when the snowball lands. **This is completely normal** and is just the game engine processing the massive block updates. Use it wisely, and try not to throw 10 of them at the exact same time! 😉

---

### 💡 Fun Ways to Use the Mining Ball:
1.  **The Instant Strip Mine:** Throw it down toward bedrock to quickly expose hidden caves and resources.
2.  **The Mountain Carver:** Easily hollow out the side of a cliff to build your hidden base.
3.  **Emergency Escape:** Need a quick exit from a horde of zombies? Blast a hole through the wall and run!

---

description: A datapack that recreates the hammer from the Ex Nihilo mod, with a few extra additions.
body:
### Overview If you're familiar with the [Ex Nihilo Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/exnihilosequentia) (now Ex Nihilo Sequentia), you may remember the Hammer that mod added. The Ex Nihlio hammer was able to break down Cobblestone into Gravel, and then into Sand, and then into Dust. Well, _Reg's Hammers_ aims to do just that. You can use this datapack to craft a Hammer for every tier of tool, just like Ex Nihilo.
Instead of breaking Sand into Dust however, Sand will turn into a Clay Ball. Breaking down blocks of Clay will now turn into Coarse Dirt. _Reg's Hammers_ also comes with a few bonus features. You can use hammers to break down blocks such as Stone Bricks and Sandstone into their previous components. So, Stone Bricks will turn into Stone, Sandstone into Sand, Polished Andesite into Andesite, and so on. ### Installation If you're installing the datapack, you'll have to actually click on the datapack page and scroll down to find the resource pack. The next update will put everything together so it's a big zip file. If you're using the modded version, just use Modrinth's Launcher! It's great, handy, and is easy to work with. Otherwise, you can download the .jar file and use it however you need. ### Commands Just like my other projects, admins/moderators can use a custom /give command to obtain the custom hammers. Just use `/function vanillahammers:give_item/(id) {player:'@p',count:1}` to give a player of choice a specific number of hammers. ### Important Notes Please keep in mind these important notes, they may save you some time later! - Many blocks can now be broken down, including Quartz Blocks back into Quartz. A wiki is coming soon with the full list, but if you don't know what you can break, just hammer it! - The hammers are able to act as pickaxes/axes for blocks that require them, but they are not replacements for those tools! Hammers will attempt to break down blocks first and foremost, and will only drop the block itself if it can't. - An example of this would be using it to mine Cobblestone. It can mine it like a pickaxe, but it'll turn into Gravel! - To upgrade a Diamond Hammer into Netherite, **DO NOT USE THE SMITHING TABLE!** Instead, stand _in front_ of the Smithing Table and hold a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template in your offhand while having the Diamond Hammer in your mainhand. Then, ensure you have a Netherite Ingot somewhere in your inventory. Then, press crouch to upgrade it. - Upgrading Diamond Hammers will retain all enchantments, custom names, what have you. It just changes the model and adds some new data like an upgraded durability and resistance to fire. Just like real netherite! - Red Sand has a very small chance of turning into 1-2 Iron Nuggets when broken specifically with a Diamond or Netherite Hammer. This chance increases with Fortune, so if you need Iron you can search for a Mesa biome and go to town. ### Other Information If you want to use this in your modpack, go for it! Just credit me and or this project somewhere if you plan on releasing it so I can get more feedback on how to make this better. Also, you can send me a message in my Discord Server if you have any questions! It's where I have all my other projects anyhow, so you can look at the other ones too if you'd like. All item textures were made by me, sorry if they look bad.

body:

This is a rewritten **server-side** version of [Tp Chat Command](https://modrinth.com/mod/tp-chat-cmd).

This mod provides a command called `/tpchat`. You can use it to send clickable message
to **EVERY ONLINE PLAYER** for teleporting. And it can be used to teleport
between dimensions, e.g., overworld <-> nether.

## Usage 

`tpchat [dimension (Default is current dimension)] [location (Default is current location)] [rotation]`

All parameters are optional. You can add a [text component](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Text_component_format) or a `msg <message>` (like which is in /msg) at the end of your command to customize the text.

body:
Team Abnormals' mods are always great, but a personal grievance I have with them is how bulky some plants you will commonly see are compared to the vanilla ones. This mod shears down the models to be as thin as vanilla ones. 

The Large Tall Grass from Environmental and the Beachgrass from Upgrade Aquatic are the only ones touched so far. This mod will also help with shading issues resulting from the original model and display more of the texture.

In the classic Chinese animated series Calabash Brothers, Butterfly fairy xiaohudie “小蝴蝶” is a character that plays an important figure in the story and represents a kind-hearted fairy, She appears as a quiet and sweet-looking girl. She wears a pink dress with butterfly patterns, adorned with pink butterfly wing scales and yellow inner clothing. Her black hair has purple streaks and blue spots, with yellow flower-like markings near the ends. She has fair skin, large eyes with bright, deep green irises, and cherry red lips. On her head, she wears a light green crown-like accessory with two butterfly antennae, and near her ears, she has spherical decorations resembling pink ear covers (from a distance, they also resemble butterfly eyes). She has a slim figure, and unlike snake demon, who has a snake tail with no legs or feet, she has feet, and wears white socks and brownish-yellow shoes.
![ataeadff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0b0aa6c2cafc01aadea97672f221f3679313759.jpeg)
When she transforms into her original form, she becomes a beautiful large pink butterfly! with pink wings edged in black and decorated with white spots. assists the main characters, the Calabash Brothers; she was kidnapped by the evil Snake Demon and other enemies and forced to become their slave, but one day, Butterfly Sprite Xiaohudie accidentally stained Snake  Demon's treasure bag.

She also accidentally eat the divine elixir of the snake demon for unknown reason, most likely because of hunge. Thus she was reduced to jail for eternity, Her waist is constrained by a magic lock, which can be tightened by the incarceration of a snake demon to torture her, which gives her no way to escape from the control of the snake demon.![Butterfly Sprite xiaohudie image in this mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45b4e4440070f30adf7af323b6d951d9136fbabd.jpeg)

but the Calabash Brothers luckily rescued her in their fight against the evil Snake Demon and other enemies; she added a sense of magic and mystery to the story. Her appearance is cute and exudes a mysterious charm, reflecting her kind and helpful nature in the series; during the battle, she uses her ability to distract the enemies and buy time for the Calabash Brothers, Butterfly fairy xiaohudie meets a tragic end. Unfortunately, to help the Calabash Brothers fight against the Snake Demon, she sacrifices due to the mouse demon's spear being stabbed into her heart; her sacrifice is filled with tragedy, highlighting her kind and selfless character. This ending adds emotional depth to the story, leaving a lasting impression on the audience of her bravery and dedication.
![Butterfly sprite xiaohudie's death](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2734dcd234dca1f07ddebd47983e741a69cfe411.jpeg)

The story that happend on butterfly fairy in sequel:

In the aftermath of Calabash Brothers: Return of the Gourd King, the Butterfly Fairy did not truly perish. Instead, her soul was preserved and nourished by the radiant energies of the Seven-colored Peak, emanated from the combined spirits of the Calabash Brothers. She transcended her origins as a mere妖精(yáo jīng) and evolved into an independent being that bridges the gap between celestial and demonic realms.

Detailed Plot
Rebirth and Awakening

After her sacrifice, the Butterfly Fairy’s soul drifted aimlessly near the Seven-colored Peak, helpless but unwilling to fade away. Her spirit lingered, carried by the mountain breezes. The luminous energy left behind by the Calabash Brothers not only revitalized the land but also shielded her fragile essence. One fateful day, the Mountain God discovered her faint but tenacious spirit and was moved by her unyielding determination. He entrusted her soul to the celestial Weaver Girl.

The Weaver Girl, upon witnessing her resilient yet sorrowful soul, decided to remake the Butterfly Fairy. Using threads spun from the seven radiant colors of the Calabash Brothers, she wove together a new body for the Butterfly Fairy. The threads interwove妖族(yáo zú) agility with celestial purity, birthing a being of unmatched grace and latent power—the "Butterfly Spirit."

Awakening in her new form, the Butterfly Fairy found herself transformed. Her butterfly wings shimmered with celestial brilliance, and her aura radiated an otherworldly glow. Though her appearance remained that of the gentle girl she remembered, the immense power coursing through her felt foreign.

Struggles in the Heavenly Realm

Upon entering the Heavenly Realm, the Butterfly Fairy was captivated by its beauty yet felt constrained by its rigid rules. Her longing for freedom clashed with the strict codes of conduct upheld by the celestials. She was seen as an outsider due to her妖(yáo) heritage, facing prejudice and isolation.

Her internal struggle manifested in her inability to control her newfound powers, leading to an incident where her uncontrolled abilities nearly caused disaster. The celestials considered banishing her to the mortal realm as punishment. However, in her darkest hour, the spirits of the Calabash Brothers appeared to her in a dream. They spoke to her with warmth and encouragement:

“Butterfly Sister, true freedom lies not in escape, but in using your strength to protect what you hold dear.”

Their words reignited her will to persevere. From then on, she dedicated herself to mastering her powers, enduring countless trials, and slowly earning the respect of some celestials.

Breakthrough of Power

After centuries of rigorous training, the Butterfly Fairy awakened her "Butterfly Deity" bloodline, achieving a dramatic surge in strength. She shed her past frailty, becoming a figure of divine grace and unrivaled might.

Charging Attack: This skill symbolizes her liberation from past constraints. A single strike could shatter mountains and chains alike.

Heaven Strike: Harnessing celestial energy, she descends from the skies like a meteor, unleashing devastation upon her enemies.

Photon Blade: This luminous weapon blends妖灵(yáo líng) dexterity with divine sanctity, capable of cutting through the toughest defenses while radiating healing energy.

Through these transformations, she came to understand that power was not merely for destruction but for safeguarding the things she loved.

Return to the Fragrant Valley

Upon completing her celestial training, the Butterfly Fairy longed to return to the Fragrant Valley—the sanctuary of her happiest memories. However, she was heartbroken to find it desolate and barren. The vibrant flowers and lush greenery were gone, replaced by an expanse of lifeless soil. Tears welled in her eyes as she vowed to restore her beloved valley.

Using her newfound powers, she revitalized the land. Her wings stirred gentle breezes that carried seeds across the valley, and droplets of celestial dew nurtured the earth. Her Photon Blade carved the soil, allowing life to bloom anew. Gradually, the Fragrant Valley regained its vibrant beauty, filled with cascading flowers and the sweet scent of renewal.

One serene moonlit night, the Butterfly Fairy encountered the spirit of Calabash King in her dreams.

“Butterfly Sister, have you found your freedom?” he asked, his voice soft and warm.

The Butterfly Fairy smiled, her eyes glistening with gratitude. “Thank you, Big Brother. You taught me that true freedom lies not in escaping, but in the peace within one’s heart. I have found it at last.”

From that moment, she took up the mantle of "Butterfly Deity," dedicating herself to guarding the Fragrant Valley, ensuring it would remain a haven of beauty and peace for generations to come

中文介绍

小蝴蝶是中国剪纸动画片《葫芦小金刚》及其衍生作品中的女性角色，又称蝴蝶小妖精、由一只粉色蝴蝶化为人形。 本是青蛇大王的丫鬟， [被青蛇精利用来迷惑葫芦小金刚， 但喜欢上小金刚后变成了所谓的善良妖精。 

其性格不仅友善温柔，并且重视友情又讲义气，对葫芦小金刚有着崇拜与期待之心， 但曾经为了得到自由，不得不听命于青蛇大王，虽暗助青蛇精使蝙蝠妖偷走葫芦小金刚的吊坠， 但始终没有对小金刚下毒手

曾偷吃青蛇精的仙丹、弄脏青蛇精的百宝锦囊，而被其关押在牢洞内，长久不见天日，并被强行箍上枷锁，腰间被套上青蛇精的法宝魔爪金箍，此物越劈越紧，只有青蛇精可以松开。这导致葫芦小金刚虽然拯救了她行动上的沦陷，但却一直没让小蝴蝶彻底挣脱腰上这副枷锁的束缚。 虽然肉体没能恢复完全的自由，但仍留有变回蝴蝶而飞翔的本能后来还是被青蛇精利用，以恢复自由为诱饵， 因不得已而泄露了小金刚的弱点， 而导致对方被青蛇精夺走法宝而囚禁地牢，好在小蝴蝶奋力协助葫芦小金刚重获吊坠； 就在准备逃亡时，小蝴蝶不幸被青蛇精手下的小妖用飞枪刺中而亡，在临死前向小金刚坦白了自己的心迹，并告知其打败青蛇精的秘密。

这个模组假设蝴蝶仙子小蝴蝶在被长矛穿透后并没有死亡。她曾服用过一种灵丹，这种灵丹的作用类似于不死图腾，还赋予了她巨大的力量，远远超过蛇妖的效果，强大百倍。很可能是蝴蝶仙子小蝴蝶的体质与灵丹的制造过程相契合，几年后她在被遗弃的洞穴中苏醒（在原故事中蛇妖已被全部消灭），灵丹的效果赋予了她巨大的能量和超乎想象的身体能力，远超原故事中的设定。她还为了保护自己，开发了一种个人的物理防御技能。虽然《葫芦兄弟》的故事已经结束，但小蝴蝶的新冒险即将开始。



续集关于小蝴蝶的背景故事

小蝴蝶在牺牲后，她的灵魂漂泊于七彩峰附近，无助却不愿消散，始终追随着七彩峰的微风。葫芦兄弟牺牲后化作的七彩灵气不仅滋养了大地，也保护了她的灵魂。某一天，山神偶然发现了她微弱但执着的灵魂光辉，惊叹于她顽强的意志，便将她托付给天庭织女。

织女看到这颗灵魂，感受到她承受的痛苦和不屈的精神，于是决定以七彩丝线为媒介，将小蝴蝶重新塑造为一个全新的生命体。织女用丝线将她的灵魂细细缠绕，织入了妖族的灵动与天界的光辉，最终创造出一个拥有天界力量与妖族本能的新生命体——“蝶灵”。

小蝴蝶在重生后，发现自己既拥有蝴蝶的翅膀，又被赋予了一种超然的神秘力量。她的外形仍然是她所熟悉的少女模样，但散发出的光辉却让她感到陌生。

初入天庭的挣扎

小蝴蝶初入天庭时，充满了对自由的向往。然而，天庭的规矩让她感到无比压抑：仙人们奉行严格的秩序，要求她必须服从天庭的规则，不得擅自行动。

她因内心对自由的追求而多次触犯天规，被其他仙人排斥。她的妖族血统也成为许多仙人冷落她的原因。即便如此，她依然怀抱希望，坚持探索自己的能力。

在一次任务中，她因为力量失控，险些造成灾难，天庭甚至考虑将她贬下凡间。就在她几乎绝望时，葫芦兄弟的灵魂通过梦境出现。他们告诉她：“蝴蝶妹妹，真正的自由，不是逃避，而是用你的力量保护你想守护的一切。”

这句话让小蝴蝶重拾信心。她开始认真学习如何掌控自己的力量，并在考验中逐渐展现出自己的潜力。

力量的突破

经过数百年的修炼，小蝴蝶觉醒了“蝶神”的血脉。她的力量得到了质的飞跃，彻底摆脱了昔日的弱小形象。



随着力量的觉醒，小蝴蝶也明白，力量的真正意义不是为了征服，而是为了守护。

回归奇香谷

在天庭中完成修炼的小蝴蝶，决定回到她最爱的奇香谷。她发现这里已经成为一片荒芜之地，曾经的花海早已消失殆尽。小蝴蝶流下了眼泪，她开始用自己的力量复苏这片土地。

她的翅膀轻轻扇动，带来了缤纷的花种与清新的甘露。她的光刀划过大地，种下新的生命。最终，奇香谷再一次被五彩斑斓的花海覆盖，散发出令人沉醉的香气。

在一个月夜，小蝴蝶在梦境中与葫芦小金刚的灵魂重逢。

“蝴蝶妹妹，你找到了属于自己的自由了吗？”小金刚微笑着问。

小蝴蝶轻轻点头：“小哥哥，谢谢你教会我，真正的自由，不是逃离，而是内心的平静。现在，我终于明白了。”

从此，小蝴蝶成为奇香谷的守护神。她以“蝶神”之名守护着这片她曾深爱的土地，为后人传颂。

title: SimpleClientBlocker
description: Blocks specific Minecraft clients from joining your server.
body:
Blocks specific Minecraft clients from joining your server.


## Features
- Kicks players using specific clients from the server.
- Configurable blacklist or whitelist for allowed clients.
- Customizable kick message displayed when a player is kicked.
- Notifications for online players when someone is kicked for using a blocked client.
- Notifications for online players when a player successfully joins with an allowed client.
- Ability to check the client of a specific player using a command.


## Commands
- Use **/simpleclientblocker reload** to reload the plugin.
- Use **/simpleclientblocker about** to get information about the plugin.
- Use **/simpleclientblocker client <player>** to check the client of the specified player.

## Permissions
- **simpleclientblocker.admin.reload** - Allows you to use /simpleclientblocker reload.
- **simpleclientblocker.client** - Allows you to use /simpleclientblocker client <player>.
- **simpleclientblocker.bypass** - Allows players to bypass the client check.
- **simpleclientblocker.notify** - Allows players to receive notifications about player client checks.


<details>
<summary>View config.yml</summary>


```
# SimpleClientBlocker by Losterixx
# Version: 1.0.0 | MC-Version: 1.21.1
#
# Hint: To use HEX colors, write '&x&r&r&g&g&b&b' instead of '#rrggbb'.

prefix: "&8[&4SimpleClientBlocker&8] &7"

messages:
  noPlayer: "&cOnly players can use this command!"
  noPerms: "&cYou do not have permission to execute this command!"

# These clients will be kicked upon joining
list:
  # BLACKLIST or WHITELIST
  type: WHITELIST
  # List of clients (only uppercases)
  clients:
    - FORGE
    - FEATHER FABRIC

# The message players receive when kicked
# Use \n for a new line
kick-message: "&cThe client &e%client% &cis not allowed on this server!"

notify:
  kicked:
    enabled: true
    message: "&7The player &e%player% &7attempted to join with &e%client% &7and was automatically kicked!"
  joined:
    enabled: true
    message: "&7The player &e%player% &7joined using &e%client%&7!"
```

  
</details>

<details>
<summary>View messages.yml</summary>


```
# SimpleClientBlocker by Losterixx
# Version: 1.0.0 | MC-Version: 1.21.1
#
# Hint: To use HEX colors, write '&x&r&r&g&g&b&b' instead of '#rrggbb'.

reload:
  reloading: "&7SimpleClientBlocker &eis reloading&7..."
  success: "&7SimpleClientBlocker has been &areloaded&7!"
  error: "&cAn error occurred while reloading SimpleClientBlocker! Check the console for details."

simpleclientblocker:
  usage: "&cPlease use &e/simpleclientblocker <about/reload/client/version> <player>&c!"
  notFound: "&cPlayer &e%player% &cwas not found!"
  client: "&7The player &e%player% &7is using &e%client%&7!"
  version: "&7The player &e%player% &7is using &e%version%&7!"
```


</details>


## Contact

If you encounter any issues or bugs, or have a
request for a new feature, please contact me via Discord or join my Discord-Server.

> My discord-name is **Losterixx**.

> My Discord-Server: [Link](https://discord.gg/gnGsUAwp76)

title: WorldManager
description: WorldManager is a simple plugin allowing worlds to be automatically reset on demand.
body:
# WorldManager
WorldManager is a simple plugin allowing worlds to be automatically reset on demand.

**NOTE:** The plugin is currently in beta, so please check out [here](https://github.com/Zffu/WorldManager) to suggest features you'd like!

## Commands
### /worldmanager
This is the main command of the plugin, allows to have a list of the commands.

### /worlds
This command allows you to have information on worlds handled by WorldManager.

### /loadworld
This command allows you to load a world handled by WorldManager.

### /unloadworld
This command allows you to unload a world handled by WorldManager.

### /createworld
This command allows you to create a world reset option for the specified world.

## Permissions & Messages
WorldManager allows its users to modify the required permissions and messages to whatever they'd like. In order to do so, please head to the config

## API
WorldManager comes with an API allows you to use its features without the plugin.

title: Cacimbinhas Approved Bingo
description: A modpack that allows players to play bingo in Minecraft, with a huge focus on optimization and utilities.
body:
This modpack is intended for multiplayer purposes, but it can be fun to play alone as a challenge.

### Bingo
It uses the YetAnotherBingo mod to generate a bingo chart that the players must fight to complete. It allows for up to 8 players and many customizations, such as:
- Time limit
- Lockout mode
- Objectives (X lines, X items, whole card)
- Select the difficulty of items to catch based on an item tier list
- Start with some perks
- Spawn distant between teams
- And much more.

The mod also comes with a pre-built lobby that allows players to configure the bingo the way they deem it best.


### Optimization
This modpack comes with a handful of optimization mods, such as:
- Sodium (and Sodium Extra)
- Lithium
- Indium
- Entity Culling
- FerriteCore
- ImmediatelyFast
- Dynamic FPS
- More Culling
- Clumps
- And much more.

All designed to improve on the optimization of the modpack in all fronts, be it rendering, logic, memory usage, resource usage, etc.


### Utilities
The modpack also has some mods incorporated for utility purposes, such as:
- AppleSkin (Food HUD improvement)
- BetterF3 (Cleaner F3 screen)
- Food Effect Tooltips (More information about the food)
- Jade (Information about the block you're looking at)
- JourneyMap (Minimap)
- Just Enough Items (Crafting recipes for items)
- Mod Menu (Enables quick access to mod configs)
- Mouse Tweeks (Enhances inventory management)
- Status Effect Bars (Better active effects HUD)
- Zoomify (Zoom).


### Graphics
Even though this isn't the focus of the modpack, it comes with Iris and a pre-installed shader pack, aimed at making the lighting and overall feel of Minecraft a bit better. It also makes use of the Dynamic Lights mod to make the whole thing come alive better, allowing items and blocks, such as torches, to interact with the light in a better and smoother way.

title: Windows Pack
description: My project is a pack that uses a 16-color palette from Windows
body:
# Windows Pack
My Minecraft texture pack is designed around the unique constraint of using a 16-color Windows palette. While the result may not always be the most visually refined, the challenge of working within this limited palette allows for a distinct, retro aesthetic. Each texture in the game from blocks to items has been meticulously created using only these 16 colors:

### Palette 16x Windows :
- #000000 (Black)
- #7e7e7e (Dark Gray)
- #bebebe (Light Gray)
- #ffffff (White)
- #7e0000 (Dark Red)
- #fe0000 (Bright Red)
- #047e00 (Dark Green)
- #06ff04 (Bright Green)
- #7e7e00 (Dark Yellow)
- #ffff04 (Bright Yellow)
- #00007e (Dark Blue)
- #0000ff (Bright Blue)
- #7e007e (Dark Magenta)
- #fe00ff (Bright Magenta)
- #047e7e (Dark Cyan)
- #06ffff (Bright Cyan)

This limitation creates a pixel-art style that feels nostalgic and challenging, appealing to those who appreciate creative boundaries in game design.

title: Fancier Mansions

body:
Fancier Mansions is a datapack that replaces all of the vanilla structure segments of a Woodland Mansion with visually upgraded ones. 

The goal was to give the mansion a more detailed aesthetic while still retaining a vanilla feel as well as the vanilla gameplay. The overall block palette has been darkened, and almost every segment has been further detailed to be more atmospheric and add a bit more context to the purpose of each room.

Since this pack only replaces structure files, you should be able to add it to most existing worlds without issue (Old mansions will not update. You will need to discover new ones in newly generated chunks).

title: XinXinBotApi
description: A super powerful QQ bot plugin that is fully compatible with OneBot and Mirai
body:
## 兼容核心  
插件只在下列核心进行测试，正常使用，其它服务端核心未知，请自行测试。  
1.8.8版本：Paper、Spigot  
1.12.2版本：CatServer、spigot  
1.16.5版本：CatServer、spigot  
1.19.2版本：paper、Spigot  
1.20.2版本：mohist、arclight  

## 插件简介  
此插件可以通过WebSocket对接 OneBot 以及 Mirai 机器人框架  
对接 Mirai 机器人请自行安装 mirai-api-http 插件  
推荐使用 Mirai 机器人框架，若实在不会搭建可以使用 OneBot标准 的机器人  

此插件因只作为一个前置Api使用所以只有一个绑定功能且默认关闭  

为什么是对接而不是把机器人直接写入插件？  
如果是直接将机器人写入插件可能会导致多服服主或多端服主头疼  
因为这样你可能需要准备更多的QQ号  
但如果是直接接入框架本身的话  
首先你也能正常使用框架本身的插件并且还能对接服务器  
​
## 插件功能  
此插件使用 WebSocket 进行QQ消息操作  
所以必须通过指令连接一次 WebSocket 才能正常使用  
在配置文件中可以开启自动连接，但需要提前开启 OneBot 或 Mirai 机器人  
绑定信息支持 MySQL 储存，若不开启则为本地文件储存 

此插件作为单独使用的话只有一个绑定玩家功能  
而这个绑定功能也没有任何实质性作用  
但是可以通过其他附属插件达到想要的作用  

## 指令权限&介绍  
管理员指令介绍（所需权限：`XinxinBotApi.admin`）  
`/xbot bind <QQ> <玩家ID>` —— 手动绑定一个QQ  
`/xbot unbind <QQ>` —— 删除一个QQ的绑定账号  
`/xbot connect` —— 连接WebSocket  
`/xbot close` —— 断开WebSocket  
`/xbot reload` —— 重载插件  

​
## 图片展示  
Api自带绑定功能（需要在配置文件手动开启SetBind项)  

![1711706528727.png](https://bbs.mc9y.net/attachments/8458/)
​
## 开发文档 & 安装教程  
若将此插件作为开发前置即可让MC充满各种可能性  
或许在这之前你开发群服互联插件会去找各种Api  
现在你只需要把本插件添加为你的依赖  
使用本插件作为前置开发请在 `Plugin.yml` 里加入 `depend: XinxinBotApi`  
从而让本插件在你插件之前加载  
[![1.png](http://img.mcxin.cn/images/2024/02/19/1.png)](http://wiki.mcxin.cn/zh/%E6%96%B0%E9%91%AB%E6%8F%92%E4%BB%B6%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B/XinxinBotApi)

## 附属插件  
绑定礼包 | 查询信息 | 进服验证 | 图片信息 | 群服注册 | 互联指令 | 我的精灵  
（一个一个改链接太麻烦了，在[新鑫论坛](https://bbs.mcxin.cn/)搜索XinxinBot则可以浏览所有附属）  
! 附属插件统计可能并不完全，更多附属插件自行开发或找他人定制  

## 版权声明
本插件所用所有代码均为原创,不存在借用/抄袭等行为  
本插件为非盈利性插件，免费发布，严禁销售和转卖  
若需要开发任何与此插件相关的附属插件可以联系作者  

### 转载声明  
转载至[https://bbs.mcxin.cn/archives/216](https://bbs.mcxin.cn/archives/216)  
已得到原作者授权  
![屏幕截图 2024-08-17 154930.png](https://pic.imge.cc/2024/08/17/66c05ff7ae88b.png)

欢迎加入新鑫咕咕交流群：1124109145​
[![2.png](http://img.mcxin.cn/images/2024/02/19/2.png)](http://bbs.mcxin.cn/?golink=aHR0cHM6Ly9naXRodWIuY29tL1hpbnhpbi1lbnQvWGlueGluQm90QXBp)

title: hostprofiles
description: hostprofiles is a Minecraft plugin for various platforms that detects if a player joins the server on a specific address and then logs them into a completely different game profile.
body:
# hostprofiles

> **Deprecation notice**
> Please consider using [staffprofiles](https://modrinth.com/plugin/staffprofiles) instead, which is more practical and easier to use.

hostprofiles is a Minecraft plugin for various platforms that detects if a player joins the server on a specific address
and then logs them into a completely different game profile.

Here is a usage example:
If your server address were myserver.com, you could configure admin.myserver.com (the host) as a special host and map
the player with the UUID of Joe to be logged with another, predefined UUID, use Admin_Joe as his username and have a
completely different skin (the profile). You could then only give Admin_Joe administrator privileges. This means that if
Joe joins using myserver.com, he is logged in as Joe and could play as a normal player, but if he logs into
admin.myserver.com is logged in as Admin_Joe and can do administrative tasks.

You can configure:

- Which profile (UUID, name and skin) a player trying to log in (identified by his UUID) is going to have
- If a player gets kicked if there is no entry for his UUID
- A special MOTD for every host
- If a player should keep his original skin, or use a profile skin

## Platforms

Right now, the spigot plugin is only available for 1.18.1, Paper works on 1.18.1 and above. Supported platforms are Paper and Spigot.
**If you use Paper you MUST also use the build for Paper, the spigot build is NOT going to work.**

## Support

The Spigot and Paper builds are still very unstable, as they use various reflection tricks to change the game profile
and retrieve the hostname. Because the Paper API provides a method to set the game profile on join, there is one less
hack in there, so I would consider it preferable. The Velocity version uses only API, therefor is the most stable.

**Velocity > Paper > Spigot**

Problems or feature requests should be reported as issues on GitHub. If you have any questions or would like to receive
quick support, you can do so on the [my discord server](G4T9aKXJfy).

title: Voice Command Mod
description: This mod takes your words and if you say a trigger word it spawns a mob
body:
# Voice Command Mod
Say something you shouldn't. Watch something spawn. [Shown best by Xeroh.](https://youtu.be/LPT3_7KWyW0)

Voice Command Mod listens to your microphone while you play Minecraft. When it detects a trigger word in your speech, it randomly selects a mob and spawns it near you. No Python, no external programs, no setup beyond dropping the JAR in your mods folder.

Built for streamers, but works for anyone who wants a reason to watch their mouth.

# How It Works
The mod uses **Vosk** for offline speech recognition. Everything runs locally on your computer. A small voice model(around 40MB) is extracted to your .minecraft folder on first launch automatically. No internet connection required for voice detection, and no audio data is ever sent anywhere.

# Requirements
- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge 47.3.0 or higher
- wonderland.jar (required to spawn preset mobs, HOWEVER, this can be changed in the config to any mob id you want)
- A working microphone set as your default recording device in Windows

# Features
- **Voice Triggered Mob Spawns** say a trigger word(changeable in config) and a mob from that word's pool spawns. Each word group has a list of mobs and one is chosen at random every time.
- **Substring Detection** the mod catches trigger words inside longer words. Without this, the mod was a bit boring. This was added for some extra chaos.
- **Cursed Lottery** every 10th word activates the Cursed Lottery. Instead of one mob, 3 to 5 random mobs from the entire pool spawn rapidly.
- **Shame Title** every time a word triggers a message appears in chat showing your total swear count and the word you said.
- **Clean Streak Tracker** after each trigger the time since your last trigger word is displayed above your hotbar so you and your viewers can see how long you managed to behave.
- **Fully Configurable Word and Mob Lists** (As of version 2.1.1 there is an in game config menu) On first launch the mod creates a plain text config file at 
```
.minecraft/config/voicecommand_words.txt
```
Open it in Notepad to add words, remove words, change which mobs each word spawns, and control which mobs spawn on top of you verus in front of you. No JSON, no special syntax, just plain text.
Example of adding a new trigger word:

```
chicken = the_wonderland:carrier_aggro, the_wonderland:eyeless
```
- **In Game Settings** additional settings are avaiable through the Forge mod config screen under Mods -> Voice Command Mod -> Config:
    - Enable or disable mod entirely
    - Trigger cooldown in seconds
    - Lottery frequency
    - Toggle swear count display
    - Toggle streak display
# First Launch
On your very first launch with the mod installed, the Vosk voice model will be automatically extracted to your .minecraft folder. This happens in the background and takes a few seconds. You will see this message in your game log when it is ready:

```
[VoiceMod] Microphone started - listening for trigger words!
```
# For Streamers
This mod was designed with streaming in mind. The shame title appears in chat so viewers can see them in stream. The streak tracker gives viewers something to watch build up. The Cursed Lottery creates natural moments of tension as the swear count climbs toward the next jackpot.

The word and mob config file makes it easy to customise the mod for your specific modpack without needing to recompile anything.

# Troubleshooting
**Nothing happens when I speak**
- Make sure your microphone is set as default recording device in Windows Sound Settings
- Check the game log for the line "[VoiceMod] Microphone started"
- Make sure you are fully loaded into a world, not just on the title screen

**Mobs are not spawning**
- Make sure the wonderland.jar is installed(unless changed in configs)
- Check the config file to confirm the mob IDs are correct
- Check the game log for any lines starting with [VoiceMod] ERROR
- Make sure you have permissions to spawn mobs (only in version 2.0.0)

**I want to use mobs from a different mod**
- Open .minecraft/config/voicecommand_words.txt
- Replace the mob IDs with any valid entity ID from your modpack
- The format is modid:entityname, the same as the /summon command

# Privacy
This mod uses the Vosk speech recognition library which runs entirely offline. No audio is recorded to disk. No audio or transciption data is ever sent to any server. Everything stays on your machine.

# Bugs
Bug reports can be submitted in my [discord](https://discord.gg/3SJsVAWCT3), along with suggestions for the mod.

# Credits
Speech recognition powered by **Vosk** by Alpha Cephei. Modded mobs from **wonderland.jar**

title: ConnectMe
description: Create a bridge between minecraft, discord and even telegram!
body: # Description **ConnectMe** is a powerful multi-platform chat bridge that seamlessly connects Minecraft server chat with **Telegram** and **Discord**. It provides real-time bidirectional messaging between all three platforms, allowing players and community members to communicate regardless of which platform they're using. Every message format, bridge setting, and notification type is fully customizable through _config.yml_. The plugin features independent platform configuration, loop prevention systems, and comprehensive event notifications including player joins/leaves, deaths, advancements, and server status. Unique systems include direct Discord-Telegram bridging, customizable message formatting with color codes, and permission-based access controls for all features. This elegant solution is perfect for community-driven servers seeking to unify their player base across multiple communication platforms while maintaining full control over message flow and formatting. _Java 21 or higher is required._ Installation Guide # Commands - Reload the ConnectMe configuration file ``` /tlgreload ``` - Mention a user from Telegram (will only appear in Telegram) ``` /tlgmention (Alias: /tlg) ``` - Get Discord server invite link ``` /discord ``` # Key Features Multi-Platform Bridge: Real-time bidirectional chat between Minecraft, Telegram, and Discord with independent enable/disable controls Direct Platform Bridging: Optional direct Discord ↔ Telegram messaging without routing through Minecraft ## Comprehensive Event Notifications: - Player chat messages between all platforms - Player join/leave events with online count - Death messages with cause details - Advancement completions with proper formatting - Server startup/shutdown status - Customizable Messaging: Every message format fully configurable with Minecraft color codes (&) and placeholders (%player%, %message%, etc.) - Loop Prevention: Advanced message tracking prevents infinite message loops between platforms ## Permission System: ### Granular control over who can send/receive messages and use commands: - connectme.telegramreceive - Receive Telegram messages - connectme.telegramsend - Send messages to Telegram - connectme.telegramcommands.mention - Use mention commands - connectme.reload - Reload configuration ## Telegram Integration: ``` /online - View online players ``` ``` /time - Check server time and date ``` ``` /discord - Request the Discord invitation link ``` - Automatic user mention system - Group chat support with configurable chat ID ## Discord Integration: - Rich message formatting with embeds - Channel-specific messaging - Invite URL - Proper intent handling for message content - Flexible Configuration: Enable/disable individual features, customize all message formats, set up platform-specific settings, and control bridge behavior through extensive config.yml options - Smart Message Handling: Automatic message length management, duplicate prevention, and proper async processing to avoid server lag

**Performium Reborn** is a fork of [**Performium**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/performium-was-taken) modpack. * **Minor version (`Y`)** — smaller additions, tweaks, fixes

Example: `v1.0`

The modpack also has an internal release state shown on Modrinth:

* **Alpha** — incomplete or unstable, many planned mods/features may be missing
* **Beta** — mostly complete, but some non-critical mods may still be outdated or unavailable
* **Release** — intended feature set is fully implemented and stable

The release state is not included in the modpack name, since it only reflects how complete the current version is relative to its intended mod list

title: Magic Ritual (阵法)
description: A magic mod for Minecraft that differs from the past magic mods, focusing on more long term and thought out magic rituals!
body:
# Getting Started
The basics of magic rituals and your first tools.
### Ritual Dagger
> The Ritual Dagger is your primary tool for creating and managing magic rituals.
> Right-click with the dagger to open the Magic Circle Selection screen, where you can choose a magic circle type to place at your feet. Shift + Right-click to open the Radius Selection screen, where you can place a Magic Center Block with a chosen radius.

# Magic Center
The heart of your ritual setup - fuel, control, and radius management
### What is a Magic Center
> The Magic Center Block is the invisible anchor of your ritual setup. It defines the radius in which magic circles operate and provides the fuel they need to function.
> To place one, Shift + Right-click with the Ritual Dagger and choose a radius . The center is placed beneath your feet.The center block is invisible but shows red particle effects along its radius. It breaks very easily and does not drop anything.

# Magic Circles
Different types of magic circles and their effects.
### Circle Types
>There are three types of magic circles, each granting a different effect to entities standing on them. Multiple circles of the same type within a Magic Center's radius will stack their effects.
- > Attack Red - Grants Strength I. Each additional Attack circle increases the amplifier by one level.
- > Defense Blue - Grants Resistance I. Extra Defense circles increase the resistance level.
- > Regeneration Green - Grants Regeneration I. More Regeneration circles increase the regeneration amplifier.
> The effects are applied passively every tick as long as the Magic Center has fuel.

# Spirit Resources
All the info you need to be rich!
### Spirit Ore
> Spirit Ore is a resource found deep underground in large veins. It must be mined with an Iron Pickaxe or better to drop Spirit Stones.
> Spirit Ore Veins generate between Y=0 and Y=-100 . Each vein is very large, containing 200-250 ore blocks. Mining through a vein may reveal Spirit Vein Centers. Use a Spirit Map or /locate poi magic_ritual_mod:spirit_vein_center command to find nearby veins.

title: OreSim
description: Ore Sim is a client-side utility that simulates Minecraft's ore generation from a known world seed and visualizes the predicted ore positions in the world.
body:
# Ore Sim

Ore Sim is a client-side utility that simulates Minecraft's ore generation from a known world seed and visualizes the predicted ore positions in the world.

Given a world seed, the mod re-runs Minecraft's vanilla ore placement algorithm locally and highlights where ores are expected to generate. Various rendering and performance settings allow you to customize how predictions are displayed.

## Features

* Predicts ore locations from a world seed
* Supports the following ores:

  * Coal
  * Iron
  * Gold
  * Redstone
  * Diamond
  * Lapis Lazuli
  * Copper
  * Emerald
  * Nether Quartz
  * Ancient Debris
* Adjustable render distance
* Fade and visibility controls
* Configurable performance budget
* In-game configuration screen
* Rebindable keybinds
* Settings persist between game sessions
* Commands for:

  * Entering or changing the seed
  * Toggling predictions on and off
  * Listing nearby predicted ore locations

## Usage

1. Enter a valid world seed.
2. Enable ore prediction.
3. Explore the world while Ore Sim visualizes the predicted ore generation positions.

## Disclaimer

This is a **client-side tool** designed for **single-player worlds, educational purposes, and seed analysis**.

Using this mod to gain an advantage on multiplayer servers may violate server rules. Always respect the policies of the servers you play on.

title: Crafter's Player Heads
description: A simple and lightweight plugin to drop player heads with lots of cool details and features!
body:
![CraftersPlayerHeads-Banner](https://i.imgur.com/cZKxEZP.png) --- ### This plugin is intended to be used with Tile Data Saver. ### Download it here: https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/tiledatasaver.85624 --- --- Towards the end of 2021 a player by the name of TheMasterChief69 requested the server we all played on have player heads, he was so adamant in-fact that it drove us to add them. I predicted they would be an awful, terrible, no good thing to plague the server. Well here we are in 2023 and I hate them still.. However; I was tasked with creating a new player heads plugin to replace the old system. It's a very simple plugin that drops heads when players die. The heads are all named as `Player's Head #DEATHS_TOTAL` and depending on the type of death, pvp or not, the lore will display information about the cause of death. --- ### > Deaths Normal deaths will contain information in the lore stating who the player's head is, how they died, the date and the coords of where the player died. Dropped down below that is a section with a skull emoji that states the total deaths of the player and the UUID of the player who died. ### > PVP Deaths A death in PVP will yield a player head decked to the brim with sick stats about the epic duel that took place. Including the player who killed them, when it happened and where it all took place. By default the name of the weapon will be displayed in the lore message, if a nickname is not set then it will default to the block name. Also included in a darker colour is the total deaths with under that being displayed both the victim's and killer's UUIDs. --- ### > Weapon Flags Okay this part is super exciting to me. Our server is a vanilla SMP with some enhancements, such as voice chat, that involves some levels of roleplay. Playing with this aspect I wanted a way to make it so player's could prevent their identity being displayed or their coords being displayed. Just append to a weapon's nickname one of the available flags for the plugin and it should be good to go. The appended flag will not display in the nickname of the weapon within the player head's lore. The flag -anonymous will hide the killer's name and UUID. Instead presenting a scrambled mess. The flag -hidden will hide the killer's location, the coords, in the death lore's second line. Instead presenting a scrambled mess. Both of these can be used together on the same weapon. There is a video here, but I have also placed it at the top of this page. --- ### > Permissions craftersplayerheads.admin --- ### > Commands /head Note: The player must have joined the server previously. --- ### > Legacy Heads If you have another player head plugin then you can now convert them smoothly into 'legacy heads.' If you choose to enable the setting to convert old player heads in our config then your player heads that don't match our info check will be renamed and have new lore added to them, adjustable in the config. When you have this setting enabled it will prevent all player heads from being named, be warned this could cause some issues if you turn it off and back on once more. It should only be turned on once and turned off once after that. I'm working on a better solution to the info check, but for now it doesn't work with renamed player heads without causing some duplicated lore and resetting the player head's name back to the legacy config name. ---

# Description
CharacterDialogue is a plugin that transforms your NPCs into interactive characters with dynamic, branching conversations. Create immersive experiences for your players with animated dialogues, meaningful choices, and NPCs that come to life.

![Image of a conversation with a witch mob](https://r2.e-z.host/a992a427-74c5-45d9-8edb-61722d83e2b4/6y6jy52m.gif)

# Features
## Dialogue System
* Persistent conversations that save between sessions
* Custom first-interaction dialogues for unique NPC introductions
* Animated text with typewriter effect
## Choice System
* Player decision points with multiple display formats
* Chat interface with click or number key selection
![Chat choices](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8515849a4a3c6ef267fc0d03bc715e2b7759d70b.png)
* GUI menu with custom player heads
![Choices GUI gif](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16486cd7cb80cac0464548c29ce5ead7276016ee.gif)
* Native forms for Bedrock players (with [Floodgate](https://geysermc.org/wiki/floodgate/))

    ![Bedrock choices](https://r2.e-z.host/a992a427-74c5-45d9-8edb-61722d83e2b4/khf7zhaj.png)
## NPC Control
* Make NPCs follow you during dialogues
* Teleport NPCs to specific locations
* Record and replay NPC movements
* Equip items to NPCs dynamically
![Npc recording example](https://r2.e-z.host/a992a427-74c5-45d9-8edb-61722d83e2b4/pnckv20l.gif)
## Item Management
* Give custom items during dialogues
* Remove specific items from inventory
* Save custom items for reuse
## Condition System
* Branching dialogue paths based on conditions
* Hidden NPCs that appear based on conditions 
* PlaceholderAPI integration for dynamic conditions

![Conversation example with hide condition](https://r2.e-z.host/a992a427-74c5-45d9-8edb-61722d83e2b4/88zncj6z.gif)
## Regional Dialogues
* Auto-start dialogues when entering WorldGuard regions
* Configurable conditions for regional activation
## Visual Customization
* Full MiniMessage support for text formatting
* Holograms with HolographicDisplays or DecentHolograms
* Customizable titles and subtitles
* Configurable sounds for each action
# Compatibility
## Supported NPC Plugins
* [Citizens](https://ci.citizensnpcs.co/job/citizens2/)
* [ZNPCs Plus](https://modrinth.com/plugin/znpcsplus)
* [FancyNPCs](https://modrinth.com/plugin/fancynpcs)
## Optional Integrations
* PlaceholderAPI - Dynamic variables
* WorldGuard - Regional dialogues
* Floodgate - Bedrock support
* ConditionalEvents - Additional conditions
# Requirements
* Minecraft 1.16+
* Spigotmc or Papermc
* At least one supported NPC plugin
# Documentation
For detailed guides, examples, advanced configuration, and developer API, visit the [**official documentation**](https://absolute-algorithmic.gitbook.io/character-dialogue-documentation)

title: Nations
description: The Ultimate Plugin for making and leading nations, forming alliances, and declaring wars!
body:
# Nations
![Nations Banner](https://img.shields.io/badge/Nations-1.1.0-gold?style=for-the-badge) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.8--1.21+-gold?style=for-the-badge) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Spigot%20%7C%20Paper%20%7C%20Bukkit-gold?style=for-the-badge) **A comprehensive nations, warfare, and alliance plugin for Minecraft servers.** *Created by **Nevmind**. All rights reserved to him.*
--- ## Overview Nations is a feature-rich Minecraft plugin that allows players to create and manage their own nations, form alliances, and engage in organized warfare. Whether you're running a survival server, a roleplay server, or a political faction server, Nations provides all the tools you need for immersive geopolitical gameplay. --- ## Features ### Nation Management - **Create Nations** - Players can establish their own nations with custom names - **Multiple Join Types** - Open, approval-based, or application-based joining - **Custom Application Questions** - Nation leaders can set up to 5 questions for applicants - **Role System** - Create custom roles with specific permissions - **Multi-Leader Support** - Nations can have multiple co-leaders ### Alliance System - **Create Alliances** - Nation leaders can form alliances with other nations - **Alliance Leadership** - Multiple nations can share leadership of an alliance - **Diplomatic Relations** - Invite nations, manage membership, and coordinate strategy ### Warfare System - **Declare War** - Nation leaders can declare war on rival nations - **Two War Modes**: - **Mode 1 (Instant)**: Combat begins immediately - **Mode 2 (Grace Period)**: Configurable grace period before combat - **Casualty Tracking** - Real-time kill tracking during wars - **War Scoreboard** - Live scoreboard showing war status and casualties - **Alliance Support** - Allies are notified and can join wars ### Admin Controls - **War Approval System** - Optionally require admin approval for wars - **Restrict Nation Creation** - Limit nation creation to admins only - **In-Game Config Editing** - Modify all settings without touching files - **Full Override Permissions** - Admins can manage any nation ### LuckPerms Integration - **Automatic Groups** - Nations automatically create LuckPerms groups - **Name Tags** - Players display their nation and role in chat/name tags --- ## Installation 1. **Download** the `Nations-1.0.0.jar` file 2. **Stop** your Minecraft server 3. **Place** the JAR file in your server's `plugins` folder 4. **Start** your server 5. The plugin will generate its configuration files automatically 6. **(Optional)** Install [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/) for name tag integration --- ## Commands ### General Commands | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/nations help [page]` | Show help pages | Everyone | | `/nations creator` | Show plugin creator | Everyone | | `/nations list` | List all nations | `nations.player.list` | | `/nations info [nation]` | View nation information | `nations.player.info` | ### Nation Management | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/nations create [type]` | Create a nation | `nations.player.create` | | `/nations delete` | Delete your nation | Nation Leader | | `/nations join ` | Join a nation | `nations.player.join` | | `/nations leave` | Leave your nation | `nations.player.leave` | | `/nations kick ` | Kick a member | Role permission | | `/nations notifications` | Toggle join notifications | Nation Leader | ### Join Requests & Applications | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/nations requests [page]` | View pending requests | Role permission | | `/nations accept ` | Accept a request | Role permission | | `/nations deny ` | Deny a request | Role permission | | `/nations questions list` | List application questions | Nation Leader | | `/nations questions add ` | Add a question | Nation Leader | | `/nations questions remove <#>` | Remove a question | Nation Leader | ### Role Management | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/nations role create ` | Create a role | Role permission | | `/nations role delete ` | Delete a role | Role permission | | `/nations role list` | List all roles | Role permission | | `/nations role perms ` | Set role permission | Role permission | | `/nations setrole ` | Assign role to player | Role permission | **Available Role Permissions:** - `accept_requests` - Accept/deny join requests - `declare_war` - Declare war on other nations - `kick_members` - Kick members from the nation - `invite_members` - Invite players to the nation - `manage_roles` - Create, edit, and assign roles ### Leadership Commands | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/nations leader add ` | Add a co-leader | Nation Leader | | `/nations leader remove ` | Remove a co-leader | Nation Leader | | `/nations leader transfer ` | Transfer leadership | Nation Leader | ### War Commands | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/nations war declare ` | Declare war | Role permission | | `/nations war confirm` | Confirm war declaration | Role permission | | `/nations war list` | List active wars | Everyone | | `/nations war join ` | Join an ongoing war | Role permission | | `/nations war end ` | End a war | `nations.admin.war` | | `/nations war approve ` | Approve pending war | `nations.admin.war` | **War Outcomes:** `attacker`, `defender`, `draw`, `attacker_surrender`, `defender_surrender` ### Alliance Commands | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/nations alliance create ` | Create an alliance | Nation Leader | | `/nations alliance invite ` | Invite nation to alliance | Alliance Leader | | `/nations alliance join ` | Join an alliance | Nation Leader | | `/nations alliance leave` | Leave your alliance | Nation Leader | | `/nations alliance kick ` | Kick from alliance | Alliance Leader | | `/nations alliance delete` | Delete your alliance | Alliance Leader | | `/nations alliance info [name]` | View alliance info | Everyone | | `/nations alliance list` | List all alliances | Everyone | ### Admin Commands | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/nations reload` | Reload configuration | `nations.admin.reload` | | `/nations config get ` | Get config value | `nations.admin.config` | | `/nations config set ` | Set config value | `nations.admin.config` | | `/nations config list [section]` | List config keys | `nations.admin.config` | | `/nations admin create ` | Create nation for player | `nations.admin.create` | | `/nations admin delete ` | Delete any nation | `nations.admin.delete` | | `/nations admin setleader ` | Set nation leader | `nations.admin.leader` | --- ## Permissions ### Player Permissions (Default: true) | Permission | Description | |------------|-------------| | `nations.player.*` | All player permissions | | `nations.player.create` | Create a nation | | `nations.player.join` | Join a nation | | `nations.player.leave` | Leave a nation | | `nations.player.info` | View nation information | | `nations.player.list` | List all nations | ### Admin Permissions (Default: OP) | Permission | Description | |------------|-------------| | `nations.admin.*` | All admin permissions | | `nations.admin` | General admin permission | | `nations.admin.reload` | Reload configuration | | `nations.admin.config` | Edit configuration in-game | | `nations.admin.create` | Create nations for players | | `nations.admin.delete` | Delete any nation | | `nations.admin.kick` | Kick from any nation | | `nations.admin.leader` | Manage any nation's leadership | | `nations.admin.roles` | Manage any nation's roles | | `nations.admin.war` | Approve and end wars | ### Bypass Permissions (Default: OP) | Permission | Description | |------------|-------------| | `nations.bypass.*` | Bypass all restrictions | | `nations.bypass.cooldown` | Bypass join/leave cooldowns | --- ## Configuration The configuration file (`config.yml`) is automatically generated with extensive comments. Here's an overview of key settings: ### Messages ```yaml messages: prefix: "&8[&6Nations&8] &r" ``` ### Appearance ```yaml appearance: primary-color: "&6" secondary-color: "&e" accent-color: "&7" error-color: "&c" success-color: "&a" ``` ### Nation Settings ```yaml nations: player-creation-enabled: true # Allow players to create nations join-requests-enabled: true # Allow join requests max-application-questions: 5 # Max questions per application join-cooldown-seconds: 0 # Cooldown before joining (0 = disabled) leave-cooldown-seconds: 0 # Cooldown before leaving (0 = disabled) ``` ### War Settings ```yaml war: mode: 1 # 1 = Instant, 2 = Grace Period require-admin-approval: false # Require admin approval for wars grace-period-seconds: 300 # Grace period duration (mode 2 only) chat-notifications: true # Announce kills in chat scoreboard-enabled: true # Show war scoreboard ``` ### Integrations ```yaml integrations: luckperms-enabled: true # Enable LuckPerms integration ``` --- ## In-Game Config Editing You can modify any configuration value without editing files: ``` /nations config get war.mode /nations config set war.mode 2 /nations config set war.grace-period-seconds 600 /nations config list war ``` Changes are saved immediately and apply on the next relevant action. --- ## Compatibility ### Supported Minecraft Versions - **Minimum:** 1.8 - **Maximum:** 1.21+ (and future versions) - The plugin uses only stable Bukkit/Spigot API calls ### Supported Platforms - **Spigot** - **Paper** - **Bukkit** - **Paper forks** (Purpur, Pufferfish, etc.) ### Optional Dependencies - **LuckPerms** - For name tag integration --- ## Troubleshooting ### Common Issues **Q: The plugin won't load!** - Ensure you're running a compatible server version (1.8+) - Check the console for error messages - Verify the JAR file isn't corrupted **Q: LuckPerms integration isn't working!** - Ensure LuckPerms is installed and loaded before Nations - Check that `integrations.luckperms-enabled` is set to `true` - Verify LuckPerms is version 5.0 or higher **Q: Players can't create nations!** - Check `nations.player-creation-enabled` in config - Verify players have `nations.player.create` permission **Q: Wars aren't starting!** - If using admin approval, wars need to be approved first - Check `war.require-admin-approval` in config **Q: Scoreboard isn't showing!** - Verify `war.scoreboard-enabled` is `true` - Some scoreboard plugins may conflict --- ## FAQ **Q: Can I have multiple nations at once?** A: No, players can only be in one nation at a time. **Q: What happens when a nation is deleted?** A: All members are removed, the nation is disbanded, and if in an alliance, it's removed from there too. **Q: Can wars have multiple nations on each side?** A: Yes! Alliance members can join wars, and non-allied nations can choose a side. **Q: Is there a limit to nation size?** A: No built-in limit. You can implement one via permissions or external plugins. --- ## Attribution **Created by Nevmind. All rights reserved to him.**
**Nations v1.0.0** | Created by Nevmind | All rights reserved

title: TheDashboard
description: The best way to manage your self hosted Minecraft server.
body:
# TheDashboard

Leichtes Web-Dashboard für deinen Paper‑Minecraft‑Server – verwalte Spieler, sieh Live‑Logs, sende Konsolenbefehle und starte/stoppe den Server direkt im Browser.

— English below —

## 🇩🇪 Deutsch
TheDashboard ist ein schlankes Web‑Panel, das direkt im Plugin läuft. Kein externer Webserver nötig. Per Passwort‑Token sicher zugreifen und deinen Server bequem verwalten.

### Highlights
- Online‑Spieler ansehen (OP‑Badge) und verwalten: Kick, Ban, Unban, OP/Deop
- Live‑Konsole und Server‑Logs im Browser
- Befehle an die Server‑Konsole senden
- Server stoppen und neu starten (Paper)
- Modernes, reaktives UI – sofort einsatzbereit
- Whitelist per Schalter aktivieren/deaktivieren und verwalten (Spieler hinzufügen/entfernen)
- Live‑TPS‑Anzeige (1 Minute) im Panel

### Schnellstart
1) JAR nach plugins/ legen und Server starten
2) Im Browser öffnen: http://<server‑ip>:4646/
3) Beim ersten Start neues Passwort setzen (Setup‑Dialog)
4) Mit Passwort einloggen und loslegen

### Kompatibilität
- Paper 1.21.x
- Java 21

### Konfiguration (Basics)
- Port und Passwort in plugins/TheDashboard/config.yml (Standardport: 4646)
- Optional: webserver.logFile setzen, falls Logs nicht automatisch erkannt werden

### Sicherheit
- Unbedingt das Standardpasswort „YOUR_SECURE_PASSWORD“ ändern
- (optional) wenn öffentlich erreichbar: hinter Reverse Proxy, HTTPS aktivieren und per Firewall schützen

— — —

## 🇬🇧 English
TheDashboard is a lightweight web panel that runs inside the plugin. No external web server required. Access via a password token and manage your server from the browser.

### Highlights
- View and manage online players (OP badge): kick, ban, unban, op/deop
- Live console and server logs in the browser
- Send commands to the server console
- Stop and restart the server (Paper)
- Modern, responsive UI – works out of the box
- Whitelist toggle and management (add/remove players)
- Live TPS display (1‑minute) in the panel

### Quick Start
1) Drop the JAR into plugins/ and start the server
2) Open in your browser: http://<server‑ip>:4646/
3) On first run, set a new password (setup dialog)
4) Log in with the password and start managing

### Compatibility
- Paper 1.21.x
- Java 21

### Configuration (Basics)
- Port and password in plugins/TheDashboard/config.yml (default port: 4646)
- Optional: set webserver.logFile if logs aren’t detected automatically

### Security
- Change the default password “YOUR_SECURE_PASSWORD” immediately
- (optional) If exposed publicly: place behind a reverse proxy, enable HTTPS, and restrict via firewall
