title: Sudden Death
description: Enhance the monster's abilities, survival becomes impossible.
body:
![Main](https://proxy.spigotmc.org/2a622a83ff1d474e5e229d2e2c8dd23cd7e088c3/68747470733a2f2f692e6962622e636f2f466b6a63385151682f7364732e706e67)

Done with predictable, easy survival worlds? Brace yourself for Sudden Death! This plugin cranks up the challenge, pushing your survival skills to the limit with intense hardcore features and thrilling new mechanics. Watch out—monsters now wield unique, powerful abilities that’ll keep you on edge. Transform your Minecraft server with a fresh, heart-pounding experience!

![Features](https://proxy.spigotmc.org/b83a59b1934ca1c495b267ebeb2a53fc258ee0bc/68747470733a2f2f692e696d6775722e636f6d2f4d6971434838582e706e67)

**Survival features**
- **Advanced Player Drops:** Players drop a skull, bones, and human flesh on death. Flesh can be cooked.
- **Arrow Slow:** Arrows slow players for a short duration.
- **Bleeding:** Damage has a chance to cause bleeding, disabling health regen and dealing periodic damage. Stopped with a bandage.
- **Blood Screen:** Player screen turns red when damaged, based on health or interval.
- **Dangerous Coal:** Mining coal may trigger a gas pocket explosion.
- **Electricity Shock:** Powered redstone components deal damage to players periodically.
- **Fall Stun:** High falls slow players, with duration based on fall height.
- **Freddy:** Waking up has a chance to summon Freddy.
- **Hunger Nausea:** Hunger causes permanent nausea.
- **Infection:** Zombies may infect players, causing nausea and periodic damage; stopped with Strange Brew.
- **Physic EnderPearl:** EnderPearl will have physical properties like bounce, friction.
- **Realistic Pickup:** Players must crouch and look down to pick up items, causing brief slowdown.
- **Snow Slow:** Players without specific boots are slowed on snow.
- **Stone Stiffness:** Punching stone deals damage to players.
- **Whisper of the Desert:** Husk has a chance to emerge from the ground in barren biomes, attacking and weakening the player. ***New!***

**Events**
- **Blood Moon:** Nights may turn red, increasing player damage taken and slowing them; monsters gain speed, strength, and resistance.
- **Meteor Rain:** At night, a meteor may strike, leaving a crater with rare minerals at its center. ***New!***
- **Thunderstorm:** Storms may become thunderstorms with stronger, more frequent lightning.

**Monster abilities**
- **Abyssal Vortex:** The Guardian can create a whirlpool that pulls players toward it, preventing them from escaping. ***New!***
- **Angry Spiders:** Spiders throw cobwebs, dealing damage and slowing players.
- **Armor Piercing:** All monsters will have a chance to attack, ignoring armor, protective enchantments, and golden apples (true damage). ***New!***
- **Bone Grenades:** Skeletons may throw explosive bone grenades, causing damage and knockback.
- **Bone Wizards:** Skeletons named 'Bone Wizards' cast fireball or frost curse spells, dealing damage and slowing players.
- **Breeze Dash:** Breeze may accelerate and fire multiple WindCharges, but with reduced jump ability.
- **Creeper Revenge:** Creepers may explode on death.
- **Ender Power:** Hitting certain End mobs may blind players temporarily.
- **Everburning Blazes:** Blazes summon fire beams that ignite players.
- **Force of the Undead:** Monsters deal increased attack damage, configurable per mob.
- **Firework Arrows:** Pillager will have a chance to fire explosive fireworks arrows in an area, dealing damage and stunning players. ***New!***
- **Homing Flame Barrage:** Blaze has a chance to fire a beam of fire. It tracks the player and deals HP each beam with a hit rate 100%.
- **Immortal Evoker:** Evoker has a chance to use Totem to avoid death and summon Fangs can pull the player into the ground.
- **Leaping Spiders:** Spiders can leap powerfully at players.
- **Mob Critical Strikes:** Monsters can deal critical strikes with extra damage, configurable per mob.
- **Nether Shield:** Magma cubes, pigmen, and blazes may block attacks, reflecting damage and igniting players.
- **Phantom Blade:** Phantoms enter invisible state. Shoot Wind Blades applying weakness effect ***New!***
- **Poisoned Slimes:** Slimes may poison players on hit.
- **Quick Mobs:** Monsters move faster, configurable per mob.
- **Shocking Skeleton Arrows:** Skeleton arrows shock players, slowing them.
- **Silverfishes Summon:** Zombies may spawn silverfish on death.
- **Stray Frost:** Strays may shoot frost arrows, freezing players.
- **Spider Web:** Cave spiders may shoot webs to trap players.
- **Spider Nest**: Breaking a Cobweb has a chance to spawn Spiders or Cave Spiders
- **Tanky Monsters:** Monsters take reduced damage, configurable per mob.
- **Thief Slimes:** Slimes may steal EXP from players on hit.
- **Trident's Wrath:** Drowned have a chance to use their Trident to launch at a player. ***New!***
- **Undead Gunners:** Zombies named 'Undead Gunner' cast explosive rockets.
- **Undead Rage:** Zombies and pigmen gain strength and speed when damaged.
- **Witch Scrolls:** Witches may block damage with a shield and cast runes that damage and slow players.
- **Wither Machinegun:** Wither Skeletons throw damaging coal projectiles.
- **Wither Rush:** Wither Skeletons teleport to players, dealing damage.
- **Zombie Break Block:** Zombie with tools in hand can break the corresponding block type ***New!***
- **Zombie Tools:** Zombies have a chance to spawn with random tools ***New!***

  <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/xuVP11NURZo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
  <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/nJhvstEeJyo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
  <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/7GqOPtsJ-2Q" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**Custom Mob System**
Unleash your creativity with **Sudden Death**’s custom mob system! Craft unique monsters with fully adjustable stats and spawn rates to spice up your Minecraft server. While it’s not as intricate as comprehensive plugins like MythicMobs (for example, it doesn’t support custom drops), it’s perfect for those who want a quick, hassle-free way to design mobs without spending hours on setup. Here’s what you can customize for your mobs:
- **Attack Strength**
- **Max Health**
- **Movement Speed**
- **Main & Off-Hand Items**
- **Gear & Equipment**
- **Custom Name Display**
- **Enchantments & Leather Armor Colors for equipped items**
- **Spawn Probability**
- **Potion Effects**
Elevate your server’s challenge and excitement with these tailored monster-making tools!

**Admin and Player GUI**
- Admins can use the admin GUI (/sds admin) to see all features, and to disable/enable them in specific worlds.
- Player can use the player GUI (/sds menu) to see all current enabled features in the server.

**Extra features**
- Cool particle & sound effects for every ability
- All GUI, features can be fully translated.
- **WorldGuard** flags
- Full tab completion system

![Command](https://proxy.spigotmc.org/bb97a71266a9bca5f199810909cddef53f452b03/68747470733a2f2f692e696d6775722e636f6d2f306333304444702e706e67)

- **/sds status** shows your current status (bleeding, infected...).
- **/sds admin** opens up the Admin GUI, where operators can freely enable and disable features.
- **/sds get <item-name>** gives you a specific plugin item.
- **/sds itemlist** shows every custom item, and how to get them.
- **/sds menu** opens the feature view GUI.
- **/sds reload** reloads the configuration file.
- **/sds recipe** opens the crafting recipe GUI.
- **/sds clean** removes bleeding, infected... effects.
- **/sds help** shows the available commands.
- **/sds start/stop** start or stop an event.

- **/sdmob create <type> <mob-id>** creates a new custom monster.
- **/sdmob help** shows the available commands.
- **/sdmob remove <type> <mob-id>** deletes an existing monster.
- **/sdmob edit <type> <mob-id>** opens the Mob Editor GUI.
- **/sdmob list** shows supported monster types.
- **/sdmob list <type>** shows every custom mob of a certain type.
- **/sdmob spawn <type> <mob-id> <amount>** spawn an amount of custom mob

- **suddendeath.status** allow you to open the status GUI. *(default:true)*
- **suddendeath.admin** allow to use admin commands.
- **suddendeath.update-notify** prompts a notification on login when an update is available.
- **suddendeath.recipe** allow to open recipe GUI *(default:true)*

**WorldGuard Flags**
- **sds-effect** Allow/Deny bleeding, infection in a region. *(default: ALLOW)*
- **sds-remove** Allow to remove bleeding, infection effect when players enter a region. *(default: DENY)*
- **sds-event** Allow to disable event in a region. *(default: ALLOW)*
- **sds-break** Allow/Deny zombie with tools can break block in a region *(default: DENY)*

**Dependencies**
- **ProtocolLib**
- **WorldGuard** *[Optional]*
- **SkinsRestorer** *[Optional]*

title: Evolving Sword
description: Transform your humble wooden sword into a legendary weapon that grows stronger with every battle you fight.
body:
# Evolving Sword Mod
![Title of Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4545eedc8723216dc1c4f4e688898c177677a636_0.webp)
**Transform your humble wooden sword into a legendary weapon that grows stronger with every battle you fight.**

## Description

Tired of replacing your weapons every time you find better materials? The Evolving Sword mod revolutionizes combat progression by introducing a single weapon that evolves alongside your adventures. Instead of crafting multiple swords, you'll nurture one blade from its humble wooden origins to an ultimate Ender-tier legendary weapon.

### The Evolution Journey

Your adventure begins deep underground, mining the mysterious **Evolving Stone Ore** - a rare mineral that pulses with transformative energy. Craft your first Evolving Sword and watch as it hungers for experience, growing more powerful with every mob you defeat.

**Seven Evolution Tiers Await:**
- **Wood** → **Stone** → **Iron** → **Gold** → **Diamond** → **Netherite** → **Ender**

Each evolution isn't just a stat boost - it's a complete transformation that unlocks new abilities:

### Unleash Devastating Abilities

**🗡️ Enhanced Combat**
- Extended attack reach that grows with each tier
- Increased attack speed for lightning-fast strikes  
- Life steal to sustain yourself in prolonged battles
- Bleeding effects that make enemies suffer over time

**⚡ Supernatural Powers**
- Movement speed bonuses for swift battlefield mobility
- Fire and lava immunity at higher tiers
- **Teleportation** - The ultimate Ender sword lets you blink across the battlefield

**📈 Strategic Progression**
- Bonus experience from all mob kills accelerates your growth
- Each tier requires more experience, creating meaningful progression choices
- Visual evolution - watch your sword transform as it grows stronger

### Highly Customizable Experience

Server owners and players love the extensive configuration options:
- Adjust XP requirements to match your server's progression speed
- Fine-tune ability values for perfect balance
- Enable/disable specific abilities to create unique gameplay experiences

### Quick Start Guide

1. **Explore and Mine** - Find Evolving Stone Ore in both regular stone and deepslate layers
2. **Forge Your Destiny** - Craft your first sword (2 Evolving Stones + 1 Stick, vertical pattern)
3. **Battle and Grow** - Fight mobs to gain bonus experience with your evolving sword
4. **Evolve** - Press Middle Mouse Button when you have enough XP to unlock the next tier
5. **Become Legendary** - Progress through all seven tiers to achieve ultimate power

## FAQ

**Q: How is this different from just crafting better swords?**  
A: Instead of replacing weapons, you develop an emotional connection with one blade that grows with you. Each evolution unlocks unique abilities impossible with vanilla weapons.

**Q: Will this make the game too easy?**  
A: The mod is balanced around progression - early tiers provide modest bonuses, while game-changing abilities require significant time investment to unlock.

**Q: Can I use this on my server?**  
A: Absolutely! The mod works flawlessly on multiplayer servers and includes extensive config options for server balance.

**Q: How do I repair my evolving sword?**  
A: Use Evolving Stone in an anvil to repair any tier of evolving sword. This makes Evolving Stone valuable throughout your entire progression, not just for initial crafting.

**Q: Do I lose my enchantments and custom name when evolving?**  
A: No! Your sword keeps all enchantments and custom names through every evolution. The blade remembers its entire history as it grows stronger.

---

## Available in 11 Languages

Full localization support for global players:  
English • Spanish (Spain & Chile) • German • French • Italian • Portuguese (Brazil) • Russian • Japanese • Korean • Chinese (Simplified)

---

## Support & Feedback

Join thousands of players who've transformed their Minecraft combat experience! I actively welcome suggestions, balance feedback, and bug reports to keep improving this mod for the community.

title: SiveKoth
description: The All-in-One King of the Hill plugin for Minecraft 1.21+ with GUI editor, scheduler, holograms, rewards, PlaceholderAPI support, and more!
body:
# SiveKoth - King of the Hill

**SiveKoth** is a powerful and feature-rich King of the Hill (KOTH) plugin designed for Minecraft 1.21+ servers running Paper/Purpur. Create exciting PvP events where players compete to control a zone and earn rewards!

## Features

### Two Game Modes
- **CAPTURE Mode** - Hold the zone for a set amount of time to win
- **SCORE Mode** - Earn points by staying in the zone, highest score wins

### Intuitive GUI Editor
- Easy-to-use graphical interface for arena management
- Create, edit, and delete arenas without commands
- Visual arena status indicators

### Automatic Scheduler
- Schedule events using cron expressions
- Configurable timezone support
- Per-arena scheduling options

### Display Systems
- **BossBar** - Real-time event progress display
- **Scoreboard** - Dynamic event information
- **Holograms** - Using Text Display entities (no dependencies!)
- All displays are fully customizable

### Reward System
- Item rewards with custom NBT data
- Command execution support
- Per-placement rewards (1st, 2nd, 3rd)
- Custom enchantments and lore

### Statistics & Leaderboards
- Track wins, captures, time in zone, and kills
- SQLite and MySQL database support
- Top players hologram display

### PlaceholderAPI Integration
- `%sivekoth_wins%` - Player's total wins
- `%sivekoth_captures%` - Player's total captures
- `%sivekoth_time%` - Time spent in zones
- `%sivekoth_kills%` - Kills in zones
- `%sivekoth_top_<position>_name%` - Top players
- `%sivekoth_arena_<name>_status%` - Arena status
- And more!

### Combat Features
- **Knockout System** - Timer resets when attacked
- Configurable knockout duration
- Fair PvP mechanics

### MiniMessage Support
- Modern MiniMessage formatting
- Gradient colors support
- Fully customizable messages

## Commands

- `/koth` - Main command
- `/koth create <name>` - Create new arena
- `/koth delete <name>` - Delete arena
- `/koth start <name>` - Start event
- `/koth stop <name>` - Stop event
- `/koth wand` - Get selection wand
- `/koth gui` - Open arena manager
- `/koth reload` - Reload configuration

## Permissions

- `sivekoth.admin` - Full admin access
- `sivekoth.use` - Basic usage
- `sivekoth.create` - Create arenas
- `sivekoth.delete` - Delete arenas
- `sivekoth.start` - Start events
- `sivekoth.stop` - Stop events
- `sivekoth.gui` - Access GUI
- `sivekoth.wand` - Use selection wand

## Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.21+
- **Server**: Paper/Purpur
- **Java**: 21+
- **Optional**: PlaceholderAPI

## Quick Start

1. Download and place the plugin in your `plugins` folder
2. Start your server
3. Use `/koth wand` to get a selection wand
4. Select your capture zone (left-click pos1, right-click pos2)
5. Use `/koth create <name>` to create an arena
6. Use `/koth start <name>` to begin the event!

---

*Made with love by SiveCraft*

# Spoofer+

A Minecraft mod that lets you **spoof (fake!) your F3 menu and Mod Menu list**.
Currently, in **BETA**.

### Main Uses

* Hide your coordinates (great for SMPs)
* Hide the mod itself
* Add a touch of humour

---

## Features

### Simple/Hidden Manager

* **Keybind:** Default is `G` (configurable under the *General* tab).
* Config file: `/assets/spoof.json` (inside your Minecraft folder).

### Hide Mods

- Need privacy? Delete any mod while Minecraft is running (it’s in RAM already), then hide it from Mod Menu with Spoofer.
- Add mods to the blacklist under the *Mods* section.
- **Note:** It only hides the mod in Mod Menu. The total mod count will still show.

### F3 Menu Spoofing *(Beta)*

- Change details displayed in the F3 menu (more features coming soon).
- Current spoof options:
  - **Coordinates** – Four modes:
    - `DEFAULT` → Normal behaviour
    - `RANDOM` → Randomized values (good for screenshots, not streams)
    - `FIXED` → Stays the same, even when you move
    - `OFFSET` → Shifts your coordinates by a chosen offset (e.g., real: 25/30/73 → offset X:+7 → shows 32/30/73)
  - **FPS** – Works similarly to offset coordinates.
- Works only for the F3 menu. 
- ⚠️ Expected conflicts with *BetterF3*.

---

## Disclaimer

This mod is made **purely for humour and privacy**.
It is **not** intended for cheating, malicious use, or false advertising.
Use responsibly.

title: Moscovium
description: Multiplayer Zombies modpack heavily based on creating different settlement groups, battles, and skirmishes between players while striving to survive in a zombie-infested world. (This can be played single player if you wish to do so!)
body:
[![Discord Invite](https://github.com/DiscRealms/cdn/blob/main/badges/png/discord/cozy.png?raw=true)](https://discord.gg/85ZaBCJTTv)
[![Disc Realms AD](https://github.com/DiscRealms/cdn/blob/main/badges/png/discrealms/cozy.png?raw=true)](https://discrealms.net)

![Moscovium Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33fb9f2cc833385c9c6d37b23ee68895c4c17ad9.png)
What is Moscovium?
- Moscovium (symbol: Mc, atomic number: 115) is a synthetic chemical element in the periodic table. It is found in the Call of Duty Zombies franchise – Used by scientists to create zombies, alter time and space, and create alternate dimensions.

## A MZS* Modpack

Moscovium is a Multiplayer modpack intended to be played by a single group or multiple groups. You can strive in a zombie-infested world alone, with friends, or in a large group, competing against each other to see who can survive the longest. 

*MZS - Multiplayer Zombies Survival

⚠️ macOS: Reduce Resolution on macOS is enabled. If your game is 1/4 the size of the window, just resize the window a little bit to fix!

## Features

- Upon spawning 
- Disabled Nether and End dimensions to limit players to only survive the overworld. 
- Zombie Variants through texture, attributes, and items.
  - Zombies spawn frequently, persist, and do not burn in the sun.
  - Zombies drop some unobtainable items, such as enderpearls, netherwart, and blaze rods.
- Disabled spawning of villagers, forcing you to rely on pure survival tactics rather than cheesing.
  - Curing Zombie Villagers will not revive them; instead, make them disappear.
- TacZ Guns Mod and addons – prepare for battles against other player groups or against large zombie waves that may approach your base.
- New Biomes and Structures across the world, barren and overtaken by zombies – choose a good spot to develop a fortress!
- Open Parties and Claims – create claims around your fortress and invite your teammates to survive alongside you!

## How to Play
Upon creation of a Multiplayer instance or Singleplayer world, these rules should be followed for a full experience:
- You may not make an underground base or have a basement lower than 20 blocks below the ground level on which your fortress is.
- Players should not be allowed to fight each other for the first few days or 2 weeks to allow groups to establish forts and materials.
- Make sure to have fun spending time with your friends <3

## Server Operator Notes
### Modpack Modification 
When playing using a dedicated server from [PebbleHost](https://billing.pebblehost.com/aff.php?aff=4522) or any other hosting service alike, please make sure to remove client-sided mods such as sodium, iris, entity culling, etc. 
### server.properties
As recommended, set these options in the server.properties file of your Fabric Server instance when using this modpack.
```yaml
allow-nether=true
# Disables the Nether (Mod handles disabling portals and End)
difficulty=hard
# Maximizes difficulty of the modpack (Optionally enable Hardcore if wanted)
enforce-secure-profile=false
# Disables Chat Reports within the server (Modpack comes with NoChatReports)
pvp=false
# Disable PVP for the first few days, optionally.
```
### Setting up for Players
From the console, please set this to allow for the best experience:
```sh
/gamerule spawnradius 200 
# Players will spawn within a 200 block radius of the spawn point (Optionally increase to your liking)
```

## Hosting

To play with friends, you can use 2 of these recommended hosting methods or choose your own!

[![E4MC Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qANg5Jrr/40269a95e1e4237e9204e0f8b2172cbf4658c9c1_96.webp)](https://modrinth.com/mod/e4mc)
### E4MC
You can host the world directly from your computer for friends to join! However, due to the modpack’s high requirements, your computer may struggle. (Note: Simple Voicechat is not compatible with E4MC.)

[![Pebblehost Icon](https://pebblehost.com/src/img/logos/main.png)
](https://billing.pebblehost.com/aff.php?aff=4522)
### Pebblehost
Deploy your server instantly with Pebblehost! Enjoy great locations and low ping for seamless 24/7 hosting with your friends. Multiple ports let you use Simple Voicechat to enhance your gameplay experience!

title: UpgradeMyDog
description: A lightweight, configurable plugin that allows players to level up their pet wolves (dogs). Improve their health, damage, and speed to turn your loyal companion into a true ally.
body:
## Overview
Tired of your loyal canine companions being left behind as you progress? **UpgradeMyDog** transforms vanilla wolves from simple pets into powerful, evolving allies with a deep and engaging progression system. Level them up, enhance their stats, and even grant them new abilities like carrying items. Give your players a reason to cherish their pets again!

This plugin is designed to be lightweight, highly configurable, and intuitive for both players and server administrators.

---
## ✨ Core Features

### Dynamic Leveling System
- **Level Up Through Combat:** Your dogs gain experience and level up by helping you fight hostile mobs.
- **Health Boost:** With each level, your dog's maximum health increases, making them more durable in battle. The formula is fully configurable.

### Unique Attribute Upgrades
Your dog's main level is just the beginning. Players can specialize their companions through two distinct upgrade paths:
- **Damage Upgrade:** Feed your dog a specific item (default: Cooked Rabbit, fully configurable) to increase its damage output.
- **Speed Upgrade:** Splash your dog with Potions of Speed to permanently increase its movement speed.

### 🐾 Doggy Chests - Mobile Storage!
- **Unlock a New Utility:** Once a dog reaches a certain health threshold (configurable), players can attach a chest to it by shift-right-clicking.
- **Your Items are Safe:** The dog becomes a mobile storage unit! If the dog unfortunately dies, all of its items will safely drop on the ground.
- **Fully Customizable:** The inventory size, title, and the entire feature can be configured or disabled in the `config.yml`.

---
## 💻 Commands & Permissions
The plugin features a powerful interactive command to manage and view pets.

- **/petinfo** (Aliases: `/doginfo`, `/mydogs`)
  - **Permission:** (No permission required by default for players)
  - **Function:** Displays a detailed, clickable list of all your pets, showing their current Level, Health, Damage, Speed, and Chest status. Hover over any stat to get a tooltip on how to improve it!

- **Secure Pet Removal**
  - **Permission:** (No permission required by default for players)
  - **Function:** Clicking the `[-]` button next to a pet's name in `/petinfo` initiates a secure, two-step removal process to prevent accidents. The player must type `/petinfo confirm` to finalize the removal.

- **/upgrademydog reload**
  - **Permission:** `upgrademydog.reload` (default: op)
  - **Function:** Reloads the entire plugin configuration without needing a server restart.

---
## 🔧 Highly Configurable
We believe every server is unique. That's why nearly every aspect of **UpgradeMyDog** can be tailored to your needs in the well-commented `config.yml`.

- **Formulas:** Change all calculations for leveling, health gain, and upgrade requirements.
- **Items:** Define which item is used for the damage upgrade.
- **Messages:** Customize or translate every single message shown to players.
- **Features:** Enable or disable major features like the Doggy Chest system.

---
*We hope you and your players enjoy creating truly legendary companions with UpgradeMyDog!*

title: XP Tools
description: Minecraft Forge mod for tweaking various things about XP in Minecraft. Primarily targeted at modpack developers.
body:
![Banner artwork.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54e430c3c984ce6865495604052d52cbecbc8762.jpeg)

This mod currently lets you change the XP drops of blocks and entities. It lets you specify lists of operations to perform on the XP drops of either all block/entities or specific ones (by ID or TAG). You can also specify a range for your value if you want a randomized amount. Operations are ordered by their specified priorities.

Note: This is a server-sided mod and the configuration file will be generated per-world inside the serverconfig folder.

Example configuration for block breaking:

_The following sets the XP drops of all blocks to 0. Then it adds 0-10 XP for all blocks tagged `#minecraft:mineable/shovel` and sets the XP of blocks tagged `#forge:ores` to 2-5._
```
#Settings for block breaking
[block_breaking]
	#Available operations: [SET, ADD, SUBTRACT, MULTIPLY, DIVIDE]
	#List of global operations. Format: '[operation],[min],[max],[priority]'
	#Global operations are run before any unique operations.
	#Examples:
	#'set,0,0,0' - Sets the xp of all blocks to 0.
	blockBreakGlobalOperations = ["set,0,0,0"]
	#List of unique operations. Format: '[block_id/tag_id],[operation],[min],[max],[priority],[is_last]'
	#Examples:
	#'minecraft:dirt,set,2,2,0,true' - Sets the xp drop of the dirt block to 2, takes highest priority and stops any additional operations.
	#'#forge:ores,multiply,1,2,1,false' - Multiplies xp drop of all blocks tagged forge:ores by 1-2, allows additional operations.
	blockBreakOperations = ["#minecraft:mineable/shovel,add,0,10,0,false", "#forge:ores,set,2,5,0,false"]
```

# Brighter Ores

A resource pack that makes ores emissive in vanilla minecraft.

As of Java Edition 1.21.2, Mojang added light_emission to models, allowing glowing models in vanilla.

All existing emissive ores resource packs require optifine or iris or another mod as far as I know.

Also, I saw the [emissive torchflowers resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/glowing-torchflowers), and decided to do that for ores.

description:
An RPG modpack with a hardcore twist.

Featuring Magic, Tech and Adventure mods.

body:
# WIP under development

# Welcome to Nine Lives!
For some unknown reason, Felinox, Keeper of the Void, has taken a special interest in your life and has granted you nine lives to do with as you please. How will you spend your newfound lives, and what adventures will you go on?

# Hardcore
Prepare yourself for an RPG challenge with a hardcore twist, where danger lurks around every corner and only the strongest survive. Every decision counts and every fight matters. Players will begin their journey with 9 hardcore lives. Once they are killed by an enemy or fall due to poor decision making, they are put into a downed state and will need another player to revive them, preventing the loss of a hardcore life (Multiplayer feature). After all 9 lives are extinguished, the player is put into a permanent ghost state unless another player can revive them from beyond the grave.

# Mods
Nine Lives features a carefully curated selection of high-quality mods. This modpack delivers an immersive and challenging experience, perfect for veterans and new players alike. 

While the crafting is simple (Expert pack soon?), the hardcore element adds a dangerous edge to every moment. Are you building something with explosive potential? Maybe your factory is a lot taller than you thought? One wrong move and a life is easily lost.

# Performance
This modpack is built on a combination of [Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop) and [Adrenaline](https://modrinth.com/modpack/adrenaline) to ensure a seamless, optimised, and lag-free adventure. This pack ensures you can dive deep into your favourite mods without any performance hiccups, with the smoothest gameplay possible emphasizing the focus on building and learning, and less on the technical limitations of your creations.

title: Hardcore Hearts Stream Team Sound Pack
description: This is a Minecraft resource pack containing sounds featuring various Twitch streamers in CarlCrafts' Hardcore Hearts Stream Team.
body:
# Hardcore Hearts Sound Pack

## 📢👉Version 1.0 is out now, featuring [Sir_Nipplington](https://www.twitch.tv/sir_nipplington)!

## What's this all about?
This is a Minecraft resource pack containing sounds featuring various Twitch streamers in [CarlCrafts](https://www.twitch.tv/carlcrafts)' Hardcore Hearts Stream Team.  The long-term goal of the project is to eventually include sounds from every active team member.

## Follow The Stream Team
* Catch their live streams on [Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/team/hardcorehearts), and tell them Kuoxsr sent you.

## How to install
1. In Minecraft's main menu, click "Options"
2. Click "Resource Packs."
3. At the bottom of the screen that appears, click "Open Pack Folder."
4. Drop the zip file into this folder using your file manager and then return to Minecraft.  You should see the pack in the list at the left side of the screen (Available)
5. Click the arrow on the pack to move it to the right side of the screen (Selected)
6. Click "Done" and play the game.

## Bug reports
Please report any bugs or issues or feature requests you have on the project's Github [issues](https://github.com/Kuoxsr/hardcore-hearts-sound-pack/issues) page.
#### Suggestions for new additions
If you hear a streamer in the Hardcore Hearts Stream Team say something or make a sound that would be a great addition to the pack, do the following:

* Take a clip of the word or phrase, and publish it
	- Remember to keep a link to the clip
* Open an [issue](https://github.com/Kuoxsr/hardcore-hearts-sound-pack/issues) on the GitHub page for this project
	- Describe the interesting word or phrase from the clip
	- Include a link to the clip
	- Name the Minecraft event you think the clip would be good for

## Currently featured in this pack:
- [CarlCrafts](https://www.twitch.tv/carlcrafts) Secret jump-scare
- [JazzLikeOnion](https://www.twitch.tv/jazzlikeonion) Enderman: scream, Ghast: warn, Player: fall damage, Villager: ambient, trade
- 🎉 [Sir_Nipplington](https://www.twitch.tv/sir_nipplington) Cow: death, Phantom: ambient, hurt, Player: burp, Villager: ambient, celebrate, death, hurt, no, trade, yes, Witch: ambient, celebrate, Zombie_villager: ambient
- [Tamildin](https://www.twitch.tv/tamildin) Witch: ambient, Villager: hurt
- [TheBakedDean](https://www.twitch.tv/thebakeddean) Villager: death, hurt

## Full changelog and technical notes
Check out  [this document](https://github.com/Kuoxsr/hardcore-hearts-sound-pack/blob/main/changelog.md) for a full change log, and if you really enjoy reading, you can take a look at the [technical information](https://github.com/Kuoxsr/hardcore-hearts-sound-pack/blob/main/technical-notes.md) about the inner workings of the pack.

Yes.. **MULTIPLE** TARDIS mods

### Exploration

Important to note, the generation is vanilla! Yet, there are many new structures and villages look nothing like normal. Find HUGE underground bunkers FILLED with loot and enjoy YUNG's Better.. basically everything.

### Transportation

There are many ways of moving around in this modpack. Be it by trains, jetpack, plane, car, airship, watership, waystone, walking or **TARDIS**... The choice is YOURS!

Im a big fan of automation so technology mods are a MUST, this pack contains **AE2**, **Modern Industrialization** **Create**, **Ad Astra**, **CC:T**, **Flux Networks** and most importantly **K9**!

Possibly asked questions

### What is the purpose of this pack?

This pack serves as a way for me to not lose my pack if i mess it up (by adding more mods) and easily sharing it with friends.


### How does the pack run?

This runs fairly ok but has only been tested on a beefy computer. It is not recommended to play on a low-end PC.

### Should you play it?

This pack is higly **UNTESTED** and will probably crash at some point. There are a few optimisation mods but things **WILL** lag a bit when loading stuff. It will get updates as I play with it and make it crash myself. If this sounds appealing then go for it! What is there to loose?

### Can this be used on a server?

Yes! All you need to do is make a fabric server with the same loader version, then add all the mods from your instance's mods folder execpt Distant Horizons.

description: An Enhanced Vanilla Experience: Performance, Quality of Life Features, and Aesthetic Upgrades
body:
## Archived: This modpack isn't staying up to date, but it still works perfectly fine on version 1.20.2


## Quick Summary: My favorite way to play Minecraft: vanilla gameplay, but with optimized performance, quality of life features, and aesthetic upgrades. Works perfectly when playing on servers, as everything in the pack is primarily client-side (only affects you). Of course, feel free to add, remove, or reconfigure whatever you like, as this pack and its description are intended to be a source of discovery. If you have a question, suggestion, recommendation, feedback, or notice an issue, post it in my [Discord](https://discord.gg/wGJ2JKnBtB)!


## Core: ⚙️ The Foundation for everything else - Fabric API - Cloth Config API - Indium - Sodium - Iris - Mod Menu


## Performance: 🔥 The Current Leading Performance Mods - x3 FPS! Referenced from [Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop) I recommend allocating 2-4GB of RAM (≈2000-3800MiB). - Immediately Fast - Entity Culling - Exordium - Krypton - ModernFix - More Culling - Concurrent Chunk Management Engine - FerriteCore - Enhanced Block Entities - Lithium
***Settings for Maximum Performance**:* - turn shaders off or use a lighter one     - *high impact* - lower render & simulation distance       - *high impact* - graphics from fancy to fast                   - *medium impact* - particles to minimal                               - *impact depends on amount of nearby particles* - cap framerate at about 10-20fps above your monitor's refresh rate - *can lower system thermals and improve framerate consistency* - disable/remove always-active QoL features (Auto Hud, Dynamic Crosshair, Ambient Sounds) - *low impact* - toggle off FPS - Display and Coordinates Display when not using - *low impact, less intensive than F3* - If you use NVIDIA, I highly recommend turning "background application max framerate" to 24fps in NVIDIA Control Panel. Does the same thing as Dynamic FPS mod but better. - If you use NVIDIA and don't use shaders, Nvidium is an extremely effective performance mod you can add.


## QoL Features: ➕ - No Chat Reports       - *protection from losing account due to new report/moderation systems* - Continuity                 - *connected glass* - Gamma Utils             - *toggle see in the dark* - Lighty                       - *indicates light levels for mob spawning* - GrassKiss                 - *grass is ignored when using weapons* - FreeCam                   - *gives an ability similar to spectator mode while in survival* - Zoomify                     - *toggle zoom*   - ItemPhysic Lite         - *items behave more realistically* - AmbientSounds       - *adds immersive ambient sounds, such as birds chirping* - Xaero's World Map - Xaero's MiniMap - Coordinates Display - FPS - Display


## Resource Packs: 🌿 - New Glowing Ores     - *glowing diamonds & debris (modified)* - Ore Grids                   - *adds an outline to all other ores except copper (modified)* - Fast Better Grass     - *grass blocks are green on every face instead of only the top* - Rain Revamp             - *desaturates rain to look more realistic* - Seagrass Fix             - *seagrass doesn't stick out of water* - [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/)         - *a lot of small aesthetic changes that enhance the game*

## Shaders: 🌅 My Favorite Shaders that I actually play with because they're beautiful and are light enough to run well on my mid-tier pc. Makeup & Sildur's Enhanced are relatively light shaders that manage to look stunning, while Sildur's Basic & VanillAA are super light shaders that subtly enhance the vanilla look. - MakeUp-Ultrafast - [Silder's Enhanced Default](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/shaders/sildurs-enhanced-default) - [Silder's Basic Shaders](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/shaders/sildurs-basic-shaders) - VanillAA


## Recommendations: ✔️ - First, configure your controls/keybinds to taste, as well as other settings. If you have already perfectly configured your settings elsewhere and don't want to manually do it again for this pack, you can simply copy your options.txt from your other .minecraft and paste it into the .minecraft of this pack (deleting the existing one ofc). - If you want to play your existing worlds, copy their folders (found in "saves" in your .minecraft) and paste them into the "saves" folder of this pack. - If you have already used one of the mods in this pack and would like to use the configurations you've already made, simply copy the config file of said mod and paste it into the .minecraft of this pack (deleting the existing one ofc). - My preferred shader settings are in the gallery. If you would like to try them out without manually changing your settings, I included my .txt config file within the .zip of each shader, and all you have to do is move it outside of the shader's .zip folder into the shaderpacks folder for them to automatically apply. - **NOTICE**: Lithium must have the following config to be compatible with GrassKiss and not crash the game (included in this pack): **mixin.shapes.lazy_shape_context=false**


## Cool Stuff Not Included: Not everyone may like these, so I didn't include them in this pack, but I think they're worth mentioning. - Dynamic Crosshair   - *crosshair only visible when in range to interact with block or entity* - Auto Hud                   - *health, hunger, etc. only visible when relevant* - ClearDespawn           - *items blink just before despawning* - Fresh Animations - BetterEnd - Distant Horizons - Craftify - Better F3 - Reece’s Sodium Options - Sodium Extra - Complementary Shaders - BSL Shaders - Bliss - Solas Shader


## Extra: - To use Modrinth modpacks, use [MultiMC](https://multimc.org/), the Modrinth app, or another supported launcher. - [Install/Update Java](https://thebreakdown.xyz/how-to-download-install-the-java-se-development-kit/) (needed for all MC mods) - Update Graphics Drivers (at least once every 6 months) [link for NVIDIA users](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/drivers/) (strongly recommend NOT installing GeForce Experience bloatware) - [icon image source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/wooden-robot-6069/) - If you wish to use this pack as a starting point for your own, go for it! If you plan to distribute it, please be sure that it's truly unique and properly give credit where credit is due: name everything included and link everything that came from outside of Modrinth (not all of them require it, but it's a good practice anyway). If you use the same or similar performance mods and their configurations, please link Simply Optimized and state that you referenced it. Please include a link to this pack if you leave its contents relatively similar. Thanks!

title: Unfairly Hard Minecraft
description: A 1.16.5+ Minecraft server plugin that makes Minecraft much harder!
body:
This is **Unfairly Hard MC**, a _plugin_ that makes the Minecraft experience _much_ harder and introduces new game mechanics to make your gameplay experience more miserable. 

Features include sudden overwhelming mob spawns, sudden random damage, overall hurt damage multipliers, blocks deciding not to drop at random, fast hunger depletion, and faster mobs, among other things.

**How to set up (to play by yourself)**
Set up a local Minecraft "Paper" server. Do not use the software Microsoft provides - it does not support plugins. Find a tutorial on how to set up the server. It must be 1.16.5 or later. If you have a local server already, skip this step.
Drag and drop the downloaded JAR into the "plugins" directory inside your server's directory.
Start the server. If it is running, restart it.
You're done!

**How to set up (on a public server)**
Repeat Step 2 from the play by yourself tutorial, but instead put the plugin inside the "plugins" folder on your public server.

**How to activate:**
Type into chat "/setdifficulty sigmasonly" (must be an operator to use, or else nothing happens)

_This is a beta. **Don't use this on a server if you don't have a backup.**_

_This plugin is only compatible with **Minecraft 1.16.5 and later versions** at the moment. More support will come soon._

title: Chat Translation Mod
description: This Minecraft mod translates chat messages into your chosen language with a single click. It uses the Google Apps Script (GAS) API for translation.
body:
> 

# Chat Translation Mod
A mod that translates Minecraft chat messages into your specified language with a single click. The translation is done via the Google Apps Script (GAS) API. It works on the Fabric environment, Minecraft Version 1.21.11 or 26.2.

***

**If setting it up is too much trouble, you can just copy the following link and paste to API URL (config/translator-url.txt):**
```
https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbyoiiASzJr_SNFV9Wn5388f03C8jKuz6IQMrRVt-AejbhKaDjO0BXxvQw_zp2rkv05g-w/exec
```

***

## How to Use
You must complete these steps to enable translations.  

**Step 1.** Log in to your Google account and go to https://script.google.com/.  
**Step 2.** Create a new project. You can name it anything you like, such as "Minecraft Translation API".  
**Step 3.** Select and delete all the default code, then paste the following code:  
```javascript
function doGet(e) {
  var {text, target = 'ja', source = ''} = e.parameter;
  var translatedText = LanguageApp.translate(text, source, target);
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(translatedText).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.TEXT);
}
```
**Step 4.** Click the "Deploy" button and choose "New deployment". Set the type to "Web app". You can enter any description. Set "Execute as" to "Me" and "Who has access" to "Anyone", then click the "Deploy" button.  
**Step 5.** Copy the generated Web App URL (which looks like `https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec`) to complete this step. Do not share this URL with anyone!  
**Step 6.** Place the downloaded `.jar` file into your `mods` folder.  
**Step 7.** Launch Minecraft once and close it. This will generate the configuration files in your `config` folder.  
**Step 8.** Open `translator-url.txt`, paste the translation API URL (GAS, etc.) you prepared in the previous step, and save the file.  
**Step 9.** Open `translator-lang.txt` to change the target language code (e.g., `en` for English, `ja` for Japanese). Default language is Japanese(ja).
  
***
* If you have any questions, feature requests, or encounter issues, please send me a DM on Discord. 
* Discord Username: @nuyuchi

title: Hoyocraft
description: Bring the exploration of Genshin Impact into your Minecraft world. Hoyocraft introduces plenty of iconic creatures and monsters from the game!
body:
# Hoyocraft (Alpha)

Welcome to **Hoyocraft**, an unofficial expansion designed to integrate the creatures, mechanics, and environmental elements of Genshin Impact into Minecraft. This project represents a dedicated learning endeavor to translate these distinct behaviors into a block based sandbox environment.

---

## Core Features

### Ambient AI & Behaviors
To make the world feel more dynamic, entities feature custom idle AI when out of combat. Hilichurls can be observed resting near campfires or foraging for resources, while ambient wildlife will react to player presence.

### Abyssal Invasions
An event system driven by customizable JSON configurations. Naturally, an invasion has a chance to trigger every five in game days, or it can be manually initiated by players with appropriate permissions using the command:
`/hoyo startinvasion`
Once active, Abyssal Portals will manifest and spawn progressive waves of enemies, offering a challenging defense event.

![portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e56aeb3b57d2f2a408dce3481ecf9b80baa0dd73.png)

![abyss](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85931c868698964a4d48e59ea8297016711bb094.png)
  
### Dynamic Group Spawning
Instead of spawning entirely in isolation, certain "Leader" class entities can spawn and establish small camps. Once a camp is established, reinforcement entities of the same faction will be dynamically attracted to the area, creating more natural enemy encounters.

---

## Current Entity Roster (Alpha 1.0.0)
  
### Monsters

*   **Hilichurl Fighter:** The standard, club wielding variant of the Hilichurl family. They utilize multiple attack styles and have a chance to spawn as a Leader to establish camps.

![hilichurls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d52215e88f522b7172045767199f10c298a5b562.png)

*   **Ruin Guard:** A massive, ancient mechanical defender that features distinct active, waking, and sleeping states depending on how it generates in the world.

![ruinguard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5b9b97c309eb6f1555ceef4a4c12969d7298933.png)

*   **Hydro Slime:** Spawns exclusively in aquatic areas. It is capable of sliding across water surfaces and regenerates health when exposed to rain or standing water.

![hydroslime](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6339a68017053fcf7eafffa5e9aa683892817f0d.png)

*   **Pyro Slime:** Completely immune to fire and resides in lava. It regenerates health while submerged in lava and solidifies adjacent water blocks into cobblestone.

![pyroslime](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c13798d6a6bba52ad5a16677809fcd2d4cd4943.png)

*   **Cryo Slime:** Found in colder biomes. It naturally freezes adjacent water blocks into ice as it travels across them.

![cryoslime](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2088574554a14aad6b238248b5535a65f1e1bdb.png)

*   **Electro Slime:** Features distinct "charged" and "discharged" states, becoming significantly more dangerous while glowing. During thunderstorms, it can attract lightning strikes to forcefully restore its health and charged state.

![electroslime](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e80aceb47004fa4d53daee9f75245e4316354bf.png)

*   **Dendro Slime:** A stealth-oriented entity that remains hidden underground, emerging only to ambush targets. If spotted while peeking, it will panic and retreat. Exposure to fire will burn away its foliage, permanently disrupting its ability to hide underground.

![dendro](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61145a1afb58490d939cfa24e052b400438a14d9.png)

*   **Anemo Slime:** An exceptionally lightweight entity capable of performing aerial dash attacks and falling at a greatly reduced speed.

![anemoslime](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c08d501eefae0fe5b0faa6a758ef7fc5ba79b505.png)

*   **Geo Slime:** A highly resilient, tank-like variant equipped with natural armor and significant knockback resistance.

![geo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81edfd64b7517bf62d141264c184c5a05b739a98.png)

### Wildlife

*   **Finch:** Ambient birds featuring four distinct visual variants. They will take flight and relocate to a new landing spot if approached too closely.

![finch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc8ce1283fb4ad63bd1328bcf6f30a7fb9c2e09f.png)

*   **Boar:** Forest dwelling mammals that will actively flee from players and attackers. When harmed, they will alert nearby wildlife to flee with them. If cornered or startled, they can execute a high speed charging attack before retreating.

---

## Disclaimer & Community Feedback

> ⚠️ **Important Notice:** Hoyocraft is currently in a very early **Alpha** stage of development. As a solo project developed alongside the learning process, you will likely encounter bugs, unfinished features, and unpolished attributes. 

To report issues, share ideas, or join the discussion, please join the official Discord server:
**Discord Invitation:** https://discord.gg/pWSa7sxZ5

Thank you for testing the mod and supporting the project. Your participation is greatly appreciated.

title: Spacetime Traverse
description: Adds features that enable spatial teleportation.
body:
# Spacetime Traverse

- **X(Twitter)**
- **GitHub**
--- 日本語の説明は下にあります。

This Mod adds functionality enabling spacetime travel.
This Mod is an addon for TokorotenSlime, so you'll also need to download that as well.
## Position Swap - You can swap your position, rotation, and some states with an entity you are looking at within a 30-block radius. - If the distance to the entity the player is looking at is within 4 blocks, it will randomly swap with an entity inside a block within 30 blocks (the player is excluded in this case). - In this case, it faces the direction of the coordinates before the swap. - **The default key is R.** ## Spatial Teleportation ### Crafting - Crafting requires 1 Ender Eye, 4 Netherite Ingots, and 4 Nether Stars.
![spacetime_eye_recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15b4c20ce02adfa4f05fd939bda84a4f94f22b5c.png) ### Specifications - Using the item unlocks an advancement, which allows access to the Portal Action Button. - In the Waypoint List screen, you can register, edit, delete, quick-register waypoints, and place portals. - When registering a waypoint, the current player coordinates are entered by default. - If the dimension field is left blank, it defaults to overworld. If specified, a valid dimension name must be entered. - You can register up to 10 waypoints. - Quick Register allows you to spawn a portal to a registered waypoint without opening the waypoint list screen. - Pressing a specific key allows you to spawn or remove a portal. - If there is no block beneath the player when warping, a temporary platform block will appear.(It will not appear if the entity is airborne.) - This temporary block only disappears over time, and will vanish if no entity is detected for 2 seconds. - The portal will not appear if there is an entity at the intended spawn location. - Portals automatically disappear after approximately 1 minute. - Chunks containing an active portal remain loaded.

- **C key (default)**: Spawns a portal linked to the quick-registered waypoint. If pressed while looking at your own portal, the portal will be removed. - **C key (default) + Ctrl**: Opens the Waypoint List screen.

- The swap ability is enhanced, adding velocity during the swap. - Press **R (default) + Ctrl** to use the original(non-enhanced) behavior. --- --- The English explanation is above.

このModは時空間移動を可能とする機能を追加します。
このModはTokorotenSlimeのアドオンであるため、そちらもダウンロードが必要です。
## 位置入れ替え - 半径30ブロック以内のブロックの内側にある目線を向けているエンティティと位置・向き・一部状態を入れ替えることができます。 - 目線を向けている先のエンティティとの距離が4ブロック以内であった場合、30ブロック以内のブロックの内側にあるエンティティとランダムで入れ替わります(この場合プレイヤーは対象外です)。 - この場合は、入れ替わる前の座標の方向を向きます。 - **デフォルトキーはRです。** ## 空間移動 ### クラフト - エンダーアイ、ネザライトインゴットx4、ネザースターx4をクラフトに使用します。
![current_features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15b4c20ce02adfa4f05fd939bda84a4f94f22b5c.png) ### 仕様 - アイテムを使用することで実績を解除し、ポータルアクションボタンを使用することができるようになります。 - ウェイポイントリスト画面では、ウェイポイントを登録、編集、削除、クイック登録、ポータル設置をすることができます。 - 登録時、座標は今いる地点がデフォルトで入力されてます。 - ディメンションは、未入力時はoverworld、入力時は適切な入力が必要です。 - ウェイポイントの登録は最大10個まで可能です。 - クイック登録では、登録したウェイポイント先へ行くポータルをリスト画面を表示せず出現させることができます。 - 特定のキーを押すことで、ポータル出現、消滅させることができます。 - ワープ時、足場がなかった場合一時的な足場ブロックが出現します。(エンティティが空中状態だった場合出現しません) - このブロックは時間でのみ消滅し、2秒間エンティティを検知できなかったら消滅します。 - ポータルは、出現予定場所にエンティティがある場合出現しません。 - ポータルは約1分で自動消滅します。 - ポータルのあるチャンクはロードし続けます。

- **Cキー(デフォルト)**: クイック登録されたウェイポイント情報を持つポータルを出現させる(自分のポータルに目線を向けたまま押した場合、ポータルが消滅します) - **Cキー(デフォルト) + Ctrlキー**: ウェイポイントリスト画面を表示

- また、位置入れ替えが強化され、入れ替えに速度が追加されます。 - **Rキー(デフォルト)+Ctrlキー**で強化前の仕様と使い分けることが可能です。

# Moar Charcoal Datapack
Do you ever feel like charcoal is completely useless? Well, not anymore. This datapack adds an abundance of recipes to smelt things into charcoal, making it something you'll incorporate into your usual Minecraft playthrough.

## How It Works
In a furnace, you can put in anything that seems like it would burn, along with fuel, and it will smelt into charcoal. From planks to bamboo to an elytra, you'll be smelting your old tools and excess blocks into fuel that you can use in the future.

## Why This Matters
More Use Cases: Charcoal is an easy resource to get, instead of coming from a costly one log per piece. Now, virtually anything wooden can be smelted into a better source of fuel.

Get Rid of Old Things: Instead of throwing away wooden tools and excess planks, they can be turned into charcoal and smelted into a renewable fuel.

## Compatibility
Works in 1.21+

Compatible with most other datapacks.

## Intended Experience
This datapack is made for players who want to use charcoal more and add plenty of ways to get it.

title: Connected Textures By Blond
description: The definitive CTM pack. Maybe
body:
![The cover image for the resource pack, featuring a bunch of connected textures.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6abda2fd74d34a00c760dc8c15ead67637bd1d5f.png)

This is a resource pack that takes a bunch of Minecraft's textures and connects them together!

"Aren't there already tons of these kinds of resource packs?", I hear you ask, and the answer to that question is... kinda not really? Sure, there are plenty connected texture packs out there, but most of them are either incomplete, not up to date, or have rather *interesting* design choices.

The goal of *this* connected texture pack is to provide a definitive CTM experience. This shouldn't be *a* CTM pack, it should be ***the*** CTM pack!

### Disclaimer
This definitive CTM experience doesn't support connected glass right now. I'll get it done soon!  Before 26.3!! I promise!!! [' > ,]

Speaking of missing support, this definitive CTM experience is also not complete and is still in development. Pretty much everything important is done (except glass [*' > ,*]), but there are still plenty of blocks I want to add CTM support to including but not limited to workstations and chiseled blocks!

### Compatibility
This resource pack requires a mod that uses either uses the **McPatcher CTM** format or the **Fusion CTM** format. (Yea it works with both lol d[^ ^ ]z)
- [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) and [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/home) support the **McPatcher CTM** format.
- [Fusion](https://modrinth.com/mod/fusion-connected-textures) supports the **Fusion CTM** format.
- I didn't know ConnectedTexturesMod, ya know, the mod called "CTM", doesn't use the classic McPatcher CTM format. I'll look into adding support for it at some point in the future.

This pack also has a sister pack called [Connected Double Slabs By Blond](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/connected-double-slabs-by-blond) which gives double slab blocks their own textures for building and distinguishability!

### Special Thanks
**MASSIVE** shoutout to my best friend for making a program to help create the texture files needed for all of this to work. This whole thing *would* have been possible without Jake's help, but *man* it would've been slow and painful.

The tool is [here](https://github.com/JakeThe28th/ctm_tool) if you want to check it out and use it yourself!

<details>
<summary>Terms of Use</summary>
  
For the sake of transparency, while this is under All Rights Reserved, there are plenty of things you are allowed to do with this resource pack. *Note that this list is subject to change in the future. Likely if I find a license that actually has all this stuff included.*
  
### You are allowed to:
- Include this resource pack in any modpacks, videos, and/or showcases. While not required, linking back to this project would be *highly* appreciated!
- Make and upload your own resource packs using this style to add support for more mods provided you try not to include files from this project and clarify that it was made by someone else. "Unofficial", if you will.
- Steal and modify non-unique assets from this project to help make your own resource packs (like the pack.mcmeta file). Ye.

### You are ***NOT*** allowed to:
- Reupload this pack to other resource pack hosting sites, *especially* not scammy ones.
- Port this resource pack to Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, or any other Minecrafts, Bedrocks, or Editions.
- Redistribute a modified version of this resource pack.
- Attempt to sell this thing. Come on now.
- Steal unique assets. Generic stuff like core shaders and "items" .json files are perfectly fine to take and reference, but don't grab a texture from this and put it into your own pack please.

title: Petlings
description: Petlings gives you a pet to interact and play with in Minecraft.
body:
# Petlings

  **Your virtual pet companion in Minecraft.** Adopt, customize, and bond with AI-driven pets that follow you everywhere, across the game, the web, and soon mobile.

  > 📌 **What's new in 0.6.0**: picker UI overhaul, animated cosmetics (spinning haloes, turning gears, propellers), mood-driven textures, idle-watch sleep animations, and a major pet-shake fix. Full changelog at the bottom.

![Petlings Family](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/425ef40787cb09873f626cfbb996a23df5a1a697.png)

  ---

  ## What is Petlings?

  Petlings adds **client-side pet companions** to Minecraft. Pick from 42 pet species, dress them up with 150+ 3D cosmetics, teach them emotes, and watch them develop unique personalities. Your pet syncs across devices, so the same pet you see in Minecraft also appears on [petlings.gg](https://petlings.gg) and
  the upcoming iOS app.

  No server install required - Petlings runs entirely on your client.

  ---

  ## ✨ Features

  ### 42 Pet Species
  Cats, wolves, foxes, axolotls, baby dragons, elemental slimes, wisps, lantern imps, pigmy krakens, pocket phoenixes, mini gryphons, shadowling wolves, star sprites, nimbus pups, and more. Each has variants, randomized personality traits, and (for the May 2026 Bloom-release pets) **mood-driven texture
  switching**.

![Duck Parade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5670cb87aee95c1545f9670ec02db35a13202524.gif)

  ### 150+ 3D Cosmetics
  Hats, glasses, capes, wings, weapons, trails, ears, tails, horns, collars, boots, back-items. All rendered as full 3D models attached to your pet, **animated cosmetics included**: the Storm Halo spins, the Clockwork Collar's gear turns, the Propeller Pack's blades spin.

![Pet Selector](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c32d3b8d8a47518afa5b4ee5a39a572a13c1d49.png)

  ### Pet AI with Personality
  Pets follow you with smooth pathfinding, idle animations, wandering, sitting, playing, looking, and after 30 seconds of not moving, they curl up and sleep with a per-pet one-shot animation. Each pet has randomized playfulness / curiosity / laziness traits that drive behavior.

  ### Emote System
  19 emotes across five categories: Greeting (wave, nod, bow), Dance (spin, hop dance, wiggle), Expression (happy jump, confused, sad droop, angry stomp, love hearts), Action (sit, beg, roll over, play dead, sleep), Trick (backflip, handstand, fetch). Press **Y** for the emote wheel.

![Thunder](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2370112733627eb5b9b296865381045c96b38a28.gif)

![Rainbow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39b3a0d06152584c0514ad08d719eb88a8a07af1.gif)

  ### Multiplayer
  See other players' pets with their cosmetics, tints, and emotes in real-time. Works server-wide on any backend, no plugins required.

  ### Cosmetic Editor
  Fine-tune the position, scale, and rotation of each cosmetic slot per pet type. Save profiles per pet.

  ### Pet Leveling & Abilities
  Feed, play with, and pet your companion to earn XP. Unlock **6 abilities**: Head Mount, Night Vision, Ore Radar, Swift Companion, Pet Satchel, Combat Buddy.

  ### Cross-Platform Sync
  Your pet, cosmetics, level, and stats sync to the cloud. Log in from any device and pick up where you left off.

  ![Hats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f67cd378650dbbf90adb04ae06b2e475c3994324.png)

  ---

  ## 🎮 Controls

  | Key | Action |
  |---|---|
  | **O** | Open pet menu |
  | **J** | Toggle pet visibility |
  | **B** | Dismiss / re-summon pet *(survives a relog)* |
  | **K** | Quick chat with your pet |
  | **Y** | Emote wheel |
  | **\\** | Toggle HUD |

  All keys are rebindable in **Options → Controls → Petlings**.

  ---

  ## 📦 Requirements

  - **Minecraft 1.21.11** or **26.1**
  - **Fabric Loader** (0.16+)
  - That's it — Fabric API and GeckoLib are bundled.

  ---

  ## 🔄 Changelog — 0.6.0

  **Polish patch on top of the May 2026 Bloom release.**

  - **Cosmetic picker**: every cosmetic is now legible in the picker grid; weapons (Wizard Quill, Magic Wand, Tea Cup, etc.) are no longer clipped above the tile.
  - **Pet shake fix**: pets actually sit still during idle/sit/look instead of micro-quivering toward player input jitter.
  - **New mood / animation system**: storm halo spins, clockwork collar's gear turns, propeller pack spins, pets play one-shot animations on interact / level-up / sleep.
  - **5 cosmetic texture fixes** (cropped artist spritesheets to single frames).
  - **New cosmetics**: Heart Monocle 2x, Pixel Visor, three trail textures (candy sprinkles, ghost wisps, musical note).
  - **Multiplayer polish**: cleaner cross-server presence matching (handles `play.` subdomains and default ports).
  - **Pet dismiss toggle** that survives a relog.

  Older changelogs: see [GitHub releases](https://github.com/Bownlux/Petlings/releases).

  ---

  ## 🔗 Links

  - 🌐 **Website**: [petlings.gg](https://petlings.gg)
  - 💬 **Discord**: [discord.gg/hkcNBCTckG](https://discord.gg/hkcNBCTckG)
  - 🐙 **GitHub**: [Bownlux/Petlings](https://github.com/Bownlux/Petlings)
  - 📱 **iOS app**: coming soon

title: beaconauth
description: Secure web, OAuth, and passkey authentication for Minecraft servers using the BeaconAuth mod and a self-hosted auth server.
body:
BeaconAuth adds a secure sign-in layer for Minecraft communities. It connects a Minecraft server to a self-hosted BeaconAuth web service, allowing server owners to require web-based authentication for modded clients while keeping account verification clear, configurable, and under their own control.

## Features

- Web-based Minecraft login flow
- OAuth and passkey support through the BeaconAuth server
- Signed session verification with JWT and JWKS
- Configurable server-side authentication behavior
- Support for community-managed BeaconAuth accounts
- Localized client messages
- No third-party analytics, advertising, telemetry, or external file downloads in the Minecraft mod

## How it works

When a player joins a server that uses BeaconAuth, the mod can open the configured BeaconAuth login page in the player’s browser. After the login is completed, the mod returns a signed authentication result to the Minecraft server, where it is verified against the configured BeaconAuth server keys.

Server owners host and configure their own BeaconAuth server URL.

## Supported versions

| Minecraft version | Fabric | Forge | NeoForge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.20.1 | Yes | Yes | No |
| 1.21.1 | Yes | No | Yes |
| 1.21.8 | Yes | No | Yes |

Install the jar that matches your Minecraft version and loader from the Files tab.

## Privacy and network usage

The Minecraft mod connects to the BeaconAuth server configured by the server owner during the login flow. It does not include ads, analytics, telemetry, or background file downloads.

The client may open the configured BeaconAuth web page in the player’s browser and use a temporary local callback listener to complete the login flow.

Server owners are responsible for their own BeaconAuth deployment, logs, OAuth provider configuration, and community privacy notice.

## License

BeaconAuth is licensed under the MIT License.

# Join Actions

**Join Actions** is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod that automatically runs chat commands when you join specific multiplayer servers.

It’s designed to be simple, configurable, and safe to use across multiple servers.

---

## ✨ Features

- Run commands automatically when joining a server
- Supports **up to 4 servers**, each with its own command
- Easy configuration via **Mod Menu**
- Runs commands **once on join**
- Client-side only

---

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.10+
- **Fabric Loader:** 0.18.4+
- **Fabric API**

### Optional (recommended)
- **Mod Menu** – for accessing the config screen
- **Cloth Config** – required when using Mod Menu

If **Mod Menu** and **Cloth Config** are installed:

1. Open **Mod Menu**
2. Click **Join Actions**
3. Configure up to 4 server / command pairs:
    - Server 1 → Command 1
    - Server 2 → Command 2
    - etc.

body:
Shulker Vault

A NeoForge-first storage mod that bridges the gap between Vanilla Shulker Boxes and the Create Mod ecosystem.

[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/shulker-vault?color=00AF5C&label=Modrinth&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white&style=flat-square&cache=none)](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-shulker-vault) [![CurseForge Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1509542?color=F16436&label=CurseForge&logo=curseforge&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-shulker-vault) [![GitHub Repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/wyfyjohnson/Create-ShulkerVault) [![Codeberg Repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/Codeberg-Source-2185D0?logo=codeberg&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://codeberg.org/wyfy/ShulkerVault)
--- ## 📦 Overview Welcome to **Shulker Vault**, a mod designed to create physically interactive, automation-friendly, quality-of-life storage blocks that feel perfectly natural alongside both vanilla Minecraft and the Create mod. This isn't just an animated container. It's a hybrid storage solution combining the mobility of a Shulker Box with the utility of Create's Item Vaults and Toolboxes, topped off with modern inventory conveniences. ## ✨ Features ### The Base Shulker Vault The core storage block of the mod, designed for everyday use and automation. * **Vanilla Familiarity:** 27 inventory slots with physical lid-opening animations and player-lifting mechanics. * **High Capacity:** Configurable per-slot stack multipliers (Defaults to `4x`, allowing massive storage in a small footprint). * **Create Integration:** Fully supports Create-style interaction patterns. Works seamlessly with chutes, funnels, hoppers, and wrench pickups (which safely preserve your inventory!). * **Quality of Life:** Built-in fast access and convenience interactions inspired by modern inventory mods. ### The Advanced Shulker Vault An upgraded, logistics-focused tier for power users and complex Create factories. Crafted via Mechanical Crafters using a Shulker Vault, an Electron Tube, and a Packager. * **All Base Features:** Upgrading your base vault preserves its entire inventory and metadata. * **Direct Package Unpacking:** Acts as its own package destination. It can receive and internally unpack Create packages directly from Frogports, funnels, and hoppers without needing a separate Packager block. * **Dedicated Package Slot:** Includes a specialized overflow slot to safely hold incoming packages if the main inventory cannot fully accommodate the unpacked items. * **Smart Memory:** Package-aware inventory memory behavior allows the block to predictably handle repeated deliveries of specific items. * **Searchable GUI:** Easily find what you're looking for with built-in search capabilities. ## ⚙️ Requirements * **Minecraft:** 1.21.1 * **Mod Loader:** NeoForge * **Dependencies:** [Create Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) *Note: Shulker Vault is currently developed exclusively for NeoForge. Fabric support is not currently planned.* ## 🛠️ Configuration & Compatibility Shulker Vault is built to play nice with your favorite modpacks. * **Configurable Multipliers:** Adjust the per-slot stack multiplier in the configs to suit your modpack's balance. * **Smart Overrides:** Built-in QoL interactions are designed to avoid conflicts with dedicated inventory mods (like Easy Shulker Boxes or Sophisticated Backpacks). * **Stack Merging:** Items follow strict merging rules, ensuring components match perfectly before combining. ---
If you encounter any issues or have feature requests, please report them on our Issue Tracker.

## Fixes

### 1. Screen shake crash (Species – NPE)

**Problem:** In some situations (e.g. during loading or in certain modpack setups), Species’ screen shake runs when the camera entity is null, causing a crash.

**Fix:** A null-check is applied before using the camera entity. When the camera is null, the shake degree is forced to 0 so the game does not crash.

**Config:** `screenShakeFix` (default: `true`)

---

### 2. Mob Smasher vs hard mobs (Quake, Limpet, Grottol, …)

**Problem:** Some mobs are effectively immune to the Mob Grinding Utils Saw / Mob Smasher because of custom damage logic (parry, deflect, “only pickaxe damage”, etc.). Examples: **Quake** and **Limpet** from Species, **Grottol** from Mowzie’s Mobs.

**Fix:** When the Saw’s **FakePlayer** hits one of the configured entities, the mob is killed immediately and the normal `hurt` logic is skipped. This lets the Saw/Mob Smasher work reliably on those targets.

**Config:** the list of affected entities is fully configurable via `sawKillEntities` (see below).

---

## New Feathures

### Soul Inhibitor (Forbidden Arcanus – Lost Soul spawn prevention)

Adds a new block: **Soul Inhibitor**.

- When placed and **ON**, it prevents **Forbidden Arcanus** `lost_soul` spawns in a configurable radius.
- The block has two states: **ON/OFF**. Default is **ON**.
- Toggle with **right click** or with a **redstone pulse**.
- The crafting recipe is only loaded when `forbidden_arcanus` is present.

**Config:** `soulInhibitorEnabled`, `soulInhibitorRadius`

---

## Configuration

Config file: `config/species_fix-common.toml`

- **screenShakeFix** (default: true) – Prevents crash when camera is null during Species screen shake.
- **sawKillEntities** (list of strings, default: `["species:quake", "species:limpet", "mowziesmobs:grottol"]`) – Entity IDs (modid:entity) that the Saw’s FakePlayer should kill instantly, bypassing their custom immunity.
- **soulInhibitorEnabled** (default: true) – Enables Soul Inhibitor spawn blocking behavior.
- **soulInhibitorRadius** (default: 16) – Radius (in blocks) checked around Soul Inhibitor blocks.

To disable the screen shake fix, set `screenShakeFix = false`.
To change which mobs are affected by the Mob Smasher, edit the `sawKillEntities` list and restart the game (or reload the config).

## 🔴 RED-OS: Advanced Technology Ecosystem (BETA)

RED-OS is a technological suite for Minecraft, it is a unified operating system for your world.


## 🚀 Key Features

**Global Communication Suite:**
The ultimate command center for player interaction. Features a high-performance Global Chat, an Encrypted Private Messenger Vault for secure player-to-player
communication with persistent local history, and a seamless Discord Bridge to connect your in-game world with your external community in real-time. Coordinate logistics
and stay connected with your team anywhere in the world.


**Administrative & Security Operations (OP Level):**
RED-OS provides streamlined access for authorized world administrators. Players with Operator privileges can access the Admin Console, designed for the convenience of
monitoring global network health and managing player permissions. This layer provides OPs with an efficient overview to maintain order and security across the
technological ecosystem without unnecessary complexity.


**Autonomous Drone Logistics:**
Deploy intelligent Drone Units managed by a centralized Master Controller. These autonomous agents navigate complex Mesh Networks to transport resources with high
efficiency, featuring built-in survival protocols and intelligent back-pressure detection for full containers.


**Surveillance & Remote Automation:**
Maintain total situational awareness with high-definition Wireless IP Cameras, Smart Motion Sensors, and Remote Redstone Triggers. Monitor your facility through
real-time video feeds, configure automated alerts, and remotely activate redstone machinery from anywhere on the network via your handheld.

**Quantum Teleportation Infrastructure:**
Master the Quantum Porter system for instantaneous long-range logistics and personnel travel. Utilizing advanced spatial mapping, the Porter provides secure,
zero-latency movement across your entire RED-OS network.


**High-Energy Defense & Mobility:**
Protect your assets with the Plasma Pulse Disintegrator weapon and master the skies with the Ion Exo Chestplate. This advanced jetpack provides high-speed aerial
mobility with built-in glider functionality and supersonic capabilities.


## 🛰 How it Works: Discovery & Progression

In Survival mode, RED-OS utilizes an advancement-based unlock system. Hardware tiers are unlocked as soon as the required items are detected in your inventory.

* **Tier 1 (Base Technology):** Automatically unlocks when a `Clock` and `Redstone Torch` are detected in your inventory. Grants access to basic networking, cameras, and sensors.
* **Tier 2 (Advanced Spatial):** Requires Tier 1 completion and discovery of an `Echo Shard`. Unlocks the Quantum Porter and Plasma Disintegrator.

> **Note:** For architects, all features are immediately available in **Creative Mode** by searching for **RED-OS**.



## 🛠 Requirements
Minecraft: 1.21.11
Fabric Loader: 0.18.1 or higher
Fabric API: 0.141.2+1.21.11



## 📦 Installation
Download the latest .jar from the Releases page.
Place the file in your Minecraft mods folder.
Ensure you have the correct version of Fabric API installed.



## 🐛 Bug Reporting & Feedback
We are currently in BETA. Stability is our primary goal for the v1.0 release. If you encounter any issues, please report them via the GitHub Issues page.

Your feedback helps make RED-OS better for everyone!

description: Re-balances Mending Enchantment without making it useless
body:
# README

Unmending Plus re-balances Mending Enchantment. In spite of its name, Unmending Plus is a minor addition to Txuritan's Unmending. Bugfix to be precise. Txuritan's Unmending (accidentally) allows tools with Mending be repaired with XP Orbs. Unmending Plus tries to fix that.

Mending is great but Minecraft become boring once you obtain the best gears that never break. In order to "Make Minecraft Great Again", Unmending Plus does the following: 

### 1. Disables XP Orb Repair

XP Orbs can no longer repair tools with Mending.

### 2. Forbids Mending Be Applied as Enchantment

Mending Books cannot be applied to tools.

### 3. Mending Resets "Extra Repair Cost"

Because of "Too Expensive", tools become unrepairable after a certain point. This is where new Mending mechanics become useful. Mending Books can reset Extra Repair Cost when applied using Anvil.

## Credit

- [Unmending](https://modrinth.com/mod/unmending) by Txuritan
- [Unmending](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/unmending) by Vazkii
