title: FishPro
description: FishPro rewards fishing with coins, upgrades, and a shop; intuitive menus, optionally disables vanilla rod enchanting, and quick setup and reload.
body:
# FishPro — Player Guide

Welcome! This guide shows you, step by step, how to use FishPro:

Quick commands
- /fp menu — opens the main menu (Upgrade, Shop, Help)
- /fp help — opens the Help menu

1) Getting started
- Get a fishing rod.
- Type /fp menu.
- You’ll see:
    - Upgrade: upgrade your rod using coins.
    - Shop: buy cooked fish and sell raw fish.
    - Help: quick info and a link to this guide.

2) Earning coins
- Go fishing as normal.
- On catches, you have a chance to earn coins (the server sets the chance).
- Some servers only reward coins for real fish (Cod, Salmon, Pufferfish, Tropical Fish).
- Coin Booster (an upgrade) increases your chance to receive coins per catch.
- Your current coin balance is shown in menus as a gold ingot.

3) Upgrading your rod
- Hold your fishing rod in your main hand.
- Type /fp menu → click Upgrade.

What you can upgrade:
- Lure I–III
- Luck of the Sea I–III
- Unbreaking I–III
- Mending I (unlocks after Lure III + Luck III + Unbreaking III)
- Coin Booster I–III (+ extra coin chance per catch)

How buying works:
- Click an upgrade in the GUI.
- If you have enough coins and meet requirements, it’s purchased.
- If your rod is fully maxed, the main menu shows (Maxed) in red and the Upgrade menu won’t open.

Back button:
- In the Upgrade menu, the top-right slot (arrow) returns you to the main menu.

4) Using the Shop
   Open:
- /fp menu → Shop

What you can do:
- Buy cooked fish:
    - Cooked Cod, Cooked Salmon
    - Left-click or Right-click buys 1
- Sell raw fish:
    - Cod, Salmon, Tropical Fish, Pufferfish
    - Left-click sells 1
    - Right-click sells all of that fish in your inventory

Item info shows:
- Price
- How many you have
- Total coins if you sell all (for sell items)
- Your current coin balance

Notes:
- If an item has no price on this server, you won’t be able to buy/sell it.
- If your inventory is full you can’t buy until you free space.

Back button:
- In the Shop, the top-right slot (arrow) returns you to the main menu.

5) Help menu
   Open:
- /fp help, or /fp menu → Help

You’ll find:
- How coins are earned.
- Upgrade steps and what Coin Booster does.
- A button to get a web link for this guide.
- A button to reopen the main menu.

6) Enchanting table and anvil (important)
   Depending on this server’s settings:
- If vanilla rod enchanting is disabled:
    - Enchanting table:
        - When you try to enchant a fishing rod, the slot shows a red barrier named “Enchanting Rods are disabled.”
        - Use /fp menu → Upgrade instead.
    - Anvil:
        - Trying to apply an enchanted book to a fishing rod shows a red barrier as the result and you can’t take it.
        - Renaming your rod is still allowed.
- If vanilla enchanting is allowed, the table/anvil work as normal.

7) Tips and common questions
- “I can’t open Upgrade.” Hold a fishing rod in your main hand.
- “(Maxed) in red?” Your rod has every upgrade available here — nothing left to buy.
- “Right-click doesn’t work?” Shift-right-click counts as right-click; shift-left-click counts as left-click.
- “Shop button does nothing on an item.” That item likely has no price on this server.
- “I didn’t get the cooked fish I bought.” Check if your inventory is full.


---

# FishPro — Admin Guide

This section explains how to set up and customize FishPro for your server: configuration, prices, features, and admin actions.

A) Installation and folders
1) Stop the server.
2) Put the FishPro jar in plugins/.
3) Start the server once.

Created folders/files (first run):
```
plugins/FishPro/
  Configurations/
    config.yml
    upgrade.yml
    shop.yml
  Players/
    <playerName>/
      coins.yml
      profile.yml
  Guide/
    Configuration.md
    Configuration.txt
```
Notes:
- Players/<name>/… is created when a player joins (or first time their coins are saved).
- The Guide/ files are auto-copied on first run; the plugin flattens accidental nested “Guide/Guide” or “Guide/Giuide” folders automatically.

B) Commands and menus
- /fp menu → Main menu (Coins, Upgrade, Shop, Help)
- /fp help → Help menu (includes OP-only Reload button, if you’re OP)

C) Configuring features (Configurations/config.yml)
```yml
reward:
  chance_percent: 20.0   # Base chance per eligible catch to earn coins
  amount: 1              # Coins awarded on success
  only_fish_items: true  # true = only real fish items count; false = any catch type

features:
  coin_booster_enabled: true          # Enable/disable the Coin Booster upgrade
  disable_vanilla_rod_enchanting: true # true = block table/anvil rod-enchanting visually
```
- disable_vanilla_rod_enchanting: when true, players see a red barrier named “Enchanting Rods are disabled” in the enchanting table item slot and as the anvil result if they try to apply books to rods. Renaming rods in anvil remains allowed.
- coin_booster_enabled: when false, Coin Booster won’t appear in the Upgrade menu and doesn’t apply.

D) Upgrade prices (Configurations/upgrade.yml)
Set coin costs per level:
```yml
upgrades:
  lure:
    1: 10
    2: 25
    3: 50
  luck_of_the_sea:
    1: 10
    2: 25
    3: 50
  unbreaking:
    1: 10
    2: 25
    3: 50
  mending:
    1: 100
  coin_booster:
    1: 50
    2: 100
    3: 150
```
Rules:
- Lure/Luck/Unbreaking go up to III on this server by design.
- Mending unlocks only after Lure III + Luck III + Unbreaking III.
- Coin Booster adds +10% coin chance per level (I–III).
- If coin_booster_enabled is false, Coin Booster is hidden.

E) Shop prices (Configurations/shop.yml)
Define buy/sell prices:
```yml
shop:
  cooked_cod:
    buy: 5
  cooked_salmon:
    buy: 6

  cod:
    sell: 2
  salmon:
    sell: 2
  tropical_fish:
    sell: 2
  pufferfish:
    sell: 2
```
Behavior:
- Cooked Cod/Salmon: Left or Right-click = buy 1 (needs “buy” price).
- Raw Cod/Salmon/Tropical/Pufferfish: Left-click = sell 1, Right-click = sell all (needs “sell” price).

F) Reloading changes
- Recommended: stop/start the server after changes.
- Quick in-game reload: /fp help → “Reload Configs” (visible and usable only for OP). This re-reads config.yml, upgrade.yml, and shop.yml.

G) Player data
- Location: plugins/FishPro/Players/<playerName>/
    - coins.yml → player’s coin balance
    - profile.yml → uuid, name, last_seen
- Created/updated when the player joins.

H) Customization and UX notes
- Back button: Shop and Upgrade menus have a back arrow in the top-right.
- The Help menu intentionally has no back arrow (it has an “Open Menu” button inside).
- Coin Booster boosts coin-chance only; it does not change Minecraft loot tables.
- If you disable vanilla rod enchanting, players get a clear, visual block (no chat spam) with a barrier item that says “Enchanting Rods are disabled” and a hint to use /fp menu → Upgrade.

I) Troubleshooting
- “Shop/Upgrade clicks do nothing”
    - Ensure players click the GUI items (top inventory), not their own inventory below.
    - Verify prices exist in shop.yml and upgrade.yml.
    - Fully restart the server after updates (avoid /reload if possible).
    - Check console for errors on startup.

- “Players folder doesn’t appear”
    - Folders are created when players join at least once.

- “Enchanting table/anvil not blocking rod enchanting”
    - Check features.disable_vanilla_rod_enchanting: true in config.yml.
    - Restart the server after toggling.

- Version and platform
    - FishPro targets modern Paper/Spigot builds (1.20+ recommended).
    - If you’re on a fork or older version, test thoroughly after changes.

J) Quick admin checklist
- Set your desired coin-chance and amount in config.yml.
- Adjust upgrade prices in upgrade.yml.
- Set shop buy/sell prices in shop.yml.
- Decide if you want to:
    - Enable Coin Booster (features.coin_booster_enabled)
    - Disable vanilla rod enchanting (features.disable_vanilla_rod_enchanting)
- Restart the server, then test with a fresh account:
    - Earn coins while fishing.
    - Buy/sell in Shop.
    - Upgrade rod (respecting Mending unlock and maxed state).
    - If disabled, confirm table/anvil rod enchanting shows the barrier item.

title: Tools, Don't Break.
description: Broken tools will stay, like Elytras.
body:
Instead of breaking, tools will gain *negative durability.* Tools with ≤ 0 durability won't work at all.

Combine your tools in a crafting table or an anvil to repair them, or smelt them into nuggets.

---

## For Developers

* Data component types added to `#tdnb:removed_from_broken_items` will be removed from an item when it breaks.
  * Data component types added to `#tdnb:restored_to_repaired_items` will be re-added to an item when it is repaired.
  * Data component types added to `#tdnb:removed_from_broken_and_restored_to_repaired_items` will be added to both (by default, `minecraft:tool` and `minecraft:weapon`).
  * *Components to be restored are stored under the `tdnb:broken_components` object inside the `minecraft:custom_data` data component.*
* Enchantments added to `#tdnb:ignored` will not be disabled when they break, nor re-enabled when they are repaired (by default, `minecraft:mending` and `minecraft:vanishing_curse`).
  * *Disabled enchantments are moved from `minecraft:enchantments` to `minecraft:stored_enchantments`.*
* Items added to `#tdnb:ignored` will be ignored by the mod completely (by default, `#c:elytra` containing `minecraft:elytra`, and `#tconstruct:modifiable`).

---

*This mod was made for the [Vanillative](https://modrinth.com/modpack/Vanillative) modpack.*

## Commands
### Definitions
* `<required>` - "required" (literal) is required for the command to work.
* `(optional)` - "optional" (literal) is optional for the command to work.
* `"thing"` - thing is non-literal; meaning you specify something that "thing" describes. Such as a world name, or player name.

### Plugin Commands

- `buildmode.command.buildmode` - Allows running the command `/buildmode`.

title: Bushcraft
description: Bushcraft is a low-tech tech mod that can help you survive and gather resources, especially in the early game.
body:
# Bushcraft
Bushcraft is a low-tech tech mod that can help you survive and gather resources, especially in the early game. It's designed for a slow-paced outdoor experience, but it could also be useful in skyblock and other resource limited modpacks.

## ALPHA RELEASE ##

This is an alpha release. There are no major known issues, but this is an early version of the mod. I'm still planning on adding some more features, and improving some of the features that are already there. I will mention any large/breaking changes in changelogs.

# Features
* Flint tools - flint tools break faster than stone tools, but are nearly as effective as iron tools
* Tree tap - gather sap from birch to make syrup, or from spruce trees to make pitch.
* Hand pump - will pump fluids from an area around the pump, as long as the player keeps pumping it.
* Drying rack - a good source of leather, string, and clay. Works similar to a campfire, but it works with hoppers.
* Washer - a coal powered block that washes blocks. Great for getting things wet or eroding them into smaller pieces.
* Crucible - place heat sources underneath it to melt blocks, or place ice under or around it to cool fluids and make them solid.
* Copper bell - make a perimeter of these around your camp, and you will hear the creepers coming. 

# Some planned features
* A rabbit snare - (spawns, and then) lures rabbits to trap them. This will be a low capacity block that will need to be checked regularly.
* A "hunter's stew" cooking pot - keep adding ingredients and water to it--just fill it back up when it starts to run low. A good way to make rotten foods edible!
* Berry harvester - slowly gather nearby berries
* Fermenting barrel - Make fizzy drinks from tree saps, honey, and berries
* Paper production - turn wood fibers into paper
* Some sort of use for leaf litter
* A few simple magical rituals - weather control, monster repellant, seed/sapling transformation
* Rudimentary enchantments - low level enchantments that can be applied to equipment without the need for an anvil
* A few (useful?) decorational blocks, like strings of fish or crude lamps
* Add configuration for tuning and customizing

# Known issues
* Sap is not rendering in Jade display
* Fluids are not rendering in REI displays

# Supported mods
* EMI/JEI/REI supported
* Jade supported

# Supported versions
* Initial release for 1.21.1 Fabric, with 1.21.1 NeoForge coming soon!
* Ongoing support for 1.21.1 and latest version planned (also coming soon, but not as soon as NeoForge)

## Credits

* https://github.com/malcolmriley/unused-textures for some of the item textures used in Bushcraft

title: Neo Vanilla Additions
description: Vanilla Additions provides features that seamlessly integrate into the base game, making it feel more complete.
body:
# Neo Vanilla Additions enriches your fundamental Minecraft gameplay by introducing a suite of carefully designed quality-of-life enhancements. This mod focuses on seamlessly integrating new features that feel like they belong in the base game, providing solutions to common frustrations and expanding upon existing mechanics.

**This mod provides the following key additions:
**

![Gears](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/08494887f28fb70bf5105e884d783d7e51a6c885.png)
## Expanded Gear Sets:
##        
Copper Tools and Armor: Discover a complete set of copper tools (sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe) and armor (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots). These items bridge the gap between wood and stone/iron, offering a balanced progression and practical use for copper beyond decorative blocks. Copper gear also has slightly enhanced efficiency during rain and thunderstorms, adding a dynamic weather-based element.
      
Emerald Tools and Armor: Equip yourself with emerald tools and armor, a tier above iron but below diamond. Emerald gear offers increased durability and efficiency, providing a valuable mid-to-late-game option for players seeking superior performance.
   
## Villager Management:
## 
Villager Summoning Totem: Craft a unique totem that allows you to summon villagers to your desired location. This feature simplifies villager trading setups and eliminates the need for lengthy transportation methods, streamlining your gameplay.

## Crafting Enhancements:
##        
Craftable Saddles, Name Tags, and Horse Armor: Gain the ability to craft previously uncraftable items. This addresses common player frustrations and provides a more self-sufficient gameplay experience, especially in situations where these items are scarce.

# Why choose Neo Vanilla Additions?
# 
## Seamless Integration: All features are designed to feel like natural extensions of the vanilla game, maintaining the core Minecraft experience while adding valuable improvements.

## Quality-of-Life Focus: This mod tackles common player frustrations, such as the difficulty of obtaining certain items and managing villagers, providing practical solutions.
   
## Balanced Progression: The addition of copper and emerald gear offers a smoother and more rewarding progression curve, filling gaps in the existing item tiers.
   
## Increased Player Agency: Crafting previously uncraftable items empowers players to be more self-sufficient and adaptable.
  
## Enhanced Utility: Copper is given a new purpose and emeralds are made more useful.

## Simplified Gameplay: The villager summoning totem greatly simplifies villager transport.

If you're looking to enhance your Minecraft experience without straying too far from the vanilla feel, Neo Vanilla Additions is the perfect mod for you. It provides practical improvements and valuable additions that make the game more enjoyable and efficient.

title: ServerGreeter
description: ServerGreeter is a Minecraft plugin that greets players with a custom title message upon joining. Administrators configure the message using placeholders in a `config.yml` file and can reload settings or manually test the message using commands.
body:
**ServerGreeter**

The ServerGreeter plugin enhances the welcoming experience for players joining your Minecraft server. It allows server administrators to customize the welcome message displayed to players upon joining, making it more engaging and personalized. With support for placeholders and color codes, administrators can create dynamic and visually appealing welcome messages tailored to their server's style.

**Key Features:**
- **Customizable Welcome Message:** Administrators can configure a personalized welcome message using placeholders to greet players as they join the server.
- **Color Support:** The plugin supports color codes in the welcome message, enabling administrators to add visual flair and emphasis.
- **Configuration Reload Command:** The `/sg reload` command allows administrators to reload the plugin configuration in-game, facilitating easy customization without server restarts.
- **Test Title Command:** Administrators can manually trigger the welcome title message using the `/sg test` command, providing a convenient way to preview the welcome message without waiting for a player to join.

**Usage:**

- **/sg reload:** Reloads the plugin configuration, applying any changes made to the welcome message or other settings without restarting the server. This command is essential for administrators to customize the welcome message on the fly.
  - Permission: servergreeter.reload

- **/sg test:** Manually triggers a test title message for the executing player, allowing administrators to preview the welcome message without waiting for a player to join the server. This command is useful for ensuring the welcome message looks as intended before players join.
  - Permission: servergreeter.test

Upon joining the server, players will be greeted with the customized welcome message specified in the plugin configuration. The welcome message can include placeholders such as `%player%` to dynamically insert the player's name, providing a personalized experience for each player.

---

This description highlights the key features of the ServerGreeter plugin and provides a comprehensive overview of its usage and functionality.

title: Mob Spawner Modification Commands
description: Provides a complete set of commands to modify anything and everything about mob spawners and the spawned entities.
body:
# Mob Spawner Modification Commands

This plugin provides a complete set of commands to modify anything and everything about mob spawners and the spawned entities.

- Change simple things like spawn rate.
- Or the entity spawned.
- Or where the entity spawns.
- Or what the entity is holding.
- And so much more!

All from within the game. No exiting out to MCEdit or another NBT Editor, making your changes, uploading the new world, and restarting the server. Just nice simple commands, with instant results.

## Documentation

Basic commands are `/spawner`, `/tool`, `/mob-modifier`, `/mob-specific`, `/entity`, and `/entity-specific`. I hope those are pretty self explanatory as to what they contain.

Currently, there’s only permission available, which is `msm.modify` and it defaults to OP.

Most of the command arguments are the same as the NBT properties, and function the same.

### Commands

<details>
<summary>View command documentation</summary>

#### `/display [property]`
Usage of this command requires strict knowledge of the NBT tag structure. Unlike the rest of these commands, proper capitalization and spelling is essential for this command to output the correct property value. Syntax is simple. (Ex. `/display SpawnData Health`). Valid NBT tags can be found here, under Mob Spawner. Any properties relating to entites should go under SpawnData, like in the example shown. Properties relating to the spawner itself can be done like so. (Ex. `/display EntityId`)   

#### `/tool [tool]`
* **Copy:** If the players held item is empty, it gives them this tool. Otherwise, it sets the players currently held item to this tool. This tool allows the player to copy all the attributes of a spawner, and paste those attributes onto a different one. Right click a spawner with the tool in hand to copy, and shift right-click to paste.  
* **Position:** If the players held item is empty, it gives them this tool. Otherwise, it sets the players currently held item to this tool. This tool allows for easy modification of the coordinates where an entity will spawn, without entering precise coordinates. Simply right-click with this tool in hand to set the coordinates to the Player’s current coordinates. Right-clicking on a spawner will set those coordinates to the spawner.  
  
#### `/spawner [property] [value]`
* **EntityId:** Takes the name of the entity to be spawned. Takes mobs and other entities (ie. ARROW, PRIMED_TNT, List at the bottom)  
* **SpawnCount:** Amount of entities to be spawned each time the spawner activates (roughly spawns this amount, depends on amount of nearby entities)  
* **SpawnRange:** Range of blocks the entities will spawn in, moves out from spawner block, not counting spawner (1 would be the immediate blocks around the spawner)  
* **Delay:** # of ticks until next spawn. Setting to 1 will cause immediate spawn.  
* **MinSpawnDelay:** Minimum amount of ticks until next spawn.  
* **MaxSpawnDelay:** Maximum amount of ticks until next spawn (CAN’T BE 0. CAUSES CRASH! Must be 1 or above).  
* **MaxNearbyEntites:** Maximum of entities allowed around the spawner (if this number is reached, new entites won’t spawn)  
* **RequiredPlayerRange:** Range in which players are detected for spawner activation.  
  
#### `/entity [property] [value]`
* **Pos/Position:** Takes the x, y, and z coordinates respectively to spawn the entity at. (Ex. `/entity pos 100 12 0`) Alternatively, (`/entity pos player`) will set the coordinates to the current player position/  
* **Motion:** Takes the x, y, and z velocity amounts to apply to the entity when first spawned.  
* **Rotation:** takes the yaw and pitch values respectively (Ex. `/entity rotation [0-360] [-90 - 90]`) can also use (`/entity rotation player`) to apply the current yaw/pitch of the player.  
* **FallDistance:** amount of blocks the entity is set to have fallen upon spawn.  
* **Fire:** Amount of ticks the entity has until fire is extinguished. Setting to a negative number will set that many ticks until the mob can be set on fire.  
* **Air:** Amount of air left (0 – 200 I believe)  
* **OnGround:** Takes a boolean value (0/1) whether the entity is on the ground when spawned (just a value, won’t actually place on ground. Will be overwritten if the entity spawns in the air)  
* **Dimension:** Sets the dimension the entity is in. Pointless, since dimensions aren’t handled this way. Won’t do anything.  
* **Invulnerable:** Takes boolean value (0/1) whether the entity will be invulnerable. Not all entities accept this flag.  
* **PortalCooldown:** Amount of ticks until entity can next use portal.  
  
#### `/mob-modifier [property] [value]`
* **Health:** Amount of half-hearts the entity has. Setting to zero will kill the entity on update.  
* **AttackTime:**
* **HurtTime:**
* **DeathTime:** 
* **CanPickUpLoot:** Boolean value (0/1) whether the entity can pickup items (zombies will hold any picked up items)  
* **PersistenceRequired:** Boolean value (0/1) whether the entity should be persistant (won’t despawn).  
* **InLove:** Ticks until no longer in love (while in love, mobs/villagers will attempt to breed)  
* **Age:** Age of the entity in ticks. If negative, baby mob.  
* **Owner:** Takes string to define the owner of the mob. Only used with wolves to determine owner.  
* **Sitting:** Only on wolves, determines whether the wolf will spawn sitting.  
* **PotionEfects:** Takes more arguments after this.  
    * **Add:** Takes the potion effect id (List at the bottom), the amplifier (starts at 0) and the duration in ticks.  
    * **Remove:** Takes the line number of the potion to be removed. Numbers gotten with get command.  
    * **Get:** Returns the potion effects to be applied, with numbers. Numbers used with Remove command.  
* **Equip:**  
    * **Set:**
        * **[Held/Head/Chest/Legs/Feet]**: This command will set the item in the defined slot to whatever the player is currently holding. Item damage, enchantments, name, lore, and leather armor color will all carry over.  
    * **Remove**
        * **[Held/Head/Chest/Legs/Feet]**: Simply clears the defined item slot.  
    * **Get:** Returns the items worn/held  
* **DropChances:** Takes more arguments after this. (WARNING: May not be functional.)  
    * **Held:** Takes value between 0 and 1. Probability of item dropping.  
    * **Feet:** Takes value between 0 and 1. Probability of item dropping.  
    * **Legs:** Takes value between 0 and 1. Probability of item dropping.  
    * **Chest:** Takes value between 0 and 1. Probability of item dropping.  
    * **Head:** Takes value between 0 and 1. Probability of item dropping.  
  
#### `/mob-specific [property] [value]` 

**WARNING: Checks for the values are not implemented, so be sure you’re using the proper value to avoid errors/crashing.**

* **Bat:**  
    * **BatFlags:** Takes boolean value (0/1) whether the bat should spawn hanging.  
* **Creeper:**  
    * **Powered:** Takes boolean value (0/1) whether the creeper should spawn with the powered effect.  
    * **ExplosionRadius:** Takes the radius that the explosion should reach out to.  
    * **Fuse:** Amount of ticks until the creeper explodes once activated.  
* **Enderman:**  
    * **Carried:** Takes block material (at the bottom), or block id, that the enderman will spawn carrying.  
    * **CarriedData:** Takes the metadata value (number) of the carried block.  
* **Ozelot:**  
    * **CatType:** Skin of the spawned cat (number).  
* **Slime/LavaSlime** (both work)  
    * **Size:** Takes size of the spawned slime (number)  
* **Pig:**  
    * **Saddle:** Takes boolean value (0/1) whether the pig will spawn with a saddle.  
* **Zombie/PigZombie** (both work)  
    * **isVillager:** Takes boolean value (0/1) whether the zombie will be a zombie villager (only applies to zombies)  
    * **isBaby:** Takes boolean value (0/1) whether the zombie/pig zombie will spawn as a baby.  
    * **ConversionTime:** Takes amount of ticks until zombie villager is cured  
    * **Anger:** Amount of anger…? Applies to pig zombies  
* **Sheep:**  
    * **Sheared:** Takes boolean value (0/1) whether the sheep will spawn sheared.  
    * **Color:** Takes color value (number, list at bottom)  
* **Skeleton:**  
    * **SkeletonType:** Determines skeleton type (0 = normal skeleton, 1 = wither skeleton)  
* **Wither/WitherBoss** (both work)  
    * **Invul:** Number of ticks until invulnerability effect wears off.  
* **Wolf:**
    * **Angry:** Boolean value (0/1) whether wolf spawns angry.  
    * **CollarColor:** Number value of color (list below)  
* **VillagerGolem/IronGolem (both work)**
    * **PlayerCreated:** boolean value (0/1) whether the golem was created by the player  
  
#### `/entity-specific [property] [value]`  
* **PrimedTnt:**  
    * **Fuse:** Amount of ticks until TNT detonates  
* **FallingSand:**  
    * **Tile:** Block id to mimic.  
    * **Data:** Metadata for block being mimiced.  
    * **Time:**  
    * **DropItem:** Boolean value (0/1) whether it’ll drop an item if broken.

Experience Nugget Style Ingots (or ENSI for short) is a Minecraft Resource Pack to make every ingot/plate and some crystals be in the shape of Experience Nugget in the [Create Mod](https://github.com/Creators-of-Create/Create).

title: Crystals
description: Adds custom ores and enchants to Minecraft
body:
#### The Crystals

There are three types of crystals in this mod: red, green and blue.

You can find shards of each color in desert temples, dungeons and ancient cities. It takes seven shards to make a full crystal.

You can also find crystal ores deep underground, which drop crystal shards when mined.

This mod also adds new enchants, which you can unlock by putting a weapon (must be diamond, gold or iron) into a smithing table, which enchants your item.

 #### The Enchants

- Red Enchant

Increases weapon attack damage by 3

- Green Enchant

Gives poison to anything you hit (wither effect if they are an undead mob)

- Blue Enchant

Applies slowness effect to anything you hit

title: KMD Fast Travel
description: Simulates Kingdom Come deliverance fast travel in minecraft. By simulating fast travel with events.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b8f9a7fbe370cb819376912b4620177f927d35a.png)

# About
KMD tries to simulate the fast travel risk/reward and atmosphere of Kingdom Come: Deliverance inside Minecraft.

This mod is still in its early stages, with more content planned to be added over time.

# ✨ Features

- Full custom Events.
- Ability to fast travel between discovered travel posts.
- Simulated travel instead of instant teleporting.
- Random events that can interrupt fast travel.
- Hostile and passive encounters on land and at sea.
- Multiple travel post wood variants.
- Shared travel posts that can be visible to everyone.
- Renameable travel posts.
- Dyeable travel post sign text.
- Banner-based map pins.

# ⚠️ How To Use

KMD is designed as a standalone mod for stylized builds, medieval worlds, fantasy servers, and adventure-focused gameplay.

Place down a travel post and right-click it to discover/bind it. Place a second travel post, discover it, and you can fast travel between the two.

Shared travel posts are a special version of the travel post that can be visible to everyone without each player needing to discover it first.

# Recipes

![CraftingRecipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83f7d8626d906a7293fd66d5cb0b5a8d8967a2eb.png)

![SharedCraftingRecipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0fd4e6a74530f7d6a53e2f66b1d51dcbd991fd1.png)

Regular travel posts work with different kinds of wood.

Shared travel posts require more expensive materials and are intended for public/server-wide travel points.

# Encounters %
-By default all encounters are based on time of day (Night time travel higher chance for encounter)

-Distance (More distance higher chance for encounters)

-Armor level (Lowers both encounter chance but also increases chance to avoid or sneak away from encounters)

-Food Level (More hungry , more encounter chance)

All of the above can be configured via the ingame commands or the config

# Commands

All commands require permission level 2 or higher.

- `/kmdtravel events [true|false]` — Shows or toggles travel events.
- `/kmdtravel eventwait [5-600]` — Shows or changes passive-event wait time in seconds.
- `/kmdtravel basechance <0-1>` — Sets the base chance for any travel event.
- `/kmdtravel nightmultiplier <0-10>` — Sets the event chance multiplier at night.
- `/kmdtravel armor perpoint <0-0.1>` — Sets event chance reduction per armor/toughness point.
- `/kmdtravel armor maxreduction <0-0.95>` — Sets the max armor protection cap.
- `/kmdtravel hunger low <0-1>` — Sets added event chance when hunger is very low.
- `/kmdtravel hunger medium <0-1>` — Sets added event chance when hunger is medium.
- `/kmdtravel distancechance <0-1>` — Sets added event chance per 1000 blocks.
- `/kmdtravel maxchance <0-1>` — Sets the final maximum event chance cap.
- `/kmdtravel sharedpostcrafting [true|false]` — Shows or toggles shared travel post crafting.
- `/kmdtravel finishencounter @p` — Force ends an encounter a player is having.

# Misc

title: better brightness setup
description: Overhauls minecraft's brightness/gamma setup - open a faithful calibration screen on first launch or from Video Settings, with Sodium support and an adjustable max brightness
body:
# Better Brightness Setup

Vanilla Minecraft gives you a single brightness slider with no preview, so you end up setting it blind. Too dark and caves are a black void, too bright and everything looks flat and washed out. This mod adds a real setup screen so you can see what you're actually doing.

## What it does

The setup screen shows four tiles: a creeper in the dark, deepslate, coal ore and diamond ore, each at a different light level. As you drag the slider they're lit with Minecraft's real lightmap gamma curve (the same one the game uses), so they brighten and darken exactly like those blocks would down in a cave.

So you just set the slider until the creeper stays hidden but the diamond ore is still clearly visible, and you've got a brightness that fits your screen instead of a guess.

A few other things it does:

- Opens once on a fresh install, after Minecraft's own onboarding/accessibility screens.
- Can be reopened any time: in Video Settings the gamma slider is swapped for a "Setup Brightness" button.
- Works with Sodium - the calibration icons show up inline under its own brightness slider
- Lets you go past vanilla's 100% cap. A config option (in the mod list) raises the max up to 500% for dark monitors, and it sticks across restarts.
- Is translated into every Minecraft language (the major ones checked by hand), plus Pirate, LOLCAT and upside-down.

## Compatibility

Client-side only, so it's fine to join any server with it. Runs on Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge. Requires Cloth Config. Optionally uses Mod Menu (config button on Fabric/Quilt) and Sodium (inline icons).

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a81420ac0041c2dd91d3f40084fd9617e4cb79f_0.webp)

title: Stats Command
description: A simple Fabric mod that provides player statistics and leaderboards in one command.
body:
This mod allows players to view statistics view leaderboards for any tracked metric in the game. It is engineered for scalability, utilizing memory-mapped files and incremental indexing to ensure zero impact on server performance, even with potentially tens of thousands of unique player files. It uses the built-in vanilla stat system and can show stats for any player that have, at any time, been playing on the server.

## Features

- **Instant Lookups**: specific stats for any player (mined, crafted, broken, killed, dropped, etc.).
- **Leaderboards**: View top rankings for any category with `/stats top`.
- **Custom Stats**: Support for custom statistics registered by datapacks.
- **High Performance**:
  - Uses memory-mapped I/O for nanosecond-level access times.
  - Non-blocking, incremental indexing system.
  - Zero main-thread lag, suitable for large production servers.

## Usage

**Lookup a player:**
```
/stats <player> <category> <stat>
/stats Steve mined diamond_ore
```

**View leaderboard:**
```
/stats top <category> <stat> [page]
/stats top killed creeper
```

## Installation

Requires Fabric Loader and Fabric API. Place the mod .jar file in your server's `mods` folder.
Have been tested on 1.21.11

```
],

    "saturation": "x",
    "eatSeconds": "x",
    "effects": []
    },
    {
    "tooltip": "Edible",
    "color": 16777045,
    "duration": 3,
    "nurtition": "x/2",
    "saturation": "x/2",
    "eatSeconds": "x",
    "effects": []
    },
    {
    "tooltip": "Rotten",
    "color": 16733525,
    "duration": -1,
    "nurtition": "0",
    "saturation": "0",
    "eatSeconds": "x*2",
    "effects": [
        {
        "probability": 1.0,
        "id": "minecraft:nausea",
        "duration": 200,
        "amplifier": 1,
        "ambient": true,
        "showParticles": false,
        "showIcon": false
        }
    ]
    }
]
}
```

Here are a things you should know before tampering with the config:
- All Food Stages must be in order. The highest one comes first.
- Values for nutrition, saturation, eatSeconds are essentially equations, where x is the original value of the given item. They can be anything, ranging from "(x / 2) + 1" to a plain number like "2". Mark that x value is not affected by the previous stage as it is the original value.
- Duration is measured in world days(Which means even if you do /time set [insert some crazy number] all your food won't immediately rot)
- Color is an rgb integer.
- Effects allow you to add your own effects to a certain stage(The food will still keep it's original effects).
- When "modDataComponentsEnabled" is set to false the mod will actively remove the rotting functionality from every item it can tick. Essentialy all the food in players inventory will reset and become normal food that doesn't rot.
- randomiseFoodState randomises the food items state when you get it, within the range of maxRandomState. maxRandomState of 2 means you would get either 1 - Fresh or 2 - Edible.

## Why was this mod made?
Truthfully i just wanted to make my friends to suffer. And i thought maybe someone might have a simillar desire or might add this to his hardcore world...

As always, any mistakes are my own.

## Mechanics
*Soups* are made using a Water Cauldron on top of a Campfire. To create a soup, simply throw your ingredients (up to 3) into the cauldron and collect the Soup using a bowl.

The Nutrition and Saturation value of a Soup are the combined values of all of its ingredients, except with a couple of modifiers applied:


<details>
<summary>All Modifiers</summary>
  
» Duplicate ingredients have their values halved
  
» Adding additional ingredients after the first one decreases the total by 10%

» Any ingredient in the *Other* category boosts the total by 20%

» Adding 2 *Meats* decreases the total by 10%

» Adding 3 *Meats* decreases the total by a further 20%

» Similarly, adding 3 *Vegetables* decreases the total by 20%

</details>

title: EasyWarps
description: A convenient and lightweight warp and spawn manager with a fully customizable graphical interface (GUI). Forget about commands!
body:
# EasyWarps: Convenient and Easy Warp Manager

**EasyWarps** — It is a simple and intuitive plug-in for the Spigot/Paper server, designed to manage all warps and spawns through a modern graphical interface (GUI). Forget about long commands — all navigation is now in a few clicks!

## Main Features

`Everything can be configured via config.yml`

**Modern GUI:** Access to all warps and spawns via a user-friendly, fully customizable menu.

**Flexible filtering:** Quickly switch between warp categories directly in the menu:

**Server**

**Public** (created by players)

**My** (Your personal warps)

**Spawns** (All available spawn points)

**Lots of Spawns:** Set and use multiple spawn points (_/setspawn 1_, _/setspawn 2_) with the possibility of random teleportation.

**Safety:** Built-in location check before teleportation to prevent players from getting stuck in blocks.

**Improving Teams:** Support for Auto-completion (Tab Completer) for all commands, making their use as fast and convenient as possible.

## Warp materials design

`Materials can be configured via config.yml`

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ecac35c7b57ddda6dee68c194386ed30fa1b5a5.png)

**Default public warp material:** Compass

**Default server warp material:** Book

**Default spawn material:** BEACON

**Default warp material by name:** 

  `shop: Emerald`
  
  `mine: Diamond Pickaxe`
  
  `pvp: Diamond Sword`
  
  `home: Wooden door`
  
## Commands and Rights

`All rights can be set via plugin.yml`

**Resources can be downloaded on [GitHub](https://github.com/Lostor-dev/EasyWarps)**

`/warps [filter]`	Opens the GUI.	**easywarps.warps**

`/warp <name>`Teleports to the warp.	**easywarps.warp**

`/setwarp <name>`	Install a new warp. **easywarps.setwarp**

`/delwarp <name>`	Remove the warp.	**easywarps.delwarp**

`/spawn [number]`Teleports to spawn.	**easywarps.spawn**

`/setspawn [number]` Sets a spawn with a number (optional). **easywarps.setspawn**

`/delspawn [number]` Deletes the spawn with the number (optional). **easywarps.delspawn**

## Compatibility

**Platform:** Spigot, Paper (or forks based on the Spigot API).

**Minecraft Versions:** 1.16.5 - 1.20 .x and higher. **(recommended 1.18+)**

## Note from the developer

**Hello! My name is Lostor, and I am a novice Java developer. This plugin is my first major project. I tried to make it as clean, stable, and useful as possible. I will be glad to hear your feedback and to report any bugs I find! Your support will help me develop as a programmer.**

Set worlds to always be day, always night, rain-free, and customize all messages with full HEX color support! Body (Full Description) Tired of unpredictable weather in your lobby? Want to create a mining world that's perpetually dark and storm-free? xDay is the definitive solution. This extremely lightweight and efficient plugin gives you absolute control over the day-night cycle and the weather, all on a per-world basis. Its intuitive configuration and total message customization make it an essential tool for any server type, from Survival to minigames. ✨ Key Features ✅ Total Per-World Control: The main event! Assign a fixed time and weather to specific worlds (world, world_nether, lobby, etc.) and let the rest run normally. ⚙️ Simple & Intuitive Configuration: Everything is managed from a very easy-to-understand config.yml file. No complex in-game commands needed! 🎨 100% Customizable Messages: Edit every plugin message from messages.yml. Full support for classic Minecraft color codes (&a) and HEX color codes (<#FF5733>) for unique color palettes! 📖 Dynamic Help Menu: Add or remove lines from the help menu directly in the messages.yml file. Tailor the help message to your server! 🚀 Lightweight & High-Performance: Designed to be as efficient as possible, with no impact on your server's performance. 🤝 Developer API: Includes a simple API for other plugins to hook into xDay and get a world's configuration. ⌨️ Command Tab-Completion: The /xday help and /xday reload commands have tab completion for faster use. 🔧 Configuration The plugin generates two configuration files in the /plugins/xDay/ folder. config.yml ```yaml # _________ _____.__ # \_ ___ \ ____ _____/ ____\__| ____ # / \ \/ / _ \ / \ __\| |/ ___\ # \ \___( <_> ) | \ | | / /_/ > # \______ /\____/|___| /__| |__\___ / # \/ \/ /_____/ # Hecho con amor por 777 Studios - xPlugins # Usa colores HEX (<#RRGGBB>) o de Minecraft (&a, &b, etc.) prefix: "<#FFB347> [xDay] " reload: "<#77DD77>¡La configuración y los mensajes han sido recargados!" no-permission: "<#FF6961>No tienes permiso para ejecutar este comando." help-message: - "&7-----------------&f Ayuda de <#FFB347>xDay &7--------------------" - '' - "<#AEC6CF> /xday help <#878787>➛&f Muestra este mensaje de ayuda." - "<#AEC6CF> /xday reload <#878787>➛&f Recarga la configuración del plugin." - "" - "<#C3B1E1>💕 Plugin creado por WillfryDev. 💕" - '' - "&7---------------------------------------" ``` 💻 Commands & Permissions /xday help (Alias: /xd) Description: Displays the configurable help menu. Permission: xday.help (granted to all by default). /xday reload Description: Reloads the config.yml and messages.yml files without a server restart. Permission: xday.reload (granted to OPs by) ![bstats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/xDay/27310)
📘 For Developers (API) ```
xDay includes a static API to make integration with other plugins easy. 1. Add softdepend to your plugin.yml: YAML softdepend: [xDay] 2. Access the API in your code: Java // Check if xDay is on the server if (getServer().getPluginManager().getPlugin("xDay") != null) { // Get the API instance jn.willfrydev.xday.api.xDayAPI api = jn.willfrydev.xday.xDay.getApi(); // Example Usage World lobbyWorld = Bukkit.getWorld("lobby"); if (lobbyWorld != null) { String weather = api.getLockedWeather(lobbyWorld); // Returns "clear", "rain", or "disabled" String time = api.getLockedTime(lobbyWorld); // Returns "day", "night", etc. System.out.println("The weather in the lobby is locked to: " + weather); // You can also force an update api.forceUpdate(lobbyWorld); } }

title: Death Spectate
description: DeathSpectate is a complete Minecraft plugin that turns death into a temporary spectator experience
body:
# DeathSpectate

DeathSpectate transforms Minecraft deaths into a temporary spectator experience, keeping players safe and invisible while they wait to respawn.

## Features

- Spectate temporarily at the **death location**, keeping the same view angle.
- Fully configurable countdown before respawn.
- Customizable chat messages, **titles**, and **subtitles** for each player.
- Configurable death, tick, and respawn sounds.
- Respects player bed spawn; if none, respawns at **worldspawn** or **custom spawn** set with `/dssetspawn`.
- Full protection: players **cannot interact**, pick up items, take damage, invisible and flying during spectate.
- Admin commands:
  - `/dssetspawn` → set a custom spawn point.
  - `/dsreload` → reload plugin config without restarting the server.
- Common bug fixes:
  - Fire ticks reset after respawn.
  - Keeps players safe if they leave and rejoin the server while in spectate.

## Configuration

Fully customizable via `config.yml`:
- Chat messages, titles, and subtitles.
- Death, tick, and respawn sounds.
- Spectate duration.
- Custom spawn location.

---

Turn death into a smoother, safer, and more fun experience for your players while keeping your server secure from exploits.

body:
# idwthp
A minecraft client-side mod which prevent you from accidentally hurting other's pets. Useful for playing with pets lovers!

## Features
When enabled, prevents you from attacking any entity tamed by you or other players.

Press the hotkey (default: `H`) and the mod will be enabled/disabled.

## Installation
[Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/idwthp/versions) and put the `.jar` file into your `mods` folder.

## Some Q&A
Q: Why client-side only?

A: Because there's already plenty of mods and plugins which works around the problem from server-side. To me, this function is more like a protection than a restriction, so I decided to develop a fully client-side mod to achieve this.

Q: Supported minecraft versions?/When will the mod be updated?

A: There's not much code in here, so I think it'll work fine on most modern minecraft version, although only 1.21.5 was tested. To the same reason, the mod would probably work fine in newer versions without making any changes.

If you've tested the mod in another version, please let me know.

description: A Vanilla-Style Modpack made for Multiplayer and Singleplayer, to enhance the Minecraft experience in many ways.
body:
## Preview

Vanillus aims to give a new, fresh Minecraft experience not too far out of line with Unmodded/Vanilla. Many features are changed/improved, such as _mob behavior_, _structure generation_, _terrain generation_, and _player interaction_, while also boasting _performance optimizations_ over Vanilla. More mods will be added over time in future updates, as well as a guidebook and exclusive features.

Vanillus is made for both Singleplayer and Multiplayer 1.21. It falls in the Vanilla+ genre, and improves both tedious and exciting parts of Minecraft so that even someone who thought the game was getting stale would have many exciting moments and fresh experiences playing this pack. A player might face difficulties in the new dungeons or mobs in Vanillus, but they might then use the new interesting tools at their disposal to try to overcome them.

**Note:** This project is separate from the Curseforge project by the same name.

## Installation and Play

When installing this modpack, make sure that the memory is set to at least 4GB, or 4096MB, or else you may encounter some performance issues. All modded launchers are supported. Other than that, no other adjustments have to be made.

Vanillus contains the _Essential Mod_, which allows for easy Multiplayer without the use of a server host, along with other Multiplayer-friendly features. However, Singleplayer is supported and significantly improved as well.

title: Astra Abomina

body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1aad6709f921f94390b7f0ff4de3b642af38d4d.png)
------------------------------------------------------------
The Overworld welcomes a new age - The Age of Abominations. Though we may never reclaim this land, we may yet claim another. As you journey through these treacherous lands, you discover the plans for a way to escape the Overworld - a new planet to call home. This is Astra Abomina.

## What is Astra Abomina?
Astra Abomina is a horror-themed modpack with a goal to escape to the stars. Fight a myriad of terrifying creatures as you work to build your spaceship to escape the Overworld.

## What kind of threats will I face?
Most abominations have claimed all those who tried to document them, but we do know that they lurk in the caves and the fog...

## How do I escape?
That will depend entirely upon your skills. Those brave enough to venture into the Overworld will find the means to escape it entirely, however, in this quest they may find the means to push back against the abominations and reclaim what was lost.

# HB's Satellite Compat Mod

Compatability layer mod which adds support between HB's Satellites and **several** non-required weaponry and information mods including:

[Base Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/hbs-satellites)

### [Create: Big Cannons](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons) (>=5.11.2)

- Allows players to use the Target Controller and Target receiver blocks to orient the Cannon Mount towards a target location
- The Cannon itself needs to be loaded or it will not target correctly as the Cannon's power is determined by the current munitions

To use:
1. Place a Target Controller next to the array grid of Satellite Display Blocks which are powered on and connected to a Satellite
2. Place a Target Receiver Block directly next to the Cannon Mount Block, this can be anywhere in the world that is chunk loaded
3. Build the Cannon, load the Cannon, and construct the cannon with a redstone signal
4. Use the "target" button on the Target Controller to start the targeting process
5. Right Click any location on the Satellite holo-display to set the target - the cannon will orient itself towards the target automatically
6. You can fire the cannon anyway you like, or use the "fire" button on the Target Controller


### [Eshan's Missiles](https://modrinth.com/mod/eshans-missile-mod) **(NOT IMPLEMENTED YET)**
- Setting a target receiver block next to a Missile Silo will feed target position to Missile Silo
- Firing from Target Controller will trigger Missile launch from Silo

title: VartaPack
description: beta! A support report and diagnostics tool for Minecraft modpack authors.
body:
![prewiew](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9b1862f6efaee4e9e35a11248365d8aa5fe858a.png)
# VartaPack

A lightweight diagnostics, integrity, and support-report tool for Minecraft modpacks.

VartaPack helps modpack authors understand whether a player's instance is clean, modified, unsupported, or broken. It validates the local environment, detects common setup problems, and generates structured reports that are easy to share when support is needed.

## Purpose

VartaPack is not a performance mod.

It is a support layer for modpacks. It helps players see what is wrong and gives authors a clear overview before requesting full logs or crash reports.

## Checks

VartaPack can validate:

- Minecraft version
- mod loader
- Java version
- allocated RAM
- required mods
- recommended mods
- blocked mods
- extra mods
- known conflicts
- selected file integrity

Detected issues can be shown through a startup notification and an in-game issues screen.

## Pack status

VartaPack classifies the current instance as:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Clean | The instance matches the expected profile. |
| Modified | The player changed something, but no critical issue was detected. |
| Unsupported | The instance may still run, but support should be limited. |
| Broken | A critical issue was detected. |

## Support reports

Players can copy a generated support report with one click.

Reports may include:

- pack name and profile version
- Minecraft version
- loader and loader version
- Java version
- allocated RAM
- operating system
- detected issues
- missing required mods
- blocked mods
- extra mods
- installed mods
- suggested fixes

Reports are useful for GitHub issues, Discord support, CurseForge comments, and Modrinth support threads.

## Crash analysis

VartaPack can scan local logs and crash reports for common patterns, such as:

- mixin failures
- missing dependencies
- incompatible mod sets
- duplicate mods
- wrong Java version
- out of memory errors
- renderer conflicts

Crash analysis is meant to help with debugging. It does not replace manual investigation.

## Configuration

Modpack authors can configure VartaPack through:

```text
config/vartapack/
```

Common files:

```text
profile.json
rules.json
integrity.json
vartapack.json
```

These files define the expected environment, mod rules, conflict rules, integrity checks, support links, and report behavior.

Configuration examples and usage guide are available on [GitHub](https://github.com/stromblex/VartaPack).

## Privacy

VartaPack does not collect telemetry.

Reports are generated locally. Logs, mod lists, usernames, file paths, and personal data are not uploaded automatically.

The player decides whether to copy and share a report.

Private paths and usernames are redacted where possible.

## Limitations

VartaPack is a client-side diagnostics tool.

It cannot prevent every startup crash, because some crashes happen before any mod code can run. For those cases, use crash reports, doctor mode, and proper loader-level dependency or conflict rules.

## Companion use

VartaPack can be used together with [PackPing](https://modrinth.com/mod/packping).

Recommended setup:

- VartaPack for diagnostics, integrity checks, and support reports
- PackPing for modpack update notifications

They can also be used separately.

title: SCP-027, The Vermin God
description: An anomalous effect that spreads an infestation of vermin.
body:
The Vermin God adds a new entity. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-027, also known as the Vermin God.


SCP-027 is a phenomenon bound to a single host. Those afflicted by the effect become surrounded by swarms of insects and vermin that grow increasingly dangerous over time. The infestation progresses through three stages, each summoning more aggressive creatures. The curse can spread to nearby players or villagers upon death, ensuring that the plague of vermin never truly ends.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-027 spawn?

SCP-027 does not spawn naturally. Instead, you have to find a corpse that can spawn in caves like a normal monster. However, there can only be one host for SCP-027.

► Can I contain SCP-027

Yes, you can contain SCP-027. You will need a host for SCP-027 to contain it.

Build a 3x3 wide room with a large hole at the bottom which is filled with magma blocks, fire or lava to kill the vermin that spawns from the host. 3 blocks above the deadly trap should be a single glass pane or iron bar in the middle of the room, with no connection to the walls.

Place a boat on the block and trap a villager in it. Move the boat a bit to the side, so that it kinda floats above the trap, but is still on the block. The Villager needs to be the new SCP-027 host. To make that villager the next host, you will need to have the SCP-027 effect and die next to the villager, so that the effect spreads to the villager.

Now the upcoming vermin and insects from the SCP-027 should fall into the trap without attacking the current host. 

</details>



![SCP-027](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dfef6b23a94f5698b274d735fd72061d19ff379.png)

SCP-027 is an anomalous effect that progresses through three stages. In Stage one, SCP-027 will cover the host in flies and dust particles. Sometimes, it will spawn cockroaches and maggots. In Stage two, it will also spawn worms and centepedes. The Host will also noticed a slowness effect within Stage two. In the final stage, rats and spiders will also appear, while the host gets a slowness, weakness and mining fatique effect. The vermin spawned by SCP-027 will only attack the host of SCP-027 within a 20 block range. If a host dies, the SCP-027 effect spreads to the nearest player or villager within 20 blocks, continuing the infestation.

title: Depillage
description: Kill enough pillagers at an outpost to stop them from spawning
body:
# Depillage

Ever thought it's stupid that there is no way to prevent pillager outposts from spawning pillagers infinitely in a huge area? Yeah, me too.

This mod stops pillagers from spawning at their pillager outpost if enough pillagers have been killed near the outpost. Participating players will receive on-screen messages indicating their progress at the current outpost.

The mod is fully server-side but also works in singleplayer. If server-side, installing the mod on the client or installing [Polymer](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymer) on the server and enabling Auto-Host will enable custom text and translations for on-screen progress messages on the client, otherwise default English text will be used.

### Game rules
- `required_kills_to_prevent_spawning`: Amount of mob kills near the structure required to prevent spawning around the structure (default 100)
- `structure_kill_counting_radius`: Radius in blocks around structures where mob kills are counted (default 64)

### Configuring additional structures
The mod can actually be used to make any structure with unique mob spawns "clearable" - it's just preconfigured to work with pillager outposts out of the box. Simply add structures to the [`depillage:clearable` structure tag](https://github.com/pajicadvance/depillage/blob/multicutter-v2/src/main/resources/data/depillage/tags/worldgen/structure/clearable.json) using a data pack, and optionally provide [translations for on-screen progress messages](https://github.com/pajicadvance/depillage/blob/multicutter-v2/src/main/resources/assets/depillage/lang/en_us.json) (the mod will use default translations if none are provided). The mod will automatically detect which mob spawns are unique to the structure, count kills for those mobs, and prevent those mobs from spawning in that structure when enough have been killed.

title: HardcoreLives
description: This simple plugin adds hardcore lives to your minecraft server.
body:
# HardcoreLives

HardcoreLives is a straightforward plugin that adds a limited lives system to your Minecraft server. It’s built for SMPs or hardcore servers where you want death to have real consequences, but don't want to permanently ban your players.

When a player hits 0 lives, they get temp-banned for a set amount of time. To keep things balanced, players can use a specific item to add a life back to their account.

## Support
Support is available on my discord server.

## Features
* **Custom Temp-Bans:** Ban players for a specific amount of time when they run out of lives.
* **Life Management:** Set how many lives a player starts with, what their maximum cap is, and how many they get back after their ban expires.
* **Custom 'Life' Items:** Define an item that players can right-click to gain +1 life. It fully supports `CustomModelData`, so you can easily hook it into resource packs or plugins like ItemsAdder, Oraxen, or CraftEngine.
* **PlaceholderAPI:** Use `%hardcorelives_lives%` to display remaining lives on scoreboards or tab lists.
* **Custom Messages:** All messages are fully translatable and support MiniMessage formatting (`<red>`, `<bold>`, etc.).

## Commands & Permissions
* `/lives` - Check your remaining lives.
* `/lives [player]` - Check another player's lives.
* `/lives add <player> <amount>` - Add lives to a player. *(Permission: `hardcorelives.admin`)*
* `/lives set <player> <amount>` - Override and set a player's lives. *(Permission: `hardcorelives.admin`)*

## Configuration (config.yml)
```yaml
starting_lives: 3
ban_hours: 24
max_lives: 5
lives_after_ban: 1

life_item:
  enabled: true
  material: "NETHER_STAR"
  custom_model_data: 1111 # Optional: Remove this line to allow standard vanilla items

messages:
  kick_ban: "<red>You ran out of lives! Banned for %hours% hours.</red>"
  death_lives_remaining: "<yellow>You died! Lives remaining: %lives%</yellow>"
  command_lives_self: "<green>You have %lives% lives remaining.</green>"
  command_lives_other: "<green>%player% has %lives% lives remaining.</green>"
  command_player_not_found: "<red>Player not found.</red>"
  item_used: "<green>Added 1 life! You now have %lives% lives.</green>"
  admin_set: "<green>Set %lives% lives for %player%.</green>"
  admin_add: "<green>Added lives. %player% now has %lives% lives.</green>"
  no_permission: "<red>No permission (hardcorelives.admin).</red>"
  invalid_number: "<red>Invalid number provided.</red>"
  invalid_usage: "<red>Usage: /lives [player] | /lives <set/add> <player> <amount></red>"
```

title: DrainCounter
description: Counts the use of fireworks and respawn anchors
body:
# EN

**Client-side** mod that counts how many Respawn Anchors (⚓) players place and how many Firework Rockets (🎆) players use, and shows the counters right in the nametag.

> Counts are visual/client-only: it works on any server without installing anything server-side.

### ✨ Features
- **Nametag counters**: shows `⚓ Anchors` and `🎆 Fireworks` after the player name.
- **Colored icons**: anchors are purple, fireworks are soft red.
- **Auto reset on death**: counters reset when a player dies.
- **Client commands**:
  - `/draincounter list` — shows stats for currently loaded players.
  - `/draincounter reset` — prints stats then resets everything to zero.

### 📦 Dependencies
- **Fabric API** — required.

### ⚠ Notes
- Other players' anchor placements are detected using a best-effort heuristic.
- Your own anchor placements are confirmed via interaction + block check.

Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue on GitHub.



# RU

**Клиентский** мод, который считает сколько раз игроки поставили Якорь возрождения (⚓) и сколько раз использовали Фейерверки (🎆), и показывает это прямо в нике над головой.

> Счётчики видны только тебе (клиенту): мод работает на любых серверах без установки на сервер.

### ✨ Особенности
- **Счётчики в нике**: показывает `⚓ Якоря` и `🎆 Фейерверки` после ника игрока.
- **Цветные иконки**: якоря — фиолетовые, фейерверки — приятный красный.
- **Сброс при смерти**: при смерти игрока счётчики обнуляются.
- **Клиентские команды**:
  - `/draincounter list` — показывает статистику по загруженным игрокам.
  - `/draincounter reset` — выводит статистику и сбрасывает всё в ноль.

### 📦 Зависимости
- **Fabric API** — обязательно.

### ⚠ Примечания
- Якоря других игроков определяются эвристикой (best-effort).
- Свои якоря подтверждаются по взаимодействию + проверке поставленного блока.

title: bring back disarmed tripwire
description: Adds the pre-1.21.2 Minecraft functionality to disarm tripwires
body:
# Bring Back Disarmed Tripwire

Restores the pre-1.21.1 behavior of tripwire: when you use shears on tripwire string, it is disarmed instead of broken.

## What it does

- First shear hit on tripwire string: the string remains and becomes disarmed; shears lose 1 durability.
- Subsequent break (or shear) on an already disarmed string: the string breaks normally.
- Works in singleplayer and on dedicated servers.
- Clients do not need the mod to join a modded server running this.

## Installation (Fabric only)

### Dedicated server

1. Install Fabric Loader for your server version.
2. Place the built JAR into the `mods/` folder along with Fabric API.
3. Start the server. Vanilla clients can connect.

### Singleplayer

1. Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API on your client.
2. Place the JAR into your client `mods/` folder.
3. Launch the game. The behavior applies because singleplayer runs an integrated server.

## Build from source

```bash
./gradlew build
```

The remapped JAR will be in `build/libs/`.

## License

- MIT

![Building Package!! Modpack Logo](https://github.com/bluffcon/building_package/blob/main/building_package.png?raw=true)
# Building tools, all united!
ℹ️ ;; When I got bored and wanted to build a simple map with Axiom and alike, I found out that there aren't any packs like that! It was a real shame, so I made this one for everyone to use!

## Contents!!
🔨 :: This modpack features some strong building tools, optimizations, and cosmetic improvements! Giant-scale building with **Axiom**, posing with **Armor Stands**, a head, text, banner generator provided by **FZMM**, Datapack tools, Server Resource Pack utilities, Unicode character gallery, and many many more!

📊 :: If you value optimization, the pack is shipped with **Sodium and Lithium,** their addons, and some other culling mods to make sure your game doesn't lag! Iris and some **shaders** _(Complimentary, Fullbright, others)_ are also included, in case you want to see how everything looks fully done!

⚙️ :: This pack runs on Fabric, of the latest version. Most mods are client-side.

🏆 :: UI quality of life features are also included, like a cuter menu with **FancyMenu** with a dedicated *Menu Editing Mode* that allows you to move buttons around freely to make your own layout!

## Crash?
💀 :: The most common issue would be that your launcher named the modpack folder with the "!!" included, which makes Fabric unable to launch. Rename the folder to not have this special symbol.

## Unknown mods?
📖 :: Even if you're just starting out with these mods, the **Guide** button in the main menu has a list of featured mods and their main keybinds! Everything comes pre-configured, but if you want to change things up, Mod Menu allows for more customization!

## Afterword
🧧 :: This modpack is very simple, but if you feel the need, you can suggest more features or report bugs on the ⚠️ [issues Tracker](https://github.com/bluffcon/building_package/issues) over on GitHub! This pack will continue to get updates for a long time after its first release!

title: Teatime!
description: Adds a copper Kettle for simple, early-game brewing
body:
## you should download [Toil and Trouble](https://modrinth.com/mod/toil-and-trouble) instead lmao

By the time you access brewing, potions can already feel outclassed by enchantments. To give them a place again, **Teatime** adds a simple way to brew basic potions early-game!

![Kettle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8ecfff824e6c011b8abec8b292ca87de68299fd.png)


The **Kettle** can be crafted with 6 Copper Ingots, adding an extra use to Copper and making it accessible very early — in exchange, it can only brew 1 potion at a time and cannot strengthen them. By default, Awkward Potions can be made in the Kettle with any **Mushroom** in place of Nether Wart.

![heat sources](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2df12d3ccb674896728cd5355c848251450823e0.png)

Kettles don't require fuel, but can be placed over **hot** blocks to speed them up! Fire, Campfires, and their Soul variants offer a 1.5x boost, while a lit Furnace, Blast Furnace, or Smoker will brew twice as fast! 

![New recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0cf85fed48ace7b233726f7d2bd48f3bc037b4b.png)

Teatime features full JEI support and **data-driven recipes** making use of 1.21's Item Component system. To demonstrate, it includes balanced potions for effects that didn't previously have them, like Haste, Saturation, Glowing, and Blindness. They can all be edited or disabled through datapacks. 

## FAQ
- **Why is the UI so clunky?** I'm still working on it... The separate output slot was necessary to support stackable potions. I don't like it either.

- **Why mushrooms?** Growing mushroom colonies is fun! It's an underutilized mechanic. Why not? Replace it if you like. Spider Eyes are another good choice, I think.

- **The Brewing Stand has a much better design.** I know...T_T It's much more visual. Not a lot of thought went into the model for this mod i just thought a tea kettle would be cute and vaguely make sense 

- **How can I change the recipes?** JSON recipes are read from `teatime:data/recipes`. `base` is the item that goes in the bottle slot, `ingredient` is the item in the upper slot, and `result` is the output item — both `base` and `output` are ItemStacks and will match PotionContents attributes if included. I recommend unzipping the mod file to copy and edit the recipes it comes with!

- **You can already make custom potion recipes with [BlueLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/bluelib).** Yeah. If you want to edit recipes for the Brewing Stand, please use it instead.

## How else can I improve Minecraft's brewing?
Teatime was designed to be used with [Stackable Potions](https://modrinth.com/mod/stackablepotions) or an equivalent mod, and the ever-essential [Amendments](https://modrinth.com/mod/amendments) adds potion mixing in Cauldrons. I highly recommend them both! Also — huge thanks to KaupenJoe and his tutorial series for providing the base BlockEntity code I ripped off to make this <3

title: Timer (by echt)
description: A Datapack to display your playtime of a world.
body:
## THE NEWEST VERSION IS IN PROGRESS. STAY TUNED.

The timer datapack by echt is a datapack to simply display your time you've spent in your Minecraft world. Once applied to the world, it will count the reallife-time you have been ingame. Without hours of setting up, it will start count up as soon as you joined the world! It can also be paused and reset.

**_! All Versions Up To 16w03v Only Use German As Language For In-Game Notifications !_**

**_! Version 18w05v Only Supports German And English As Languages, French May And Will Show Errors !_**

As this is an early version of the pack, it will receive updates and new features over time.

# Usage
By dragging it into the world creation-menu, you will activate the timer automatically when you join the world. It will count your Seconds, Minutes, Hours and even Days you spent in your Survival or Creative world.

## Commands


```
/trigger t.pause
```
Pause the timer, good for being idle. Will show "Timer paused" instead of the time you've spent. Reactivate the timer by using...

```
/trigger t.resume
```
Resumes the timer. After pausing the timer, you can use this command to re-activate it. It will use the last saved timecode, so you can just jump right again into your gameplay!

```
/trigger t.reset
```
Resets the timer. Using this command will pause the timer and reset it to complete zero. Useful if you want to start the world with your friends and don't want to count the time you spent setting up the world, as example.

```
/trigger t.settings
```
Opens the settings menu with options to manipulate displayed time or ending the timer after a specific scenario (like killing the enderdragon). More coming soon.
**Only 18w05v or higher**

title: CIT for Roguelike Dungeons
description: Custom Item Textures for RLD's Novelty Items
body:
[![Check out the picture Gallery!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5H3YIqHN/images/5cc6a6e9bb2c518cc5fd0a3a90f8b5dbe6dbb656.gif)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/rld-cit/gallery)

[![Designed for Roguelike Dungeons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba3e3f06f5031945bef126c9b31580bf8a25c860.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/roguelikedungeons)
[![Requires CIT Resewn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4218ce7399d9320fd6db9d6a328b34e1e8b848d2.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn) [![Requires Animatica](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/869cb329618064c782cbfd0b6337ed9f8b524b93.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/animatica)

Adds custom item textures (animated and emissive) for Novelty Items and custom potions generated by the Roguelike Dungeons mod.  
- 12 Novelty Items: ANIMATED and EMISSIVE (16x16 px).  
- 10 Potion Mixtures: (16x16 px)  

### If you love collecting stuff, this is a MUST HAVE!

I'm pretty sure there are thousands of players that have completely ignored Roguelike dungeons' Novelty Items, simply because they didn't stand out.  
I mean, you open a chest while being attacked by hoardes of zombies and among all items inside, you see a Cookie or a Stick. Would you even consider stopping to look at its tooltip?
Or a random Zombie spawns with Bread in its hand. Would you care to even pick it up?  

When I checked the code, I wondered what was so special about these items, so I researched videos and forums from 11, 12 years ago and discovered how precious those memories were.  

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/6bI9nzdh6Uk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>  

That's why I created this Resource pack, so players would feel excited when they find these rare, collectable items. Just like the mod dev imagined.  

### CAUTION!

The Novelty items are not meant to be placed or eaten.  
Remember they are just Vanilla items with custom name, lore and enchantments!  
Therefore, if you place the block ones (Sign, etc.) or eat the food ones, they are gone forever!  
Do not use orally after using rectally.  

-------  

You need Animatica and CIT Resewn for this Resource Pack to work.  


All Novelty items textures and models were designed by [Artsy](https://www.curseforge.com/members/star_artsy/projects)'s blessed hands.  
The Potion Mixtures textures were created by me.  

You are free to include this Resourcepack in your Modpack, as long as it includes a link to this project.  

You are not allowed to repost this Resourcepack or claim it as yours. (These textures cost me actual money, so don't steal them!)

title: ColdWinter
description:
[1.8-1.21+] Freeze your server when no ones playing!

Save power and resources!
body:
# ColdWinter [1.8-1.21+]
Freeze your server when no one's home!

Unload chunks and make the server sleep when no ones on-line. Handy for small servers that might not see constant player activity (hosting for a group of friends, etc).

A spiritual successor of [Hibernate](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/hibernate.4441/) for 1.21 and beyond!


Commands

```
/coldwinter - Toggles freezing on/off.
/coldwinter status - Displays the current freezing status & loaded chunks.
/coldwinter reload - Reloads the ColdWinter configuration.
```
Permissions

```
coldwinter.toggle
```


FAQ:

  Q1: My web-map plugin isn't rendering anymore!? 
  
  - A1: Because we're freezing the server, stuff like dynmap will stop background renders when no-ones online. You could temporarily toggle the plugin and let a render happen.
  


  Q2: "Can’t Keep Up! Is the Server Overloaded?" messages are appearing constantly!?
  
  - A2: This happens, because we're freezing the server (running at a low tickrate). 
     In anycase, using something like [LogCleaner](https://github.com/appztr4ckt/LogCleaner/) would be beneficial to get rid of old logs.
     


  Q3: My server performance monitoring plugin says my TPS is bad!?
  
  - A3: Read A1

[bStats](https://bstats.org/) statistics (which can be disabled inside its configuration for your server).

![bstats graph that shows servers and players](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/coldwinter.svg)


_[Icon background by Dawid Boldys (Canva)](https://www.pexels.com/photo/deer-on-snowfield-at-daytime-745499/)_

title: Exploration Innovation
description: A modpack focused on exploration and the origins mod!
body:
### Exploration Innovation is a modpack focused on, wouldn't you guess it, exploration.

![A jungle background with the text "Exploration Innovation" over it.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efac534f8eb7652b25005be1503fd0a5ad2ed76d.png)

When you first create a world, you'll need to choose an origin. This choice may affect your playthrough drastically, slightly, or not at all depending on your preference. Choose wisely!

After this, you'll have the opportunity to explore your world and find a variety of new structures. Deliberately, the choice has been made to exclude the most popular structure mods such as the YUNGs series of structures. This is because I see them in nearly every pack that I play and have gotten tired of them, I can't imagine I'm the only one to feel this way! They're great structures, but some variety is great to have too!

![A ancient city on the surface shrouded under moonlight.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/528080c5ea2bf61b71346aab76c02ac942eea407.png)

![A stray fortress in a cold climate.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51114636282dbfb968783255ae52ea13a47226ef.png)

There are also a tasteful, small amount of new biomes included in the pack. Enough that you'll certainly encounter them, but not so much that they drown out the vanilla biomes you know and love.

![A coconut biome with a small village.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/209a64be4cec2b0d9387ba0a095b538172109107.png)

Here's a list of some changes that will make exploring your world feel much more fun than it is in vanilla:

- Dozens of new structures and biomes for you to find.
- You can now create real, block built ships and airships using the Eureka mod.
- Minecarts can now be linked together with chains
- Minecarts now go much faster when their rails are on top of Gravel Blocks.
- Minecart Rails are now also craftable with Copper Ingots.
- Horses are faster than their vanilla counterparts.
- Horses can now equip Horseshoes, which improve speed and are enchantable.
- Horse armor is now trimmable.
- Horses and their riders now walk through leaves.
- Horses can now swim with a rider.
- Sacks let you carry more items in the early game similarly to Shulker Boxes.
- Elytra can now roll like a plane can (toggleable).
- The ocean is much more populated than before.
- Expanded archaeology and rewards for persuing it.
- Craftable Atlases to create a finite, tangible mini-map.
- Expanded combat with the Better Combat mod to make fighting through structures more fun.
- A set of balanced new craftale weapons to add variety to combat.

### Credits
- All mods are the creations of their respective authors, listed in the dependencies section. Please show them your support!
- Blockbench title generator (which the packs title text was made using) created by Ewan Howell
- Custom recipe datapacks made with the help of TheDestruc7i0n's website, [https://crafting.thedestruc7i0n.ca/](https://crafting.thedestruc7i0n.ca/)
