title: Man Hunt latest
description: Minecraft Manhunt is a competitive game plugin in which multiple players are divided into hunters and runners.
body:
# 🏃 Minecraft Manhunt Latest - Project Summary

[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/man-hunt-latest?label=Downloads&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/man-hunt-latest)
[![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/0x48lab/minecraft_manhunt?label=Latest%20Release)](https://github.com/0x48lab/minecraft_manhunt/releases)
[![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.4-green.svg)](https://www.minecraft.net/)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Spigot%20%7C%20Paper-orange.svg)](https://papermc.io/)

A comprehensive multiplayer Manhunt plugin for Minecraft servers featuring advanced tracking systems, economy integration, and full internationalization support.

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 Core Manhunt Gameplay
- **Dynamic Role System**: Players can be Hunters, Runners, or Spectators
- **Advanced Compass Tracking**: Virtual compass-based tracking with target switching
- **Proximity Warning System**: Tiered warning system for Runners when Hunters approach
- **Automatic Game Management**: Smart game state handling with reconnection support

### ⏱️ Game Modes
- **Time Limit Mode** (default 40 minutes)
  - Game ends when time expires
  - Winner determined by proximity/escape time ratio
  - Kill bonus adds 5 minutes to killer's team time
  - Real-time dominance percentage display
  - Instant runner respawn in this mode
- **Endless Mode** (time-limit: 0)
  - Traditional Manhunt gameplay
  - Game continues until victory conditions are met
  - Runner respawn with 300-second wait time
  - No time pressure, strategic gameplay focus

### 💰 Economy & Shop System
- **In-Game Currency**: Earn coins through gameplay actions
- **Comprehensive Shop**: 40+ items across 6 categories (Weapons, Armor, Tools, Consumables, Food, Special)
- **Role-Based Rewards**: Different earning methods for Hunters and Runners
- **Purchase Restrictions**: Item limits, cooldowns, and role-specific restrictions
- **Movement Bonus**: Sprint movement rewards when enemies are within 3 chunks

### 🌍 Full Internationalization
- **Multi-Language Support**: Complete English and Japanese localization
- **Player-Specific Languages**: Individual language preferences
- **Localized Shop Items**: All items and descriptions fully translated
- **Dynamic UI**: All interfaces adapt to player language settings

### 📊 Advanced Statistics & Results
- **Detailed Player Statistics**: Track performance, earnings, and achievements
- **MVP System**: Automatic recognition of top performers
- **Comprehensive Game Results**: Multi-stage result presentation with visual effects
- **Team Rankings**: Performance-based team and individual rankings

### 🎮 Enhanced User Experience
- **Role Selection GUI**: Intuitive graphical role selection menu
- **Spectator Menu**: Easy teleportation system for spectators
- **Team Communication**: Private team chat and coordinate sharing
- **Buddy System**: Partner up with a teammate for enhanced coordination
- **Real-time UI**: Dynamic scoreboard, action bar, and boss bar displays
- **Warp System**: Teleport to teammates with cost and delay
- **Automatic Night Skip**: Skip to dawn when night falls
- **Achievement Reset**: Fresh start for each game

## 🎯 Game Objectives

- **🏃 Runners**: Defeat the Ender Dragon to achieve victory
- **🗡 Hunters**: Eliminate all Runners before they complete their objective
- **👁 Spectators**: Observe the game with full mobility and teleportation options

## 📋 Requirements

- **Minecraft Version**: 1.21.4
- **Server Software**: Spigot or Paper
- **Java Version**: 21 or higher
- **Minimum Players**: 2 (configurable)

## 🎮 Quick Start

1. Join the server and run `/manhunt roles`
2. Select your role using menu (GUI menu)
3. Wait for minimum players and automatic game start
4. Use `/manhunt help` for all available commands

## ⚙️ Configuration

The plugin is highly configurable through `config.yml`:

```yaml
# Language Settings
language:
  default: "en"                    # Default language (ja/en)
  per-player: true                 # Per-player language settings

# Game Settings
game:
  min-players: 2                   # Minimum players to start
  start-countdown: 10              # Countdown before game start
  reset-advancements: true         # Reset achievements on game start
  time-limit: 40                   # Game time limit in minutes (0 for endless)
  
  # Time Mode Settings (only active when time-limit > 0)
  time-mode:
    kill-bonus: 5                  # Minutes added for each kill
    proximity-distance: 3          # Chunks for proximity calculation
    runner-instant-respawn: true   # Instant respawn for runners
    runner-respawn-time: 30        # Respawn wait time in seconds

# Economy Settings
economy:
  starting-balance: 0              # Starting money (0G)
  currency-unit: "G"               # Currency symbol
  earn-multiplier: 2.0             # Earning rate multiplier
  hunter:
    damage-reward: 5               # Reward per damage point
    kill-reward: 150               # Reward per kill
    tracking-reward: 30            # Continuous tracking bonus
  runner:
    survival-bonus: 0.05           # Survival bonus per second
    nether-reward: 200             # Nether entry reward
    end-reward: 500                # End entry reward
```

## 🎯 Commands

### Player Commands
- `/manhunt role <runner|hunter|spectator>` - Change role (waiting only)
- `/manhunt roles` - Open role selection GUI
- `/manhunt status` - Check game status
- `/manhunt compass` - Get tracking compass (Hunters only)
- `/manhunt spectate` - Open spectator menu (Spectators only)
- `/r <message>` - Team chat
- `/pos` - Share coordinates with team
- `/shop` - Open shop menu
- `/shop balance` - Check balance
- `/buddy <subcommand>` - Buddy system commands (during game only)
- `/warp <player>` - Teleport to teammate (costs 100G, 5s delay)

### Admin Commands
- `/manhunt start` - Force start game
- `/manhunt stop` or `/manhunt end` - Force stop game
- `/manhunt sethunter <player>` - Assign hunter role
- `/manhunt setrunner <player>` - Assign runner role
- `/manhunt setspectator <player>` - Assign spectator role
- `/manhunt minplayers <number>` - Set minimum players
- `/manhunt reload [config|shop|all]` - Reload configurations
- `/manhunt ui <toggle|status>` - Control UI displays
- `/manhunt respawntime <player> <seconds>` - Set custom respawn time
- `/manhunt reset` - Force reset game (after game ended only)
- `/manhunt give <player> <amount>` - Give money to player
- `/manhunt validate-messages` - Check message file integrity
- `/manhunt diagnose` - Output diagnostic information

## 🏆 Economy System

### Earning Methods

**🗡 Hunters:**
- 5G per damage point dealt to Runners
- 150G per Runner elimination
- 30G for tracking a Runner continuously for 30 seconds (within 100m)
- 1.5G every 30 seconds (time bonus)

**🏃 Runners:**
- 1.5G every 30 seconds (survival bonus)
- 200G for reaching the Nether
- 300G for finding a fortress
- 500G for reaching the End
- 25G per diamond collected
- 20G for successful escapes (100m+ distance)
- Movement bonus when sprinting with enemies nearby

### Shop Categories
- **⚔️ Weapons**: Swords, axes, tridents
- **🛡️ Armor**: Full armor sets in various materials
- **🔧 Tools**: Pickaxes, shovels, buckets
- **🧪 Consumables**: Potions, golden apples
- **🍖 Food**: Various food items
- **✨ Special**: Elytra, ender pearls, emeralds

## 🌟 Advanced Features

### Spawn Placement System
- **Dynamic Placement Range**: Automatically adjusts based on total players
  - 2 players: Max 500m
  - 20 players: Max 2000m
  - 20+ players: Additional 500m per 20 players
- **Enemy Distance**: Minimum distance between enemy teams (default: 500m)
- **Team Ratio Adjustments**:
  - Minority team: Placed close together
  - Majority team: Spread apart based on team ratio
- **Safe Placement**: Avoids dangerous locations, places on ground

### Proximity Warning System
- **Red Alert**: Hunter within 1 chunk
- **Orange Alert**: Hunter within 2 chunks  
- **Yellow Alert**: Hunter within 3 chunks
- **Frequency Control**: Warnings limited to prevent spam

### Virtual Compass Tracking System
- Physical compass item or empty hand right-click
- Target switching with right-click (cycles through runners)
- Distance and direction indicators with particles
- Same-world tracking only
- Death state awareness (dead runners not tracked)
- 1-second cooldown between uses

### Team Coordination
- Private team chat with `/r <message>`
- Coordinate sharing with `/pos`
- Real-time teammate positions in Tab list
- Buddy system for enhanced teamwork

### Buddy System
- Partner with one teammate for closer coordination
- Real-time buddy location display in scoreboard
- Orange color highlighting in player list
- Commands: `/buddy invite`, `accept`, `decline`, `remove`, `status`
- Mutual consent required for buddy relationships
- Automatic cleanup on game end or player disconnect

### Respawn System
- **Hunters**: Instant respawn (1 tick delay)
- **Runners**: 
  - Endless mode: 300-second wait in spectator mode
  - Time mode: Instant respawn
  - Real-time countdown display
  - Full spectator capabilities during wait

### Encounter Notifications
- Automatic notification when hunter finds runner
- Configurable cooldown between notifications
- Sound and title effects
- Prevents duplicate notifications for continuous proximity

## 🔧 Technical Details

- **Language**: Kotlin 1.9.24
- **Build Tool**: Gradle 8.8
- **Target JVM**: Java 21
- **API**: Spigot/Paper 1.21.5(Tested)
- **Architecture**: Event-driven with comprehensive manager classes

### Core Components
- `Main.kt` - Plugin main class
- `GameManager.kt` - Game state and player management
- `VirtualCompass.kt` - Virtual compass tracking system
- `EventListener.kt` - Event handling
- `UIManager.kt` - User interface management
- `EconomyManager.kt` - Currency system
- `MessageManager.kt` - Internationalization
- `ProximityTimeTracker.kt` - Time mode tracking

### Building

1. Clone the repository
2. Run `./gradlew build`
3. The plugin JAR will be in `build/libs/`

### Message Key Validation

The build process automatically checks that all message keys used in the code are defined in both `ja.yml` and `en.yml` files. 

To manually check message keys:
```bash
./gradlew checkMessageKeys
```

If any keys are missing, the build will fail and provide suggestions for the missing keys.

## 📝 Latest Updates (2025-07-22)

### New Features
- **Achievement Reset**: Automatically resets all player achievements when game starts
- **Night Skip**: Automatically advances to dawn when night falls (configurable)
- **Warp Command**: Teleport to teammates with 100G cost and 5-second delay
- **Tracking Persistence Bonus**: Hunters earn 30G for continuously tracking runners

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed runner respawn visibility bug where dead runners appeared in survival mode instead of spectator mode
- Fixed compass tracking continuing for dead runners during respawn wait time
- Fixed distance display showing actual distance for dead runners (now shows 0m)
- Fixed economy bonus payouts for dead runners
- Prevented duplicate encounter notifications
- Fixed role selector GUI not working after game reset
- Fixed various hardcoded language strings throughout the codebase
- Removed unnecessary game reset countdown for instant reset after results display

title: Arcane Caches
description: Adds rare structures with endgame+ loot to the world.
body:
This is a first release data pack, created to get the idea out of my head. While it has been tested for funcionality, the game mechanics it adds may not be properly balanced 
yet. Constructive feedback on the balance is appreciated.

This data pack adds rare structures with endgame+ loot, beyond what's obtainable in vanilla survival to the world. Occasional random encounters with custom wandering traders offering explorer maps to the nearest structure are also generated.

<details>
<summary>Notes For Use</summary>
  
1. This data pack is best installed before initial world generation. The vanilla world generation only adds structures to newly generated chunks. Due to the rarity of the structures, significant new exploration may be required to produce structures on established worlds.

2. This data pack contains loot tables that use luck modifiers. If used with other data packs/plugins/mods that allow players to acquire elevated luck attributes, overly generous loot will be generated.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Notes For Multi-Player</summary>
  
1. Use in a multi-player environment was anticipated during development. While rare, structure generation should be frequent enough that players can reasonably locate new ones in the late game. All random events are unique per player.

2. If installed on a server where the world seed is known, server owners may want to modify the salt values of the structure set files located in 'data/arcane_caches/worldgen/structure_set/' to prevent players installing this datapack on a single player world to locate the structures.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Feedback</summary>
Feedback can be sent to arcane.caches@mrdrkn.net; include the word 'alpaca' in the subject line.
</details>

Sodium: Replaces Minecraft's renderer with a more efficient and optimized version, drastically improving frame rates and reducing lag. (this is the main mod)

Lithium: Optimizes numerous game mechanics and systems, resulting in better overall performance without affecting gameplay or visuals.

Dynamic FPS: Adjusts frame rates dynamically when Minecraft is running in the background, saving system resources.

Entity Culling: Prevents rendering of entities that are out of sight, improving performance during gameplay.

FerriteCore: Reduces memory usage by optimizing the way Minecraft handles data.
Krypton: Enhances network performance, reducing latency and improving the multiplayer experience.

ImmediatelyFast: Speeds up various aspects of Minecraft to improve overall responsiveness.

ModernFix: Fixes bugs and optimizes performance for modern systems.

Cloth Config API: Provides a user-friendly interface for configuring the various mods included in the pack.

title: Ember's Log Filtering
description: A highly configurable log filtering mod for Minecraft
body:
# LogFilter

A highly configurable log filtering mod for Minecraft. Suppress noisy log messages, highlight important ones, and keep your console clean — all with hot-reloadable rules.

## Features

- **Regex message filtering** — Match and suppress log messages by content using regular expressions
- **Logger name filtering** — Filter by exact logger name or regex pattern, with hierarchical matching
- **Log level filtering** — Target specific log levels (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR)
- **Filter actions** — DENY (suppress), ALLOW (force show), or NEUTRAL (pass through) per rule
- **Per-rule enable/disable** — Toggle individual rules without removing them
- **Hot-reload** — Edit `logfilter.json` and changes apply instantly, no restart needed
- **Default rules included** — Ships with pre-made (disabled) rules for common log spam

## Supported Platforms

| Loader | Minecraft Version |
|--------|-------------------|
| Forge | 1.20.1 |
| NeoForge | 1.21.1 |
| Fabric | 1.20.1 |
| Fabric | 1.21.1 |

## Configuration

LogFilter stores its config in `logfilter.json` in your Minecraft config directory. The file is created automatically on first launch with sensible defaults.

### Example Config

```json
{
  "configVersion": 1,
  "enabled": true,
  "rules": [
    {
      "name": "Suppress OpenAL spam",
      "enabled": true,
      "type": "MESSAGE_REGEX",
      "pattern": "(?i)openal",
      "action": "DENY",
      "level": null
    },
    {
      "name": "Block debug logs from server level",
      "enabled": true,
      "type": "LOGGER_NAME",
      "pattern": "net.minecraft.server.level",
      "action": "DENY",
      "level": "DEBUG"
    },
    {
      "name": "Always show errors",
      "enabled": true,
      "type": "LEVEL",
      "pattern": "ERROR",
      "action": "ALLOW",
      "level": null
    }
  ]
}
```

### Rule Types

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `MESSAGE_REGEX` | Match the log message content against a regex pattern |
| `LOGGER_NAME` | Match by exact logger name or prefix (hierarchical) |
| `LOGGER_REGEX` | Match logger names using a regex pattern |
| `LEVEL` | Match by log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR) |

### Actions

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `DENY` | Suppress the log message |
| `ALLOW` | Force the message through, regardless of other rules |
| `NEUTRAL` | No effect — pass through to the next rule |

### Optional Level Restriction

Any rule can include a `level` field to restrict it to a specific log level. For example, a `LOGGER_NAME` rule with `"level": "DEBUG"` will only match debug messages from that logger.

## Default Rules

LogFilter ships with several pre-configured rules (disabled by default) to get you started:

- Suppress OpenAL/LWJGL info spam
- Suppress advancement loading messages
- Suppress debug logs from `net.minecraft.server.level`
- Suppress recipe loading messages
- Always allow ERROR-level messages

Enable them by setting `"enabled": true` in the config file.

title: Bedrock Miner
description: Allows players to mine bedrock with a netherite pickaxe
body:
# Bedrock Miner

**Bedrock Miner** is a Fabric mod that allows players to mine bedrock in survival mode through a fully configurable and balanced mining system.

Instead of simply making bedrock breakable, the mod integrates with Minecraft's mining mechanics and lets server owners or players decide exactly how difficult bedrock should be to obtain.

## Features

### Configurable Bedrock Mining

Every aspect of bedrock mining can be customized through an in-game configuration screen (Mod Menu + Cloth Config):

* Adjustable bedrock hardness
* Configurable minimum pickaxe tier required to mine bedrock
* Optional bedrock block drops
* Changes can be made without editing configuration files manually

### Vanilla-Based Mining Formula

Mining speed is calculated using Minecraft's real tool mining speeds:

| Pickaxe   | Mining Speed |
| --------- | ------------ |
| Wood      | 2            |
| Stone     | 4            |
| Copper    | 5            |
| Iron      | 6            |
| Diamond   | 8            |
| Netherite | 9            |
| Gold      | 12           |

Efficiency enchantments use their vanilla mining bonuses:

| Efficiency | Bonus |
| ---------- | ----- |
| I          | +2    |
| II         | +5    |
| III        | +10   |
| IV         | +17   |
| V          | +26   |

The Haste effect is also fully supported and further increases mining speed.

### Progressive Mining

* Continuous mining is required
* The mining process resets if the player stops mining
* Vanilla-style crack animation is displayed during mining
* Tool durability is consumed correctly
* Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer

## Default Settings

By default, the mod is configured to preserve game balance:

* Hardness: **150**
* Minimum Pickaxe: **Netherite**
* Bedrock Drops: **Disabled**

This makes bedrock a late-game resource that still requires significant investment to obtain.

## Why Use Bedrock Miner?

Many bedrock-breaking mods either make bedrock trivial to obtain or rely on exploits. Bedrock Miner provides a configurable alternative that feels like a natural extension of Minecraft's progression system.

Whether you want a challenging late-game objective, a custom server economy, or simply more control over survival gameplay, Bedrock Miner lets you decide how bedrock should behave in your world.

## Technical Details

* Server-side mining logic
* Client synchronization for mining progress
* Multiplayer compatible
* In-game configuration support
* Fabric API support
* Mod Menu integration
* Cloth Config integration

## Compatibility

* Minecraft **1.21.11**
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API

## Dependencies

Required:

* Fabric API
* Cloth Config

Optional:

* Mod Menu (for the in-game configuration screen)

title: MC Matrix Bridge
description: A forge mod that bridges chat between a Minecraft server and a matrix room.
body:
# Minecraft Matrix Bridge (Forge/NeoForge, Server-Only)
Bridges chat between a Minecraft server and **one Matrix room** (unencrypted only). ## Features - **MC → Matrix**: forwards player chat into a Matrix room. - **Matrix → MC**: forwards Matrix `m.text` room messages into Minecraft server chat. - **Server-only**: vanilla clients can join without installing anything (no client mod). - Sync state stored in the **world save** (prevents replay spam on restart). - The "Matrix room connected: …" notice is localized server-side based on each player's reported client language (currently includes `en_us` and `zh_cn`). - If the bot is **invited** to the configured room but not joined yet, it will **auto-accept the invite** and join on startup. - **Event Taps**: dynamically subscribe to Forge/NeoForge events and forward them to Matrix for debugging/monitoring. ## Requirements - Java 17 (Forge 1.18–1.20), Java 21 (Forge/NeoForge 1.21.x), or Java 25 (Forge/NeoForge 26.1) - Minecraft Forge/NeoForge server matching the versions. I only manually test it in popular minor versions, and hopefully it works in other minor versions. - 1.18.2 - 1.19.2 - 1.20.1 - 1.21.1 - 26.1 - Matrix room must be **unencrypted** (no E2EE) ## Installation 1. Download the jar or build it locally with `./scripts/build_dist.sh` (all supported versions) or `./scripts/build_dist_26.sh` (26.x only). The generated jars are written to `dist/`. 2. Drop the jar into your Forge/NeoForge server's `mods/` folder (pick the jar matching your loader + Minecraft major). 3. Start the server once to generate config. ### Build all versions (creates `dist/`) To build jars for all supported Minecraft versions and collect them into `dist/`: - `./scripts/build_dist.sh` `dist/` includes Forge jars for 1.18.x–1.21.x and 26.x, plus NeoForge jars for 1.21.x and 26.x. ### Build only the 26.x line The 26.x projects use the dedicated Gradle 9 wrapper and are conditionally included by `settings.gradle`. - Build and collect both 26.x jars into `dist/`: `./scripts/build_dist_26.sh` - Build Forge 26 only: `./gradlew-26 -Pomx_modern_26=true :forge-26:build` - Build NeoForge 26 only: `./gradlew-26 -Pomx_modern_26=true :neoforge-26:build` - On Windows, use `gradlew-26.bat` instead of `./gradlew-26` `./scripts/build_dist_26.sh` produces: - `dist/minecraftmatrixbridge-forge-26.x-.jar` - `dist/minecraftmatrixbridge-neoforge-26.x-.jar` - `dist/SHA256SUMS.txt` ## Configuration Edit `config/minecraftmatrixbridge.toml`: - `matrix.homeserver` (required) e.g. `https://matrix.example.com` - `matrix.roomId` (required) room ID `!abcdef:example.com` or room alias `#myroom:example.com` (the room **should not be encrypted**) - `matrix.accessToken` (required, or use env variable `MATRIX_ACCESS_TOKEN`) ### Bridge Options - `bridge.enableMcToMatrix` (default `true`) - Forward MC chat to Matrix - `bridge.enableMatrixToMc` (default `true`) - Forward Matrix messages to MC - `bridge.announceConnected` (default `true`) - Announce `Matrix room connected: {roomIdOrAlias}` when bridge starts - `bridge.enableJoinLeaveToMatrix` (default `false`) - Send `{player} joined/left the game` to Matrix - `bridge.enableServerLifecycleToMatrix` (default `false`) - Send `Server started/stopping` to Matrix - `bridge.mcToMatrixPrefix` (default `[MC] `) - Prefix for MC messages in Matrix - `bridge.matrixToMcPrefix` (default `[Matrix] `) - Prefix for Matrix messages in MC - `bridge.matrixBotPrefix` (default `!mc`) - Matrix bot command prefix; messages starting with this prefix are treated as bot commands and are not forwarded to Minecraft chat - `bridge.syncTimeoutMs` (default `30000`) - Matrix sync timeout in milliseconds - `bridge.timelineLimit` (default `20`) - Maximum timeline events per sync - `bridge.maxQueueSize` (default `1000`) - Maximum outgoing message queue size - `bridge.dedupSize` (default `512`) - Event deduplication cache size ### Event Tap Options - `bridge.enableEventTaps` (default `true`) - Enable or disable event taps feature entirely. When disabled, no event indexing occurs at startup. - `bridge.maxActiveEventTaps` (default `10`) - Maximum concurrent event subscriptions - `bridge.defaultEventThrottleMs` (default `1000`) - Minimum interval between forwarded events (prevents spam) - `bridge.eventCommandMinPowerLevel` (default `50`) - Minimum Matrix power level required to use event commands from Matrix (0=default user, 50=moderator, 100=admin) ## World-save state Sync state is stored at: - `/data/minecraftmatrixbridge/state.json` ## Commands ### Minecraft Commands (OP-only) - `/matrix status` - Show bridge status - `/matrix reload` - Reload bridge config - `/matrix test` - Send a test message to Matrix ### Matrix Bot Commands Matrix room bot commands (requires `bridge.enableMatrixToMc=true`): - `!mc help` (or replace `!mc` with `bridge.matrixBotPrefix`) - `!mc list` - Replies with online player names; command messages are not forwarded into Minecraft chat ## Event Taps (Advanced) Event taps allow server operators to subscribe to Forge/NeoForge events at runtime and forward them to the Matrix room. This is useful for debugging and monitoring. ### Minecraft Commands (OP-only) - `/matrix event on [filter] [duration]` - Enable event tap - `eventName`: Simple class name (e.g., `ServerChatEvent`) or fully-qualified class name - `filter`: Optional substring filter (case-insensitive) - `duration`: `once` (default), `permanent`, or time-based (`30s`, `10m`, `2h`, `1d`) - `/matrix event off ` - Disable event tap - `/matrix event list` - List active event taps - `/matrix event search ` - Search available events - `/matrix event help` - Show help ### Matrix Bot Commands Same commands available via Matrix (requires `bridge.enableMatrixToMc=true` and `bridge.enableEventTaps=true`): - `!mc event on [filter] [duration]` - `!mc event off ` - `!mc event list` - `!mc event search ` - `!mc event help` Matrix event commands require the sender to have a power level >= `bridge.eventCommandMinPowerLevel` (default 50). ### Safety Features - Master switch (`enableEventTaps`) - Disable entirely to skip event indexing at startup - Maximum 10 concurrent event taps (configurable) - Default 1-second throttle between forwarded events - Tick events automatically enforce minimum 1-second throttle - Event output truncated to 2048 characters - Client-only events are rejected on dedicated servers ### Examples ``` # Monitor all chat events (fire once) /matrix event on ServerChatEvent # Monitor player logins for 10 minutes /matrix event on PlayerLoggedInEvent "" 10m # Monitor block breaks with "diamond" in the event data, permanently /matrix event on BlockEvent diamond permanent # From Matrix !mc event on ServerChatEvent !mc event list !mc event off ServerChatEvent ``` ## AI use declaration Codex and cursor are used to develop this project. ## Acknowledgments I appreciate the great mod projects (e.g. [Matrix Bridge](https://modrinth.com/mod/matrix-bridge)) that have inspired me to create this project. ## License The mod is licensed under the AGPL-3.0 license.

title: Skew
description: Screen distortion shader with animated skew and subtle camera shake.
body:
[![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1321365/description_19767e94-ef82-4569-92c6-b1e8b60e6e07.png)](https://discord.gg/XgH4EpyPD2)

> *Subtle instability. Dynamic motion. Zero gameplay impact.*

This lightweight post-processing shader adds animated screen distortion, directional skew, and camera-like shake to create a more intense and immersive visual experience. Designed for OptiFine and Iris compatibility, it runs entirely as a fullscreen effect with minimal performance overhead.

![Portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ijajuutw/images/fc0c2b2c8cb11b881457c3bf9c3500468455e21b.png)
-
![Me](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ijajuutw/images/f935428cf35b5fb7d4ee9456f7e29d98ada71e84.png)

### ✨ Features

**Animated Screen Skew**
A time-varying shear transformation subtly bends the image horizontally and vertically, creating a dynamic sense of movement without becoming distracting.

**Micro Camera Shake**
Procedural jitter introduces tiny camera movements that make the scene feel less static. Scaled by screen resolution to remain consistent across devices.

**Dynamic Rotation**
A gentle rolling motion adds natural instability and prevents the effect from feeling mechanically repetitive.

**Scanline-Based Distortion**
A lightweight horizontal wobble effect simulates slight signal interference and enhances motion intensity during gameplay.

**Procedural Noise**
Texture-free hash noise drives the shake system, ensuring smooth animation with virtually no additional resource usage.

**Safe Edge Handling**
UV clamping prevents artifacting and edge stretching on drivers that struggle with out-of-bounds texture sampling.

---
![Zombiew](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ijajuutw/images/a286113be755b66dc5bef996bab459b76093ad5e.png)
---

### ⚙️ Technical Details

|                        |                 |
| ---------------------- | --------------- |
| **GLSL Version**       | `#version 120`  |
| **Shader Type**        | Post-Processing |
| **Pipeline**           | Composite       |
| **Performance Impact** | Very Low        |
| **Compatibility**      | OptiFine / Iris |

---

### 🎛️ Included Effects

Animated skew · screen distortion · procedural jitter · micro shake · rotational drift · scanline wobble · edge-safe texture sampling

*Built for lightweight cinematic motion and enhanced visual intensity.*

title: CancelChat Fabric
description: Prevent chat messages from appearing.
body:
# CancelChat

Prevent chat messages sent by players from appearing to other players.

## Players

This mod should not be installed on the client. Players do not need it.

## Standalone servers

This mod could technically be used to disable the chat on standalone Fabric servers — but messages will still be sent to the server console. This may be useful if a mod relies on chat input for data entry.

## Proxies (Bungeecord, Velocity, etc.)

This mod is intended to be installed on your **backend Fabric** servers. It prevents messages from being broadcast to other players, but still allows the message to be processed by the server.

It is intended for situations where a chat handling plugin (i.e. [HuskChat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/huskchat)) is used on your proxy, but you still need messages to be passed through to your backend server, e.g. for [Discord Integration](https://modrinth.com/plugin/dcintegration).

For Spigot servers, see [this plugin]([https://github.com/WiIIiam278/CancelChat](https://github.com/WiIIiam278/CancelChat)).

title: StackCluster Optimizer
description: A lightweight client-side FPS optimization mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric).
body:
A lightweight client-side FPS optimization mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric).
When large amounts of the same item are dropped on the ground in a pile — like after a mob farm, bulk crafting, or a death — Minecraft renders every single item entity individually, which can tank your FPS. StackCluster fixes this by detecting clusters of the same item and hiding a configurable percentage of them visually. The items still exist and can be picked up normally — they're just not rendered.
Features:

Fully client-side — works on any server, no server-side install needed
Configurable cluster radius (how far to search for same-type items)
Configurable minimum cluster size (how many items trigger culling)
Configurable cull percentage (how many items in a cluster to hide)
Master on/off toggle
In-game config screen via ModMenu + Cloth Config

Requirements:

Fabric Loader 0.19+

Fabric API

Cloth Config

ModMenu (optional, for in-game config screen)


Performance tip: The default settings (3 block radius, min 3 items, 90% culled) are conservative. For mob farms or bulk item drops, try radius 5-6 and 95% cull for maximum FPS gains.

title: Torch on the belt
description: Wear a torch on your belt, light the way hands-free, and remove it anytime with a keybind.
body:
![Torch on the belt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15c6cce1990fd0539c62fed0ad2a1708b65d1f91.png)

**Torch on the belt** is a Fabric mod for **Minecraft 1.21.11** that lets you equip a **regular vanilla torch** on your belt and carry light without keeping it in your hand.

Designed for players who want a simple and immersive solution for exploration, this mod gives you a moving light source while keeping your hands free for mining, combat, building, or using tools.

## Features

- Equip a normal torch on your belt with `V`
- Remove it and return it to your inventory with `G`
- Emits moving light around the player while equipped
- Keeps the normal vanilla right-click torch placement
- Uses a standard vanilla torch instead of adding a separate custom item
- Visually appears on the player model for a more immersive look

## Why use it?

Exploring caves with a torch in your hand is inconvenient, especially when you need to mine, fight, or move quickly.  
**Torch on the belt** solves that problem by letting you wear your torch instead of holding it.

You keep the familiar vanilla torch, but gain a cleaner and more practical exploration experience.

## How it works

1. Hold a normal torch in your hand
2. Press `V` to equip it on your belt
3. The torch is removed from your inventory and attached to your player
4. While equipped, it creates moving light around you
5. Press `G` to remove it and return it to your inventory

## Notes

- Works with **regular vanilla torches**
- Torches can still be placed normally with right-click
- If your inventory is full when removing the torch, it will be dropped near the player
- Requires **Fabric API**

## Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.11
- **Mod Loader:** Fabric
- **Dependency:** Fabric API

# Cobblemon PC Export

A lightweight client-side mod that exports your Cobblemon PC box data to an excel (.xlsx) workbook with images of the Pokémon.

## Features
Every Pokémon is exported as a detailed row, plus the mod allows for a complete control over what fields are exported to excel. 

- Box #
- Slot #
- Box Name
- PC UUID
- Species
- Dex #
- Form
- Nickname
- UUID
- Level
- XP
- Friendship
- Shiny
- Gender
- Tera Type
- Primary Type
- Secondary Type
- All Types
- Aspects
- Size
- Held Item Visible
- Marks
- Markings
- Cosmetic Item
- Ability Name
- Ability Description
- Original Nature
- Minted Nature
- Current Nature
- Original Trainer UUID
- Original Trainer Name (Not reliable, use UUID and NameMC).
- Caught Ball
- Held Item
- IVs (HP/ATK/DEF/SP.ATK/SP.DEF/SPD)
- EVs (HP/ATK/DEF/SP.ATK/SP.DEF/SPD)
- Stats (HP/ATK/DEF/SP.ATK/SP.DEF/SPD)
- Base (HP/ATK/DEF/SP.ATK/SP.DEF/SPD)
- Height (m)
- Weight (kg)
- Moves 1–4 (Name, Type, Category, Power, Accuracy, Max PP)
- Benched Moves


## How to Use

Option 1: 
Export while in the Cobblemon PC!
1. Open your Cobblemon PC in-game.
2. Press **F9** (default keybind) to export the currently visible box to an Excel file.
3. The output folder will open automatically when the export finishes.

Option 2:
You can use the /pcexport chat command to quickly export multiple boxes. When playing multiplayer you may have to open your PC box at least once before using the chat command to export.

```
/pcexport 1          → Export Box 1
/pcexport 1,2,3      → Export Boxes 1, 2, and 3
```

It is recommended to allocate **at least 6gb** of memory to Minecraft to prevent your client from crashing when trying to export a large number of PC boxes filled with Pokemon.

```
/pcexport all        → Export all boxes ("Disable Export Limits" must be set to yes in settings first)
```

*Not affiliated with the official Cobblemon project.*

# 🏦 Monier: The Ultimate Economy Solution

**Transform your Minecraft world with a modern, fully integrated banking and economy system.**

Monier goes beyond simple currency. It introduces a comprehensive financial ecosystem designed for both roleplay servers and survival multiplayer. Whether you are trading with players, negotiating with villagers, or managing your digital fortune, Monier provides the tools you need.

## ✨ Key Features

### 💳 Advanced Credit Card System
Forget about carrying stacks of gold or emeralds that clog up your inventory.
* **Cashless Economy:** Carry your entire fortune in a single item.
* **Secure Payments:** Use your Credit Card to access ATMs and make instant purchases.
* **Status Symbol:** Cards act as a physical representation of your digital balance.

### 💸 Instant Money Transfer
Banking made easy. Send and receive money seamlessly.
* **Player-to-Player (P2P):** Send funds to your friends or pay for services instantly with simple commands or the banking UI.
* **No Fees:** Direct transfers designed for a fluid server economy.

### 👨‍🌾 Modern Villager Commerce
The natives have evolved! Villagers are now integrated into the global economy.
* **Economic Trading:** Villager trades are no longer limited to just Emeralds.
* **Dynamic Interaction:** Interact with villagers using the Monier economy system for a more immersive trading experience.

### 🏧 The ATM Booth & Banking
A fully functional, high-value banking machine.
* **Physical Banking:** Withdraw and deposit cash physically in the world.
* **Market Value:** The ATM block itself is a high-value item ($1,000,000), making it perfect for server shops, banks, or as a display of wealth.

### 📈 Dynamic Market Registry
* **Smart Pricing:** Item values are calculated dynamically based on their crafting recipes and material costs.
* **Real-time Economy:** Buy and sell items with prices that make sense. Rare items like Netherite and Diamonds hold significant value, while common blocks remain affordable.

---

## 🚀 Installation

1.  Download and install **Fabric Loader**.
2.  Ensure you have **Fabric API** installed.
3.  Download **Architectury API** (Required).
4.  Place `Monier.jar` into your `mods` folder.

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Feel free to open an issue on our tracker!

title: RaySteal
description: ❤️‍🩹 A complete Lifesteal plugin for Spigot & Paper. Steal hearts from other players, craft powerful items, and revive friends from a unique "ghost" 👻 state!
body:
# RaySteal: The Ultimate Lifesteal Core
RaySteal is a complete Lifesteal Core plugin for Spigot & Paper servers, designed for Minecraft 1.21+. It transforms survival gameplay by linking player health directly to combat. Gain hearts by defeating your enemies, but be careful—losing a fight will cost you your own!

This plugin is designed to be a drag-and-drop solution for any server wanting to add a high-stakes Lifesteal mechanic.

---

### ❤️ Core Features
* **Heart Stealing:** Slay other players to steal their hearts and increase your maximum health.
* **High-Stakes PvP:** Losing hearts makes you weaker, creating intense and meaningful combat.
* **Unique Elimination System:** When a player runs out of hearts, they aren't banned. They become a "ghost" in a purgatory-like state—weak and unable to interact with the world until a friend revives them.
* **Craftable Items:** Craft powerful "Hearts" to permanently increase your health and legendary "Revival Totems" to bring your eliminated friends back from the brink.
* **Interactive GUIs:** Use the Revival Totem to open a menu of eliminated players, or use `/rs recipe` to see how to craft the custom items.
* **Configurable Sounds:** Every command and action has a configurable sound effect for immersive feedback.
* **Fully Configurable:** Almost everything can be changed in the config files, from crafting recipes to sound effects and heart drop rules.
* **HD Texture Pack Ready:** Full support for custom textures via `CustomModelData`.

---

### 📖 Commands & Permissions
The main command is `/raysteal` or `/rs`.

#### Player Commands (`raysteal.use` - default)
* `/rs help` - Shows a clickable list of all commands.
* `/rs hearts [player]` - Check your own or another player's hearts.
* `/rs withdraw <amount>` - Convert your life force into physical heart items.
* `/rs recipe` - Opens a GUI showing the crafting recipes.

#### Admin Commands (`raysteal.admin`)
* `/rs revive <player>` - Revive an eliminated player.
* `/rs sethearts <player> <amount>` - Set a player's max hearts.
* `/rs giveheart <player> <amount>` - Give heart items to a player.
* `/rs setdeathloc` - Sets the location where eliminated players are sent.
* `/rs reload` - Reloads the configuration files.

---

### 🛠️ Crafting Recipes

**Default Heart Recipe:**

![Default Heart Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75e0d9dac3a0b311b7eca9aa33f8c8797717b6af.png)

**Default Revival Totem Recipe:**

![Default Revival Totem Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9655962ba1972922114a50b8fecfbcadf650225.png)

---
### 🔧 Setup
1.  Drop the `RaySteal.jar` into your server's `plugins` folder.
2.  Start your server to generate the default configuration files.
3.  **(Admin)** Use `/rs setdeathloc` at the location where you want eliminated players to be sent.
4.  Enjoy the chaos!

While playing Minecraft, have you ever been concerned about how diamonds never looked edible enough? Have you longed for an emerald that looked like it could give you the same euphoric sensation as biting down into a delectable green apple fruit gusher?

If you said yes to any of those questions, that's a little bit concerning... You okay there, pal..?


...Oh, and also, this resource pack is the perfect thing for you! Probably.

## Overview

<details>
<summary>In-game screenshot</summary>

![The modified gem textures as shown in-game, along with a few other modified blocks related to them.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ddntlBwE/images/9a7140fa6dfe3b88dcb1df1637ce028aa7327557.png)

This small pack modifies the item textures of **diamonds** and **emeralds** to make them look more like their respective gems while still maintaining the same color palette and general shape. title: Command on Interval
description:
A mod runs in-game command with customize configs.
一款可执行游戏内命令的模组，外加自定义设置
body:
**[English](https://github.com/FelixAgairu/command-on-interval/blob/main/README.md)** [简体中文](https://github.com/FelixAgairu/command-on-interval/blob/main/README-zh_cn.md)
## What is that
A mod runs in-game command with customize configs.\
For now the commands will run as soon as server mod initialize.

## Use
Also load the require mod [Config Manager](https://modrinth.com/mod/config-manager)\
Remember that Singleplayer contains an integrated server.

## Features
- Multi-command support
- Ticks or seconds: Whether use game ticks or seconds (20 ticks) in timing
- Delays: Add delay before command run
- Interval: The cycle of each command does
- ~~There's no reason to run a command from Java code~~

## Example
![eg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50dbf240015376229c8493ce18401910cf1004d1_0.webp)
`command_on_interval.json`:
```json
{
   "0":{
      "enabled":true,
      "unit-use-ticks":false,
      "delay":0,
      "interval":10,
      "command":"say Hello, world!"
   },
   "1":{
      "enabled":true,
      "unit-use-ticks":true,
      "delay":0,
      "interval":180,
      "command":"time set day"
   },
   "2":{
      "enabled":true,
      "unit-use-ticks":true,
      "delay":5,
      "interval":200,
      "command":"kill @e[type=item]"
   }
}
```

## Config
Locate your config in Minecraft installation location.\
> Default location using official launcher on Windows:\
> `%APPDATA%\.minecraft\config\command_on_interval.json`\
> Or\
> `C:\Users\YOUR_USER_NAME\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\config\command_on_interval.json`

You will get somethings like that:
```json
{
   "0":{
      "enabled":true,
      "unit-use-ticks":false,
      "delay":0,
      "interval":10,
      "command":""
   }
}
```

#### "0"
> No. 1 command，you can add `"1"` also `"2"` etc...

#### enabled
> True enable this entry of setting, vice versa

#### unit-use-ticks
> For delay or interval, `true` use ticks, `false` ues seconds

#### delay
> Delay before each command runs

#### interval
> Cycles interval for each command

#### command
> In-game command without **`/`** prefix\
> Eg. `time set day`

# Polydex2REI
Bridging the Gap Between Polymer and REI — Let Your Recipes Be Seen

## 📦 What is Polydex2REI?
Polydex2REI is a compatibility addon that connects Polymer and REI (Roughly Enough Items), enabling full support for virtual items and custom recipes defined by Polydex.

By default, REI cannot recognize Polymer’s server-side virtual items, leading to missing entries in recipe viewers and item lookups. Polydex2REI fixes that.

## 🔧 Features
- 📘 Supports custom recipes registered via the Polydex API
- 🔄 Synchronizes item lookup actions — clicking or keypress correctly opens the recipe page
- 💡 Works with both server-side and client-side virtual items
-🌐 Requires both sides installed to function properly
- ❓ Why Use It?
If you're a modpack creator or developer using Polymer to register virtual items (e.g. recipe placeholders, guide items, UI buttons), you’ve likely run into the issue: REI can’t find them. This addon solves that cleanly — no extra setup, just plug and play.

## 🧩 Requirements
Polymer
REI
Polydex
Must be installed on both client and server

# FPS Limit Fix

Improved FPS limiting for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 running on the [Ornithe Toolchain](https://ornithemc.net/).

## Details

Changes the `Power Saver` limit from `40` to `60` instead, as this is a more common refresh rate.  
Ensures the `Balanced` limit of `120` FPS is actually adhered to, instead of resulting in no limiting.

Additionally, the built-in FPS limiter is replaced with a vastly superior implementation provided by LWJGL.

title: JLM
description: JoinLeaveMessages is a plug—in for Paper that allows you to customize player entry and exit messages with support for color codes and name substitution. Enables the command to update the configuration without restarting the server.
body:
JoinLeaveMessages is a lightweight and user—friendly plugin that allows you to set up personalized messages when players log in and out on the server. You can use it to add more atmosphere, welcome new players, or simply decorate the chat with beautiful colored notifications.

---------------

✨ Capabilities:

✔ Custom greetings and goodbyes – set your own unique messages for players to enter and exit.

✔ Color code support – Use ```&``` to change text color.

✔ Dynamic nickname substitution – ```%player%``` is replaced with the player's name.

✔ Flexible configuration via ```config.yml``` – easily edit messages without changing the code.
 The ```/ljmreload``` command is an instant reboot of the configuration without the need to restart the server.

-------------------

⚙ How to Install?

1️⃣ Download ```JoinLeaveMessages.jar```.

2️⃣ Move the file to the ```plugins/``` folder.

3️⃣ Start the server to generate the ```config.yml``` file.

4️⃣ Edit ```plugins/JoinLeaveMessages/config.yml```:


```
join_message: "&aWelcome, %player%!"
quit_message: "&c%player% has left the server."
```
5️⃣ Use ```/ljmreload``` in-game or in the console to apply changes.

----------------

| Command           | 	Description            | Permission             |
|---------------------|:---------------------:|---------------------:|
| ```/ljmreload```           | Reloads the plugin configuration             | 	```ljm.reload```   

--------

📥 Download, customize, and create a welcoming atmosphere on your server with JoinLeaveMessages! 🎉

# Better Minecarts

- Place down two minecarts (any type) one block apart from each other on rail blocks (any type).

- If you wish to unlink a minecart, shift and attack the minecart once, giving you a chain and unlinking it. Alternatively, breaking (no shifting required) a linked minecart will also drop a chain and unlink it.

- Unlink minecarts by sneaking/attacking or unloading

title: Custom-Death-Messages
description: A Plugin thats lets you configure custom death messages random or with a specific death corse
body:
# CustomDeaths

![banner](https://github.com/BlackDevCoding/BlackDevAssets/blob/main/banner.png?raw=true)

Rule-based, funny death messages for Minecraft. Designed for **PaperMC 1.21.x** and **Java 21**. Shows the **original vanilla death message on hover** while broadcasting your customized one.

---

⚠️ **Irreversible (Messaging Only):** This plugin *replaces broadcast death messages*. It does not change drops, XP, or inventories, but your chat history cannot be “un-broadcast.” Use with care.

---

## ✅ Supported Platforms & Requirements

- **Minecraft server:** PaperMC 1.21.x (API 1.21).  
- Works on Paper-compatible forks that maintain API parity (e.g., Purpur).  
- **Java runtime:** Java 21 (server + build).

---

## ✨ Features

- **Custom Death Rules:** Define messages by conditions:
  - Damage cause, world, biome
  - Y height (above/below)
  - Killer type, name, or whether killer is a player
  - Victim permissions or held item
- **Original on Hover:** Vanilla death message remains available as a hover tooltip.  
- **Enable/Disable Quickly:** Toggle via `/customdeaths toggle` or set `enabled: true|false`.  
- **Per-Cause & Global Messages:** Simple config lists.  
- **Presets Included:** Ship with defaults; disable via `use-presets: false`.  
- **Hot Reload:** `/customdeaths reload` applies changes without restart.

---

## 📦 Commands

- `/customdeaths reload` — Reload `config.yml`.  
- `/customdeaths toggle` — Flip the master `enabled` flag on/off.  

### Permissions
- `customdeaths.admin` — default: **op**

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (`plugins/CustomDeaths/config.yml`)

```yaml
enabled: true
hover-original: true
override-broadcast: true
use-presets: true

messages:
  - "{player} took a permanent nap without setting an alarm."

per-cause:
  VOID:
    - "{player} fell off the edge of the internet."

# Custom rules (first match wins)
custom-deaths:
  - name: "archer_headshot"
    when:
      killer-type: "SKELETON"
      y-above: 100
    messages:
      - "{player} got a high-altitude headshot from {killer}."

presets:
  messages:
    - "{player} opened the hardcore tutorial."
  per-cause:
    FALL:
      - "{player} mistook the ground for a trampoline."
```

**Supported `when` keys**
- `cause` (DamageCause), `world`, `biome`  
- `y-above`, `y-below`  
- `killer-type` (EntityType), `killer-name`, `killer-is-player`  
- `victim-has-permission`, `victim-holding`  

**Placeholders:** `{player}`, `{killer}`, `{cause}`

---

## 🧭 How it Works

1. On `PlayerDeathEvent`, the plugin checks **custom-deaths** rules in order.  
2. First match wins; if none, it falls back to **per-cause**, then **messages**, then **presets**.  
3. The chosen line is broadcast, with the vanilla message shown on hover (if enabled).  

---

## 📥 Installation

1. Drop the plugin JAR into `plugins/` on a Paper 1.21.x server.  
2. Start the server to generate `config.yml`.  
3. Edit `plugins/CustomDeaths/config.yml`.  
4. Apply changes with `/customdeaths reload` (or restart).  

---

## 🔒 Safety Notes

- Only the broadcasted death message is replaced; no inventories, XP, or drops are touched.  
- Ensure admins understand that **first match wins** in `custom-deaths`.  

---

## 📄 License

MIT — free to use and contribute.

title: Whispers of adventure
description:
Modpack somewhere between Vanilla+ and modded, suitable for both experienced players and beginners.
It focuses on exploration, atmosphere and aesthetics, transforming the basic game into an RPG without inserting complicated mechanics.
body:
![A Minecraft-stylized title where it is written "Minecraft - Whispers of adventure."](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93cab4e9926a8c5f15fe18c5be712d4197d1c8e0.png)
## Presentation :

**Whispers of adventure** is a modpack somewhere between Vanilla+ and modded, suitable for both experienced players and beginners.
It focuses on exploration, atmosphere and aesthetics, transforming the basic game into an RPG without inserting complicated mechanics.

The modpack is available in 4 versions :
- **Whispers of adventure - Full version :** Full version.
	- If you keep the "Distant Horizons" mod activated, it is extremely recommend to set the memory allocation of your instance to 4096 MB or more.
- **Whispers of adventure - Medium version :** Lighter version, suitable for less powerful computers.
- **Whispers of adventure - Essential version :** Extremely light version containing only the mods needed to join a server containing this modpack. Not recommended if you want a full experience.
- **Whispers of adventure - Server version :** Dedicated server version.
  - To install it on a Minecraft server, you need to install it into a Modrinth instance, and then transfer the necessary files and folders on the server.

**⚠️ Please always download the latest version for the best experience ! ⚠️**

**ℹ️ See the Q&A section below for instructions on how to update the modpack. ℹ️**

Important mods include :
- A map RPG-style terrain generation mod
- 10 large structures mods
- A skill mod
- A terrain generation mod and a structure mod for the End
- 2 new dimensions:
	- The Heaven
	- The Afterdark
- A few mods adding new enchantments
- 2 teleportation mods

**The base config of the modpack may give very powerful abilities to the player very quickly.** If you prefer a slower progression, you are free to change the mods configurations. This config is designed to allow casual players to level up quickly, but it can be too easy for advanced players. If you want to make the modpack more progressive, you can adjust the totem spawn probability of the Everlasting Abilities mod, and disable the BeyondEnchant mod.

## Q&A :

<details>
<summary>How to choose which version of the modpack to install ?</summary>

The easiest way to determine the most suitable version of the modpack for your computer, is to start with the largest version, and switch to the next lighter version if it is not playable.
Please keep in mind that the performances can be very different whether you are playing solo or on a server. You generally need a less powerful computer to play on a server, as the server runs some processes for you.
Here is the order with which you can try :
- Whispers of adventure - Full version
- Whispers of adventure - Medium version
- Whispers of adventure - Essential version

</details>

<details>
<summary>Can I modify and redistribute the modpack ?</summary>

You can modify and redistribute the modpack, but you CANNOT redistribute it under the same name and without mentioning the author's pseudo.
Remember that all credits must be given to the creators of the mods, datapack and resource packs.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Can I add mods/datapacks/resource packs to this modpack ?</summary>

You can do whatever you like. If you're on a server, follow the server's rules.

</details>


<details>
<summary>How to update the modpack to a newer version without losing my own config (keybinds, mod configs, etc) ?</summary>

If you want to update to a newer version, but don't want to lose your own congif (for example if you want to keep your own keybinds, mod configs, etc), you can do the following :
- Install the latest version of the modpack (without deleting the old one !).
- Open the instance folders of the old and the new modpack version :
  - Open the old modpack instance.
  - Click on "...".
  - Click on "Open folder".
  - Do the same for the new modpack instance.
- Copy the following files or folders from the old version's folder to the new version's folder (replace them if they already exist) :
  - Distant_Horizons_server_data
  - saves
  - xaero
  - XaeroWaypoints_BACKUP...
  - command_history.txt
  - options.txt
  - servers.dat
  - Optionally, if you prefer some mod configs of your old instance, you can also copy them. Be aware that it can potentially overwrite some configs that have been modified in the new version (for example for bug-fixing purposes).
- Launch the game to check that it works.
- If the game works and you don't see any missing data, you can delete the old version of the modpack.

</details>

<details>
<summary>I'm having major performance problems. What can I do ?</summary>

If you're playing with the "Distant Horizons" mod, check that you have at least 4096 MB of memory allocated to the instance (if you have enough RAM, of course).
If you don't have enough RAM, disable the “Distant Horizons” mod.
If you still have performance problems, use the next lighter version of the modpack.

</details>

<details>
<summary>There are errors in the console when using the modpack. Is this normal ?</summary>

Yes, some mods give minor errors. If I've kept the mods causing the error, that means they should normally work correctly.

</details>

## Notes :

Please do not contact me for mod-related bugs. I am not responsible for the development of the mods contained in this modpack.

Feel free to join my Discord server if you have any questions about this modpack.

## Mods :

<details>
<summary>Terrain generation </summary>

- **Enderscape :** Total overhaul of the End dimension, featuring new world generation, four new biomes, revamped End Cities, and many other additions that enrich the End and all that lies beyond.
- **Larion World Generation :** Terrain generation mod that overhauls the style and layout of world generation in a modern-vanilla-like "epic fantasy" style.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Structures :</summary>

- **Dungeons and Taverns :** Adds vanilla like structures that are supposed to blend in with the rest of the game and feel like they belong there.
- **Katters Structures :** Adds 30+ brand-new vanilla-like structures to the game.
- **Sparse Structures :** Allows to make all structures more spread out.
- **Tidal Towns :** Adds ocean villages.
- **YUNG's Better Desert Temples :** Redesigns Minecraft's desert temples.
- **YUNG's Better Dungeons :** Redesigns Minecraft's dungeons.
- **YUNG's Better End Island :** Overhauls the main End Island.
- **YUNG's Better Jungle Temples :** Redesigns Minecraft's jungle temples.
- **YUNG's Better Mineshafts :** Overhauls the abandoned mineshaft.
- **YUNG's Better Nether Fortresses :** Redesigns Minecraft's Nether fortresses.
- **YUNG's Better Ocean Monuments :** Redesigns Minecraft's ocean monuments.
- **YUNG's Better Strongholds :** Redesigns Minecraft's strongholds.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Atmosphere and visuals :</summary>

- **3D Skin Layers :** Replaces the usually flat second layer of player skins with a 3d modeled version.
- **AmbientSounds :** Adds a rich ambience to the minecraft world.
- **Astrocraft :** Adds a realistic night sky with real life stars, planets and other things.
- **Chunks fade in :** Adds smooth fade-in and motion animations for chunk loading.
- **Distant Horizons :** Add simplified terrain past Minecraft's default view distance to improve performance and allow for longer draw distances.
- **Iris Shaders :** Allows to use shaders.
- **LambDynamicLights :** Adds dynamic lighting.
- **Particle Rain :** Replaces the default weather with prettier particle effects.
- **Reactive Music :** Trades Minecraft's default music for something dynamic, reactive, and ever-changing.
  - Modified to deactivate the boss's music.
- **Sound Physics Remastered :** Provides realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and absorption through blocks.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Magic :</summary>

- **BeyondEnchant :** Allows you to break the traditional limits of enchantments.
- **Enchants Plus :** Add new enchantments that feel vanilla and spice up the game.
- **Grind Enchantments :** Allows to disenchant and transfer enchantments using a grindstone.
- **Neo Enchant+ :** Add new enchantments to the game.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Abilities :</summary>

- **Everlasting Abilities :** Adds persistent abilities that can be impactful on the gameplay.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Dimensions :</summary>

- **Heaven Dimension :** Add a Heaven dimension far above the ground.
  - Modified to increase the height for the teleportation in the Heaven dimension.
- **The Afterdark :** Adds a new dimension accessed from a structure near a Ancient City.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Transportation :</summary>

- **Telepass :** Adds a way to players to teleport to each other.
- **Waystones :** Adds waystone blocks that the player can return to once they've been activated.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Improved GUIs :</summary>

- **Better Advancements :** Improves the UI and UX for the advancements system.
- **Better Statistics Screen :** Replaces the Vanilla statistics screen with an new and improved statistics screen that is easier to use and that has more helpful features.
- **BetterF3 :** Replaces Minecraft's original debug HUD with a highly customizable, more human-readable HUD.
- **FPS - Display :** Displays the current FPS on screen.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Performances :</summary>

- **Chunky :** \[Optional\] Allows to pre-generates chunks, quickly, efficiently, and safely.
- **Dynamic FPS :** Reduce resource usage while Minecraft is in the background, idle, or on battery.
- **FerriteCore :** Reduces the memory usage of Minecraft in a few different ways.
- **Lithium :** Modern, general-purpose optimization mod for Minecraft which works to improve a number of systems (game physics, mob AI, block ticking, etc) with the goal of not changing any vanilla mechanics.
- **Noisium :** Optimises worldgen performance for a better gameplay experience.
- **Sodium :** Powerful optimization mod for the Minecraft client, which greatly improves frame rates and micro-stutter, while fixing many graphical issues in Minecraft.
- **Sodium Extra :** Brings most of OptiFine's eye-candy options to Sodium, in addition to providing some features such as visual bug fixes and other performance options that are not yet available on Sodium.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Difficulty :</summary>

- **Progressive Ender Eyes :** Changes the recipe for Ender Eyes.
- **True Ending: Ender Dragon Overhaul :** Overhauls the vanilla Ender Dragon to improve and make more difficult the fight against it.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Utilities :</summary>

- **Bottle Your Xp :** Allows the creation of experience bottles from your own gathered xp.
- **Durability Tooltip :** Shows the durability of items.
- **Easy Anvils :** Makes working with anvils much more enjoyable.
- **Easy Magic :** Enables enchanting tables to retain their inventory contents even after closing the interface.
- **Easy Shulker Boxes :** Brings some extremely useful changes to shulker boxes, making them usable from directly within your inventory.
- **FallingTree :** Allows to break trees instantly.
- **Lootr :** Creates a unique inventory for each player who opens a container that has a loot table.
- **Monsters in the Closet :** Highlights the mobs that prevent the player from sleeping.
- **Nemo's Inventory Sorting :** Adds buttons to inventories for sorting items.
- **Passive Shield :** Disable the rendering of the shield when not used.
- **Resource Backpack's :** Adds backpacks.
- **Roughly Enough Items (REI) :** Allows to view all items and their recipe(s).
- **Simple Voice Chat :** Adds proximity voice chat.
- **Trade Cycling :** Adds a trade cycling functionality.
- **Universal Graves :** Adds graves to temporarily store the items of the players when they die.
- **Xaero's World Map :** Adds a world-map.
- **Zoomify :** Adds a zoom.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Others :</summary>

- **AudioPlayer :** Allows you to put your own audio files on music discs.
- **Disable Accessibility Screen :** Skips the Accessibility Screen menu when launching into a new Minecraft instance.
- **Disable Custom Worlds Advice :** Disables the annoying "Experimental Features" advice that appears every time you create or load a world with custom dimensions or world settings.
- **Disable Insecure Chat Toast :** Deletes warning toast about connecting to a server without enforce secure chat.
- **Disable Portals :** \[Server only\] Allows for the disabling of nether portals and end portals.
- **Drippy Loading Screen :** Addon for FancyMenu for fully customizing Minecraft’s loading screen.
- **FancyMenu :** Allows personalised game GUIs.
- **Mod Menu :** Allows to view the installed mods and, if supported by the mod, enables quick and easy access to the mod's config screens.
- **Ore Creeper :** Adds creepers based on the Ores that the game includes.
- **Reese's Sodium Options** : Replaces Sodium's Options Screen with intention of improving UX.
- **Spitting Image :** Allows the player to spit.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Dependencies or libraries required :</summary>

- **\[EMF\] Entity Model Features**
- **\[ETF\] Entity Texture Features**
- **Architectury API**
- **Balm**
- **Cloth Config API**
- **Collective**
- **Continuity**
- **CreativeCore**
- **Cyclops Core**
- **Fabric API**
- **Forge Config API Port**
- **Konkrete**
- **Melody**
- **Polymer**
- **Puzzles Lib**
- **Resource Config API**
- **Resource Library**
- **SuperMartijn642's Config Lib**
- **TCDCommons API**
- **Text Placeholder API**
- **YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)**
- **YUNG's API**

</details>

## Ressource packs :

<details>
<summary>Improved GUIs :</summary>

- **Colourful containers Dark Mode GUI :** Adds a container GUI replacement mod that matches the menu to every one of Minecraft's colourful interactable blocks.
- **Colourful containers GUI** : Adds a container GUI replacement mod that hopes to match the menu to every one of Minecraft's colourful interactable blocks.
- **Default Dark Mode :** Gives the Minecraft GUI a darker look while maintaining the vanilla textures.
- **Default Dark Mode: Expansion :** Add-on towards the "Default Dark Mode" Resource Pack which adds, improves and updates textures for over 80-90 Minecraft mods.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Atmosphere and visuals :</summary>

- **Fresh Animations :** Gives an animation overhaul to the creatures in the default look of Minecraft.
- **Fresh Moves :** Overhauls the idle, walking and swimming animation and gives some othe details to the player.
- **New Glowing Ores :** Makes all the ores glow.
- **ReactiveMusic_SongPack :** Default songpack of the Reactive Music mod, but modified to remove the boss songs.

</details>

## Included shaders :

- **Complementary Shaders - Unbound**

## Issues :

- The Universal Graves mod does not recognize the backpack slot. If you die with a backpack in this slot, the backpack will drop as an item.
- The Particle Rain mod isn't fully compatible with shaders. Since it was primarily added to the modpack for use without shaders, you can disable them if you experience any issues.

## Credits :

All credits go entirely to the creators of the mods, datapacks and resource packs contained in this modpack.

title: CrownCrawl
description: It is a mod still in development that aims to improve the vanilla experience of the game by adding new bosses and items.
body:
![crowncrawl is the logo of the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c2933a6d0b83953c2916faa719026b856be45f2.png)          

CrownCrawl is a Forge mod that expands the world of Minecraft with entirely new creatures inspired by real-life insects, amphibians, and original fantasy designs.

Explore a more dynamic and dangerous environment featuring frogs, flies, snails, and powerful enhanced versions of these mobs. Face unique bosses, discover custom items, and craft special gear with new mechanics.

⚠️ Warning: This mod is meant to be more difficult than standard Minecraft. Be prepared for a tougher survival experience.
💡 Tip: This mod is fully compatible with JEI, which is highly recommended for viewing all crafting recipes in-game.

![All the mobs added by this mod! Including frogs, snails, flies... and their upgraded versions!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/169552d15088f18e73b67e5ba27c0e48ce67b8c2.png)
